title: Hierarchical BM25: Lexical Search at Billion-Document Scale
summary:
A flat BM25 index over one billion documents occupies about 400 GB. Holding it in memory requires DRAM proportional to corpus size. Serving it from disk takes 4-12 seconds per query. Exact top-k lexical retrieval at this scale is therefore impractical within an interactive latency budget.
  Hierarchical BM25 gives up exact ranking in exchange for fixed bounds on memory and latency. A resident coarse index selects which of ~1K topical, size-balanced document groups a query visits, using two signals: the total frequency of each query term within a group, and, for informative terms spread too thinly across groups for frequency totals to reflect, whether several of them appear together in one document. Selected groups are then searched exhaustively and scored against ~100 KB of global statistics. Every returned score therefore equals the flat index's score, and the approximation is confined to selection alone. The resident footprint is ~4.4 GB, independent of corpus size. Sixteen-term queries over one billion documents return in ~300 ms (4.7x to 5.6x the throughput of a flat multi-threaded index), and a warmed cache sustains ~32 queries per second versus under 3 for flat indexing. At a 500K-document configuration, visiting 5-10% of clusters recovers 0.83-0.92 of the exhaustive result score. Billion-scale recall and a direct comparison against document-reordered BlockMax-WAND remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层BM25索引（Hierarchical BM25），通过粗粒度索引选择文档组而非全量扫描，在固定内存（~4.4GB）和延迟预算内实现十亿级文档的近似top-k词法检索，单查询约300ms。
AI.motivation: 平坦BM25索引在十亿文档规模下需要约400GB内存或每次查询4-12秒的磁盘延迟，无法满足交互式延迟预算。需要一种在固定资源约束下实现大规模词法检索的方法。
AI.method: 构建层次化索引：驻留内存的粗粒度索引将~1000个主题、大小均衡的文档组作为选择单元。选择基于两个信号——组内每个查询词的总词频，以及对分布在多组中的信息词检测文档内共现。选中组进行穷举搜索，用~100KB全局统计量评分，保证每次返回分数与平坦索引一致，近似仅发生在组选择阶段。
AI.result: 驻留内存仅4.4GB且与语料大小无关；十亿文档、16词查询约300ms（吞吐量为平坦多线程索引的4.7-5.6倍）；热缓存下每秒约32个查询 vs 平坦索引不到3个。50万文档配置下访问5-10%的簇可恢复0.83-0.92的穷举结果分数。
AI.conclusion: 分层BM25在牺牲精确排序的前提下，以固定内存换取了显著的查询延迟提升，使十亿级词法检索进入交互式延迟范围。未来工作包括十亿级召回率评估和与BlockMax-WAND的直接比较。

title: CeQe: Grounding Lexical Retrieval in Semantic Evidence
summary: Lexical retrieval (BM25) captures exact keyword matches and weights terms by corpus-wide significance, but it is blind to the semantic vocabulary gap: when a relevant document phrases an answer differently from the query, BM25 never retrieves it, and no amount of downstream reranking or fusion can recover a document that was never in the candidate set. We present Cross-Encoder Query Expansion (CE-QE), which reads the per-token relevance attributions of a cross-encoder applied to top semantic search results, selects the terms the cross-encoder treats as decisive, and appends them to the BM25 query. Unlike classical pseudo-relevance feedback, which reuses BM25's own (possibly wrong) top results, CE-QE seeds expansion from the semantic retriever's results, avoiding self-reinforcing query drift. Unlike recent generative query expansion (HyDE, Query2doc), which prompts a large language model to hallucinate text from its parametric knowledge, every CE-QE expansion term is copied verbatim from a retrieved passage, so it cannot introduce vocabulary the corpus does not contain, and its only added cost is attribution extraction on a cross-encoder a hybrid pipeline already runs for reranking. On seven BEIR datasets, CE-QE improves lexical recall substantially where query and answer vocabulary diverge (e.g., NQ Recall@100 from 0.32 to 0.47), and its score-fusion variant (SESF) beats cross-encoder score fusion by 2.5% on Recall@100 and beats SPLADEv2 and ColBERTv2 by 5.3% and 4.6% on nDCG@10, while leaving the underlying BM25 index completely unmodified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cross-Encoder Query Expansion (CE-QE)，利用cross-encoder对语义检索结果的token级相关性归因，选择关键术语并将其附加到BM25查询中，从而弥合词汇语义鸿沟。该方法在BEIR数据集上显著提升词法召回率，且无需修改原有BM25索引。
AI.motivation: BM25等词法检索方法无法处理词汇语义鸿沟问题——当相关文档以不同措辞表达答案时，BM25永远检索不到这些文档，后续的任何重排序或融合都无法弥补候选集缺失的问题。现有伪相关反馈方法复用BM25自身可能有误的结果导致自我强化漂移，而生成式查询扩展（如HyDE）依赖大语言模型参数知识可能引入不存在于语料库的词汇。
AI.method: CE-QE通过以下步骤工作：1）对语义检索（cross-encoder）的top结果计算per-token相关性归因；2）选择cross-encoder判定为决定性的术语；3）将这些术语逐字附加到BM25查询中。关键设计：每个扩展术语都从检索到的段落中逐字复制，确保词汇存在于语料库中；成本仅为在混合流水线中已运行的cross-encoder上提取归因。
AI.result: 在7个BEIR数据集上，CE-QE在查询与答案词汇分歧的场景下大幅提升词法召回率（如NQ Recall@100从0.32提升至0.47）。其分数融合变体SESF在Recall@100上优于cross-encoder分数融合2.5%，在nDCG@10上分别优于SPLADEv2和ColBERTv2达5.3%和4.6%，且BM25索引完全无需修改。
AI.conclusion: CE-QE通过从语义检索结果中提取cross-encoder的归因术语来扩展BM25查询，既避免了传统伪相关反馈的自我强化问题，又避免了生成式扩展引入语料库外词汇的风险。该方法以极低的额外开销实现显著的词法召回提升，并且可与现有混合检索流水线无缝集成。

title: A Context-Aware Cultural Heritage Guide Powered by LLMs
summary: We present an extension of Triangolazioni (a Cultural Heritage webapp) to enrich curated content with context-dependent, external information provided by Large Language Models (LLMs) within a loosely-coupled architecture agnostic to the LLM. The system supports context-dependent information search and presentation within an architecture agnostic to the exploited LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了对文化遗产Web应用Triangolazioni的扩展，通过一种松耦合、与LLM无关的架构，将策展内容与大语言模型提供的外部上下文相关信息进行融合，实现上下文相关信息的检索与呈现。
AI.motivation: 提升文化遗产应用的内容丰富度，利用大语言模型为策展内容补充上下文相关的外部信息，同时保持架构的灵活性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 采用松耦合架构扩展Triangolazioni，该架构与具体的大语言模型无关（agnostic），支持上下文相关的信息搜索与展示，将外部LLM信息与原有策展内容相融合。
AI.result: 该扩展系统能够实现上下文相关的外部信息检索与呈现，且架构不依赖特定LLM，具有通用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过松耦合、LLM无关的架构设计，成功将LLM能力集成到文化遗产应用中，丰富了策展内容的上下文相关信息。

title: PHA-Net: Prototype-based Hierarchical Alignment Network for Text-Video Retrieval
summary: With the emergence of large-scale image-text pre-training models, e.g., CLIP, text-video retrieval has experienced substantial advances in recent years. Existing best-performing methods involve aligning cross-modal semantics at individual, local, and global levels simultaneously, raising concerns about the intrinsic semantic mismatch between concise texts and rich videos. A canonical approach is to integrate multiple language-video attention modules into the hierarchical framework while this paradigm only optimizes visual representations with prohibitive computational costs. In this paper, we propose a new prototype-based hierarchical alignment network (PHA-Net) to align individual/local/global level representations across modalities. Concretely, we introduce multiple modality-shared prototypes as the bridge to efficiently optimize text and video representations for cross-modal alignment. Then, we argue that the imbalanced semantic distribution in clustered tokens may undermine retrieval performance, as tokens with weak semantics are of little interest. To reduce the impact of these tokens, a proposed prototype-supported token merge module is responsible for enhancing tokens with strong semantics and suppressing others with weak semantics via prototype semantics guidance. Moreover, we devise a prototype contrastive loss to encourage textual and visual prototypes to focus on different semantic information. The idea of this auxiliary loss is to ensure higher similarity between textual and visual prototypes from the same prototype than those from different prototypes. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks confirm the effectiveness of our PHA-Net, which achieves significant improvements in the sum of all recalls on MSR-VTT (8.8%), ActivityNet (19.2%), VATEX (0.7%), and Charades (4.9%). Code is available at https://github.com/JingXiaolun/PHA-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于原型的层次对齐网络（PHA-Net），通过引入模态共享原型作为桥梁，高效地对齐文本和视频在个体、局部和全局三个层次上的语义表示，并设计了原型支持的分词合并模块和原型对比损失，在四个基准数据集上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能文本-视频检索方法需要在个体、局部和全局三个层次同时对齐跨模态语义，但存在两个问题：(1) 简洁文本与丰富视频之间存在固有的语义不匹配；(2) 现有集成多语言-视频注意力模块的层次框架只优化视觉表示，计算成本高昂。此外，聚类分词中语义分布不平衡会损害检索性能。
AI.method: PHA-Net包含三个核心组件：(1) 引入多个模态共享原型作为桥梁，同时高效优化文本和视频表示；(2) 原型支持的分词合并模块，通过原型语义指导增强强语义分词并抑制弱语义分词；(3) 原型对比损失，鼓励文本和视觉原型关注不同语义信息，确保同原型内对齐高于跨原型。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上取得了显著改进：MSR-VTT上所有召回率总和提升8.8%，ActivityNet提升19.2%，VATEX提升0.7%，Charades提升4.9%。
AI.conclusion: PHA-Net通过原型机制有效解决了文本-视频检索中的语义不匹配和分词语义分布不平衡问题，同时避免了高昂的计算成本，验证了原型引导的层次对齐策略的有效性。

title: EmergencyBias: Bias in Text-to-Image Models under Emergency Scenarios
summary: Bias in Text-to-Image (T2I) generation has become an important problem in multimedia content creation and communication. However, existing studies have primarily focused on relatively static and explicit forms of bias, such as disparities in the representation of gender, race, and geo-cultural attributes. Less attention has been paid to behavioral bias in how different groups are portrayed acting, reacting, and occupying social roles. Emergency scenarios provide a revealing setting for studying such bias because they require models to depict not only who is present, but also who is at risk, who intervenes, and how responsibility is allocated. In this paper, we define EmergencyBias, a form of bias in T2I generation under emergency scenarios that includes both demographic bias and behavioral bias. We construct an evaluation framework to systematically study EmergencyBias across seven leading T2I models, six representative emergency scenarios, and three demographic dimensions. Our experimental results reveal three main findings. First, under blank prompts without demographic specification, T2I models exhibit clear demographic bias in emergency scenarios, reflected in the distributions of portrayed individuals across gender, age, and skin tone. Second, under controlled prompts, behavioral bias in emergency responses remains systematically associated with demographic variation, with particularly pronounced disparities along gender and substantial differences across models. Third, we introduce ActionAlign, a lightweight prompt-embedding calibration method that outperforms a representative prompt-based baseline in reducing behavioral disparities while largely preserving image quality. Overall, our work identifies emergency scenarios as an important setting for bias evaluation in T2I models and offers a practical direction toward fairer visual generation in socially consequential contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了EmergencyBias——一种在紧急场景下图像生成模型(T2I)特有的偏见形式，包含人口统计偏见和行为偏见。研究跨越7个主流T2I模型、6种紧急场景和3个人口统计维度，揭示了空白提示下的明显人口统计偏见、受控提示下行为偏见与人口特征的系统性关联，并提出了ActionAlign这一轻量级提示嵌入校准方法来减少行为差异。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I偏见研究主要关注静态和显性偏见（如性别、种族、地域文化的表征差异），而忽视了行为偏见——即不同群体在行为方式、社会角色和责任分配上的差异。紧急场景提供了一个独特的视角来研究这类偏见，因为模型不仅需要描绘谁在场，还要描绘谁处于危险、谁干预、责任如何分配。
AI.method: 构建了EmergencyBias评估框架，涵盖人口统计偏见（谁被描绘）和行为偏见（如何被描绘）。评估了7个领先T2I模型、6种紧急场景和3个人口统计维度。并提出了ActionAlign，一种轻量级的提示嵌入校准方法，用于减少行为层面的偏见。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1) 空白人口统计提示下，T2I模型在紧急场景中表现出明显的人口统计偏见（性别、年龄、肤色分布不均）；(2) 受控提示下，行为偏见与人口统计变化系统性相关，性别维度上的差异尤为突出，且不同模型间差异显著；(3) ActionAlign在减少行为差异上优于代表性基于提示的基线方法，同时基本保持图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 紧急场景是评估T2I模型偏见的重要设置，本研究为在社会影响深远的场景中实现更公平的视觉生成提供了实用方向。

title: SDDMO-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Streaming Data-Driven Dynamic Multi-Objective Optimization
comment: Submitted to IEEE MIND Conference. This submission contains main manuscript and supplementary materials. Corresponding author: Hui Bai
summary: Streaming data-driven dynamic multi-objective optimization requires algorithms to track time-varying Pareto fronts using only sequential observations under concept drift. However, systematic evaluation remains difficult because real-world problems usually lack ground-truth optima, drift annotations, and controllable conditions, while existing benchmarks provide limited support for standardized comparison. This paper proposes SDDMO-Bench, a benchmark suite that transforms classical dynamic multi-objective test problems into streaming environments by combining intrinsic objective-mapping evolution, controllable distributional drift, and sequential data revelation. By combining five representative time-dependent base functions with six distributional drift patterns, SDDMO-Bench constructs 30 scenarios with diverse levels of non-stationarity, problem complexity, sample-distribution variation, and Pareto-front evolution. Experiments with representative evolutionary algorithms demonstrate that SDDMO-Bench provides challenging and discriminative test scenarios, offering a standardized, controllable, and reproducible benchmark for evaluating adaptability, robustness, and Pareto-front tracking in streaming data-driven dynamic multi-objective optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SDDMO-Bench，一个用于流式数据驱动动态多目标优化的基准测试套件。该套件将经典的动态多目标测试问题转化为流式环境，通过结合5种时间依赖基函数和6种分布漂移模式，构建了30个具有不同非平稳性、问题复杂度和Pareto前沿演化的测试场景，为标准化、可控且可复现的算法评估提供了平台。
AI.motivation: 流式数据驱动的动态多目标优化需要算法在概念漂移下仅依靠顺序观测来追踪时变的Pareto前沿，但系统评估面临困难：真实世界问题缺乏真实最优解、漂移标注和可控条件，而现有基准对标准化比较的支持有限。
AI.method: SDDMO-Bench通过三项机制将经典动态多目标测试问题转化为流式环境：(1) 内在目标映射演化（intrinsic objective-mapping evolution）；(2) 可控分布漂移（controllable distributional drift）；(3) 顺序数据揭示（sequential data revelation）。通过组合5种时间依赖基函数和6种分布漂移模式，构建30个多样化测试场景。
AI.result: 实验使用代表性进化算法验证了SDDMO-Bench能够提供具有挑战性和区分度的测试场景，有效评估算法在流式数据驱动动态多目标优化中的适应性、鲁棒性和Pareto前沿追踪能力。
AI.conclusion: SDDMO-Bench为流式数据驱动动态多目标优化提供了一个标准化、可控且可复现的基准测试方案，弥补了现有基准在流式场景支持上的不足。

title: Pure-Strategy Equilibrium in the Generalized First-Price Auction
summary: We revisit the classic result on the (non-)existence of pure-strategy Nash equilibria in the Generalized First-Price Auction for sponsored search advertising and show that the conclusion may be reversed when ads are ranked based on the product of stochastic quality scores and bid amounts, rather than solely on the bids or on the product of bids and deterministic quality scores. Moreover, the expected revenue in the pure strategy equilibrium of the Generalized First-Price Auction may substantially exceed that of the Generalized Second-Price Auction, although under some conditions the relation may also be reversed.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了广义第一价格拍卖（GFP）中纯策略纳什均衡存在性的经典结论，发现当广告排名依据随机质量评分与出价的乘积（而非仅依据出价或出价与确定性质量评分的乘积）时，结论可能发生反转。此外，GFP在纯策略均衡下的预期收入可能显著超过广义第二价格拍卖（GSP），但在某些条件下这种关系也可能逆转。
AI.motivation: 经典文献认为广义第一价格拍卖（GFP）在赞助搜索广告中缺乏纯策略纳什均衡，这与其在实践中的广泛使用形成矛盾。本文试图通过引入随机质量评分来重新审视这一结论，并比较GFP与GSP的收入表现。
AI.method: 从理论上重新分析GFP拍卖的均衡存在性，将排名机制从"仅依据出价"或"确定性质量评分×出价"扩展为"随机质量评分×出价"，并考察纯策略均衡下GFP与GSP的预期收入对比。
AI.result: 当广告排名基于随机质量评分与出价的乘积时，GFP拍卖中纯策略纳什均衡的存在性结论与经典结果相反（即可能存在均衡）。在均衡状态下，GFP的预期收入可能显著高于GSP，但在某些条件下GSP的收入也可能更高。
AI.conclusion: 随机质量评分的引入可以改变GFP拍卖的均衡性质，使得纯策略纳什均衡在更广泛的情况下存在，且收入表现与传统认知有所不同，这对赞助搜索广告拍卖机制的设计具有重要启示。

title: Cross-Benchmark Generalization in Long-Horizon Agents
comment: Accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Agent Behavior. 11 pages, 4 tables
summary: For reinforcement learning (RL) in self-contained environments, a policy can get rewards by exploiting environment-specific regularities (tool schemas, grader parsing, task templates) rather than by acquiring transferable skill, and an in-distribution holdout shares those regularities. We argue that the discriminating question is behavioral, namely how a trained agent acts, and that cross-benchmark transfer is the right place to look for it. We post-train an open-weight mixture-of-experts model (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) on 363 long-horizon Model Context Protocol (MCP) tasks across 27 categories, using a two-stage SFT-then-RL pipeline. Toolathlon performance informed the initial base-family and SFT-teacher choices, but no external-benchmark task or grader entered training and no external score informed the reward, training hyperparameters, trained-checkpoint selection, or stopping. At greedy pass@1, the trained model improves over the base on five reported external evaluations: Toolathlon (+9.6 pp), $τ^2$-Bench (+5.3 pp), BFCL-V4 (+3.5 pp), SWE-Bench Pro (+5.8 pp), and Terminal-Bench 2 (+2.8 pp). Both software-engineering benchmarks improve despite the training collection containing no software-engineering tasks. An exploratory paired-trajectory analysis identifies four recurring behavioral differences (more careful local-goal formation, building goal-relevant working state, keeping parent goals stable through local repairs, and verifying completion) that appear in analogous forms across office workflows and code. These results provide descriptive evidence that long-horizon multi-tool post-training can change ways of working that transfer beyond its training domain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究强化学习（RL）在自包含环境中容易利用环境特定规律而非获得可迁移技能的问题，提出通过跨基准迁移来判别行为的可迁移性。作者在363个长时程MCP任务上对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B混合专家模型进行两阶段（SFT+RL）后训练，在五个外部基准上均取得提升，并通过配对轨迹分析识别出四种可迁移的行为模式。
AI.motivation: 现有RL评估面临一个关键问题：智能体在自包含环境中可以通过利用环境特有的规律（如工具模式、评分器解析、任务模板）获得奖励，而无需真正学到可迁移的技能。分布内留出集同样包含这些规律，因此无法判别智能体是否真正获得了泛化能力。作者认为核心问题在于行为层面——训练后的智能体如何行动，并主张跨基准迁移是检验这一点的正确场所。
AI.method: 采用两阶段SFT-then-RL训练流程，在363个长时程MCP任务（覆盖27个类别）上对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B开放权重混合专家模型进行后训练。训练中严格隔离外部信息：不使用任何外部基准任务或评分器参与训练，也不使用外部分数指导奖励、超参数选择、检查点选择或停止时机。训练前仅在基座模型家族和SFT教师选择时参考了Toolathlon性能。训练后通过五种外部基准评估迁移效果，并进行配对轨迹分析识别行为差异。
AI.result: 贪心pass@1评估下，训练模型在五个外部基准上均优于基座：Toolathlon（+9.6个百分点）、τ²-Bench（+5.3）、BFCL-V4（+3.5）、SWE-Bench Pro（+5.8）、Terminal-Bench 2（+2.8）。值得注意的是，尽管训练集不含软件工程任务，两个软件工程基准仍有提升。配对轨迹分析识别出四种反复出现的行为差异：更仔细的局部目标形成、构建与目标相关的工作状态、通过局部修复保持父目标稳定、以及验证完成度——这些模式在办公工作流和代码场景中以类似形式出现。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明长时程多工具后训练能够改变智能体的工作方式，且这些方式的改变可以迁移到训练领域之外。这为RL智能体的行为可迁移性提供了描述性证据，暗示后训练的价值不仅在于任务内性能提升，更在于培养通用的工作方式。

title: ELECTRIC: Evidential Learning-Enhanced CT Reconstruction via Iterative Correction
summary: Here we introduce ELECTRIC (Evidential Learning-Enhanced CT Reconstruction via Iterative Correction), a physics-guided Bayesian formulation. An evidential neural network provides an image proposal and an error-predictive epistemic-uncertainty surrogate. The latter is converted into an adaptive precision field and inserted into a Poisson-weighted MAP update. The resulting image-evidence-precision-reconstruction loop treats prior confidence as a learned state variable of iterative reconstruction. In addition to the formulation and theoretical analysis, we report two simulation studies on image slices from the AAPM Mayo Clinic Low-Dose CT dataset: a mechanism-validation pilot using transparent surrogate estimators, and a feasibility study in which a trained Normal-Inverse-Gamma evidential network drives the full closed loop. On held-out patients, the learned prior mean reduces reconstruction error by roughly 70 percent relative to filtered back-projection, the learned epistemic uncertainty is error-predictive and supports selective trust, and the physics-guided update restores measurement consistency while the adaptive-precision reconstruction matches or exceeds a validation-tuned fixed prior and remains markedly more robust to prior-strength misspecification. Together these results demonstrate the complete ELECTRIC closed-loop pipeline, while identifying formal uncertainty calibration and joint training as the principal directions for future work.

AI.tldr: ELECTRIC是一种基于物理引导贝叶斯框架的低剂量CT重建方法，通过证据神经网络提供图像提议和误差预测的不确定性代理，并将其转化为自适应精度场集成到泊松加权MAP更新中，形成一个图像-证据-精度-重建的闭环迭代过程。在Mayo Clinic低剂量CT数据集上，该方法将重建误差相对于滤波反投影降低了约70%，并且对先验强度误设定更具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 低剂量CT重建面临测量噪声大、传统重建方法（如滤波反投影）误差高的问题，同时现有方法难以将先验可信度作为可学习的状态变量动态融入迭代重建过程，缺乏对重建不确定性的量化与利用。
AI.method: 提出物理引导的贝叶斯公式：1）使用证据神经网络（如Normal-Inverse-Gamma）生成图像提议和误差预测的不确定性代理；2）将不确定性转化为自适应精度场；3）插入泊松加权MAP更新中，形成图像-证据-精度-重建的闭环迭代循环，把先验置信度作为迭代重建的可学习状态变量。
AI.result: 在Mayo Clinic低剂量CT数据集的仿真研究中：学习的先验均值将重建误差相对FBP降低约70%；学习的认知不确定性具有误差预测能力并支持选择性信任；物理引导更新恢复测量一致性；自适应精度重建在匹配或超过验证调优固定先验的同时，对先验强度误设定显著更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 完成了ELECTRIC完整闭环管线的验证，表明将证据学习与物理引导迭代重建相结合是有效的；未来工作主要方向包括形式化不确定性校准和联合训练。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Simulation-Based Inference for Operations Research with Large Language Models
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for operations research (OR) tasks remains challenging because correctness depends on a coherent modeling process, not merely a correct final answer. Standard autoregressive generation operates on a myopic policy, which sometimes fails to anticipate whether a partial formulation can be validly extended into a globally consistent optimization model. Consequently, locally plausible steps may propagate into catastrophic downstream formulation or solver code errors. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-aware, training-free inference framework for OR mathematical modeling. Without updating model parameters, our method evaluates intermediate candidate steps using short lookahead simulations to quantify downstream predictive uncertainty or probability concentration. Candidates that demonstrate a higher likelihood of yielding coherent mathematical formulations are then dynamically selected via importance resampling. Empirical evaluations across multiple OR benchmarks (including NL4OPT, MAMO, and IndustryOR) demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both standard and low-temperature baselines, establishing an efficient, training-free paradigm for reliable OR formulation generation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的、基于不确定性的推理框架，用于提升大语言模型在运筹学数学建模任务中的可靠性和正确性。
AI.motivation: LLM在运筹学任务中的正确性依赖于连贯的建模过程，而标准的自回归生成采用短视策略，无法预见局部公式是否能有效扩展为全局一致的优化模型，导致错误传播。现有方法缺乏对中间建模步骤的全局预见性。
AI.method: 提出不确定性感知、无需训练的推理框架。通过短视向前瞻模拟（short lookahead simulations）评估中间候选步骤，量化下游预测不确定性或概率集中度，再利用重要性重采样（importance resampling）动态选择更可能产生连贯数学公式的候选。
AI.result: 在多个OR基准测试（NL4OPT、MAMO、IndustryOR）上，该框架始终优于标准生成和低温度基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了高效、无需训练的可信OR公式生成范式，有效提升了LLM在运筹学建模任务中的可靠性。

title: Cost-Effective Automated Judging of Natural-Language Mathematical Proofs
summary: Grading natural-language mathematical proofs is a recurring cost in evaluating math-reasoning systems, and frontier LLM judges are expensive. We ask whether cheap open-weight models can serve as reliable judges given a candidate proof, a ground-truth proof, and a human-grading rubric. On a 200-instance validation sample of IMO-GradingBench, three cheap judges (GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek-V4 Flash, Gemma-4 31B) agree with human pass/fail decisions at rates statistically indistinguishable from Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, at up to $100\times$ lower cost. We had expected a majority vote of the three to be the best budget option; it matched the frontier but did not improve on its strongest member. Extending to the full 1000-instance benchmark and exploring consensus rules, we found that requiring unanimous agreement (all-three-pass) reaches the highest pass-agreement and precision and, on four replicate runs, the smallest run-to-run spread. The headline finding is that cheap judges are competitive with the frontier at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost; as a deployable default we recommend all-three-pass, with the caveat that this rule was identified post-hoc and warrants independent replication.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用廉价开源权重模型作为数学证明自动评分器的可行性。在IMO-GradingBench基准上，三个廉价模型（GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B）与人类评判的一致性在统计上与Claude Opus 4.7和Gemini 3.1 Pro等前沿模型相当，但成本降低了最多100倍。额外发现三人一致通过（all-three-pass）规则能达到最高的通过一致性和精确度，并且运行间波动最小。
AI.motivation: 数学推理系统的评估需要对自然语言数学证明进行人工分级，这是一项反复发生的成本。虽然前沿LLM评判者表现优秀，但其使用成本高昂，因此探索廉价开源模型能否作为可靠的替代评判者具有重要的经济价值。
AI.method: 在200实例的验证样本上，比较三个廉价评判模型（GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B）与两个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro）在给定候选证明、真实证明和人工评分规则下与人类通过/失败判断的一致性；随后扩展到1000实例完整基准，测试多数据投票规则，包括三人一致通过（all-three-pass）策略，并进行四次重复实验评估运行稳定性。
AI.result: 廉价模型与人类判断的一致性在统计上与前沿模型无显著差异，成本降低高达100倍。多数投票与前沿模型持平但未超越其最强成员；全票通过规则（all-three-pass）实现了最高的通过一致性和精确度，并且在四次重复运行中具有最小的运行间差异。
AI.conclusion: 廉价开源权重模型作为数学证明评判者与前沿模型竞争力相当，成本低一到两个数量级，推荐将all-three-pass作为默认部署规则，但需注意该规则是在事后识别的，有待独立复制验证。

title: Revisiting Classic Thought Experiments to Measure Consciousness for Artificial Intelligence Safety
summary: This research note revisits Leibniz's mill, Turing's imitation game, and Searle's Chinese Room through the Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) framework. It formalises a toy symbolic setting in which successful behaviour is measured by task performance ($W_{causal,T}$), while the efficiency with which preserved internal structure supports that behaviour is measured by operational consciousness ($κ_T$). Within this setup, an uncompressed lookup system and a compact generative system can in principle achieve comparable behavioural success, yet diverge sharply in $κ_T$: the former relies on an expanding standing store of unreused mappings, whereas the latter reuses compact internal structure. The note therefore reframes classic disputes about understanding by separating outward performance from the organisation that sustains it, and motivates why this distinction may matter for later AI-safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过守恒一致编码（CCE）框架重新审视莱布尼茨磨坊、图灵测试和塞尔中文房间等经典思想实验，提出区分行为表现（W_causal,T）与操作性意识（κ_T）的正式符号框架，并论证系统性压缩与查表机制虽可达到相同行为表现，但在内部结构组织效率上存在本质差异。
AI.motivation: 经典的"理解"之争（如中文房间论证）长期陷入行为主义与内在主义的对立，缺乏一个能够同时刻画外部行为表现与内部结构组织的统一形式化框架。作者希望借助CCE框架为这些经典争论提供一个可量化的分析工具，并为后续AI安全研究奠定理论基础。
AI.method: 提出CCE（Conservation-Congruent Encoding）框架，在一个玩具符号系统中定义两个关键指标：任务表现W_causal,T衡量行为成功程度，操作性意识κ_T衡量保存的内部结构支持该行为的效率。通过对比未压缩查表系统与紧凑生成式系统在两个指标上的差异来展开分析。
AI.result: 研究表明，未压缩查表系统依赖于不断扩张的未重用映射存储，而紧凑生成式系统则重用紧凑的内部结构。两者在行为表现上可以达到相当水平，但在κ_T上存在显著差异——前者远低于后者。这说明了行为表现与内部组织可以解耦。
AI.conclusion: CCE框架将关于"理解"的经典争论重新表述为外部表现与维持该表现的组织结构之间的区分，为AI安全分析中区分系统"能做什么"与"如何做到"提供了新的理论视角，暗示在评估AI系统时需要对内部效率与行为表现分开考量。

title: GARDRec: Decision-Level Graph Grounding for Large Language Model Recommendation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for recommendation by interpreting item descriptions, user instructions, and external knowledge through natural-language prompts. However, existing graph-augmented LLM recommenders often use knowledge graphs mainly as prompt-level evidence, leaving ranking decisions weakly constrained by structured user-item relations. This is problematic for next-item recommendation, where the model must compare candidates under the same user context while preserving temporal preference, collaborative signals, and attribute matches. To address this issue, we propose \emph{GARDRec}, a Graph-grounded Adaptive Reasoning and Decision-aware Recommendation framework for LLM-based next-item ranking. GARDRec constructs semantic-structural item representations from textual node features and graph propagation, derives personalized graph contexts from temporally weighted histories and first-order neighborhoods, and aligns graph-derived representations with a frozen LLM through continuous multimodal prompts. Explicit interaction and matching features are injected through late-stage decision branches, while inter-candidate attention and restricted generative likelihood support final ranking. Experiments on three public benchmarks with multiple LLM backbones show that GARDRec generally improves candidate-ranking performance over representative baselines. Ablation and diagnostic analyses verify the contributions of graph projection, neighborhood retrieval, explicit decision features, ranking loss, and generative calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GARDRec框架，通过图引导的自适应推理和决策感知推荐，将知识图谱的结构化信息与LLM的自然语言能力结合，解决全量级LLM推荐器中排序决策缺乏结构化用户-物品关系约束的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有图增强的LLM推荐器通常仅将知识图谱作为提示级别的证据使用，导致排序决策未能充分利用结构化的用户-物品关系。这在下一项推荐任务中尤为关键，因为模型需要在同一用户上下文中比较候选物品，同时保持时间偏好、协同信号和属性匹配。
AI.method: GARDRec框架包含：(1) 从文本节点特征和图传播构建语义-结构物品表示；(2) 从时间加权历史和一阶邻居获取个性化图上下文；(3) 通过连续多模态提示将对齐图衍生表示与冻结的LLM；(4) 通过后期决策分支注入显式交互和匹配特征；(5) 使用候选间注意力和受限生成似然支持最终排序。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上使用多个LLM骨干的实验表明，GARDRec在候选排序性能上普遍优于代表性基线。消融和诊断分析验证了图投影、邻居检索、显式决策特征、排序损失和生成校准的贡献。
AI.conclusion: GARDRec通过将图结构信息以多模态提示形式注入冻结LLM，并辅以显式决策特征和排序校准机制，有效提升了LLM在下一项推荐任务中的排序性能，验证了图引导推理与LLM自适应决策结合的有效性。

title: FATE: Frame-Level Audio-Visual Temporal Embedding
summary: When a dog opens its mouth and barks, humans naturally recognize what the sound is and when it occurs. Building audio-visual models with this same ability requires representations that capture both semantic and temporal alignment. Current approaches fall short on one side or the other: embedding models match semantic but lose temporal information; synchronization models capture temporal offsets but lack semantic understanding. To bridge this gap, we propose FATE, Frame-level Audio-visual Temporal Embedding. Unlike prior embedding models that pool each modality into a single embedding and discard temporal information, FATE retains frame-level sequences, aligns them on the physical timeline, and computes similarity over strictly aligned frame pairs. Unlike synchronization models that output only an offset prediction, FATE encodes synchronization in a reusable embedding space, trained with a joint objective combining cross-video semantic and within-video temporal contrastive learning to capture both what sounds and when it occurs. Across three tasks, FATE surpasses the strongest baseline on temporal and semantic retrieval by a large margin, matches fully supervised methods on event localization in a zero-shot setting, and achieves the best correlation with human judgments as a generation evaluation metric. The source code can be found at \texttt{https://github.com/guankaisi/FATE}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FATE（帧级音视频时间嵌入）模型，通过保留帧级序列并在物理时间轴上对齐帧对来计算相似度，同时结合跨视频语义对比学习和视频内时间对比学习，统一了语义与时间对齐能力，在时间/语义检索、零样本事件定位和生成评估等多个任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频模型存在"语义-时间"两难困境：嵌入模型能匹配语义但丢失时间信息；同步模型能捕获时间偏移但缺乏语义理解。作者希望构建同时具备语义和时间对齐能力的统一表示。
AI.method: FATE保留每个模态的帧级序列而非pool成单一嵌入，在物理时间轴上严格对齐帧对并计算相似度；采用联合训练目标，包含跨视频语义对比学习和视频内时间对比学习，将同步信息编码进可复用的嵌入空间中。
AI.result: FATE在时间检索和语义检索任务上大幅超越最强基线；在零样本事件定位达到与全监督方法相当的性能；作为生成评估指标时与人类判断的相关性最佳。
AI.conclusion: FATE通过帧级时间对齐和联合语义-时间对比学习，成功弥合了嵌入模型与同步模型之间的鸿沟，证明了时间信息可以嵌入到可复用的表示空间中而不牺牲语义能力。

title: SMM Transformer: Leveraging Spiking Neural Networks for Multimodal Tasks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable event-driven computation with sparse activations, but building multimodal Transformers on SNNs is hindered by unstable training in deep spiking stacks and the mismatch between dense softmax attention and spike-based communication. We propose SMM Transformer, an SNN-based multimodal Transformer framework that combines (i)PLMP, a Parallel LIF with Multistage Learnable Parameters neuron and a tailored P-STBP algorithm for stable deep SNN training, (ii) SMSA, an attention-inspired spike-driven token-mixing module that replaces dense pairwise softmax attention with channel-wise spike co-activation and self-compensation, and (iii)SMoE, a spiking mixture-of-experts module for modality-aware fusion. Across visual and multimodal benchmarks, SMM Transformer achieves competitive accuracy compared to ANN baselines. Under a standard MAC/AC arithmetic model, SMSA reduces the estimated operator-level compute energy of the attention module by up to 97%, while whole-model profiling shows more moderate but consistent efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMM Transformer，一个基于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的多模态Transformer框架，通过PLMP神经元与P-STBP训练算法解决深度SNN训练不稳定问题，用SMSA脉冲驱动token混合模块替代密集softmax注意力，并结合SMoE实现模态感知融合，在视觉和多模态基准上达到与ANN基线相当的精度，同时显著降低注意力模块的能耗（最高97%）。
AI.motivation: SNN具有事件驱动计算和稀疏激活的优势，但其在多模态Transformer中面临两大障碍：一是深层脉冲堆叠训练不稳定，二是密集softmax注意力与脉冲通信机制不匹配。现有方法难以将SNN有效应用于多模态场景。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：(i) PLMP（并行LIF多级可学习参数神经元）配合定制化的P-STBP训练算法，实现深层SNN的稳定训练；(ii) SMSA（脉冲驱动token混合模块），利用通道级脉冲共激活与自补偿机制替代密集成对softmax注意力；(iii) SMoE（脉冲混合专家模块），用于模态感知的融合。
AI.result: 在视觉和多模态基准测试中，SMM Transformer达到与ANN基线相当的精度。在标准MAC/AC算术模型下，SMSA将注意力模块的算子级计算能耗降低高达97%，整模型性能分析显示更温和但一致的效率提升。
AI.conclusion: SMM Transformer证明了SNN可以在多模态Transformer中实现与ANN相当的精度，同时大幅降低计算能耗，为高效事件驱动的多模态处理提供了可行方案。

title: Understanding Federated Learning Through the Lens of Mechanism Design: The Role of Data Heterogeneity
comment: Extended version (with full proofs) of a paper accepted at GameSec 2026. 29 pages, 5 figures
summary: Federated learning (FL) requires effective incentive mechanisms to motivate data sharing and prevent strategic free-riding. Recent FL mechanisms such as the Shapley value mechanism M^Shap guarantee reciprocal fairness for agents. However, a complete analysis of how such mechanisms impact social optimality and individual rationality under realistic, standalone outside options remains unknown. In this paper, we address this gap by adapting the classical Externality mechanism M^E to the federated learning setting. We conduct a comparison of M^Shap and M^E across three dimensions: social optimality, individual rationality, and fairness/reciprocity. First, we establish that M^Shap generally does not maximize social welfare because its marginal incentives drive agents to over-contribute resources, while M^E maximizes social welfare by design. Second, we evaluate participation incentives through the individual rationality gap when considering agents' outside options as standalone training on their own data. We find that both mechanisms ensure individual rationality in homogeneous settings. We further show that under mild conditions, M^E maintains this guarantee under agent heterogeneity, whereas M^Shap does not. Third, we demonstrate that while M^Shap maintains perfect reciprocity by design, M^E generally does not, and only ensures that individual benefits match Shapley contributions at symmetric equilibria under homogeneity, as it sacrifices individual fairness to maximize collective welfare under heterogeneity. Empirical simulations validate our theoretical findings and illustrate a tradeoff between reciprocal fairness and social efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了联邦学习中的激励机制，重点比较了Shapley值机制（M^Shap）和外部性机制（M^E）在三种维度上的表现：社会最优性、个体理性（参与激励）和公平性/互惠性。研究发现M^Shap因边际激励导致过度贡献而无法最大化社会福利，而M^E在设计上实现社会福利最大化；在考虑独立外部选项时，M^Shap在异构场景下无法保证个体理性，M^E在温和条件下可以保证；M^Shap保持完美互惠性，而M^E以牺牲个体公平换取集体效率。实证模拟验证了理论发现，并揭示了互惠公平与社会效率之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习需要有效的激励机制来鼓励数据共享并防止搭便车行为。虽然已有如Shapley值机制（M^Shap）能保证代理人的互惠公平，但在现实且独立的"外部选项"（即代理人可独立用自己的数据训练）条件下，这些机制如何影响社会最优性和个体理性仍未得到完整分析。本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 本文将经典的Externality机制（M^E）适配到联邦学习场景，并从三个维度系统比较M^Shap和M^E：1）通过理论分析评估社会最优性（社会福利最大化）；2）通过个体理性差距评估参与激励，考虑代理人可独立训练的外部选项；3）分析公平性/互惠性保障。同时通过实证模拟验证理论发现。
AI.result: 1）M^Shap因边际激励导致过度贡献，一般不最大化社会福利；M^E按设计最大化社会福利。2）两种机制在同质设置下均保证个体理性；在温和条件下M^E在异构设置下仍维持个体理性保障，而M^Shap无法保证。3）M^Shap按设计保持完美互惠性，M^E一般不保证，仅在同质对称均衡下使个体收益匹配Shapley贡献。实证模拟验证了理论结果，并展示了互惠公平与社会效率之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过系统比较揭示了联邦学习激励机制的"公平-效率"权衡：M^Shap牺牲社会效率以换取互惠公平，而M^E最大化社会效率但牺牲个体公平。这为联邦学习激励机制的设计选择提供了重要理论指导，帮助设计者根据具体需求权衡公平性与效率。

title: Source Code Authorship Attribution Does Not Generalize from Competitions to Classrooms
summary: Source code authorship attribution aims to identify the author of a program fragment from its writing style. We fine-tune the pre-trained transformer CodeBERT on three sources of data: publicly available Google Code Jam (GCJ) submissions from an open Kaggle repository, a curated GCJ archive, and institutional coursework datasets collected at a technical university. On multi-round GCJ data, CodeBERT reaches 92.6% Top-1 accuracy for 10 authors and retains 70.7% Top-1 (88.2% Top-10) for 1000 authors. On the examined coursework datasets, the same pipeline performs at or below the corresponding chance baselines: 0.2% Top-1 on a closed-assignment dataset of 690 authors and 0.06% Top-1 on open-ended assignments evaluated over 812 authors. A companion multi-model benchmark provides consistent cross-model evidence across additional dataset configurations, indicating that the observed performance gap is not specific to CodeBERT and persists across the evaluated model families. We analyze dataset and task properties that plausibly explain this gap and argue that GCJ-based benchmarks overestimate the practical applicability of authorship attribution in educational settings unless they are validated on the target coursework context.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用预训练Transformer模型CodeBERT在多种数据集上进行源代码作者归属任务，发现在Google Code Jam数据上表现优异（10作者92.6% Top-1，1000作者70.7% Top-1），但在实际课程作业数据集上表现极差（接近随机基线），揭示了GCJ基准对教育场景实际适用性的高估问题。
AI.motivation: 源代码作者归属在学术诚信检测中具有重要应用价值，但现有基准（如Google Code Jam）可能无法反映教育场景中的实际挑战。作者希望通过对比公开竞赛数据与真实课程作业数据，揭示基准与真实应用场景之间的性能差距，从而为实际应用提供更可靠的评估依据。
AI.method: 对预训练Transformer模型CodeBERT进行微调，使用三种数据源：Kaggle上的公开GCJ提交数据、精选GCJ档案、以及技术大学收集的课程作业数据集（包括封闭式作业和开放式作业）。同时建立多模型基准进行跨模型验证，排除CodeBERT特异的可能性。
AI.result: GCJ数据上CodeBERT达到92.6% Top-1（10作者）和70.7% Top-1（1000作者）；但在课程作业数据上仅为0.2% Top-1（690作者封闭式作业）和0.06% Top-1（812作者开放式作业），接近随机基线。多模型基准验证了这一性能差距并非CodeBERT特有。
AI.conclusion: GCJ基准高估了作者归属在真实教育场景中的实用性，除非在目标课程作业情境下进行验证。数据集和任务属性（如代码规模、风格一致性、作业约束）的差异是造成性能差距的可能原因，这提醒研究者需要在实际应用场景中评估此类技术的有效性。

title: Noise-Robust Conditional Flow Matching: Generating Clean Samples from Noisy Datasets
summary: Generative models learn the statistical properties of their training data, so high-quality generation depends on clean and representative datasets. In scientific imaging, acquisition often yields noisy measurements, while collecting clean references can be costly, impractical or even unattainable. Training directly on these measurements results in a model that reproduces the corrupted data. This can be circumvented by learning the clean population distribution directly from the noisy data. Conditional flow matching (CFM) combines a simple regression objective with stable training, efficient sampling, and strong image-generation performance, making it a natural framework for this setting. We introduce Noise-Robust Conditional Flow Matching (NR-CFM), an unconditional generator that learns from one corrupted observation per image. NR-CFM provides a closed-form clean endpoint correction for additive white Gaussian noise and learns a data-driven correction for general Gaussian corruptions with more complex covariance structure. Across the evaluated corruption settings, NR-CFM outperforms NR-GAN in most cases and remains competitive with Ambient Diffusion in the high-noise regime. We further evaluate NR-CFM on scientific data at signal-to-noise ratios as low as $0.001$, where it generates plausible particle images from severely corrupted measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出噪声鲁棒条件流匹配（NR-CFM），一种无条件生成模型，能够从每张图像仅有一次噪声观测中学习干净的种群分布。NR-CFM对加性高斯白噪声提供闭式干净端点校正，对更复杂协方差结构的高斯退化学习数据驱动的校正。在多个退化设置下，NR-CFM在多数情况下优于NR-GAN，在高噪声区间与Ambient Diffusion相当，并在信噪比低至0.001的科学数据上生成合理的粒子图像。
AI.motivation: 科学成像中采集常产生噪声测量，而获取干净参考图像成本高昂甚至不可行。直接在噪声数据上训练生成模型会复现数据中的退化。因此需要一种方法，能够在仅有噪声观测的情况下学习干净的种群分布。
AI.method: 基于条件流匹配（CFM）框架，提出NR-CFM：1) 对加性高斯白噪声推导闭式解进行干净端点校正；2) 对协方差结构更复杂的一般高斯退化，学习数据驱动的校正方法。该模型是无条件的生成器，仅需每张图像一次噪声观测即可训练。
AI.result: 在评估的各种退化设置中，NR-CFM在大多数情况下优于NR-GAN，在高噪声区间与Ambient Diffusion表现相当。在信噪比低至0.001的科学数据上，NR-CFM仍能生成合理的粒子图像。
AI.conclusion: NR-CFM证明了条件流匹配框架在从噪声观测中学习干净分布的有效性，为科学成像中难以获取干净参考数据的场景提供了一种实用的生成建模方案。

title: Learning Compositional Meta-Routing for Agentic Workflows: An Executable Benchmark
summary: Agentic systems must decide not only what answer to produce, but which reasoning and execution operations should precede it. A controller may answer directly, decompose a request, retrieve evidence, execute code, delegate to a specialist, or verify an intermediate result. Existing routing work largely selects model endpoints, retrieval depth, or tools in isolation. We introduce an executable benchmark and a budget-aware meta-router that composes heterogeneous operations from raw task text. The benchmark contains 216 training, 72 development, 108 held-out test, and 108 locked lexical-shift challenge tasks across data analysis, frozen-corpus research, and document processing. Outcomes are machine checked after operations execute. Independent regularized logistic heads predict operation probabilities from word and character features, are temperature-scaled on development data, and are greedily composed under route-cost and action-count budgets. On the held-out test, the learned policy achieves 100% success versus 93.5% for strong static and fixed workflows, with 43% lower cost than the static policy; a matched learned one-shot router reaches 56.5%. On the untouched challenge split, learned success falls to 75.9% and trails static routing at 93.5%, while remaining 49% cheaper and exceeding one-shot routing by 34.3 points. The gap identifies lexical generalization, rather than route execution, as the principal limitation. These results establish a reproducible testbed and a bounded proof of concept, not evidence of live-LLM performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可执行基准测试和一个预算感知的元路由器（meta-router），用于在代理系统中从原始任务文本中组合异构操作（如直接回答、分解请求、检索证据、执行代码、委派专家、验证中间结果）。基准包含数据分析和文档处理等任务的训练/开发/测试集及词汇偏移挑战集。学习策略在测试集上达到100%成功率（比静态路由高出6.5个百分点）且成本降低43%，但在词汇偏移挑战集上降至75.9%，暴露了词汇泛化是主要局限。
AI.motivation: 现有路由工作大多孤立地选择模型端点、检索深度或工具，而代理系统需要在操作层面做更复杂的组合决策（如何时分解任务、何时检索证据、何时执行代码等），缺乏一个可执行的基准和能组合异构操作的路由方法。
AI.method: 构建包含216训练/72开发/108测试/108词汇偏移挑战任务的基准；提出元路由器，使用独立正则化逻辑回归头从词和字符特征预测操作概率，通过温度缩放校准后，在路由成本和动作数量预算下贪心组合操作序列。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，学习策略达到100%成功率（静态工作流93.5%），成本比静态策略低43%；匹配的一次性学习路由器仅56.5%。在未触碰的词汇偏移挑战集上，学习成功率降至75.9%，落后于静态路由的93.5%，但仍比静态便宜49%，且比一次性路由高34.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明词汇泛化而非路由执行是主要局限；该方法提供了可复现的测试平台和有界的概念验证，但并非实时LLM性能的证据。

title: RubricReviewer: From Direct Critique to Objective and Comprehensive Rubric-Driven Peer Review
summary: Peer review at major venues is under unprecedented submission pressure, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) as review assistants. Existing LLM-based reviewers, however, face two structural limitations. First, they map manuscripts directly to reviews, leaving the underlying rubric implicit and entangling its derivation with the judgement. Second, the prevailing paradigms each capture only half of a good review: training-free agents gather broad evidence but produce undirected critiques, while training-based reviewers inherit human discriminative judgement together with its noise and uneven coverage. We introduce RubricReviewer, a fully rubric-driven framework that addresses both limitations. It makes rubric generation an explicit intermediate step, so that both review generation and the final assessment are conditioned on paper-adaptive rubrics. It further combines a training-free agent (Scout) that gathers external evidence with a human-aligned trained model (Aligner) that consumes this evidence, fusing the strengths of both supervision sources. Experiments on real-world submissions show that RubricReviewer produces reviews that are markedly more comprehensive and more discriminative than prior systems, and exhibits the strongest robustness against adversarial prompt-injection attacks. Ablation studies further confirm the necessity of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RubricReviewer，一个完全由评分准则驱动的LLM评审框架。它将评分准则生成作为显式的中间步骤，使评审生成和最终评估都基于论文自适应准则；同时结合无训练代理（Scout）收集外部证据和人类对齐的微调模型（Aligner）消费证据，融合两种监督来源的优势。实验表明其评审更全面、更具区分度，且对提示注入攻击的鲁棒性最强。
AI.motivation: 大型学术会议审稿压力空前，LLM辅助审稿需求迫切。但现有基于LLM的评审系统存在两个结构性缺陷：(1)直接将手稿映射到评审意见，隐含的评分准则未被显式化，准则推导与判断纠缠不清；(2)现有两类范式各只捕获了好评审的一半：无训练的代理能收集广泛证据但产生无方向的批评，而训练型评审者继承了人类判别性判断及其噪声和不均匀覆盖。
AI.method: RubricReviewer采用完全由评分准则驱动的框架。核心设计：(1)将评分准则生成设为显式中间步骤，使评审生成和最终评估都基于论文自适应的准则；(2)双组件架构——Scout（无训练代理）负责收集外部证据，Aligner（人类对齐的微调模型）负责消费这些证据生成评审，融合两种监督来源的优势。
AI.result: 在真实世界提交数据上的实验表明，RubricReviewer生成的评审比现有系统明显更全面、更具区分度，并且在对抗性提示注入攻击下展现出最强的鲁棒性。消融实验进一步确认了每个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RubricReviewer通过显式化评分准则和融合无训练代理与人类对齐模型的优势，有效解决了现有LLM评审系统在准则隐式化和监督来源不完整方面的结构性局限，为LLM辅助学术评审提供了更可靠、更全面的解决方案。

title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) plays an important role in modern engineering, but using open-source solvers such as OpenFOAM requires considerable knowledge and skills, as well as time-consuming configuration file setup. To reduce this burden, we propose AutoFOAM - a self-evolving large language model (LLM) agent that creates, evaluates, runs, and evolves its own OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural-language instructions. Our model is pre-trained on the Qwen-coder 2.5-14B, which is then fine-tuned on 252 text prompts targeting 7 OpenFOAM solvers, 13 parametrized mesh templates, and a y plus-aware numerical policy. The crucial element of the algorithm is a sophisticated evolution loop composed of 7 stages. To prevent model degeneration under repeated self-training, the agent employs three complementary anti-collapse streams: RAG-augmented retry context, surgical dictionary-level patching, and prompt-diversity paraphrasing. By bridging generative artificial intelligence with rigorous fluid simulations, AutoFOAM accelerates rapid prototyping and democratizes advanced CFD workflows.

AI.tldr: AutoFOAM是一个自进化的LLM智能体，基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B微调，能够通过自然语言指令自动创建、评估、运行和进化OpenFOAM仿真，通过7阶段的进化循环和三种防退化机制来加速CFD工作流程。
AI.motivation: 使用OpenFOAM等开源CFD求解器需要大量的专业知识、技能和时间来配置文件设置，这阻碍了CFD在快速原型设计和更广泛工程领域的应用。作者希望通过大语言模型来自动化这一过程。
AI.method: 该方法包括：(1) 在Qwen-coder 2.5-14B基础上微调，使用252个文本提示覆盖7个OpenFOAM求解器、13个参数化网格模板和y-plus数值策略；(2) 设计包含7个阶段的进化循环算法；(3) 提出三种互补的抗退化机制：RAG增强重试上下文、外科手术式字典级补丁和提示多样性改写。
AI.result: AutoFOAM将生成式AI与严格的流体仿真相结合，加速了快速原型设计，并使高级CFD工作流程更加民主化，降低了使用门槛。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动化OpenFOAM仿真流程，AutoFOAM显著降低了CFD使用的专业壁垒，使非专家用户也能通过自然语言进行流体仿真，加速工程原型迭代。

title: A Triple-Robustness Analysis of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Requirements Traceability
summary: Reported verdicts on GraphRAG versus vector RAG disagree, and the evidence is typically tied to a single corpus, embedder, and judge -- and, we show, to where citation quality is measured. We present a triple-robustness analysis that holds a five-pipeline architecture matrix fixed and varies embedder (local e5-small vs. Azure text-embedding-3-small), corpus (DO-178C typed-edge requirements vs. Wikipedia paragraph chains via MuSiQue), and judge (paired GPT-5.4 x GPT-4.1 on both corpora), over 2x4,440 main-matrix runs, 600 cross-corpus runs, and over 5,000 faithfulness judgments. (C2a) GraphRAG's graph walk floods the context window at precision 0.12-0.23, but the synthesizer cites selectively at precision 0.48-0.65; scoring the retrieved set as the attribution set inverts the architecture ranking, which reconciles part of the disagreement in prior reports. (C1) Answer-level citation winners are corpus- and stratum-conditional but embedder-robust: GraphRAG ties vanilla on short-hop DO-178C queries and wins every MuSiQue stratum, while agentic pipelines lead only on 3+-hop requirements queries. (C2b) Faithfulness is corpus-conditional: on DO-178C it declines with hop distance (trend p<0.05 in three of four judge x embedder combinations); on Wikipedia chains neither judge shows a collapse. (C3) Single-judge LLM faithfulness is fragile to retrieval state: GPT-5.4's self-kappa across embedders is 0.137 (41% verdict change) against a same-day test-retest floor of 0.76, and re-judging frozen inputs eleven weeks later gives kappa <= 0.14 for both judges. A learned router on dense embeddings alone reaches macro-F1 0.86 on hop classification (C4). We argue that RAG architecture claims should be tested at this level of robustness -- including robustness to the citation-measurement point -- before they are trusted.

AI.tldr: 本文对GraphRAG与向量RAG进行三重稳健性分析，固定五管道架构矩阵，变化嵌入器、语料库和评判器，共2x4,440次主矩阵运行及5,000多次忠实性评判。发现GraphRAG的优劣取决于引用质量测量点（检索集vs.归因集会反转排名）、语料库和层深条件，但对嵌入器稳健；同时揭示LLM评判器的忠实性评判极其脆弱（kappa低至0.137），呼吁RAG架构研究需在同等稳健性水平下验证。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG与向量RAG的对比研究结论相互矛盾，原因在于每项研究仅基于单一语料库、单一嵌入器和单一评判器，且忽视了引用质量测量点的位置差异。作者希望系统性澄清这些不一致并确立更严格的评估标准。
AI.method: 采用三重稳健性分析框架：固定五管道架构矩阵，变化三个维度——嵌入器（本地e5-small vs. Azure text-embedding-3-small）、语料库（DO-178C typed-edge需求 vs. Wikipedia段落链MuSiQue）、评判器（GPT-5.4和GPT-4.1在双语料库上配对评估）。执行2x4,440主矩阵运行、600跨语料库运行和5,000多次忠实性评判，并对引用精度在检索集与归因集两个测量点分别计算。
AI.result: 关键发现：(C2a) GraphRAG在检索集上精度仅0.12-0.23，但合成器选择性引用时精度达0.48-0.65，测量点选择会反转架构排名；(C1) 答案级引用胜者依赖语料库和层深但对嵌入器稳健，GraphRAG在MuSiQue全部层深胜出；(C2b) 忠实性在DO-178C上随跳数下降，但在Wikipedia链上无此效应；(C3) LLM评判器评估忠实性极不可靠，GPT-5.4跨嵌入器自kappa仅0.137，重评判11周前冻结输入kappa<=0.14；(C4) 学习路由器在稠密嵌入上实现宏F1 0.86的跳数分类。
AI.conclusion: RAG架构的结论高度依赖评估设置，尤其是引用测量点、语料库特性和评判器稳定性。作者主张RAG架构声明必须在如此水平的稳健性下检验——包括对引用测量点的稳健性——才应被采信。

title: Hear, Invoke, and Understand: A Skill-Calling Multimodal Agent for Large Audio Language Models
summary: Complex acoustic problems may require models to perform acoustic operations, interact with external tools and reason over the resulting textual or processed-audio observations rather than answer directly from a fixed audio input. We study such problems as tool-interactive audio reasoning and develop SpeechAgent-R, an audio agent that coordinates its intrinsic multimodal understanding with external skills and tools. To support this capability, we construct HIU-Corpus, comprising 65,492 interaction trajectories and 507.6 hours of audio across 24 tasks, 8 skills and 9 tools. SpeechAgent-R first learns structured interaction behaviors through trajectory-based supervised fine-tuning and then improves its decisions through multi-turn reinforcement learning. We further introduce HIU-Bench to jointly evaluate task performance, interaction quality and generalization to diverse task settings. It contains 1,395 samples across 56 tasks, including in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) splits with substantial shifts in tool usage and workflow composition. SpeechAgent-R achieves 84.17 on ID tasks and 70.94 on OOD tasks, improving over the base model under the same agent harness by 15.40 and 14.23 points. These results demonstrate that learning skill and tool coordination improves audio agents' ability to handle diverse task settings and adaptive tool interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpeechAgent-R，一个支持工具交互式音频推理的音频智能体，并构建了HIU-Corpus（65,492条交互轨迹，507.6小时音频，覆盖24个任务、8种技能和9种工具）和HIU-Bench基准（56个任务，1,395个样本，包含分布内和分布外测试集）。SpeechAgent-R通过轨迹级监督微调学习结构化交互行为，再通过多轮强化学习优化决策，在分布内任务上达到84.17分，分布外任务上达到70.94分，相比基线模型分别提升15.40和14.23分。
AI.motivation: 复杂的声学问题可能需要模型执行声学操作、与外部工具交互，并基于文本或处理后的音频观测进行推理，而非直接从固定音频输入作答。现有音频模型缺乏这种工具交互式推理能力，因此需要研究工具交互式音频推理问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建HIU-Corpus语料库，包含65,492条交互轨迹和507.6小时音频，覆盖24个任务、8种技能和9种工具；2) SpeechAgent-R先通过轨迹级监督微调学习结构化交互行为；3) 再通过多轮强化学习提升决策能力；4) 引入HIU-Bench基准，包含56个任务，含分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）分割，用于联合评估任务性能、交互质量和泛化能力。
AI.result: SpeechAgent-R在分布内（ID）任务上达到84.17分，在分布外（OOD）任务上达到70.94分，在相同的智能体框架下相比基础模型分别提升15.40和14.23分。
AI.conclusion: 学习技能和工具协调能够显著提升音频智能体处理多样化任务设置和自适应工具交互的能力，证明了工具交互式音频推理这一研究方向的有效性。

title: Spike-HTR: Spiking Neural Transformer for Handwritten Text Recognition
summary: Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) is computationally imbalanced in two ways: most image pixels are background, and many width-axis sequence positions are blank-dominated. This creates a mismatch for Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs): handwriting is observed as a static image, whereas spiking computation unfolds over timesteps. We propose Spike-HTR, a hybrid spiking recognizer that controls both the number of spiking steps and the number of width positions processed by the deep sequence mixer. To make a static image suitable for short-horizon spiking inference, InkCoder converts it into a coarse-to-fine input stream, where early steps cover broad stroke regions and later steps emphasize sharper stroke details. To reduce sequence computation, a CTC-guided length reducer keeps likely character or uncertain positions and compresses long blank-dominated stretches before deep mixing. With $T{=}2$, Spike-HTR trains only on target data, decodes without language models or lexicons, and reaches validation/test CERs of 3.5/5.4, 2.3/2.5, and 4.2/3.9 on IAM, LAM, and READ2016. Codes are available at https://github.com/QomolangmaH/SpikeHTR.

AI.tldr: Spike-HTR 是一种混合脉冲手写文本识别器，通过 InkCoder 将静态图像转换为由粗到细的脉冲输入流，并结合 CTC 引导的长度缩减器压缩空白主导区域，以仅 2 个时间步在 IAM、LAM 和 READ2016 数据集上达到低字符错误率。
AI.motivation: 手写文本识别 (HTR) 在计算上存在两种不平衡：大部分图像像素是背景，且许多宽度轴序列位置被空白主导。这导致与脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 不匹配，因为手写作为静态图像被观察，而脉冲计算随时间步展开。
AI.method: 提出 Spike-HTR 混合脉冲识别器，同时控制脉冲步数和深度序列混合器处理的宽度位置数量。InkCoder 将静态图像转换为由粗到细的输入流（早期步骤覆盖宽笔画区域，后期步骤强调细节），CTC 引导的长度缩减器保留可能字符或不确定位置并压缩长空白段后再进行深度混合。
AI.result: 在 T=2 时，Spike-HTR 仅使用目标数据训练，无需语言模型或词典解码，在 IAM、LAM 和 READ2016 上分别达到验证/测试 CER 3.5/5.4、2.3/2.5 和 4.2/3.9。
AI.conclusion: Spike-HTR 通过极少的脉冲步数和序列压缩，实现了无需外部语言模型的高效手写文本识别，代码已开源。

title: Support Contraction for Well-Supported Nash Equilibria
summary:
We introduce the support contraction, a structural procedure for computing well-supported Nash equilibria (WSNE) in bimatrix games. On a common action rectangle, the procedure alternately retains the support of a row maximin strategy for the row-payoff matrix and the support of a column maximin strategy for the column-payoff matrix. Each restriction preserves the value of the matrix game that selected it and can only increase the other value. At a stable rectangle, full support of the two maximizing strategies and complementary slackness make every surviving action tight. Crossing the two minimax strategies then gives an exact Nash equilibrium of the retained subgame, while the two zero-sum values bound deviations to deleted actions.
  Support contraction gives a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that computes a $1/2$-WSNE of every rational bimatrix game with payoffs in $[0,1]$, with no additive slack, and a deterministic $O(ε^{-2}\log^2 n)$-bit two-party protocol for a $(1/2+ε)$-WSNE. The same support-contraction certificate, preceded by randomized one-sided localization, gives an $O(ε^{-2}n\log n)$ payoff-query algorithm for the same guarantee, improving the $ε^{-4}$ dependence to $ε^{-2}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种称为"支撑收缩"(support contraction)的结构化过程，用于计算双矩阵博弈中的良好支撑纳什均衡(WSNE)。该方法在公共行动矩形上交替保留行支付矩阵的极大极小策略支撑和列支付矩阵的极大极小策略支撑。在稳定矩形处，两种极大极小策略的满支撑和互补松弛性保证了所有存活动作都紧致。该方法给出了确定性多项式时间算法计算每个有理双矩阵博弈的1/2-WSNE，以及改进的算法和通信复杂度结果。
AI.motivation: 计算双矩阵博弈的良好支撑纳什均衡(WSNE)是一个重要的计算问题。已有算法在时间复杂度和通信复杂度上存在改进空间，特别是对于1/2-WSNE的确定性算法和查询复杂度方面，需要更高效的方法。
AI.method: 提出支撑收缩过程：在公共行动矩形上，交替保留行支付矩阵的行极大极小策略支撑和列支付矩阵的列极大极小策略支撑。每次限制都保留选择它的矩阵博弈的值，且只能增加另一个值。在稳定矩形处，通过交叉两个极小极大策略得到保留子博弈的精确纳什均衡，而两个零和值限制了对删除行动的偏离。还结合随机一侧定位（one-sided localization）进一步改进查询算法。
AI.result: (1) 确定了多项式时间算法，计算每个支付在[0,1]的有理双矩阵博弈的无加性松弛的1/2-WSNE；(2) 确定性的O(ε⁻²log²n)比特两方协议用于(1/2+ε)-WSNE；(3) 结合随机一侧定位后，得到O(ε⁻²nlogn)支付查询算法用于同样的保证，将查询复杂度从ε⁻⁴改进为ε⁻²。
AI.conclusion: 支撑收缩提供了一种统一且高效的计算框架，显著改进了双矩阵博弈中WSNE的计算复杂度，特别是在查询复杂度方面实现了从ε⁻⁴到ε⁻²的二次改进。

title: Modelling Android applications through static analysis and systematic exploratory testing
summary:
Mobile application development is a fast paced industry with frequent releases. While the development pace increases, so too does the need for automated test generation. Model-based test generation is one of the most common and successful approaches to support this need. Understanding and modelling the application under test is integral to producing comprehensive, dependable and effective tests. Unfortunately, mobile platforms such as Android, introduce a host of difficulties. Static analysis struggles with Android's event-based nature and the growing variety of mechanisms available for developers to implement different features. Additionally, dynamic analysis, implemented by popular random test generators, is slow, inefficient, and limited by a lack of application knowledge.
  This paper introduces DroidGraph, a framework to generate a comprehensive control flow model of Android applications using traditional static analysis and efficient systematic exploratory tests. DroidGraph provides a detailed model of an Android application, from low level method statements to high level user interface structures. This model can be used to support automated test generation. We apply DroidGraph to 19 diverse apps and show that our efficient exploratory tests, on average, interact with 18% more of the app than commonly used random exploration in 345 less interactions. Integrating the dynamic analysis results provided by these tests complements our static analysis, and uncovers on average 51 more components and 49% more interface callback links in the application code.

AI.tldr: DroidGraph是一个用于生成Android应用全面控制流模型的框架，结合传统静态分析与高效的系统性探索测试，弥补了静态分析在Android事件驱动特性上的不足以及动态随机测试的低效问题。实验表明，该框架在19个应用中平均以少345次交互的方式多探索了18%的应用内容，并额外发现了51个组件和49%的接口回调链接。
AI.motivation: 移动应用开发节奏快，频繁发布增加了对自动化测试生成的需求。基于模型的测试生成是常用且有效的方法，但在Android平台上，静态分析难以应对事件驱动的特性和多样化的开发者实现机制，而动态随机测试生成器则缓慢、低效且缺乏对应用的了解。因此需要一种更全面的建模方法来支持Android应用的自动化测试生成。
AI.method: DroidGraph框架结合了传统静态分析与高效的系统性探索测试。静态分析用于构建应用的控制流模型，从底层方法语句到高层用户界面结构；动态分析则通过系统性的探索测试补充静态分析的不足之处，最终生成一个覆盖全面的Android应用模型，可用于支持自动化测试生成。
AI.result: 在19个多样化应用上的实验表明，DroidGraph的高效探索测试平均比常用的随机探索多交互18%的应用内容，且所需交互次数减少了345次。将动态分析结果与静态分析相结合，平均额外发现了51个组件和49%更多的接口回调链接。
AI.conclusion: DroidGraph通过结合静态分析和系统性动态探索，能够生成比传统方法更全面的Android应用控制流模型，显著提升了对应用代码的覆盖率和组件发现能力，为自动化测试生成提供了更可靠的基础。

title: PhysAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Remote Heart Rate Estimation
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart-rate estimation from facial videos, but its weak physiological signal is easily corrupted by motion, illumination changes, occlusion, skin-appearance variation, and device noise. Existing rPPG methods typically rely on a single model to directly predict heart rate or recover pulse waveforms, while different strong estimators may produce conflicting yet individually plausible candidates for the same video. To resolve these conflicts, we propose PhysAgent, an inference-time multi-agent candidate-verification framework. Unlike direct prediction approaches, PhysAgent neither trains a new base rPPG model nor asks Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to output heart rate directly. In contrast, it treats outputs from multiple base estimators as physiological hypotheses to be verified and uses a lightweight 4B MLLM, Qwen3-VL-4B, to drive multi-agent reasoning over video conditions, signal reliability, and candidate disagreement. A deterministic physiological verifier checks the fusion proposal, and a reproducible numerical fusion process produces the final heart rate. Experimental results on multiple public rPPG benchmarks show that PhysAgent improves fusion stability and reliability across different datasets and source-domain settings, while avoiding the irreproducibility and physiological inconsistency of direct MLLM prediction or unconstrained ensemble fusion. The code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysAgent，一种推理时的多智能体候选验证框架，用于远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）心率估计。它不直接训练新模型或让MLLM直接输出心率，而是将多个基础估计器的输出视为待验证的生理学假设，利用轻量级4B MLLM（Qwen3-VL-4B）驱动多智能体推理，结合确定性生理验证器和可复现的数值融合过程，最终生成可靠的融合心率结果。
AI.motivation: rPPG的弱生理信号易受运动、光照变化、遮挡、肤色差异和设备噪声干扰，现有方法通常依赖单一模型直接预测心率，但不同强估计器可能对同一视频产生冲突且各自看似合理的候选结果，缺乏有效的冲突消解机制。
AI.method: PhysAgent框架：1）将多个基础rPPG估计器的输出作为生理学假设；2）使用轻量级4B MLLM（Qwen3-VL-4B）驱动多智能体推理，分析视频条件、信号可靠性和候选不一致性；3）通过确定性生理验证器检查融合提议；4）通过可复现的数值融合过程产生最终心率。
AI.result: 在多个公开rPPG基准数据集上的实验表明，PhysAgent在不同数据集和源域条件下均提升了融合的稳定性和可靠性，同时避免了直接MLLM预测或非约束集成融合的不可复现性和生理不一致性问题。
AI.conclusion: PhysAgent通过多智能体候选验证框架有效解决了rPPG多估计器输出冲突的问题，在不训练新基础模型的前提下实现了更稳定可靠的融合心率估计，为rPPG领域提供了一种新的推理时验证范式。

title: MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing
summary: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a shared execution model. The initial benchmark contains 180 synthetic task profiles spanning data analysis, research, and document processing, eight routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds. Across 43,200 traces, a task-aware compositional policy achieves 79.4% success compared with 76.7% for a strong workload-specific static policy, 67.4% for one-shot task routing, and 52.9% for direct answering. Relative to the static policy, this is a 2.7 percentage-point improvement with paired 95% CI of plus or minus 2.0 points, at 4.7% higher mean cost and 6.4% higher latency. Ablations show the largest losses when route composition is restricted to one operation and when verification is removed. These results are generated by a seeded offline execution model rather than a live deployment; accordingly, the primary contribution is a reproducible evaluation method and an analysis of routing-policy tradeoffs, not evidence of production effectiveness. We release task generation, policies, traces, tests, and analysis artifacts to support live-system validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MetaRoute-Bench，一个开放、可检查的框架，用于在共享执行模型下比较智能体系统中的元决策策略（如直接回答、分解任务、调用工具、委派专家等）。基准包含180个合成任务、8种路由策略和30对随机种子，共43,200条执行轨迹。任务感知组合策略达到79.4%的成功率，优于静态策略（76.7%）、一次性任务路由（67.4%）和直接回答（52.9%），代价是4.7%更高的成本和6.4%更高的延迟。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统需要在多个操作（直接回答、任务分解、工具调用、代码执行、委派、验证、恢复等）之间反复做出元决策，这些决策不仅影响任务成功率，还影响成本和延迟。然而，这些元决策通常被嵌入编排框架中，且仅通过总体任务准确率进行评估，缺乏系统化的对比分析方法。
AI.method: 构建MetaRoute-Bench框架：(1) 包含180个覆盖数据分析、研究和文档处理的合成任务模板；(2) 实现8种路由策略（包括任务感知组合策略、工作负载特定的静态策略、一次性任务路由、直接回答等）；(3) 使用30对随机种子的离线执行模型进行受控实验；(4) 通过消融实验分析各组件（如操作限制、验证环节）的贡献。
AI.result: 任务感知组合策略取得79.4%成功率，比静态策略高2.7个百分点（95%置信区间±2.0），比一次性路由高12.7个百分点，比直接回答高26.5个百分点。代价是比静态策略高4.7%的平均成本和6.4%的延迟。消融实验显示，限制为单一操作和移除验证环节时性能损失最大。
AI.conclusion: MetaRoute-Bench的主要贡献是可复现的评估方法和路由策略权衡分析，而非生产环境有效性证明。作者强调这是基于离线执行模型的结果，并发布了任务生成、策略、轨迹、测试和分析工件以支持实际系统验证。

title: MemoryForge: Synthesize Lifelong Memory for Human-Like LLM Agents
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with human-like personas is crucial for agentic applications, such as role-play and user simulation. Traditional prompt-based methods rely on descriptive conditioning by injecting static textual profiles, which often makes agents show generic behaviors due to a lack of realistic life memory. To fill this gap, we introduce memory-based conditioning, a paradigm inspired by the cognitive psychology, which replaces abstract profiles with an autobiographical memory base, enabling frozen LLMs to dynamically retrieve situation-relevant memory to guide their behaviors. We formalize its enabling task as customized lifelong memory synthesis and propose MemoryForge, a novel framework to synthesize such lifelong memory from brief target personas. MemoryForge has three key components: a context generator for socio-historical grounding, a life organizer for developmental coherence toward the target identity, and a multi-resolution simulator that balances broad temporal summaries with high-fidelity episodic experiences. Experiments on PersonaGym for role-play and SimulatorArena for user-simulation, show that the synthesized memory base by MemoryForge enables frozen LLMs to exhibit more human-like behaviors than strong descriptive conditioning baselines across multiple metrics and LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于记忆的条件化（memory-based conditioning）范式来替代传统基于提示词描述的条件化方法，使冻结的LLM拥有类似人类的个性化行为。作者提出MemoryForge框架，从简短目标人格中合成终身记忆，包含上下文生成器、生活组织器和多分辨率模拟器三个组件，在PersonaGym和SimulatorArena上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于提示词的方法通过注入静态文本描述来赋予LLM人格，但由于缺乏真实的生活记忆，智能体往往表现出泛化的行为，不够拟人化。作者希望借鉴认知心理学中自传体记忆的概念，用情景化的记忆来替代抽象的人格描述。
AI.method: 提出MemoryForge框架，包含三个关键组件：(1)上下文生成器用于社会历史背景锚定；(2)生活组织器用于确保记忆发展向目标身份连贯演进；(3)多分辨率模拟器在广泛的时间摘要与高保真情景体验之间取得平衡。整个框架从简短的目标人格描述中合成自定义的终身记忆库。
AI.result: 在PersonaGym（角色扮演）和SimulatorArena（用户模拟）两个基准上，MemoryForge合成的记忆库能使冻结的LLM展现出比强描述条件化基线更拟人化的行为，在多个指标和多种LLM骨干网络上均取得优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于记忆的条件化是一种比基于描述的条件化更有效的LLM人格赋予范式，MemoryForge成功证明了从简短人格描述合成贴近人类自传体记忆的可行性，为未来的智能体应用提供了新方向。

title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), a part of artificial intelligence (AI), are increasingly being adopted by Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to enhance question-answering capabilities and support business decision-making processes. However, hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs can serve as a source of misinformation, reducing user confidence in their reliability and trustworthiness within SMEs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising approach to address this challenge by incorporating external knowledge sources into the modeling process. In this paper, we present VectorRAG and GraphRAG modeling approaches to mitigate hallucinations and misinformation risks and evaluate their effectiveness in SME environments. Our experimental evaluation is conducted on multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen, to assess performance in terms of useful response generation, risk of hallucination, contextual relevance, as well as human-interpretation. The results demonstrate that RAG-enhanced LLMs can significantly improve response quality by reducing hallucinations and misinformation, thereby supporting more reliable, trustworthy, and context-aware decision-making in SME environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种检索增强生成方法，用于减轻中小企业在使用大型语言模型进行决策时产生的幻觉和错误信息问题，并在多个主流LLM（LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被中小企业采用以增强问答和决策支持能力，但LLM生成的幻觉输出可能成为错误信息来源，降低用户对其可靠性和可信度的信心。因此，需要有效的方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种检索增强生成（RAG）建模方法，通过将外部知识源引入建模过程来缓解幻觉和错误信息风险。实验在多个先进LLM（包括LLaMA、Mistral和Qwen）上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，RAG增强的LLM能够显著提高响应质量，减少幻觉和错误信息，从而在中小企业环境中支持更可靠、可信和上下文感知的决策。
AI.conclusion: RAG增强方法（VectorRAG和GraphRAG）是缓解LLM幻觉问题的有效手段，能够提升中小企业在实际业务决策中对LLM输出的信任度和可靠性。

title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization for Generative Recommendations
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at KDD 2026 Research Track
summary: Generative recommenders select items by autoregressively decoding semantic identifiers (SIDs), whose token positions induce a coarse-to-fine hierarchy over the item space. In practice, SID decoders are trained via supervised next-token prediction, which imitates logged trajectories rather than directly optimizing downstream utility. This motivates post-training with outcome feedback to guide decoding toward higher utility. However, logged feedback is only observed for the final exposed item, causing most post-training methods to operate at the item level and broadcast the same terminal signal across all SID tokens. As a result, token-level credit assignment becomes sparse, high-variance, and layer-dependent. To this end, we propose Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization (HRPO), a post-training framework that converts item-level outcomes into dense, token-aligned learning signals for conservative token-wise improvement. Specifically, HRPO first estimates SID prefix-level utilities via group-wise reward smoothing over feature-based user clusters. It then decomposes these utilities into residual token credits and accumulates them into credit-to-go signals. Finally, Residual-Return Policy Optimization (RRPO) optimizes the residual credits using clipped updates, group-normalized advantages, and KL regularization to preserve stability. Experiments on a public dataset and an online A/B test in a large-scale commercial system show consistent gains in session-level utility and key business metrics. Source code and the archived artifact are available for reproduction.

AI.tldr: 提出了HRPO框架，将物品级别的奖励信号转化为密集的token级别信用分配信号，用于生成式推荐系统的后训练优化，在公开数据集和线上A/B测试中均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐器通过自回归解码语义标识符（SIDs）来选择物品，但SID解码器通常通过监督式下一token预测训练，模仿日志轨迹而非直接优化下游效用。现有后训练方法仅在物品级别操作，将相同的终端信号广播到所有SID token上，导致token级别的信用分配稀疏、高方差且依赖层级。
AI.method: HRPO框架包含三个步骤：(1) 通过基于特征用户聚类的组级奖励平滑来估计SID前缀级别的效用；(2) 将这些效用分解为残差token信用并累积成信用到未来（credit-to-go）信号；(3) 使用残差返回策略优化（RRPO），结合裁剪更新、组归一化优势函数和KL正则化来优化残差信用，保持训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和大型商业系统的在线A/B测试中，HRPO在会话级效用和关键业务指标上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物品级反馈转化为密集、token对齐的学习信号，HRPO实现了保守的token级改进，有效解决了生成式推荐中token级信用分配的核心挑战，且方法可复现（提供源代码和存档工件）。

title: AcoustiTrace: When Plausible Sound Violates Physics
summary: Recent audio-video generators can produce semantically plausible and apparently synchronized sound, yet may still violate the acoustic processes implied by visible events and environments. Existing benchmarks provide limited support for attributing such violations to particular acoustic processes and quantifying their severity. We introduce AcoustiTrace, a diagnostic benchmark that formalizes acoustic physical realism in audio-video generation. AcoustiTrace organizes text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) evaluation around the acoustic process, covering sound generation, propagation environment, and acoustic reception through eight dimensions grounded in measurable acoustic quantities. Based on these evaluation dimensions, we construct a large-scale dataset organized around acoustic mechanisms, comprising real-world audio-video recordings and acoustically annotated RGB-D observations, and use it to develop targeted prompt suites and validated evaluators. Experiments reveal that even leading generators still struggle with fundamental acoustic processes despite producing plausible sound events. Finally, we show that the diagnostics AcoustiTrace provides for specific acoustic relations can guide model refinement toward more physically faithful audio and open new directions for incorporating acoustic principles into training objectives, reward modeling, and candidate selection.

AI.tldr: AcoustiTrace是一个诊断基准，用于评估音视频生成中的声学物理真实性。它围绕声学过程（声音生成、传播环境、声学接收）建立八个评估维度，并构建了大规模数据集、提示词套件和验证评估器。实验表明即使领先的生成模型在基础声学过程上仍存在不足，且该基准的诊断结果可指导模型改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的音视频生成模型虽然能生成语义合理且表面上同步的声音，但往往违反可见事件和环境隐含的声学物理过程。已有基准无法将此类违规归因于特定声学过程，也无法量化其严重程度，因此需要形式化的诊断基准来系统性评估声学物理真实性。
AI.method: AcoustiTrace围绕声学过程组织T2AV和I2AV评估，涵盖声音生成、传播环境和声学接收三个层面，细分为八个基于可测声学量的评估维度。方法包括：构建基于声学机制的大规模数据集（含真实音视频记录和声学标注的RGB-D观测）、开发针对性的提示词套件、以及经过验证的评估器。
AI.result: 实验发现，即使领先的生成模型在产生合理声音事件的同时，仍难以处理基础声学过程。此外，AcoustiTrace提供的特定声学关系诊断结果可以有效指导模型改进，使其朝向更符合物理真实性的音频生成。
AI.conclusion: AcoustiTrace为音视频生成中的声学物理真实性提供了系统化的诊断框架，不仅揭示了现有模型的不足，还为将声学原理纳入训练目标、奖励建模和候选选择打开了新方向，推动生成模型向更物理保真的方向发展。

title: An Evolutionary Algorithm Assisted by an Ensemble of Pareto-Optimal Surrogate Models
comment: A preprint of the "Accepted article" version
summary: An ensemble of surrogate models helps improve the prediction quality and robustness of surrogate models, and in turn, the search performance of surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithms (SAEAs). Although different degrees of smoothness of the approximated fitness landscapes need to be carefully designed for an effective ensemble, little attention has been paid to the explicit tuning of the degree of smoothness derived by surrogate models. This study proposes an adaptive ensemble SAEA, which automatically constructs plausible ensemble models by optimizing their parameter settings. Unlike existing adaptive/ensemble SAEAs, which consider prediction accuracy alone, the proposed algorithm optimizes the structure of radial basis function networks (RBFNs) by solving bi-objective minimization problems of approximation error and model complexity, resulting in robust ensemble models of accurate surrogate models with different degrees of smoothness of the approximated fitness landscapes. As a result, the over/under-fittings are reduced. Additionally, an infill criterion is designed so that surrogate models with different degrees of smoothness can contribute to the solution prescreening. The experimental results demonstrated the statistical superiority of our algorithm over state-of-the-art SAEAs on a single-objective benchmark and real-world problem sets under an expensive optimization scenario. The source code of the proposed algorithm is available at https://github.com/haranychan/EPOS

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应集成代理模型辅助进化算法（EPOS），通过双目标优化自动构建具有不同平滑度的RBFN集成模型，并设计相应的填充准则，在昂贵优化场景下显著优于现有SAEAs。
AI.motivation: 现有集成代理模型方法通常只关注预测精度，忽略了不同平滑度对集成效果和搜索性能的重要影响，缺乏对代理模型平滑度的显式调节机制。
AI.method: 将RBFN结构与参数优化建模为近似误差和模型复杂度的双目标最小化问题，通过求解Pareto最优解集自动获得具有不同平滑度的代理模型集成；同时设计填充准则让不同平滑度的模型共同参与解预筛选。
AI.result: 在单目标基准测试和真实世界问题集上，在昂贵优化场景下，所提算法在统计上优于最先进的SAEAs。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式优化平滑度多样性构建自适应集成代理模型，可以有效减少过拟合和欠拟合，提升SAEA的搜索性能，并提供开源代码供复现。

title: Order Auctions with Private Position Preferences
summary: We study auctions where two positions are sold to unit-demand bidders with private heterogeneous order preferences: some are specialists who value only the first position, while others are generalists who are indifferent between the two. First, we consider a standard first-price rule which allocates the first and second items to the highest and second-highest bidders, respectively. We show that no strategy profile ex-post implements the efficient allocation at every type profile, irrespective of payments, and provide a distribution-free equilibrium welfare guarantee of $\frac{1}{2}$. To augment this result, we prove that for deterministic one-round auctions and discrete bids, the efficient allocation requires each bidder to communicate at least one bit more than its bid's binary representation. We next ask what the same bit accomplishes in winner-pays-bid formats where bidders can also specify specific item preferences. In particular, we show that this strengthens our distribution-free equilibrium welfare guarantee to $1-\frac{1}{e}$. Finally, we discuss our results' applicability to priority service auctions and blockchain transaction sequencing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两个物品拍卖中，针对具有不同物品偏好（专家只重视第一个位置，通才则无所谓）的买家，分析标准第一价格拍卖的效率与福利保证，并探讨允许表达物品偏好的拍卖如何将无分布均衡福利保证从1/2提升到1-1/e，最后讨论其在优先服务拍卖和区块链交易排序中的应用。
AI.motivation: 在现实拍卖场景（如优先服务拍卖、区块链交易排序）中，买家对多个拍卖物品可能存在异构偏好，而标准拍卖机制（如第一价格）可能无法保证有效配置。作者希望研究这种异构偏好下拍卖的效率界限，并探索简单的机制改进（如多传达一个比特）能带来怎样的福利改善。
AI.method: 理论分析：（1）证明在标准第一价格拍卖下，无论支付规则如何，不存在能实现事后有效配置的策略组合；（2）提供一个无分布依赖的均衡福利保障1/2；（3）证明对于确定性单轮拍卖和离散出价，实现有效配置需要每个竞拍者至少比其出价二进制表示多传达一个比特的信息；（4）在拍卖中允许竞拍者指定特定物品偏好的情况下（winner-pays-bid格式），证明福利保障可提升至1-1/e。
AI.result: 获得了三个主要结果：标准第一价格拍卖无法事后有效配置、无分布福利保证为1/2；实现有效配置需要额外的信息比特；允许表达物品偏好的winner-pays-bid格式可将福利保证提升至1-1/e（约0.632）。
AI.conclusion: 作者表明，在异构物品偏好的多物品拍卖中，标准机制存在根本性效率局限，但通过让竞拍者有能力表达特定物品偏好（即多传达一个比特信息），可以显著改善福利保证。该结果为优先服务拍卖与区块链交易排序等应用场景设计提供了理论指导。

title: PADRAIG: Precise Android Automated Input Generation
summary:
Android automated test input generation has been a highly researched topic for over a decade and has shown promising results with a variety of approaches. Random input generation is commonly used and the easiest to maintain, but ultimately inefficient. Systematic and search-based approaches produce effective tests but require a disproportionally large generation runtime. Model-based approaches have the additional overhead of modelling the application under test (AUT) but they result in a faster test generation.
  In this paper we present Precise AnDRoid Automated Input Generation (PADRAIG), a model-based test input generation framework that uses a detailed control flow model of the AUT to generate tests that can achieve higher line coverage, with a lower test generation runtime than the state of the art. We compare the line coverage achieved, and the generation runtime of PADRAIG against 3 state of the art tools, each of which uses a different test input generation technique. Our results, using 19 randomly selected Android apps from the F-Droid application store, show that PADRAIG achieves, on average, 16% more coverage of the AUT than the state of the art and it can generate tests with, on average, 84% less runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PADRAIG，一个基于模型的Android自动化测试输入生成框架，通过使用应用详细的控制流模型，在19个F-Droid随机选取的应用上，相比现有技术平均提高16%的行覆盖率，同时生成时间平均减少84%。
AI.motivation: 现有Android自动化测试输入生成方法各有不足：随机输入生成简单但效率低；系统化和基于搜索的方法能生成有效测试但需要过长的生成时间；基于模型的方法虽有额外建模开销但生成更快。作者希望结合模型驱动的优势，提供一种既能达到更高覆盖率又能缩短生成时间的方案。
AI.method: PADRAIG采用基于模型的方法，构建应用在测（AUT）的详细控制流模型，并据此生成测试输入。通过精细的控制流建模来指导输入生成，以实现更高的行覆盖率和更低的生成运行时间。
AI.result: 在19个从F-Droid应用商店随机选取的Android应用上，与3个使用不同测试输入生成技术的现有工具（各自对应不同方法）进行比较。结果显示PADRAIG平均比现有技术多覆盖16%的代码行，同时测试生成运行时间平均减少84%。
AI.conclusion: 基于详细控制流模型的测试输入生成方法（PADRAIG）在行覆盖率和生成效率两方面均优于现有技术，证明了模型驱动方法相比其他测试生成技术的有效性。

title: SafeBuild-Bench: A Temporal-Robust Construction Safety Benchmark with Graph-Enhanced Data Mining
summary: Construction-safety models must handle concrete deployment risks, such as a worker standing near a scaffold edge without guardrails, rather than only recognize common objects in curated images. Yet real inspection archives are redundant, long-tailed, and collected across changing sites and months. We introduce SafeBuild-Bench, a metadata-driven benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on construction safety under realistic temporal and site variation. It is mined from 100K+ industrial image-text records and contains 3,314 task instances from over 3,000 expert-verified images, covering multiple-choice hazard identification and free-form hazard description. To make expert verification scalable, we develop GEMS, a graph-enhanced multimodal selection pipeline that combines a proxy-model confusion signal with graph-based diversity to identify informative candidates from redundant streams. On public instruction-tuning data, GEMS-selected subsets preserve robustness-oriented performance under small data budgets. On SafeBuild-Bench, current MLLMs remain far from reliable construction-safety understanding, with the best overall score near 60. We release the benchmark, evaluation scripts, and GEMS codebase at https://github.com/safebuild/gems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SafeBuild-Bench，一个面向多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的建筑安全评估基准，包含3,314个任务实例和3,000+专家验证图像，覆盖多选题隐患识别和自由形式隐患描述。同时提出GEMS（图增强多模态选择管道），通过代理模型混淆信号和图基多样性从冗余数据流中筛选有信息量的候选样本，实现可扩展的专家验证。实验表明当前MLLMs在该基准上最佳得分仅约60%，远未达到可靠水平。
AI.motivation: 建筑安全模型需要处理具体的部署风险（如工人站在无护栏的脚手架边缘），而不仅仅是识别整理图像中的常见物体。然而真实的巡检档案数据冗余、长尾分布且跨场地和月份变化，现有基准无法评估模型在真实时空变化下的安全理解能力。
AI.method: 1) 从100K+工业图像-文本记录中挖掘构建SafeBuild-Bench基准，包含两类任务：多选题隐患识别和自由形式隐患描述。2) 开发GEMS图增强多模态选择管道，结合代理模型混淆信号与图基多样性来从冗余数据流中筛选信息量大、多样性高的候选样本，用于可扩展的专家验证。
AI.result: GEMS在公共指令微调数据上，以较小数据预算保持了鲁棒性导向的性能。在SafeBuild-Bench上，当前MLLMs最佳整体得分接近60%，说明现有模型在建筑安全理解上仍远不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在建筑安全实际部署场景下的理解能力仍有显著不足，本文发布的基准和GEMS管道为相关研究提供了评估工具和数据筛选方法。代码和基准已开源。

title: Progressive$^2$: A Teacher-Student Progressive Co-Evolving Knowledge Distillation Method for Substantial Model Compression
comment: Manuscript under review at IEEE Transactions on Services Computing
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely utilized technique for transferring knowledge from a large model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student). Owing to its flexibility and broad applicability, KD has been extensively applied in the compression of server-side models to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of client users. Despite significant advancements, the performance of distillation is substantially compromised when a large disparity exists between the capabilities of the server and the requirements of the client. To alleviate this problem, we propose a novel distillation approach, named Progressive$^2$, which operates through the combination of a progressively stronger teacher and a progressively smaller student. On the side of the teacher, rather than involving all layers simultaneously, we progressively select additional layers for distillation following a raw-to-rich semantic progression, establishing a systematic learning curriculum. Furthermore, we design a teacher-side multi-feature fusion adapter for the teacher to improve training stability, which is theoretically supported by the framework of Lipschitz continuity. On the side of the student, rather than directly training a tiny model, we gradually reduce the size of the network to facilitate an iterative co-evolution with the teacher. Progressive$^2$ serves as a flexible framework; the progressive strategy of the teacher can be deployed independently to achieve an optimal balance between accuracy and training efficiency, while the joint integration of the teacher and the student yields further improvements in overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Progressive²，一种结合渐进增强教师和渐进缩小学生的知识蒸馏新方法。教师侧按raw-to-rich语义顺序渐进选择层进行蒸馏，并设计多特征融合适配器（基于Lipschitz连续性理论支持）提升训练稳定性；学生侧逐步缩小网络规模，促进师生间的迭代共同进化。该框架灵活，教师侧策略可独立部署，联合集成可进一步提升整体性能。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏（KD）被广泛用于将大模型（教师）知识迁移到小模型（学生），以压缩服务器端模型满足客户端服务质量需求。然而，当服务器模型能力与客户端需求之间存在较大差距时，蒸馏性能会严重受损。本文旨在解决师生能力差异过大导致的蒸馏性能下降问题。
AI.method: 提出Progressive²方法，包含两个关键设计：(1) 教师侧：不一次性引入所有层，而是按照从浅层到深层的语义进展渐进选择额外层参与蒸馏，建立系统学习课程；同时设计教师侧多特征融合适配器，基于Lipschitz连续性理论框架提升训练稳定性。(2) 学生侧：不直接训练极小模型，而是逐渐减小网络规模，实现与教师侧的迭代共同进化。
AI.result: Progressive²作为灵活框架，教师侧渐进策略可独立部署，在准确性和训练效率之间达到最优平衡；教师与学生联合集成可进一步改善整体性能。
AI.conclusion: Progressive²通过渐进式师生共同进化策略，有效缓解了师生能力差距过大导致的蒸馏性能退化问题，同时保持了框架的灵活性，既支持教师侧独立部署以优化效率，也支持联合集成以最大化性能提升。

title: AgentMemBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Management Strategies in Conversational AI Agents
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures submitted on Neural Computing and Applications
summary: Long-term memory remains a critical bottleneck for conversational AI agents, whose finite context windows cannot support coherent recall across thousands of turns. We present AgentMemBench, a unified, reproducible benchmark evaluating five memory management strategies under identical conditions: in-context windowing (ICW), external key-value store (EKV), graph-based episodic memory (GEM), compression-based summarisation (CBS), and web-augmented memory (WAM).
