Existing inference-energy benchmarks report model-, phase-, or token-level energy, and recent carbon-accounting work motivates Shapley fairness conceptually. Neither provides measured request-level ground truth, so how far the accounting rules used in practice deviate from a fair allocation has remained unknown. We present JouleShare, an attribution framework with two components. An offline harness establishes this ground truth by replaying request subsets under vLLM with a reproducible protocol, integrating GPU power telemetry, and computing exact Shapley energy for each request. A lightweight calibration model, JCalib, then learns to predict Shapley shares from cheap request features for use at serving time. Across 16 model/workload runs, token-proportional attribution differs from exact Shapley by 0.440 normalized L1 on average under static batching and by 0.458 under continuous batching, a gap that reproduces across three data-center GPUs. JCalib reduces this error to 0.116 under static batching and 0.177 under continuous batching, below even a standalone-measurement baseline that is unavailable online, while preserving exact batch-energy efficiency. Sampled Shapley extends the measured reference to larger group sizes, where the gap persists and a single offline calibration remains the most accurate deployable rule. The results show that token attribution is not a reliable proxy for marginal energy under batched execution, and that measured Shapley ground truth can calibrate low-cost request features toward fairer attribution.

AI.tldr: JouleShare是一个请求级能源归因框架，通过离线测量精确Shapley能量作为基准，并用轻量级校准模型JCalib在服务时预测Shapley份额。实验表明token按比例归因与精确Shapley存在显著偏差（归一化L1约0.44-0.46），而JCalib可将误差降至0.116-0.177。
AI.motivation: 批处理LLM服务提高了吞吐量但使能量核算复杂化。GPU功率遥测是聚合级别的，而可持续性报告、费用分摊和工作负载分析通常需要请求级别的能量核算。现有基准只报告模型级、阶段级或token级能量，缺乏测量得到的请求级真实值，导致实践中使用的核算规则与公平分配之间的偏差未知。
AI.method: JouleShare包含两个组件：(1) 离线框架通过重放请求子集、集成GPU功率遥测、计算精确Shapley能量来建立请求级能量基准；(2) 轻量级校准模型JCalib从廉价请求特征学习预测Shapley份额以用于服务时。此外，采样Shapley将测量参考扩展到更大的组规模。
AI.result: 在16个模型/工作负载运行中，token按比例归因与精确Shapley的平均归一化L1差异为0.440（静态批处理）和0.458（连续批处理），在三种数据中心GPU上可复现。JCalib将误差降至0.116（静态）和0.177（连续），优于在线不可用的独立测量基线，同时保持精确批次能量效率。采样Shapley显示差距持续存在，单一离线校准仍是最准确的部署规则。
AI.conclusion: Token归因并非批处理执行下边际能量的可靠代理，测量得到的Shapley真实值可以校准低成本请求特征以实现更公平的能量归因。该工作填补了请求级能量核算中缺乏测量真实值的空白。

title: Auditing Semantic Gains in Sequential Recommendation: A Lightweight Recovery Test
summary: Recent semantic and generative-retrieval recommenders report substantial improvements over ID-only sequential baselines, but it remains unclear whether these gains arise from language-model reasoning, semantic-ID generation, end-to-end semantic architectures, stronger offline item representations, or complementary semantic and collaborative signals. We investigate this attribution ambiguity through LIME-Rec, a lightweight and auditable recovery test. LIME-Rec combines three independent experts: a SASRec sequential expert, an ItemCF co-occurrence expert, and a semantic expert based on frozen BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 item embeddings. Their full-catalog scores are normalized per user and combined through auditable score-level fusion followed by bounded history calibration. The fusion gate and calibration head are fitted on validation data only, require no serving-time language-model inference, and keep each expert contribution separately inspectable. On Amazon Beauty, Toys, and Sports, LIME-Rec achieves R@10 scores of 0.0996, 0.1105, and 0.0593, outperforming the strongest comparison baseline by 7.0%-12.0%. Three-expert fusion without history calibration consistently outperforms calibrated SASRec, showing that calibration alone does not explain the recovery. Randomly permuting item-text embeddings across item IDs reduces R@10 by 13.6%-17.5%, indicating that the gains depend on genuine item-text correspondence rather than additional representation capacity. These results suggest that lightweight recovery from offline item representations and transparent fusion should be ruled out before improvements are attributed to serving-time language modeling, semantic-ID generation, or heavier semantic machinery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIME-Rec，一种轻量级且可审计的恢复测试方法，用于探究语义和生成式检索推荐器性能提升的真正来源。LIME-Rec通过融合三个独立专家（SASRec序列专家、ItemCF共现专家、基于冻结语义嵌入的语义专家），在三个Amazon数据集上以7.0%-12.0%的R@10提升超越最强基线，并通过消融实验证明性能增益依赖于真实的item-text对应关系，而非语言模型推理或重型语义机制。
AI.motivation: 近期语义和生成式检索推荐器相比仅ID的序列基线有显著提升，但这些提升究竟源于语言模型推理、语义ID生成、端到端语义架构、更强的离线物品表示，还是语义与协同信号的互补，尚不清楚。这种归因模糊性阻碍了领域的科学进展。
AI.method: LIME-Rec结合三个独立专家：SASRec序列专家、ItemCF共现专家、基于冻结BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5物品嵌入的语义专家。全目录分数按用户归一化，通过可审计的分数级融合和受界历史校准组合。融合门和校准头仅在验证集上拟合，不需要服务时语言模型推理，每个专家贡献可独立检查。通过置换item-text嵌入进行归因测试。
AI.result: 在Amazon Beauty、Toys、Sports上，LIME-Rec的R@10分别为0.0996、0.1105、0.0593，超越最强基线7.0%-12.0%。三专家融合（无历史校准）持续优于校准后的SASRec。随机置换嵌入使R@10下降13.6%-17.5%，证明增益依赖真实item-text对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 在将推荐性能提升归因于服务时语言建模、语义ID生成或更重的语义机制之前，应先排除轻量级离线物品表示恢复和透明融合的可能性。LIME-Rec作为可审计的基准工具，为推荐系统归因分析提供了新范式。

title: Governance Outruns Analysis: Incidence and Manipulability of Credential-Gated Reciprocal Review
summary: Generative tools have lowered the cost of producing a submission without lowering the cost of evaluating one, and venues have responded with governance: submission caps, reviewing obligations tied to submission count, and eligibility gates keyed to prior publication. These rules bind tens of thousands of researchers and are typically announced without published analysis of their incentive properties. We formalise the family as credential-gated reciprocal review and prove three structural results: a step-shaped obligation against linear demand yields incidence that is not monotone in consumption; a transferable credential gate defeats padding-resistant quota design, since the gate confers feasibility and no per-author price offsets a jump in the feasible set; and a per-author obligation with a per-paper penalty makes sanction risk perfectly correlated within an author's portfolio. Evaluating against a full prior-cycle submission graph (19,814 submissions, 64,648 authors, 75,859 observed reviews), the obligation covers 84.2% of realised demand, 81.4% of authors owe nothing, and the most burdened agents owe 4.45 times the review labour they generate against 0.45 times for the least. A three-part modification, evaluated on the same fixed graph, flattens incidence to near-uniform and removes the padding incentive.

AI.tldr: 本文首次形式化分析学术会议治理中"以资格为前提的互惠评审"（credential-gated reciprocal review）制度，证明了其三个结构性缺陷：阶梯式义务在应对线性需求时产生非单调负担；可转移资格门槛击败防灌水配额设计；人均义务与按论文惩罚结合导致作者组合内制裁风险完全相关。作者用19,814篇投稿、64,648位作者、75,859条评审的真实数据验证了该制度的不均衡性（81.4%作者零义务，最重负担者按4.45倍承担），并提出三部分修改方案将负担摊平至近似均匀并消除灌水动机。
AI.motivation: 生成式工具降低了提交论文的成本却未降低评审成本，学术会议因此引入治理规则（提交上限、评审义务、资格门槛），但这些规则约束着数万研究者，却从未被系统分析其激励属性。作者希望填补这一空白，为治理政策提供正式的理论分析依据。
AI.method: 作者将这类治理规则形式化为"资格门槛-互惠评审"（credential-gated reciprocal review）统一框架，通过博弈论与机制设计证明三个结构性定理；随后使用前一完整周期的真实投稿图数据（19,814篇投稿、64,648位作者、75,859条评审记录）进行实证评估，并提出三部分修改方案在同一固定图上验证效果。
AI.result: 三项定理分别揭示了：阶梯型义务对线性需求产生非单调负担分布；可转移资格门槛使防灌水配额设计失效；作者组合内制裁风险完全相关导致风险过度集中。实证显示现状制度下84.2%的实际需求被义务覆盖，81.4%的作者无需承担义务，最重负担者贡献量是最轻者的约10倍（4.45 vs 0.45）。三部分修改方案在相同图上将负担摊平至近似均匀并消除灌水激励。
AI.conclusion: 当前学术会议评审治理制度存在系统性激励缺陷，通过形式化分析可以揭示并改进。所提三部分修改方案在保持覆盖率的条件下显著改善公平性并消除灌水动机，为会议主办方提供了可落地的政策改进方向。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Modeling & Simulation: An Overview
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) and Modeling & Simulation (M&S) are increasingly intertwined, reflecting converging research needs across both communities, rapid technological advances such as the rise of generative AI, and the growing availability of data and computational resources. This report provides a structured overview of the intersections of AI and M&S. The relationship goes both ways: AI can support, augment, or even replace components of simulation studies, while simulations can serve as data generators, training environments, and evaluation platforms for AI. We organize this landscape along the stages of M&S from model specification and input modeling to execution, experimentation, verification and validation, and output analysis. Selected studies at each stage illustrates how techniques such as Large Language Models have reshaped simulation practices, while highlighting limitations and open challenges. This report also provides a conceptual roadmap that helps readers navigate a rapidly changing ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了人工智能（AI）与建模与仿真（M&S）交叉领域的结构化综述，从M&S的各个阶段（模型规范、输入建模、执行、实验、验证与验证、输出分析）梳理两者双向关系，并给出概念路线图。
AI.motivation: AI与M&S正在深度融合，但两者交叉领域缺乏系统性梳理。由于生成式AI的兴起、数据与算力资源的增长，以及两个社区的研究需求日益趋同，需要一份结构化报告来帮助读者理解这一快速变化的生态系统。
AI.method: 按M&S的流程阶段（模型规范、输入建模、执行、实验、验证与验证、输出分析）组织综述，在每个阶段选取代表性研究案例，展示LLM等技术如何重塑仿真实践，同时指出局限性。
AI.result: 揭示了AI与M&S之间双向赋能关系：AI可支持、增强或替代仿真研究中的组件；仿真可作为AI的数据生成器、训练环境和评估平台。提供了各阶段的典型案例与面临的开放挑战，以及概念性路线图。
AI.conclusion: AI与M&S的融合是双向且多维的，虽然LLM等技术已显著改变仿真实践，但仍存在局限性和开放挑战。该报告为读者提供了导航这一快速演进领域的结构化框架。

title: K-space Gaussian Representation for Parallel MRI
summary: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) aims to recover the k-space signal from acquired measurements, where accurate estimation of missing samples is essential for high-fidelity reconstruction. Existing k-space reconstruction methods estimate missing samples through interpolation operators or structure priors defined on discrete sampling grids. Although these formulations effectively exploit local interpolation relationships and global k-space redundancy, they reconstruct only discrete frequency coefficients and therefore do not explicitly model the underlying continuous signal. To overcome this limitation, we propose K-space Gaussian Representation (KGR), the first explicit continuous representation formulated directly in the native k-space domain. Rather than estimating unknown samples on discrete grids, KGR parameterizes the continuous signal using Gabor-Gaussian primitives with shared spatial geometry, yielding a compact representation that naturally preserves inter-coil correlations. Because unconstrained continuous fitting does not necessarily satisfy the intrinsic structural properties of multi-coil signal, the estimated representation is projected onto a low-rank manifold to enforce the algebraic constraints arising from smoothly varying phase and coil redundancy. A frequency-adaptive fitting strategy accommodates the heterogeneous characteristics of different k-space regions. Comprehensive validation across multiple datasets and sampling schemes shows consistent improvements over representative reconstruction baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. These results suggest that explicit continuous parameterization of native k-space provides a principled framework for integrating continuous signal modeling with structured low-rank reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KGR（K空间高斯表示），首次在原生k空间域中建立显式连续表示，用于加速MRI重建。KGR使用Gabor-Gaussian基元参数化连续信号，并投影到低秩流形以保持多线圈信号的代数约束，配合频率自适应拟合策略，在多个数据集和采样方案上优于现有重建基线。
AI.motivation: 现有k空间重建方法仅在离散采样网格上估计缺失样本，虽有局部插值与全局冗余优势，但无法显式建模底层连续信号，限制了重建精度与物理一致性。
AI.method: 1) 提出KGR，在原生k空间域用共享空间几何的Gabor-Gaussian基元参数化连续信号；2) 将估计的表示投影到低秩流形，施加由平滑相位和线圈冗余产生的代数结构约束；3) 采用频率自适应拟合策略，适应不同k空间区域的异质特性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和采样方案上的综合验证表明，KGR在定量指标和视觉质量上均一致优于代表性重建基线。
AI.conclusion: 原生k空间的显式连续参数化为整合连续信号建模与结构化低秩重建提供了原则性框架，且证明了该思路的有效性。

title: AutoCause: A Python framework that automates expert decisions in environmental time-series causal discovery
comment: 33 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software
summary: Environmental time-series causal discovery requires expert decisions about method choice, conditional-independence tests, lag horizons, sample-size adequacy, multiple-testing control, and evidence interpretation. Applied inconsistently across datasets, these choices yield graphs that cannot be compared, reproduced, or audited. We present AutoCause, an open-source Python workflow that records each decision, derives defaults from an extended causal-audit module, and admits domain-informed overrides. The workflow wraps four established causal-discovery methods from three families, adds non-causal reference models, and grades links by method-count support. On 145 datasets from DGP-Atlas, TimeGraph, and a topology-derived CausalRivers reference, the methods recover complementary parts of the reference graphs. Majority-supported links are more precise than single-method links on the synthetic benchmarks but not against river topology. AutoCause converts inconsistent expert practice into an auditable, repeatable analysis; causal interpretation remains with the analyst. Available at https://github.com/marcoruizrueda/autocause.

AI.tldr: AutoCause是一个开源Python工作流，用于环境时间序列因果发现。它记录每个决策、从扩展的因果审计模块派生默认值、允许领域专家覆盖，并整合四种来自三个家族的因果发现方法。在145个数据集上的评估表明，多数方法支持的链接比单一方法更精确，该系统将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析流程。
AI.motivation: 环境时间序列因果发现中，专家在方法选择、条件独立性检验、滞后范围、样本量、多重检验控制和证据解读等方面做出的决策不一致，导致生成的图无法比较、复现或审计。这种主观决策的不一致性是当前领域的主要痛点。
AI.method: 构建一个自动化工作流：1) 记录每个分析决策形成审计轨迹；2) 从扩展的因果审计模块中推导默认配置；3) 允许领域知识驱动的覆盖；4) 封装四种已建立的因果发现方法（涵盖三个方法家族）；5) 增加非因果参考模型作为对照；6) 根据方法支持的数量对链接进行分级。
AI.result: 在145个数据集（来自DGP-Atlas、TimeGraph和拓扑衍生的CausalRivers参考）上的评估显示，不同方法恢复参考图中的互补部分。在合成基准中，多数方法支持的链接比单一方法产生的链接更精确，但在河流拓扑基准上并非如此。
AI.conclusion: AutoCause将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析流程，提高因果链接的精度，但因果的解释责任仍然保留在分析师手中。

title: Exploring More to Solve More: Boosting Diversity in Text Diffusion Models via Entropy-Based Guidance
summary: Although diffusion models have revolutionized continuous domains like image synthesis through high quality generations and controllable guidance mechanisms, bringing this controllability to the discrete, sequential nature of text remains an open challenge. Meanwhile, current sampling strategies and guidance methods adjust token likelihoods without capturing the broader semantic landscape, leading to a suboptimal balance between fidelity and diversity. In this work, we introduce a novel training-free Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy (SAKE) guidance method. Our method computes the order-2 Rényi entropy over a kernel Gram matrix that captures both cross-token semantic interactions and relative token positions. By linearizing this objective in the embedding space, we derive a tractable guidance signal that dynamically adjusts the sampling distribution, flattening it to encourage exploration during redundancy and sharpening it for fidelity when diverse. Empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a superior Pareto frontier between fidelity and diversity, and improves multi-sample performance on reasoning-intensive tasks, such as code and mathematics generation, compared to temperature scaling and discrete guidance baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的语义感知核熵（SAKE）引导方法，通过计算核Gram矩阵上的二阶Rényi熵来捕捉跨token语义交互和相对位置信息，从而在文本生成中动态调整采样分布，实现保真度与多样性之间的更优权衡，并在推理密集型任务上优于温度缩放和离散引导基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在连续域（如图像）已实现高质量生成和可控引导，但将其可控性迁移到离散、序列化的文本领域仍是开放挑战。现有采样策略和引导方法仅调整token似然，未能捕捉更广泛的语义景观，导致保真度与多样性之间的平衡欠佳。
AI.method: 提出SAKE（Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy）引导方法：1）构建核Gram矩阵以捕捉跨token语义交互与相对token位置信息；2）计算该矩阵上的order-2 Rényi熵作为目标；3）在嵌入空间中对目标进行线性化，推导出易于处理的引导信号；4）该信号动态调整采样分布——在冗余时展平分布以鼓励探索，在多样时锐化分布以提升保真度。整个过程无需额外训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，SAKE在保真度与多样性之间实现了更优的Pareto前沿，并在推理密集型任务（如代码生成和数学生成）中相比温度缩放和离散引导基线显著提升了多样本采样性能。
AI.conclusion: SAKE作为一种训练免费的引导方法，通过语义感知的核熵信号为文本生成提供了动态可控的采样策略，在无需额外训练开销的前提下同时改善了生成质量与多样性，填补了扩散模型可控性在文本离散领域的空白。

title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
comment: 9 pages of main text, 8 pages of appendix, 6 figures. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: Motif-Mamba是一种结构化状态空间模型，通过向Mamba添加受三节点网络基序启发的低秩循环通路，增强状态维度间的交互通信，同时保持线性时间复杂度的循环结构，在长序列外推、语言建模和脑机接口解码任务上均优于Mamba基线。
AI.motivation: 自注意力随序列长度呈二次方增长，长序列建模效率低下。Mamba通过选择性状态空间递归提供了线性时间替代方案，但其对角状态转移矩阵限制了状态维度之间的显式交互，阻碍了跨维度信息通信能力。
AI.method: 在Mamba基础上增加一个基序约束的低秩循环通路：首先将隐藏状态投影到紧凑的动力学子空间，然后施加基序引导的三节点交互，最后将动力学结果映射回原始状态空间。该设计在保持线性时间递归结构的同时增强了跨维度通信。
AI.result: 在长序列外推、语言建模基准和脑机接口解码等多个任务上，Motif-Mamba均相较于Mamba骨干网络取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基序引导的低秩动力学为长序列建模提供了有效的结构先验，验证了在状态空间模型中引入网络基序结构约束的可行性。

title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative Recommendation (GR) has exhibited great potential by modeling item transitions as a sequence-to-sequence task. Despite the success of GR, existing frameworks primarily focus on modeling individual user sequences within a constrained internal parametric space, failing to explicitly leverage cross-user collaborative signals. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{OMEGA}, a cOllaborative MEmory augmentation framework for Generative recommendAtion. OMEGA bridges the gap between implicit parametric knowledge and explicit collaborative signals. We first introduce a latent context compression method that utilizes learnable query tokens to distill sequential user behavior into compact representations, significantly reducing storage overhead. These compressed representations are aggregated into a collaborative memory bank, serving as an explicit repository of global behavioral patterns. To ensure precise knowledge acquisition, we design a lightweight and target-aware retrieval mechanism that identifies pertinent memories by considering both sequence-level and target-level similarities. Furthermore, a context-aware integration module, equipped with a gated cross-attention mechanism, is employed to adaptively fuse the retrieved collaborative memories with the local user context while mitigating the interference of noisy patterns. Empirical evaluations on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that OMEGA significantly outperforms existing advanced GR models, validating the potential of external memory as a complement to the generative paradigm.

AI.tldr: OMEGA是一个面向生成式推荐（GR）的协作记忆增强框架。它通过可学习查询令牌将用户序列压缩为紧凑表示，聚合为协作记忆库来显式捕捉跨用户协同信号，并利用目标感知检索机制和上下文感知门控交叉注意力集成模块，将外部记忆与局部用户上下文自适应融合，在多个真实数据集上显著优于现有GR模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐框架主要局限于在内部参数空间中建模单一用户序列，无法显式利用跨用户的协作信号，这是其性能提升面临的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 1）利用可学习查询令牌的潜在上下文压缩方法，将序列行为蒸馏为紧凑表示；2）将压缩表示聚合为协作记忆库，作为全局行为模式的显式存储库；3）轻量级目标感知检索机制，同时考虑序列级和目标级相似度；4）配备门控交叉注意力的上下文感知集成模块，自适应融合协作记忆与局部用户上下文。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上的实证评估表明，OMEGA显著优于现有先进GR模型，验证了外部记忆作为生成式范式补充的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 外部显式协作记忆可以有效地弥补生成式推荐内部参数化知识的不足，为GR提供了一种可行的增强方向。

title: CultureVidBench: Benchmarking Cultural Understanding in Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models have advanced rapidly, yet their ability to represent diverse cultural contexts remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on perceptual quality, physical plausibility, and text-video alignment, but do not directly assess whether generated videos capture culturally specific objects, actions, rituals, visible text, or audio cues. We introduce CultureVidBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating cultural understanding in T2V generation. CultureVidBench contains 1,000 curated prompts covering 12 countries, 6 continents, 8 cultural regions, and 14 cultural aspects organized into three categories: material culture, social practice & performance, and ritual & ceremony. Designed specifically for video generation, CultureVidBench emphasizes dynamic and multimodal cultural representation, including social interactions, ritual procedure, and culturally appropriate visible text and audio. We evaluate seven representative T2V models through human user studies and MLLM-based automatic assessment across cultural faithfulness, multimodal cultural rendering, semantic adherence, and perceptual quality. Results show that although current models achieve strong semantic adherence and visual quality, they often fail to faithfully capture fine-grained cultural details, particularly for underrepresented regions, rituals, and multimodal cultural cues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CultureVidBench，一个专门评估文生视频（T2V）模型文化理解能力的综合基准。该基准包含1000条精心设计的提示词，覆盖12个国家、6大洲、8个文化区域和14个文化方面，分为物质文化、社会实践与表演、仪式与典礼三大类。通过对7个代表性T2V模型的评估，发现现有模型虽在语义遵循和视觉质量上表现良好，但在捕捉精细化文化细节（尤其是欠发达地区、仪式和多媒体文化线索）方面存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的文生视频基准主要关注感知质量、物理合理性和文本-视频对齐，但缺乏对生成视频是否准确捕捉文化特定对象、行为、仪式、可见文本和音频线索的直接评估。随着T2V模型快速发展，文化多样性的表达能力仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建CultureVidBench基准，包含1000条覆盖12国、6大洲、8个文化区域、14个文化方面的提示词，按物质文化、社会实践与表演、仪式与典礼三类组织。特别强调动态和多模态文化表征，包括社会互动、仪式流程、文化适配的可见文本和音频。采用人工用户研究和基于MLLM的自动评估相结合的方式，从文化忠实度、多模态文化渲染、语义遵循和感知质量四个维度评估7个代表性T2V模型。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，当前T2V模型在语义遵循和视觉质量方面表现强劲，但在忠实捕捉精细化文化细节方面经常失败，尤其是对欠代表性地区、仪式以及多模态文化线索的呈现不够准确。
AI.conclusion: CultureVidBench揭示了现有T2V模型在文化理解方面的显著短板，为未来的多模态文化生成研究提供了评估基准和改进方向。

title: What Multichoice Values Cannot See: The Information Content of Anonymous Values for Games with Graded Participation
summary: In a cooperative game with graded participation, each of $n$ players acts at one of $m$ ordered levels; multichoice games, voting with abstention, and graded feature attribution all take this form. We determine exactly what the entire family of linear, player-symmetric values, power indices, and importance measures proposed for this setting, present and future, can and cannot see, for all $m$ at once. The mechanism is short: the functional computing any one player's payoff under an anonymous value is invariant under permutations of the other $n-1$ players, and by the branching rule such invariants exist only in the Specht constituents $(n)$ and $(n-1,1)$ of $(\mathbb{C}^m)^{\otimes n}$. Consequences: the joint information of all anonymous values is a component of dimension polynomial in $n$ against an $m^n$-dimensional game space, with the classical binary theory as the $m=2$ shadow. Three players can hide: for $m\ge3$ the blind space is nonzero already at $n=3$, and the first invisible constituent is not a correlation but a chirality, realized by two distinct monotone abstention-voting rules on three voters that every anonymous power index scores identically. For $n\ge4$ the blind space is spanned by $\pm1$ games on four profiles each. Order-$d$ interaction probes see exactly the partitions with at most $d$ cells outside the first row, with full recovery only at $d=n-\lceil n/m\rceil$. Audit evasion gets easier than in the binary theory: a coalition of $c$ players evades every order-$d$ audit iff $c-\lceil c/m\rceil\ge d+1$, so with three or more levels, trios can restructure invisibly to every value-based payment scheme. Algorithmically, the visible part of a game is a polynomial-size, cheaply estimable sketch, while exact computation of any full-support value requires all $m^n-1$ nonzero queries. All dimension and rank claims are verified computationally.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带分级参与的博弈（如多选择博弈、弃权投票、分级特征归因）中线性、玩家对称值/权力指数/重要性度量的表达能力边界。通过分支规则证明所有匿名值只能看到Specht分量(n)和(n-1,1)，其余为"盲区"空间。盲区在n=3时已非零（由手性构成），三玩家可隐藏行为；审计规避比二元理论更容易。可见部分可被多项式大小的草图廉价估计，但精确计算全支撑值需全部m^n-1次查询。
AI.motivation: 在分级参与博弈中，大量线性玩家对称的值、权力指数和重要性度量被提出（多选择博弈、弃权投票、分级特征归因等），但没人知道这些家族整体能"看见"什么、不能"看见"什么。本文旨在一次性刻画全部此类机制（现在和未来的）的表达能力边界，特别是盲区空间的结构与规模。
AI.method: 利用表示论的分支规则：匿名值下每个玩家的支付函数在其余n-1个玩家的排列下不变，此类不变量仅存在于(C^m)^{⊗n}的Specht分量(n)和(n-1,1)中。由此确定可见/盲区空间的维数和结构，并给出订单交互探针的恢复条件和审计规避阈值。
AI.result: (1) 所有匿名值的联合信息仅是一个维度为n多项式大小的分量，对比m^n维博弈空间；(2) m≥3时n=3即存在非零盲区，由手性（chirality）构成，两个不同的单调弃权投票规则在所有匿名权力指数下得分相同；(3) n≥4时盲区由±1博弈生成；(4) 阶d交互探针恰能看到第一行外至多d个cell的分割，完整恢复需d=n-⌈n/m⌉；(5) c人联盟规避所有阶d审计当且仅当c-⌈c/m⌉≥d+1，意味着三玩家可隐形重组；(6) 所有维度与秩的声明均经计算验证。
AI.conclusion: 分级参与博弈的匿名值家族存在本质的表达能力瓶颈：只能感知博弈空间的一个微小子空间，且盲区包含结构性信息（不只是相关性，还有手性）。这意味着一类在二元情形下可见的信息在m≥3时对匿名值完全不可见，审计规避威胁比二元理论更严重。算法上可见部分可高效估计，但全支撑值计算代价高昂。

title: CASPER-Change-Aware Slice Prioritization for Efficient Regression Testing of LLM-based systems
summary:
Regression testing for LLM-based systems poses unique challenges because individual regression instances provide limited information about system-level regressions. A failure in a single instance does not necessarily indicate a meaningful regression or provide sufficient information to diagnose affected behaviors. Conversely, detecting regressions based only on overall system performance changes is too coarse-grained, as it does not identify which behaviors are affected. This motivates analyzing regression instances at an intermediate level through test suite slices.
  To address this challenge, we propose CASPER, a change-aware slice prioritization framework for efficient regression testing of prompt-level and model-level changes in LLM-based systems. CASPER first identifies regression slices containing semantically related instances with consistent performance characteristics using an evolutionary slice identification approach. Given a change to an LLM-based application, CASPER prioritizes slices according to their likelihood of regression using behavioral information extracted from execution logs. We instantiate CASPER in the software issue resolution domain and evaluate slice identification against clustering-based baselines and regressed slice prioritization against a random ranking baseline. Results show that CASPER generates more consistent slices while maintaining comparable or better semantic coherence and improves regressed slice prioritization across different LLM-based system changes and testing budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASPER框架，用于LLM系统的回归测试，通过切片（slice）级别的分析来平衡单实例粒度与整体性能粒度的不足，实现高效的变化感知回归测试。
AI.motivation: LLM系统的回归测试面临两难困境：单个回归实例信息量有限且可能产生误报，无法诊断受影响的行为；而仅基于整体系统性能变化的检测又过于粗粒度，无法定位具体受影响的行为。因此需要在中间层（测试套件切片）进行分析。
AI.method: CASPER框架包含两个核心步骤：(1) 使用进化式切片识别方法，将语义相关且性能特征一致的实例聚集成回归切片；(2) 针对LLM应用的变更，基于执行日志中提取的行为信息，按回归可能性对切片进行优先级排序。
AI.result: 在软件问题解决领域进行评估：切片识别方面比基于聚类的基线产生更一致的结果，同时保持可比或更好的语义连贯性；回归切片优先级排序方面在多种LLM系统变更和测试预算下均优于随机排序基线。
AI.conclusion: CASPER通过在切片层面进行回归分析，有效平衡了细粒度单实例诊断与粗粒度系统级检测之间的权衡，为LLM系统的回归测试提供了更高效且可诊断的解决方案。

title: Which Modality Decides? Counterfactual Modality Attribution for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly support high-stakes decision making by combining complementary information from images and text. While existing explainability methods identify influential image regions or text tokens, they cannot answer a fundamental question: which modality drives a prediction? Consequently, a model may produce the correct output while relying on the wrong source of evidence, masking shortcut learning and unsafe reasoning. We formulate modality attribution as a complementary explainability objective for multimodal foundation models and propose Counterfactual Modality Attribution (CMA), the first framework for quantifying modality-level contributions in MLLMs. CMA generates image-only, text-only, and joint multimodal counterfactuals using coupled diffusion priors and converts them into principled modality attribution scores through a cooperative game-theoretic formulation based on Shapley values. We evaluate CMA on controlled synthetic benchmarks with known ground-truth modality reliance and on a real-world multimodal clinical dataset. CMA correctly identifies the decision-driving modality in 98% of controlled cases and consistently outperforms baselines, revealing failures of cross-modal reasoning that remain invisible to predictive accuracy alone. Our results establish modality attribution as a complementary dimension of explainability beyond feature attribution, providing a principled framework for auditing multimodal foundation models in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Counterfactual Modality Attribution (CMA)，首个量化多模态大语言模型中模态级贡献的框架。通过耦合扩散先验生成图像/文本/联合多模态反事实样本，结合基于Shapley值的合作博弈论公式计算模态归因分数，在受控合成基准（98%准确率）和真实临床数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法只能识别有影响力的图像区域或文本token，无法回答"哪个模态驱动了预测"这一根本问题。模型可能输出正确结果却依赖错误的证据来源，掩盖了捷径学习和不安全推理，这在高风险决策场景中是严重隐患。
AI.method: CMA框架包含两个核心组件：1) 使用耦合扩散先验生成图像-only、文本-only和联合多模态三种反事实样本；2) 将这些反事实转换为基于Shapley值的合作博弈论公式，计算原理化的模态归因分数。
AI.result: 在98%的受控合成案例中正确识别决策驱动模态，一致优于基线方法，并揭示了交叉模态推理的失败——这些失败在仅看预测准确率时是不可见的。
AI.conclusion: 模态归因被确立为超越特征归因的可解释性互补维度，为安全关键应用中审计多模态基础模型提供了原理化框架。

title: A Physics-Chemistry-Informed Neural Network (PCINN) for Real-Time Spatial-ALD Coverage Prediction and Reliable Kinetics Inversion
summary:
Spatial atomic layer deposition (SALD) is a leading atmospheric-pressure, high-throughput route to industrial ALD, but design and control are limited by the cost of predicting surface coverage: high-fidelity CFD is far too slow for operating-window scans, while analytic models miss transport modulation such as the gas curtain. We present a physics-chemistry-informed neural network (PCINN), a hybrid surrogate with CFD-level accuracy at real-time speed: a query returns coverage in about 7 ms, roughly 5x10^4 times faster than a CFD solve, reaching a test R^2_log = 0.998 (leave-one-out R^2_raw = 0.974) from only 30 training cases spanning four orders of magnitude in coverage.
  The architecture is not a black box: a small network learns only the operating-condition to near-wall concentration closure, while the known surface kinetics is a hard-coded, trainable chemistry layer integrated along the substrate trajectory. This single-scalar bottleneck keeps it accurate under sparse data, interpretable and invertible.
  We add a full identifiability analysis (Fisher information, profile likelihood). The adsorption energy E_ads and desorption rate k_des are robustly identifiable; k_ads is not separately identifiable at a single temperature (only k_ads*c_wall is). Across four temperatures the prefactor nu and E_ads bind along a weakly identifiable degeneracy valley of slope 0.065 eV/decade, derived analytically as k_B T_eff ln(10) and turned into a reliability diagnostic: a seven-chemistry mismatch matrix shows it is invariant under any single-Arrhenius mismatch and shifts only when a second thermally activated process appears, so a slope departure flags unmodelled site heterogeneity.
  Data come from simulation with known ground truth inverted by the same kinetic form, so the study verifies pipeline self-consistency and the identifiability boundary, not real parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理-化学信息神经网络(PCINN)作为空间原子层沉积(SALD)的混合代理模型，实现CFD级精度但快约5万倍的实时预测（~7ms），同时通过硬编码化学动力学层保持可解释性，并开展了完整的可辨识性分析。
AI.motivation: SALD是工业级原子层沉积的领先技术，但其设计和控制受限于表面覆盖率的预测成本：高保真CFD仿真太慢，无法用于操作窗口扫描；而解析模型无法捕捉气体帘等传输调制效应。亟需一种兼具精度与速度的替代方案。
AI.method: 构建PCINN混合代理模型：小型神经网络仅学习"操作条件→近壁浓度"的闭合关系，而已知的表面动力学作为硬编码、可训练的化学层沿基底轨迹积分。这种单标量瓶颈设计使其在稀疏数据下保持准确、可解释且可逆。研究还结合Fisher信息和概似面进行了完整可辨识性分析。
AI.result: 查询仅需约7ms，比CFD快约5×10^4倍；仅用30个训练案例（覆盖四个数量级）即达到测试R²_log=0.998和留一法R²_raw=0.974。可辨识性分析表明吸附能E_ads和脱附速率k_des可稳健辨识，而k_ads在单一温度下不可独立辨识；四温度下观测到斜率为0.065 eV/decade的弱可辨识退化谷，可作为未建模位点异质性的诊断指标。
AI.conclusion: PCINN成功结合物理知识与数据驱动方法，实现了SALD表面覆盖率的高精度实时预测，并建立了参数可辨识性的系统框架。但需注意数据来自仿真且反演使用相同动力学形式，验证的是管道自洽性和可辨识性边界，而非真实参数。

title: SLMs as Multi-Agent Routers: A Progressive SFT and Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Specialised retrieval agents typically surface higher quality results than general-purpose search, but selecting the optimal agent for a given query remains an open problem. Current approaches route queries based on inferred topic or intent, however intent-based selection is fundamentally limited: it does not incorporate signal from retrieved content, and cannot detect when a topically aligned agent produces low-relevance results. We address this by training a small language model via supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning to jointly perform agent selection and structured parameter generation for downstream tool calls, using a hierarchical reward function grounded in retrieval relevance along with query-agent topic alignment. This enables the model to learn task-dependent agent suitability from retrieval performance: which agents reliably yield high-relevance results for which query distributions, and when to redirect queries away from specialised agents despite surface-level topical overlap. On a targeted subset of such agent-query mismatches, the trained model achieves an NDCG@10 of 0.918 compared to 0.539 and 0.490 for two LLM baselines (Amazon Nova Lite and Claude Haiku 4.5) that route on intent alone. Overall, it achieves a mean NDCG@10 of 0.771 (+0.177 over Nova Lite, +0.219 over Haiku) with a mean selection latency of 120.1ms, an 82.4% reduction over Nova Lite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过监督微调+强化学习训练一个小语言模型，联合执行检索代理选择和结构化参数生成，利用基于检索相关性和查询-代理主题对齐的分层奖励函数，使模型能够从检索性能中学习任务相关的代理适用性，显著优于仅基于意图路由的LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 专业的检索代理通常比通用搜索返回更高质量的结果，但如何为给定查询选择最优代理仍是一个未解决问题。现有方法基于推断的主题或意图进行路由，但意图选择存在根本性局限：它不包含检索内容信号，且无法检测主题对齐的代理是否产生低相关性结果。
AI.method: 训练一个小语言模型，通过监督微调加强化学习，联合执行代理选择和下游工具调用的结构化参数生成。使用分层奖励函数，基于检索相关性和查询-代理主题对齐进行评分。模型从检索性能中学习任务相关的代理适用性。
AI.result: 在代理-查询不匹配的目标子集上，训练模型NDCG@10达到0.918，而两个仅基于意图路由的LLM基线（Nova Lite和Claude Haiku 4.5）分别为0.539和0.490。整体平均NDCG@10为0.771（比Nova Lite高0.177，比Haiku高0.219），平均选择延迟120.1ms，比Nova Lite降低82.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将检索性能反馈纳入路由决策，超越了仅基于意图选择的路由方法，能够识别主题匹配但相关性低的代理场景并重定向查询，同时大幅降低延迟。

title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
summary: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: Nova是一个自动化的端到端JIT编译器，旨在通过对硬件映射的精确控制来最大化深度学习模型的物理硬件利用率。它通过捕获eager执行、统一前向和反向传播到单一值语义方言中，实现激进的whole-graph优化，并利用Analytic Configurator基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行计划（零搜索时间），配合结构化哈希运行时直接合成细粒度内核。在RTX 3060上，Nova在TF32矩阵乘法上匹敌或略微超越cuBLAS和XLA（相对误差<5e-4），在4200万参数模型上吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%、比XLA高4.4%，并将内存占用减少高达29%，成功在12GB消费级GPU上训练1.44亿参数模型（17,900 tokens/s），而PyTorch遭遇OOM失败。
AI.motivation: 高层张量框架（如PyTorch）的eager执行模式缺乏whole-graph可见性，以及对硬件和内存的细粒度控制，导致无法原生地最大化物理硬件利用率。这在高性能计算需求日益增长的深度学习场景中构成了关键瓶颈——需要一种能够弥合高层数学操作与底层物理硬件之间鸿沟的自动化编译解决方案。
AI.method: Nova采用端到端JIT编译器的架构：1）捕获eager执行并将前向与反向传播统一到单一值语义方言中，从而解锁whole-graph级别的激进优化；2）利用Analytic Configurator根据算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度，消除了传统的搜索开销（搜索时间降为零）；3）通过结构化哈希运行时，直接从计算的结构中合成细粒度的内核，实现融合操作、优化复杂内存层次结构以及寄存器级别的调优。
AI.result: 在RTX 3060上的评估表明：1）TF32矩阵乘法方面，Nova在大多数形状上匹敌或略微超越cuBLAS和XLA，保持严格的<5e-4相对误差；2）在4200万参数模型上，吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%，比XLA高4.4%，且不牺牲数值精度；3）内存占用比PyTorch减少高达29%，使得Nova能在12GB消费级GPU上成功训练1.44亿参数模型（17,900 tokens/s），而PyTorch在此条件下发生OOM失败。
AI.conclusion: Nova通过将自动化编译技术和精确的硬件感知优化相结合，在保持数值保真度的同时实现了显著的性能提升和内存效率改善。其关键贡献在于：推导式配置取代搜索式调优、结构哈希驱动的内核合成，以及通过统一方言实现跨前向/反向的whole-graph优化——这些设计使深度学习训练在资源受限的消费级硬件上突破了现有的性能与内存瓶颈。

title: Real-Time Hybrid Retrieval in Hyperbolic Space for Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Edge Devices
summary: This paper presents a hybrid document retrieval system designed for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that operates entirely within the Lorentz model of hyperbolic geometry. Unlike conventional dense retrievers confined to Euclidean space, this system projects pretrained word embeddings into hyperbolic space through a learned HyTE-H transformation, whose exponential volume growth suits the hierarchical organization of natural language. Documents are segmented into overlapping chunks, indexed by their Lorentz embeddings, and retrieved through a two-stage pipeline that first applies BM25 lexical scoring, then re-ranks candidates using Lorentzian inner-product similarity. A tunable parameter $α$ blends the BM25 score with the hyperbolic similarity score. The system was evaluated on five datasets from the BEIR benchmark suite, SciFact, NFCorpus, ArguAna, SciDocs, and FiQA, achieving NDCG@10 scores of 0.654, 0.304, 0.342, 0.150, and 0.217 respectively with word embeddings alone, without fine-tuned neural encoders or cross-attention rerankers. The system supports real-time indexing of user-supplied documents and resource-efficient querying over tens of thousands of moderately sized documents, so hyperbolic retrieval can run on edge devices at interactive latencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种完全在双曲几何Lorentz模型下运行的混合文档检索系统，用于检索增强生成（RAG）。系统通过学习的HyTE变换将预训练词嵌入投影到双曲空间，采用BM25词法评分与Lorentz内积相似度结合的混合两阶段检索管线，在BEIR基准的五个数据集上取得了具有竞争力的NDCG@10成绩，且无需微调神经编码器，支持边缘设备上的实时索引和交互式查询。
AI.motivation: 传统稠密检索器局限于欧几里得空间，难以有效捕捉自然语言数据内在的层次化组织结构。双曲空间的指数体积增长特性更适合建模层级语义，但此前鲜有工作将完整的RAG检索流程迁移到双曲几何中。
AI.method: 系统将预训练词嵌入通过学习的HyTE-H变换投影到Lorentz模型的双曲空间；文档被分割为重叠块并以其Lorentz嵌入建立索引；检索采用两阶段流程：先用BM25进行词法粗排，再用Lorentzian内积相似度重排候选文档；通过可调参数α融合BM25分数与双曲相似度分数。
AI.result: 在BEIR基准的五个数据集（SciFact、NFCorpus、ArguAna、SciDocs、FiQA）上分别取得NDCG@10为0.654、0.304、0.342、0.150、0.217的成绩，且仅使用词嵌入，无需微调神经编码器或交叉注意力重排器。系统支持实时索引和数万篇中等规模文档的资源高效查询，可在边缘设备上实现交互式延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了仅依赖词嵌入和双曲几何就能构建具备竞争力的RAG检索系统，无需昂贵的微调过程，同时实现边缘设备上的高效部署，为轻量化、资源友好的检索增强生成提供了新方向。

title: Déjà Cue: Localizing States in Object Histories via Vocabulary-Relative Coordinates
summary: Tracking links observations of the same object through visual change, yet cannot by itself determine when the object is empty or filled, intact or cut. We formulate identity-conditioned state-moment retrieval: given a tracked-object history and alternative state descriptions, localize an interval in which each described state holds. Absolute image-text similarity scores descriptions independently; because every visible frame depicts the same target, shared object compatibility can obscure the state evidence needed to identify the target interval. The alternatives provide the missing reference: evidence for one state should be measured against the others. We introduce Déjà Cue, a training-free framework that turns these alternatives into a vocabulary-relative coordinate system. It subtracts their state-balanced centroid from each description, calibrates frame scores, and scans multiple durations within contiguous visible runs using a frozen encoder. On 78 VOST histories, holding the temporal scan fixed and changing only the query reference nearly doubles R@1 at tIoU 0.5 from 10.3\% to 20.5\% and raises Top-1 tIoU from 16.0\% to 21.5\%. Candidate-rank analyses show that vocabulary-relative queries rank useful intervals higher within the same candidate set. Related state descriptions can therefore serve as an object-specific, query-time coordinate system for reading frozen visual representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Déjà Cue，一种无需训练的状态时刻检索框架。给定跟踪对象的历史和备选状态描述，通过将备选状态转化为词汇相对坐标系，减去状态平衡质心来校准帧评分，从而定位每个描述状态对应的时间区间。在78个VOST历史上，仅改变查询参考就使R@1 (tIoU 0.5) 从10.3%提升至20.5%。
AI.motivation: 跟踪只关联同一对象的视觉变化，但无法判断对象何时为空/满、完整/切割。绝对图像-文本相似度独立评分各描述，由于所有可见帧描绘同一目标，共享的对象兼容性会掩盖识别目标区间所需的状态证据。这促使作者利用备选描述作为缺失的参照。
AI.method: 提出Déjà Cue框架：(1) 将备选状态描述转化为词汇相对坐标系；(2) 从每个描述中减去状态平衡的质心以校准帧分数；(3) 在连续可见运行内使用冻结编码器扫描多个时长区间；(4) 状态证据通过对其他状态的相对比较来测量。
AI.result: 在78个VOST历史上，保持时间扫描固定仅改变查询参考，R@1（tIoU 0.5）从10.3%提升至20.5%（接近翻倍），Top-1 tIoU从16.0%提升至21.5%。候选排名分析显示词汇相对查询在相同候选集中将有用区间排名更高。
AI.conclusion: 相关的状态描述可以充当对象特定的、查询时的坐标系，用于读取冻结的视觉表示，从而显著提升状态时刻检索的性能。

title: Conjugation invariants determine the metacommutation permutation only up to relabelling
summary: Let $\mathcal{H}$ be the Hurwitz quaternions, $p$ an odd prime, and $Q \in \mathcal{H}$ a prime of norm $q \neq p$. Metacommutation $PQ = Q'P'$ induces a permutation $π_Q$ of the $p+1$ left-associate classes of primes of norm $p$. Cohn and Kumar compute its sign and fixed-point count, and Leite and Machiavelo its full cycle structure, by formulas depending only on conjugation-invariant data of $Q$ (namely $q$ and $\mathrm{tr}\,Q$). We prove this is exactly the boundary of what such invariants can carry: no quantity $I(Q)$ invariant under unit conjugation determines $π_Q$ as a labelled permutation of the intrinsic class set, or even the image of a single specified class. The proof combines an equivariance identity $π_{uQu^{-1}} = ρ_u π_Q ρ_u^{-1}$ with a minimal, fully explicit witness at $(p,q) = (3,5)$: the four primes $2+i$, $2+j$, $2+k$, $2-i$ form a single unit-conjugacy orbit, hence agree under every conjugation-invariant function, yet induce four pairwise distinct $4$-cycles of the same four classes. We further observe that isomorphisms $\mathcal{H}/p\mathcal{H} \to M_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ form a torsor under $\mathrm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$, so no projective labelling of the classes is canonical, and that by orbit-stabilizer the datum of one destination $π_Q(C)$ is exactly a coset $g_Q G_C$ in $\mathrm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)/G_C$. All sixteen refactorizations in the witness are listed in the appendix and have been verified by machine along two independent routes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Hurwitz四元数中素数元换位（metacommutation）诱导的置换π_Q。作者证明了Cohn-Kumar和Leite-Machiavelo基于共轭不变量（q和tr Q）的公式已经达到了这类不变量能携带信息的极限：任何单位共轭不变的量I(Q)都无法确定π_Q作为标记置换，甚至无法确定单个指定类别的像。证明结合了一个等变性恒等式和一个最小显式见证（p,q)=(3,5)，其中四个素数2+i, 2+j, 2+k, 2-i构成单一共轭轨道，却诱导四个两两不同的4-循环。
AI.motivation: 先前的文献（Cohn-Kumar, Leite-Machiavelo）已通过仅依赖共轭不变量（norm和trace）的公式，完全刻画了metacommutation诱导置换的符号、不动点数和完整循环结构。一个自然的问题是：这类不变量能否携带更多信息，例如确定置换本身（作为标记置换）？本文旨在回答这个问题，证明其边界——即这类不变量无法确定置换的标记结构或单个类别的像。
AI.method: 证明包含三个关键部分：(1) 建立等变性恒等式 π_{uQu^{-1}} = ρ_u π_Q ρ_u^{-1}，说明共轭作用与置换作用可交换；(2) 构造最小显式见证：在(p,q)=(3,5)时，四个素数2+i, 2+j, 2+k, 2-i处于同一单位共轭轨道（因此所有共轭不变函数对其取值相同），但它们诱导出四个两两不同的4-循环；(3) 进一步利用同构 H/pH → M_2(F_p) 构成PGL_2(F_p)-torsor的事实，以及轨道-稳定子定理，论证π_Q(C)的目标数据恰好是PGL_2(F_p)/G_C中的一个陪集g_Q G_C，说明不存在规范的射影标记。
AI.result: 证明了任何单位共轭不变量I(Q)都无法确定π_Q作为内在类别集合上的标记置换，甚至无法确定单个指定类别C的像π_Q(C)。附录列出了见证中全部16种重构分解，并经两条独立计算路线机器验证。
AI.conclusion: 先验文献中的公式在信息论意义下已经达到最优：共轭不变量恰好能承载循环结构（符号、不动点、循环分解）的全部信息，但无法承载标记信息（具体类别如何映射）。这揭示了metacommutation置换中"不变量可计算的部分"与"本质非规范的部分"之间的精确边界。

title: Distilling Reasoning Traces into Advisory Prompts for Software Engineering Tasks
summary: Language models are widely used for generating and otherwise processing code (e.g., identifying code hallucinations, possible inputs, or predicting outputs); however, LLMs can make mistakes, which can be serious. One key issue is that models are trained on (still) largely human-written, and thus imperfect, code; it's not easy to find sufficiently large code corpora that are entirely free of bugs. Thus, other inference-time ways of reducing LLM errors, without additional training, are desirable. "Reasoning" or "thinking" modes, exposed as a togglable feature by hybrid reasoning models, do reduce errors; however, reasoning consumes additional resources. This paper asks if better performance can be achieved without always incurring the cost of reasoning. Human students of programming learn to avoid mistakes by (a) identifying them, (b) reflecting upon the cognitive lapses that led to them (essentially, "thinking through" the errors), (c) inferring general rules or lessons from these reflections, and (d) internalizing these lessons into rules. In tutorial sessions with an instructor, this is a common Socratic interaction. Examples of such internalizable rules might include the nugget "Before coding, restate the requirements to clarify them." Inspired by this process, this paper describes an approach where we first identify examples in which "thinking mode" in a (low-resource) LLM avoids errors. These errors, and their avoidance via "thinking" in the same LLM, are then examined by a bigger LLM to generate summary explanations; these are then summarized by a large LLM into brief advisory prompts. This approach works on many modest-sized models; in some cases, the "advisory prompts" thus learned can also be gainfully transferred to other models. We also present investigations into the nature of coding errors that language models make, and a characterization of when this approach can be helpful.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的推理时方法：利用大型LLM从低资源LLM在"思考模式"下避免编码错误的事例中，提取并总结出简短的"建议提示词"（advisory prompts），将这些人类式学习经验迁移到其他模型，从而在不总是付出推理成本的情况下提升代码处理性能。
AI.motivation: LLM用于代码生成和处理时容易出错，但训练数据主要来源于人类编写的不完美代码，难以获得完全无缺陷的大规模语料。虽然"推理/思考模式"能减少错误，但会消耗额外计算资源。作者希望找到一种方法，在不需要总是启用推理模式的情况下也能获得更好的性能。
AI.method: 受人类编程学习过程（识别错误→反思认知失误→提炼一般性规则→内化规则）启发，方法分三步：(1)在低资源LLM中识别"思考模式"能避免的错误示例；(2)用更大的LLM检查这些错误及思考模式避免它们的过程，生成总结性解释；(3)再用大型LLM将这些解释总结为简短的"建议提示词"。这些提示词可应用于其他模型，并可跨模型迁移。
AI.result: 该方法在多个中等规模模型上有效，某些情况下学到的"建议提示词"可以成功迁移到其他模型。论文还提供了对LLM编码错误本质的调查，以及该方法何时有用的特征分析。
AI.conclusion: 通过模仿人类编程学习的苏格拉底式互动过程，可以从低资源模型的思考模式中提炼出可迁移的建议提示词，以低成本方式提升LLM的代码处理性能，减少错误。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Auditing Spatial Provenance in Visual Token Pruning for OCR-Critical MLLM Inference
comment: 21 pages, including supplementary material. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/SouthWinter/spatial-provenance-audit
summary: Visual-token pruning is usually judged by answer quality at a fixed retention budget. For text-rich multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this protocol can miss a distinct failure: an answer remains correct even when no retained token is locally traceable to the small OCR region that supports it. We turn this blind spot into an evidence-risk audit that couples answer behavior with geometric token-origin provenance, interventions, and realized cost; transparent training-free selectors isolate controlled operating points. On locked image-disjoint confirmation, Qwen Target at 30% retention has observed accuracy 0.786 versus 0.783 for Full (paired image-cluster difference +0.003, 95% CI [-0.014, +0.020]), yet same-budget Target, Random, and Grid retain sharply different positive-support coverage: 0.620, 0.270, and 0.318. Across Qwen3-VL-8B, LLaVA-1.5-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B, matched controls, interventions, detector tests, and external methods reveal model-specific quality-risk-traceability frontiers that accuracy alone does not expose. Materialized prefixes yield up to 4.32x batch-prefill speedup and 76.4% lower incremental peak memory; full-validation TextVQA and DocVQA further show that favorable target-verification points do not imply task-general compression. Visual-token pruning should therefore report surviving spatial provenance and realized cost alongside quality and compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"证据风险审计"框架来评估视觉token剪枝。与仅关注固定保留预算下的答案质量不同，该方法将答案行为与几何token来源溯源、干预实验和实际成本相结合。研究发现，即使答案正确，保留的token也可能无法在空间上追溯到支持该答案的OCR区域。在多个MLLM模型上的实验表明，准确率无法揭示模型特定的质量-风险-可追溯性边界，且物化前缀可带来最高4.32倍批处理预填充加速和76.4%的峰值内存降低。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝评估仅以固定保留预算下的答案质量为准，这掩盖了一个关键失败模式：即使没有保留任何可空间追溯到支持答案的OCR区域的token，答案仍可能正确。这种"盲区"导致压缩模型的实际证据支撑能力被忽视，需要新的审计方法。
AI.method: 提出证据风险审计框架，核心包括：(1) 将答案行为与几何token来源溯源（provenance）耦合；(2) 进行干预实验（interventions）；(3) 计算实际成本（realized cost）；(4) 使用透明的免训练选择器来隔离可控操作点。在图像不重叠的确认集上，对比不同选择器（Target、Random、Grid）在相同预算下的正支持覆盖率。
AI.result: 在Qwen-VL上，30%保留率下Target的准确率(0.786)与Full(0.783)相当（配对差异+0.003，95% CI [-0.014, +0.020]），但Target、Random、Grid的正支持覆盖率差异显著：0.620、0.270、0.318。跨Qwen3-VL-8B、LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL3.5-8B模型，匹配对照、干预、检测器测试和外部方法揭示了仅靠准确率无法暴露的模型特定边界。物化前缀实现最高4.32倍批处理预填充加速和76.4%更低增量峰值内存。但完整验证集上的TextVQA和DocVQA表明，好的目标验证点并不预示任务通用的压缩效果。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token剪枝评估不应仅报告质量和压缩率，还必须报告存活的token空间溯源（provenance）和实际成本。准确率、压缩率、证据可追溯性和成本之间构成多维评估空间，单一指标无法全面反映剪枝方法的优劣。

title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
summary: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability. The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个反直觉的现象：使用可验证奖励的在线强化学习（RLVR）虽然能提升当前任务的表现，但会导致此后目标所需的成功行为变得过于稀有而难以采样和强化，作者称之为"验证器引发的支持重塑"（verifier-induced support reshaping）。通过数学推理和约束指令跟随两个任务上的双向顺序训练，研究发现RLVR主要重排了基础策略中已有的开头token，且这种开头选择因果性地影响后续任务的搜索能力，导致端点指标提升并不能保证未来的可训练性或联合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLVR研究通常只关注单一任务上的即时性能提升，忽略了在线策略优化可能改变轨迹分布，从而影响后续任务训练能力的隐患。作者希望系统性地研究：当依次在多个任务上应用RLVR时，前一个任务的训练是否会损害后一个任务的成功轨迹的采样概率（即可奖励支持），进而阻碍未来的训练。
AI.method: 研究设计了双模型（Qwen系列）、双任务（数学推理Math-RLVR和约束指令跟随IF-RLVR）的框架：(1) 通过重复验证器评分采样和双向顺序训练来测量有效可奖励支持（固定rollout预算内可到达的成功轨迹）；(2) 进行token分布分析以定位支持重塑发生的层级；(3) 通过受控开头干预实验检验开头token对数学可搜索性的因果影响；(4) 测试参考策略约束、路由先验和在线蒸馏等缓解方案的效果。
AI.result: 实验发现：Math-RLVR提升平均指令跟随成功率但降低重复采样下有成功响应的提示数量（IFEval上pass@1提升6.5个百分点而best@32下降9.8个百分点）；IF-RLVR将数学响应从逐步解题推向直接答案，降低各采样预算下的best@k并减少后续Math-RLVR的奖励变异；这些变化集中在响应开头几个token；RLVR主要重排基础策略已有的开头而非产生新开头；已测试的缓解策略只能部分保留跨任务支持，边际收益只能部分转化为兼顾正确性和指令跟随的响应。
AI.conclusion: RLVR的端点改善并不保证未来的可训练性或联合能力——在线策略优化会因为支持重塑而牺牲后续任务的训练基础。这为顺序多任务RLVR训练的设计提出了警告，需要更根本性的缓解方案来维持跨任务的可奖励支持。

title: XL-DocBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Extra-Long Document Understanding
summary: Real-world document tasks often ask professionals to answer questions from annual reports, regulations, clinical guidelines, and technical manuals that span hundreds or thousands of pages. Some questions also require comparing related reports. Reliable long-document understanding is therefore a prerequisite for using LLMs in compliance, clinical, financial, and engineering workflows, where decisions must be traceable to specific evidence pages and the cost of an unsupported answer is high -- yet most existing benchmarks still measure short-context or single-page QA. We introduce XL-DocBench, a fully human-verified benchmark for extra-long document understanding, with 1,519 retained questions from six professional domains and contexts up to 2,303 pages. XL-DocBench goes beyond page-level lookup. 1,103 examples (72.6\%) use multiple evidence pages. The final set also includes 556 questions (36.6\%) that use tables, charts, or figures, and 165 questions (10.9\%) that require evidence from multiple documents. Each question has one of twelve reasoning labels, expert-annotated evidence pages, a typed verification rule, and an answer format, including 218 None-answer cases. We build the benchmark with a tree-guided synthesis pipeline followed by artifact filters and full verification by 194 human experts. By coupling extra-long professional contexts with page-level evidence and typed rules, XL-DocBench fills a gap left by prior single-page, short multi-page, or text-only long-context benchmarks, and lets future work attribute system failures to retrieval, evidence use, or rule following rather than to a single leaderboard score. The results show that current systems still struggle with long contexts, multi-page evidence, and structured reasoning over professional documents.

AI.tldr: XL-DocBench 是一个全新的、完全人工验证的超长文档理解基准测试，包含来自六个专业领域的 1,519 道题，上下文最长可达 2,303 页。它超越了单页查找，涵盖多证据页（72.6%）、表格图表（36.6%）和多文档推理（10.9%）等问题，每个问题配有推理标签、专家标注的证据页和类型化验证规则。评估显示当前系统在长上下文、多页证据和结构化推理方面仍面临显著挑战。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的专业文档任务（如合规、临床、金融、工程）常常需要从成百上千页的报告中回答问题，且决策必须可追溯到具体的证据页。然而现有基准大多只衡量短上下文或单页问答，无法反映真实的长文档理解需求，也无法将系统失败归因于检索、证据使用还是规则遵循。
AI.method: 作者提出树引导合成流水线（tree-guided synthesis pipeline）构建基准，随后通过人工过滤器筛选，并由 194 位人类专家全面验证。每个问题包含十二种推理标签之一、专家标注的证据页、类型化验证规则和答案格式（包括 218 个无答案案例），支持跨单页、多页、多文档及结构化数据（表格/图表/图形）等多种推理场景。
AI.result: 基准包含 1,519 道保留问题，其中 72.6% 需要多页证据，36.6% 涉及表格、图表或图形，10.9% 需要跨文档证据。评测结果表明当前系统在长上下文理解、多页证据聚合和结构化推理方面仍然表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: XL-DocBench 填补了先前单页、短多页或纯文本长上下文基准的空白，通过将超长专业上下文与页级证据和类型化规则结合，使未来工作能够将系统失败归因到检索、证据使用或规则遵循等具体环节，而不仅仅依赖单一排行榜分数。

title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
summary:
SIRIN (Semantic Inconsistency Recognition and Inspection Nexus) is a unified toolkit and interactive web UI for detecting contextual hallucinations (fluent, plausible responses unsupported by the provided evidence) in retrieval-augmented, agentic, and memory-grounded LLM systems. SIRIN unifies three detector paradigms (representation probing, uncertainty estimation, and judge-style verification) and the complementary task of pre-generation query answerability under one interface, configuration system, and evaluation pipeline, supporting response- and span-level inspection in both white-box and black-box settings. The web UI enables live analysis of user-supplied context-query-answer triples through hallucination scores, unsupported-span highlighting, and side-by-side detector comparison, with a lightweight plug-in design for adding new detectors. We demonstrate SIRIN on hallucination detection, query answerability, and as a faithfulness gate within long-term memory systems.
  The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sb-ai-lab/SIRIN.

AI.tldr: SIRIN 是一个统一的工具包和交互式Web界面，用于检测检索增强、智能体和记忆接地LLM系统中的上下文幻觉（即流畅但缺乏证据支持的响应）。它统一了三种检测器范式（表征探测、不确定性估计和评审式验证）以及查询可回答性任务，支持白盒和黑盒设置下的响应级和跨度级检查。
AI.motivation: 检索增强、智能体和记忆接地LLM系统中存在上下文幻觉问题，即模型生成的响应流畅合理但缺乏提供的证据支持。现有检测方法分散在不同范式中，缺乏统一的工具和评估框架来综合检测、比较和检查这些幻觉。
AI.method: SIRIN将三种检测器范式（表征探测、不确定性估计和评审式验证）统一到一个界面和配置系统下，同时支持预生成查询可回答性任务。提供响应级和跨度级检测，兼容白盒与黑盒设置，并提供轻量级插件设计以添加新检测器。Web UI支持实时分析上下文-查询-答案三元组，包括幻觉评分、无支撑跨度高亮和并排检测器比较。
AI.result: SIRIN在幻觉检测、查询可回答性以及作为长时记忆系统中的忠实度门控方面得到了验证和展示，源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: SIRIN为LLM系统中的上下文幻觉检测提供了一个统一、可扩展且交互式的解决方案，集成了多种检测范式，便于实际部署和研究使用。

title: Floor, Ceiling, and the Fusion Gap: How Much of Crowd Reading Attention Can Machines Predict?
comment: 8 pages. Ancillary files include the pre-registrations, hostile-audit records, verification scripts, and the aggregate artifacts every reported number is generated from
summary: A benchmark score means nothing without knowing what a trivial method achieves and what the best possible method could achieve. We construct both bounds for a task with a rare kind of ground truth: predicting which sentences a crowd of readers -- highlighting for their own purposes, unpaid, uninstructed, and blind to each other -- marked in 120 web documents. The floor is naive truncation (lead); the ceiling is a split-half oracle: half the crowd predicting the other half. The gap between them is +0.2028 AP [+0.1698, +0.2342, domain-clustered], and three findings structure it. First, the gap is semantic: position and length features recover 5% of it. Second, frontier language models reach 35-53% of it zero-shot -- far above classical baselines, far below the crowd; a state-of-the-art prompt compressor (LLMLingua-2) lands below the floor, indistinguishable from random selection. Third, an unweighted cross-vendor fusion of five frontier rankings plus a position prior reaches 60%, beating the best single model by +0.0159 [+0.0044, +0.0269; Holm p=0.019] -- a gain that survives ablation of its best member, split-half arm selection, prompt paraphrase, and label, gate, and seed perturbations, and was CONFIRMED by a pre-registered replication on 217 independent documents (+0.0179, Holm p=0.042). Finally, the bracket compresses: distilling the fusion into one open-weight 8B student that reads the whole document retains 90% of the fusion's edge and reaches statistical parity with the strongest single frontier model (+0.0070 [-0.0068, +0.0200]), where a local-context student retains only 63% -- the crowd's signal lives in document-level structure, and the cheapest known improvement is to ask several different models and average.

AI.tldr: 本文为一个罕见的众包句子级标注任务（120个网页文档中读者自发高亮）建立了性能上下界：下限为朴素截断（lead），上限为分裂半群oracle。上下界差距为+0.2028 AP，并结构化地揭示了三个发现：差距是语义性的、前沿语言模型零样本可达35-53%但远低于众包水平、跨供应商融合五个模型排名可达60%。融合方法通过了预注册复现验证，并可通过蒸馏到8B开源模型保留90%的增益。
AI.motivation: 基准分数若无参照（平凡方法的下限和理想方法的上限）则毫无意义。论文旨在为一个具有真实标注的罕见任务构建上下界，以理解众包高亮预测任务的难度结构，以及当前最优方法的实际表现位置。
AI.method: 构建两类边界：下限为朴素的截断（lead）策略；上限为分裂半群oracle（一半众包预测另一半）。分析特征对差距的贡献（位置和长度特征仅恢复5%）。测试零样本前沿语言模型、经典基线和提示压缩器（LLMLingua-2）。采用跨供应商多模型融合策略，并最终将融合结果蒸馏到8B开源学生模型。
AI.result: 上下界差距为+0.2028 AP。语义特征主导差距（位置/长度仅恢复5%）。前沿LLM零样本达到35-53%，LLMLingua-2低于下限。五模型融合达60%，比最佳单模型高+0.0159（Holm p=0.019），并在217文档预注册复现中确认（+0.0179，p=0.042）。蒸馏到8B模型保留90%边缘，本地上下文学生仅保留63%。
AI.conclusion: 众包高亮的信号存在于文档级结构中，而非局部特征；融合多个不同模型并平均是最便宜有效的改进方式；该任务仍有显著提升空间（最佳方法仅达上限的60%），为未来工作指明了方向。

title: MIEScore: Human-Aligned Evaluation for Multi-Source Image Editing
summary: Recent advances in unified multimodal models have significantly improved text-guided image editing abilities. In particular, models such as Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 demonstrate emerging capabilities in multi-source image editing (MIE), including tasks such as object synthesis, person-background composition, and cross-image style fusion. However, existing benchmarks and image editing assessment (IEQA) methods remain primarily focused on single-image editing tasks and largely overlook the more challenging setting of MIE. This highlights the urgent need for a comprehensive and human-aligned benchmark for MIE. To this end, we introduce MIE-Bench, the first large-scale multiple image editing benchmark with fine-grained human preference annotations. Specifically, MIE-Bench includes 3,000 editing instances across 16 tasks, each involving more than two source images and an editing prompt, together with 36K edited images produced by 12 state-of-the-art editing models and over 108K mean opinion scores (MOSs) covering visual quality, instruction following, and attribute preservation. Based on MIE-Bench, we propose MIEScore, a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based evaluation model enhanced with skill optimization and multi-dimensional supervised fine-tuning, to provide human-aligned feedback for MIE. Extensive experiments show that MIEScore achieves state-of-the-art performance in aligning with human preferences and generalizes well across other IEQA datasets. Both the dataset and the model are available at https://github.com/IntMeGroup/MIEScore.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIE-Bench，这是首个大规模多源图像编辑基准，包含3,000个编辑实例、16个任务、12个模型的36K张编辑图像和超过108K个人类偏好评分；同时提出MIEScore，一个基于多模态大语言模型的评估模型，通过技能优化和多维监督微调实现与人类偏好高度对齐的自动评估。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（如Nano-Banana-Pro和GPT-Image-2）已展现出多源图像编辑（MIE）能力，但现有基准和图像编辑评估方法仍主要聚焦于单图像编辑任务，缺乏针对MIE这一更具挑战性场景的综合性与人类对齐基准。
AI.method: 构建MIE-Bench，包含3,000个编辑实例、16类任务，每个实例涉及两张以上源图像和编辑提示；收集12个SOTA编辑模型生成的36K张编辑图像，并获取10.8万余条平均意见分数（MOS），覆盖视觉质量、指令遵循和属性保持三个维度。基于此，提出MIEScore，一个融合技能优化和多维监督微调的MLLM评估模型。
AI.result: 实验表明MIEScore在与人类偏好对齐方面达到SOTA性能，并能很好地泛化到其他图像编辑评估数据集（IEQA）。
AI.conclusion: MIE-Bench和MIEScore填补了多源图像编辑评估领域的空白，为多源图像编辑提供了一套人类对齐的评估框架，数据集和模型已开源。

title: Optimal Prior-Free Mechanisms for Consumer Surplus
summary:
We settle the worst-case approximability of residual-surplus maximization in general multidimensional mechanism-design environments. For $n$ agents with arbitrary nonnegative valuations over a finite outcome space, we give a universally truthful and ex-post individually rational mechanism whose expected residual surplus is at least $W(N)/H_n$, where $W(N)$ is the optimal social welfare and $H_n$ is the $n$-th harmonic number. This guarantee is worst-case optimal, including its constant, even for a single-item auction with a known i.i.d. prior and under the weaker requirement of Bayesian incentive compatibility.
  Our result resolves the welfare-approximation aspect of the open question of [Hartline and Roughgarden 2008] on the power of money burning beyond $k$-unit auctions, as well as an open question of [Ezra et al. 2025] concerning optimal guarantees for broader valuation classes. It also replaces the outcome-dependent $O(\log|\mathcal{O}|)$ guarantee of [Fotakis et al. 2015] by the tight agent-dependent factor $H_n$, while strengthening truthfulness in expectation to universal truthfulness.
  The mechanism is polynomial-time whenever welfare-maximizing VCG is polynomial-time, yielding efficient mechanisms for gross-substitutes and multi-unit valuations and for several natural single-parameter feasibility constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了一般多维机制设计环境中剩余盈余最大化的最坏情况可逼近性问题。作者给出一个普遍真实且事后个体理性的机制，其期望剩余盈余至少为最优社会福利的 W(N)/H_n（其中 H_n 为第 n 个调和数），并证明该保证（包括常数）在最坏情况下是最优的，即使在单物品拍卖、已知 i.i.d. 先验及仅需贝叶斯激励相容的较弱要求下也是如此。
AI.motivation: 主要动机是解决两个长期开放的公开问题：(1) Hartline 和 Roughgarden (2008) 关于烧钱机制在 k-单位拍卖之外一般环境中的能力问题中的福利逼近方面；(2) Ezra 等人 (2025) 关于更广泛估值类别下最优保证的开放问题。此外，该工作希望将 Fotakis 等人 (2015) 依赖于结果空间大小的 O(log|O|) 保证改进为依赖于代理人数的紧致因子 H_n，并将期望真实性加强为普遍真实性。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个普遍真实（universally truthful）且事后个体理性（ex-post IR）的机制，在任意非负估值、有限结果空间的 n 个代理人环境中，实现期望剩余盈余至少为 W(N)/H_n（W(N) 为最优社会福利，H_n 为调和数）。该机制在福利最大化 VCG 是多项式时间的环境下亦保持多项式时间，覆盖了总替代（gross-substitutes）估值、多单位估值及多种自然单参数可行性约束。
AI.result: 该机制的期望剩余盈余保证 W(N)/H_n 在最坏情况下是最优的，且常数不可改进——即使在单物品拍卖、已知 i.i.d. 先验、仅需贝叶斯激励相容的弱化设定下也无法改进。这一结果同时解决了两个开放问题，并将此前依赖于结果空间规模的 O(log|O|) 界提升为依赖于代理人数的紧致 H_n 界，同时将期望真实性强化为普遍真实性。机制的效率在 VCG 可高效计算时得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 本文为一般多维机制设计环境中的剩余盈余最大化提供了紧致的最坏情况逼近界 H_n，克服了此前依赖于结果空间大小的保证，在更强的真实性要求下依然达到最优，涵盖了广泛的估值类别和可行性约束，并为烧钱机制的一般能力问题给出了完整的福利逼近答案。

title: AiFlow: Token-Native Reactive Orchestration with Bounded Backpressure for Streaming LLM Applications
comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables, 1 algorithm, and 1 code listing. Public implementation: https://github.com/ModelEngine-Group/fit-framework
summary: Large language model (LLM) applications increasingly operate as streaming workflows combining retrieval, tool calls, safety filters, and multi-agent coordination. Although contemporary frameworks expose provider deltas, workflow nodes often treat generation as coarse request-response steps, leaving queue management, worker allocation, ordering, and backpressure to ad hoc callback code. This paper presents AiFlow, a token-native reactive orchestration model that normalizes provider deltas into typed Context<T> events propagated through a directed streaming graph. Each node is managed by a Node Guardian that declares and enforces local queue bounds, worker concurrency, ordering, overflow policy, cancellation propagation, and retry discipline. We formalize the bounded-memory property, present the compilation from a compact DSL and JSON graph form, and provide static validation for type safety, state concurrency, and injection compatibility. Controlled microbenchmarks, captured DeepSeek trace replay (30 runs), descriptive online runs, LangGraph baselines, a streaming RAG workload, and an Ollama local-backend check show that AiFlow does not alter provider-side Model TTFT but reduces Application TTFPT by 70.9-94.7\% versus aggregation and keeps runtime-owned queue depth within declared bounds (93.7-96.5\% MaxQ reduction versus unbounded policies). The supplementary artifact contains scripts, raw traces, machine-readable tables, checksums, and an API-free smoke test; the public implementation is available through the FIT Framework repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AiFlow，一个基于token的响应式流式编排模型，将LLM供应商的增量输出规范化为类型化的Context<T>事件，通过有向流式图传播，并由Node Guardian管理队列边界、并发、排序和背压等关键属性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM工作流（检索、工具调用、安全过滤、多智能体协调）虽然暴露了供应商的增量数据流，但工作流节点仍将生成视为粗粒度的请求-响应步骤，队列管理、工作分配、排序和背压依赖临时回调代码，缺乏系统性支持。
AI.method: AiFlow采用token原生响应式编排模型：1) 将供应商增量规范化为类型化Context<T>事件，通过有向流式图传播；2) 每个节点由Node Guardian管理，声明并强制本地队列边界、工作并发、排序、溢出策略、取消传播和重试纪律；3) 形式化有界内存属性；4) 支持从紧凑DSL和JSON图形式编译；5) 提供类型安全、状态并发和注入兼容性的静态验证。
AI.result: 微基准测试、DeepSeek轨迹回放（30次运行）、在线运行、LangGraph基线对比、流式RAG工作负载和Ollama本地后端测试表明：AiFlow不改变供应商端Model TTFT，但将应用端TTFPT降低70.9-94.7%（对比聚合方式），并将运行时队列深度保持在声明边界内（对比无界策略降低93.7-96.5% MaxQ）。
AI.conclusion: AiFlow证明了token原生响应式编排在LLM流式工作流中的有效性，既能显著降低端到端时延，又能通过声明式Node Guardian确保有界内存资源使用，且不牺牲提供商端首次令牌时间。

title: Device-First Feedback: Toward Mobile-Native LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
summary: Deploying convolutional neural networks generated by large language models (LLMs) on real mobile hardware requires more than GPU validation accuracy: INT8 TensorFlow Lite export, delegate selection, and on-device latency jointly determine whether a model is usable. We present an automated mobile deployment pipeline that closes the loop from QLoRA fine-tuning of an architecture-generating LLM through GPU evaluation, INT8 export, and physical-device benchmarking to gated augmentation of the training corpus. The pipeline is fully scripted and runs cycle-by-cycle without manual intervention, with resume support after interruptions. We evaluate the same frozen protocol on two benchmarks, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, on a Samsung SM-P613 tablet (seed 42, 20 models per cycle, cycles 0-6). On CIFAR-10, cycle 1 is gate-accepted and improves the mobile deployment score approximately 25.6x over the baseline with a mean quantized accuracy of 46.9%; later cycles raise GPU accuracy but fail the non-decreasing mobile gate. On CIFAR-100, the pre-QLoRA baseline retains the best mobile score; iterative rounds improve GPU accuracy (up to 26.2%) yet cannot surpass cycle 0 on-device, and the training pool stalls at 19 examples after the first accepted round. Together, the two studies show that closed-loop GPU fine-tuning does not guarantee monotonic mobile gains, especially on harder classification tasks, and that multi-dataset, on-device measurement is needed to stress-test deployment objectives. We release per-cycle metrics with 95% confidence intervals, all figures, and complete reproduction commands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个从LLM生成CNN架构到移动端部署的全自动闭环流水线，涵盖QLoRA微调、GPU评估、INT8导出和真机基准测试，并在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上验证。结果显示CIFAR-10上移动部署分数提升25.6倍但后续周期未通过门控；CIFAR-100上迭代虽提升GPU精度但难以超越基线移动端性能，表明闭环GPU微调无法保证移动端单调增益。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的CNN架构在实际移动硬件上部署时，仅看GPU验证精度是不够的，还需要考虑INT8 TensorFlow Lite导出、推理后端选择和端上延迟等多个因素共同决定模型可用性。现有工作缺乏一个从架构生成到真机部署全自动闭环的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建一个全自动流水线：QLoRA微调架构生成LLM → GPU评估 → INT8导出 → 真机（Samsung SM-P613）基准测试 → 门控机制决定是否将样本加入训练语料库。流水线完全脚本化，支持中断恢复，按周期循环运行。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上使用固定协议（种子42，每周期20个模型，周期0-6）评估。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上，周期1通过门控并比基线提升约25.6倍移动部署分数，平均量化精度46.9%；后续周期提升GPU精度但未通过非递减移动门控。CIFAR-100上，QLoRA前的基线保留最佳移动分数；迭代提升GPU精度达26.2%但始终无法超越第0周期端上性能，训练池在首次接受后停滞在19个样本。两个数据集结果显示闭环GPU微调不能保证移动端单调增益。
AI.conclusion: 多数据集、真机测量对于压力测试部署目标至关重要，仅依靠GPU精度反馈的闭环优化不足以指导移动端部署，需要将端上指标纳入优化环路。作者公开了每周期指标（含95%置信区间）、所有图表和完整复现命令。

title: Similarity-Aware Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning removes the influence of user-specified training examples from a trained model, avoiding the need to retrain it from scratch. Localization-based methods improve unlearning efficiency by identifying a subset of influential model parameters. However, existing approaches select parameters based solely on forget-set importance, neglecting their role in retained dataset and often causing collateral damage to semantically similar retained examples. We address this limitation with a retain-aware localization method that considers parameter importance to both forgotten and retained data. We also introduce a retain-similar evaluation set, constructed using cosine similarity in the model embedding space, to directly measure collateral damage. Across eleven experimental settings on CIFAR-10 dataset and ResNet18 model, our method consistently reduces collateral damage while improving standard unlearning metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of retain-aware localization for similarity-aware machine unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种保留感知的定位方法（retain-aware localization），用于机器遗忘任务。与现有仅基于遗忘集重要性选择参数的方法不同，该方法同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性，从而减少对语义相似保留样本的附带损害。作者还引入了基于嵌入空间余弦相似度构建的评估集来直接度量附带损害。
AI.motivation: 现有基于定位的机器遗忘方法仅根据遗忘集的重要性选择模型参数子集，忽略了这些参数在保留数据集中的作用，导致对语义上相似的保留样本造成附带损害（collateral damage），影响模型在保留数据上的表现。
AI.method: 提出保留感知的定位方法，同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性来确定需调整的参数子集；并构建保留相似评估集（retain-similar evaluation set），通过模型嵌入空间中的余弦相似度构造，用于直接量化附带损害。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集和ResNet18模型上进行了11种实验设置，该方法一致性地减少了附带损害，同时提升了标准遗忘指标，验证了保留感知定位方法在相似性感知机器遗忘中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 考虑参数对保留数据的角色是提升机器遗忘质量的关键，保留感知定位方法能够在保持遗忘效果的同时显著降低对相似保留样本的负面影响。

title: Trustworthiness Costs of Domain Adaptation in Small Language Models:A Cross-Architecture Empirical Study
comment: 13 pages, 7 tables, 2 appendices (Reproducibility Checklist; Software and Data Availability). Code, model checkpoints, and datasets publicly available at https://github.com/rbpdlf/slm-trw
summary: Domain adaptation of small language models (SLMs) has emerged as a practical strategy for deploying capable NLP systems in resource-constrained, high-stakes environments including healthcare, legal services, and financial analysis. While performance gains from parameter-efficient fine-tuning are well characterised, the corresponding impact on trustworthiness (factual calibration and adversarial robustness) remains poorly understood. This paper presents the first systematic cross-domain, cross-architecture empirical study quantifying the trustworthiness cost of domain adaptation across three SLM architectures (TinyLlama 1B, Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), three domains (healthcare, legal, finance), two training-data conditions (benign and adversarially perturbed), and four fine-tuning strategies (baseline LoRA, Safety-DPO, Dark Experience Replay, and Task Arithmetic LoRA, TA-LoRA). Trustworthiness is evaluated through TruthfulQA MC2 (factual calibration) and HarmBench ASR (adversarial robustness) across all 216 experimental configurations with three random seeds. Three principal findings emerge. First, baseline QLoRA domain adaptation produces minimal TruthfulQA MC2 change across all model-domain combinations (mean |Delta TQA| < 0.02). Second, adversarially perturbed training data consistently improves domain adaptation quality (Delta loss approximately -0.040) without worsening trustworthiness benchmarks. Third, none of the three safety-preserving strategies reduced adversarial harm susceptibility: Safety-DPO was effectively neutral (mean Delta ASR < 0.001), while Dark ER and TA-LoRA increased mean HarmBench ASR by +0.171 and +0.155 respectively in safety-aligned models (Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), with individual configurations exceeding +0.45. These results challenge the assumption that replay-based and arithmetic-merge strategies transfer alignment to domain-adapted SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对小型语言模型（SLMs）领域自适应过程中的可信度代价进行系统性跨领域、跨架构实证研究，覆盖3种架构、3个领域、2种训练数据条件和4种微调策略，共216个实验配置。研究发现：基线QLoRA领域自适应对事实校准影响极小；对抗扰动数据反而提升自适应质量且不损害可信度；三种安全保护策略均未降低对抗危害敏感性，其中Dark ER和TA-LoRA反而显著增加了HarmBench ASR。
AI.motivation: SLMs在医疗、法律、金融等高危领域的部署越来越普遍，但领域自适应的性能提升已被充分研究，其对可信度（事实校准与对抗鲁棒性）的影响却知之甚少。现有研究假设基于经验回放和算术合并的策略能够将对齐能力迁移到领域自适应模型中，但这一假设缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 采用系统化的实证研究设计：3种SLM架构（TinyLlama 1B、Gemma-2 2B、Llama 3.2 1B），3个领域（医疗、法律、金融），2种训练数据条件（良性、对抗扰动），4种微调策略（基线LoRA、Safety-DPO、Dark Experience Replay、Task Arithmetic LoRA）。通过TruthfulQA MC2评估事实校准，HarmBench ASR评估对抗鲁棒性，共216个实验配置并重复3次随机种子。
AI.result: 三项核心发现：（1）基线QLoRA领域自适应在所有模型-领域组合中仅产生极小的TruthfulQA MC2变化（平均|Delta TQA| < 0.02）；（2）对抗扰动训练数据一致性地提升领域自适应质量（Delta loss约-0.040）且不恶化可信度基准；（3）三种安全保护策略均未能减少对抗危害敏感性：Safety-DPO基本中性（平均Delta ASR < 0.001），而Dark ER和TA-LoRA在安全对齐模型中分别将平均HarmBench ASR提高了+0.171和+0.155，个别配置甚至超过+0.45。
AI.conclusion: 本文质疑了经验回放和算术合并策略能够将对齐能力迁移到领域自适应SLM的假设。研究结果表明，现有的安全保护策略在实际领域自适应场景中可能失效甚至适得其反，需要重新思考如何在保持SLM可信度的前提下进行领域自适应。这为高风险领域中的SLM部署提供了重要的安全警示。

title: Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）中语言提示能够主动重塑视觉表征，而非将视觉表征视为静态信息库。作者识别出两种具体的语言诱导重编码机制：一是抽象的"参考表征"（reference representation），通过对比steering vectors标识目标相关物体，且具有跨对象、跨任务、甚至跨合成/自然图像的泛化能力；二是语言诱导的属性调制（attribute modulation），即后期层会选择性放大目标相关属性在视觉表征中的信号。因果干预实验证明这种属性调制直接介导了VLM的反应分布。
AI.motivation: 以往研究大多将VLM中的视觉表征视为被语言表征操纵的静态信息仓库，忽视了语言提示可能主动重塑视觉表征的可能性。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统性地探究目标导向语言是否以及如何改变VLM内部的视觉编码过程。
AI.method: 1) 提取对比steering vectors来表示自然语言提示下的抽象参考表征，并通过因果干预验证其对模型预测的影响；2) 分析后期层中语言提示对视觉表征中目标相关属性的选择性放大（attribute modulation）；3) 通过因果干预实验证明属性调制介导VLM的反应分布。
AI.result: 研究发现两类语言诱导的视觉表征重编码：一是抽象的参考表征，能够泛化到不同对象、不同任务场景，甚至从合成图像迁移到自然图像；二是后期层对目标相关属性的选择性放大。因果干预进一步证实属性调制直接介导了模型的输出分布。
AI.conclusion: VLM中的跨模态处理是动态的——视觉token并非静态信息仓库，而是会被语言查询主动调制和重编码。这挑战了传统的"静态视觉表征"观点，为理解VLM的跨模态机制提供了更动态的理论框架。

title: MODE: Mutual Optimality in Direct Effects of Reciprocal Recommendations in Matching Markets
summary: Matching platforms such as job posting services and online dating platforms have become widely used over the past decade. For a matching platform to be successful, it is crucial to design appropriate reciprocal recommendation systems (RRSs) that consider the preferences of users on both sides (job candidates and employers) and prevent opportunities from being concentrated too heavily on a few popular users. However, prioritizing concentration mitigation too much can lead to recommending undesirable results to some individual users, resulting in their dissatisfaction. In this paper, we formulate the concept of ``optimality of direct effects'' of the recommendation list for an individual user, given the recommendations to other users. Furthermore, we propose a novel method, MODE, that computes mutually optimal recommendations in direct effects. Experiments with synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that MODE surpasses other existing methods in terms of mutual optimality of direct effects, exhibits faster processing speeds, and enables a higher expected number of matches.

AI.tldr: 本文针对匹配平台（如招聘、婚恋）中的双向推荐系统，提出"直接效应最优性"概念，并设计了MODE方法，在考虑其他用户推荐结果的同时计算对单个用户相互最优的推荐，兼顾机会分配的公平性与个体满意度。
AI.motivation: 匹配平台（如招聘网站、在线约会平台）的成功依赖于设计合理的双向推荐系统（RRS），需同时考虑双边用户（求职者与雇主）的偏好，并防止机会过度集中在少数热门用户身上。然而，过度强调缓解集中度可能导致对某些个体用户推荐不理想的结果，引起用户不满。因此需要在个体推荐质量与整体机会分配之间寻求平衡。
AI.method: 论文首次形式化定义了"直接效应最优性"（optimality of direct effects）概念，即在给定对其他用户推荐列表的条件下，衡量推荐列表对单个用户的直接效果最优程度。基于此概念，提出MODE（Mutually Optimal Direct Effects）方法，能够计算在直接效应上相互最优的推荐结果。
AI.result: 通过在合成数据与真实数据上的实验表明，MODE在相互直接效应最优性方面优于现有方法，处理速度更快，且能够实现更高的预期匹配数量。
AI.conclusion: MODE为匹配平台的双向推荐系统提供了一种兼顾个体用户直接效用与整体匹配效率的解决方案，在公平性（缓解机会集中）与个体满意度之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: Deep Multimodal Fusion Detection through Spatial Mask and Channel Fusion
summary: Deep multimodal fusion for object detection has demonstrated good performance through mining modal characteristics. However, existing feature-level fusion methods mainly weigh between two modalities and unify them in a unified representation space. This can lead to overfitting or over-specialization of the statistical properties of a single modality within a dual-backbone architecture. This paper proposes an Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling framework for robust improvement of cross-modality object detection. Based on a shared channel spatial attention mechanism, we first introduce the semantic mask exchange to actively mix the boundaries of the modalities during the training phase, forcing the backbone network to learn generalized features without relying on fixed modal labels. Then we propose a learnable channel competition to sample and aggregate features in a channel-wise and learnable way. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that the proposed method is effective and yields competitive results among existing state-of-the-art approaches. The source code is provided in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于注意力驱动的互补重采样框架（ACR），用于跨模态目标检测的鲁棒性改进。通过语义掩码交换和可学习的通道竞争机制，该框架有效缓解了双骨干架构中单一模态统计特性过拟合的问题，在多个数据集上取得了具有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的特征级跨模态融合方法主要在两个模态之间进行加权并在统一表示空间中融合，这容易导致双骨干架构中模型对单一模态的统计特性产生过拟合或过度特化，从而影响模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 基于共享的通道空间注意力机制，提出两个核心模块：(1) 语义掩码交换（Semantic Mask Exchange）——在训练阶段主动混合模态边界，迫使骨干网络学习不依赖固定模态标签的广义特征；(2) 可学习通道竞争（Learnable Channel Competition）——以通道维度和可学习的方式对特征进行采样与聚合。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，所提出的ACR框架是有效的，并在现有最先进方法中取得了具有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过注意力驱动的互补重采样策略，有效提升了跨模态目标检测的鲁棒性，避免了单一模态过拟合问题，源代码已在补充材料中提供。

title: Online Learning in Stackelberg Security Games with Adaptive Attacker Sequences and Time-Varying Attack Intensities
summary: This work studies no-regret online learning in Repeated Stackelberg Security Games with time-varying attack intensities. We formulate an extended security game in which an attacker may select multiple targets and derive an exact mixed-integer linear programming oracle under a optimistic tie-breaking rule. Under full-information feedback, the oracle is integrated with Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader and yields expected $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret against non-anticipating sequences with time-varying follower numbers, attack intensities, and attacker types.
