Under bandit feedback, we consider multiple followers sharing a fixed attacker type and use a barycentric-spanner construction to reconstruct utility estimates from aggregate attack observations, obtaining expected $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret. Extensive simulations demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our approach under full and partial information feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了攻击强度随时间变化的重复Stackelberg安全博弈中的无遗憾在线学习问题。作者将安全博弈扩展为攻击者可选择多个目标的情形，并推导出在乐观平局打破规则下的精确混合整数线性规划（MILP）oracle。在全信息反馈下，将oracle与跟随扰动领导者（FTPL）结合，对非前瞻性序列（含时变攻击者数量、攻击强度和攻击者类型）达到期望O(√T)遗憾；在带反馈下，针对共享固定攻击者类型的多个跟随者，利用重心跨度构造从聚合攻击观测中重建效用估计，获得期望O(T^{2/3})遗憾。大量模拟验证了方法在完整和部分信息反馈下的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的Stackelberg安全博弈研究大多假设攻击强度固定或攻击者只攻击单个目标，且缺乏对时变环境（如攻击强度随时间变化）下在线学习算法的系统研究。实际安全场景中攻击者的意图、数量和攻击强度随时间波动，需要更通用的博弈模型和理论保证。
AI.method: 1) 提出扩展安全博弈模型，允许攻击者选择多个目标；2) 在乐观平局打破规则下推导精确的MILP oracle；3) 全信息反馈下将oracle与Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader结合；4) 带反馈下利用重心跨度（barycentric-spanner）构造从聚合攻击观测中重建效用估计。
AI.result: 全信息反馈下达到期望O(√T)遗憾，带反馈下达到期望O(T^{2/3})遗憾，并通过大量仿真实验验证了方法在两种反馈设置下的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为时变攻击强度下的重复Stackelberg安全博弈提供了严格的无遗憾在线学习框架，兼顾了理论保证与实用有效性，填补了该领域在时变多攻击者场景下的研究空白。

title: Can Perplexity Serve as a Cognitive Signal for Code Understandability?
summary: Recent work suggests that token-level perplexity from large language models can align with localized human confusion during code comprehension. This raises a natural question: can perplexity also serve as a snippet-level signal for code understandability? We conduct an empirical study of this question across multiple human-grounded datasets, including method-level understandability judgments, output-prediction tasks, and accepted understandability-improvement patches. Despite prior token-level evidence, we find that simple snippet-level aggregations of token perplexity, such as average, median, or peak perplexity, do not reliably correlate with human understandability. We then investigate why this happens. First, token perplexity is highly skewed and heavy-tailed across code structures; extreme spikes arise not only from semantically meaningful constructs, but also from identifiers, literals, types, separators, and tokenization artifacts. Second, human understandability labels often lack consensus, making whole-snippet difficulty a noisy target. Third, perplexity distributions and their alignment with human difficulty vary substantially across models and tokenizers. These findings explain why prior token-level perplexity--confusion alignment does not directly transfer to snippet-level understandability. Overall, our study positions perplexity as a promising but delicate cognitive signal: useful for localized code confusion, but requiring code-aware aggregation, consensus-aware evaluation, and model-sensitivity analysis before it can support reliable code-understandability measurement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多个人类标注数据集（方法级可理解性判断、输出预测任务、可理解性改进补丁）进行实证研究，发现简单的困惑度（perplexity）聚合指标（如均值、中位数、峰值）并不能可靠地与人类代码可理解性相关，并揭示了三个根本原因：token级困惑度分布高度偏斜且重尾、人类标注缺乏共识、不同模型和分词器间困惑度分布差异显著。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明token级困惑度与局部代码理解困惑度一致，因此自然产生一个疑问：困惑度能否作为代码片段级别的可理解性信号？这促使作者进行系统性的实证研究来检验这一假设。
AI.method: 作者在多个基于人类标注的数据集上进行实证研究，包括方法级可理解性判断、输出预测任务和可理解性改进补丁，测试简单困惑度聚合策略（平均、中位数、峰值）与人类可理解性的相关性，并深入分析失败原因。
AI.result: 简单的困惑度聚合指标与人类可理解性无可靠相关性。失败原因包括：（1）token困惑度高度偏斜且重尾，极端值不仅来自语义有意义的构造，还来自标识符、字面量、类型、分隔符和分词伪影；（2）人类可理解性标注缺乏共识；（3）困惑度分布及其与人类难度的对齐在不同模型和分词器间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 困惑度是"有前景但敏感"的认知信号——适用于局部代码困惑检测，但在用于可靠的可理解性测量之前，需要代码感知的聚合方法、共识感知的评估以及模型敏感性分析。

title: LeapTalk: Breaking the Latency-Quality Trade-off in Talking Head Generation
summary: Long-form and real-time talking-head generation remains challenging due to a latency-quality trade-off: inefficient multi-step diffusion prohibits streaming generation, whereas real-time autoregressive approaches suffer from error accumulation and identity drift. To address this drawback, we propose LeapTalk, a novel framework that achieves stable and real-time talking-head generation with a single forward step, scaling to arbitrarily long videos. At the heart of our approach lies a single-step bridge distillation scheme. On the one hand, departing from the conventional noise-to-data paradigm, we introduce a data-to-data transport formulation based on a Brownian bridge. Anchored by a persistent reference, this strategy effectively mitigates identity drift and enhances long-term temporal stability. On the other hand, to enable smooth knowledge transfer from a pre-trained diffusion teacher to the student bridge model, we explore a heterogeneous distillation framework with an SNR-aligned time transformation $Φ(τ)$, which bridges the functional discrepancy between the two models. Moreover, we propose an audio-driven classifier-free guidance mechanism to maintain fine-grained lip synchronization under extreme step reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity and temporally consistent video generation with only 1 step at up to 200 FPS, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both efficiency and stability. Project Page: https://zhangrongxiang.github.io/leaptalk-page/

AI.tldr: LeapTalk提出了一种基于单步桥式蒸馏的实时说话头生成框架，通过数据到数据的布朗桥传输、SNR对齐时间变换和音频驱动无分类器引导，实现了200 FPS的单步高保真、长时间稳定的视频生成。
AI.motivation: 长时且实时的说话头生成存在延迟-质量权衡难题：多步扩散模型计算开销大，无法支持流式生成；而实时自回归方法则面临误差累积和身份漂移问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于布朗桥的数据到数据传输公式，用持久参考锚定以缓解身份漂移并增强长时稳定性；2) 设计SNR对齐的时间变换Φ(τ)实现异构蒸馏，使预训练扩散教师知识平滑迁移到学生桥模型；3) 引入音频驱动的无分类器引导机制，在极端步数缩减下保持精细唇形同步。
AI.result: 仅需1步推理，生成速度高达200 FPS，在高保真度和时间一致性方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LeapTalk成功打破了延迟与质量之间的权衡，证明单步桥式蒸馏框架能够实现稳定、实时且可扩展到任意长度视频的说话头生成。

title: Stabilized Best-of-$K$ Training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Leader Reward modifies POMO training to emphasize the best trajectory produced by repeated inference. We test a narrow extension: replace its binary leader/non-leader distinction with a stabilized rank signal indexed by a sampling budget $K$. With the POMO architecture, 3,050-epoch schedule, and TSP-100 test set held fixed, the Leader Reward reimplementation obtains $7.7662$ under 100-start, 8-augmentation greedy decoding, matching the reported $7.766$ at its displayed precision. Under independent sampling, the stabilized $K=8$ recipe lowers realized Best-of-8 cost in all three paired training seeds: $7.7944$ versus $7.8136$. This observation is estimation-only and decoder-specific: three seeds are below the six-seed testing floor, Leader Reward is better at sampled $K=1$, and it remains slightly better under its original augmented-greedy protocol. We make no unbiased-estimator, universal superiority, or state-of-the-art claim.

AI.tldr: 本文对POMO变体Leader Reward进行窄范围扩展研究，将其二元的leader/non-leader区分替换为基于采样预算K的稳定排名信号。在固定POMO架构和TSP-100测试集下，K=8的稳定配方在三个配对训练种子中均优于原方法（7.7944 vs 7.8136），但作者明确声明这仅是估计层面和特定解码器下的观察，不做无偏估计、普遍优越性或SOTA声明。
AI.motivation: 探索Leader Reward训练方法的改进空间，通过将二元信号替换为更精细的排名信号来考察是否能在不改变整体架构的情况下提升性能，属于窄范围的增量研究。
AI.method: 将Leader Reward中的二元leader/non-leader区分替换为稳定化排名信号，该信号由采样预算K索引。保持POMO架构、3,050轮训练计划和TSP-100测试集不变，进行对照实验。
AI.result: 1) Leader Reward重现在100-start、8-augmentation贪心解码下得到7.7662，与报告的7.766一致；2) 在独立采样下，稳定K=8配方在三个配对训练种子中均优于原方法（7.7944 vs 7.8136）；3) 但K=1时Leader Reward更优，且在原始augmented-greedy协议下仍略优。
AI.conclusion: 稳定排名信号（K=8）在特定条件（独立采样、Best-of-8基准）下展现出一致但微小的优势，但该结果受限于样本量（仅3个种子，低于6个种子的测试下限）和特定解码器设置，不能推广为普遍结论。作者明确不做SOTA或普遍优越性声明，保持审慎态度。

title: Predicting Startup Exit from Textual Descriptors - A Computational Linguistics Framework
summary: This study shows that textual descriptors alone can predict early-stage startup success, defined as Exit, without relying on contextual, financial, or human capital variables. Using venture capital-curated datasets covering 7,419 startups over 20 years, the research isolates text-based framing variables and engineers 850 features through startup narrative mapping. Data subsets and vector embeddings are evaluated for statistical significance, followed by supervised machine learning experiments across six models. LightGBM achieved the highest predictive performance (F1 = 0.48), while textual descriptors alone achieved F1 = 0.30, confirming the standalone predictive value of founder narratives. Feature analysis shows that optimized densities of hyping markers, including adjectives, jargon, and buzzwords, are associated with higher Exit probability, whereas excessive statement or name length reduces it. The study also introduces a quantifiable Hyping Score for venture capital applications, demonstrating that startup framing provides measurable signals for predicting Exit under conditions of high information asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明仅凭文本描述符即可预测初创企业成功（以Exit为定义），无需依赖情境、财务或人力资本变量。基于风投策展的20年7,419家初创企业数据集，通过叙事映射工程化850个特征，LightGBM达到最佳性能（F1=0.48），纯文本描述符达F1=0.30。研究发现适度的营销夸大标记（形容词、行话、流行语）与更高退出概率相关，而过长的陈述或名称则降低概率，并引入了量化的Hyping Score。
AI.motivation: 在高信息不对称的早期投资环境中，如何仅从可获得的文本信息中预测初创企业成功是一个关键问题。现有研究通常依赖情境、财务或人力资本变量，而本文旨在验证纯文本描述符是否具有独立的预测价值。
AI.method: 使用风投策展数据集（7,419家初创企业、20年），通过初创企业叙事映射工程化850个特征，评估数据子集和向量嵌入的统计显著性，并在六个监督机器学习模型上进行实验，同时进行特征分析以识别关键预测因子。
AI.result: LightGBM达到最高预测性能（F1=0.48），纯文本描述符达到F1=0.30。特征分析显示，优化的夸大标记密度（形容词、行话、流行语）与更高的Exit概率相关，而过长的陈述或名称长度则降低Exit概率。
AI.conclusion: 创始人的文本叙事框架可提供可测量的信号以预测Exit，在高信息不对称条件下具有独立预测价值。研究引入了可用于风投应用的量化Hyping Score，为早期投资决策提供了新的文本分析工具。

title: RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to use external and domain-specific knowledge, but its reliability depends on the interaction between the generative model, embedding model, retrieval mechanism, and prompt construction strategy. We present RagTester, an automated end-to-end testing approach for RAG systems. RagTester generates retrieval documents, test inputs, and expected outputs; executes the tests; and evaluates the resulting answers using an LLM as a judge. Its test-generation strategy targets complex passages, unsupported queries, and document-coverage criteria. We evaluate RagTester using eight LLMs and six embedding models, yielding 24 compatible configurations, and compare it with a baseline test-input generator. Across 72,000 test executions, RagTester detected 21,633 failures, 6.6% more than the baseline, and outperformed it in 20 of the 24 configurations. The detected failures include inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, incomplete use of retrieved context, and difficulties interpreting complex passages. These results show that coverage-oriented test generation can effectively expose failures caused by the interaction between retrieval and generation components and support the assessment of RAG configurations before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RagTester，一个用于RAG系统的自动化端到端测试方法。该方法能够自动生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，并利用LLM作为评判者来评估RAG系统的回答质量。实验使用了8个LLM和6个嵌入模型组成的24种配置，通过72,000次测试执行检测到21,633个失败，比基线方法多6.6%，在24种配置中的20种中表现更优。
AI.motivation: RAG系统的可靠性高度依赖于生成模型、嵌入模型、检索机制和提示词构建策略之间的复杂交互，但现有测试方法缺乏系统性和自动化手段来全面评估这些组件之间的协同效果。因此需要一种自动化端到端测试方法来暴露RAG系统中的潜在失败。
AI.method: RagTester的核心方法包括：(1) 自动生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出；(2) 执行测试；(3) 使用LLM作为评判者评估回答质量。其测试生成策略针对三个维度：复杂段落、不支持查询和文档覆盖率标准。
AI.result: 在72,000次测试执行中，RagTester检测到21,633个失败，比基线多6.6%，且24种配置中的20种表现优于基线。检测到的失败类型包括检索不准确、不支持的回答、对检索上下文使用不完整以及解释复杂段落困难。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率导向的测试生成能够有效暴露RAG系统中检索与生成组件交互所导致的失败，并支持在部署前评估RAG配置的适用性。

title: X-KGRank: A Knowledge Graph RAG Framework for Explainable Recommendations via Pattern Mining and LLM Re-Ranking
summary: Modern recommender systems produce predictions that users cannot interrogate. The two dominant improvements, collaborative filtering and LLM-based reasoning, each fall short: collaborative filtering captures behavioural signals but offers no reasoning, while large language models (LLMs) generate fluent explanations but hallucinate and are poorly grounded in a user's history. We present X-KGRank, a knowledge graph retrieval augmented framework that unifies structural collaborative filtering with LLM-based explanation. From the MovieLens-1M dataset (6,040 users, 3,704 items, 988,129 interactions) we construct a heterogeneous knowledge graph of 9,762 nodes and 999,264 edges spanning three relation types (RATED, HAS_GENRE, and CO_RATED) persisted in Neo4j. We train a LightGCN ranker with content-aware SBERT initialization and a rating weighted BPR objective, and apply a popularity selective routing strategy that grounds long-tail items (1,855 of 3,704) in knowledge-graph paths while serving popular items from pre-trained knowledge, reducing KG-augmented generations by roughly 50%. On the MovieLens-1M test set under a 99-sample protocol, X-KGRank achieves NDCG@10 = 0.2956 and Recall@10 = 0.5371, improving over a strong popularity baseline by 17.1% on both metrics, by 15.6% on NDCG@20 (0.3449 vs. 0.2983), and by 14.6% on MRR (0.2435 vs. 0.2124). Across three LLM backbones evaluated on 16 cases, a 1.5-billion-parameter model (Qwen2.5-1.5B) matches a 7-billion-parameter model (Mistral-7B) on heuristic explanation quality (0.97 vs. 0.94), yet qualitative analysis shows the smaller model is more prone to factual fabrication.

AI.tldr: X-KGRank是一个知识图谱检索增强框架，统一了结构化协同过滤与LLM解释生成。在MovieLens-1M数据集上构建异构知识图谱，训练LightGCN排序器，并通过流行度选择性路由策略减少约50%的KG增强生成。实验表明NDCG@10=0.2956，Recall@10=0.5371，较强流行度基线提升17.1%。1.5B参数的小模型在解释质量上可匹敌7B模型，但更容易产生事实性虚构。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统存在双重困境：协同过滤能捕获行为信号但无法提供推理，而LLM虽能生成流畅解释却会产生幻觉且缺乏用户历史依据。现有方法无法同时兼顾推荐准确性与可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 从MovieLens-1M构建包含9,762节点和999,264边的异构知识图谱（三种关系：RATED、HAS_GENRE、CO_RATED），存储在Neo4j中；2) 训练LightGCN排序器，使用内容感知的SBERT初始化和评分加权BPR目标；3) 采用流行度选择性路由策略：长尾物品通过知识图谱路径进行检索增强生成，热门物品直接使用预训练知识，减少约50%的KG增强生成。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-1M上采用99样本协议测试，NDCG@10=0.2956、Recall@10=0.5371，较流行度基线两项指标均提升17.1%；NDCG@20提升15.6%（0.3449 vs 0.2983），MRR提升14.6%（0.2435 vs 0.2124）。在16个案例上评估三个LLM骨干，Qwen2.5-1.5B在启发式解释质量上（0.97）甚至略优于Mistral-7B（0.94），但定性分析显示小模型更容易产生事实性虚构。
AI.conclusion: X-KGRank通过知识图谱检索增强成功统一了协同过滤的信号捕获能力与LLM的解释生成能力，在推荐性能和解释质量两方面均取得显著提升。但研究也揭示小规模LLM在解释中面临事实幻觉风险，提示模型规模对解释可信度的重要性。

title: Limitations of Best-of-Both-Worlds Solutions in Approval-Based Multiwinner Elections
summary: We study the best-of-both-worlds fairness in approval-based multi-winner elections, asking whether ex-ante guarantees for a fractional outcome can be implemented while every realized committee satisfies an ex-post representation axiom. Recent work has shown that several ex-ante proportionality guarantees can be achieved together with strong ex-post representation axioms. We first prove that ex-ante weak Pareto optimality (weak PO), which requires that no other fractional outcome makes every voter strictly better off, is incompatible with ex-post justified representation (JR). Since fractional core stability implies weak PO, this also rules out the possibility of combining ex-ante fractional core, a central fairness notion for fractional committees, with ex-post JR. We further show that ex-ante AJR is incompatible with ex-post JR, even though AJR is a much stronger average-representation analogue of JR. On the positive side, we show that the fractional ex-ante side itself remains highly compatible: several natural ex-ante representation guarantees can be satisfied simultaneously, including fractional core, group-resource proportionality, AJR (as well as its strict strengthening AJR+), and Pareto-optimality. Hence, highly fair fractional committees may exist even when they cannot be implemented by randomization over JR committees. Our results separate fractional representation from best-of-both-worlds implementability and identify fundamental limitations of fair randomized committee selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于批准的多赢家选举中"两全其美"公平性，探讨 ex-ante 公平保证能否通过 ex-post 表示公理的可实现委员会来实施。作者证明了 ex-ante 弱帕累托最优与 ex-post JR 不相容，且 ex-ante AJR 与 ex-post JR 也不相容；但在正面，多个 ex-ante 表示保证（分数核、群资源比例性、AJR 等）可以同时满足。
AI.motivation: 在多赢家选举中，研究者希望同时实现 ex-ante（事前）和 ex-post（事后）的公平性保证，即"两全其美"。最近的研究表明若干 ex-ante 比例性保证可以与强 ex-post 表示公理同时实现，但本文想要探索这种兼容性的边界和根本限制。
AI.method: 通过形式化证明不相容性结果：1）证明 ex-ante 弱帕累托最优（weak PO）与 ex-post 公正表示（JR）不相容；2）由于分数核稳定性蕴含弱 PO，因此分数核与 ex-post JR 也无法结合；3）证明 ex-ante AJR 与 ex-post JR 不相容。同时在正面方向，证明多个 ex-ante 表示保证（包括分数核、群资源比例性、AJR、AJR+ 和帕累托最优）可以同时满足。
AI.result: 主要结果为：ex-ante 弱帕累托最优与 ex-post JR 不相容（进而排除分数核与 ex-post JR 的组合）；ex-ante AJR 与 ex-post JR 不相容。正面结果为：分数核、群资源比例性、AJR（及其严格加强 AJR+）和帕累托最优等 ex-ante 保证可以同时满足。这些结果表明分数表示与"两全其美"可实现性之间存在分离。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别了公平随机委员会选择中的根本限制：即使存在高度公平的分数委员会，也可能无法通过 JR 委员会的随机化来实现。这为理解 ex-ante 与 ex-post 公平性之间的张力提供了理论基础，并揭示了分数表示与可实现性之间的深层分离。

title: Understanding Online Failure Prediction in Linux Through Complementary Multi-View Explainability
comment: Accepted for publication in the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) 2026
summary: Accurate Online Failure Prediction (OFP) has been shown to be feasible in Operating Systems (OSs) settings, but prediction alone is not sufficient for practical adoption. Without diagnostic insight, operators have limited basis to trust alerts or decide how to respond. Moreover, even when predictive accuracy is high, it is often unclear whether models are capturing meaningful failure processes or merely exploiting workload-specific noise and incidental correlations in telemetry. This paper reports a practical experience building and evaluating an explainable OFP pipeline for Linux OSs. We combine consensus-based feature selection for detection with temporal onset analysis, subsystemlevel causal analysis, and complementary diagnostic mechanisms to support failure interpretation. Evaluated under strict crossworkload conditions with frozen training artifacts, it achieved 91-94% detection on unseen workloads without retraining, while maintaining false alarm rates below 1%. However, failure mode diagnosis proved substantially more sensitive to workload shift, and several diagnostics mechanisms showed limited effectiveness for specific failure types. Our experience highlights three main lessons: i) detection generalizes more robustly than diagnosis across workload changes; ii) early-warning capability depends strongly on the failure mode, ranging from 38 to 215 seconds in our study; and iii) unseen failure modes are not reliably diagnosable from related training modes alone, providing 0% accuracy under Leave-One-Mode-Out (LOMO) evaluation. Taken together, these results show the value of complementary explainability mechanisms for interpreting accurate failure predictions, revealing when predictive signals reflect transferable failure structure and when diagnostic generalization breaks down under workload variation.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了在Linux操作系统上构建可解释的在线故障预测(OFP)管道的实践经验。该管道结合共识特征选择、时间onset分析、子系统级因果分析和补充诊断机制，在严格的跨工作负载条件下（冻结训练产物，无需重训练）实现了91-94%的检测率和低于1%的误报率，但发现故障模式诊断对工作负载迁移更敏感，且在留一模式（LOMO）评估下不可见故障模式的诊断准确率为0%。
AI.motivation: 在线故障预测虽已证明在OS环境中可行，但仅靠预测不足以实际采用——操作员缺乏信任依据和响应决策基础；同时高预测精度可能只是利用了工作负载特定噪声和意外相关性，而非捕捉有意义的故障过程。因此需要可解释性机制来验证预测信号是否反映可迁移的故障结构。
AI.method: 构建可解释OFP管道，包含四个组成部分：(1) 基于共识的特征选择用于检测；(2) 时间onset分析；(3) 子系统级因果分析；(4) 互补诊断机制支持故障解读。采用严格的跨工作负载评估，使用冻结训练产物测试未见工作负载。
AI.result: 检测方面：在未见工作负载上无需重训练达到91-94%的检测率，误报率低于1%。诊断方面：故障模式诊断对工作负载迁移更为敏感，部分诊断机制对特定故障类型效果有限。早期预警时间因故障模式而异，范围38-215秒。LOMO评估下不可见故障模式诊断准确率为0%。
AI.conclusion: 三个主要经验：(i) 检测的泛化能力比诊断更稳健；(ii) 早期预警能力强烈依赖故障模式；(iii) 不可见故障模式无法仅从相关训练模式可靠诊断。互补的可解释性机制对于解读准确预测至关重要，能够揭示预测信号何时反映可迁移的故障结构、何时在负载变化下诊断泛化失效。

title: Beyond Edge Maps: Wavelet-Domain Conditioning for Multi-Adapter Map-to-Satellite Diffusion
summary: Commercial mapping partnerships are often unavailable in low-resource regions, leaving satellite basemaps stale and motivating synthesis of satellite imagery from independently maintained cartographic data. Existing ControlNet-based diffusion methods typically condition on structural signals like edges or segmentation extracted from the target image itself, assuming the imagery already exists and limiting their use exactly where synthesis matters most. Map-conditioned alternatives add cues like edge detection but omit frequency-domain structure. We propose a ControlNet-based diffusion framework conditioned only on cartographic sources obtainable independently of the target imagery: OpenStreetMap (OSM) raster maps and their stationary wavelet transform (SWT) subbands, a conditioning signal previously unexplored for map-to-satellite diffusion. Two ControlNet adapters, trained separately on the map and wavelet representations atop a frozen Stable Diffusion backbone, are fused via MultiControlNet, jointly drawing on spatial structure and frequency detail without retraining a multi-input model. We evaluate on a new paired map-satellite dataset curated for Nepal, a data-scarce, topographically diverse region, alongside the Pix2Pix maps-satellite benchmark. Combined conditioning wins six of eight metric-dataset comparisons -- SSIM and PSNR on both datasets, plus LPIPS (both Alex and VGG backbones) on ours and ties map-only on both Pix2Pix LPIPS backbones while still edging past wavelet-only there. Wavelet-only takes the lowest FID on both datasets, matching the tradeoff between per-image fidelity and distributional realism. We treat this gap cautiously given our modest test-set sizes and FID's known small-sample bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖独立可获取的制图数据（OSM栅格地图及其静态小波变换子带）作为条件的ControlNet扩散框架，用于低资源区域的卫星影像合成。通过两个分别训练的ControlNet适配器融合多尺度空间与频域信息，在尼泊尔数据集上综合指标优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 商业地图合作在低资源地区往往不可用，导致卫星底图陈旧。现有ControlNet方法依赖从目标图像本身提取的结构信号（如边缘、分割），假设图像已经存在，限制了其在合成最需要的场景中的使用。而地图条件替代方案虽加入边缘检测等线索，但忽略了频域结构信息。
AI.method: 提出基于ControlNet的双适配器diffusion框架：一个适配器以OSM栅格地图为条件，另一个以静态小波变换（SWT）子带为条件，两者基于冻结的Stable Diffusion骨干分别独立训练，再通过MultiControlNet联合融合，同时利用空间结构和频域细节，无需重新训练多输入模型。
AI.result: 在尼泊尔数据集和Pix2Pix地图-卫星基准上，组合条件在8个指标-数据集比较中赢得6个（两个数据集的SSIM和PSNR，以及本数据集的LPIPS两个骨干版本），在Pix2Pix的LPIPS上与地图单独条件打平。小波单独条件在两个数据集上取得最低FID，反映了单图像保真度与分布真实感之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结合地图空间结构与频域小波子带的双条件方案整体优于单一条件，但FID小样本偏差需谨慎对待。该方法为低资源区域无需目标图像即可合成卫星影像提供了可行方案。

title: Abstention as an Action Can Kill Both the Reward Gradient and the KL Anchor: Collapse Law and Repair for Error-Penalized Reinforcement Learning
summary: Error-penalized scoring rules ($+1$ for a correct answer, $-λ$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining) are increasingly prescribed against hallucination: a rational agent facing such a rule answers exactly when its correctness probability exceeds Chow's threshold $t^\ast=λ/(1+λ)$. We prove that a KL-anchored gradient learner can do the opposite. When abstention is a discrete action, the reward gradient and the anchor's restoring force are throttled by the same gate-saturation factor and die together: under explicit conditions (among them, blanket answering loses score in expectation and prompts share a bounded readout) the model drifts toward refusing everything, its mean training reward rising to zero like $1/t$ in training time $t$, so the curve reads as improvement while coverage collapses. The advantage estimator compounds the failure: in its sparse-answer regime, group normalization silently replaces every designed penalty with an effective penalty of one, moving the learned threshold from $t^\ast$ to $1/2$. The repair is structural: train a mandatory confidence report with a strictly proper score plus a correctness reward, and abstain only at deployment by thresholding the report. The always-emitted report has no gate to saturate, so no shared factor can kill its reward gradient and its anchor together, and its calibrated optimum is attracting. Simulations confirm every prediction, and experiments on language models at two scales confirm the mechanism live: the rule silences questions the models demonstrably still solve within ten optimizer steps, an ablation isolates the cause, and report-level training raises coverage, accuracy, and calibration together.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了误差惩罚评分规则（答对+1，答错-λ，弃权0）在对抗幻觉中的应用，发现KL锚定梯度学习器在该规则下可能走向"拒绝一切"的极端。作者证明当弃权是离散动作时，奖励梯度和锚定恢复力被同一个门饱和因子抑制并同时消失，模型会逐渐漂移向拒绝所有问题，平均奖励以1/t的速率趋近于零，表面看是性能提升实则是覆盖率崩溃。优势估计器会加剧此问题，在稀疏答案场景下组归一化会将所有设计的惩罚替换为有效惩罚1，使学习阈值从t*移到1/2。修复方案是结构性改变：训练持续输出的置信度报告（使用严格适当的评分加正确性奖励），仅在部署时通过阈值化报告来决定是否弃权。模拟和两种规模的LM实验都验证了该机制。
AI.motivation: 误差惩罚评分规则（Chow阈值）被越来越广泛地推荐用于对抗大语言模型的幻觉问题，但作者发现这类规则在梯度学习框架下可能产生与预期完全相反的行为——模型不是学会在不确定时弃权，而是倾向于对所有问题弃权。这种"假改进"现象（训练奖励上升但覆盖率崩塌）极具危害性，需要深入分析和修复。
AI.method: 理论分析上，作者证明KL锚定梯度学习器在离散弃权动作下，奖励梯度与锚的恢复力被相同的门饱和因子同时扼杀，导致模型漂移向全拒绝状态，训练奖励以1/t速率趋近于零。同时分析优势估计器在稀疏答案场景下通过组归一化将惩罚阈值从t*扭曲为1/2。修复方案采用结构性设计：训练一个始终输出的置信度报告（严格适当评分+正确性奖励），部署时再通过阈值化决定弃权，避免门饱和因子的共同扼杀效应。
AI.result: 模拟实验验证了所有理论预测。在两种规模的语言模型实验（较小和较大规模）中，确认了该机制在实际运行中的表现：规则在十步优化内就让模型对原本仍能正确回答的问题保持沉默；消融实验隔离了原因；基于报告的训练同时提升了覆盖率、准确率和校准度。
AI.conclusion: 误差惩罚评分规则在KL锚定梯度学习器下存在系统性失败：离散弃权动作的门饱和效应会使模型崩塌为全拒绝策略，且训练曲线伪装成改进。优势估计器进一步加剧问题。根本修复不是调整超参数，而是结构性改变——使用始终输出的置信度报告作为中间表示，将弃权决策推迟到部署阶段，从而避免训练中共享门饱和因子的致命效应。

title: Neural Circuit Function Inference with LLMs
summary: The success of connectome mapping now shifts the challenge of understanding the nervous system to the interpretation of neural circuits. Here, we devise a new automated method, LLantia (LLM automated neural circuit inference and analysis), to systematically infer neural circuit function and the role of its component neural cell types. Our approach distills descriptions of cell type function from the literature and, in combination with the connectome, then infers the function for all other cell types, which serves as a basis for subsequent neural circuit function inference. Results are structured hierarchically, with different possible circuit functions organised under multiple possible behavioural and physiological contexts, and each circuit function composed of subcircuit descriptions alongside relevant cell types to facilitate both backtracking to known, published information and support further experimental research. We illustrate our method by inferring cell type function for all cell types of the adult fruit fly brain and for select broader circuits within, and validate our findings, including by cross-checking with literature published after the release date of our analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为LLantia的自动化方法，利用大语言模型结合连接组数据，从文献中提取细胞类型功能描述，进而系统地推断神经回路功能及组成细胞类型的作用。该方法在果蝇成虫大脑上进行了验证，生成层次化、可回溯的推断结果。
AI.motivation: 连接组图谱绘制已取得成功，但理解神经系统的挑战已转向如何解读神经回路的功能。需要一个自动化方法系统地推断神经回路功能及其组成细胞类型的作用。
AI.method: LLantia方法从文献中提取细胞类型功能描述，结合连接组数据，推断所有其他细胞类型的功能，并在此基础上进一步推断神经回路功能。结果以层次化结构组织，将不同可能的回路功能分类到多种行为和生理情境下，每个回路功能包含子回路描述和相关细胞类型，便于回溯已发表信息。
AI.result: 该方法在成年果蝇大脑的所有细胞类型及若干更广泛的回路中进行了功能推断，并通过与分析发布后发表的文献交叉验证进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: LLantia提供了一种系统化、自动化且可验证的神经回路功能推断方法，能够支持后续实验研究。

title: H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases
summary: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost. This mismatch raises a natural question: can context-dependent phrases provide a useful retrieval unit between global vectors and tokens? We introduce H+ Embedding, a unified multi-granularity retriever that predicts variable-length phrase partitions, preserves uncovered tokens as singletons, and applies importance-guided unit selection with weighted MaxSim interaction. Across 16 scientific, medical, and bilingual tasks, its phrase retrieval branch exceeds the global retrieval branch by 6.91 macro nDCG@10. It also nearly matches Token while using 13.7% fewer document vectors and outperforms content-independent grouping rules under moderate vector budgets. Context-dependent phrase interaction therefore provides an intermediate quality-cost point between global compression and token-level interaction for practical retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，通过预测可变长度短语分区（未被覆盖的词保留为单例），并结合重要性引导的单元选择与加权MaxSim交互，在全局向量和token级交互之间提供了中间质量的检索方案。在16个科学、医学及双语任务上，短语检索分支比全局检索分支提升6.91 macro nDCG@10，同时相比Token方法减少13.7%的文档向量。
AI.motivation: 现有检索表示处于两个极端：单向量检索器过度压缩局部相关信号，而token级延迟交互保留每个子词导致巨大的索引、存储和评分成本。术语密集型检索（尤其是医学场景）依赖保留多词实体、缩写、数值约束和组合概念，但现有表示无法同时兼顾质量和效率，因此作者探索上下文相关短语作为介于全局向量与token之间的检索单元。
AI.method: 提出H+ Embedding统一多粒度检索器，核心包括：(1) 预测可变长度短语分区；(2) 将未被短语覆盖的token保留为单例；(3) 应用重要性引导的单元选择；(4) 采用加权MaxSim交互机制进行评分。
AI.result: 在16个科学、医学和双语任务上，H+ Embedding的短语检索分支相比全局检索分支提升6.91 macro nDCG@10；在与Token方法对比中，使用13.7%更少的文档向量便接近其性能；在中等向量预算下优于与内容无关的分组规则。
AI.conclusion: 上下文相关的短语交互提供了一种介于全局压缩与token级交互之间的中间质量-成本方案，适合实际检索系统部署。

title: SPEAR: Selection-aware Personalized End-to-end Adaptive Rewriting and Retrieval for Community Search
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Main Track of the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026). Code: https://github.com/mallocagi1-cell/spear
summary: Query reformulation bridges user intent and retrieval in e-commerce search, yet production systems optimize rewrite quality and retrieval effectiveness separately, leaving the two stages structurally misaligned. Path-based architectures unify them end-to-end but were designed for personalization, where relevance is not an explicit constraint-search additionally requires the rewrite to remain faithful to the user's stated query intent. Transplanted directly, these models learn a shortcut we term the generic-word dominance effect: they favor generic rewrites that score well on paths but drift from query intent. To address this, we propose SPEAR (Selection-aware Personalized End-to-end Adaptive Rewriting and Retrieval), which integrates three components that each target one failure mode: (1) a dual-embedding backbone with auxiliary loss and gradient isolation that shields recall-side semantics from being eroded by CTR-driven ranking signals; (2) a multiplicative gating aggregator that lets a rewrite score high only when both its confidence and item relevance are strong, eliminating the generic-word shortcut; (3) a Dynamic Rewrite Selector that jointly generates request-specific rewrite weights and user-query-conditioned scale and bias terms, allowing both rewrite preference and relevance calibration to adapt to each request. Offline evaluation on 100K held-out industrial search sessions shows that the proposed framework improves rewrite semantic similarity@10 by +18.2 and click recall@10 by +99.5 over the production baseline. In online A/B testing, SPEAR achieves +0.259 in query-view CTR and +0.733 in average reading depth, confirming that improved rewrite selection translates into stronger retrieval and deeper user engagement. The proposed SPEAR system has been fully deployed in Dewu's community search platform since 2025. Our code is available at https://github.com/mallocagi1-cell/spear.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEAR系统，解决电商搜索中查询改写与检索端到端联合优化时的结构错配问题。针对移植路径式架构产生的"通用词主导效应"（改写偏向通用词而偏离用户原始意图），SPEAR通过双嵌入骨干、乘法门控聚合器和动态改写选择器三个组件分别解决三个故障模式，在离线100K工业会话和在线A/B测试中均显著提升检索效果，已部署于Dewu社区搜索平台。
AI.motivation: 生产系统的查询改写和检索质量优化是分开进行的，导致两阶段结构错配。虽然路径式架构可以端到端统一二者，但这类架构最初是为个性化推荐设计的，不包含相关性约束。直接移植会导致模型学习到"通用词主导效应"——改写偏向能获得高路径分数的通用词，但偏离用户查询的真实意图。
AI.method: SPEAR包含三个组件：(1)双嵌入骨干架构，通过辅助损失和梯度隔离保护召回侧语义不被CTR驱动的排序信号侵蚀；(2)乘法门控聚合器，仅当改写置信度和物品相关性都强时评分才高，消除通用词捷径；(3)动态改写选择器，联合生成请求特定的改写权重和用户-查询条件化的缩放及偏置项，使改写偏好和相关性校准都能自适应每个请求。
AI.result: 离线评估在100K工业搜索会话上，改写语义相似度@10提升+18.2，点击召回率@10提升+99.5（相对生产基线）。在线A/B测试中，query-view CTR提升+0.259，平均阅读深度提升+0.733。系统自2025年起已完全部署在Dewu社区搜索平台。
AI.conclusion: SPEAR通过针对性地解决端到端改写-检索系统中的三个具体故障模式，证明了在保持查询意图保真度的同时实现改写与检索联合优化的可行性。该方法在离线与在线实验中均验证了有效性，并已在生产中全量部署。

title: Beyond the PPAD hardness of Auto-bidding Auctions
comment: For questions regarding this work, please contact yyangh at cs dot washington dot edu
summary:
Computing certain autobidding equilibria is PPAD complete in the worst case. Yet such instances rarely arise in practice, where advertisers running simple, decentralized learning strategies usually converge quickly. We show there is no contradiction: the hardness requires atomicity and vanishes once the value distribution is nonatomic, as it is in real world markets.
  To bridge worst case hardness and practical convergence, we introduce diffuse analysis, a beyond worst case framework that studies equilibrium computation when bidder values are drawn from general nonatomic distributions. Under this framework, the autobidding equilibrium becomes a separately monotone generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE). For this GNE, we give the first solver with last iterate linear convergence. Thus, the equilibrium has polynomial diffuse complexity, matching the convergence observed in real-world markets.
  Concretely, our framework subsumes the budget pacing and the throttling equilibrium as special cases when the payment rule is a convex combination of first and second price.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"扩散分析"（diffuse analysis）这一超越最坏情况的框架，用于研究自动竞价均衡的计算问题。作者证明在最坏情况下该问题是PPAD完全的，但当价值分布为非原子的（如实世界市场中的情形）时，这种困难性消失。在该框架下，自动竞价均衡成为单独单调的广义纳什均衡（GNE），作者给出了首个具有最后迭代线性收敛性的求解器，从而证明均衡具有多项式扩散复杂度，与现实市场中观察到的收敛行为一致。
AI.motivation: 自动竞价均衡在最坏情况下计算是PPAD完全的，但在实际市场中简单的去中心化学习策略通常能快速收敛，这两者之间存在看似矛盾的现象。作者希望弥合这种理论最坏情况困难与实际实践收敛之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 作者引入"扩散分析"（diffuse analysis）作为超越最坏情况的框架，研究当竞价者价值来自一般非原子分布时的均衡计算。在此框架下，自动竞价均衡被刻画为单独单调的广义纳什均衡（GNE），并为其设计了首个具有最后迭代线性收敛性质的求解器。该框架在支付规则为第一价格和第二价格的凸组合时，统一了预算配速（budget pacing）和节流（throttling）均衡作为特例。
AI.result: 证明最坏情况下PPAD完全性源于原子性（atomicity），一旦价值分布为非原子的，困难性消失。在扩散分析框架下，自动竞价均衡具有多项式扩散复杂度，并给出了首个线性收敛的GNE求解器，与现实市场观察到的快速收敛行为相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入扩散分析框架，论文成功弥合了自动竞价均衡计算的理论最坏情况困难与实际市场快速收敛之间的鸿沟，证明非原子价值分布下均衡计算具有多项式复杂度，并提供了可收敛的求解算法。

title: Unreliable in Practice? A Comprehensive Study of Errors in LLM-Generated Code
comment: Accepted for publication in the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being widely used for coding, with reports indicating that AI now generates an increasing share of production code. Studies show that LLMs can significantly improve developer productivity, yet they still struggle with more complex coding tasks. Just as understanding error modes in human-written code has been central to improving software quality, identifying and characterizing the errors in LLM-generated code is critical for setting realistic expectations and designing mitigation strategies. Prior research has been limited in scope, often focusing on a single language, a small number of problems, or a limited selection of models. As a result, there is still no comprehensive understanding of which errors are common and which are specific to certain models or languages. To address these gaps and develop a deeper understanding of the quality of LLM-generated code, we analyzed a corpus of 86,726 code samples that contained compilation or runtime errors. These samples were generated by seven LLMs across four compiled languages. We classified errors by their underlying causes using an LLM, manually validated these classifications, and performed a comparative analysis. This labeled data is then used to measure error prevalence by model, language, and problem difficulty, to identify common error patterns. Results show that, although error types vary strongly across languages and models, even the largest models frequently make simple mistakes. We also observe that generated code often omits basic input validation or memory-safety checks, which can lead to overflows, resource exhaustion, or other reliability/security issues.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了由7个LLM在4种编译语言中生成的86,726个包含编译或运行时错误的代码样本，利用LLM分类错误原因并人工验证，系统性地比较了不同模型、语言和问题难度下的错误分布模式。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用于代码生成，但其生成的代码在复杂任务中仍存在错误。以往研究规模有限（单一语言、少量问题或有限模型），缺乏对LLM生成代码错误模式的全面理解。理解这些错误模式对设定合理预期和设计缓解策略至关重要。
AI.method: 构建包含86,726个含编译/运行时错误代码样本的语料库，由7个LLM在4种编译语言上生成；使用LLM对错误按根因分类，人工验证分类结果，并基于标注数据按模型、语言和问题难度进行错误流行度比较与模式识别。
AI.result: 错误类型在不同语言和模型间差异显著，但即使是最大的模型也频繁犯简单错误；生成的代码经常缺少基本的输入验证或内存安全检查，可能导致溢出、资源耗尽或其他可靠性与安全问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成代码的错误存在明显的模型与语言特异性，但同时也存在普遍性的基础性错误（如输入验证缺失），这些发现为LLM代码生成工具的质量改进和风险评估提供了实证依据。

title: From Pixels to PCells: A Neurosymbolic Approach to Photonic Component Creation
summary: We present PixCell, a neurosymbolic system in which multimodal agents convert a visually presented photonic component into a parametric program over a small domain-specific language (DSL) of geometric primitives. A system enabling deterministic visual verification renders evaluation asymmetrically cheaper than the generation attempt. While models using multi-seed sampling and iterative revision reach a mean best-turn IoU of only 0.416, multimodal agents through PixCell's interface and verifier consistently exceed 0.9 mean IoU, with scores reaching 0.974 and 0.955 across eight component targets while also satisfying source contracts. These results demonstrate that frontier multimodal agents can reliably understand and render executable parametric representations from visual targets. Using these live parameters, cross-stack studies on an interferometer reconstruct primitive programs that satisfy an 8.0 nm free spectral range target and the original footprint constraint on modeled 220-nm SOI, 400-nm SiN, and 400-nm TFLN stacks. PixCell further carries a paper-derived splitter from visual reconstruction through SOI full-wave simulation, producing symmetric propagation and balanced outputs. Finally, the same executable verifier supplies a training reward and dataset used to train a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model with LoRA and GRPO without supervised demonstrations. On eight training-excluded paper figures, its mean champion IoU rises from 0.422 after eight initial attempts to 0.491 after three verifier-guided revision rounds. These results therefore establish a controlled framework for measuring, retargeting, and improving visual-to-parametric photonic component design.

AI.tldr: PixCell是一个神经符号系统，利用多模态智能体将视觉呈现的光子组件转换为领域特定语言(DSL)中的参数化程序。系统通过确定性视觉验证使评估成本远低于生成尝试。多模态智能体在八个组件目标上平均IoU超过0.9（最高达0.974），远优于多种子采样和迭代修订方法的0.416。系统还通过可执行验证器提供训练奖励，使用LoRA和GRPO训练Qwen模型，无需监督演示即可提升性能。
AI.motivation: 解决从视觉图像到可执行参数化程序这一"视觉到参数"转换难题，现有模型在多种子采样和迭代修订下平均IoU仅为0.416，准确率不高，需要更可靠的框架来理解和渲染可执行的光子组件参数化表示。
AI.method: 1) 构建小型DSL，包含几何原语的参数化程序表示；2) 采用确定性视觉验证器，使评估比生成便宜得多；3) 多模态智能体通过PixCell接口与验证器交互；4) 使用可执行验证器提供训练奖励，结合LoRA和GRPO训练Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型（无需监督演示）。
AI.result: 多模态智能体在八个组件目标上平均IoU超过0.9（0.974和0.955），满足源契约；跨栈研究在220-nm SOI、400-nm SiN和400-nm TFLN栈上重建干涉仪原语程序，满足8.0nm自由光谱范围和原始封装约束；通过视觉重建完成SOI全波模拟，产生对称传播和平衡输出；训练后的Qwen模型在八个未见论文图形上平均冠军IoU从0.422提升至0.491。
AI.conclusion: PixCell建立了一个受控框架，用于测量、重定向和改进视觉到参数的光子组件设计，证明前沿多模态智能体能够可靠理解和渲染可执行的参数化表示，并且该框架可用于训练更小的模型在无监督演示条件下提升性能。

title: Agentic Bayesian Optimization through Surrogate-Augmented Autoresearch
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard tool for sample-efficient optimization and owes its efficiency to uncertainty-aware search driven by generic statistical priors. Richer domain priors can improve BO in principle, but encoding them through tailored kernels or problem structure is difficult and rarely done in practice. LLMs can help sidestep this difficulty by making informal priors from natural language, code, and documentation directly available to the optimizer. However, existing LLM-based BO methods either insert the LLM into a fixed role (surrogate, acquisition proxy, or configuration interface) or hand it broad control, sacrificing the systematic exploration that makes BO reliable. We introduce agentic Bayesian optimization: a paradigm in which an LLM agent is the central decision maker in the BO loop while a Bayesian backend provides the uncertainty-aware optimization substrate. The agent configures the problem, queries the backend, selects and commits evaluations, and can revise the optimization strategy during the run by tightening bounds, switching acquisition functions, proposing targeted evaluations, or even reframing the problem following new instructions or observed evidence. We instantiate this idea in Sara, a surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent, and lenz, a modular BoTorch-based backend that the agent can inspect and modify through a structured interface. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, Sara preserves the reliability of state-of-the-art BO without prior knowledge, outperforms LLM-based baselines, and uses natural-language priors to improve beyond standard BO. We further demonstrate the practical value of agentic BO in dynamic settings, where Sara reconfigures the full optimization problem on the fly as requirements change, a capability not previously available in standard BO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"agentic Bayesian optimization"的新范式，将LLM智能体作为BO循环中的核心决策者，同时保留贝叶斯后端提供的不确定性感知优化基础。作者实现了Sara（智能体）和lenz（模块化BoTorch后端），允许智能体在优化过程中动态配置问题、查询后端、选择评估点并修订优化策略。实验表明该方法在合成和真实基准上保持甚至超越标准BO的性能，并能利用自然语言先验改进优化效果，还能在动态场景中实时重新配置优化问题。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化依赖通用统计先验实现样本高效优化，而更丰富的领域先验（如自然语言、代码、文档中的非正式知识）难以通过定制核函数或问题结构编码进BO。现有基于LLM的BO方法要么将LLM固定在单一角色（替代、采集函数代理或配置接口），要么赋予其过度宽泛的控制权，牺牲了BO系统的可靠探索能力。因此需要一种新范式，既能利用LLM灵活处理非正式先验和动态调整，又能保持BO的系统化搜索可靠性。
AI.method: 提出agentic Bayesian optimization范式：LLM智能体作为BO循环中的中央决策者，贝叶斯后端提供不确定感知的优化基础。具体实现包括两个组件：(1) Sara，一个代理增强的自研究智能体，负责配置问题、查询后端、选择并执行评估、在运行期间修订优化策略（收紧边界、切换采集函数、提出定向评估、甚至重新定义问题）；(2) lenz，一个模块化的BoTorch后端，通过结构化接口供智能体检查（检查）和修改。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准上，Sara在无先验知识时保持了最先进BO的可靠性，超越了基于LLM的基线方法，并能利用自然语言先验提升超越标准BO的性能。此外，在动态设置中Sara能实时重新配置整个优化问题以适应需求变化，这是标准BO此前不具备的能力。
AI.conclusion: Agentic BO范式成功结合了LLM的灵活性和贝叶斯优化的可靠性，为将非正式领域知识（自然语言、代码、文档）引入优化过程提供了一条实用路径，并支持动态场景下的问题重构能力，拓展了BO的应用边界。

title: LLM-OSDA: An Optimal-Stopping Dynamic Auction for Native Advertising in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
summary: LLM-native advertising embeds sponsored content directly into model-generated responses, shifting the unit of sale from a fixed slot to a moment within an evolving conversation. Existing LLM ad-auction mechanisms primarily operate within a single response, settling the winner but not the timing. The extension is nontrivial: with one native insertion opportunity per session, the stopping time depends on bids, coupling timing with allocation, so static truthfulness arguments no longer apply. We propose the LLM-based Optimal Stopping Dynamic Auction (LLM-OSDA), a dynamic cost-per-click auction that integrates Bellman optimal stopping, winner allocation, and envelope pricing. A bid-independent LLM layer estimates contextual click quality and seamlessly renders the winning ad, while bids enter only the committed auction mechanism. Under an exact Bellman oracle, the expected discounted-click allocation is monotone in each advertiser's bid, and the corresponding envelope payment makes truthful bidding weakly dominant in expectation. For practical deployment, a learned StopNet approximates the Bellman action values. We show that its decisions differ from the optimal policy only near the stopping boundary and bound the resulting incentive loss in terms of its approximation error. Experiments on a simulated conversational advertising corpus show that LLM-OSDA improves net revenue by 11 percent over the strongest fixed-timing baseline while maintaining comparable user retention. Code is at https://github.com/2025Fang2025/llm-osda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-OSDA（基于LLM的最优停止动态拍卖机制），将传统单次响应的LLM广告拍卖扩展到跨对话会话的动态时序场景，通过Bellman最优停止、winner分配和包络定价的整合，实现时序与分配的耦合优化，并证明了诚实的弱占优均衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM广告拍卖机制仅作用于单次响应，解决了"谁赢得广告位"但未解决"何时插入广告"这一关键时序问题。随着对话会话的演进而非固定slot的广告单元，停止时机依赖于竞价，导致时序与分配相互耦合，传统的静态真实性论证不再适用，需要新的动态拍卖机制。
AI.method: 提出LLM-OSDA动态CPC拍卖机制，核心组件包括：(1) Bellman最优停止方程求解插入时机；(2) winner allocation与envelope pricing整合；(3) 与竞价无关的LLM层估计上下文点击质量并渲染广告，竞价仅进入承诺的拍卖机制；(4) 实际部署中使用StopNet近似Bellman动作值，其决策仅在停止边界附近与最优策略有差异，并界定了近似误差导致的激励损失。
AI.result: 在精确Bellman oracle下证明了期望折扣点击分配的单调性及包络支付的激励相容性；在模拟对话广告语料上，LLM-OSDA相比最强固定时序基线在净收入上提升11%，同时保持可比的用户留存率。
AI.conclusion: LLM-OSDA首次系统性地解决了LLM原生广告中对话级时序与分配的联合最优问题，实现了动态环境下的激励相容拍卖，并为实际部署提供了可学习的近似方案，为LLM广告拍卖研究开辟了"何时插入"的新维度。

title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
summary:
AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.
  Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对AI编码智能体（如GitHub Copilot等）的工作负载进行了生产规模的表征分析，基于2026年6月采样的大规模数据（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用、95万亿token），揭示了智能体工作负载与传统聊天机器人工作负载的本质差异，包括高的KV缓存命中率、长时间用户空闲期等特性，并提出轻量级空闲时间预测器以优化资源编排。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体（如GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex）将多步LLM推理与工具执行交织在一起，形成了一种不同于传统聊天机器人的新工作负载。然而，目前对这种工作负载的特性缺乏系统性的理解，现有LLM服务系统基于聊天工作负载的假设可能不再适用，因此需要对其进行分析和表征。
AI.method: 基于2026年6月采样的GitHub Copilot生产级追踪数据（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用、95万亿token），从会话结构、KV缓存命中率、token消耗分布、时间跨度、工具调用等多个维度对智能体编码工作负载进行系统性表征分析，并设计了一个轻量级空闲时间预测器来捕获用户空闲期。
AI.result: 发现智能体编码会话由稀疏的用户发起轮次组成，每轮展开为自主智能体循环；KV缓存命中率在轮次内平均高达90%，但跨轮次边界降至55%，并在模型切换或上下文压缩等事件后大幅失效；工作负载在token消耗、时间跨度和工具调用上呈现长尾分布且高度多样化；智能体快速周转时间与分钟级用户空闲期形成鲜明对比；设计的轻量级空闲预测器可捕获86-90%的总空闲时间。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM服务系统的底层假设（基于聊天工作负载设计）在智能体工作负载下受到挑战，本研究为构建面向智能体的原生基础设施提供了实证基础。

title: HyperAgent4POI: Dynamic Semantic Message Passing on Multi-Agent Hypergraphs for Missing-Modality Recommendation
summary: Next Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation benefits from textual and visual content that describes venue semantics, yet such content is often incomplete in real-world services. Missing modalities weaken POI representations and reduce the semantic evidence available for ranking. The resulting representations also provide unreliable evidence for modeling higher-order user--POI interactions. We propose HyperAgent4POI, which uses Dynamic Semantic Message Passing (DSMP) to perform modality completion and soft incidence refinement within each hypergraph layer. Persistent node agents share a frozen Llama backbone and use role-specific adapters to produce node-to-hyperedge messages. Semantic hyperedge motifs formed from these messages guide soft incidence scoring and modality completion. Final node representations are cached for online ranking without LLM calls. Experiments on three real-world LBSN datasets show consistent ranking gains over 15 baselines across modality-missing rates, while cached inference provides practical online efficiency. Under a 60% modality-missing rate, HyperAgent4POI improves NDCG@20 over the strongest baseline by 8.2% on average across the three datasets.

AI.tldr: HyperAgent4POI是一个基于超图神经网络的下一个兴趣点推荐方法，利用动态语义消息传递和LLM代理来处理模态缺失问题，通过缓存的推理实现在线效率，在三个真实数据集上平均比最强基线提升8.2%的NDCG@20。
AI.motivation: 现有的POI推荐依赖于文本和视觉等多模态内容来描述地点语义，但真实世界中这些模态常常不完整。缺失的模态会削弱POI表示，降低排序所需的语义证据，并影响高阶用户-兴趣点交互的建模质量。
AI.method: 提出HyperAgent4POI框架：1) 动态语义消息传递(DSMP)在每层超图内同时执行模态补全和软关联(soft incidence)细化；2) 持久节点代理共享冻结的Llama主干，使用角色特定适配器生成节点到超边的消息；3) 由这些消息形成的语义超边模态(motifs)指导软关联评分和模态补全；4) 最终节点表示被缓存用于在线排名，无需LLM调用。
AI.result: 在三个真实LBSN数据集上，HyperAgent4POI在15个基线方法中始终取得排名提升。在60%模态缺失率下，相比最强基线，三个数据集上的NDCG@20平均提升8.2%，同时缓存推理保证了实际在线效率。
AI.conclusion: HyperAgent4POI通过将LLM代理与超图消息传递结合，有效解决了POI推荐中的模态缺失问题，在保证推荐质量的同时实现了实用的在线推理效率。

title: Second-Order Potentials for Finite Games: Existence, Characterisation, and Game Decomposition
summary:
Monderer and Shapley (1996) showed that a game is an exact potential game exactly when the players' cross-differences agree pair by pair, a symmetry condition on how any two players' incentives interlock. This paper asks what can be built from these characteristics when symmetry fails. The resulting MS-potential is constructed from the second differences that represent the game's common-interest elements. The MS-potential is unique up to separable payoff terms and it exists precisely when a higher-order MS-condition holds. On the class of exact potential games it recovers the potential up to the players' individualistic main effects. A least-squares construction subsequently extends the MS-potential to the class of all finite games. The construction induces the MS-decomposition: every finite game splits into a common-interest MS-potential game and a residual that absorbs every player's individualistic payoffs.
  The paper's central result is an identity: for games in which all players have equally many actions, an augmentation of the MS-potential coincides --- up to the additive constant --- with the potential of Candogan, Menache, Ozdaglar and Parrilo (2011).

AI.tldr: 本文在Monderer和Shapley(1996)精确势博弈理论的基础上，研究了当对称性条件（交叉差分一致性）不成立时，如何构建一种推广的势函数——MS-势。MS-势由刻画博弈共同利益元素的二阶差分构造，在更高阶MS条件满足时存在且唯一（至多差可分离支付项）。通过最小二乘构造，MS-势可推广至所有有限博弈，并诱导出MS-分解：每个有限博弈可分解为共同利益的MS-势博弈与吸收个体支付的残差之和。论文的核心结果是：当所有玩家行动数相同时，MS-势的某种增广形式与Candogan等人(2011)的势函数在加法常数意义下完全一致。
AI.motivation: Monderer和Shapley(1996)证明了精确势博弈等价于玩家的交叉差分逐对一致，这是一种关于任意两位玩家激励如何交错的对称性条件。本文的研究动机是：当这种对称性失效时，能否仍从这些（二阶差分）特征中构建出有意义的结构？换言之，论文试图将势博弈理论推广到更广泛的非对称博弈类别中。
AI.method: 论文提出了MS-势的构建方法：（1）从代表博弈共同兴趣元素的二阶差分出发构造MS-势；（2）证明了MS-势的存在性等价于一个更高阶的MS条件；（3）在精确势博弈类上，MS-势能恢复势函数（至多个体性主效应差异）；（4）通过最小二乘构造将MS-势扩展到所有有限博弈，从而诱导出MS-分解：每个有限博弈分解为共同兴趣的MS-势博弈加一个吸收所有玩家个体支付的残差项。
AI.result: 论文的核心结果是：对于所有玩家具有相同行动数的博弈，MS-势的某种增广形式与Candogan, Menache, Ozdaglar和Parrilo(2011)所提出的势函数在加法常数意义下完全一致，建立了两种势博弈理论框架之间的精确联系。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地将精确势博弈理论从对称情形推广到非对称的一般博弈，建立了MS-势的概念及其存在唯一性、扩展与分解理论，并揭示了其与既有势函数框架（Candogan等2011）的内在等价关系，为有限博弈的结构分析提供了一个统一的新视角。

title: Vul4Py: Benchmarking Automated Vulnerability Repair in Python with Paired Exploit and Functional Oracles
summary: Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) has advanced rapidly across program analysis, machine learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs), but a verifiable, head-to-head comparison of AVR approaches on Python is still missing. Python underpins critical web, data, and machine-learning infrastructure, yet existing Python benchmarks accept a patch on the strength of a proof-of-concept exploit alone, or apply a functional test only on the subset of entries whose upstream project happens to ship one. Both therefore miss functional regressions, in which a patch defeats the exploit but breaks unrelated behavior. We present Vul4Py, a Python AVR benchmark in which every entry carries a paired oracle: an exploit oracle that must fail on the vulnerable revision and pass on the fixed one, together with a project-native pytest functional oracle that must pass on both. Vul4Py comprises 100 real vulnerabilities from 60 open-source projects, spanning 60 distinct CWEs and the years 2017 to 2025, each packaged with a pinned, reproducible per-instance environment. Using Vul4Py, we compare six approaches in three categories: a specialized vulnerability repair tool, directly prompted LLMs, and software engineering agents. The agents dominate: OpenHands repairs 41 of 100 vulnerabilities, against 4 for the strongest directly prompted LLM and 2 for the specialized tool, despite all three sharing the same backbone model. The paired oracle is what makes these counts trustworthy: it rejects 15 of the 119 patches that an exploit-only oracle would accept, and 98 of the 104 patches it admits are manually confirmed to be semantically equivalent to the developer's patches

AI.tldr: 本文提出Vul4Py，一个针对Python的自动化漏洞修复（AVR）基准测试集，包含100个来自60个开源项目的真实漏洞，每个漏洞都配有成对的双重验证器（漏洞利用验证器和功能回归测试）。通过该基准对六种修复方法进行对比，发现软件工程智能体（OpenHands）显著优于直接提示的LLM和专用修复工具，修复了41/100个漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有Python漏洞修复基准存在严重缺陷：要么仅依赖概念验证漏洞利用来接受补丁，要么只在部分项目上应用功能测试，这导致大量"功能回归"（补丁解决了漏洞但破坏了其他功能）被遗漏。缺乏一个可验证的、公平的对比基准来评估不同AVR方法在Python上的真实表现。
AI.method: 构建Vul4Py基准：收集100个跨越2017-2025年的真实Python漏洞，涵盖60个开源项目和60种不同的CWE。每个条目包含成对的验证：漏洞利用oracle（在漏洞版本必须失败、在修复版本必须通过）和项目原生pytest功能oracle（在两个版本都必须通过）。同时提供固定的、可复现的逐实例环境。然后对六种方法进行系统对比：专用漏洞修复工具、直接提示的LLM、软件工程智能体。
AI.result: 软件工程智能体表现最佳：OpenHands修复了100个中的41个漏洞；最强的直接提示LLM仅修复4个，专用工具仅修复2个（三者使用相同的骨干模型）。成对oracle的重要性得到验证：它拒绝了119个仅用漏洞利用oracle会接受的补丁中的15个，且104个被接受的补丁中有98个经人工确认为与开发者补丁语义等价。
AI.conclusion: Vul4Py证明了对Python AVR评估必须同时使用漏洞利用验证和功能回归测试，否则会严重高估修复方法的有效性。研究还表明，软件工程智能体在处理真实Python漏洞修复任务上显著优于直接提示的LLM和专用工具，为未来的AVR研究提供了更可靠的评估标准和方向。

title: DS@GT ARC at MEDIQA-CORE-Task-1 2026: Trimodal Model Fusion with Task-Specific Gates for Brain Tumor Subtype Classification
comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21 - 24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
summary: Brain tumor diagnosis is a time-sensitive process in which patients may wait weeks for a finalized pathology report. This problem motivates automated systems that classify tumor subtype from multimodal inputs. This paper details the DS@GT ARC team's work for ImageCLEFmed MEDIQA-CORE 2026 Task~1, Brain Tumor Subtype Classification. The task evaluates three glioma classification problems: Level-1 Molecular Type, LGG vs HGG, and WHO Grade. We combine pre-extracted MRI (NeuroVFM) and histopathology (Prov-GigaPath) embeddings with free-text radiology reports. Our team explored two trimodal fusion architectures, two report encoders (RadBERT and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and a biologically motivated post-processing stage. We achieve a mean macro-F1 of 0.801 under the Fully Multimodal condition, exceeding the organizers' baseline of 0.796 and ranking second among the teams whose code passed verification. Additional evaluation across modality-dropping conditions shows that this advantage depends heavily on the availability of the histopathology modality, and that our system falls behind the baseline when modalities are missing. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-mediqacore-2026.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DS@GT ARC团队在ImageCLEFmed MEDIQA-CORE 2026 Task 1脑肿瘤亚型分类任务中的工作。该团队结合MRI嵌入、组织病理学嵌入和放射学报告文本，探索了两种三模态融合架构、两种报告编码器以及生物启发的后处理阶段，最终在完全多模态条件下取得平均macro-F1为0.801的成绩，超过基线0.796，排名第二。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤诊断是一个时间敏感的过程，患者可能需要等待数周才能获得最终的病理报告。这一问题促使研究者开发自动化系统，从多模态输入中对肿瘤亚型进行分类，以加速诊断流程。
AI.method: 将预提取的MRI嵌入（NeuroVFM）和组织病理学嵌入（Prov-GigaPath）与自由文本放射学报告相结合。探索了两种三模态融合架构、两种报告编码器（RadBERT和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct），并设计了生物启发的后处理阶段。
AI.result: 在完全多模态条件下取得平均macro-F1为0.801，超过组织者基线0.796，在通过代码验证的团队中排名第二。但在模态缺失条件下，系统的优势严重依赖组织病理学模态的可用性，当模态缺失时性能落后于基线。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在完整多模态输入下表现优异，但暴露了一个关键弱点：对单一模态（尤其是组织病理学）的过度依赖导致在模态缺失时鲁棒性不足，未来需要增强系统的模态鲁棒性。

title: Neural operator learning for collision-aware trajectory planning of spacecraft swarms
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Nature Machine Intelligence. Video abstract included as ancillary file
summary: Autonomous spacecraft swarms must plan fuel-efficient, collision-free maneuvers in increasingly congested orbits, yet classical trajectory optimization scales poorly as pairwise safety constraints multiply with swarm size, and learning-based planners rarely transfer across swarm sizes or debris densities. Here we introduce a permutation-equivariant neural operator that maps distributions of spacecraft, targets and debris to collision-aware trajectories for an entire swarm in a single forward pass, paired with a batched Gauss-Newton finish that enforces exact orbital dynamics. The operator is trained without optimal-trajectory labels, combining self-supervised physics objectives with adversarial threats generated against its own rollouts. Trained on ten spacecraft, it generalizes zero-shot to swarms of 1,000 amid more than 11,000 catalogued objects, matching a per-agent optimal-control solver's accuracy, evading worst-case threats that a debris-blind baseline cannot, and reducing proximity within the swarm several-fold. Physics-grounded operator learning thus offers a fast, scalable alternative to optimal control for crowded orbits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种置换等变神经算子，可在单次前向传播中为整个航天器编队规划避碰轨迹，配合批量高斯-牛顿精修确保精确轨道动力学。该算子通过自监督物理目标和对抗威胁训练，无需最优轨迹标签，可从10个航天器零样本泛化到1000个航天器及11000+个障碍物的规模。
AI.motivation: 传统轨迹优化方法在编队规模增大时，成对安全约束数量激增导致可扩展性差；而基于学习的规划器难以跨编队规模和碎片密度泛化。当前拥挤轨道环境下需要兼具高效与鲁棒性的自主编队规划方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计置换等变神经算子，将航天器、目标和碎片的分布映射为整个编队的碰撞感知轨迹；2) 结合批量化的高斯-牛顿精修阶段，强制满足精确轨道动力学约束；3) 训练不使用最优轨迹标签，而是结合自监督物理目标函数与针对自身滚动预测生成的对抗性威胁进行训练。
AI.result: 在10个航天器上训练后，该算子可零样本泛化到1000个航天器、11000+个编目物体的场景；精度与单智能体最优控制求解器相当；能规避碎片盲基线无法应对的最坏情况威胁；并将编队内部邻近度降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于物理约束的算子学习为拥挤轨道的航天器编队规划提供了快速、可扩展的替代方案，克服了经典最优控制在规模化上的瓶颈。

title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
summary: We introduce DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-weight language model that uses discrete diffusion to generate text at exceptionally high speed. Rather than decoding one token at a time, DiffusionGemma iteratively refines blocks of 256 tokens in parallel, avoiding the sequential decoding bottleneck of conventional autoregressive (AR) large language models. Instead of training from scratch, we obtain DiffusionGemma by fine-tuning the mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with 3.8B activated and 25.2B total parameters. Our compute-efficient two-stage training pipeline uses fewer than 10% of the starting AR model's total training token budget. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to teach bidirectional denoising, while the second stage combines reinforcement learning with sampler distillation to jointly improve generation quality and inference efficiency. DiffusionGemma establishes a new Pareto frontier for the trade-off between generation speed and model capability. Averaged across our full evaluation suite, it generates around 20 tokens per forward pass and achieves roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, which is substantially faster than AR models even with state-of-the-art speculative decoding. DiffusionGemma also retains the starting model's support for thinking mode, multimodal inputs, and long contexts. Despite diffusion fine-tuning, it remains capable of AR generation with only minor performance degradation, suggesting a path toward hybrid diffusion-AR decoding.

AI.tldr: DiffusionGemma是一个基于离散扩散的开放权重语言模型，通过在Gemma 4模型上微调（而非从头训练），实现了并行生成256个token的高效文本生成，在单张H100上达到约1500 tokens/秒的速度，显著快于传统自回归模型，同时保持多模态、长上下文和思考模式等能力。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归（AR）大语言模型逐个token顺序解码，存在推理速度瓶颈。作者希望通过离散扩散模型实现并行token生成，打破顺序解码的限制，在不从头训练的情况下获得高质量的快速生成模型。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练流程：第一阶段通过监督微调（SFT）教授模型双向去噪能力；第二阶段结合强化学习（RL）与采样器蒸馏（sampler distillation），联合优化生成质量和推理效率。在Gemma 4（3.8B激活/25.2B总参数）混合专家模型上进行微调，训练预算不到原模型的10%。
AI.result: DiffusionGemma在速度-能力权衡上建立了新的帕累托前沿：平均每个前向传播生成约20个token，在单张NVIDIA H100上达到约1500输出tokens/秒，即使与采用最先进投机解码的AR模型相比也显著更快。同时保留了思考模式、多模态输入和长上下文支持，且仍可进行自回归生成。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型微调可作为从AR模型获得高速文本生成能力的有效途径，且不牺牲原有能力。模型仍保留AR生成能力（仅轻微性能下降），为混合扩散-自回归解码的未来方向提供了可能性。

title: Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
summary: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Bazaar，一个动态密封投标基准，用于在隐藏客户偏好、实时竞争和需求变化条件下测试LLM代理在多属性拍卖中的定价能力。研究发现不同LLM在客户获取和利润上的表现排名不一致，且在需求冲击下排名会变化，最强的代理也只能获得不到三分之一的 hindsight 最优利润。
AI.motivation: Agentic commerce正在从概念走向实际部署，支付网络、零售商和AI平台正在为代理进行交易铺路。然而，LLM代理能否在真实市场中（隐藏客户偏好、实时竞争、需求突变）具备胜任的定价能力，尚未被系统性测试。现有工作缺乏一个能够精确评估代理在动态不确定性条件下定价能力的基准。
AI.method: 提出了Bazaar基准：一个动态密封投标的多属性拍卖基准。该基准模拟了隐藏客户偏好、实时竞争和需求冲击等真实市场条件。尽管市场是动态的，但基准基于闭式客户效用函数构建，从而可以进行精确评估。
AI.result: 对来自四个提供商的11个前沿LLM进行了测试。发现：1) 在客户获取上领先的代理（如Gemini 3.1 Pro）往往不是利润领先者（如Opus 4.6）；2) 在需求冲击下排名会变化，冲击前学习最快的代理在冲击后通常最慢修正信念，而Gemini 3.1 Pro恢复最快但利润并非领先；3) 即使最强的代理也仅获得不到hindsight最优利润的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在agentic commerce中已取得进展，但仍有很大的提升空间。定价能力在不同市场条件下表现不稳定，需要更强的适应性定价和信念更新能力。

title: A Self-Triggered Agentic Push Recommendation System
summary: Push notification is a critical recommendation scenario on large-scale platforms, allowing the system to proactively reach users outside the application to improve long-term re-engagement. However, designing an optimal push system requires handling a complex action space for the "whether and when" delivery problem under strict system resource constraints. Existing solutions typically fall into two passive paradigms: pre-planned frequency methods that allocate delivery times via offline modeling, limiting real-time adaptability; and fixed-interval triggering methods that periodically poll the system, creating a strict dilemma between excessive computational overhead and diminished optimal timing capture. Furthermore, such multi-stage frameworks severely suffer from local optima. To overcome these limitations, in this paper, we propose STEPS, a proactive, Self-Triggered End-to-end Agentic Push Recommendation System, which is already fully deployed at Douyin with over 1 billion users. STEPS reformulates push recommendation as a self-triggered agentic process in which the system decides not only whether to send a push, but also when to invoke itself again, thereby forming a closed loop that balances real-time effectiveness and efficiency. Specifically, STEPS consists of two decision transformer-based agents: a planning agent that schedules the next system invocation using a gated ordinal regression method, and an execution agent that decides whether to send a push based on trajectory rewards. Furthermore, we introduce a lightweight filtering agent to both control computational overhead and act as a crucial safeguard against unreasonable planning behaviors. Online A/B testing demonstrates that STEPS significantly increases user active days by 0.2843% and reduces the push permission disablement rate by 1.9089%, while the filtering agent reduces computational overhead by 79.42%.

AI.tldr: STEPS是一个已在抖音全面部署的主动式自触发端到端智能推送推荐系统，将推送推荐重构为自触发的智能体过程，由规划智能体（基于门控序数回归调度下一次系统调用）和执行智能体（基于轨迹奖励决定是否推送）组成，并引入轻量级过滤智能体控制计算开销。在线A/B测试显示用户活跃天数提升0.2843%，推送权限禁用率降低1.9089%，计算开销减少79.42%。
AI.motivation: 现有推送系统存在两大范式缺陷：(1)预计划频率方法通过离线建模分配发送时间，缺乏实时适应性；(2)固定间隔触发方法周期轮询系统，在计算开销与最优时机捕捉之间存在严格两难。此外，多阶段框架严重受限于局部最优解。需要一种能够平衡实时性与效率的主动式推送方案。
AI.method: STEPS将推送推荐形式化为自触发智能体过程：系统不仅决定是否发送推送，还决定何时再次自我调用，形成闭环。具体包含三个组件：(1)规划智能体——基于决策Transformer，使用门控序数回归方法调度下一次系统调用时间；(2)执行智能体——基于决策Transformer和轨迹奖励决定是否发送推送；(3)过滤智能体——轻量级设计，用于控制计算开销并对不合理规划行为进行安全管控。
AI.result: 在线A/B测试结果显示：STEPS显著提升用户活跃天数0.2843%，推送权限禁用率降低1.9089%，过滤智能体将计算开销降低79.42%。系统已在拥有超过10亿用户的抖音平台上全面部署。
AI.conclusion: STEPS通过自触发智能体架构有效解决了推送推荐中"是否发送"和"何时发送"的复杂决策问题，在实时性与效率之间取得平衡，避免了多阶段框架的局部最优问题，并在超大规模真实平台中得到了部署验证。

title: Intention Inference Under Execution Noise: Separating Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty in Social Dilemmas
summary: In noisy social dilemmas, intended actions are stochastically corrupted before execution, so an observed defection may reflect hostile intent or action error. Standard Markov Decision Process (MDP) formulations treat executed actions as states, structurally precluding this distinction and causing systematic over-retaliation. We introduce a Partially Observable MDP (POMDP) formulation encoding opponent intentions as latent states and executed actions as noisy observations, solved within the active inference (AIF) framework with a cost function that decomposes into epistemic and pragmatic components that jointly address inferring current intent and learning how intent evolves. In the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma with symmetric noise, we derive a critical noise threshold governing cooperation collapse, connecting it to a fixed-point condition on learned priors. Experiments reveal that the value of intention inference is context-dependent: the POMDP provides consistent advantages against conditionally cooperative opponents, but mutual intention inference under sufficient noise produces correlated belief-driven collapse. The advantage is specific to games where intent attribution is decision-relevant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的框架，用于在噪声社会困境中编码对手意图为潜在状态、将执行动作视为噪声观测，并通过主动推理（AIF）框架求解，从而区分敌意意图与动作错误，避免过度报复。
AI.motivation: 在噪声社会困境中，由于动作在执行前会被随机扰动，观察到的背叛可能源于敌意意图或动作错误。传统MDP将执行动作视为状态，结构上无法区分这两种情况，导致系统性过度报复行为。
AI.method: 引入POMDP公式，将对手意图编码为潜在状态，执行动作作为噪声观测；在主动推理框架下求解，代价函数分解为认知性（epistemic）和实用性（pragmatic）两个组成部分，分别处理当前意图推断和意图如何演化学习的问题。
AI.result: 在对称噪声的迭代囚徒困境中，推导出一个临界噪声阈值控制合作崩溃，并将该阈值与学习先验的固定点条件相关联。实验表明：意图推断的价值具有情境依赖性——POMDP对条件合作型对手提供一致优势，但在足够噪声下，相互意图推断会产生相关的信念驱动崩溃。该优势仅存在于意图归因与决策相关的博弈中。
AI.conclusion: 意图推断的价值是情境相关的，POMDP在特定条件下优于传统方法，但也可能因信念相关而导致合作崩溃，其优势仅在意图归因对决策重要时体现。

title: EduPluginBench: Executable Assurance for AI-Generated Educational Plugins
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
summary: Code-generation models can produce executable components, but compilation and functional tests do not establish compliance with least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, privileged-write authority, lifecycle constraints, or bounded failure. We introduce EduPluginBench, an executable benchmark and staged admission method for generated plugins in governed software ecosystems. Across 1,440 activation-checked first-order mutants from 30 specifications, P0-P4 increased release-blocking-defect recall by 74.7 percentage points (specification-clustered 95% CI 73.4-75.8) over P0-P2, with no observed rejection among 120 clean references (95% Wilson upper bound 3.1%). A frozen transfer study of 600 unmodified generations from two current coding models found that 300/600 parsed, but none passed P0 or achieved P0-P4 conformance (95% upper bound 0.64%); downstream assurance estimands were undefined. An independently labelled Moodle study retained 16 vulnerable/fixed pairs; the frozen generic PHP detector found no vulnerable revisions. These negative transfer results prevent controlled contract consistency from being read as independent real-defect effectiveness. An earlier 540-generation diagnostic found that post-hoc bounded repair yielded 112 P0 passes, all nonconforming, with recall increasing from 13.4% to 100%. The artifact retains protocols, public-source provenance, raw generations, row-level decisions, audits, analysis code, and reproduction instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EduPluginBench，一个面向受治理软件生态系统中生成插件的可执行基准与分阶段准入方法。实验表明P0-P4比P0-P2在释放阻断缺陷召回率上提升74.7个百分点，但迁移研究发现当前代码生成模型均无法通过P0，负迁移结果警示不能将受控契约一致性误读为真实缺陷有效性。
AI.motivation: 代码生成模型虽能生成可执行组件，但编译和功能测试无法验证最小权限、遥测同意、来源、特权写入、生命周期约束和故障边界等治理合规属性。现有基准缺乏针对受治理生态系统中插件级合规性的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出EduPluginBench可执行基准和分阶段准入方法（P0-P4），使用1,440个激活检查的一阶突变体（来自30个规格）进行评估，并辅以迁移研究、独立标签的Moodle研究和诊断实验来验证方法的有效性与局限性。
AI.result: P0-P4相比P0-P2将释放阻断缺陷召回率提升74.7个百分点（95% CI 73.4-75.8），120个干净参考无拒绝（Wilson上限3.1%）。但两个当前编码模型的600个未修改生成产物中300/600可解析，无一通过P0或P0-P4（上限0.64%）；Moodle研究中冷冻PHP检测器未发现漏洞修订；540代诊断中事后有界修复产生112个P0通过但全部不合规。
AI.conclusion: EduPluginBench能有效区分合规与不合规的生成插件，但当前代码生成模型在治理合规方面能力严重不足。负迁移结果表明不能将受控契约一致性视为独立真实缺陷有效性的证据，需要更好的技术和基准来弥合这一差距。

title: DODA: A Database of Datasets for Aesthetics Research
summary: With rapid growth in the fields of empirical and computational aesthetics we have seen a vast increase in large image datasets annotated for aesthetics. As the image databases differ widely in many respects (e.g., different standards for annotation), it can be tedious to find the dataset that fits one's research needs best. The absence of a centralized open-science search system causes additional problems. Currently, researchers typically share dataset links in papers or on diverse platforms like OSF, GitHub or Dropbox. Manually searching for details like image quality and content often requires downloading all datasets. Therefore, we present the Database Of Datasets for Aesthetics (DODA), an intuitive Web application in which researchers can browse all important datasets for aesthetics research. DODA provides general information about these datasets (size, resolution, type of annotation, number of annotators, etc.) and for many of them also precomputed quantitative image properties. We discuss relevant criteria for selecting a suitable dataset with DODA and illustrate the benefits of reusing datasets. Our approach facilitates collaboration across the fields of empirical and computational aesthetics. Keywords: empirical aesthetics, computational aesthetics, machine learning, image annotation, quantitative image properties, Open Science

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DODA（美学数据集数据库），一个用于美学研究数据集的集中式Web搜索系统，帮助研究者浏览、比较和选择适合其研究需求的美学图像数据集。
AI.motivation: 随着实证与计算美学领域的发展，大型美学图像数据集迅速增多，但这些数据集在标注标准等方面差异巨大，且缺乏集中的开放科学搜索系统。研究者目前通常通过论文或不同平台分享数据集链接，手动搜索图像质量和内容等细节往往需要下载所有数据集，效率低下且繁琐。
AI.method: 作者构建了DODA——一个直观的Web应用，允许研究者浏览美学研究的所有重要数据集。DODA提供这些数据集的通用信息（如大小、分辨率、标注类型、标注者数量等），并为许多数据集预先计算了定量图像属性。文章还讨论了使用DODA选择合适数据集的相关标准，并展示了重用数据集的益处。
AI.result: DODA作为一个集中式搜索平台，能够为研究者提供美学数据集的系统化浏览和比较功能，包括通用元数据和预计算的定量图像属性，促进了实证与计算美学领域之间的合作。
AI.conclusion: DODA通过提供集中化的数据集搜索和管理系统，解决了美学研究领域数据集分散、难以比较的问题，有望促进实证与计算美学领域的开放式协作。

title: Ensemble of Unsupervised Deep Learning for Clustering Imbalanced Tabular Data
summary: Data imbalance poses a major challenge in supervised classification, where the majority-class bias contributes to false negatives and overestimates classification accuracy. Unsupervised deep clustering can be immune to class imbalance because representation learning for clustering is performed without class labels. Deep clustering has been proposed for images, languages, and graphs, while its application to tabular data has only emerged recently. This paper is among the first to examine the performance of state-of-the-art deep clustering methods under varying levels of data imbalance. We introduce two novel cluster ensemble approaches: one aggregates deep clustering assignments across different embedding dimensions, and the other applies majority voting to the best-performing clustering algorithms. Experiments on 16 binary tabular datasets with varying and artificially induced levels of imbalance reveal distinct strengths of different deep clustering methods. On average, our ensemble methods outperform individual clustering methods in ACC, NMI, and ARI scores, offering greater resilience to data imbalance when identifying ground-truth classes without supervision. Therefore, in an imbalanced data scenario, deep clustering can serve as a strong alternative to supervised classification.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了深度聚类方法在不平衡表格数据上的表现，提出了两种新的聚类集成方法（跨嵌入维度聚合和多数投票），在16个二分类表格数据集上验证了集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI指标上优于单一深度聚类方法，并指出深度聚类可成为不平衡场景下监督分类的有力替代方案。
AI.motivation: 数据不平衡在监督分类中会导致多数类偏置、假阴性增加和分类准确率高估等问题，而深度聚类因不依赖类别标签进行表示学习，天然对类别不平衡具有免疫力。本文旨在探究深度聚类方法在不平衡表格数据上的表现，并提升其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出两种聚类集成方法：(1) 在不同嵌入维度上聚合深度聚类的分配结果；(2) 对表现最好的聚类算法进行多数投票。实验在16个二分类表格数据集上进行，通过人工诱导不同程度的不平衡来系统评估多种SOTA深度聚类方法。
AI.result: 实验发现不同深度聚类方法在不同不平衡程度下各有优势；两种集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI指标上平均优于单一聚类方法，对数据不平衡具有更强的韧性，能更好地在无监督条件下识别真实类别。
AI.conclusion: 在不平衡数据场景下，深度聚类（尤其是所提出的集成方法）可以作为监督分类的强有力替代方案，提供了无需标注即可处理类别不平衡问题的新途径。

title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
summary: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard. Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Guard, a constitution-grid instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C-Guard和C-LIM框架，用于解决RL对齐中安全防护训练的两个冲突目标（捕捉真实危害与不拒绝良性提示）之间的数据效率问题。实验发现过拒率从22.4%改善到12.8%，但对抗攻击下的欠拒率反而从0.27恶化到0.33。C-LIM通过逐单元格可学习性评分来指导数据区域的剪枝、加密、修改和扩展，能提前识别无效数据区域（187行无收益数据），并将该区域的学习效能从0.733提升至0.80。
AI.motivation: 在RL对齐中，训练安全防护模型需要同时优化两个冲突目标：捕捉真实危害和不拒绝良性提示。在这种冲突目标下进行数据高效训练非常困难，现有方法无法有效平衡这两个目标，且难以识别和利用训练数据中的无效区域。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) C-Guard，一个基于宪法网格（constitution-grid）的工具，用于生成RL训练数据；(2) C-LIM，一个逐单元格可学习性评分（per-cell learnability score），用于决定每个数据单元格的处理策略：剪枝（prune）、加密（densify）、修改（amend）或扩展（expand）。该评分能在投入训练预算之前识别出无效数据区域。
AI.result: 过拒率从22.4%改善至12.8%，但对抗攻击下的欠拒率从0.27恶化到0.33。C-LIM成功识别出187行零收益的无效数据，并将同一数据区域的学习影响从0.733提升至0.80。
AI.conclusion: C-Guard和C-LIM提供了一种更高效、更智能的冲突目标RL对齐训练方法，能够在训练前识别数据质量并针对性地优化数据区域，代码和宪法已开源。

title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
summary: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个在生产环境中部署的组织级共享记忆系统，该系统将经验捕获作为编码工作平台级的一部分：自动收集任务相关经验（需贡献者批准）、整理为可复用的问答记忆、过滤安全和隐私风险，并为未来的智能体提供检索服务。目前正在评估其对检索和编码任务的实际影响。
AI.motivation: 企业编码智能体依赖工具和检索，但企业知识（内部DSL、专有平台、本地约定、近期修复、隐性工作流）往往不在公开训练数据或正式文档中。现有知识接口依赖智能体主动识别和显式记录经验，导致捕获与编码工作流脱节，开发经验被反复"重新发现"。
AI.method: 该系统通过四个生命周期环节工作：(1) 任务相邻经验收集（需贡献者批准）；(2) 将经验整理为可复用的问答记忆；(3) 对明显安全与隐私风险进行门控；(4) 为未来智能体检索记忆。系统已在生产中持续部署。
AI.result: 论文报告了部署生命周期和操作快照，但检索和编码任务的实际效果仍在评估中。
AI.conclusion: 该系统将经验捕获从智能体的显式行为提升为编码平台的固有功能，有望解决企业知识重复发现的问题，但有效性仍需进一步验证。

title: SmartGR: Hierarchy and Beam-Aware Knowledge Distillation for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for recommender systems. Scaling up GR models can improve recommendation performance, but it also substantially increases inference cost. Knowledge distillation provides a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large GR model to a lightweight one. However, existing distillation methods do not account for two GR-specific challenges: imbalanced distillation difficulty across the semantic ID (SID) hierarchy and incorrect prefix pruning during beam search. To address these challenges, we propose SmartGR, a novel distillation framework that utilizes Hierarchy-Aware SID Distillation to transfer the teacher's modeling capability across the hierarchy and leverages Beam-Aware Ranking Distillation to distill the teacher's ranking preferences during beam search. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of SmartGR, improving the performance by 8.6% while achieving a 2.39$\times$ inference speedup on average.

AI.tldr: SmartGR是一个针对生成式推荐系统的知识蒸馏框架，通过层级感知的SID蒸馏和束搜索感知的排序蒸馏，在提升推荐性能8.6%的同时实现2.39倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐模型（GR）规模扩大虽能提升性能，但带来高昂的推理成本。知识蒸馏虽可用于将大模型知识迁移到轻量模型，但现有方法未解决GR特有的两个挑战：语义ID层级上的蒸馏难度不均衡，以及束搜索过程中错误的前缀剪枝问题。
AI.method: 提出SmartGR蒸馏框架，包含两个核心组件：1) Hierarchy-Aware SID Distillation，将教师的建模能力沿语义ID层级进行传递；2) Beam-Aware Ranking Distillation，在束搜索过程中蒸馏教师的排序偏好。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SmartGR平均提升推荐性能8.6%，同时实现2.39倍的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: SmartGR有效解决了GR场景下知识蒸馏的两大特有挑战，在保持推理效率的同时显著提升推荐性能，验证了层级感知和束搜索感知蒸馏策略的有效性。

title: House-monotone multi-level apportionment has logarithmic quota discrepancy
summary: Multi-level apportionment allocates integer seats through a hierarchy of groups. Schmidt-Kraepelin, Suksompong, and Wijaya proved that, at every fixed house size, lower and upper quota can be satisfied simultaneously; they also constructed house-monotone rules satisfying either quota separately. They left open whether one rule can satisfy lower quota, upper quota, and house monotonicity together, even when quota is required only relative to the root. We give a negative answer. For a full binary comb with $D$ equally entitled leaves, every house-monotone allocation sequence induces a sequence of seat recipients. Quota for the nested comb groups would force every grid-aligned prefix discrepancy to be below one. A midpoint embedding then bounds the full interval discrepancy by this quantity plus $1/2$, contradicting Schmidt's logarithmic lower bound. Conversely, a binary van der Corput seat schedule has comb-prefix error at most $\log D/(3\log 2)+1$. Thus the optimal worst-case error on the comb is $Θ(\log D)$, and for sufficiently large finite $D$ no house-monotone quota rule exists. The proof isolates a static--dynamic gap: each house size admits a quota-feasible allocation, but the feasible allocations cannot be embedded into one monotone path. In quantization language, the result characterizes the order of the embedded-quantization penalty for progressive one-hot rounding on the comb.

AI.tldr: 本文否定回答了多层级分配（multi-level apportionment）中的一个开放问题：不存在单一规则能同时满足下配额、上配额和房屋单调性（house monotonicity）。通过二叉树梳状结构上的分歧分析，证明了最优最坏情况误差为Θ(log D)。
AI.motivation: 此前Schmidt-Kraepelin等人证明在固定房屋规模下可以同时满足下配额和上配额，也能分别构造满足任一配额的房屋单调规则，但尚不清楚是否存在一个规则能同时满足三个性质。作者旨在解决这一开放问题。
AI.method: 采用梳状（comb）结构作为反例。利用中点嵌入（midpoint embedding）技术将网格对齐前缀分歧（grid-aligned prefix discrepancy）与完整区间分歧联系起来，再结合Schmidt的对数下界导出矛盾；同时构造二元的van der Corput席位调度方案证明上界。
AI.result: 证明了对D个等权叶子的满二叉树梳状结构，不存在同时满足下配额、上配额和房屋单调性的规则；梳状结构上的最优最坏情况误差为Θ(log D)；并将结果表述为静态-动态差距（static-dynamic gap）以及嵌入式量化惩罚的阶。
AI.conclusion: 该论文给出了否定的答案，揭示了静态可行性（每个房屋规模存在可行分配）与动态一致性（可行分配无法嵌入单一单调路径）之间的本质鸿沟，并与量化理论建立了联系。

title: Less Is More: Tuning Configurable Systems with Imperfect Fidelity
comment: Accepted by the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary: Configuration tuning is essential for optimizing the performance of highly configurable systems, e.g., throughput or runtime, under a given environment. Yet, this is a challenging process as there can be many options to tune, and configuration measurement is often highly expensive. In this paper, we demonstrate the phenomenon of ``less can be more'': system configuration tuning can be greatly improved with much superior budget utilization by partially tuning under the imperfect-fidelity---an environment that is similar, but cheaper to measure, compared with the concerned perfect-fidelity of environment under which the system should be tuned. We codify a conceptual framework of fidelity for configurable systems, drawing on which allows us to propose MFTune, a tuner that proactively explores in the space of $>10^4$ possible imperfect-fidelity settings to approximate a useful one, which strikes for the wideness of tuning. This creates high-quality seeds for the perfect-fidelity, which in turn ensures the tuning depth.
