Experiment results against $10$ state-of-the-art tuners, obtained from running diverse real-world systems for $19$ months $24 \times 7$, show that MFTune performs considerably better on $83.33$\% cases with up to $19.34\%$ improvement while achieving hours of budget saving in general.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFTune，一种基于"不完美保真度"（imperfect-fidelity）环境的系统配置调优方法。核心观点是"少即是多"：在相似但测量成本更低的环境下进行部分调优，比直接在完美保真度环境下调优能更有效地利用预算。MFTune在10^4个可能的保真度设置中主动探索，找到合适的近似环境来生成高质量种子，再在完美保真度下进行深度调优。实验对比10个最先进调优器，在83.33%的情况下表现更优，最高提升19.34%，并节省数小时预算。
AI.motivation: 高度可配置系统的调优极其困难：配置选项多、测量成本高昂。传统方法直接在目标环境（完美保真度）下调优，预算消耗巨大。作者观察到"不完美但便宜"的环境可能带来更好的预算利用效率，但缺乏系统性框架来理解和利用这一现象。
AI.method: 1) 提出配置系统"保真度"（fidelity）的概念框架，将测量环境的质量与成本形式化。2) 提出MFTune调优器：在超过10^4个候选不完美保真度设置中主动探索，寻找"宽度的调优"（广泛搜索）的近似环境，生成高质量种子，再在完美保真度下进行"深度的调优"（精细优化）。
AI.result: 在19个月24×7的持续实验中，测试多种真实世界系统，对比10个最先进的调优器。MFTune在83.33%的情况下表现更好，性能提升最高达19.34%，并普遍节省了数小时的调优预算。
AI.conclusion: "少即是多"在配置调优中成立：使用不完美但便宜的环境进行探索性调优，再结合完美保真度的精细调优，是一种更优的策略。MFTune验证了这一思路的有效性，为配置调优领域提供了一种新的范式。

title: Video Models as Native 4D Renderers: World-Grounded Conditioning from Animated Mesh
summary: Pretrained video diffusion models can act as renderers when the desired scene state is already specified by an animated mesh, a camera trajectory, and a reference image. This 4D generative rendering setting raises a representation question: what image-format condition lets a video backbone obey both camera motion and scene-internal animation? We propose DAR, a reference-guided renderer that extends Wan2.2 camera control from Plücker rays alone to a joint camera-plus-geometry interface. DAR projects a neural 4D G-buffer (tracking, world position, and normal) from the animated mesh and injects it through a widened control adapter while preserving the pretrained image-to-video prior. The central design choice is the pair of tracking and world position. Tracking identifies the persistent surface element that should carry appearance; world position gives its current scene-coordinate state; normal supplies local shape. Depth plus calibrated rays can recover 3D in principle, but depth is a camera-dependent chart in which camera and object motion are mixed. On the 68-case DAR-4D benchmark, LoRA DAR reaches PSNR 23.22, SSIM 0.895, and LPIPS 0.134, improving over off-the-shelf Wan2.2-Depth by 1.54 dB PSNR; a full fine-tune reaches PSNR 25.36 and SSIM 0.917. Matched ablations show that replacing world position by depth reduces PSNR by 1.26--1.55 dB at every checkpoint, supporting tracking+world-position correspondence as a practical 4D rendering condition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAR，一种参考引导的4D生成渲染器，通过将跟踪（tracking）、世界位置（world position）和法线（normal）组成的神经4D G-buffer投影到动画网格上，并注入到扩展的控制适配器中，扩展了Wan2.2的相机控制能力，使其能够同时遵循相机运动和场景内部动画。在DAR-4D基准上，LoRA DAR达到PSNR 23.22，全微调达到25.36。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频扩散模型在给定动画网格、相机轨迹和参考图像时可以作为渲染器使用。这种4D生成渲染设置面临一个表征问题：什么样的图像格式条件能让视频骨干网络同时遵循相机运动和场景内部动画。深度图虽能恢复3D，但它是依赖相机的图表，相机运动和物体运动在其中是混合的，需要更好的表征方案。
AI.method: DAR将Wan2.2的Plücker射线相机控制扩展为联合相机加几何接口。具体做法是：从动画网格投影出神经4D G-buffer（包含跟踪、世界位置和法线三个通道），通过加宽的控制适配器注入网络，同时保留预训练的图像到视频先验。核心设计选择是跟踪与世界位置的配对：跟踪用于识别应携带外观的持久表面元素，世界位置给出其在场景坐标中的当前状态，法线提供局部形状信息。
AI.result: 在68个案例的DAR-4D基准上，LoRA DAR达到PSNR 23.22、SSIM 0.895、LPIPS 0.134，较现成的Wan2.2-Depth提升1.54 dB PSNR；全微调版本达到PSNR 25.36、SSIM 0.917。对齐消融实验显示，用深度替换世界位置在每个检查点都会使PSNR降低1.26-1.55 dB，验证了跟踪+世界位置对应作为4D渲染条件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 跟踪加世界位置的对应关系是实用的4D渲染条件，相较于深度图能够更有效地解耦相机运动与物体内部动画，为参考引导的4D生成渲染提供了更好的表征方案。

title: Modeling Unknown Nonlocal PDE Systems via Flow Map Learning
summary: Nonlocal partial differential equations arise in many applications but are often difficult to model and learn because of the presence of nonlocal operators. We present a flow-map learning (FML) framework for modeling unknown nonlocal PDEs directly from solution data. Rather than learning or approximating the underlying nonlocal operators, the proposed approach learns the finite-time evolution operator in either modal or nodal space. Two complementary formulations are developed for spectral and grid-based solution representations. Numerical experiments on one- and two-dimensional fractional diffusion and wave equations demonstrate accurate and stable long-time prediction using only short observation windows. The proposed approach provides an effective data-driven framework for learning unknown nonlocal dynamics without explicit evaluation of nonlocal operators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种流映射学习（FML）框架，用于直接从解数据中建模未知的非局部偏微分方程。该方法不学习或逼近底层的非局部算子，而是学习有限时间演化算子，并在谱空间或节点空间中实现。在二维分数阶扩散和波动方程上验证了该方法仅需短观察窗口即可实现准确且稳定的长时间预测。
AI.motivation: 非局部偏微分方程在许多应用中频繁出现，但由于非局部算子的存在，它们往往难以建模和学习。现有的方法通常试图直接学习或近似非局部算子，这在实际中可能非常困难，因此需要一种更有效的数据驱动建模方法。
AI.method: 提出的FML框架绕开对非局部算子的直接学习/逼近，改为学习有限时间演化算子。方法提供了两种互补的公式化方案，分别针对谱表示和网格表示的解，在模态空间或节点空间中执行学习。
AI.result: 在一维和二维的分数阶扩散方程及波动方程上的数值实验表明，该方法仅使用短的观察窗口就能实现准确且稳定的长时间预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为非局部未知动力学提供了一种有效的数据驱动学习方法，无需显式评估非局部算子即可完成建模与预测。

title: Averaging Bias: Human Faithfulness Annotations are not Locally Faithful
summary: Evaluation of faithfulness of text summarization treats a model generated summary as faithful only if every of its sentences is supported by the source document: a strict conjunctive rule under which a single unsupported sentence makes the whole summary unfaithful. Yet most faithfulness benchmarks collect only one global human annotation label per summary. We ask whether such global human labels actually implement the conjunctive rule. We hypothesize that annotators may accept a summary as faithful when most sentences are faithful, not only when all are faithful. To test our hypothesis, we use five large language model (LLM) judges as per-sentence raters across four widely used faithfulness benchmarks. We find that global human labels correlate better with the average of per-sentence LLM judgments than with the implementation of the strict conjunctive rule. A manual review confirms that a substantial fraction of summaries labeled faithful by humans contain genuine local factual errors. We call this tendency Averaging Bias. Our results reveal that human labels on widely used faithfulness benchmarks contain measurable Averaging Bias, calling for carefully structured designs for trustworthy human annotations

AI.tldr: 本文发现广泛使用的文本摘要忠实度基准中的人类标注存在"平均化偏差"（Averaging Bias）：人类标注者在判断摘要是否忠实于源文档时，更倾向于基于大多数句子的忠实度来整体判断，而非严格遵循"所有句子都必须忠实"的合取规则。通过五个LLM裁判对四个基准数据集进行逐句评估，发现人类全局标签与逐句LLM判断的平均值相关性更高，且人工复核确认大量被标注为"忠实"的摘要确实包含局部事实错误。
AI.motivation: 现有文本摘要忠实度评估在理论上采用严格的合取规则（所有句子都必须被源文档支持才判定为忠实），但大多数基准数据集仅收集一个全局人工标注标签。作者质疑这种全局标签是否真正实现了合取规则，怀疑人类标注者在实践中可能采用更宽松的"多数句子忠实即可"的判断标准。
AI.method: 使用五个大语言模型（LLM）作为逐句评分器，对四个广泛使用的忠实度基准数据集进行逐句忠实度评估。然后将全局人类标注与两种聚合方式进行比较：(1) 严格合取规则的实现（所有句子都忠实才算忠实）；(2) 逐句LLM判断的平均值。并通过人工复核验证被标注为忠实但包含局部事实错误的摘要。
AI.result: 研究发现全局人类标签与逐句LLM判断的平均值相关性高于与严格合取规则实现的相关性。人工复核确认相当比例被人类标注为"忠实"的摘要实际上包含真实的局部事实错误，证实了平均化偏差的存在。
AI.conclusion: 人类在广泛使用的忠实度基准上的标注包含可测量的平均化偏差，这提示需要精心设计结构化的标注方案以获取可信赖的人工标注，而非依赖单一的全局判断标签。

title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentStream统一框架，用于在真实流式任务场景下评估自演化LLM智能体，通过构建可配置任务流并实例化Isolated、Sequential和Interleaved三种流式场景，组合评估5种自演化方法和3个前沿基础模型，揭示了自演化可靠性随流式场景变化、收益受模型能力门控且与模型强度非单调关系等关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有的自演化LLM智能体研究主要采用独立评估方式，忽略了真实流式场景中智能体需要适应多样化复杂任务流的现实情况，导致对自演化智能体在实际应用中的行为缺乏理解。
AI.method: 提出AgentStream框架：将智能体基准测试组织为可配置的任务流，在测试时实例化Isolated、Sequential和Interleaved三种流式场景，场景在范围和领域组成上逐步变化；对5种代表性自演化方法在3个前沿基础模型上进行组合评估，解耦模型能力、方法架构和流式场景对自演化的共同影响。
AI.result: 发现自演化可靠性在不同流式场景下表现不同；自演化的收益受模型能力门控且与模型强度呈非单调关系；没有单一方法能在所有模型和场景下占优。
AI.conclusion: 自演化智能体应在真实任务流而非隔离的单任务设置下进行评估，研究结果为跨模型和流式场景选择自演化方法提供了具体指导。

title: Douyin Multimodal Embedding Model Technical Report
summary: Multimodal representation learning is a cornerstone of modern AI. By encoding multimodal queries and targets into vectors, it powers industrial search and recommendation and underpins modern agents. Real-world platforms with complex modalities and massive-scale content, such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube, demand both efficiency under billion-scale indexing and fine-grained discrimination for hard matching. Existing MLLM embedding models rarely satisfy both. Contrastive models are efficient but rely on pair-level supervision too coarse for fine-grained distinctions, while CoT-based models improve discrimination through explicit generation impractical to serve online. We present Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME), a model trained in two stages to combine both strengths. Stage 1 performs large-scale contrastive pre-training that establishes a unified multimodal embedding space with broad modality and task coverage. Stage 2 supplements semantic sufficiency, the property that an embedding is grounded in retrieval-relevant evidence and preserves fine-grained counterpart-side semantics, via two mechanisms. Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning organizes retrieval evidence through hidden-space latent reasoning, and Cross-Conditional Reconstruction enforces counterpart-side semantics through cross-directional autoregressive reconstruction. Both act only during training and add only marginal query-side overhead, so DME serves as efficiently as a standard contrastive encoder. On MMEB-v2, DME reaches state-of-the-art results at comparable scales for its 2B and 9B variants (74.8 and 78.4), with especially strong video and visual-document tasks. In production, DME delivers a 2.92% relative gain on Douyin's in-house offline evaluation set, is deployed across Douyin scenarios such as generative, image, and AI search, and yields a 0.1% Lifetime (LT) gain in online A/B testing on Douyin search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了抖音多模态嵌入模型（DME），通过两阶段训练同时实现大规模索引下的高效检索和细粒度判别能力。第一阶段进行大规模对比预训练建立统一嵌入空间，第二阶段通过证据引导的隐式类型潜在推理和跨条件重建两种机制补充语义充分性。DME在MMEB-v2上达到SOTA（2B和9B版本分别74.8和78.4），并在抖音生产环境中带来显著在线收益。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型难以同时满足两个关键需求：对比学习方法效率高但依赖粗粒度的pair级监督，难以处理细粒度硬匹配；CoT方法通过显式生成提升判别力但推理开销大，无法在线服务。真实工业平台（如抖音、小红书、YouTube）需要在十亿级索引下兼顾效率和精细判别。
AI.method: DME采用两阶段训练策略：Stage 1进行大规模对比预训练，建立覆盖广泛模态和任务的统一多模态嵌入空间；Stage 2引入两种训练时机制补充语义充分性——(1) Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning，通过在隐藏空间中进行潜在推理来组织检索证据；(2) Cross-Conditional Reconstruction，通过跨方向自回归重建来强制执行对端语义。两种机制仅在训练时生效，推理时只增加极轻微的query端开销。
AI.result: 在MMEB-v2基准上，DME 2B和9B变体分别达到74.8和78.4的SOTA成绩，尤其在视频和视觉文档任务上表现突出。在生产环境中，DME在抖音内部离线评估集上获得2.92%的相对提升，已部署于生成式、图像和AI搜索等场景，在线A/B测试显示抖音搜索0.1%的Lifetime（LT）收益。
AI.conclusion: DME通过两阶段训练策略成功融合了对比学习的高效性和潜在推理的细粒度判别能力，证明了在不牺牲在线服务效率的前提下可以显著提升多模态嵌入的质量。该工作为大规模工业级多模态检索提供了一个实用且有效的解决方案。

title: Turning Interaction History into Execution State: A Runtime Layer for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents accumulate hundreds of actions and observations in their trajectories, yet nothing in this record indicates which observations still describe the repository as it currently stands. Before every decision, the model must implicitly infer the execution status from raw history, and when this inference falls short, the agent acts on outdated file contents or re-executes work whose results are still valid. We propose Ledger, a deterministic runtime layer that distills an agent's completed interactions into an explicit execution state: what has been observed, what has been modified, and what has been attempted. Ledger keeps this state in an online execution ledger and applies it at two boundaries of every step. Before the model acts, an inform path appends a compact runtime state view to the prompt; before a proposed command runs, a govern path checks it against the ledger, returning still-valid earlier results in place of re-execution and flagging likely-redundant repetition. The layer adds no language-model calls and wraps an otherwise unmodified agent. Across all 500 SWE-bench Verified instances, Ledger raises Pass@1 from 56.2% to 64.2% with GPT-5 mini and from 75.8% to 81.0% with MiniMax M2.5, while cutting total cost by 28.9% and 31.8%. Attached to OpenAI Codex, it adds 3.4 percentage points of Pass@1 at 24.4% lower cost. Ablations attribute most of the resolution gain to govern and most of the efficiency gain to inform, with their combination performing best. What long-horizon agents lack, we conclude, is not a shorter view of their history but an explicit account of their own execution state.

AI.tldr: Ledger是一个确定性运行时层，为长时程编码智能体维护显式的执行状态账本（已观察、已修改、已尝试），在模型行动前通过inform路径注入简洁状态视图，在命令执行前通过govern路径检查并复用仍有效的早期结果。在SWE-bench Verified上，Ledger将GPT-5 mini的Pass@1从56.2%提升至64.2%，将MiniMax M2.5从75.8%提升至81.0%，同时分别降低28.9%和31.8%的总成本，且不增加任何语言模型调用。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体在执行数百个动作后，轨迹中没有任何记录能表明哪些观察仍准确描述当前仓库状态。模型必须从原始历史中隐式推断执行状态，当推断失败时会基于过时文件内容行动或重复执行仍有效的工作。
AI.method: Ledger是一个确定性运行时层，包含两个核心组件：(1) inform路径——在模型行动前将紧凑的运行时状态视图附加到提示中；(2) govern路径——在命令执行前对照账本进行检查，返回仍有效的早期结果以避免重复执行，并标记可能冗余的操作。该层不增加任何语言模型调用，直接包裹未修改的智能体。
AI.result: 在全部500个SWE-bench Verified实例上：GPT-5 mini的Pass@1从56.2%提升至64.2%（+8.0%），MiniMax M2.5从75.8%提升至81.0%（+5.2%），总成本分别降低28.9%和31.8%。在OpenAI Codex上增加3.4个百分点Pass@1，成本降低24.4%。消融实验表明govern贡献大部分正确率提升，inform贡献大部分效率提升，两者组合效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 长时程智能体缺乏的不是更短的视角，而是对自身执行状态的显式账户。通过确定性的执行账本而非依赖模型的隐式推断，可以显著提升正确率与效率。

title: Logographic Character Visual Pretraining via Semantic-based Contrastive Learning
summary: Current deep learning-based character vision studies, e.g., text recognition, character image denoising, and historical text completion, are offering new solutions for learning, managing, and utilizing character resources. However, the performance of these studies peaks only with large and balanced datasets, which is a rarity with real-world character datasets, especially for logographic character languages, e.g., Chinese. The imbalance in data distribution of logographic characters is a common issue due to differences in character usage frequency and new characters being continuously created. In this paper, we propose a novel method for logographic character recognition, which introduces a multi-modal learning approach using visual semantics and contextual semantics of characters. A novel pre-training strategy is designed to enhance deep visual representations, especially for datasets suffering from issues of imbalanced and rare instances, by extracting the contextual semantics of each character from the corresponding language models. We conduct experiments across various datasets to evaluate our character recognition method and further validate the contrastive pre-training strategy by several downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多模态学习的表意文字识别方法，通过结合字符的视觉语义和上下文语义（从语言模型中提取），并设计新颖的对比预训练策略，来解决真实世界表意文字数据集（如中文）中普遍存在的数据不平衡和稀有样本问题，实验证明该方法优于现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 深度学习字符视觉研究（如文字识别、字符图像去噪、历史文本补全）性能依赖于大规模且平衡的数据集，但真实世界中的表意文字（如中文）数据集常存在数据不平衡问题，这是因为字符使用频率差异大且新字符不断产生。这种不平衡和稀有样本分布严重制约了现有方法的性能。
AI.method: 提出一种多模态学习的表意文字识别方法，融合字符的视觉语义和上下文语义。具体包括：(1) 从对应语言模型中提取每个字符的上下文语义；(2) 设计一种新颖的对比预训练策略，通过上下文语义增强深度视觉表征，特别针对数据不平衡和稀有实例的问题。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上进行了广泛的实验来评估所提出的字符识别方法，并通过多个下游任务验证了对比预训练策略的有效性。实验结果表明，该方法相比最先进的现有方法具有优越性。
AI.conclusion: 多模态学习方法（视觉+上下文语义）结合对比预训练策略，能够有效缓解表意文字数据集中的不平衡问题，提升稀有字符的识别性能，为表意文字识别提供了一种新的解决方案。

title: DSETA: A Dual-Stage Continual Learning Framework for Travel Time Prediction in Dynamic Traffic Environments
summary: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is a core component of intelligent transportation systems. As traffic congestion patterns become increasingly dynamic in large cities, maintaining high prediction accuracy poses a major challenge for ride-hailing platforms. Existing methods either fail to adapt to irregular traffic patterns and sudden congestion, or suffer from new distributions without disentangling long-term trends from short-term fluctuations, thereby degrading model performance in real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose DSETA, an incrementally updated Dual-Stage ETA prediction framework. Specifically, the continual learning process is divided into \textit{inter-day} and \textit{intra-day} stages. We first design the \textit{intra-day} learning stage, which relies entirely on real-time data to enable dynamic adaptation to short-term traffic patterns caused by events like holidays or accidents. Next, we develop the \textit{inter-day} learning stage, which leverages aggregated historical data from a short time window to capture knowledge of long-term distribution shifts, such as seasonal trends and traffic network evolution. Subsequently, to prevent catastrophic forgetting and preserve knowledge of regular patterns, we explore a \textit{Historical Traffic Knowledge Consolidation} module. Finally, we validate DSETA's effectiveness and robustness through extensive offline and online experiments conducted on real-world datasets from DiDi's platform. Online A/B tests across three major cities including Beijing, Wuhan, and Xi'an consistently demonstrated performance gains, achieving MAE reductions of 6.62\%, 0.73\%, and 2.40\% respectively. This framework has been successfully deployed in DiDi's production environment, processing hundreds of millions of daily requests and validating its strong performance in industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DSETA，一个增量更新的双阶段ETA（预计到达时间）预测框架。它将持续学习过程分为日内和日间两个阶段：日内阶段依赖实时数据适应短期交通波动（如节假日、事故），日间阶段利用短时间窗口的聚合历史数据捕捉长期分布偏移（如季节趋势和路网演变）。此外还设计了历史交通知识巩固模块以防止灾难性遗忘。在滴滴真实数据集上的离线与在线实验中，DSETA在北京、武汉、西安三个城市分别实现了6.62%、0.73%和2.40%的MAE降低，并已成功部署于生产环境。
AI.motivation: 现有ETA预测方法难以适应大城市中日益动态化的交通拥堵模式：要么无法应对不规则的交通模式和突发拥堵，要么在面临新分布时无法解耦长期趋势与短期波动，导致真实场景中模型性能退化。
AI.method: 提出DSETA框架，将持续学习分为两个阶段：(1) 日内学习阶段，完全依赖实时数据动态适应短期交通模式；(2) 日间学习阶段，利用短时间窗口的聚合历史数据学习长期分布偏移。同时设计历史交通知识巩固模块防止灾难性遗忘，保留常规交通模式的知识。
AI.result: 在滴滴真实数据集上进行大量离线和在线实验。在线A/B测试覆盖北京、武汉、西安三个城市，MAE分别降低6.62%、0.73%和2.40%。框架已在滴滴生产环境部署，每日处理数亿级请求。
AI.conclusion: DSETA通过双阶段增量学习机制有效解耦了短期波动与长期偏移，兼顾动态适应性与知识保持，在工业大规模场景中验证了其有效性和鲁棒性，具有实际生产部署价值。

title: Bridging the English-Arabic Medical Knowledge Gap: Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation via Causal Layer Selection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly in English medical tasks but degrade substantially in Arabic, a gap widely attributed to limited training data. We systematically investigate this assumption via tuned lens probing and causal activation patching, and find that Arabic medical knowledge is present in intermediate model representations but fails to surface at the output. This mechanistic insight motivates a targeted adaptation strategy: rather than fine-tuning the full network, we propose Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation (TLoRA), restricted to the layer window where cross-lingual representations diverge, upstream of the output layers where the failure manifests. We evaluate TLoRA on multiple-choice medical QA, where our approach outperforms full-network LoRA, zero-shot, and few-shot baselines. We further evaluate it on short-answer generation and multi-turn clinical dialogue, where it performs competitively without the need for task-specific finetuning. We additionally introduce AraClinicDialog, a clinician-constructed Arabic medical dialogue benchmark in MSA with validated variants across four Arabic dialects. Together, these contributions demonstrate that mechanistic diagnosis can serve as a practical guide for targeted adaptation in underrepresented-language medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制性分析（tuned lens探测和因果激活修补）发现阿拉伯语医学知识其实存在于LLM的中间层表征中，但无法在输出层浮现。基于此发现，作者提出TLoRA（Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation），仅在跨语言表征分叉的层窗口进行低秩适配，在多项选择医学问答上优于全网络LoRA及零样本/少样本基线，并在短答案生成和多轮临床对话上表现良好。同时引入AraClinicDialog阿拉伯语医学对话基准。
AI.motivation: LLM在英语医学任务上表现优异，但在阿拉伯语上性能显著下降，以往归因于训练数据不足。作者希望系统性地验证这一假设是否成立，并探索是否存在更精确、更高效的适配策略。
AI.method: 1) 使用tuned lens探测和因果激活修补进行机制分析，定位跨语言表征分叉的层窗口；2) 提出TLoRA，仅在该分叉层窗口进行低秩适配，而非全网络微调；3) 在多项选择医学QA、短答案生成和多轮临床对话上进行评估。
AI.result: TLoRA在多项选择医学QA上超越全网络LoRA、零样本和少样本基线；在短答案生成和多轮临床对话任务上无需任务特定微调即可达到竞争性表现；并构建了AraClinicDialog基准（含MSA及四种方言变体）。
AI.conclusion: 机制诊断（mechanistic diagnosis）可以作为低资源语言医学LLM针对性适配的实用指导，表明问题并非知识缺失而是知识表达与输出的断层，可通过精确的局部适配高效解决。

title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding
summary: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.

AI.tldr: TRACE-TS 是一个用于可穿戴时间序列数据的可追溯推理框架，通过专家分类器的属性归因来识别关键时空传感器区域，构建具有显式证据来源的 DAG 推理轨迹，并训练紧凑语言模型通过门控交叉注意力生成这些轨迹。在七个可穿戴基准上取得了最佳平均准确率和 F1 分数。
AI.motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器分析方法大多将信号简化为活动标签，而近期基于 LM 的方法虽能生成自然语言解释，但其推理与底层信号关联薄弱，导致解释流畅但不可验证。
AI.method: 1) 使用专家分类器的属性归因识别显著时空传感器区域；2) 构建带有显式证据来源的 DAG 推理轨迹；3) 训练紧凑语言模型通过门控交叉注意力在传感器记忆 token 上生成这些轨迹；4) 推理时联合输出活动预测和推理轨迹，无需属性计算或教师指导。同时引入 SNM（Semantic Node Match）指标，作为 LLM 评判来诊断观察、推理和综合层面的推理保真度。
AI.result: 在七个可穿戴基准上，TRACE-TS 在所有评估方法中取得最佳平均准确率（84.43%）和 F1 分数（81.24%），比最优 LLM 基线在 F1 上高出 17.96%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-TS 通过将推理显式锚定在传感器信号的归因证据上，实现了可验证且高保真的可穿戴时间序列推理，超越了现有基于 LLM 的解释方法。

title: Disentangled Contrastive Learning for Zero-Shot Multilingual Dense Retrieval
summary: Multilingual dense retrieval aims to handle queries and documents across different languages based on a unified retriever model. The challenge lies in enabling robust retrieval transfer to low-resource languages where annotated retrieval data is often scarce. Although previous studies transfer high-resource supervision to low-resource languages in multilingual semantic representation learning, the shared representation often entangles semantic and linguistic features, which may interfere with optimizing semantic relevance for retrieval. Different from existing methods that focus on learning language-agnostic semantic features under such entanglement, we propose a disentangled contrastive learning~(DCL) method for multilingual dense retrieval by separating multilingual representations into semantic and linguistic subspaces. Specifically, we design disentangled optimization objectives based on hierarchical semantic alignment and language debiasing contrastive learning. By aligning retrieval-relevant semantics across languages at both sentence and token levels while capturing language-specific variations in the linguistic subspace, these objectives reduce language-induced interference in semantic matching. We jointly optimize them with the retrieval objective to facilitate stable zero-shot transfer from English supervision to multilingual dense retrieval. Extensive experiments on mMARCO and MIRACL show that our method consistently outperforms several strong baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalization ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于多语言稠密检索的解耦对比学习方法（DCL），通过将多语言表示分离为语义子空间和语言子空间，分别进行层级语义对齐和语言去偏对比学习，从而减少语言特征对语义匹配的干扰，实现了从英语监督到多语言的稳定零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 多语言稠密检索中，低资源语言缺乏标注数据，以往研究通过将高资源语言的监督迁移到低资源语言，但共享表示常常混淆了语义特征和语言特征，这会干扰语义相关性的优化。现有方法专注于在这种纠缠下学习语言无关的语义特征，但效果有限，因此需要从根本上解耦语义和语言信息。
AI.method: 提出解耦对比学习（DCL）方法，将多语言表示拆分为语义子空间和语言子空间。设计两个解耦优化目标：（1）层级语义对齐，在句子级和词元级对齐跨语言的检索相关语义；（2）语言去偏对比学习，捕获语言特定变化到语言子空间。与检索目标联合优化，实现从英语监督到多语言检索的稳定零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在mMARCO和MIRACL基准上进行大量实验，该方法在多个强基线方法上表现出一致的性能提升，验证了其有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦语义与语言特征，DCL方法能够有效减少语言特征对语义匹配的干扰，显著提升了多语言稠密检索在零样本跨语言迁移场景下的性能，并在多种语言和数据集上展现了良好的泛化能力。

title: Passing Coarse Marginal Checks Can Be Cheap: Persona Mixtures and Imprecise Treatment-Response Estimates in an LLM Persona Panel
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Project site: https://yoheinakajima.github.io/synthetic-players/ ; code, data, registrations, review record, and zero-call replay capsule: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/synthetic-players
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic research participants and are often validated by whether their marginal responses resemble human data. We study a fixed panel of sixteen lightweight persona-conditioned GPT-4.1 configurations in repeated strategic games. The panel met preregistered broad-reference condition-mean criteria in three of four repeated-game cells; the sole miss was 0.011 below the lower reference bound. Variation was strongly prompt-indexed, but its share depended on uncertainty assumptions: fixed-panel symmetric-Dirichlet sensitivities produced median between-prompt shares of 63%-71% under Jeffreys alpha=0.5 and 47%-53% under alpha=1, while finite-opportunity plug-in estimates were 85%-96%. Aggregate continuation-probability contrasts were +0.083 and +0.078, with conservative simultaneous 95% intervals [-0.171, +0.330] and [-0.181, +0.330]. The treatment jointly changed the continuation process and its textual representation. A separate wording-and-position operation shifted cooperation from 0/40 to 37/40 in the bare configuration, and a label conflict also revealed representation control. The original persona-level p13 result was not prospectively family-controlled, while a post-adjudication exact gate was structurally underpowered; p13 is therefore a replication target rather than a finding. External review exposed family-error, dependence, construct, and boundary-uncertainty defects, and zero-call reanalysis changed the interpretation without rewriting the historical record. The registered marginal criteria could be passed without precisely estimating the treatment-response object. A public capsule verifies 4,916 confirmatory Phase 3-5 runs with no live model calls. The results concern one fixed model-prompt panel and do not establish human substitutability.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了由16个轻量级人格条件化GPT-4.1配置组成的固定面板在重复策略博弈中的表现。面板在四个重复博弈单元中有三个通过了预先注册的宽泛参考条件均值标准，唯一未通过者仅低于参考下限0.011。研究揭示了提示索引引起的强烈变异，但变异份额取决于不确定性假设。处理效应在继续概率上表现为+0.083和+0.078的正向对比，但置信区间较宽。研究还发现措辞和位置操作能显著改变合作行为（从0/40到37/40）。原始p13结果因缺乏前瞻性族控制被视为复制目标而非发现。外部审查暴露了族错误、依赖、构念和边界不确定性等缺陷。零调用重分析改变了解释但未改写历史记录。公共验证胶囊确认了4,916次第3-5阶段确认性运行且无实时模型调用。研究结果仅限于一个固定的模型-提示面板，不能证明人类可替代性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型被越来越多地用作合成研究参与者，通常通过其边际响应是否与人类数据相似来验证其有效性。本研究旨在严格检验一组轻量级人格条件化GPT-4.1配置在重复策略博弈中的行为是否符合预先注册的人类参考标准，并对之前报告的p13结果进行审慎的复制性评估。
AI.method: 采用固定面板设计，包含16个人格条件化的GPT-4.1配置，在重复策略博弈中进行测试。使用预先注册的宽泛参考条件均值标准进行验证，评估提示索引对结果变异的影响（通过对称Dirichlet敏感性和有限机会插件估计），计算处理效应的继续概率对比及保守同时置信区间，并进行了措辞-位置操作实验和外部审查后的零调用重分析。
AI.result: 面板在三个重复博弈单元中通过预注册标准（唯一未通过者低于参考下限0.011）。提示索引的变异份额在固定面板对称Dirichlet敏感性下为47%-71%（取决于alpha参数），在有限机会插件估计下为85%-96%。处理在继续概率上的对比为+0.083和+0.078，同时改变了继续过程和其文本表示。措辞-位置操作将合作从0/40提升至37/40。原始p13结果未被族控制，后裁定精确门槛结构性功效不足，因此视为复制目标。
AI.conclusion: 预注册的边际标准可以被通过，但这不等同于精确估计处理响应对象。外部审查和零调用重分析揭示了研究设计中的族错误、依赖、构念和边界不确定性等缺陷。该研究结果仅限于一个固定的模型-提示面板，不能推广为人类可替代性的证据。研究强调了对LLM作为合成参与者进行更严格验证方法的需求。

title: Structure-Aware Semantic Chunking with Title-Chain Prefixes: A 1600-Query Evaluation and the Measurement Trap in Text-Transform Ablations
summary: Chunking is the first and most consequential step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): every downstream retrieval decision inherits the chunk boundaries. We present a three-stage, chunk-side-only semantic chunking pipeline---header-split, semantic merge, and title-chain prefixing---that costs zero additional LLM calls: the title chain reuses the document's own header hierarchy instead of a generated summary. On a 1600-query stratified evaluation over a production Markdown knowledge base, the pipeline improves MRR@5 from 0.374 to 0.463 (+23.8%) on the full set and from 0.828 to 0.925 (+11.7%) on the answerable subset (n=563), with dual-annotator Cohen's kappa 0.45 (unweighted, 16,000 score pairs). We then report what we tried and what failed: three query-side or architecture-level follow-ups are design dead ends (unevaluated---no comparable run artifacts), one measured failure (prefix weight decay), and one protocol-level failure that is the paper's central methodological finding. In a same-pool prefix on/off ablation, dual-annotator agreement collapsed from kappa 0.45 to 0.04 under identical prompts---stripping the title-chain context strips the disambiguation signal annotators need to agree on relevance. This measurement trap invalidates a common evaluation practice in chunking research and motivates retrieval-time per-candidate prefix evaluation, the direction we recommend from all our evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三段式、仅作用于块侧的语义分块流水线（标题分割、语义合并、标题链前缀），零额外LLM调用，通过复用文档自身的标题层级而非生成摘要来构建标题链。在1600查询的生产Markdown知识库评估中，MRR@5从0.374提升至0.463（+23.8%），可回答子集上从0.828提升至0.925（+11.7%）。论文同时报告了失败的尝试，并揭示了一个关键方法论发现：在相同池的前缀开/关消融中，双标注者一致性从kappa 0.45骤降至0.04，表明标题链上下文是标注者达成相关性共识所需的消歧信号，这一测量陷阱使分块研究中常见的评估实践失效。
AI.motivation: 分块是RAG系统中第一个且影响最深远的步骤，所有下游检索决策都继承了块边界。现有语义分块方法通常依赖额外LLM调用生成摘要来提供上下文，成本高昂。作者希望设计一种零额外LLM调用的语义分块方案，同时揭示分块评估中潜在的测量陷阱。
AI.method: 提出三阶段块侧语义分块流水线：(1) header-split：按文档标题层级分割；(2) semantic merge：语义合并相关片段；(3) title-chain prefixing：将文档自身的标题层级链作为前缀注入每个块，替代生成的摘要。整个流水线零额外LLM调用。此外通过系统性的失败报告，记录了无效尝试和关键的方法论消融实验。
AI.result: 在1600查询的评估中，MRR@5从0.374提升到0.463（+23.8%）；可回答子集（n=563）从0.828提升到0.925（+11.7%）。双标注者Cohen's kappa为0.45（16,000评分对）。一个关键发现是前缀开/关消融实验中，kappa从0.45骤降至0.04，证明标题链上下文是标注者一致性不可或缺的消歧信号。
AI.conclusion: 标题链复用文档自身层级结构是一种高效且有效的语义分块策略。更重要的方法论结论是：传统"prefix on/off"消融评估方式存在致命缺陷——剥离标题链上下文会导致标注者无法就相关性达成一致，建议采用检索时逐候选前缀评估的方向。

title: SPARC-Rad: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Pipeline for Spatial and Anatomical Reasoning in Radiology Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for medical imaging, but many available benchmarks emphasize disease classification, report generation, or broad visual question answering rather than the spatial and anatomical reasoning required for radiology. We developed the Spatial Perception and Anatomical Reasoning in Clinical Radiology (SPARC-Rad) Benchmark, a manually curated multimodal benchmark dataset and evaluation pipeline for assessing these capabilities in radiology VLMs. SPARC-Rad includes 300 image-question pairs derived from healthy control imaging studies in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA), spanning CT, MRI, and radiography across the abdomen, chest, breast, neuro, and musculoskeletal categories. Radiology trainees manually designed and annotated questions to evaluate anatomical identification, localization, laterality, regional recognition, device identification, and inter-structure spatial relationships. The evaluation pipeline supports standardized prompting, structured output collection, response normalization, LLM-as-judge grading, human quality review, binary correctness scoring, and subgroup analysis by modality, anatomy, and reasoning type. SPARC-Rad provides a reusable framework for evaluating whether VLMs can provide reasoning for radiologic anatomy as a spatial system, supporting future model development, failure-mode analysis, and pre-deployment assessment.

AI.tldr: SPARC-Rad是一个手动策划的多模态基准数据集和评估管线，用于评估医学影像视觉语言模型（VLM）在放射学中的空间感知和解剖推理能力，包含300个图像-问题对，覆盖CT、MRI和X光等多种模态。
AI.motivation: 现有医学影像VLM基准大多侧重疾病分类、报告生成或广泛的视觉问答，缺乏针对放射学所需的空间和解剖推理能力的评估。
AI.method: 从TCIA健康对照影像中收集300个图像-问题对，覆盖CT、MRI和X光，跨腹部、胸部、乳腺、神经和肌肉骨骼类别；由放射学实习生手动设计标注问题，评估解剖识别、定位、侧别、区域识别、装置识别和结构间空间关系；提供标准化提示、结构化输出收集、响应归一化、LLM作为评判者评分、人工质量审查、二元正确性评分及按模态/解剖/推理类型的亚组分析。
AI.result: 论文构建了SPARC-Rad基准数据集和评估管线，但摘要中未报告具体的模型性能结果。
AI.conclusion: SPARC-Rad提供了一个可复用的框架，用于评估VLM是否能够将放射学解剖作为空间系统进行推理，支持未来模型开发、失败模式分析和部署前评估。

title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models: A Blueprint for Real-Time, Enterprise-Ready Deployments
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Authors' accepted version of an article published in IEEE Computer. The version of record is available at the DOI below
summary: Large language models deployed in real-time, regulated settings face knowledge staleness, catastrophic forgetting, hallucination, and weak feedback loops. We present a unified, pattern-driven LLMOps architecture integrating real-time data ingestion, continual learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and human-in-the-loop feedback into a single operational pipeline. Four contributions map to established software design patterns: an adaptive ingestion pattern orchestrator (AIPO) evaluated with FreshStreamBench; STAR+FAR continual learning with sparse temporal adapter routing and freshness-aware replay; SAGE, an SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy predicting a per-query passage budget to meet tail-latency targets; and an automated feedback-driven convergence stage with RLHF triggers. The result reduces latency-cost-accuracy trade-offs while supporting auditability and rollback for high-risk sectors such as health care and finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的、模式驱动的LLMOps架构，将实时数据摄取、持续学习、RAG和人机回环反馈整合到单一运营管道中，以解决大语言模型在实时、受监管环境中面临的知识过时、灾难性遗忘、幻觉和弱反馈循环等问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在实时部署和受监管场景（如医疗、金融）中面临四大核心挑战：知识过时（模型知识跟不上现实变化）、灾难性遗忘（持续学习导致旧知识丢失）、幻觉问题，以及缺乏有效的反馈闭环机制。现有方案往往孤立地解决单个问题，缺乏统一的操作架构。
AI.method: 提出四种映射到既有软件设计模式的组件：(1) AIPO——自适应摄取模式编排器，基于FreshStreamBench评估；(2) STAR+FAR——持续学习机制，采用稀疏时序适配器路由和新鲜度感知回放；(3) SAGE——SLO感知的自适应检索策略，预测每个查询的段落预算以满足尾延迟目标；(4) 自动化反馈驱动收敛阶段，配备RLHF触发机制。
AI.result: 该架构在延迟-成本-准确率三者之间实现了更好的权衡，同时满足了高风险行业（如医疗和金融）对可审计性和回滚能力的要求。
AI.conclusion: 通过将软件设计模式系统地映射到LLMOps组件，实现了可扩展、可审计且支持回滚的统一运营管道，为受监管环境中的LLM部署提供了一种工程化的解决方案。

title: A Few Neurons Reveal When LLMs Misuse Tools: Sparse Detection and Selective Steering for Reliable Tool Use
summary: Agentic LLMs exhibit three consequential tool-use failures: invalid arguments (validity), unnecessary calls (over-calling), and omitted calls when tools are needed (missing). We find that a small, failure-specific set of MLP neurons could distinguish such failures with linearly separable decision boundaries. Building on this observation, we introduce PRISMS (Probing Representations In Support of Monitoring and Steering), a closed-loop framework that shares a failure-specific neuron basis between sparse detection and activation steering. PRISMS selects contribution-critical MLP neurons and fits an L1-regularized detector on their activations. Across six models from the Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma families, over-calling and missing are detected at the pre-generation prompt boundary with ROC-AUC 0.90-1.00, while validity is detected from the generated tool-call span with ROC-AUC 0.86-0.90. These results are achieved with highly sparse readouts: only 1-2 MLP neurons for missing, 2-16 for over-calling, and approximately 128 for validity. These sparse detectors match or outperform dense residual-stream baselines using 23-627 times fewer features. The shared neuron basis also supports bidirectional control over tool-calling behavior, suppressing unnecessary calls and eliciting omitted ones. PRISMS therefore gates intervention on predicted failure risk to mitigate the collateral effects of unconditional steering. Across all six models, PRISMS reduces pooled over-calling rate by 80% (from 0.131 to 0.026) while increasing tool-required accuracy by 14.2 percentage points (from 0.689 to 0.831). PRISMS thus provides lightweight failure detection and selective intervention across model families.

AI.tldr: PRISMS是一个基于稀疏MLP神经元探测的闭环框架，用于检测和干预Agentic LLM的工具调用失败（参数无效、过度调用、缺失调用）。通过识别少量失败相关的MLP神经元并拟合L1正则化检测器，PRISMS在六个模型上实现了高精度的失败检测（ROC-AUC 0.86-1.00），同时通过激活引导实现双向控制，将过度调用率降低80%，并将工具需求准确率提升14.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: Agentic LLM在工具调用中表现出三种关键失败模式：参数无效、过度调用和缺失调用。这些失败会严重影响智能体系统的可靠性和效率。作者发现这些失败可以通过少量特定的MLP神经元以线性可分的方式进行区分，这为开发轻量级的检测和干预机制提供了基础。
AI.method: PRISMS框架包含以下核心组件：(1) 识别对工具调用失败贡献关键的MLP神经元集合；(2) 在这些神经元的激活上拟合L1正则化的稀疏检测器；(3) 利用共享的失败相关神经元基进行激活引导(steering)；(4) 通过门控机制，仅在预测的失败风险较高时进行干预，以减轻无条件引导带来的副作用。
AI.result: 在Qwen3、Llama和Gemma三个模型家族共六个模型上：过度调用和缺失调用在预生成提示边界处检测ROC-AUC达0.90-1.00，参数有效性从生成的工具调用片段中检测ROC-AUC达0.86-0.90。检测器高度稀疏（缺失仅需1-2个神经元，过度调用需2-16个，有效性约128个），并以23-627倍更少的特征匹配或超越密集基线。PRISMS将聚合过度调用率降低80%（从0.131到0.026），同时将工具需求准确率提升14.2个百分点（从0.689到0.831）。
AI.conclusion: PRISMS证明了基于稀疏MLP神经元的探测能够实现跨模型家族的轻量级工具调用失败检测，并通过门控干预机制在避免副作用的同时有效改善工具调用行为。这一发现为理解和控制Agentic LLM的工具使用行为提供了可解释、高效且可迁移的解决方案。

title: Personalizing Large Language Model Agents with Small Policy Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve memory, call tools, ask clarifying questions, and vary response style, yet adapting these execution decisions to an individual user remains difficult. Fine-tuning a separate LLM is costly or impossible for proprietary systems, while prompts and memory primarily expose user information to the agent rather than adapt its execution decisions from feedback. We formulate personalization of a frozen agent as online learning of a per-user execution policy from scalar feedback observed only for the executed action. We propose FABLE (Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution), a lightweight policy layer outside a potentially black-box host agent. FABLE factorizes memory, information-acquisition, and response decisions so feedback updates related choices; filters actions through an externally specified feasible set before exploration; and learns user-specific residual preferences relative to a fixed default-and-cost score via Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling. Under a linear residual-reward model, a calibrated variant inherits an expected-regret bound against the best feasible action. We also characterize preferences unidentifiable under persistent feasibility constraints and provide anytime-valid false-promotion control. Across personalized-reasoning, controlled-feedback, and executable tool-use evaluations, FABLE improves several preference-sensitive behaviors relative to rule-only control while remaining competitive on end-to-end task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FABLE（因子化自适应Bandit执行层），一个轻量级策略层，通过在线学习从标量反馈中为冻结的LLM智能体实现用户个性化执行决策，无需微调底层模型。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽能进行记忆检索、工具调用、澄清提问和调整响应风格，但将这些执行决策适配到单个用户仍然困难。微调单独LLM成本高昂或对专有系统不可行，而提示和记忆主要向智能体暴露用户信息，而非从反馈中适配其执行决策。
AI.method: FABLE将记忆、信息获取和响应决策进行因子化解耦，使反馈更新相关选择；在探索前通过外部指定的可行集过滤动作；使用贝叶斯上下文汤普森采样学习用户相对于固定默认与成本评分的特定残差偏好。
AI.result: 在线性残差奖励模型下，校准变体对最优可行动作具有期望遗憾界；论文还刻画了在持久可行性约束下不可识别的偏好，并提供随时有效的错误提升控制。在个性化推理、受控反馈和可执行工具使用评估中，FABLE相比纯规则控制改善了多个偏好敏感行为，同时在端到端任务性能上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FABLE通过轻量级、可解释的策略层为冻结LLM智能体提供有效的用户个性化，具有理论保证和实证竞争力，是微调之外一种实用且可扩展的个性化方案。

title: Advancing Relevance Measurement with Vision-Language Models for Web-Scale Search
summary: Relevance evaluation plays a crucial role in personalized search systems, serving as a guardrail alongside user engagement metrics to ensure that search results align with user queries and intent. While human annotation is the traditional method for relevance evaluation, its high cost and long turnaround time limit its scalability. In this work, we present a VLM-based automated relevance evaluation pipeline deployed within Pinterest Search for online A/B experiments. We rigorously validate the alignment between VLM-generated judgments and human annotations, demonstrating that VLMs can provide reliable relevance measurement for experiments while greatly improving the evaluation efficiency. Leveraging VLM-based labeling further unlocks opportunities to expand the query set, optimize sampling design, and efficiently assess a wider range of search experiences at scale. This approach leads to higher-quality relevance metrics and significantly reduces the Minimum Detectable Effects (MDEs) in online experiment measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Pinterest搜索中部署的基于VLM的自动化相关性评估流水线，用于在线A/B实验。研究表明VLM生成的评估与人类标注高度一致，在提高评估效率的同时提供了可靠的相关性度量，并显著降低了在线实验中的最小可检测效应（MDEs）。
AI.motivation: 传统的人工标注相关性评估成本高昂且周期长，限制了其可扩展性。个性化搜索系统需要一种高效且可靠的相关性评估方法，以保障搜索结果与用户查询意图的一致性。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于VLM（视觉语言模型）的自动化相关性评估流水线，部署在Pinterest搜索的在线A/B实验中，并严格验证了VLM评估与人类标注之间的一致性。
AI.result: VLM能够提供可靠的相关性测量，大幅提升评估效率，扩展查询集，优化采样设计，降低在线实验测量中的最小可检测效应（MDEs），从而获得更高质量的相关性指标。
AI.conclusion: VLM-based相关性评估可以在实际工业搜索系统中替代人工标注，兼具可靠性、高效性和可扩展性，为在线实验提供了更灵敏的相关性测量手段。

title: Co-evolution of social reward and punishment under institutional interventions
summary: We investigate how peer and institutional incentives jointly shape the evolution of cooperation, social welfare, and enforcement efficiency in social dilemmas. In a Prisoners Dilemma with four strategies, unconditional cooperators (C), defectors (D), social punishers (SP), and social rewarders (SR), we allow decentralised peer incentives and centralised institutional incentives to act simultaneously, with the institution able to reward or punish any subset of strategies. In infinite well-mixed populations, we analyse the resulting four-strategy replicator dynamics, and in structured populations we use agent-based simulations on square lattices to study spatial effects and network reciprocity. Intervention schemes are evaluated by equilibrium states and evolutionary flow for infinite well-mixed populations, by cooperation levels and social welfare for structured populations, defined as aggregate population payoff net of institutional cost. We find that peer punishment most strongly promotes cooperation, whereas peer reward is more beneficial for social welfare. Institutionally rewarding peer incentive strategies substantially improves both cooperation and welfare, while subsidising unconditional cooperators has little impact. Under institutional punishment, directly penalising defectors is the only consistently effective policy; punishing peer incentive strategies dismantles decentralised incentives, reduces cooperation, and harms social welfare, showing that maximising cooperation does not necessarily optimise overall societal benefit. Our findings provide design principles for institutions seeking to balance cooperation promotion with welfare maximisation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了同伴激励（peer incentives）与制度激励（institutional incentives）如何共同影响社会困境中的合作演化、社会福利和执法效率。通过在囚徒困境中引入四种策略（无条件合作者、背叛者、社会惩罚者、社会奖励者），并允许分散的同伴激励与集中的制度激励同时作用，结合无穷混合人群的复制者动力学分析和结构化人群的智能体模拟，发现同伴惩罚最能促进合作，同伴奖励更有利于社会福利；制度奖励同伴激励策略能显著提升合作与福利，制度惩罚中直接惩罚背叛者是唯一一贯有效的政策，惩罚同伴激励策略会瓦解分散激励并损害社会福利。
AI.motivation: 理解同伴激励与制度激励如何协同作用以促进合作和社会福利，为制度设计提供原则性指导，因为最大化合作并不一定等同于优化整体社会效益。
AI.method: 采用四策略（C、D、SP、SR）囚徒困境模型，同时纳入分散同伴激励和集中制度激励；在无穷混合人群中分析四策略复制者动力学，在结构化人群中采用方格上的智能体模拟研究空间效应和网络互惠；通过均衡状态、演化流、合作水平和社会福利来评估干预方案。
AI.result: 同伴惩罚最能促进合作，同伴奖励更有利于社会福利；制度奖励同伴激励策略可大幅提升合作与福利；制度惩罚中直接惩罚背叛者是唯一持续有效的政策，惩罚同伴激励策略会瓦解分散激励、降低合作并损害社会福利。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了制度设计原则，指出在促进合作与福利最大化之间需要找到平衡，制度不应替代或削弱同伴激励，而应通过奖励同伴激励策略等方式与分散激励形成互补。

title: Documentation vs. Code Patterns: What Drives LLM-Based Exception Oracle Generation?
summary:
LLM-based test oracle generation (TOG) methods report high accuracy on exception oracle generation, but it remains unclear what evidence drives these predictions. In particular, do models use explicit exceptional-behavior documentation such as Javadoc @throws clauses, or do they rely on recurring patterns in tests, code, and documentation?
  We investigate this question through a large-scale intervention-based study of three TOG systems spanning classifier-based and generative architectures and model sizes from roughly 110M to 7B parameters, evaluated on three real-world benchmarks comprising two generated-test datasets and a new benchmark of developer-written tests. We first remove Javadoc @throws clauses and find that accuracy changes only marginally, with the largest drop below one percentage point. This indicates that structured exception documentation is not the primary driver of exception-oracle prediction. We then apply attribution-guided substitution ablations to identify the signals that predictions depend on. The results show that high accuracy can be driven by shortcut signals: some models are highly sensitive to a small number of structural tokens, while others distribute reliance across many lexical cues. These findings challenge the assumption that strong exception-oracle accuracy reflects robust use of exception semantics. Future TOG systems should therefore be evaluated not only by whether they predict the correct oracle type, but also by whether their predictions are grounded in meaningful exception-triggering evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模干预实验研究LLM在测试预言生成（TOG）中的异常预言预测依据，发现模型并未主要依赖Javadoc @throws等结构化异常文档，而是依赖捷径信号（如少量结构标记或大量词汇线索），挑战了"高准确率=稳健使用异常语义"的假设。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM-based TOG方法在异常预言生成上报告了高准确率，但缺乏对其预测依据（证据）的深入理解。研究者希望弄清模型到底依赖显式异常文档还是测试/代码中的重复模式，以评估这些预测是否真正基于有意义的异常语义。
AI.method: 采用基于干预（intervention-based）的大规模研究方法，涵盖三种TOG系统（分类器和生成架构）以及约110M到7B参数的模型，在三个真实基准（两个生成测试数据集和一个开发者编写测试的新基准）上进行评估。具体包括：(1)移除Javadoc @throws子句观察准确率变化；(2)使用归因引导的替换消融（attribution-guided substitution ablations）识别预测依赖的信号。
AI.result: 移除@throws子句后准确率仅轻微变化（最大下降不足1个百分点），表明结构化异常文档并非主要预测驱动因素。归因引导消融显示不同模型存在差异：部分模型对少量结构标记高度敏感，而其他模型将依赖分散在大量词汇线索上，表明存在捷径信号。
AI.conclusion: 高异常预言准确率可能不反映对异常语义的稳健理解，未来TOG系统的评估不应仅关注预测的预言类型是否正确，还应评估预测是否基于有意义的异常触发证据。

title: What Carries the Signal in Pathology Foundation-Model Atlases? A Patient-Level Controlled Benchmark in Breast Cancer
comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Supplementary Information (16 pages) included as an ancillary file. Segmentation outputs obtained under the Aignostics Research Access Programme; OpenTME data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aignostics/OpenTME
summary:
Pathology foundation models are reported to encode molecular programmes in tissue morphology, but the evidence is usually a cohort-wide ranked gene list rather than a prediction for a held-out patient. We rebuild such an analysis with the patient as the unit of evidence and ask which pipeline component carries signal.
  Across 11 frozen backbones, four pre-specified gene programmes and 285 TCGA-BRCA patients with paired slides and RNA-seq (44 cells; GroupKFold by patient, all preprocessing fitted inside the fold), ridge regression on mean-pooled embeddings predicts held-out programme scores at Spearman rho = 0.25-0.56, UNI2 strongest on all four (immune 0.556). A matched permutation null gives raw p ~ 1e-4 at 10,000 permutations for every cell; Holm-adjusted p = 0.0044.
  The signal is real but not uniformly morphological. Against competing models on the same patients and folds, embeddings beat tissue composition for ER/luminal, proliferation and immune (+0.280, +0.284, +0.479; p <= 0.003) but not basal, where compartment fractions alone reach 0.469 against the embedding's 0.493 (p = 0.77). Fifty-four interpretable cell-count features come within 0.043-0.085 on every programme.
  The geometric machinery contributes nothing measurable, and we identify why: the geodesic graph selects neighbours by Euclidean nearest-neighbour search and only reweights edges already chosen, so the topology is Euclidean by construction (Riemannian minus Euclidean = +0.0010, 95% CI [-0.0007, +0.0029]). Applied consistently the geometry is worse (-0.0117). Ridge regression beats the graph-and-metric decoder by +0.097 (CI [+0.069, +0.127]). The driver-count metric common in this literature is near-uninformative here: 91.8% of random six-gene panels recover >=5/6 drivers.

AI.tldr: 本文以患者为分析单元，系统评估病理基础模型能否从组织形态预测分子程序。在11个冻结骨干、4个基因程序、285例TCGA-BRCA患者上，UNI2最强（免疫程序Spearman rho=0.556，置换检验p=0.0044）。信号真实但并非均匀形态学：嵌入优于组织组成（ER/管腔、增殖、免疫），但在基底程序中无显著优势。几何机制无贡献（Riemannian减Euclidean仅+0.0010），岭回归优于图与度量解码器+0.097，驱动基因计数度量近乎无效（91.8%随机六基因面板可恢复≥5/6驱动基因）。
AI.motivation: 现有病理基础模型声称编码分子程序，但证据通常是队列级排序基因列表而非对留出患者的预测。作者希望以患者为证据单元重新构建分析，并探究何种流程组件真正携带信号。
AI.method: 使用11个冻结骨干、4个预定基因程序、285例TCGA-BRCA患者（44个细胞），采用按患者分组的GroupKFold交叉验证，预处理全部在折内拟合。用岭回归对平均池化嵌入预测留出程序分数，与配对的置换零分布比较，并与组织组成、可解释细胞计数特征、图与度量几何解码器、驱动计数度量等竞争模型对比。
AI.result: UNI2在全部四个程序上最强（免疫0.556），置换检验原始p~1e-4，Holm校正后p=0.0044。嵌入在ER/管腔、增殖、免疫上优于组织组成（+0.280、+0.284、+0.479），但基底程序无显著优势（0.493 vs 0.469，p=0.77）。54个可解释细胞计数特征差距仅0.043-0.085。几何机制无贡献（+0.0010），岭回归优于几何解码器+0.097。驱动计数度量近无效。
AI.conclusion: 病理基础模型的分子预测信号是真实的，但信号来源主要是简单平均池化嵌入和线性模型，而非复杂的图与度量几何机制。几何方法因欧几里得最近邻搜索而在构造上本质是欧几里得的，不贡献可测量的信号。驱动基因计数度量在该文献中常用但近乎无效。

title: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary: Graph self-supervised learning aims to learn transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled graph data. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid explicit negative-pair construction and raw-input reconstruction by predicting masked targets directly in latent space. However, existing graph JEPAs typically rely on a single predefined graph partition, biasing the learned representations toward one structural granularity and limiting their ability to capture complementary patterns at different graph scales. To address this limitation, we propose HP-JEPA, a hierarchical partitioning framework for multi-resolution graph joint-embedding prediction. HP-JEPA organizes each graph into an ordered bank of coarse-to-fine partition resolutions and performs context-target latent prediction separately at each resolution using an online encoder, an exponential-moving-average target encoder, and a latent predictor. The resulting resolution-specific graph representations are subsequently integrated through concatenation or task-specific resolution weighting, allowing downstream models to combine complementary local, regional, and global structural information. Experiments on seven graph classification benchmarks and one graph regression benchmark show that HP-JEPA outperforms the fixed-resolution Graph-JEPA baseline on 6 of 8 tasks, improving upon Graph-JEPA on most evaluated benchmarks. Size-stratified analyses further show that HP-JEPA achieves higher accuracy than Graph-JEPA in most evaluated graph-size quartiles on three representative datasets. These results highlight the effectiveness of hierarchical multi-resolution partitioning for transferable graph representation learning.

AI.tldr: HP-JEPA是一种层次化多分辨率图自监督学习框架，通过将图组织为从粗到细的多种分区分辨率，并在每个分辨率下独立进行联合嵌入预测（JEPA），从而克服固定单一图分区带来的结构粒度偏见，在7个图分类和1个图回归基准上优于固定分辨率的Graph-JEPA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的图JEPA方法依赖单一的预定图分区，导致学习到的表征偏向于某一种特定的结构粒度，无法捕捉图在不同尺度上的互补模式（局部、区域、全局信息）。
AI.method: HP-JEPA将每个图组织成从粗到细的有序分区分辨率库，在每个分辨率下使用在线编码器、EMA目标编码器和潜在预测器分别进行上下文-目标潜在预测，最后通过拼接或任务特定分辨率加权整合各分辨率下的图表征。
AI.result: 在7个图分类基准和1个图回归基准上，HP-JEPA在6/8个任务上优于固定分辨率的Graph-JEPA基线；在3个代表性数据集上，按图大小分层分析显示HP-JEPA在大多数图大小四分位数上精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 层次化多分辨率分区策略能有效提升图自监督表示学习的可迁移性和表现，验证了多尺度结构信息互补对于图表示学习的重要性。

title: Cross-Task Dissociation in Frontier Vision-Language Model Theory of Mind
summary: Do frontier vision-language models present a coherent Theory-of-Mind (ToM) profile across tasks, matching the same human reference group, or does that profile fragment from one paradigm to the next? We evaluate a shared panel of nine frontier VLMs on two psychology-derived benchmarks: the Keysar Director Task (visual perspective-taking under egocentric interference) and the Frith-Happé animated triangles scored with the Castelli rubric (intention attribution from pure motion). On the Director Task, without chain-of-thought, the panel makes the egocentric error on 78\% of trials like children rather than adults; variation is substantial across models, and reasoning rescues several models. On the triangles, the panel under-attributes intention: its ToM profile sits more than three times closer to the high-functioning-autistic-adult (HF-ASD) mean than to the typical-development-adult (TD) mean, while Goal-Directed and Random stay near TD. No model is nearest TD on both tasks; the model that looks adult-like on the Director Task falls on the HF-ASD side on the triangles, and the most TD-like model on the triangles is child-like on the Director Task. We report group-level descriptions, not diagnostic labels for any model.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了九个前沿视觉-语言模型在两个心理学范式任务（Keysar视角任务和Frith-Happé动画三角任务）上的心智理论表现，发现所有模型的ToM画像在不同任务间不一致——没有模型在两个任务上都接近典型发育成人水平，整体呈现出碎片化的能力特征。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常孤立地在单一范式下评估模型的ToM能力，缺乏跨任务的连贯性考察。作者希望回答：前沿视觉-语言模型的ToM能力是否具有跨任务一致性，能否稳定匹配同一人类参照群体。
AI.method: 选取九个前沿视觉-语言模型，在两个心理学衍生的基准任务上进行评估：(1) Keysar导演任务——测试在自我中心干扰下的视觉观点采择能力；(2) Frith-Happé动画三角任务——使用Castelli评分体系评估从纯运动信息中进行意图归因的能力。采用与人类参照组（儿童、典型发育成人、高功能自闭症成人）的比较框架。
AI.result: 在导演任务中，无思维链提示时模型组在78%的试次中出现自我中心错误（类似儿童而非成人），但模型间差异大，推理提示能挽救部分模型。在三角任务中，模型整体意图归因不足，其ToM画像距高功能自闭症成人均值是距典型发育成人均值的3倍多，但目标导向和随机维度接近典型发育成人。没有任何模型在两个任务上都最接近典型发育成人。
AI.conclusion: 前沿视觉-语言模型的心智理论能力在不同范式间呈现碎片化而非连贯的特征，缺乏一个稳定的、跨任务一致的ToM画像。作者强调这些是群体层面的描述，而非对任何单一模型的诊断性标签。

title: More Debate, Same Evidence: Structural Limits of Homogeneous Multi-Agent Groundedness
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly organized as multi-agent panels under the assumption that exchanging critiques improves judgment quality. We test this assumption for \emph{groundedness verification}, where a judge must determine whether a claim is supported by the supplied evidence. We evaluate a homogeneous three-agent panel on six public fact-verification and hallucination-detection benchmarks. Relative to a fixed single-agent reference, the panel's system-level accuracy difference ranges from $+8.5$ to $-4.4$ percentage points: two datasets show reliable gains, one shows a reliable loss, and three are statistically inconclusive. Because the reference and panel use different model variants, these differences characterize the complete systems rather than isolate a causal debate effect.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了多智能体LLM评审小组（multi-agent panel）通过交换批评意见是否能提升判断质量的假设，具体应用于 groundedness verification（判断主张是否被证据支持）任务。在六个公开基准上，三人同质小组相比固定单智能体参考，系统级准确率差异从+8.5到-4.4个百分点不等：两个数据集有可靠增益，一个可靠损失，三个统计上不显著。研究指出由于参考和小组使用不同模型变体，差异反映的是完整系统差异而非因果关系。
AI.motivation: LLM评委越来越多地以多智能体小组形式组织，但这一做法基于"交换批评能提升判断质量"的假设尚未被严格检验。作者旨在通过实证测试验证这一假设在 groundedness verification 任务上的有效性。
AI.method: 评估一个同质的三智能体小组（homogeneous three-agent panel），在六个公开的事实验证和幻觉检测基准上，与固定的单智能体参考系统进行对比，衡量系统级准确率差异。
AI.result: 准确率差异范围从+8.5到-4.4个百分点。两个数据集显示可靠提升，一个显示可靠下降，三个数据集结果统计上不显著。由于参考与小组使用不同模型变体，结果反映完整系统差异而非因果性的辩论效应。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体小组并不总能优于单智能体参考；效果因数据集而异，且当前实验设计无法分离因果性的辩论效应，需要更严格的对照实验来验证小组讨论的价值。

title: Syntax Meets Semantics: Understanding Scientific Formulae
summary: Scientific formulae are a fundamental component of scholarly communication, yet their dual nature -- as structured syntax and carriers of semantics -- remains underexplored in scholarly information retrieval. Although prior studies show that jointly modeling syntactic and semantic modalities improves retrieval performance, the relationship between their underlying representations has not been systematically investigated. In this work, we empirically study cross-modal correspondence between formula syntax and semantics. We find that their native representation spaces exhibit extremely weak observable correspondence despite strong latent correlation, indicating a substantial representation mismatch between the two modalities. We further evaluate whether this mismatch can be reduced using standard representation learning and alignment techniques. We represent syntactic structure using graph-based encoders and semantic information using text-based encoders, then apply contrastive learning to induce a shared representation space. Results show that the learned alignment substantially improves cross-modal retrieval, suggesting that explicit representation learning can recover correspondence absent from the original representation spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了学术文献中数学公式的语法与语义两种模态之间的对应关系，发现其原生表示空间存在显著的不匹配（弱可观测对应但强潜在相关），并通过对比学习对齐两种模态表示，显著提升了跨模态检索性能。
AI.motivation: 学术公式在学术交流中具有双重属性——既是结构化语法，又承载语义信息。尽管已有研究表明联合建模语法和语义模态可提升检索性能，但两种模态底层表示之间的关系尚未被系统研究。理解这种表示层面的不对应关系，是改进跨模态检索的关键前提。
AI.method: 1) 实证分析：系统性比较公式语法表示空间与语义表示空间之间的对应关系；2) 表示学习：使用基于图的编码器表示语法结构，使用基于文本的编码器表示语义信息；3) 对比学习：应用对比学习将两种模态映射到共享表示空间，消除模态间表示差异。
AI.result: 研究发现两种模态的原生表示空间之间存在极强的潜在相关性但极弱的可观测对应，表明存在显著的表示不匹配问题。通过对比学习诱导共享表示空间后，学习到的对齐显著改善了跨模态检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式的表示学习能够恢复原生表示空间中所缺失的模态间对应关系，证明了在学术公式检索场景中，通过对比学习等表示对齐技术可以有效弥合语法与语义模态之间的鸿沟。

title: Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races
summary: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation. We first verify the game engine, then test rule recall, state tracking, payoff calculation, and stability under different but equivalent task descriptions. We then compare LLM action sequences with an evolutionary game-theory benchmark and published human data, and explore differences across models, risk conditions, personas, and two- to five-player races. The audit shows that strong rule recall can coexist with weak state tracking and expected-payoff calculation. Providing verified arithmetic and changing the response representation can also change later actions, even when the game rules stay fixed. Across seven tested model endpoints, aggregate rates hide large differences in action sequences, responses to opponents, and responses to race position. Patterns across the tested three- to five-player races are also model-specific rather than a single effect of adding competitors. These results show why multi-agent AI-race simulations need validity checks and trajectory-level analysis before their outputs are described as strategic, human-like, or safety-aware. Our findings are exploratory and apply only to the tested models, prompts, and decoding settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI开发竞赛中的多智能体安全困境，通过2至5人的重复博弈实验，验证了LLM智能体是否真正理解博弈。研究发现规则记忆强与状态追踪和期望收益计算弱可并存，且不同模型在行动序列上存在巨大差异，说明多智能体AI竞赛模拟需要有效性检查和轨迹级分析。
AI.motivation: AI开发竞赛构成多智能体安全困境，但仅凭有效行动不能证明智能体真正理解博弈。需要在进行行为解释前设立审计关卡，验证智能体是否真正掌握游戏规则、状态追踪和收益计算。
AI.method: 采用2至5名玩家的重复博弈实验，首先验证博弈引擎，然后测试规则记忆、状态追踪、收益计算及在不同任务描述下的稳定性。将LLM行动序列与演化博弈论基准和已发表的人类数据比较，并探索模型、风险条件、角色和玩家人数差异。
AI.result: 审计显示强规则记忆与弱状态追踪和期望收益计算可共存；提供经过验证的算术和改变响应表示会改变后续行动。七个模型端点的聚合率掩盖了行动序列、对对手反应和竞赛位置反应上的巨大差异，3至5人竞赛模式也因模型而异。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体AI竞赛模拟在输出被称为"战略性""类人"或"安全感知"之前，需要进行有效性检查和轨迹级分析。研究结果是探索性的，仅适用于测试的模型、提示和解码设置。

title: Joint Optimization of Human Headcount and Stochastic AI Resource Capacity
summary: Generative AI tools are rapidly becoming standard for coding and other business operations. However, while these tools can drive productivity, their unpredictable, and often significant, costs are putting severe financial strain on organizations. The leadership of such organizations must split a fixed budget between human headcount and generative-AI token capacity, yet standard deterministic planning ignores both the heavy-tailed volatility of token consumption and the cognitive cost of auditing AI-generated output. We model the joint allocation by intersecting a cognitive-friction-adjusted production function with a chance-constrained stochastic budget frontier. Per-engineer token usage is treated as i.i.d., non-negative, and right-skewed; no parametric family is assumed, as only its mean, variance, and skewness enter the analysis. The chance constraint is reduced to a deterministic equivalent via the Central Limit Theorem with a Cornish--Fisher skewness correction. Solving the resulting Lagrangian yields a closed-form optimal headcount, a transcendental condition for optimal per-capita token intensity, and a bordered-Hessian second-order condition that holds for any reasonable volatility-to-headcount ratio. Comparative statics show that rising individual token volatility raises optimal per-capita token intensity while contracting headcount: although human labor and tokens are complements in production, the stochastic budget makes them substitutes at the margin. Individual usage skewness acts as a pure deadweight tax that shrinks the budget without altering the substitution dynamics. Both conclusions presuppose that usage dispersion is invariant to the planned mean allocation. In the case where dispersion instead scales proportionally with the mean, the substitution reverses, so which regime applies is a sharp, empirically testable question.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业在固定预算下如何最优分配人力和生成式AI token容量的问题。通过结合认知摩擦调整的生产函数和机会约束随机预算边界，在无参数假设下（仅利用均值、方差和偏度），使用中心极限定理和Cornish-Fisher偏度校正推导出闭式最优解，并揭示了token消费波动性与偏度对企业资源配置决策的影响机制。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具虽能提升生产力，但其token消耗的不可预测性和显著成本（重尾波动性）给组织带来财务压力。企业领导者必须在人力成本和AI token容量之间分配固定预算，而传统的确定性规划方法忽略了token消费的波动性和审计AI输出的认知成本。
AI.method: 将认知摩擦调整的生产函数与机会约束随机预算边界相交以建模联合分配。假设每位工程师的token使用量是i.i.d.、非负且右偏的，不作参数族假设，仅使用均值、方差和偏度。通过中心极限定理配合Cornish-Fisher偏度校正将机会约束简化为确定性等价形式，求解拉格朗日方程得到最优解，并用带边界的Hessian矩阵进行二阶条件验证。
AI.result: 得到了闭式最优人力数量、人均token强度的超越条件解以及有效的二阶条件。比较静态分析表明：个体token波动率上升会提高最优人均token强度但缩减人力规模（人力与token在边际上互为替代品）；个体偏度则作为纯粹的沉没税效应缩小预算但不改变替代动态。当使用离散度与均值成比例时，替代关系反转。
AI.conclusion: 人力与token在生产中是互补品，但在随机预算约束下边际上是替代品。token消费偏度起到死重税作用。结论取决于离散度是否随均值不变或成比例，这一区分是可实证检验的关键问题。

title: Distill What RGB Can Recover: Privileged 3D Evidence for RGB-Only Vision-Language Models
summary: 3D scene understanding requires reasoning about entity existence, spatial layout, and object relations, yet RGB images alone often provide insufficient 3D cues. Existing 3D-VLMs commonly rely on depth or 3D-position-aware inputs at inference time, introducing additional acquisition, reconstruction, or annotation costs that limit RGB-only deployment. We therefore study how training-time 3D evidence can be converted into spatial reasoning capabilities retained under RGB-only inference. We propose a privileged-evidence distillation framework that constructs a distillable teacher through a unified evidence interface and controlled residual injection, and transfers its knowledge to a deployable student receiving only RGB images and questions through logit and structured representation distillation. To avoid imitating teacher signals unsupported by RGB, we further introduce evidence-sensitivity-guided distillation, which uses corrupted evidence to identify highly evidence-dependent targets and down-weight their supervision. We also define a recoverability decomposition based on the matched baseline, teacher, and student, separating privileged gains into RGB-recoverable improvements and residual teacher advantages. Across four benchmarks, the teacher achieves the best result on 7 of 11 reported metrics among the compared methods. The RGB-only student outperforms its matched baseline on all 11 metrics, including gains of 10.4 ScanQA CIDEr and 19.1 Scan2Cap CIDEr@0.5, without additional inference-time inputs. These results validate the effectiveness of training-time privileged 3D evidence distillation for both teacher performance and deployable RGB-only spatial reasoning. Separately, our matched baseline-teacher-student analysis characterizes privileged-gain transfer across evidence types and spatial skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种特权证据蒸馏框架，在训练时将3D空间证据（深度/位置信息）转化为空间推理能力，使仅接收RGB图像的模型在推理时无需任何额外的3D输入即可进行3D场景理解。通过统一的证据接口构造可蒸馏教师模型，并通过证据敏感性引导蒸馏避免模仿RGB无法支持的目标，最终RGB-only学生模型在四个基准的11项指标上全面超越匹配基线。
AI.motivation: 3D场景理解需要推理实体存在、空间布局和物体关系，但仅靠RGB图像往往缺乏足够的3D线索。现有的3D-VLM在推理时需要深度或3D位置感知输入，这引入了额外的采集、重建或标注成本，限制了仅基于RGB的部署场景。因此，作者希望研究如何将训练阶段的3D证据转化为可在RGB-only推理时保留的空间推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出特权证据蒸馏框架：通过统一的证据接口和受控残差注入构造可蒸馏的教师模型，将知识通过logit和结构化表示蒸馏传递给仅接收RGB图像和问题的学生模型。2) 引入证据敏感性引导蒸馏：使用损坏证据来识别高度依赖证据的目标，并降低其监督权重，避免模仿RGB无法支持的教师信号。3) 提出可恢复性分解：基于匹配的基线、教师和学生，将特权收益分解为RGB可恢复的改进和残差教师优势。
AI.result: 在四个基准的11项报告指标中，教师模型在其中7项上达到最佳结果。RGB-only学生模型在所有11项指标上优于其匹配基线，包括ScanQA CIDEr提高10.4、Scan2Cap CIDEr@0.5提高19.1，且无需额外的推理时输入。
AI.conclusion: 训练时的特权3D证据蒸馏对教师性能提升和可部署的RGB-only空间推理均有效。匹配的基线-教师-学生分析表征了特权收益在不同证据类型和空间技能间的迁移情况。

title: Agentic Graph Token Reasoning
summary: Graphs model relational data throughout science and industry, from citation networks to product co-purchase graphs. Because the nodes of many such graphs carry rich text, a growing line of work applies large language models (LLMs) to graph analysis. The most graph-native of these methods use graph tokens: a graph encoder compresses a graph view, such as a node, its k-hop neighbourhood, or a cluster, into a short block of continuous tokens that jointly encodes node attributes and topology and is read directly by the model. Existing methods, however, use graph tokens in a static single-shot manner: they encode one predefined graph view before the model has even seen the target and never revise it, leaving the model's step-by-step reasoning ability unused. We introduce agentic graph token reasoning, which recasts graph tokenization as part of the reasoning process itself. At each step, the model chooses which graph view to encode and at what granularity; a graph encoder is invoked on demand to materialise the corresponding graph tokens; and the resulting block is spliced into the running context. The model thus reasons step by step in the graph token space, and the tokens it reads are trajectory-dependent. We realise this with a three-stage training pipeline: (i) self-supervised tasks that teach the model to read heterogeneous graph tokens, (ii) a token-robust trajectory stage with a graph-token consistency regulariser, and (iii) preference optimisation that rewards trajectories in which the graph-token evidence and the node-text evidence agree. Across evaluations spanning seven graph domains, our models outperform a broad set of baselines by a large margin and transfer zero-shot to unseen domains without any per-target fine-tuning. More broadly, this work pushes LLM-based graph analysis from static graph-token encoders towards a graph-native agent paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种智能体图token推理（agentic graph token reasoning）方法，将图token化重新定位为推理过程的一部分。模型在每一步自主选择要编码的图视图及其粒度，按需调用图编码器生成图token并拼接到上下文，实现逐步推理。通过三阶段训练管道（自监督、token鲁棒轨迹、偏好优化）实现，在七个图域上大幅超越基线并支持零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图token的LLM图分析方法采用静态单次编码方式：在模型看到目标任务之前就预先定义并编码一个图视图，之后不再修订。这种方式没有充分利用大语言模型逐步推理的能力，也无法根据推理过程动态调整所需的信息粒度和图视图。因此需要一种将图token化融入推理过程、让模型自主决定何时以及如何编码图视图的新范式。
AI.method: 提出智能体图token推理（agentic graph token reasoning）：1）在推理每一步，模型自主选择要编码的图视图（节点、k跳邻域、聚类等）及粒度；2）按需调用图编码器生成对应的图token并拼入运行中的上下文；3）token是轨迹相关的，随推理过程动态变化。配套三阶段训练管道：(i) 自监督任务学习读取异构图token，(ii) token鲁棒轨迹阶段配合图token一致性正则化，(iii) 偏好优化奖励图token证据与节点文本证据一致的轨迹。
AI.result: 在跨越七个图领域的评测中，该方法的模型大幅优于广泛的基线方法，并且能够零样本迁移到未见过的领域，无需针对每个目标进行微调。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将基于LLM的图分析从静态图token编码器推向图原生的智能体范式，证明了将图token化作为推理过程一部分的有效性，为未来的图LLM研究提供了新方向。

title: Sixteen models, fewer than two voices: measuring ensemble dispersion where no answer is uniquely correct
comment: 34 pages (25 article + 9 supplementary), 3 figures. Supplementary material (S1-S11) included. Preregistered at OSF (osf.io/c5qk7), sealed 21 July 2026. Analysis code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21718657
summary: Sixteen language models drawn from ten families produced, on average, the semantic diversity of 1.69 distinct formulations of a psychotherapeutic case, against a single-model baseline of 1.43 from one model's own runs. Ensembles place more than one reading before a decision-maker on the premise that several models supply several perspectives. Dispersion over their outputs is measured both as diversity and as uncertainty, and both traditions validate it against a correctness criterion that this task does not admit. Measuring diversity is a solved problem: the Vendi Score, the exponential of the von Neumann entropy of a similarity matrix, is an effective number of distinct elements. What a single aggregate does not say is where the diversity comes from. We define a per-model dissent contribution, the complement of a model's mean similarity to the other members of its ensemble: a magnitude from the same matrix, not a decomposition of the spectral index, whose maximum identifies the most divergent voice. Crossing model and case, we test as a preregistered hypothesis whether model identity accounts for a non-zero share of the variance in dissent, and characterise the structure that test detects. The panel formulated fifteen stratified vignettes, yielding 7,082 formulations for analysis. Model identity was a detectable structuring factor of the dissent that remained, but the usual categories recovered it only partly: scale differences pointed in opposite directions across pairs, family grouped models on only five two-member lines, and the most divergent voice changed with panel composition, so that the surfaced outlier describes the ensemble rather than the model. Dissent did not track the interpretive openness for which the case bank was stratified; it was organised by clinical content instead, leaving the dispersion an ensemble produces a property to measure rather than assume.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了由10个模型家族16个语言模型组成的集成，在心理治疗案例描述任务上评估输出的语义多样性（平均1.69种不同表述，基线单模型为1.43）。作者提出了每个模型的异议贡献度，即该模型与集成其他成员平均相似度的补数。通过预注册假设检验，发现模型身份是异议方差的可检测结构因素，但传统分类（模型规模、家族）仅能部分解释该结构，且异议并不追踪案例的解读开放性，而是由临床内容组织。
AI.motivation: 集成方法假定多个模型提供多种视角，但现有的多样性和不确定性度量都依赖正确性标准，而心理治疗案例任务没有明确正确性标准。此外，现有的多样性聚合指标（如Vendi Score）只能报告集成整体多样性，无法指出多样性来源来自哪个模型。作者希望定义一种能从相似性矩阵中识别最异质（分歧最大）模型的贡献度量，并检验模型身份是否为异议方差的显著结构因素。
AI.method: 使用16个来自10个家族的语言模型组成的集成，对15个分层心理治疗案例小插曲进行表述生成，得到7,082个表述。用Vendi Score衡量集成语义多样性。定义每个模型的异议贡献度为该模型与集成其他成员平均相似度的补数（1 - 平均相似度），最大值即最异质的"局外人"。采用预注册假设检验，交叉模型与案例，检验模型身份是否解释异议方差中的非零份额，并表征该测试所检测到的结构。
AI.result: 模型身份确实是留在异议中的可检测结构因素，但常规分类只能部分恢复它：模型规模差异在不同模型对之间方向相反；模型家族仅在五条双成员线上将模型分组；最异质的模型随集成组成而变化。异议不追踪案例库为此分层的解读开放性，而是由临床内容组织。因此分散性是集成产生的一种属性，需要测量而非假设。
AI.conclusion: 集成的输出分散性是一种需要实测的属性而非可预先假定的性质。模型身份对异议的贡献无法被传统分类（规模、家族）完全解释，且异议的结构由临床内容而非案例开放性决定。所提出的异议贡献度提供了一种无需正确性标准的多样性来源归因方法。

title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary:
Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23\% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales.
  The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对路由问题（如TSP）的几何自监督预训练框架。通过等距变换（旋转和轴向反射）捕捉空间不变性和全局相对距离分布，模型在策略优化前学习鲁棒的结构表征，在TSP1,000的大规模零样本外推场景中实现了7.23%的路径长度改进，并比精确求解器Concorde快两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 神经组合优化（NCO）技术在解决路由问题上是传统精确算法的高效替代方案，但基于强化学习的模型在扩展到高维实例时泛化能力严重受限。虽然自监督预训练已在计算机视觉和自然语言处理等其他领域缓解了这一问题，但将其应用于路由图仍具挑战性，因为这些图除了2D空间坐标外缺乏复杂的拓扑属性。
AI.method: 提出一个针对路由问题的几何自监督预训练框架，通过应用等距变换（如旋转和轴向反射）来捕捉空间不变性和全局相对距离分布。模型在策略优化阶段之前先学习鲁棒的结构表征，利用2D空间坐标中存在的几何属性进行预训练。
AI.result: 该策略在零样本大规模外推场景（TSP1,000）中相较于从头训练的基线模型实现了7.23%的路径长度改进，并且展现出显著的计算效率，在大规模场景下比精确求解器Concorde快两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 几何自监督预训练能够有效提升NCO模型在大型路由实例上的泛化能力，同时保持极高的计算效率。该方法的代码和预训练模型已公开。

title: Unpaired Modality-Agnostic Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative Recommendation (GR) formulates recommendation as autoregressive generation over discrete semantic identifiers (IDs). Although recent multimodal GR methods improve semantic ID construction with visual and textual information, they typically require item-level paired observations, restricting tokenization to the intersection of modality availability. Moreover, incorporating unpaired observations is nontrivial because small representation shifts may cross quantization boundaries and produce incompatible identifier sequences. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{Unpair}ed Modality-Agnostic \textbf{G}enerative \textbf{R}ecommendation (UnpairGR), which learns a unified semantic-ID space from paired, image-only, and text-only observations. UnpairGR confines modality-specific processing to lightweight input projections while sharing the subsequent Transformer and residual codebooks across all observation conditions. Paired observations establish a reliability-guided cross-modal consensus, whereas unimodal observations directly refine the same representations and codes. The learned tokenizer is then fixed to provide stationary targets for a single autoregressive recommender, without feature imputation, modality-specific codebooks, or fallback mappings. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that UnpairGR consistently improves recommendation performance under both fully observed and incomplete-observation settings.

AI.tldr: UnpairGR提出了一种无需成对观测数据的多模态生成式推荐方法，通过共享Transformer和残差码本，从配对、纯图像和纯文本观测中学习统一的语义ID空间，在不进行特征插补的情况下提升推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成式推荐方法依赖成对的条目级观测数据来构建语义ID，这限制了tokenizer只能使用模态交集部分的数据。而整合非配对观测数据面临挑战：小的表示偏移可能跨越量化边界，产生不兼容的标识符序列。因此需要一个能够利用所有模态可用数据的统一方法。
AI.method: UnpairGR将模态特定的处理限制在轻量级输入投影中，共享后续的Transformer和残差码本跨所有观测条件。配对观测建立可靠性引导的跨模态共识，而单模态观测直接优化相同的表示和码本。学习后的tokenizer被固定，为单一自回归推荐器提供稳定的训练目标，无需特征插补、模态特定码本或回退映射。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，UnpairGR在完全观测和不完全观测两种设置下均持续提升了推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: UnpairGR通过统一语义ID空间有效利用了非配对的单模态数据，在无需复杂插补机制的情况下提升了生成式推荐的性能，为多模态推荐中的模态缺失问题提供了可行解决方案。

title: Reputation-driven Cooperation in Lattice-based Decentralized Federated Learning through Evolutionary Game Theory
summary: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) has emerged as an optimal privacy-preserving solution; however, it remains vulnerable to opportunistic behaviors due to the absence of a central coordinator. While Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) serves as a powerful framework for analyzing such behaviors, existing studies often assume that agents possess perfect rationality and maintain static strategies. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel EGT framework designed to analyze strategic evolution and enhance overall system performance. The primary contributions of this work are threefold: First, we model peer-to-peer (P2P) interactions on a lattice network structure under the assumption of bounded rationality. Second, we formulate a comprehensive payoff matrix incorporating training costs, communication overhead, and cooperative rewards, while tailoring a strategy update rule that captures spatial propagation dynamics. Third, we integrate a reputation-based reward-and-punishment mechanism to effectively deter free-riding behaviors. Simulation results demonstrate that the framework significantly outperforms the baseline. Specifically, it increases average accuracy from approximately 70% to 82%, elevates cooperation frequency to approach 100% (compared to below 5% in the baseline), and drops accuracy variance from around 0.40 to 0.002, thereby accelerating uniform convergence and ensuring system stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于演化博弈论（EGT）的联邦学习框架，在格子网络结构下模拟P2P交互，结合有界理性假设和声誉奖惩机制，有效遏制搭便车行为，将平均准确率从70%提升至82%，合作频率趋近100%，方差从0.40降至0.002。
AI.motivation: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）虽具隐私保护优势，但因缺乏中心协调者而易受机会主义行为攻击。现有演化博弈论（EGT）研究假设智能体完全理性和策略静态，与实际情况不符，需要更贴近现实的框架来分析策略演化。
AI.method: 该框架包含三部分：(1) 在格子网络结构上建模P2P交互，采用有界理性假设；(2) 构建包含训练成本、通信开销和合作奖励的全面收益矩阵，并定制策略更新规则以捕捉空间传播动态；(3) 集成基于声誉的奖惩机制以有效遏制搭便车行为。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明该框架显著优于基线：平均准确率从约70%提升至82%；合作频率从基线低于5%提升至接近100%；准确率方差从约0.40降至0.002，加速了统一收敛并确保了系统稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该演化博弈框架通过有界理性建模和声誉奖惩机制，有效提升了去中心化联邦学习的合作水平、准确率和系统稳定性，为DFL中机会主义行为的治理提供了新的理论视角和实用解决方案。

title: RefactorAssist: Agentic Refinement for Reliable Code Refactoring
comment: 27 pages, 10 figures, submitting to ACM TOSEM
summary: Code refactoring aims to enhance the internal structure of source code without affecting its functional behavior. The recent advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential for automating software engineering tasks, such as code refactoring. However, the refactorings produced by LLMs often introduce subtle errors, leading to functional behavior changes and failed unit tests, which limit their practical adoption. To address the limitations of LLM-generated refactorings, we analyze the root causes of their failures and develop the RefactorAssist agent to improve the functional correctness of LLM-generated refactorings. To this end, we use 10 open-source Java projects with their native test suites and manually evaluate why LLM-generated refactorings fail unit tests. We then design an agentic approach that leverages unit-test logs, error explanations, project context retrieval, and code diffs to guide the iterative refactoring. Our findings show that the main reasons for failure are context misunderstanding/hallucination (24.3%), incorrect or inconsistent renaming (15.3%), adding new functionality or variables (13.7%), code incompleteness (11.3%), syntax and structural errors (9.7%), edge cases not handled (9%), improper type handling (8.7%), and variables outside scope (8%). To make our approach cost-effective, RefactorAssist first applies a static repair step for missing imports, unbalanced brackets, and compilation errors without LLMs. For remaining failures, RefactorAssist incorporates error logs and code diffs, achieving up to a 70.8% repair rate on the remaining failures and a 94.2% cumulative pass rate under the best-performing configuration. These results indicate that static checks and test-guided, context-aware agentic repair can increase the reliability of LLM-generated refactorings, bringing them closer to practical integration within developer workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefactorAssist智能体，用于修复LLM生成代码重构时引入的功能错误。通过分析10个Java开源项目中发现的主要失败原因（如上下文误解/幻觉、重命名不一致等），设计了一个结合单元测试日志、错误解释、项目上下文检索和代码差异的迭代修复方法，在最佳配置下实现了70.8%的剩余失败修复率和94.2%的累计通过率。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的重构代码经常引入细微错误，导致功能行为改变和单元测试失败，限制了其在实际开发中的部署。现有方法缺乏对LLM重构失败根因的系统性分析，也没有有效的修复策略。
AI.method: 首先对10个开源Java项目中LLM生成重构失败的单元测试进行人工根因分析分类；然后设计RefactorAssist智能体，采用两阶段修复：(1)静态修复步骤（无需LLM）处理缺失导入、括号不平衡和编译错误；(2)基于LLM的迭代修复，利用单元测试日志、错误解释、项目上下文检索和代码差异信息指导重构。
