title: Deep Agentic Search for Repository-Level Code Question Answering: An Empirical Study
comment: 41 pages, 21 figures, 6 tables. Under review at a journal
summary: Code agents spend much of their effort simply locating the right code inside a repository. Two approaches dominate current practice. In Semantic Search, the agent retrieves code blocks from a vector index built from the repository in advance. In Deep Agentic Search (also known as grep-search by subagent), a planning agent delegates the exploration to a separate subagent that works in an isolated context window and returns only a condensed result. The second design, which is considered good context engineering practice, exists to protect the main agent from context pollution (also known as context rot), the loss of accuracy that occurs as unrelated material accumulates in the context window. Recent code agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, etc) have adopted it quickly, but there is little evidence on whether it produces better answers. We compare the two approaches on SWE-QA, a benchmark for repository-level code question answering. Semantic search answered 65.2% of questions correctly against 46.2% for deep agentic search, and it produced each correct answer at less than half the cost. To explain the gap, we then coded every failed run into a taxonomy of failure modes. The taxonomy shows that deep agentic search did not remove failures but introduced a new class of them: the single largest share of its failures, 41.8%, occurred at the hand-off between the planner and its sub-agent, and these were usually silent, ending in a fluent and confident answer that was wrong. Deep agentic search addresses a real problem and is now the preferred design in many code agents. However, our results show that the protection it offers may not be free, and that for read-only questions over a repository that can be indexed, retrieval was the stronger and cheaper option.

AI.tldr: 本文在SWE-QA基准上比较了语义搜索与深度智能体搜索（grep-search by subagent）两种代码检索策略。结果表明语义搜索正确率（65.2%）显著高于深度智能体搜索（46.2%），且成本不到后者一半。通过失败模式分类分析发现，深度智能体搜索的41.8%失败发生在规划者与子智能体的交接环节，且通常是"静默失败"——输出流畅自信但错误的答案。
AI.motivation: 深度智能体搜索（通过子智能体隔离上下文）已被Claude Code、Codex等主流代码智能体迅速采用，被视为良好的上下文工程实践以保护主智能体免受上下文污染。然而，缺乏证据表明这种设计能产出更好的答案，需要一个系统性的实证比较。
AI.method: 在SWE-QA基准（针对仓库级代码问答）上对比两种方法：1）语义搜索：从预先构建的向量索引中检索代码块；2）深度智能体搜索：规划智能体委托独立子智能体探索仓库并返回浓缩结果。随后将每个失败运行编码为失败模式分类体系，以解释性能差距。
AI.result: 语义搜索正确回答65.2%的问题，深度智能体搜索仅46.2%；且语义搜索每个正确答案的成本不到深度智能体搜索的一半。失败分类显示，深度智能体搜索并未消除失败，反而引入了新的失败类别：41.8%的失败发生在规划者与子智能体的交接环节，且大多是静默失败（输出流畅自信但答案错误）。
AI.conclusion: 深度智能体搜索解决了一个真实问题（上下文污染）并成为许多代码智能体的首选设计，但其提供的保护并非没有代价。对于可索引仓库的只读问题，传统的语义检索是更强且更便宜的选择。

title: Doc2CI: A Multi-Service Study of CI Configuration Generation Using Large Language Models
summary: Adopting Continuous Integration (CI) often requires writing YAML configurations that are error-prone and challenging to maintain. Despite increasing LLM use in software engineering, their ability to generate CI configurations from natural language across services and model families remains unclear. This paper presents a large empirical study on using LLMs to generate CI configurations. We introduce DOC2CI, a benchmark of 3,363 description-to-YAML pairs collected from the official documentation of four CI services, and evaluate 14 open-weight models from 7B-34B parameters together with GPT-4o and GPT-4.1, producing over 53,000 configurations. We assess both reference alignment and schema validity to determine whether the generated configurations are structurally valid. We further develop a failure taxonomy from a manual analysis of 385 configurations and examine why LLMs disagree. Across models and services, exact reference reproduction never exceeds 3.1%, and while 97% of outputs parse as YAML, only 71% satisfy service schemas. Larger models improve structural validity, but code specialization provides no consistent advantage over comparable general models. Model differences are driven largely by output completeness: for the same request, some models generate the expected fragment while others produce a full workflow. Finally, a training-free schema-guided repair method improves schema validity to 94%, while fine-tuning improves similarity to documentation but reduces standalone validity. This suggests that similarity and validity are distinct objectives for CI generation and motivate schema-aware evaluation and tooling for LLM-based configuration generation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个大规模实证研究，评估LLM生成CI配置（YAML）的能力。作者构建了DOC2CI基准（3,363条描述到YAML的配对，来自4个CI服务的官方文档），评估了14个开源模型（7B-34B）以及GPT-4o和GPT-4.1，生成了超过53,000个配置。研究发现：精确匹配率极低（不超过3.1%），虽97%输出可解析为YAML，但仅71%符合服务schema。更大的模型提升结构有效性，但代码特化模型并无一致优势。基于schema的无训练修复方法可将schema有效性提升至94%，而微调提升文档相似度但降低独立有效性。
AI.motivation: 采用持续集成（CI）通常需要编写容易出错且难以维护的YAML配置。尽管LLM在软件工程中的使用日益增多，但它们从自然语言生成CI配置的能力（跨服务和模型家族）仍不清楚。需要一个系统性的实证研究来评估这一能力。
AI.method: 构建了DOC2CI基准，从四个CI服务的官方文档中收集3,363个描述到YAML的配对。评估14个开源模型（7B-34B参数）和GPT-4o、GPT-4.1，共生成超过53,000个配置。评估包含参考对齐（reference alignment）和schema有效性两个维度。还开发了基于385个配置的人工分析的失败分类法，并研究LLM不一致的原因。最后提出了一个无训练的schema引导修复方法和微调方法进行对比。
AI.result: 精确参考复现率从未超过3.1%；97%的输出可解析为YAML，但仅71%满足服务schema。更大的模型改善结构有效性，但代码特化相对通用模型没有一致优势。模型差异主要由输出完整性驱动。无训练的schema引导修复将schema有效性提升至94%，而微调提高与文档的相似度但降低独立有效性。
AI.conclusion: 相似度（与参考文档的匹配）和有效性（符合schema）是CI生成的不同目标，这为基于LLM的配置生成需要schema感知的评估和工具支持提供了动机。

title: Attention-Steered Vision-Language Models for Sign Language Translation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful framework for multimodal video understanding. However, they remain limited in the sign language translation task, where we identify a key failure mode of existing VLMbased translators: poor spatial-temporal visual grounding. In particular, we find that standard next-token cross-entropy does not directly provide signal for where and when the model should attend, causing models to overlook sign-relevant regions and frames. To address this challenge, we propose AttnSign, a VLM-based spatial-temporal attention steering framework for sign language translation. AttnSign first introduces spatial attention supervision for sign-relevant regions, such as face and hands, in each frame; then develops an RL-based motion-cadence steering method that encourages the model to explore and focus on sign-level keyframes. Experimental results on How2Sign and OpenASL benchmarks show that our proposed AttnSign consistently outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AttnSign，一种基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的时空注意力引导框架，用于手语翻译任务。该方法通过空间注意力监督（聚焦面部和手部）和基于强化学习的运动节奏引导（聚焦关键帧），解决了现有VLM在手语翻译中空间-时间视觉定位不足的问题，在How2Sign和OpenASL基准上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在手语翻译任务中表现受限，关键失败模式是空间-时间视觉定位能力差。标准的下一token交叉熵损失无法直接为模型提供"应关注何处、何时"的信号，导致模型忽略与手语相关的区域和帧。
AI.method: AttnSign包含两个核心组件：(1) 空间注意力监督——为每帧中与手语相关的区域（如面部和手部）引入注意力监督；(2) 基于强化学习的运动节奏引导方法——鼓励模型探索并聚焦于手语级别的关键帧。
AI.result: 在How2Sign和OpenASL两个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，AttnSign持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式引导VLM的时空注意力，能够有效提升手语翻译的性能，验证了注意力引导策略在VLM手语翻译任务中的有效性和可行性。

title: Relative Parameter Importance in Task-Agnostic Replay-Free Continual Learning
comment: Accepted for publication at the SCL Workshop, ECML-PKDD 2026
summary: Achieving continual learning (CL) with deep neural networks requires balancing stability and plasticity while enabling knowledge transfer. In this work, we focus on offline learning algorithms under the constraints: (I) no access to training data from prior tasks (II) no access to task-id at inference time. We introduce a novel measure, the relative parameter-importance, which measures the relative importance of each parameter with respect to both the current and past tasks. Parameters with high relative importance are interpreted as more important for maintaining past-task stability and thus heavily regularised, whereas parameters with low relative-importance are allowed to be more freely updated. Unlike existing methods, our approach allows the update of parameters with high past-task importance when they have low relative-importance, thus enabling backward knowledge transfer in addition to tackling the stability-plasticity trade-off. We demonstrate improvements against state-of-the-art CL methods on both class-incremental and domain-incremental learning text classification problems and provide insights for extending our method to text generation problems. Code available at: https://github.com/itsmemala/LACL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的持续学习（CL）方法，通过引入"相对参数重要性"度量来平衡稳定性与可塑性，在无需访问先前任务数据和任务标识的条件下，支持向后知识迁移，并在文本分类（类增量与域增量）任务上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络实现持续学习需要平衡稳定性（保留过往知识）与可塑性（学习新任务），同时支持知识迁移。现有方法通常要么过度正则化高重要性参数导致可塑性不足，要么缺乏向后知识迁移能力。本文旨在提出一种新方法，在无先验数据和无任务ID约束下，同时解决稳定性-可塑性权衡与知识迁移问题。
AI.method: 引入"相对参数重要性"（relative parameter-importance）新度量，衡量每个参数相对于当前任务和过去任务的重要程度。高相对重要性参数被视为维持过去任务稳定性的关键，因此受到强正则化；低相对重要性参数则允许更自由更新。与现有方法不同，该方法允许在参数具有低相对重要性时更新高过去任务重要性的参数，从而在解决稳定性-可塑性权衡的同时实现向后知识迁移。
AI.result: 在类增量学习和域增量学习的文本分类问题上，与最新的持续学习方法相比展示了性能提升，并为将该方法扩展到文本生成问题提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过相对参数重要性度量，在离线持续学习设定下成功平衡了稳定性与可塑性，同时实现了向后知识迁移，在文本分类任务上优于现有方法，并具有扩展到文本生成任务的潜力。

title: The methodology of Constructing the Large-Scale Dataset for Detecting Presuicidal and Anti-Suicidal Signals in Social Media Texts in Russian
summary: The suicide is a terrifying act of a person who is misled by his own mental state. This problem arises across many countries. Sadly, Russia also has quite high number of persons who committed suicide. Luckily, a subset of these people writes their struggles in social media, allowing a way to find them and help. However, these valuable texts disappearing in many irrelevant texts which is considerably slowing down the decision process about person's suicidal risk. To tackle this problem, in this work we have presented a detailed methodology of building the dataset for detecting texts that describe presuicidal and anti-suicidal signals. This methodology describes the process of instruction and class table creation, the process of annotation, verification and post-annotation correction. Guiding by this methodology, we collect and annotate a large-scale Russian dataset with more than 50 thousand texts from social media. We provide a count statistic of the dataset as well as common problems in annotation. We also conduct basic experiments of building the classification models to show the on go performance on different levels of annotation. Furthermore, we make the dataset, code and all materials publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套构建自杀前兆与反自杀信号检测数据集的详细方法论，并据此收集标注了超过5万条俄语社交媒体文本的大型数据集，同时进行了基础分类实验并公开了所有资源。
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯自杀率较高，部分潜在自杀者会在社交媒体上留下文字线索，但这些有价值的信息淹没在海量无关文本中，严重影响了自杀风险评估的决策效率。为解决这一问题，需要构建高质量的数据集来训练检测模型。
AI.method: 提出了一套完整的数据集构建方法论，包括：指令与类别表的创建流程、标注过程、验证过程以及标注后修正过程。依据该方法论收集并标注了包含5万多条俄语社交媒体文本的数据集，并进行了基础分类实验以展示不同标注层次上的性能表现。
AI.result: 成功构建了包含超过5万条文本的大型俄语数据集，提供了数据集的统计信息以及标注过程中遇到的常见问题，并通过基础实验验证了分类模型在数据集上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集、代码及相关材料均已公开，为后续研究人员检测自杀前兆和反自杀信号文本提供了重要的资源基础，有助于加快自杀风险识别的决策过程。

title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.

AI.tldr: 本文发现AI代理在相同数值数据下会因情境框架不同而得出不同结论。在医学、选举预测和地缘政治预测等高风险领域中，通过保持证据不变而改变情境，研究发现AI代理的结论强烈受其先验信念影响，且框架还会改变代理的工作方式（搜索、分析规格、证据评估）。这揭示了将决策委托给AI代理的风险。
AI.motivation: AI代理越来越多地用于开放式任务，其结论可指导重大决策。如果AI代理的结论受其内部先验信念影响而非仅基于数据本身，那么将关键决策委托给AI代理将存在系统性风险，而这种风险可能不可见且不受任务控制。
AI.method: 采用受控实验设计：保持数值证据完全相同，仅改变证据出现的场景（实质性框架）。在医学、选举取证和地缘政治预测三个高风险领域中进行测试，共包含12个代理-领域比较。通过改变情境框架观察代理结论、搜索行为、分析规格选择和证据评估方式的变化。
AI.result: 在12个代理-领域比较中，代理的结论强烈受先验信念影响。当结论与其先验相符时，代理更可能得出肯定性结论；当框架与先验冲突时则相反。框架还改变了代理的工作方式：搜索更广泛、选择不同分析规格、对相同证据给出不同评估。
AI.conclusion: AI代理的决策可能依赖于既未在任务中指定、也不在决策记录中可见的先验信念，这构成了将决策委托给AI代理的特定风险，需要引起重视和进一步监管。

title: V-Mem: Modality-Routed Retrieval for Long-Term Multimodal Agentic Memory
summary: Interaction between users and LLM agents is increasingly multimodal: conversations interleave text with images, and a later question may target either. Yet most agent memories are designed around text, and even the few that support multimodal conversations still fail on vision-related questions. We trace this failure to an assumption behind the similarity search they rely on: in the index space, a query lies close to the relevant evidence that answers it. In multimodal settings, two gaps break it. By the modality gap, a query lies closer to memory content of its own modality than to evidence in another, even in a trained joint embedding space. By the similarity-relevance gap, the content most similar to a query is often not the evidence that answers it, most acutely when a query carries both text and image and its evidence resembles neither part alone. We present V-Mem, a multimodal agentic memory system that routes retrieval by the modality of the query and that of the target evidence, both recognized from the query alone. To cross the modality gap, V-Mem organizes the conversation into rounds and returns the target-modality content from the same round as the match, without comparing across modalities. To close the similarity-relevance gap, it searches with an LLM-generated anchor that sits closer to the relevant evidence than the query does: a hypothetical caption for a text-only query seeking an image, and an enriched search anchor, the query text plus relevant keywords extracted from the query image, when the evidence is reachable only by combining the two. On Mem-Gallery, V-Mem reaches an LLM-judge score of 0.82 versus 0.56 for the second best, with the largest margin on questions carrying an image (0.87, no baseline above 0.47); on LoCoMo it scores 0.69 versus 0.58.

AI.tldr: V-Mem是一个为多模态LLM智能体设计的记忆系统，通过按查询和目标证据的模态进行路由检索，并利用LLM生成的锚点（锚定到相关证据）来弥合模态差距和相似性-相关性差距。在Mem-Gallery和LoCoMo基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统主要围绕文本设计，即使支持多模态对话也无法很好地处理视觉相关查询。根本原因是相似性搜索的隐含假设（查询在索引空间中靠近相关证据）在多模态场景下被两个问题打破：模态差距（查询更靠近同模态内容）和相似性-相关性差距（最相似的内容不一定是能回答问题的最佳证据），尤其是当查询同时包含文本和图像时。
AI.method: V-Mem提出两个核心机制：(1) 按轮次组织对话，根据查询的模态（仅从查询识别）路由检索，从匹配的同一轮中返回目标模态内容，避免跨模态比较；(2) 使用LLM生成的锚来弥补相似性-相关性差距——对于追求图像的纯文本查询，生成假设性标题；当证据需要结合文本和图像时，使用富含关键词的搜索锚（查询文本+从查询图像提取的相关关键词）。
AI.result: 在Mem-Gallery上达到0.82的LLM评审分数（第二名为0.56），在带图像的查询上差距最大（0.87，无基线超过0.47）；在LoCoMo上得分为0.69对比0.58。
AI.conclusion: V-Mem通过显式识别查询和目标证据的模态，并利用LLM生成的锚点来拉近查询与相关证据在索引空间中的距离，有效解决了多模态记忆检索中的两个核心挑战，大幅提升了多模态对话中视觉相关问题的检索与回答能力。

title: An Empirical Investigation of Soft Skills and Corresponding Challenges in International Software Engineering Education
comment: to be published in the proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Software Engineering of Emerging Technologies, August 10-11, 2026, Pennsylvania, USA
summary: Joint software development work requires the application of technical skills and professional practices. Soft skills, such as teamwork, remain essential to succeeding in a professional software development environment. The phenomenon is reflected by group work in SE (software engineering) education, where students can learn and practice teamwork-related soft skills. Therefore, SE education requires students to practice those skills so that they can actively embark on their professional careers in the software industry. In this research study, empirical findings from two focus groups we conducted on group work are presented, with emphasis on the soft skills necessary for teamwork in international software engineering education, specifically student collaboration in higher education. There are several soft skills students should learn as they practice teamwork in their course-related assignments and exercises, as well as the challenges that come with it in international settings. The findings serve as a guideline to university teachers and pedagogy experts to plan student group work more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个焦点小组的实证研究，探讨了国际软件工程教育中团队合作所需的关键软技能及其挑战，为大学教师和教学专家规划学生小组作业提供指导。
AI.motivation: 软件工程专业工作中不仅需要技术能力，还需要团队合作等软技能。SE教育通过小组作业让学生学习和实践这些软技能，但在国际化高等教育背景下，学生对团队合作软技能的掌握和面临的挑战尚需深入理解。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，通过两个焦点小组（focus groups）对国际软件工程教育中的学生小组合作进行定性调查，重点收集学生对团队合作所需软技能及其挑战的经验反馈。
AI.result: 识别出学生在课程作业和练习中应学习的多种团队合作软技能，以及国际化背景下团队合作所面临的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为大学教师和教学法专家更有效地规划学生小组作业提供了指导方针，有助于在SE教育中培养学生的团队合作软技能以应对职业需求。

title: Latent-Centroid Steering: Single-Pass Classifier-Free Guidance for Command-Aligned Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving, enabling agents to map multimodal inputs and high-level navigation instructions directly to executable trajectories. However, in practice, these models exhibit a persistent command-following gap: predicted trajectories often show weak sensitivity to navigation commands, resulting in incorrect behavior at critical decision points. We identify this issue as a form of conditional policy collapse, where regression-based training under multimodal trajectory distributions encourages the model to rely on dominant visual priors while marginalizing the language-conditioned signal. To address this issue, we introduce a principled formulation of classifier-free guidance (CFG) for regression-based vision-language driving. We show that CFG can be interpreted as isolating the instruction-induced residual in the action space by contrasting conditional and unconditional predictions, thereby explicitly amplifying the effect of the navigation command at inference time. However, a standard two-pass CFG introduces prohibitive latency for real-time control and produces noisy instance-level guidance directions. Building on a mean-shift interpretation of CFG, we propose Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS), a single-pass guidance mechanism that replaces instance-level residuals with class-level latent shifts. By projecting conditional representations toward precomputed command-specific centroids, LCS performs class-level latent steering based on cluster geometry that is both more stable and computationally efficient. We demonstrate that LCS reduces inference latency by approximately 50% while achieving stronger command adherence and improved driving performance on both closed-loop (Bench2Drive) and open-loop (nuScenes) benchmarks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS)方法，解决视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中存在的命令跟随差距问题。LCS通过单次前向传播的类级潜在引导，替代标准的两次前向传播的classifier-free guidance (CFG)，显著降低推理延迟约50%，同时提升命令遵循能力和驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中的命令跟随能力存在持续差距：预测轨迹对导航命令的敏感度弱，在关键决策点表现错误。作者将其识别为条件策略崩溃(collapse)，即基于回归训练在多模态轨迹分布下，模型过度依赖主导性的视觉先验，而边缘化了语言条件信号。
AI.method: 作者首先将CFG形式化为回归式视觉语言驾驶的公式，即将CFG解释为通过在动作空间中对比条件和无条件预测来隔离指令诱导残差。然而标准的两次前向CFG延迟过高且产生噪声实例级引导。基于CFG的均值漂移解释，提出Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS)：单次前向引导机制，用类级潜在偏移替代实例级残差，将条件表示投影到预计算的命令特定质心上，基于聚类几何进行类级潜在引导。
AI.result: LCS在闭环基准(Bench2Drive)和开环基准(nuScenes)上均减少了约50%的推理延迟，同时实现了更强的命令遵循能力和更优的驾驶性能。
AI.conclusion: LCS作为单次前向的类级潜在引导机制，在保持CFG增强命令跟随能力优势的同时，解决了其计算延迟和噪声问题，为实时自动驾驶中语言条件轨迹生成提供了更高效稳定的方案。

title: Learning the Pareto Frontier of Predictive Models under Distribution Shift
summary:
Modern machine learning pipelines increasingly rely on reusing pretrained and foundation models across downstream tasks. These pretrained models can differ not only in performance but also in how they can be used: some only provide black-box predictions, while others may permit white-box access to internal representations that can be probed or fine-tuned. When deployed to the target domain in the presence of distribution shift, no single strategy, including zero-shot application, fine-tuning, or directly training a target-specific model, is uniformly the best.
  In this work, we propose Frontier Learning, a framework that treats a library of candidate models spanning different training histories and access regimes as complementary sources of information rather than mutually exclusive alternatives. Frontier Learning constructs a unified target-domain feature by concatenating internal representations from white-box candidates as well as prediction outputs from black-box candidates, then fits a lightweight, regularized supervised learner on this concatenated representation using labeled target data. Because the resulting hypothesis class contains predictors obtained by zero-shot reuse, fine-tuning, and direct training as special cases, empirical risk minimization over the frontier learner is guaranteed to be no worse, on the training sample, than any individual baseline.
  We evaluate the framework in simulations spanning varying degrees of source-target compatibility and in two real-world distribution-shift settings: visual domain adaptation on DomainNet/VisDA and clinical mortality prediction across intensive care unit domains using MIMIC-IV-Notes. Across all settings, Frontier Learning matches or outperforms the strongest individual reuse strategy, with the largest gains arising precisely when no single baseline is reliable across the range of shift considered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Frontier Learning框架，将来自不同预训练模型（包括黑盒和白盒）的信息进行拼接融合，构建统一的目标域特征表示，再拟合轻量级正则化监督学习器。该框架在理论上保证了经验风险不劣于任何单一基线策略，并在视觉域适应和临床死亡率预测等分布漂移场景中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习管线大量重用预训练模型，但这些模型在性能、访问方式（黑盒预测vs白盒内部表示）和使用策略（零样本、微调、直接训练）上存在差异。在分布漂移下没有单一策略始终最优，现有方法通常将这些模型视为互斥替代方案，而非互补信息来源。
AI.method: Frontier Learning框架：1）从白盒候选模型中提取内部表示，从黑盒候选模型中获取预测输出；2）将这些特征拼接为统一的目标域特征表示；3）在带标签的目标数据上拟合轻量级正则化监督学习器。该假设类包含零样本复用、微调和直接训练作为特例，因此经验风险最小化在训练样本上保证不低于任何单一基线。
AI.result: 在模拟实验（不同源-目标兼容度）和两个真实分布漂移场景（DomainNet/VisDA视觉域适应、MIMIC-IV-Notes的ICU死亡率预测）中，Frontier Learning匹配或超越了最强的单一复用策略。最大的增益出现在没有单一基线在漂移范围内可靠的情形下。
AI.conclusion: 将不同访问机制和训练历史的预训练模型视为互补信息源进行融合，可以稳健地应对分布漂移，且理论上保证不劣于任何单一基线，实践上在多种场景中达到最优或接近最优的性能。

title: The Learning Objective Governs Perceptual Narrowing: A Cross-Lingual, Layer-Wise, Ten-Seed Study of Self-Supervised Speech Encoders
summary: Perceptual narrowing---the developmental loss of non-native phoneme discrimination in the first year of life \citep{werker1984}---is a canonical developmental finding, yet \emph{what learning objective produces it} remains open. We train a \(\sim\)7\,M-parameter Transformer encoder on child-directed and read speech and evaluate phoneme ABX in English, French, and Mandarin over ten seeds, the seed as the unit of replication. Six results. \textbf{(1)}~The objective sets the direction of cross-lingual transfer: reconstruction (masked mel-prediction) degrades non-native discrimination, prediction (frame-contrastive) improves it---a same-encoder, same-data gap of \(+0.051\) in first-layer Mandarin ABX (\(p=3\times10^{-8}\)), unanimous in sign across twenty runs. \textbf{(2)}~That decline combines a large arm-intrinsic difficulty gradient with a smaller language-specialization effect (matched vs.\ mismatched \(+0.022\), \(p=10^{-4}\), all four layers). \textbf{(3)}~Against a language-symmetric raw-mel floor, reconstruction pushes the first layer \emph{below} the discriminability of its input; prediction pushes it \emph{above}. \textbf{(4)}~Read speech gives a \(3.6\times\) steeper non-native decline than child-directed speech. \textbf{(5)}~The customary three-seed budget cannot see this reliably: an effect unambiguous at ten seeds is called significant by as few as 70\% of three-seed subsets. \textbf{(6)}~Six objective configurations---sharpening, compression, consolidation, their composition, and word-level semantic grounding in two forms---fail to produce the full developmental signature (native improves \emph{and} non-native declines): a single objective moves both languages the same way because it acts on a shared representation. We conclude that the objective, not the architecture, is the first-order determinant of narrowing-shaped representational change.

AI.tldr: 本文通过训练约700万参数的Transformer编码器，系统比较了不同学习目标（重建vs预测）是否以及如何导致婴儿期知觉窄化（对非母语音素辨别能力的丧失）。研究发现学习目标而非架构是决定性因素：掩蔽重建目标损害非母语辨别，而帧对比预测目标反而提升之；同时揭示了三种子种子（seed）预算的统计功效不足问题，并排除了六种目标配置产生完整发展特征的可能性。
AI.motivation: 知觉窄化是发展心理学的经典发现，但产生它的学习目标（learning objective）究竟是什么至今未明。现有研究大多关注架构差异，而忽略了学习目标这一潜在的关键变量。作者希望系统性地回答：什么样的自监督学习目标能够复现婴儿期的知觉窄化现象？
AI.method: 作者训练一个约700万参数的Transformer编码器，分别在儿童导向语音和朗读语音上学习，采用两种主要目标：重建（掩蔽mel预测）和预测（帧对比）。在英语、法语和普通话三种语言上评估音素ABX辨别能力，以10个随机种子作为重复单元。同时测试了六种目标配置（锐化、压缩、巩固、组合以及两种词级语义接地变体）以探索完整发展特征（母语改善+非母语衰退）是否可能出现。
AI.result: (1) 学习目标决定跨语转移方向：重建使非母语辨别退化，预测使之改善，第一层普通话ABX差距+0.051（p=3×10⁻⁸），二十次运行方向一致；(2) 退化由大的固有难度梯度和较小的语言特化效应组成；(3) 重建使第一层低于输入的原始可辨性，预测使之上于输入；(4) 朗读语音的非母语衰退斜率是儿童导向语音的3.6倍；(5) 三个种子无法可靠检测此效应（十种子显著时，三种子子集仅70%显著）；(6) 六种目标配置均无法产生完整发展特征，因为单一目标对共享表征的作用使两种语言同向移动。
AI.conclusion: 学习目标（而非架构）是决定窄化形表征变化的一阶因素。重建类目标能产生非母语辨别退化，而预测类目标则不能；要复现完整的知觉窄化（母语同时改善），单一目标可能不足，需要更复杂的机制（如竞争性或多目标学习）。此外，研究强调使用足够多的随机种子（而非惯例的三个）以保证统计可靠性。

title: Gene Ontology-Guided Hierarchical Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology Images
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Code: https://github.com/NozomiMizore/MSGR
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histopathology images enables large-scale transcriptomic profiling without the cost of direct measurement. Existing methods decode the target gene set as a flat, unstructured vector, ignoring the inter-gene dependencies arising from shared biological pathways and regulatory programs. Without explicit structural guidance, models must infer these dependencies entirely from limited paired data, constraining prediction quality. We propose MSGR (Multi-Scale Gene Refiner), which bridges this gap by incorporating the Gene Ontology (GO), a curated functional hierarchy of genes, as an explicit structural prior. MSGR organizes target genes into a four-level GO tree. Its GO-guided decoder then progressively refines predictions from coarse functional domains to fine individual genes via residual corrections under scale-weighted supervision. Operating solely on the gene side, the GO-guided decoder serves as a seamless plug-in replacement that consistently improves existing architectures without requiring any image-side modifications. Extensive experiments on nine datasets from the HEST-1k benchmark provide empirical evidence for two central claims: GO-structured decoding consistently outperforms flat decoding, even against a state-of-the-art generative baseline, and the gain is attributable to biological ontology structure rather than hierarchical decomposition per se, as confirmed by a +0.027 margin over a structurally equivalent random hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 提出MSGR（多尺度基因精炼器），利用基因本体论（GO）作为显式结构先验，将基因组织成四层GO树，通过GO引导解码器从粗粒度功能域到细粒度单基因逐步精炼预测。在HEST-1k基准的九个数据集上，MSGR显著优于平面解码方法，且增益来源于生物本体论结构本身而非单纯的分层分解。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将目标基因组视为扁平、无结构向量进行解码，忽略了基因之间因共享生物通路和调控程序而产生的相互依赖关系。缺乏显式结构引导使得模型必须完全从有限的配对数据中推断这些依赖关系，限制了预测质量。
AI.method: MSGR将基因组织成四层GO树，其GO引导解码器通过残差校正，在尺度加权监督下从粗粒度功能域逐步精炼到细粒度单个基因的预测。该方法仅作用于基因端，作为即插即用的解码器替换，无需修改图像端架构。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k基准的九个数据集上，GO结构化解码一致优于扁平解码，包括优于最先进的生成式基线；与结构等价的随机层次相比，有+0.027的边际优势，验证了增益来自生物本体论结构本身。
AI.conclusion: MSGR证明了将生物本体论作为显式结构先验可以有效提升空间基因表达预测性能，且这种改进归因于真实的生物学层次结构而非一般性分层分解。GO引导解码器作为通用即插即用组件，可无缝提升现有架构的性能。

title: HindSearch: Trajectory-Level Hindsight Critique for Search-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
summary: Search-augmented LM agents are typically trained with a binary exact-match reward, which throws away most of what a failed trajectory tells us about why it failed. We introduce HindSearch, a hindsight self-distillation procedure for GRPO: after each rollout, a frozen judge writes a short critique of every failed trajectory using the gold answer, and the critique supplies an auxiliary on-policy distillation signal on the student's search actions. On the standard seven-benchmark suite with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, HindSearch reaches 39.4% average EM, outperforming prior search-RL baselines. Removing the judge's access to the gold answer erases most of the gain, isolating hindsight as the source of the improvement.

AI.tldr: HindSearch 是一种面向搜索增强型LM智能体的后见之明自蒸馏方法，在GRPO训练中引入冻结评审模型对失败轨迹进行批判，利用金标准答案提供辅助蒸馏信号，在七个基准套件上达到39.4%的平均EM，超越现有搜索RL基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的搜索增强型LM智能体训练通常使用二元的精确匹配奖励，这种奖励信号会丢弃失败轨迹中关于"为何失败"的大部分信息，导致训练效率低下。
AI.method: HindSearch的核心是后见之明自蒸馏过程：每轮rollout后，冻结的评审模型（judge）利用金标准答案对每条失败轨迹撰写简短批判，这些批判作为辅助的on-policy蒸馏信号，指导学生的搜索动作。
AI.result: 在标准七基准套件上，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，HindSearch达到39.4%的平均EM，优于先前的搜索RL基线。消融实验显示，移除评审模型对金标准答案的访问权会消除大部分性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 后见之明信息（金标准答案辅助的失败批判）是HindSearch性能提升的关键来源，验证了利用失败轨迹中的后见之明信号可以有效改善搜索增强型LM智能体的训练效果。

title: Semantically Calibrated Evidence Composition for CT Vision-Language Learning
summary: Learning transferable representations from CT-report pairs requires combining whole-volume context with anatomy-specific evidence. Existing methods typically emphasize either global CT-report alignment or fine-grained anatomy-level correspondence. Global alignment preserves broad study context but leaves the contribution of localized evidence implicit, whereas anatomy-level alignment explicitly grounds local findings but does not specify how independently represented evidence should interact, acquire study-level meaning, and contribute to a global CT representation. To address this gap, we propose SCOPE (Semantic Calibration Of comPosed Evidence), a framework for semantically calibrated evidence composition in CT vision-language learning. Under organ-specific report supervision, mask-guided queries with fixed anatomical identities extract context-aware organ evidence from shared, uncropped volumetric features, while an unrestricted global query retains access to whole-volume context. The global query then drives Local-Global Coupling to compose the organ evidence into a unified evidence representation. The composed evidence is subsequently calibrated using the diagnostic summary, providing study-level semantic supervision beyond local organ descriptions, and is finally integrated as a controlled residual into a context-preserving whole-volume representation aligned with the complete report. This progressive pathway connects localized evidence with study-level semantics without reducing the CT representation to a predefined set of organs. On CT-RATE and RadChestCT, SCOPE achieves macro AUCs of 85.0 and 72.2, respectively, outperforming the previous SOTA by 7.2 and 4.2, while also yielding substantial gains in linear probing and cross-modal retrieval. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of semantically calibrated evidence composition.

AI.tldr: SCOPE是一个用于CT影像-报告对的视觉-语言学习框架，通过语义校准的证据组合方法，将局部器官级证据与全局研究级语义相连接，在CT-RATE和RadChestCT数据集上分别达到85.0和72.2的macro AUC，超越了先前SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有CT视觉-语言学习方法存在两难：全局CT-报告对齐保留整体研究上下文但局部证据贡献不明确；解剖级对齐虽能显式定位局部发现，但未能说明独立表征的证据如何交互、获取研究级语义并贡献于全局CT表征。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: SCOPE框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 在器官特定报告监督下，使用具有固定解剖身份的掩码引导查询（mask-guided queries）从共享未裁剪的体素特征中提取上下文感知的器官证据，同时保留一个不受限制的全局查询访问整个体量上下文；(2) 通过局部-全局耦合（Local-Global Coupling）将器官证据组合为统一的证据表征；(3) 使用诊断摘要对组合证据进行语义校准（提供研究级语义监督），然后将校准后的证据作为受控残差整合到保留上下文的整体体积表征中，与完整报告对齐。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE和RadChestCT数据集上，SCOPE分别达到85.0和72.2的macro AUC，比先前SOTA分别高出7.2和4.2；在线性探测和跨模态检索任务中也获得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE通过渐进式路径将局部化证据与研究级语义相连接，同时不将CT表征简化为预定义的器官集合，验证了语义校准的证据组合方法的有效性。

title: Mitigating Backdoors via Decoy Shortcuts and Knowledge Decoupling
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to deep neural networks, especially when training relies on third-party data, allowing adversaries to inject malicious behaviors through data poisoning. In this work, we reveal that backdoor behaviors tend to be absorbed by a simpler parallel branch when jointly trained with the main network. Motivated by this insight, we propose Trapping and Removing (TR), a simple yet effective training-time defense that introduces a lightweight shortcut branch as a "honeypot" to trap backdoor knowledge. After training, backdoors can be removed by discarding the shortcut, without requiring any additional data. To further enhance backdoor isolation while maintaining benign performance, we design a knowledge decoupling strategy with entropy-based weight assignment, encouraging poisoned samples to flow through the honeypot while guiding the main network to focus on benign learning. In addition, we introduce an automatic shortcut generation strategy to improve generalization across model architectures. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets and five model architectures demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates a wide range of backdoor attacks while preserving performance on benign data. Code: https://github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR}{github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TR（Trapping and Removing）的训练时后门防御方法。其核心洞察是后门行为倾向于被一个更简单的并行分支吸收。TR通过引入一个轻量级捷径分支作为"蜜罐"来诱捕后门知识，训练后直接丢弃该分支即可移除后门，无需额外数据。实验在四个基准数据集和五种模型架构上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 后门攻击对深度神经网络构成严重威胁，尤其是在依赖第三方数据进行训练时，攻击者可通过数据投毒注入恶意行为。现有防御方法往往需要额外数据或复杂的后处理，本文旨在探索一种无需额外数据的训练时防御方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出Trapping and Removing (TR)框架，引入轻量级捷径分支作为"蜜罐"来诱捕后门知识，训练后直接丢弃该分支以移除后门；2) 设计基于熵的权重分配的知识解耦策略，促使中毒样本流向蜜罐分支，同时引导主网络专注于良性学习；3) 引入自动捷径生成策略以提升跨模型架构的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集和五种模型架构上的大量实验表明，该方法能有效缓解多种后门攻击，同时保持良性数据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: TR方法为后门防御提供了一种简洁有效的训练时解决方案，通过利用后门行为偏好简单分支的特性，实现了无需额外数据的后门隔离与移除。

title: Rethinking and formalising the state across languages: a unified computational learning theory account
summary: The linguistic notion of state has traditionally been restricted to the construct (annexation) state of Afroasiatic languages and treated as a language-specific morphosyntactic phenomenon. This article argues instead that the state is a systemic, context-dependent morphosyntactic mechanism that selects grammatical templates across synthetic languages. Within the Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework, taking Riffian as its primary empirical basis, the proposed theory provides a unified explanation for diverse nominal marking patterns traditionally analysed independently and is formalised as a symbolic computational model in which the state is represented by a set-valued function over grammatical templates. A learning algorithm based on finite-set operations acquires and predicts state-dependent grammatical configurations. Beyond nominal morphology, the framework has broader implications for theories of nominal structure and lexical cognition, in particular offering a unified analysis of determiner-noun structure. These results suggest that the state constitutes one instance of a broader class of syntactically conditioned dependencies that also includes agreement and grammatical case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语法态"（state）不应仅限于阿非罗-亚细亚语系的建构态，而是一个跨综合语的系统性的、依赖语境的形态句法机制。作者基于Riffian语，在模板模块化认知框架下，将语法态形式化为从语法模板到集合值函数的符号计算模型，并通过有限集运算的学习算法获取和预测依赖语法的构型。
AI.motivation: 传统的"语法态"概念被局限于阿非罗-亚细亚语系的建构态（annexation state），被视为特定语言特有的形态句法现象。作者认为这一认识过于狭隘，需要将其重新定位为跨语言通用的系统性机制。
AI.method: 提出Template-Based Modular Cognitive框架，以Riffian语为主要实证基础，将语法态形式化为一个集合值函数（set-valued function），作用于语法模板。同时设计了基于有限集运算的学习算法，用于获取和预测特定语法状态下的配置模式。
AI.result: 该框架为多种传统上被独立分析的名词标记模式提供了统一解释，并将分析扩展到限定词-名词结构，说明语法态与一致关系和语法格同属于更广泛的一类句法条件依赖。
AI.conclusion: 语法态是综合语中一类更广泛的句法条件依赖机制的实例，其意义超出了名词形态本身，对名词结构理论和词汇认知理论具有更广泛的影响。

title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
summary: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多义词在不同模态（图像vs文本）中如何被基础模型表达。通过对比17个文生图模型和15个文本生成模型，发现图像生成的多义性远低于文本生成，两者都远低于人类想象的多义多样性，揭示了一个"多模态鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 人类语言具有高度多义性，虽然已知LLM能理解词汇的多重含义，但多义词在图像等其他模态中如何被表达仍不清楚。理解这种跨模态的多义性差异对于评估基础模型的理解忠实度与均衡性至关重要。
AI.method: 对17个文生图模型和15个文本生成模型，给定无上下文的多义词提示，通过多次采样测量每个模型实际产生的语义分布（用归一化熵衡量）。同时要求模型自我报告对不同语义的生成概率分布，并与人脑想象的多义分布进行对比。
AI.result: 研究发现三个关键结果：(1) 多模态鸿沟——同一模型家族内，生成图像的语义多样性（归一化熵0.10）远低于生成文本（0.25）；(2) 两者都远低于人类对同一词汇的想象多样性（0.47）；(3) 模型自我报告的语义分布比其实际输出的分布更多样化，即模型对其多义理解存在"过度自信"。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在不同模态间对多义词的表达存在显著不一致性，其语义理解不能忠实且均衡地跨模态传递。这揭示了当前模型在表达词义多样性方面的系统性局限，对多模态AI的评估和部署具有重要启示。

title: Diagnosing Search Behavior and Failure Modes in Long-Horizon Search Agents
summary: Deep search agents answer difficult information-seeking questions by iteratively issuing search queries to gather supporting evidence, but it remains unclear whether and how greater search effort leads to better answers. We study these questions through a trajectory-level diagnosis of long-horizon search agents. Using human-annotated document-level relevance judgments, we evaluate the evidence retrieved at each search step and separate two stages of agent behavior: what evidence an agent retrieves and how effectively it uses that evidence. This distinction further allows us to decompose failures into retrieval gaps, where the necessary evidence is never found, and utilization gaps, where relevant evidence is retrieved but not used correctly. With the retrieval model and evaluation harness held fixed, we compare six agents on BrowseComp-Plus and further validate our findings on BrowseComp with an open-web search API. Across settings, we find that search effort and answer quality are only weakly aligned. Answer accuracy is better correlated with the quality of retrieved evidence, especially cumulative retrieval recall, than with the number of searches or the amount of context consumed. Useful evidence often appears early in the trajectory, yet agents tend to continue searching, producing a long tail of low-yield retrieval steps. At the query level, exploratory reformulations remain useful, but the best-performing agents issue far fewer redundant queries. Overall, by systematically characterizing the search behavior and failure modes of long-horizon search agents, this work points to practical directions for building better deep research systems, including stronger query formulation, more effective evidence selection and context management, and stopping criteria based on whether sufficient supporting evidence has been retrieved.

AI.tldr: 本文对长时程深度搜索智能体进行了轨迹级诊断分析，通过人工标注的文档级相关性判断，将智能体行为分为证据检索和证据利用两个阶段，并将失败分解为检索缺口（找不到必要证据）和利用缺口（找到证据但未正确使用）。研究发现搜索努力与答案质量相关性很弱，答案准确率与检索证据质量（尤其是累积检索召回率）的相关性远高于搜索次数或上下文消耗量。
AI.motivation: 深度搜索智能体通过迭代检索来回答困难问题，但搜索努力是否以及如何带来更好的答案仍不清楚。现有研究缺乏对长时程搜索智能体行为的系统性轨迹级诊断，无法明确回答"更多搜索是否意味着更好答案"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 使用人工标注的文档级相关性判断，在固定检索模型和评估框架的条件下，对比六个搜索智能体在BrowseComp-Plus上的表现，并用开放网络搜索API在BrowseComp上验证发现。将智能体行为分解为检索和利用两个阶段，区分检索缺口与利用缺口两类失败模式，并从轨迹级、查询级等多个维度进行分析。
AI.result: （1）搜索努力与答案质量仅弱对齐；（2）答案准确率与累积检索召回率的相关性高于搜索次数或上下文量；（3）有用证据常早期出现，但智能体倾向于继续搜索产生长尾低效步骤；（4）探索性查询改写仍然有用，但最佳智能体发出的冗余查询明显更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统刻画长时程搜索智能体的搜索行为和失败模式，本文为构建更好的深度研究系统指出了实用方向：更强的查询生成能力、更有效的证据选择与上下文管理，以及基于是否检索到足够支撑证据的停止准则。

title: Algorithm-driven Development: A Proactive Approach to Improving Software Quality and Reducing Defects
comment: Accepted for publication in The Journal of Systems & Software. Manuscript reference: JSSOFTWARE-D-26-00383R2
summary: Ensuring software quality while meeting deadlines and adapting to evolving requirements is a persistent challenge in software engineering practice. This paper introduces Algorithm-Driven Development (ADD), a methodology developed from industrial practice to address recurring challenges in translating requirements into reliable, testable, and maintainable software behavior. ADD translates requirements into algorithmic flowcharts from which acceptance tests are systematically derived. These flowcharts serve both as specification artifacts and as technical blueprints, supporting shared understanding between stakeholders and developers. By linking requirement modeling with automated test generation, ADD provides systematic coverage of functional scenarios, including edge cases, from the outset of development. The approach was evaluated over a four-year period within an industrial project at Dassault Systèmes, involving two development teams, 22,444 lines of production code for Team 1, and 157 APIs analyzed for Team 2. The evaluation combined longitudinal quality and delivery indicators with a comparative analysis of ADD, TDD, and test-last development practices across API functions of different complexity levels. Empirical data collected from internal lifecycle management and CI/CD systems show that ADD supported sustained code coverage above 95%, low defect density in both QA and post-release phases, and a stable delivery cadence. These findings provide evidence of ADD's potential to strengthen the connection between requirements, testing, and implementation in industrial software development contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为"算法驱动开发"(ADD)的软件工程方法论，它通过将需求转化为算法流程图，并从中系统性推导验收测试，从而弥合需求、测试与实现之间的鸿沟。该方法在达索系统(Dassault Systèmes)的工业项目中经过四年评估，两个团队参与，结果显示代码覆盖率持续保持在95%以上、缺陷密度低、交付节奏稳定。
AI.motivation: 软件工程实践中长期存在一个核心挑战：如何在保证软件质量的同时满足截止日期并适应不断变化的需求。传统的测试驱动开发(TDD)和测试后置(test-last)方法在需求转化为可靠、可测试、可维护软件行为的过程中仍存在反复出现的难题，需要一种更系统化的方法将需求建模与测试生成联系起来。
AI.method: ADD方法论的核心是将需求转化为算法流程图，这些流程图既作为规格说明工件，也作为技术蓝图，支持利益相关者与开发者之间的共同理解。从这些流程图中系统地推导出验收测试，从而在开发初期就实现功能场景（包括边界情况）的系统性覆盖。该方法将需求建模与自动化测试生成相链接。
AI.result: 在达索系统的四年工业评估中：团队1涉及22,444行生产代码，团队2分析了157个API。结果显示ADD支持持续保持95%以上的代码覆盖率，QA阶段和发布后阶段的缺陷密度均较低，且交付节奏稳定。此外，还进行了ADD、TDD和测试后置开发实践在不同复杂度API函数上的比较分析。
AI.conclusion: 实证数据表明ADD在工业软件开发环境中能够有效加强需求、测试与实现之间的联系，为提升软件质量、降低缺陷率同时维持稳定交付提供了有力证据。

title: MDWD: A Street-Level Dataset for Municipal Solid Waste Detection in Dense Urban Environments
comment: Accepted for publication at the 14th IEEE European Conference on Visual Information Processing (EUVIP 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Automated visual monitoring of urban environments is a growing Computer Vision research area, but municipal solid waste detection remains under-represented in dedicated benchmark resources. Existing waste-related datasets predominantly address individual litter detection, aerial imagery, or image-level classification, and none simultaneously provide street-level imagery, instance-level localization, and categorization of domestic waste streams within a structured municipal collection context. This paper introduces the Maltese Domestic Waste Dataset (MDWD), a street-level benchmark comprising 3,697 high-resolution images and 11,461 manually annotated instances across five domestic waste categories representative of Malta's municipal collection system. The dataset captures substantial variation in location, illumination, object scale, occlusion, and urban context. To establish reproducible baselines, a cross-architecture benchmark is conducted across multiple generations of the YOLO family and a transformer-based detector. On the test set, RF-DETR-M achieves the strongest overall performance with an mAP50 of 94.49% and an F1-score of 93.56%, whilst smaller-capacity variants maintain competitive accuracy at substantially reduced parameter counts. These results indicate that MDWD supports effective training across both compact real-time detectors and transformer-based models, establishing a benchmark for future research in vision-based municipal waste monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了马耳他城市生活垃圾数据集（MDWD），包含3,697张街景图像和11,461个手工标注实例，涵盖5类生活垃圾，并基于YOLO系列和Transformer检测器建立了跨架构基准，RF-DETR-M在测试集上取得最优性能（mAP50 94.49%，F1 93.56%）。
AI.motivation: 城市环境自动化视觉监测是增长中的研究领域，但城市固体废弃物检测缺乏专门的基准资源。现有废弃物数据集要么专注个别垃圾检测、要么是航拍图像或图像级分类，没有同时提供街景图像、实例级定位和按市政收集体系分类的国内废物流数据，因此需要一个新的基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建了马耳他城市生活垃圾数据集（MDWD），包含3,697张高分辨率街景图像和11,461个手工标注实例，覆盖5类与马耳他市政收集体系对应的垃圾类别。数据集体现了地点、光照、物体尺度、遮挡和城市背景的多样性。此外，进行了跨架构基准测试，涵盖多代YOLO系列和基于Transformer的检测器。
AI.result: 在测试集上，RF-DETR-M取得最优综合性能，mAP50达94.49%，F1分数为93.56%；较小容量模型在参数大幅减少的情况下仍保持有竞争力的精度。
AI.conclusion: MDWD能够有效支持紧凑型实时检测器和Transformer模型的训练，为未来基于视觉的城市废弃物监测研究建立了基准。

title: An Embedded RISC-V Evaluation of Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Hard-Constrained Recurrent Physics-Informed Models
comment: 6 pages, submitted to SBESC 2026 as an extension to the ICLR Workshop Paper https://openreview.net/forum?id=iHpbQn99RB
summary: Hard-constrained recurrent physics-informed networks (HRPINNs) embed known dynamics inside a recurrent numerical integrator and restrict a neural branch to learning only the residual dynamics that the first-principles model does not capture. Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have been proposed as parameter-efficient replacements for multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in such residual branches, but their learnable B-spline activations follow a markedly different execution profile. Building on prior work that characterized when a vanilla B-spline KAN matches or underperforms an MLP as an HRPINN residual branch in discovery accuracy, this paper asks whether that parameter efficiency survives deployment. Using identical trained weights, we measured execution latency, energy per integration step, and dependability under post-training quantization in the closed recurrent loop on a RISC-V RV64GC platform without vector extensions (StarFive VisionFive~2, SiFive U74). For the two accuracy-comparable pairs, the KAN residual branch executed $13.5\times$ and $8.0\times$ slower and consumed $11.3\times$ and $5.6\times$ more energy per integration step (3.7\,$μ$J against 0.33\,$μ$J for the smallest pair); across all four parameter-matched size tiers the ranges are $4.7\times$--$14.5\times$ and $4.7\times$--$18.7\times$. Under INT8 quantization, KAN trajectories diverged up to $43\times$ earlier than matched MLPs; the damage traces to weight quantization, not to input-side knot-interval misassignment. These results indicate that the parameter efficiency reported for KANs does not transfer to deployment cost on scalar embedded cores, and that an MLP residual branch is the more dependable default for embedded HRPINN deployment unless specific quantization co-design is used.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了KAN作为HRPINN残差分支在嵌入式RISC-V平台上的部署性能，发现KAN虽然参数高效，但执行速度慢4.7-14.5倍、能耗高4.7-18.7倍，且INT8量化下轨迹发散时间早达43倍，参数效率无法转化为部署成本优势，MLP是更可靠的默认选择。
AI.motivation: KAN被提出作为MLP的参数高效替代品用于HRPINN残差分支，但其可学习的B样条激活函数具有截然不同的执行特征。先前工作已表征了KAN与MLP在发现准确率上的匹配情况，但参数效率是否能转化为实际部署优势尚未验证。
AI.method: 使用相同的训练权重，在无向量扩展的RISC-V RV64GC平台（StarFive VisionFive 2，SiFive U74）上，测量KAN和MLP残差分支在封闭循环中的执行延迟、每积分步能耗以及后训练量化下的可靠性，覆盖四个参数匹配的尺寸层级及两组准确率可比较的配对。
AI.result: KAN残差分支在两个准确率可比配对中分别慢13.5倍和8.0倍，每步能耗高11.3倍和5.6倍（最小配对3.7μJ对0.33μJ）；全部四个尺寸层级范围为执行慢4.7-14.5倍，能耗高4.7-18.7倍。INT8量化下KAN轨迹发散比MLP早高达43倍，损伤主要归因于权重量化而非输入侧节点区间误分配。
AI.conclusion: KAN报告的参数效率无法转化为标量嵌入式核上的部署成本优势；除非采用特定的量化协同设计，MLP残差分支是嵌入式HRPINN部署中更可靠的默认选择。

title: S$^4$R: Selective Sampling, Subspaces, and Sparse Reconstruction for Compressed Long-Context KV Caching
summary: The growth of context window lengths in Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly enhances their long-context capabilities but incurs prohibitive memory costs due to the Key-Value (KV) cache. Although low-rank compression of KV cache is a promising remedy, existing methods face a dilemma: offline approaches depend on external calibration data, whereas online approaches incur substantial compute for full-prompt decomposition and reconstruction. In this paper, we propose S$^4$R, which builds low-rank subspaces from selectively sampled tokens and computes attention over a sparsely reconstructed KV representation. S$^4$R uses prompt-aware initialization to build initial key/value bases from a representative prompt subset, trading off calibration-data dependence against prefilling cost. Because fully reconstructing the cache at every decoding step is prohibitively expensive and hurts throughput, we further adopt sparse reconstruction to retain only informative positions during decoding. Extensive experiments on LongBench and RULER with Llama and Qwen model families show that S$^4$R achieves up to 5$\times$ KV compression with near full-cache accuracy, combining the efficiency of fixed compression with the adaptability of prompt-dependent methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S⁴R方法，通过从选择性采样token构建低秩子空间，并对稀疏重建的KV表示进行注意力计算，在长上下文LLM中实现高达5倍的KV缓存压缩，同时保持接近全缓存精度的性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM中KV缓存导致的内存成本过高是核心痛点。现有低秩压缩方法存在两难困境：离线方法依赖外部校准数据，在线方法则需要大量计算进行全提示分解与重建，两者都难以兼顾效率与适应性。
AI.method: S⁴R通过两个关键设计解决上述问题：(1) 提示感知初始化——从代表性提示子集构建初始键/值基，在减少校准数据依赖和预填充成本之间取得平衡；(2) 稀疏重建——在每个解码步骤仅保留信息位置，避免完全重建缓存带来的过高计算开销和吞吐量损失。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER基准上，使用Llama和Qwen模型家族的实验表明，S⁴R实现了高达5倍的KV压缩，同时保持接近全缓存精度的表现，兼具固定压缩方法的效率与提示依赖方法的适应性。
AI.conclusion: S⁴R有效解决了低秩KV压缩中离线与在线方法的矛盾，证明了通过选择性采样和稀疏重建可以在大幅压缩KV缓存的同时保持模型性能，为长上下文LLM的内存效率优化提供了新的可行路径。

title: SymboUQ: Symbolic Uncertainty Quantification for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) can produce fluent spatial reasoning traces, their intermediate relations may fail to support the final conclusion, making token-level confidence insufficient for final-answer reliability estimation. Existing formal verifiers provide stronger semantic evidence, but their applicability is partial: a parsed claim need not yield a definite semantic verdict. To address this issue, we introduce SymboUQ, a symbolic uncertainty quantification framework that estimates final-answer reliability from reasoning traces by distinguishing symbolizability, whether a claim can be represented in the verifier's formal language, from semantic determinacy, whether its execution yields an entailed or contradicted verdict rather than an unknown or not-evaluable outcome. SymboUQ comprises (i) a Layout Auditor that executes ordered spatial claims and extracts feasibility, conflict, and repair evidence; (ii) a label-free Determinacy Profile that characterizes effective executable coverage; and (iii) a Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer that integrates constraint-based, representation-based, and decoding-based scores according to verifier applicability. Extensive experiments on five spatial reasoning benchmarks with four frozen LLM backbones show that SymboUQ achieves approximately an 8% relative improvement in AUROC and a 7% relative reduction in class-balanced Brier loss over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: SymboUQ是一个符号化不确定性量化框架，通过区分可符号化性和语义确定性，从推理轨迹中估计大语言模型最终答案的可靠性。实验表明其在五个空间推理基准上相比最强基线在AUROC上提升约8%，在类平衡Brier损失上降低约7%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然能生成流畅的空间推理轨迹，但其中间关系可能无法支撑最终结论，基于token级置信度不足以可靠估计最终答案的可靠性。现有的形式化验证器虽然能提供更强的语义证据，但适用性有限——解析出的声明不一定能产生确定性的语义判定结果。
AI.method: SymboUQ包含三个核心组件：(i) Layout Auditor——执行有序空间声明，提取可行性、冲突和修复证据；(ii) 无标签的确定性画像（Determinacy Profile）——刻画有效可执行覆盖率；(iii) 确定性感知可靠性组合器（Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer）——根据验证器适用性整合基于约束、基于表示和基于解码的评分。
AI.result: 在五个空间推理基准和四个冻结LLM骨干上的广泛实验表明，SymboUQ相比最强基线在AUROC上实现了约8%的相对提升，在类平衡Brier损失上实现了约7%的相对降低。
AI.conclusion: SymboUQ通过区分可符号化性与语义确定性，有效解决了形式化验证器适用性有限的问题，为空间推理任务中的最终答案可靠性估计提供了更稳健的符号化不确定性量化方案。

title: Fetch-then-Explore: Decoupling Selection from Extraction over a Persistent Workspace for Search Agents
summary: Search agents now answer questions that take dozens of searches to settle, yet how such an agent reads a page has drawn far less attention than how it finds one. Nearly all of them use one of two document interfaces, and both tie a page to the moment it is opened. \emph{Visit-and-read} injects a reading of the page into the message history at fetch time, fixing that reading before the agent knows which fact it will need. Stateful \emph{browsing} instead extracts on demand from the page in hand, but holds one page at a time and releases it as soon as the agent opens another. Either way, a page that turns out to matter many turns later has to be fetched and rendered into context all over again. We propose \textbf{Fetch-then-Explore}, which separates page selection from evidence extraction and keeps what it selects: pages are recorded in a per-question workspace on the filesystem rather than the context window or a transient session, and evidence is pulled from them on demand later. Selection becomes almost free, extraction can wait until the agent knows what to look for and be repeated as its hypothesis sharpens, and pages are not released when the agent moves on, so evidence accumulates across the trajectory. In a unified ReAct harness with fixed search, we compare Fetch-then-Explore against snippet-only, visit-and-read, and browsing baselines on two open-web benchmarks, BrowseComp and WideSearch, across three agent backbones. It leads BrowseComp accuracy at every backbone and generally matches or exceeds the baselines on WideSearch, and a behavioral analysis traces the gains to the workspace's defining move: returning to a page after leaving it, which it does far more than any transient interface, so evidence missed on a first pass can still be recovered later.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fetch-then-Explore，一种将页面选择与证据提取分离的搜索代理文档接口设计。与主流的visit-and-read和browsing接口不同，该方法将页面保存在文件系统的每问题工作区中，而非上下文窗口或临时会话，允许按需提取证据并可反复访问页面。在BrowseComp和WideSearch两个基准上、三种代理骨干下，该方法在BrowseComp上全面领先基线，在WideSearch上通常匹配或超越基线，行为分析表明其收益主要来自对离开后的页面进行回访的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索代理在回答需要数十次搜索的问题时，对"如何找到页面"投入了大量关注，但对"如何阅读页面"却关注不足。当前主流的两类文档接口——visit-and-read（取回时注入阅读内容）和有状态browsing（按需提取但仅持有一页）——都将页面绑定在打开的瞬间，导致后期才变得重要的页面需要重新获取和渲染进上下文，造成效率低下和信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出Fetch-then-Explore架构：(1) 将页面选择与证据提取分离，页面被记录在文件系统的每问题工作区中而非上下文窗口；(2) 证据提取延迟到代理明确知道需要什么时才进行，并可随假设的完善而重复；(3) 页面不会在代理转向其他页面时被释放，证据可跨轨迹累积。在统一ReAct框架下与snippet-only、visit-and-read和browsing基线进行比较。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp和WideSearch两个开放网络基准上、三种代理骨干（backbone）下测试。该方法在BrowseComp上每个骨干都取得了最高准确率，在WideSearch上通常匹配或超越基线。行为分析表明收益主要源于工作区的关键机制：在离开页面后回访该页面，这一行为远超任何临时接口，使得首次遗漏的证据仍可在后续恢复。
AI.conclusion: Fetch-then-Explore证明将页面持久化存储而非绑定于打开时刻的瞬间状态，能显著提升搜索代理的证据提取质量。它揭示了"回访"行为的重要性——证据的获取不应受限于首次接触页面时的即时需求，而应允许在整个回答轨迹中持续累积和迭代。

title: How Well Do LLMs Generate Taxonomies in the SE Domain? A Multi-perspective Evaluation Framework
comment: 13 pages, Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026), Research Papers Track
summary: Taxonomies provide a shared conceptual framework for organizing heterogeneous observations in software engineering (SE) research. Manually constructing such taxonomies is labor-intensive and requires annotators with expertise in the SE domain. While advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have led to the emergence of automated taxonomy generation methods outside the SE domain, their applicability to technically complex SE artifacts remains unclear. In this experience paper, we present the first comprehensive empirical evaluation of how state-of-the-art automated methods perform on SE artifacts through a multi-perspective evaluation framework, including taxonomy quality, alignment with taxonomies defined by human experts, reliability under independent annotation, and efficiency. To support this evaluation, we systematically collect seven SE papers with publicly available artifacts and human-defined taxonomies, and conduct experiments using two automated methods (TnT-LLM and CLIMB) with five state-of-the-art LLMs. Our evaluation reveals a clear trade-off: TnT-LLM constructs high-quality taxonomies comparable to human-defined ones but incurs substantially higher cost and runtime and tends to generate overly complex taxonomies, whereas CLIMB is 15--40$\times$ faster and 8--49$\times$ cheaper but tends to score lower on quality when technical inference beyond surface-level similarity is required. These findings suggest that TnT-LLM and CLIMB can be used in practical situations in the SE domain, while researchers should first assess the complexity of the generated taxonomies and their cost using a subset of the target data to decide whether to use automated methods or human experts. Our work represents a first step toward a systematic understanding of automated taxonomy generation in SE, offering actionable insights for future research and practice.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对软件工程（SE）领域的自动化分类体系生成方法进行了全面的实证评估，比较了TnT-LLM和CLIMB两种方法在五个先进LLM上的表现，发现TnT-LLM生成的分类体系质量接近人工定义但成本高、运行慢，而CLIMB更快更便宜但在需要技术推理的任务上质量较低。
AI.motivation: 软件工程研究中分类体系的构建通常依赖人工标注，耗时且需要领域专家。虽然LLM推动了SE领域之外的自动化分类体系生成方法的发展，但这些方法是否适用于技术复杂度高的SE工件仍不清楚，因此需要系统的实证评估。
AI.method: 研究收集了7篇带有公开工件和人工定义分类体系的SE论文，采用多视角评估框架（包括分类体系质量、与人类专家定义的对齐程度、独立标注的可靠性以及效率），使用TnT-LLM和CLIMB两种自动化方法配合五种SOTA LLMs进行实验。
AI.result: 发现存在明显的权衡：TnT-LLM能生成与人工定义可比的高质量分类体系，但成本和运行时显著更高，且倾向于生成过于复杂的分类体系；CLIMB则快15-40倍、便宜8-49倍，但在需要超越表面相似性的技术推理时质量评分较低。
AI.conclusion: TnT-LLM和CLIMB在SE领域具有实际应用价值，但研究者应先使用目标数据的子集评估生成分类体系的复杂性和成本，再决定使用自动化方法还是人工专家。该工作为SE领域自动化分类体系生成提供了系统性理解和可操作的见解。

title: Interpretability-Guided Soft Pruning of Attention Heads in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision foundation models, such as DINOv2, learn highly expressive representations but rely on massive, opaque architectures that demand substantial computational power and memory. To provide an interpretable-guided and efficient solution to this issue, we first propose a spectral analysis and new visualization technique for individual attention heads based on the Laplacian eigenvectors of their attention maps. Building upon recent observations regarding the block structure of Vision Transformers, we perform semantic clustering of attention heads and identify functional redundancies. Leveraging these insights, we introduce SAPER (Soft Attention PrunER), an end-to-end differentiable pruning framework based on the LapSum Soft Top-K approach. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that SAPER achieves a highly favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, outperforming the competitive RAPTOR baseline in FLOPs reduction while preserving strong classification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAPER，一种基于谱分析和注意头语义聚类的端到端可微剪枝框架，用于压缩视觉基础模型（如DINOv2），在ImageNet-1K上实现了良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）虽然学习到高度表达力的表示，但其架构庞大且不透明，需要巨大的计算资源和内存。作者希望通过可解释性引导的方式设计更高效的模型压缩方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于注意图Laplacian特征向量的谱分析和可视化技术，用于分析单个注意力头；2) 基于Vision Transformer的块结构观察，对注意力头进行语义聚类并识别功能冗余；3) 引入SAPER（Soft Attention PrunER），一种基于LapSum Soft Top-K的端到端可微剪枝框架。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上的大量实验表明，SAPER在FLOPs减少方面优于竞争性的RAPTOR基线，同时保持了较强的分类性能，实现了非常有利的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过谱分析和语义聚类揭示注意头的功能冗余，SAPER实现了可解释引导的高效注意力剪枝，为视觉基础模型压缩提供了新思路。

title: Generic Vision and Cross-Attention for Reaction Yield Prediction
summary: Traditional reaction yield prediction is constrained by 1D quantum descriptors that lack explicit spatial information. To address this gap, a dual-modal Vision Cross-Attention architecture is proposed, fusing tabular physical-organic data with 2D molecular topologies. Notably, it is demonstrated that a generic computer vision backbone processing simple 2D skeletal structures independently outperforms purely quantum-based baselines. By synergizing both modalities, superior predictive accuracy compared to traditional methodologies is achieved by the optimal cross-attention framework (Test RMSE = 5.27%). Through mechanistic probing, active, descriptor-guided spatial querying is observed, effectively offloading macroscopic steric identification to the visual pathway. Furthermore, a dynamic chemical hierarchy is learned by the network to heavily prioritize critical steric bottlenecks, such as the aryl halide. Concurrently, residual skip connections are utilized to protect non-spatial electronic parameters from destructive attenuation during fusion. Collectively, a scalable and highly interpretable blueprint is provided for augmenting physical chemistry with deep visual learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双模态视觉交叉注意力（Vision Cross-Attention）架构用于化学反应产率预测，融合表格化的物理有机数据与2D分子拓扑结构。研究发现，仅使用通用计算机视觉骨干网络处理简单2D骨架结构的性能就优于纯量子描述符基线，而最优的交叉注意力框架结合两种模态后实现了卓越的预测精度（Test RMSE = 5.27%）。通过机制探针分析，网络展现出主动的、描述符引导的空间查询能力，并将大尺度位阻识别卸载给视觉通路，同时利用残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数不被破坏性衰减。这项工作为物理化学与深度视觉学习的融合提供了可扩展且高度可解释的蓝图。
AI.motivation: 传统反应产率预测依赖于一维量子描述符，缺乏显式的空间信息，限制了预测精度和模型对分子空间结构的理解能力。
AI.method: 提出双模态Vision Cross-Attention架构，融合表格化物理有机数据与2D分子拓扑。将通用计算机视觉骨干网络应用于简单2D骨架结构，并通过交叉注意力机制整合两种模态信息，同时设计残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数。
AI.result: 最优交叉注意力框架在测试集上取得RMSE=5.27%的预测精度，优于传统方法。单视觉模态优于纯量子描述符基线。机制探针证明网络学习到动态化学层级，能够优先关注关键位阻瓶颈（如芳基卤化物）。
AI.conclusion: 双模态视觉交叉注意力架构为反应产率预测提供了更优的精度和高度可解释性，展示了将深度视觉学习与物理化学结合的可行性和潜力。

title: Native Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
summary: Large Language Models have achieved substantial progress in reasoning capabilities. Yet in low-resource native settings, many suffer from cross-lingual collapse, reverting to English during intermediate steps that require complex logical reasoning. This presents a cold-start bottleneck for policy optimization, whereas standard fine-tuning risks catastrophic forgetting due to cross-lingual representation drift. To address these challenges, we introduce the Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation (OSCD), a post-training algorithm that projects high-resource reasoning trajectories into low-resource vocabulary subspaces during generative training rollouts via an integrated translator agentic loop, ensuring the stable and efficient translation of dynamically generated reference samples for fine-tuning. This is coupled with joint-embedding semantic alignment of both reference and target-language reasoning traces, thereby bridging the pairwise cross-lingual representational gaps. Comprehensive evaluations using the AIME25 and HMMT25 benchmarks demonstrate that OSCD yields up to 3.2 times overall improvements in native Southeast Asian languages for mathematical reasoning, of which the joint-embedding semantic alignment component contributes up to 6.4% improvements in linguistic debiasing over translation-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSCD（Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation）算法，解决低资源语言下大语言模型在复杂推理中发生跨语言坍缩（回退到英语）的问题。该算法通过集成的翻译器代理循环，将高资源语言的推理轨迹投影到低资源词汇子空间，并结合联合嵌入语义对齐来弥合跨语言表征差距。在AIME25和HMMT25基准上，东南亚低资源语言数学推理能力提升高达3.2倍，其中联合嵌入语义对齐组件相比纯翻译基线在语言去偏上贡献了6.4%的提升。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言环境下，大语言模型在复杂逻辑推理的中间步骤中经常发生跨语言坍缩（回退到英语），这造成了策略优化的冷启动瓶颈；而标准微调则因跨语言表征漂移面临灾难性遗忘的风险。因此需要一个既能稳定高效翻译参考样本、又能保持语言一致性的后训练方法。
AI.method: OSCD包含两个核心组件：（1）Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation：通过集成翻译器代理循环，在生成式训练rollout过程中将高资源语言的推理轨迹投影到低资源语言的词汇子空间，实现动态生成参考样本的稳定高效翻译；（2）联合嵌入语义对齐：对参考语言和目标语言的推理轨迹进行语义对齐，弥合成对跨语言表征差距。
AI.result: 在AIME25和HMMT25基准上，OSCD在东南亚低资源语言的数学推理任务上实现了最高3.2倍的整体提升；其中联合嵌入语义对齐组件相对于纯翻译基线，在语言去偏方面贡献了高达6.4%的改进。
AI.conclusion: OSCD有效解决了低资源语言场景下LLM的跨语言坍缩问题，通过结合跨蒸馏和语义对齐的后训练策略，在不引发灾难性遗忘的前提下显著提升了原生低资源语言的数学推理能力，证明了该方法的有效性与实用性。

title: Mask-Based Priors Are More Persistent than Query-Key Initializations
summary: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer在布尔外推任务上不仅缺乏数据，还会以系统性错误的方式泛化。作者提出用可学习的注意力掩码（learnable attention-logit bias）来替代传统的QK初始化方法，将结构先验直接注入注意力机制，使其在训练中保持持久，从而在布尔推理任务上实现近乎完美的外推表现。
AI.motivation: Transformer在布尔外推任务上存在系统性错误的泛化行为——它们倾向于拟合最小次数的插值器而非真实目标函数。现有基于QK投影的结构化初始化方法虽然旨在注入结构先验，但在布尔外推任务中这些先验会被训练快速覆盖，无法改变学习到的外推规则。因此需要一种更直接、更持久的结构先验注入方式。
AI.method: 提出掩码初始化方法：直接初始化加法注意力掩码（additive attention mask），即一个有限且可学习的注意力logit偏置，从任务层面的交互结构初始化得到。与传统硬掩码（如因果掩码）不同，该掩码是可学习的，并且将结构先验与内容相关的注意力分数分离，使得先验能够在整个优化过程中持续存在。与QK初始化形成对比，这种方法不被训练快速覆盖。
AI.result: 在布尔推理任务上，掩码初始化实现了近乎完美的外推性能，而普通Transformer和QK初始化的Transformer仍被困在默认归纳偏置中。该方法同样改善低数据算术任务的表现，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 注意力掩码不仅可以作为架构约束，更可以作为编码持久归纳偏置的简单载体。这一发现表明，将结构先验以可学习掩码形式直接注入注意力机制，是纠正Transformer系统性错误泛化的有效途径。

title: Do Static Embeddings Add Value to Hybrid Dutch Retrieval?
summary: Embedding benchmarks measure standalone model quality, but they do not establish whether a low-cost retriever contributes complementary ranking information once lexical and transformer-based retrieval are already combined. We present a controlled evaluation of this question across Dutch retrieval tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark for Dutch (MTEB-NL). Weighted reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) combines Best Matching 25 (BM25), Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (Qwen), and two multilingual static embedding models. Five datasets comprising 14,500 queries and 786,573 documents are scored exhaustively, and fusion weights are searched on a simplex in increments of 0.1. Ten-fold query-level cross-validation selects weights on nine folds and evaluates them on the held-out fold; paired bootstrap confidence intervals and sign-randomisation tests quantify the resulting differences. Fusion improves over the training-selected individual retriever by 0.061 mean reciprocal rank (MRR) on Dutch News, 0.029 on VABB, 0.004 on WebFAQ NL, and 0.025 on Wikipedia NL, while matching BM25 on Open Tender. All four positive differences remain distinguishable from zero after Holm correction. No unrestricted fold assigns positive weight to either static retriever: all 50 selections lie on the BM25-Qwen edge, and forcing a static contribution reduces effectiveness. Leave-one-dataset-out selection chooses equal BM25-Qwen weighting in every iteration and outperforms the cross-domain-selected individual retriever on every held-out task. The results support a two-retriever lexical-transformer architecture as a robust tested default across the evaluated Dutch tasks and show that standalone benchmark performance is insufficient to establish marginal value in hybrid retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文针对荷兰语检索任务，系统评估了在BM25和Transformer检索器（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B）组合基础上，静态嵌入模型是否能提供补充的排序信息。通过加权倒数秩融合（RRF）和十折交叉验证，发现所有50次权重选择都落在BM25-Qwen边上，静态检索器未被赋予正权重，表明双检索器（词法+Transformer）架构是稳健的默认选择。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入基准（如MTEB）仅衡量检索器独立质量，无法回答一个关键问题：低成本检索器在已有词法和Transformer检索器组合时，是否还能贡献互补的排序信息。作者希望通过受控实验填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用加权倒数秩融合（RRF）将BM25、Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B及两个多语言静态嵌入模型组合。在MTEB-NL的5个荷兰语数据集（14,500查询，786,573文档）上进行穷举打分，在单纯形上以0.1步长搜索融合权重，采用十折查询级交叉验证选择权重，并使用配对bootstrap置信区间和符号随机化检验量化差异。
AI.result: 融合在Dutch News上MRR提升0.061，VABB提升0.029，WebFAQ NL提升0.004，Wikipedia NL提升0.025，在Open Tender上与BM25持平。四个正向差异经Holm校正后仍显著。所有50次权重选择均落在BM25-Qwen边上，静态检索器未被赋予正权重。留一数据集选择中每次迭代都选择BM25-Qwen等权加权。
AI.conclusion: 支持词法+Transformer的双检索器架构作为荷兰语任务的稳健默认配置；静态嵌入模型在已有混合检索组合中没有边际价值。标准基准性能不足以预测混合检索中的贡献，需要更直接的边际价值评估方法。

title: AI-assisted Script Management for Requirements Elicitation Interviews
summary: Requirements elicitation interviews require interviewers to balance topic coverage, active listening, and adaptive probing while responding to stakeholders in real time. Although prior work has explored AI support for isolated interviewing tasks, such as script generation and follow-up question generation, little is known about how integrated support affects the interview and what requirements artifacts emerge. Furthermore, script management---which helps the interviewer track topic coverage in real time and decide when to probe further---remains underexplored. This paper presents an AI-assisted elicitation workflow that combines theory-guided script generation grounded in business goals with live support for topic coverage tracking and on-demand follow-up question generation. We evaluate the workflow in a between-subjects quasi-experimental study comparing a no-training, AI-assisted condition with a training, AI-unassisted condition. Based on a rubric derived from elicitation best practices, the AI-generated scripts score higher than training-only scripts (92.8 vs. 74.8 out of 100). AI-assisted interviews cover fewer topics (9.6 vs. 14.5), cover more scripted questions (86% vs. 69%), ask more follow-ups per topic (3.43 vs. 1.15), and produce more refined goal models (lowest-level goal fraction 0.653 vs. 0.598). Participants find script management useful, rating topic tracking as the most useful workflow feature (86% agreement). Collectively, these results show that the AI-assisted condition is associated with a different interview trajectory and different elicited requirements than a training-only condition, positioning AI-assisted workflows as elicitation scaffolds for future studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合理论驱动的脚本生成与实时主题覆盖跟踪及按需追问生成的AI辅助需求获取工作流，并通过准实验研究证明其相比仅培训条件能生成更高质量的脚本、产生更精细的目标模型，并改变访谈轨迹。
AI.motivation: 需求获取访谈要求访谈者同时平衡主题覆盖、主动倾听和实时追问，而先前研究仅探索了AI对孤立任务的辅助（如脚本生成、追问生成），对于集成式AI支持如何影响整个访谈过程及其产出的需求工件缺乏了解。此外，脚本管理（帮助访谈者实时跟踪主题覆盖并决定何时深入追问）仍是一个未被充分探索的领域。
AI.method: 本文提出一个AI辅助的需求获取工作流，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于业务目标的理论驱动脚本生成；(2) 实时主题覆盖跟踪；(3) 按需追问问题生成。研究采用被试间准实验设计，比较AI辅助（无培训）与仅培训（无AI）两种条件，并基于需求获取最佳实践制定的评分标准对脚本质量进行评估，同时分析访谈的主题覆盖、脚本问题覆盖率、追问频率及目标模型的精化程度。
AI.result: AI生成脚本评分显著高于仅培训脚本（92.8 vs 74.8，满分100）；AI辅助访谈覆盖主题更少（9.6 vs 14.5），但脚本问题覆盖率更高（86% vs 69%）、每主题追问更多（3.43 vs 1.15），并产生更精化的目标模型（最低层目标占比0.653 vs 0.598）。参与者认为脚本管理有用，其中主题跟踪被评为最有用的功能（86%同意）。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助条件与仅培训条件相比，呈现出不同的访谈轨迹和不同的需求产出，表明AI辅助工作流可作为需求获取的脚手架（elicitation scaffold），为未来研究提供了新的方向。

title: ORCA: ORgan-Centroid Aggregation for Training-Free 3D CT Visual Token Compression
summary: A 3D CT scan entering a vision-language model produces a long sequence of visual tokens, often thousands to tens of thousands per volume, and this sequence must be compressed before a language model can consume it. Token compression is well studied in general vision, but little of it targets 3D CT specifically. A common baseline is grid average, which pools regular grid cells and can blend distinct anatomy, lesion, and air into one token. We present \textbf{ORCA} (ORgan-Centroid Aggregation), a token compressor for 3D CT. It merges adjacent tokens with organ guidance and adds a sinusoidal encoding of each region's centroid to preserve spatial layout. This preserves the anatomical information a downstream model needs. ORCA is training-free and plug-and-play, producing an adjustable token set without any model change or text query. We evaluate it across two datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin) and five encoders. The evaluation spans two task types: attribute prediction over five families (size, density, location, texture, and disease) and text generation (visual question answering and report generation). At matched token budgets, ORCA improves consistently over existing compression methods. It shrinks the visual context $64\times$ and its KV-cache $50\times$, and is $31\times$ faster to process each volume. Code released at https://github.com/renjie-liang/ORCA-3DCT.

AI.tldr: ORCA是一种面向3D CT扫描的、无需训练的视觉token压缩器，通过器官引导合并相邻token并加入区域质心的正弦编码来保留空间解剖信息，在多个数据集和编码器上一致优于现有压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 3D CT扫描进入视觉语言模型会产生数千到数万长度的视觉token序列，必须压缩后才能被语言模型处理。现有token压缩方法多面向通用视觉，很少专门针对3D CT。常见的网格平均基线会混合不同的解剖结构、病灶和空气，丢失关键信息。
AI.method: ORCA（ORgan-Centroid Aggregation）是一种器官质心聚合的token压缩器。它利用器官引导合并相邻token，并为每个区域质心添加正弦编码以保留空间布局。该方法无需训练、即插即用，无需修改模型或文本查询，可生成可调节大小的token集。
AI.result: 在两个数据集（CT-RATE和Merlin）及五个编码器上评估，涵盖属性预测（大小、密度、位置、纹理、疾病五类）和文本生成（视觉问答和报告生成）两类任务。在匹配token预算下，ORCA一致优于现有压缩方法，将视觉上下文压缩64倍，KV缓存压缩50倍，处理每个体积的速度提升31倍。
AI.conclusion: ORCA通过器官引导的token聚合和质心编码，在3D CT视觉语言模型场景中有效保留了解剖信息，实现了显著优于现有方法的压缩性能，且不依赖训练和模型修改，具备良好的通用性和即插即用性。

title: Paris as a 15-Minute City: An Explainable AI Perspective
comment: 17 pages, 16 figures. Extended report of a poster presented at the NetMob 2025 conference on 8 October 2025
summary:
The 15-minute city promotes access to everyday services within a short walk or bicycle ride, but its relationship with observed mobility remains difficult to quantify. We investigate this relationship in the Paris metropolitan area using mobility trajectories from the NetMob 2025 Data Challenge, enriched with INSEE sociodemographic data and OpenStreetMap points of interest (POIs), yielding approximately 70,000 trip segments after stop-based segmentation and data cleaning.
  We construct walking- and cycling-based indicators of local service availability and examine their associations with trip duration, transport mode, and short-trip car use. Higher POI availability is associated with less private motorized travel and more active mobility, although this relationship is substantially weaker in the outer agglomeration. Gradient-boosted tree models interpreted with explainable machine-learning methods consistently identify trip purpose, home--work distance, local service availability, vehicle ownership, public-transport subscription, and sociodemographic context as important predictors. For short trips, high POI density is associated with lower car use, while car ownership and driving-licence availability are associated with higher predicted car use; where services are sparse, public-transport subscription is associated with lower predicted car dependence. Finally, explainable AI (XAI) methods are used to examine how feature attributions change under alternative assumed variable orderings.
  The results are consistent with central assumptions of the 15-minute city while revealing substantial spatial and demographic heterogeneity. They also demonstrate how explainable machine-learning methods can complement accessibility indicators and identify locally relevant hypotheses for urban-mobility policy.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用NetMob 2025数据挑战中的巴黎大都市区移动轨迹数据（约7万条出行段），结合INSEE社会人口数据和OpenStreetMap兴趣点，构建步行和骑行导向的15分钟城市可达性指标，并通过可解释机器学习方法分析其与出行时长、交通方式及短途驾车行为的关系。
AI.motivation: 15分钟城市理念强调步行和骑行范围内获取日常服务，但其与实际出行行为之间的关系难以量化。现有研究缺乏将可达性指标与大规模真实出行轨迹结合的分析，需要实证方法验证15分钟城市的核心假设。
AI.method: 使用NetMob 2025数据挑战的移动轨迹数据，通过停留点分割和数据清洗得到约7万条出行段；基于OpenStreetMap兴趣点构建步行和骑行的本地服务可达性指标；采用梯度提升树模型结合可解释机器学习（XAI）方法分析特征重要性，并检验特征归因在不同变量排序下的稳健性。
AI.result: 更高的POI可达性与更少的私人机动化出行和更多的主动出行相关，但在外圈集聚区这种关系显著减弱。POI密度高时短途驾车减少，而车辆拥有和驾照与更高的预计驾车出行相关；服务稀疏地区公共交通订阅与更低的驾车依赖相关。出行目的、家到工作距离、本地服务可达性、车辆拥有、公共交通订阅和社会人口背景是关键预测因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持15分钟城市的核心假设，同时揭示了显著的空间和社会人口异质性。可解释机器学习方法能够补充传统的可达性指标，并为城市出行政策识别本地相关的政策假设。

title: DE-NER : Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition via Dialogue Elicitation of Large Language Models
summary: Recent advancements of zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) establish strong baselines by formulating sequence labeling into question answering where Large Language Models (LLMs) can be naturally adopted. However, existing LLM-based zero-shot NER methods suffer from the limitations of prompt and demonstration engineering. To address these issues with minimal human interventions, we introduce DE-NER, a dialogue elicitation framework which elicits the chatting ability of LLMs to fully extract the knowledge encoded in LLMs. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperform the competitive baselines in zero-shot settings across multiple benchmarks, with an average improvement of 3.75\% F1 points. Codes are released in https://github.com/kkkenshi/DE-NER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DE-NER，一种利用对话引导（dialogue elicitation）框架来激发大语言模型（LLM）的对话能力，从而实现零样本命名实体识别（NER）的方法，在多个基准上平均提升3.75% F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的零样本NER方法通过将序列标注转化为问答任务来利用LLM，但这些方法受限于提示词（prompt）和示例（demonstration）工程的设计，需要人工干预且难以充分发挥LLM的知识编码能力。
AI.method: 提出DE-NER对话引导框架，通过激发LLM的对话能力（chatting ability），以对话式的方式充分提取LLM内编码的知识，减少对提示词和示例工程的人工依赖。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的零样本设置下，DE-NER优于竞争基线方法，平均提升3.75% F1分数。
AI.conclusion: DE-NER证明了通过对话引导方式利用LLM内在知识进行零样本NER的有效性，并且代码已开源。

title: TrAC: Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent reasoning traces that nevertheless lead to incorrect answers, making response-level uncertainty estimation important for abstention, human review, and adaptive compute allocation. Existing approaches generally fall into three categories: passive single-trace methods use token-level confidence signals, sampling-based methods compare multiple complete traces at higher generation cost, and active prefix-based methods probe partial traces to study answer stabilization or preference transitions. However, none actively re-elicits an answer from a completed reasoning trace to measure its consistency with and support for the original answer. To address this gap, we introduce Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency (TrAC), a correctness-supervised uncertainty quantification framework that combines active and passive signals anchored to one completed reasoning trace. Its active component, Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE), re-elicits a short answer conditioned on the completed trace and represents both its consistency with the original answer and its token-level probabilistic support. Its passive component, Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP), summarizes how token-level uncertainty evolves throughout the original generation without additional decoding. A lightweight head then integrates the two representations into a response-correctness score. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three LLM families, TrAC improves macro AUROC by 1.8% and reduces AURC by 3.4% relative to eight-sample self-consistency, while using one complete reasoning trace and a short cached answer probe. When eight samples are already available, augmenting sample consensus with re-elicitation further improves macro AUROC by 4.3% and reduces AURC by 8.3%, without additional full-trace generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrAC框架，一种结合主动与被动信号的不确定性量化方法，基于单个完整推理轨迹进行答案再elicitation，在5个数学推理基准上相比8样本自一致性提升1.8% AUROC并降低3.4% AURC，且只需一个完整推理轨迹。
AI.motivation: LLM能生成流畅但错误的推理轨迹，因此响应级不确定性估计对弃权、人工审查和自适应计算分配至关重要。现有方法分为被动单轨迹（token级置信度）、采样多轨迹对比（代价高）和主动前缀探测三类，但均未主动从完整推理轨迹中重新elicitation答案来测量其与原始答案的一致性和支持度。
AI.method: 提出TrAC（Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency），包含两个组件：(1) 主动组件PCE（Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation）：基于完整推理轨迹重新elicitation短答案，同时表示其与原始答案的一致性和token级概率支持；(2) 被动组件TUP（Trace Uncertainty Profile）：总结原始生成过程中token级不确定性演化，无需额外解码。两者通过轻量级head整合为响应正确性分数。
AI.result: 在5个数学推理基准和3个LLM家族上，TrAC相比8样本自一致性：宏观AUROC提升1.8%，AURC降低3.4%，且只需一个完整推理轨迹加一个缓存答案探测。当已有8个样本时，用re-elicitation增强样本共识可进一步提升宏观AUROC 4.3%，降低AURC 8.3%，且无需额外完整轨迹生成。
AI.conclusion: 主动re-elicitation策略能有效利用单个完整推理轨迹提高不确定性估计的准确性，且其收益可叠加到已有的采样共识方法上，在计算成本和估计质量之间提供了更优的权衡。

title: Abduction Without a Body? Representational Grounding and the Abduction Loop for Scientific Hypothesis Generation
