comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. DAB-30 execution reported in companion paper
summary: Can scientific abduction occur without continuous sensorimotor embodiment? Recent arguments in AI and philosophy of science hold that genuine hypothesis generation requires an agent continuously coupled to the physical world. We defend a narrower claim: online embodiment is not necessary for every abductive scientific act. Our focus is identity abduction: the inference that two independently developed structures are one object under an explicit correspondence, reached through representational grounding rather than bodily interaction. An agent may acquire new inferential affordances not through physical interaction but through transformations into representations that expose latent invariants. Scientific diagrams are a practical substrate because they embody independently evolved conventions that partially canonicalize symmetry, topology, and operator structure across disciplines - a property we develop as convention space, which answers a hard retrieval problem: finding mathematically related work when two fields share no discriminating vocabulary. We operationalize the mechanism as an architecture, the Abduction Loop: representation generation, motif extraction, convention-space canonicalization, cross-domain retrieval, identity-hypothesis generation, and adversarial verification, with abstention as the designed default. A documented episode, in which a multimodal model given a figure of a gravitational-memory transport model generated and then verified the hypothesis that its central differential complex is equivalent to the spherical Kaiser-Squires mass-mapping complex of weak-lensing cosmology, serves as a motivating possibility witness from which the architecture is abstracted, not as evidence of general capability. We close with a falsifiable evaluation program, the DAB-30 benchmark. The contribution is a mechanistic proposal, an architecture, and a test program.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了科学溯因推理（abduction）并非必须依赖连续的具身感知交互。作者提出"身份溯因"（identity abduction）这一更窄的主张：智能体可以通过表征转换暴露潜在不变性，从而获得新的推理能力，而非依赖物理交互。论文提出"Abduction Loop"架构（包括表征生成、动机提取、约定空间规范化、跨领域检索、身份假设生成和对抗验证），并以一个实例（多模态模型从引力记忆输运模型图中推断出其微分复形等价于弱引力透镜宇宙学的Kaiser-Squires质量映射复形）作为动机性"可能性证人"，最后提出DAB-30基准作为可证伪的评估程序。
AI.motivation: 挑战AI与科学哲学中"真正假设生成必须依赖连续的感觉运动具身体验"的主流观点。作者并不否定具身化在一般科学溯因中的价值，而是论证存在一类特定的溯因行为（身份溯因）可以不依赖在线具身实现，为纯表征层面的科学发现机制提供理论依据。
AI.method: 提出"约定空间"（convention space）概念，解释不同学科中独立演化的图示约定如何部分规范化了对称性、拓扑和算子结构，从而解决跨领域检索的词汇不匹配难题。在此基础上构建"Abduction Loop"架构：表征生成→动机提取→约定空间规范化→跨领域检索→身份假设生成→对抗验证，并以"弃权"作为设计默认行为。通过一个具体案例（引力记忆输运模型与Kaiser-Squires质量映射的等价性发现）作为提炼架构的动机性证据。
AI.result: 论文的贡献是三重：一个机制性主张（在线具身并非所有溯因行为的必要条件）、一个具体架构（Abduction Loop）、以及一个可证伪的评估程序（DAB-30基准）。案例被明确定位为"可能性证人"（possibility witness）而非通用能力的证据。
AI.conclusion: 在线具身对于身份溯因并非必要，表征层面的转换足以支撑科学发现。但结论是审慎的：当前工作仅提出机制建议和测试计划，通用能力仍需通过DAB-30基准在未来验证。这不仅是对具身认知论的一次重要修正，也为跨学科科学发现提供了可操作的计算框架。

title: Coding Agents as Test-Suite Auditors: Finding What Official Suites Miss While Approaching What They Catch
summary: Online-judge verdicts and the datasets and benchmarks built on them are treated as ground truth for evaluating and training large language models for code. Yet prior audits have sounded a warning: official suites accept buggy submissions. These audits, however, stop at the warning and offer no practical remedy. Our remedy has two parts: an off-the-shelf coding agent, serving as a test-suite auditor, both builds adversarial test suites to expose what official suites miss and supplies these suites where no official suite exists; a certification chain determines whether each agent-flagged submission is genuinely buggy without relying on the official judge: multiple independently written accepted solutions agree on the expected output for every test, brute-force solutions settle disagreements, and a per-problem validator certifies each failing input legal. One such agent identifies 589 verified accepted-but-buggy submissions among AtCoder's 20,375 audited accepted submissions; extending the same certification to all five agents yields a union floor of 906 such submissions. Five agents, scored separately, each stay within 1.7pp of official-suite coverage on logic bugs those suites catch. On post-cutoff Codeforces problems with no available official suites, the same test-building method leads all five reproduced baselines at every tested input budget. Where an official suite exists, the agent audits suite adequacy instead of assuming it; where none exists, agent suites catch the most buggy submissions among methods we reproduced and tested.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双重补救方案来审计在线评测系统中的buggy提交：使用现成的编码智能体构建对抗性测试集，并通过认证链（多个独立接受解一致、暴力解仲裁、逐题验证器）验证被标记的提交是否真正有bug。该方案在AtCoder上识别出589-906个被接受但有bug的提交，并在五个智能体上保持了接近官方套件的覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 在线评测平台的判定结果以及基于它们构建的数据集和基准，被视为评估和训练大语言模型代码能力的"金标准"（ground truth）。然而此前的审计已经发出警告：官方测试套件会接受有bug的提交。但这些审计止步于警告，没有提供任何实用的补救方案。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 使用现成的编码智能体作为测试套件审计员，构建对抗性测试集来暴露官方套件遗漏的bug，并在没有官方测试集的地方提供测试套件；(2) 构建认证链来判定每个被智能体标记的提交是否真的有问题，而不依赖官方评测：多个独立编写的被接受解在每个测试上输出一致、暴力解解决分歧、逐题验证器确保每个失败的输入合法。
AI.result: 一个智能体在AtCoder的20,375个被审计的接受提交中识别出589个经验证的"已接受但有bug"的提交；将相同的认证扩展到全部五个智能体，得到至少906个此类提交的并集下界。五个智能体分别评分，在官方套件能捕捉的逻辑bug上的覆盖率均保持在官方套件的1.7个百分点以内。在没有官方套件的截止后Codeforces问题上，相同的测试构建方法在所有测试输入预算下都使所有五个复现的基线表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 该方法的优势在于：在有官方套件的地方，智能体审计套件的充分性而非假设其可靠；在没有官方套件的地方，智能体套件在捕捉buggy提交方面优于所复现和测试的其他方法。

title: The 1st AI Children Challenge
summary: The First AI Children Challenge aims to advance real-world applications of computer vision and AI in child healthcare, child education, and pediatrics. The 2026 CV4CHL edition featured the first track in this domain: Children Gait Visual Analysis. The main goal of Children Gait Visual Analysis is the fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors from keypoint sequences. This is still a big challenge for human action recognition. Experienced medical doctors can distinguish these subtle nuances, but none of the people test AI models in this domain. To bridge this gap, we introduce thousands of 2D children keypoint sequences walking around videos across various age groups of children (3-16 years old). There is a significant opportunity for batch analysis of these videos to provide clinically relevant insights into medical diagnosis. The Challenge will be launched with two problem tracks: Edinburgh Visual Gait Score (EVGS) Scoring and Classification of Gait Patterns in Bilateral Spastic Cerebral Palsy. Each track is chosen in consultation with board-certified pediatricians based on the value of potential solutions. With the first available dataset for such tasks and ground truth for each track, the challenge enabled participants to evaluate their solutions. Final rankings will be revealed after the competition concludes, fostering reproducibility and mitigating overfitting.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了第一届AI儿童挑战赛（CV4CHL 2026）中的"儿童步态视觉分析"赛道，旨在通过2D关键点序列实现儿童步态的细粒度分析。挑战赛包含两个子任务：爱丁堡视觉步态评分（EVGS）和双侧痉挛性脑瘫步态模式分类，并提供了首个涵盖3-16岁儿童的大规模数据集。
AI.motivation: 儿童步态的细粒度分析对人类行为识别仍是巨大挑战，经验丰富的医生能区分细微差异，但缺乏针对该领域的AI模型评估。为弥合这一鸿沟，作者发起该挑战并提供大规模儿童关键点数据集，以推动计算机视觉在儿童医疗保健、教育和儿科领域的实际应用。
AI.method: 该挑战赛建立一个包含数千条2D儿童关键点序列的数据集，涵盖3-16岁不同年龄段的儿童步行视频。竞赛设计两个子赛道：EVGS评分和双侧重痉挛性脑瘫步态模式分类，每个赛道均与认证儿科医生共同协商确定。数据集提供了各赛道的真实标注，供参赛者评估解决方案。
AI.result: 提供了该领域首个可用的儿童步态分析数据集，并为两个赛道提供了真实标注。挑战赛正在进行中，最终排名将在竞赛结束后公布，以确保可复现性并缓解过拟合问题。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛填补了儿童步态视觉分析领域AI研究的空白，为临床诊断提供有价值的批量分析工具，并促进该领域研究的可复现性发展。

title: AdvPlan-Bench: Adversarial Evaluation of Structured Plan-Generation Agents
summary: Structured plan-generation agents are often evaluated as if a plan has quality in isolation, yet many realistic planning tasks require asking how a candidate behaves when another agent can search for responses. We introduce AdvPlan-Bench, an offline benchmark for adversarial evaluation of structured plan-generation agents. The contribution is a general evaluation object: a typed plan, an adversarial response set, selector diagnostics, and traceable candidate-frontier metrics. AdvPlan-Bench represents plans as typed action chains with optional branches, assigns synthetic quality scores, compares opposing plans with BLUE-vs-RED advantage and Nash-gap diagnostics, and evaluates qualitative constraint coherence with a transparent heuristic rubric. In 150 synthetic scenarios spanning five planning templates, a sampled best-response policy that draws eight response candidates reduces BLUE advantage from .518 to .486 and BLUE win rate from .900 to .820 relative to a single-sample response. An offline LLM-policy contract baseline reaches .496 BLUE advantage and .700 BLUE win rate, while a two-stage multi-agent council obtains .509 BLUE advantage and .813 BLUE win rate. A three-rater rubric-sensitivity study over 600 rating records yields .978 inter-rater agreement. AdvPlan-Bench is not an operational planner and provides no evidence about real-world decision quality; it is a reproducible benchmark artifact for studying adversarial plan evaluation, response-budget sensitivity, candidate frontiers, and multi-agent critique-and-revision traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdvPlan-Bench，一个用于对抗性评估结构化规划生成代理的离线基准。该基准引入通用评估对象（类型化计划、对抗响应集、选择器诊断、可追踪候选边界指标），包含五个规划模板下的150个合成场景。实验表明，采样最佳响应策略与多智能体委员会均能降低BLUE优势，模型间一致性高。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化规划生成代理的评估方式往往孤立地评判计划本身的质量，但现实规划任务需要考虑候选计划在面对其他智能体搜索响应时的表现。缺乏一种能够进行对抗性评估的通用基准来研究此类互动场景。
AI.method: 将计划表示为带可选分支的类型化动作链，赋予合成质量分数，使用BLUE-vs-RED优势和Nash-gap诊断比较对立计划，并通过透明启发式规则评估定性约束一致性。设计了150个覆盖五种规划模板的合成场景，引入对抗响应集与候选边界指标。
AI.result: 采样最佳响应策略（8个候选）将BLUE优势从.518降至.486，BLUE胜率从.900降至.820；离线LLM策略基线达到.496 BLUE优势与.700胜率；两阶段多智能体委员会达到.509优势与.813胜率。三评分者敏感性研究在600条评分记录上达到.978的评分者间一致性。
AI.conclusion: AdvPlan-Bench是一个可复现的基准工件，用于研究对抗性计划评估、响应预算敏感性、候选边界和多智能体批评-修订轨迹。它不是运营规划器，也不提供关于真实世界决策质量的证据。

title: Loanword or Switch? The Annotation Boundary, Not the Model, Drives Kazakh-Russian Code-Switching Identification
comment: 5 pages. Preprint. Submitted to W-NUT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/naadgob/KazNLP
summary: Off-the-shelf LID and letter heuristics over-label Kazakh-Russian social text as mixed: Russian loanwords inside Kazakh look like code-switching under a shared Cyrillic script. We release a document-level gold LID set whose guideline keeps integrated borrowings as Kazakh and reserves mixed for clause-level switches, plus a mixed-only sentiment pool used after LID in a filter-first cascade. On a shared LID test, FastText, Lingua, raw and windowed HeLI, character-trigram NB, and XLM-R range from weak to strong performance. The gap shows the bottleneck is the loanword-vs-switch annotation boundary, not model class alone.

AI.tldr: 本文针对哈萨克语-俄语社交媒体文本，指出现有的现成语言识别（LID）工具会因共享西里尔字母而将俄语借词误标为语码转换。作者发布了一个文档级金标准LID数据集（将整合借词归为哈萨克语，仅将从句级切换视为混合），以及一个仅含混合语料的情绪分析池，用于LID之后进行过滤级联。实验表明FastText、Lingua、HeLI、字符三元组NB和XLM-R等模型性能差异显著，揭示瓶颈在于借词与语码转换的标注边界，而非模型类别本身。
AI.motivation: 现成的LID工具和字母启发式方法无法准确区分哈萨克语文本中的俄语借词与真正的语码转换，导致社交媒体文本被过度标注为混合语言，影响下游任务（如情绪分析）的准确性。
AI.method: 发布文档级金标准LID数据集，标注指南将整合借词归为哈萨克语、仅从句级切换视为混合；构建仅含混合语料的情绪分析池；采用过滤级联（filter-first cascade）流程，先做LID再执行情绪分析；在共享LID测试集上对比FastText、Lingua、HeLI（原始与窗口式）、字符三元组朴素贝叶斯及XLM-R等模型。
AI.result: 各模型在共享LID测试集上表现从弱到强差异显著，性能差距揭示了核心瓶颈在于借词与语码切换的标注边界问题，而非单纯模型类别所导致。
AI.conclusion: 借词与语码切换的注释边界是哈萨克-俄语社交文本LID的主要挑战，单纯改进模型类别不足以解决该问题，需要更精细的标注指南和数据集支撑。

title: Diagnose Before You Compress: Prediction-Independent Bottleneck Witness Refinement for LLM Serving Traces
summary: Production LLM serving generates millions of diverse requests, making full-trace replay across serving configurations increasingly expensive. Existing trace reduction methods mainly preserve workload distributions or representative requests, but bottleneck-revealing workloads may be rare and non-representative. Moreover, evidence for one component cannot compensate for missing evidence in another, while using predicted bottlenecks as target truth creates circular evaluation. These limitations make it necessary to preserve evidence for every bottleneck component rather than rely on workload representativeness alone. We propose Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW), a quality-constrained framework for compact and diagnostically reliable LLM serving replay suites. BPW first performs Workload Candidate Nomination using response-blind workload features and closed source-side measurements. This stage identifies workloads that may expose scheduler, prefill, decode, or KV-cache bottlenecks. Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction then organizes multi-component proposals as reusable hyperedges and prioritizes weak and uncovered dimensions. Finally, Bottleneck Truth Verification derives prediction-independent labels solely from direct target-system measurements. The verified results determine the earliest prefix satisfying the direct two-witness requirement for every component. Experiments on BurstGPT, ServeGen, and Mooncake show that BPW reaches the verified gate with a compact workload set and outperforms 16 policies, achieving relative improvements of 2.3% and 16.3% in Mean prefix Macro-F1 and WBRC-AUC, respectively. Stage-resolved and sensitivity analyses confirm the distinct contributions and local stability of its three stages. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llmllmllm/BPW

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPW（Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing）框架，用于生成紧凑且诊断可靠的LLM服务重放套件。该框架通过三阶段设计（工作负载候选提名、覆盖优先级序列构建、瓶颈真实验证），确保每种瓶颈组件都有直接证据，而非仅依赖工作负载代表性，在BurstGPT、ServeGen和Mooncake数据集上显著优于16种基线策略。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中LLM服务产生的请求量巨大，全量重放在不同服务配置下代价高昂。现有trace缩减方法主要保留工作负载分布或代表性请求，但揭示瓶颈的工作负载可能稀有且不具代表性；且一个组件的证据无法弥补另一组件的证据缺失，而使用预测瓶颈作为目标真值会形成循环评估。因此需要为每个瓶颈组件保留证据，而非仅依赖工作负载代表性。
AI.method: BPW包含三个阶段：1) Workload Candidate Nomination：使用响应盲的工作负载特征和封闭的源端测量来提名可能暴露调度、预填充、解码或KV缓存瓶颈的工作负载；2) Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction：将多组件提议组织为可复用的超边，优先覆盖薄弱和未覆盖的维度；3) Bottleneck Truth Verification：仅通过直接的端到端系统测量推导预测无关的标签，验证结果确定满足每个组件直接双见证要求的最早前缀。
AI.result: 在BurstGPT、ServeGen和Mooncake数据集上的实验表明，BPW能以紧凑的工作负载集达到验证门槛，在Mean prefix Macro-F1和WBRC-AUC上分别相对提升2.3%和16.3%，优于16种策略。阶段消融和敏感性分析证实了三阶段的独立贡献和局部稳定性。
AI.conclusion: BPW通过瓶颈保持见证的方法论，证明保留每个瓶颈组件的证据比仅依赖工作负载代表性更有效。该框架为LLM服务重放测试提供了紧凑且诊断可靠的解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Structured Memory for Edge Language Models: Persistent Context and Corpus Retrieval via O(1) SSM State Injection
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) imposes a prefill cost proportional to retrieved context length, and -- with Transformer backbones -- a KV-cache that grows with each generated token. State-Space Models (SSMs) avoid the second cost by construction; we eliminate the first, collapsing prefill from $O(L_{context})$ to $O(1)$ per query. We introduce PRECOG (Pre-Computed Context Injection), a retrieval mechanism that exploits a property unique to SSMs: the fixed-size, position-agnostic recurrent hidden state is a complete summary of everything the model has read. PRECOG pre-encodes document corpora offline as SSM hidden states and injects the best-matching state directly at query time, bypassing in-context re-ingestion entirely. The same state-injection mechanism enables SMC (Structured Memory Consolidation): a hierarchical persistent memory with cognitive-domain clustering, an adjustable fidelity-vs-storage dial, and $O(1)$ session initialization, which consolidates short-term episodic states into long-term semantic memory and fuses both with retrieved corpus states at query time. We demonstrate the system on TENNs-LLM, a 1.2B-parameter gated-SSM language model with a 192 KB hidden state. PRECOG matches in-context RAG answer quality, reducing prefill latency from $\sim$27 s to $<$6 ms on edge hardware -- a $\sim$4500$\times$ speedup that crosses the threshold from unusable to interactive. The mechanism is architecturally impossible for Transformer KV-caches, which are position-entangled and grow linearly with context length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRECOG，一种利用状态空间模型（SSM）独特属性——固定大小、位置无关的循环隐藏状态——的检索增强生成机制，将预填充成本从O(L_context)降至O(1)，并在边缘硬件上实现约4500倍的预填充延迟加速。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG在Transformer骨干上存在两项开销：预填充成本随检索上下文长度线性增长，以及KV缓存随生成token数增长。虽然SSM天然避免后者，但前者的预填充成本问题仍未被解决，阻碍了在边缘设备上的交互式部署。
AI.method: PRECOG利用SSM固定大小、位置无关的循环隐藏状态作为输入内容的完整摘要这一特性，离线预编码文档语料库为SSM隐藏状态，在查询时直接注入最佳匹配状态，完全绕过上下文重新读取。同时提出SMC（结构化记忆整合）机制，构建具有认知域聚类的层次化持久记忆，支持保真度-存储调节旋钮和O(1)会话初始化，将短期情节状态整合为长期语义记忆，并在查询时与检索的语料库状态融合。系统在TENNs-LLM（1.2B参数gated-SSM语言模型，192KB隐藏状态）上验证。
AI.result: 在TENNs-LLM上，PRECOG在答案质量上与上下文内RAG持平，预填充延迟从约27秒降至不到6毫秒，实现约4500倍加速，将边缘硬件上的延迟从不可用跨越到交互式水平。
AI.conclusion: 该机制在架构上对Transformer KV缓存不可能实现，因为Transformer的KV缓存是位置纠缠的且随上下文长度线性增长。PRECOG展示了SSM在高效RAG中的独特架构优势。

title: Effective and Efficient Context Retrieval via Partial Dependency Graph for Repository-Level Code Generation
summary: LLM-based repository-level code generation aims to generate code using the context available in a software repository, requiring LLMs to reason over complex code dependencies. Due to limited context windows and insufficient repository-specific understanding, LLMs typically rely on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to incorporate relevant code. Early RAG approaches primarily employ similarity-based retrieval, which often fails to retrieve code snippets that the target function depends on. Recent work introduces graph-based retrieval to model such dependencies, but typically relies on manually designed rules and static global graphs, leading to limited flexibility and high construction and maintenance costs. In contrast, human developers collect helpful context by implicitly constructing a partial dependency graph and iteratively inspecting along it. Inspired by this behavior, we propose DyRetriever, an efficient context retrieval method via partial dependency graphs. DyRetriever uses an LLM to first select a set of entry-point functions and then perform multi-hop reasoning along the code dependency graph. During multi-hop reasoning, it uses the LLM's semantic understanding to validate whether a function can help generate the target function, eliminating manually designed rules and enabling flexibility across scenarios. Instead of statically constructing a global dependency graph, DyRetriever builds a partial graph on demand and discards it after use, reducing construction and maintenance costs. We integrate DyRetriever with a similarity-based code retriever to build DyCoder and evaluate it on CoderEval and DevEval. Experimental results show that DyCoder achieves relative Pass@1 improvements of 25.63% and 59.73% on CoderEval and DevEval, respectively, compared with existing RAG-based methods, while being 7.4x faster than baselines based on static dependency graph construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyRetriever，一种基于部分依赖图的上下文检索方法，用于提升LLM在仓库级代码生成任务中的表现。它通过LLM选择入口函数并进行多跳推理遍历依赖图，按需构建部分图而非静态全局图，配合相似度检索集成DyCoder，在CoderEval和DevEval上分别获得25.63%和59.73%的Pass@1相对提升，且比静态图方法快7.4倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG方法在仓库级代码生成中存在两大问题：1) 基于相似度的检索无法有效获取目标函数所依赖的代码片段；2) 基于图的检索依赖手动设计规则和静态全局图，缺乏灵活性且构建维护成本高。人类开发者通过隐式构建部分依赖图并迭代检查的方式收集上下文，受此启发提出更高效的方法。
AI.method: DyRetriever的核心方法包括：(1) 首先利用LLM选择一组入口函数；(2) 沿着代码依赖图进行多跳推理，利用LLM的语义理解能力验证每个函数是否有助于目标函数的生成，从而替代手动设计的规则；(3) 按需构建部分依赖图，使用后即丢弃，避免静态全局图的构建和维护开销；(4) 与基于相似度的检索器集成形成DyCoder系统。
AI.result: 在CoderEval和DevEval两个基准上，DyCoder相比现有RAG方法分别获得25.63%和59.73%的Pass@1相对提升，同时比基于静态依赖图构建的基线方法快7.4倍。
AI.conclusion: DyRetriever通过模拟人类开发者隐式构建部分依赖图的决策过程，在保持检索效果的同时大幅降低了计算开销，验证了"按需构建+语义验证"这一思路在仓库级代码生成中的有效性，为后续研究提供了新的方向。

title: Artificial Intelligence for the Characterization of Particles and Fibers by Optical Microscopy
summary: Optical microscopy of particle and fiber dispersions involves interpreting subtle visual cues influenced by specimen morphology, chemical composition, magnification, and illumination conditions. We introduce an artificial intelligence (AI) distillation framework that extracts semantically rich image embeddings from microscopy images using semantic anchors. A multimodal teacher combines each image's visual embedding with three text embeddings representing illumination modality, magnification, and specimen identity and morphology. Generated by LongCLIP's extended-context text encoder, this yields a 2304-dimensional block-structured teacher vector whose component blocks remain physically interpretable throughout training and inference. A student vision transformer (ViT) with a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) decoder is trained to reconstruct this teacher vector from the image alone, minimizing a mean absolute error (L1) loss that enforces coordinate-level fidelity to the teacher's block structure. A cross-entropy term over pseudo-classes derived from HDBSCAN clustering of the teacher embedding space acts as a collapse-prevention regularizer, enforcing inter-cluster separation without requiring contrastive negative mining. At inference, the student operates on image input alone, producing compact embeddings that recover the full semantic content of the teacher vector. The framework achieves approximately 80% pseudo-class validation accuracy and 75% Recall@1 on fine-grained specimen description labels under leave-one-out nearest-neighbor retrieval. These results demonstrate that semantic anchoring enables a vision-only student to acquire richer and more interpretable representations than image-only training, with direct applicability to retrieval, classification, and exploratory analysis of heterogeneous particle and fiber dispersions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI蒸馏框架，利用语义锚点从显微镜图像中提取丰富的语义嵌入。多模态教师模型结合图像视觉嵌入与三种文本嵌入（照明模态、放大倍率、样品身份和形态），生成2304维块结构教师向量；学生视觉Transformer通过L1损失重建教师向量，并用HDBSCAN聚类伪类交叉熵防止坍缩。推理时学生仅依赖图像即可恢复教师的完整语义内容，在细粒度样品描述标签上达到~80%伪类验证准确率和75% Recall@1。
AI.motivation: 粒子与纤维分散体系的光学显微分析需要解读受样品形态、化学成分、放大倍率和照明条件影响的微妙视觉线索，传统图像仅训练方法难以获得语义丰富且可解释的表征，因此需要一种能够从视觉输入中提取更丰富、更具物理可解释性的嵌入表示方法。
AI.method: 该框架包含：(1) 多模态教师模型，将图像视觉嵌入与LongCLIP文本编码器生成的三类文本嵌入（照明模态、放大倍率、样品身份与形态）结合，形成2304维块结构教师向量；(2) 学生ViT+MLP解码器，仅从图像重建教师向量，使用L1损失确保坐标级别保真；(3) 基于HDBSCAN聚类教师嵌入空间获得伪类，用交叉熵作为坍缩防止正则化项，无需对比负样本挖掘。
AI.result: 框架在细粒度样品描述标签上实现了大约80%的伪类验证准确率和75%的Recall@1（留一法最近邻检索），证明语义锚定能使纯视觉学生获得比仅图像训练更丰富、更可解释的表征。
AI.conclusion: 语义锚定蒸馏框架有效弥合了视觉与多模态语义之间的鸿沟，使纯视觉学生模型在推理时无需文本输入即可恢复教师的完整语义内容，可广泛应用于异质粒子与纤维分散体系的检索、分类和探索性分析。

title: Deep Learning CNN and Recurrence Analysis for Alpha Gamma EEG Biomarkers in Fragile X Syndrome
summary: Fragile X Syndrome (FXS) is a neurodevelopmental disorder caused by reduced expression of fragile X mental retardation protein (FMRP), leading to disrupted synaptic plasticity, cortical hyperexcitability, and impaired network synchronization. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a noninvasive window into these mechanisms and consistently reveals abnormalities in alpha (8 to 12 Hz) and gamma (30 to 100 Hz) oscillations that relate to inhibitory control, sensory processing, and cognition. This paper proposes a multi representation deep learning framework for automated characterization of FXS EEG phenotypes by integrating convolutional neural networks (CNNs), long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, and recurrence plot (RP) analysis. Band limited EEG signals are decomposed into alpha and gamma components and transformed into complementary representations, including temporal feature sequences, time frequency maps, and RP images encoding the nonlinear recurrence structure. CNN modules learn discriminative spatial-spectral and dynamical textures from image based representations, while LSTM modules model temporal modulation of oscillatory activity; a hybrid CNN LSTM architecture jointly captures spatial, temporal, and nonlinear dependencies. Subject-independent evaluation demonstrates that the hybrid model outperforms single modality baselines, with gamma features providing strong discriminative power and alpha gamma integration yielding the best overall performance. These findings support deep learning with nonlinear representations as a scalable approach for EEG biomarker development in FXS, with potential utility for diagnosis, stratification, and treatment monitoring in translational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多表征深度学习框架，通过整合CNN、LSTM和递归图分析，自动表征脆性X综合征(FXS)的EEG表型。将α和γ频段信号分解为时间序列、时频图和递归图三种互补表征，混合CNN-LSTM架构联合捕捉空间、时间及非线性依赖。独立于受试者的评估表明，混合模型优于单一模态基线，γ特征判别力强，α-γ整合性能最佳。
AI.motivation: FXS是一种由FMRP蛋白表达减少引起的神经发育障碍，表现为突触可塑性受损、皮层过度兴奋和网络同步异常。EEG能无创观测这些机制，且α和γ振荡异常与抑制控制、感觉处理和认知密切相关。然而，传统分析方法难以充分捕捉EEG中复杂的非线性动态特征，需要更强大的自动化工具来表征FXS的EEG表型。
AI.method: 提出多表征深度学习框架：1) 将带限EEG分解为α(8-12Hz)和γ(30-100Hz)成分；2) 转换为三种互补表征——时间特征序列、时频图和递归图(RP)图像；3) CNN模块从图像表征中学习判别性空间-频谱和动态纹理；4) LSTM模块建模振荡活动的时间调制；5) 混合CNN-LSTM架构联合捕捉空间、时间和非线性依赖关系。
AI.result: 独立于受试者的评估显示，混合模型优于单一模态基线。γ特征提供强判别力，α-γ集成获得最佳整体性能，验证了多表征融合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持将非线性表征与深度学习结合作为FXS EEG生物标志物开发的可扩展方法，在诊断、分层和治疗监测等转化场景中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Writing-System-Level Tokenizer Adaptation for Byte-Level BPE
comment: 15 pages. Accepted for poster presentation at the Second Tokenization Workshop (TokShop) at COLM 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Pretrained byte-level BPE tokenizers can segment underrepresented languages inefficiently. Replacing a tokenizer changes the meaning of nearly every token ID, while vocabulary expansion enlarges the model's embedding and output matrices. We study post-hoc adaptation that keeps the model-vocabulary size fixed and preserves most existing token-to-ID assignments as a construction-time compatibility property. Directly transferring tokens from a language-specific tokenizer does not guarantee derivability through the target BPE merge graph: an inserted entry can conflict with the target's greedy merge ranks. We formalize this failure as the merge ordering problem and introduce BPE-guided insertion, which builds each transferred token through a target-reachable decomposition. Our pipeline uses script-aware row selection to limit collateral fragmentation, reconstructs target-script byte-level prerequisites, and applies guided insertion to maintain merge-graph reachability. On Ukrainian adaptations of Nemotron and GPT-OSS, it reduces token counts by 33.5% and 36.6%, keeps changes on English and the evaluated four-language European aggregate within 0.05%, and retains 78.5%/77.3% of original model-vocabulary rows at the same IDs. Constraint-matched global and frequency-based removal achieve similar Ukrainian compression but increase English/European token counts by 0.7-2.2%; fresh same-size retraining compresses Ukrainian slightly more but retains effectively no same-ID rows and increases English token counts by 7.6-8.6%. The reallocation increases token counts on the evaluated three-language Cyrillic micro-aggregate by 6.7%/10.1%. Structural audits find all 28,134/45,398 inserted BPE nodes reachable under ordinary rank-ordered merging and no retained same-ID model-vocabulary entry newly broken. We release all tokenizers and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPE引导插入（BPE-guided insertion）方法，在不改变模型词汇表大小且保留大部分原有token-ID映射的前提下，通过目标BPE合并图可达性分解来高效适配预训练分词器到低资源语言（如乌克兰语）。在Nemotron和GPT-OSS上分别减少33.5%和36.6%的token数，对英文和欧洲语言影响小于0.05%，并保留78.5%/77.3%的原始模型词表行。
AI.motivation: 预训练字节级BPE分词器对低资源语言的切分效率低下。直接替换分词器会使几乎所有token ID的含义改变，而扩大词汇表会增加模型嵌入和输出矩阵的规模。现有方法缺乏在保持模型词表大小和ID分配兼容的情况下进行事后适配的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"合并排序问题"（merge ordering problem），说明直接从语言特定分词器迁移token会与目标BPE贪心合并排名冲突。2) 提出BPE引导插入，通过目标可达分解（target-reachable decomposition）构建每个迁移token。3) 使用脚本感知行选择（script-aware row selection）限制附带碎片化。4) 重建目标脚本字节级前置条件。5) 应用引导插入维持合并图可达性。
AI.result: 在乌克兰语适配Nemotron和GPT-OSS的任务中，token数分别减少33.5%和36.6%；英文和四种欧洲语言聚合指标变化在0.05%以内；保留78.5%/77.3%的原始模型词表行在相同ID上。对比方法（约束匹配的全局/频率移除）虽达到相似乌克兰语压缩但英文/欧洲token数增加0.7-2.2%；全新同规模重训练压缩略多但保留0个同ID行且英文token数增加7.6-8.6%。结构审计确认所有28,134/45,398个插入BPE节点在普通排名合并下可达，且没有保留的同ID词表条目被新破坏。
AI.conclusion: BPE引导插入提供了一种有效的后验分词器适配方法，在保持模型词汇表大小和ID兼容性的同时大幅提升低资源语言的分词效率。该方法在不增加模型参数规模、不破坏已有token分配的前提下，实现了显著的压缩收益，是一种实用且兼容性强的分词器适配方案。

title: Ekova: A Personality-Support Agent for Self-Discovery Dialogue
comment: Accepted to the COLM 2026 Lifelong Agents Workshop
summary: Emotional Support (ES) systems have long optimized a single objective: alleviating the user's emotional distress in the moment. We argue that a complementary need, helping users see themselves more clearly, defines a distinct paradigm we call Personality Support (PS). PS is not counseling or clinical intervention: it targets cognitive clarity and self-articulation, not symptom relief or diagnosis. We instantiate this paradigm in three layers. First, we present DSD, a Chinese self-discovery PS Dataset of 8,590 samples collected through real longitudinal interaction across five minimal units, Coach, Warm, Tsukkomi, Real, and Gonzo. Second, we build DeepSupport, a multi-persona PS system trained with OrthoTune, a PS-tailored framework with style-specific adapters and a style-consistency regularizer. Third, we unify the five DeepSupport personas into Ekova, a persistent personality-support agent with a unified cross-session memory layer, supporting both adaptive routing and user-customized persona selection. Experiments show that OrthoTune-trained models outperform all baselines with an average relative gain of 16.3% across all metrics over the strongest prompt-based baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/Ekova.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人格支持（Personality Support, PS）这一新范式，区别于传统情感支持（ES），聚焦于帮助用户获得认知清晰度和自我表达。作者构建了DSD中文自发现数据集（8,590个样本）、DeepSupport多角色系统（基于OrthoTune训练框架），并统一为Ekova持久化人格支持智能体。实验显示OrthoTune训练模型在所有指标上相比最强基于提示的基线平均相对提升16.3%。
AI.motivation: 情感支持（ES）系统长期只优化单一目标——即时缓解用户情绪困扰，忽视了帮助用户更清晰地认识自己这一互补需求。作者认为这种需求定义了全新且未被充分研究的范式。
AI.method: 三层实现：（1）构建DSD数据集，通过真实纵向互动收集8,590个中文自发现样本，涵盖Coach、Warm、Tsukkomi、Real、Gonzo五种最小单元；（2）训练DeepSupport多角色PS系统，使用OrthoTune框架（含风格特定适配器与风格一致性正则化器）；（3）将五种DeepSupport角色统一为Ekova，具备跨会话统一记忆层，支持自适应路由和用户自定义角色选择。
AI.result: OrthoTune训练的模型超越所有基线，在全部指标上相比最强基于提示的基线平均相对增益达16.3%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 人格支持（PS）是与情感支持互补且必要的新范式，专注于认知清晰度和自我表达而非症状缓解。该研究通过数据集、训练框架和统一智能体的完整构建，验证了PS任务的可行性与有效性。

title: UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation. Existing work has introduced Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) to push beyond exact lexical matching toward richer semantics. Yet LSR has so far remained tied to encoder-style bidirectional architectures, and its extension to multimodal settings still relies heavily on auxiliary cross-modal modules. To address these limitations, we introduce UEmbed (Unified Embedding), a decoder-only multimodal embedding model that produces both sparse lexical and dense representations in one causal forward pass. UEmbed appends N learnable special tokens to the input and partitions the vocabulary into N disjoint subsets. Each token's causal hidden state predicts sparse weights over its assigned subset, and the N subsets are concatenated into the full sparse vector. Trained on public data, we release UEmbed at 2B, 4B, and 9B scales. UEmbed-9B reaches 71.8 (dense) and 71.0 (sparse) on MMEB-v2, outperforming multimodal embedding models trained on publicly available data (e.g., RzenEmbed). On BEIR, UEmbed also remains competitive with strong dense and sparse baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate the practical utility of UEmbed across three dimensions: effectiveness, efficiency, and agentic applications. Overall, UEmbed offers a new paradigm: it unifies dense and sparse embeddings in one model, while further extending sparse retrieval to unify text and multimodal inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UEmbed，一个解码器-only的多模态嵌入模型，在单次前向传播中同时生成稀疏词汇表示和稠密表示，统一了稠密和稀疏检索，并将稀疏检索扩展到多模态场景。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习型稀疏检索（LSR）局限于编码器风格的双向架构，且扩展到多模态时仍依赖辅助跨模态模块。这限制了稀疏检索的表达能力和应用范围。
AI.method: UEmbed在输入中追加N个可学习特殊token，并将词汇表划分为N个不相交子集。每个token的因果隐藏状态预测其分配子集的稀疏权重，N个子集拼接形成完整稀疏向量，与稠密表示在单次前向中同时输出。
AI.result: UEmbed-9B在MMEB-v2上达到71.8（稠密）和71.0（稀疏），优于基于公开数据训练的多模态嵌入模型（如RzenEmbed）；在BEIR上与强稠密和稀疏基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UEmbed提供了新范式：在一个模型中统一稠密和稀疏嵌入，同时将稀疏检索扩展到文本和多模态输入的统一处理，展示了在效率、有效性和智能体应用三方面的实用价值。

title: TELLER: Non-intrusive Cross-Layer Root-Cause Analysis for LLM Inference
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Accepted to the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference has evolved from an offline workload into a continuously operated software service, yet root-cause analysis remains difficult because a single request spans the inference engine, Python/C++ backend, host CUDA APIs, GPU kernels, and distributed communication. Existing profilers expose raw timelines, while log-based diagnosis often misses cross-layer execution semantics and request-level structure. We present TELLER, a non-intrusive Trace- and Log-aware LLM inference Root-cause analysis framework. TELLER first collects NVTX/CUPTI traces and service logs without modifying model binaries, then reconstructs per-request call-chain trees and aligns log lines with the corresponding execution steps. We introduce a dependency-aware causal-context slice that preserves parent-child structure, temporal order, and communication relations, and a Trace Pair Encoding (TPE) tokenizer that compresses such slices into compact structural token sequences with parent, depth, and duration attributes. On top of these representations, TELLER combines numeric candidate localization with a multimodal root-cause model that jointly predicts abnormal steps, localizes suspicious operators, and generates natural-language explanations. Experiments on multi-node GPU inference workloads show a clear compression-accuracy trade-off: a moderate TPE vocabulary reduces per-step trace length by more than 80% while achieving the best overall performance on both horizontal (cross-node communication) and vertical (within-node execution stack) views, whereas more aggressive compression substantially degrades diagnosis quality. Further analyses under low-fault priors, strengthened baselines, modality ablations, explanation-quality checks, and tracing overhead show that TELLER provides a practical triage and evidence-localization substrate for LLM inference RCA.

AI.tldr: TELLER 是一个针对大语言模型推理服务的非侵入式根因分析框架，通过收集 NVTX/CUPTI 追踪和日志，重建每请求的调用链树，并利用 Trace Pair Encoding (TPE) 将依赖感知的因果上下文切片压缩为结构化标记序列，结合多模态根因模型实现异常步骤预测、可疑算子定位和自然语言解释生成。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理已从离线工作负载转变为持续运行的软件服务，但根因分析仍然困难，因为单个请求跨越推理引擎、Python/C++ 后端、Host CUDA API、GPU 内核和分布式通信多个层。现有分析工具只暴露原始时间线，日志诊断又缺乏跨层执行语义和请求级结构，导致难以定位问题根源。
AI.method: TELLER 首先在无需修改模型二进制的情况下收集 NVTX/CUPTI 追踪和服务日志；然后重建每请求的调用链树，并将日志行与对应执行步骤对齐；引入依赖感知的因果上下文切片保留父子结构、时序和通信关系；设计 TPE 分词器将切片压缩为带父节点、深度和时长属性的结构化标记序列；最后结合数值候选定位与多模态根因模型，联合预测异常步骤、定位可疑算子并生成自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在多节点 GPU 推理工作负载上的实验显示：适度 TPE 词表可将每步追踪长度减少 80% 以上，同时在横向（跨节点通信）和纵向（节点内执行栈）视角下取得最佳性能；激进压缩会显著降低诊断质量。低故障先验、强化基线、模态消融、解释质量检查和追踪开销等方面的进一步分析表明 TELLER 实用有效。
AI.conclusion: TELLER 为 LLM 推理根因分析提供了实用的分诊和证据定位基础，在压缩效率与诊断准确性之间找到了平衡点，验证了其作为 RCA 支撑框架的可行性和实用性。

title: Decoding Children's Gait Behavior
summary: We introduce a new problem domain for human action recognition: the fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors from standard RGB video. We specifically target the ambulatory patterns of children aged 3-17 years. Such behaviors arise naturally in the diagnosis and treatment of several critical developmental and neuromuscular disorders, such as cerebral palsy and hemiplegia. Despite their clinical value, current 3D sensor-based gait analysis systems are expensive, intrusive, and often impractical for young subjects. To address this, we introduce a new dataset comprising over 1,100 high-frame-rate (60 FPS) video sequences from 110 subjects, accompanied by synchronized, anonymized pose sequences. In each session, the child performs a 5-second "walk-around" task, capturing the gait cycle from multiple viewpoints. Crucially, we demonstrate that current state-of-the-art approaches, including gait foundation models and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), fail to effectively resolve these clinical nuances. We identify the key technical challenges in analyzing these erratic and subtle motor patterns and describe a unified end-to-end framework for decoding fundamental components of pediatric gait. Through comprehensive experimental results, we demonstrate the potential of this dataset to drive novel research questions and establish a rigorous baseline for automated child gait assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的研究领域：从标准RGB视频中对儿童步态行为进行细粒度分析，针对3-17岁儿童的运动模式。作者构建了一个包含1100多个60 FPS视频序列、110名受试者的新数据集，并证明现有最先进方法（包括步态基础模型和多模态大语言模型）无法有效解决这些临床细微差异，进而提出一个统一的端到端框架来解码儿童步态的基本组成部分。
AI.motivation: 儿童步态分析对诊断脑瘫、偏瘫等发育和神经肌肉疾病具有重要临床价值，但现有的3D传感器步态分析系统成本高昂、侵入性强且对幼儿不实用。作者引入一个新的问题领域，旨在通过标准RGB视频实现非侵入性、经济可行的儿童步态细粒度分析。
AI.method: 论文构建了一个包含1,100多个60 FPS视频序列、110名受试者的数据集，受试者执行5秒"行走"任务，从多视角捕捉步态周期。作者识别了分析这些不规则和细微运动模式的关键技术挑战，并描述了一个统一的端到端框架来解码儿童步态的基本组成部分。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有的最先进方法（包括步态基础模型和多模态大语言模型MLLMs）无法有效解决这些临床细微差异。综合实验结果展示了该数据集在推动新研究问题和建立自动化儿童步态评估严格基线方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和框架有望为儿童步态的自动评估建立严格基线，驱动新的研究问题，并为临床诊断和治疗提供更加经济、非侵入性的替代方案。

title: Nonlinear Laplacians Improve Signed-Directed Graph Learning
summary: While signed-directed graphs have been studied using linear Laplacians in the design of graph neural networks, relatively little research has focused on developing non-linear Laplacian operators for such networks. We introduce a non-linear Laplacian operator specific to signed and directed networks (NLSD). This non-linear operator extends the concepts of the signed Laplacian for signed graphs and the Laplacian for directed graphs. The NLSD calculates node-specific potentials based on features More precisely, if the potential discrepancy is not aligned with the edge direction, we ignore it (and vice versa) leveraging message-passing techniques only across edges where potential discrepancies align with the edge's direction. Utilizing this novel operator, we propose an efficient spectral GNN framework (NLSD-GNN). We conducted comprehensive evaluations focusing on node classification and link prediction, examining scenarios involving signed, directional, or both types of information. Our findings reveal that this spectral GNN framework not only integrates signed and directional data effectively but also achieves superior performance across diverse datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对带符号有向图的非线性拉普拉斯算子（NLSD），并基于此构建了高效的谱图神经网络框架（NLSD-GNN）。该算子仅在势差与边方向一致时才传递消息，实验表明其在节点分类和链接预测任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有符号有向图的图神经网络研究大多基于线性拉普拉斯算子，而对非线性拉普拉斯算子的研究相对较少。作者旨在填补这一空白，为符号有向网络设计更合适的非线性消息传递机制。
AI.method: 提出NLSD算子，扩展了符号图的符号拉普拉斯和有向图的拉普拉斯概念。该算子基于节点特征计算势差，仅当势差不一致与边方向对齐时才进行消息传递（反之忽略），从而实现了方向感知的传播机制，并基于此构建了谱GNN框架（NLSD-GNN）。
AI.result: 在节点分类和链接预测任务上进行了全面评估，涵盖仅符号、仅有向以及两者兼有的多种场景。结果表明该框架能有效整合符号与方向信息，并在多个数据集上取得了优越性能。
AI.conclusion: NLSD-GNN通过非线性拉普拉斯算子成功融合了符号与方向信息，在多样化的数据集上展现出卓越的性能，为该领域提供了新的研究方向。

title: F-WANDA: Fisher-Reweighted Post-Training Pruning for Sustainable Deployment of Large Language Models
summary: One-shot post-training pruning is the most energy-frugal compression strategy for largelanguage models (LLMs), yet existing approaches trade either quality (WANDA) or compute cost (SPARSEGPT). We introduce F-WANDA, a drop-in modification of WANDA that reallocates the per-row keep budget across output neurons in proportion to the empirical Fisher information of the pre-activation. The Fisher signal is collected in a single additional backward pass over the same calibration corpus WANDA already uses; no weights are updated. On LLAMA-2-7B at 50 % unstructured sparsity, F-WANDA attains WikiText-2 perplexity of 6.85, matches WANDA fluency, and improves 5-shot MMLU by +1.6 pp over WANDA and +1.1 pp over SPARSEGPT, while incurring only one-third of SPARSEGPT pruning wall-clock and energy. The headline trade-off is achieved without extra calibration data or fine-tuning, placing F-WANDA on the Pareto frontier of quality versus pruning cost for sustainable LLM compression.

AI.tldr: F-WANDA是一种对WANDA的后训练剪枝方法的即插即用改进，通过将按行保留的剪枝预算根据前激活的经验Fisher信息在输出神经元间重新分配，仅需一次额外反向传播即可获得Fisher信号，在保持WANDA质量的同时将计算开销降至SPARSEGPT的三分之一，实现了质量与剪枝成本的最优帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 一次性后训练剪枝是LLM最节能的压缩策略，但现有方法存在权衡困境：WANDA质量不佳，而SPARSEGPT计算成本过高。作者希望找到一种既能保持高质量又具有低计算开销的剪枝方法。
AI.method: F-WANDA是WANDA的即插即用改进：1) 在WANDA使用的同一校准语料库上额外执行一次反向传播（不更新权重）来收集前激活的经验Fisher信息；2) 根据Fisher信息将每行保留的剪枝预算跨输出神经元重新分配，而非均匀或基于幅度的分配。
AI.result: 在LLAMA-2-7B上以50%非结构化稀疏度剪枝时：WikiText-2困惑度为6.85，与WANDA流畅度相当；5-shot MMLU比WANDA提高1.6个百分点，比SPARSEGPT提高1.1个百分点；剪枝时钟时间和能耗仅为SPARSEGPT的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: F-WANDA在不增加额外校准数据或微调的情况下，实现了相比WANDA更优的质量和相比SPARSEGPT更低的计算成本，使该方法处于可持续LLM压缩的质量与剪枝成本的帕累托前沿。

title: VulnGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection
summary: Recent advances in LLM-based vulnerability detection have shown promising results, while coding agents further extend this capability from isolated code snippets to complete repositories. This shift requires agents to autonomously explore repositories and locate vulnerability-relevant code, instead of performing detection on preselected functions. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on vulnerability classification over preselected code snippets, limiting their ability to evaluate coding agents in repository-level vulnerability detection. Moreover, without fine-grained vulnerability trace annotations, the capability limitations underlying the detection process remain difficult to explore. To address these limitations, we present \textbf{VulnGym}, a real-world repository-level benchmark for evaluating vulnerability detection by coding agents. VulnGym aligns reviewed GitHub advisories with their corresponding vulnerable version repositories. It contains 184 advisories and 408 vulnerability entries across 23 repositories, with each entry annotated with line-level entry points, critical operations, and vulnerability traces. Using this fine-grained ground truth, VulnGym defines an end-to-end detection task and three oracle-based subtasks to jointly evaluate vulnerability detection and diagnose limitations in code localization and evidence construction. Our evaluation indicates that current coding agents remain limited in both end-to-end repository-level vulnerability detection and the construction of accurate supporting traces.

AI.tldr: VulnGym是一个面向代码智能体的仓库级漏洞检测基准，包含184个公告、408个漏洞条目和23个仓库，提供行级入口点、关键操作和漏洞轨迹的细粒度标注，用于评估代码智能体的端到端漏洞检测能力并诊断定位和证据构建的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有漏洞检测基准主要基于预选代码片段进行分类评估，无法适应代码智能体在仓库级别自主探索和定位漏洞代码的新范式；同时缺乏细粒度的漏洞轨迹标注，难以深入分析检测过程中的能力瓶颈。
AI.method: VulnGym对齐GitHub安全公告与对应存在漏洞的版本仓库，构建包含184个公告和408个漏洞条目的基准。每个条目标注了行级入口点、关键操作和漏洞轨迹，并定义了端到端检测任务及三个基于oracle的子任务，以联合评估漏洞检测、代码定位和证据构建能力。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，当前代码智能体在端到端仓库级漏洞检测和准确构建支持性漏洞轨迹方面均表现有限。
AI.conclusion: VulnGym为代码智能体的仓库级漏洞检测提供了更全面、更细粒度的评估框架，揭示了现有智能体在该任务上的能力差距。

title: Boosting Generalizable Depth Estimation in Endoscopy by Mixture of Lightweight Experts and Intrinsic Image Alignment
comment: Accepted by MICCAI 2026 @ The Efficient Medical AI (EMA4MICCAI) Workshop (Oral Presentation)
summary: Depth estimation is a significant task for 3D perception in endoscopic surgeries. However, illumination interference and feature diversity in various endoscopic scenes are still challenges for generalizable depth estimation and ego-motion estimation. Based on this, a novel self-supervised framework, EndoMINI, is proposed for depth estimation in endoscopic scenes. Specifically, mixture of low-rank experts (MiLoRE) is proposed to perform parameter-efficient fine-tuning, which can also boost the model adaptation to scenes with different characteristics. Meanwhile, an intrinsic image alignment (IIA) is introduced into the training loss to alleviate the influence of light reflectance in endoscopy with a novel intrinsic image decomposition network. The proposed method is evaluated on SCARED datasets for supervised depth estimation, and two endoscopic datasets, Hamlyn and SERV-CT, for zero-shot depth estimation, compared with state-of-the-art works as well. The experimental results demonstrate outstanding performance of the proposed model and the effects of the main contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EndoMINI，一个用于内窥镜手术场景的自监督深度估计框架。通过混合低秩专家（MiLoRE）实现参数高效微调以提升模型对不同场景的适应能力，并引入固有图像对齐（IIA）结合固有图像分解网络来缓解内窥镜中的光照反射干扰。在SCARED、Hamlyn和SERV-CT数据集上的实验验证了其优越性能。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜手术中的3D感知需要深度估计，但光照干扰和不同内窥镜场景下的特征多样性给可泛化的深度估计和自运动估计带来了挑战。现有方法难以同时应对这些问题。
AI.method: 提出了自监督框架EndoMINI，包含两个核心组件：(1) 混合低秩专家（MiLoRE）用于参数高效微调，增强模型对不同场景特征的适应能力；(2) 固有图像对齐（IIA）引入训练损失中，配合固有图像分解网络以缓解内窥镜中光反射的影响。
AI.result: 在SCARED数据集上进行监督深度估计评估，并在Hamlyn和SERV-CT两个内窥镜数据集上进行零样本深度估计测试，与现有最先进方法对比，实验结果显示所提模型性能优异，且各主要贡献点均有效果。
AI.conclusion: EndoMINI通过结合MiLoRE和IIA有效解决了内窥镜场景中光照干扰和场景适应性两大难题，在深度估计任务上取得了显著的性能提升，证明了该方法在内窥镜手术3D感知领域的实用价值。

title: Adaptive Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differential Equations with Applications to Fluid Dynamics
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a versatile approach for solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs), yet achieving high accuracy efficiently using these techniques remains challenging for high-dimensional or multiscale systems. Here, we present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that enhances Quantum PINNs (QPINNs) through adaptive collocation point sampling and loss-aware attention mechanisms. By dynamically prioritizing points in regions with large PDE residuals or steep solution gradients, our method mitigates the spectral bias inherent in conventional PINNs. Current Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks are commonly assumed to be limited by the expressive power of quantum circuits. In our work, we observed that, across diverse differential equations, optimization - not only expressivity - can be an important bottleneck. Furthermore, a trainable loss-weighting scheme balances contributions from physics residuals, boundary conditions, and data fidelity during training. Integrating these strategies with quantum computing techniques (including variational quantum circuits and quantum gradient estimation) can yield at least a 60% improvement in solution accuracy under specific regimes for benchmark fluid flows and reaction-diffusion systems. Finally, we argue that merely increasing model expressivity is insufficient for resolving complex PDEs via QPINNs, as they remain constrained by the structural optimization limitations of classical PINNs. This framework provides a scalable pathway for quantum-enhanced scientific machine learning, bridging physics-based modeling with emerging quantum computational capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合量子-经典框架，通过自适应配点采样和损失感知注意力机制增强量子物理信息神经网络（QPINNs），在基准流体流动和反应-扩散系统上实现至少60%的求解精度提升，并指出优化瓶颈而非仅表达能力是QPINNs的关键限制。
AI.motivation: 传统PINNs在高维或多尺度系统中存在精度和效率瓶颈，而现有QPINNs研究普遍假设量子电路表达能力是主要限制因素。作者希望探究真正的瓶颈所在，并提出更有效的QPINNs训练策略。
AI.method: 提出混合量子-经典框架：（1）自适应配点采样，动态优先关注PDE残差大或解梯度陡峭的区域；（2）损失感知注意力机制，减轻传统PINNs的谱偏置问题；（3）可训练损失加权方案，平衡物理残差、边界条件和数据保真度的贡献；（4）集成变分量子电路和量子梯度估计技术。
AI.result: 在多种微分方程上发现优化（而非仅表达能力）是QPINNs的重要瓶颈；在所提框架下，基准流体流动和反应-扩散系统在特定条件下求解精度至少提升60%。
AI.conclusion: 单纯增加模型表达能力不足以解决复杂PDEs的QPINNs问题，因为其仍受限于经典PINNs的结构性优化缺陷。所提出的框架为量子增强科学机器学习提供了可扩展路径。

title: A Heuristic Perspective on Debiasing Language Models
summary: Language models (LMs) often acquire various biases during pre-training and may express them in interactions, potentially causing social harm. Existing methods often rely on counterfactual augmentation or representation projection. These strategies remain limited in practice due to their high computational costs and difficulty in scaling to larger models. Additionally, many of these strategies require manual data annotation, narrowing their scope to specific cultures and bias categories. To overcome these limitations, we propose HEIMAT, a HEurIstic-style autoMATic debiasing framework for LMs. HEIMAT consists of two main steps: bias disclosure and debiasing fine-tuning. In the first step, it uses simple templates to construct heuristic prompts, which are applied to reveal model biases and generate corresponding context prompts. In the second step, it fine-tunes the model by minimizing the Jensen-Shannon divergence of predictions on these context prompts to reduce bias. Extensive experiments show that HEIMAT effectively mitigates bias in different cultures while maintaining the model's natural language understanding (NLU) performance.

AI.tldr: 提出HEIMAT框架，一种无需人工标注的启发式自动去偏方法，通过模板构造提示词揭示模型偏见，并通过最小化预测的Jensen-Shannon散度进行微调，在降低不同文化偏见的同时保持自然语言理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型去偏方法（如反事实增强和表示投影）存在计算成本高、难以扩展到大规模模型、且依赖人工数据标注导致局限于特定文化和偏见类别的问题，亟需一种高效、可扩展且自动化的去偏方案。
AI.method: HEIMAT包含两个步骤：(1) 偏见揭示——使用简单模板构造启发式提示词来暴露模型偏见并生成相应的上下文提示；(2) 去偏微调——通过最小化这些上下文提示预测结果之间的Jensen-Shannon散度来微调模型，从而减少偏见。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HEIMAT能有效缓解不同文化背景下的模型偏见，同时保持模型的自然语言理解（NLU）性能。
AI.conclusion: HEIMAT作为一种启发式自动去偏框架，克服了现有方法计算开销大、依赖人工标注等局限，在跨文化去偏和NLU性能保持方面均取得了良好效果。

title: The Bayesian Reflex: A Predictive Coding Engine for Artificial Intelligence
comment: From the Bayesian Brain to Artificial Intelligence
summary: Predictive coding offers a powerful theory of cortical computation, but corresponding scalable algorithmic implementations for artificial intelligence have remained elusive. This paper introduces the Bayesian reflex, a computational framework that directly instantiates predictive coding through three pillars: belief maintenance via hierarchical generative models, sequential Bayesian updating via prediction-error minimization, and uncertainty-driven action via active inference. We show that recent breakthroughs---ellipsoidal decomposition for exact $i.i.d.$ sampling, recursive Gaussian processes for deep hierarchical inference, and derivative-aware Bayesian optimization---provide the missing algorithmic ingredients. The resulting framework enables mathematically principled, scalable, and brain-inspired continual learning, perception, and decision-making. We illustrate its versatility through applications ranging from climate model evaluation to prime number discovery, offering a blueprint for truly adaptive artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"贝叶斯反射"（Bayesian reflex）计算框架，通过三个支柱直接实现预测编码理论：层次生成模型的信念维护、预测误差最小化的序贯贝叶斯更新、以及主动推理驱动的不确定性行动。该框架结合了椭球分解、递归高斯过程和导数感知贝叶斯优化等近期技术突破，实现了数学上严谨、可扩展且受大脑启发的持续学习、感知和决策系统。
AI.motivation: 预测编码是解释皮层计算的有力理论，但其在人工智能中的可扩展算法实现一直缺失。作者旨在弥合认知神经科学与实用AI算法之间的鸿沟，提供一种既能体现大脑计算原理又能规模化部署的计算框架。
AI.method: 提出"贝叶斯反射"框架，基于三大支柱：（1）利用层次生成模型维护信念；（2）通过预测误差最小化进行序贯贝叶斯更新；（3）借助主动推理实现不确定性驱动的行动。整合三项关键算法创新：椭球分解实现精确i.i.d.采样、递归高斯过程支持深度层次推理、以及导数感知贝叶斯优化。
AI.result: 框架展示了在气候模型评估和素数发现等多种应用场景中的通用性和有效性，验证了其在持续学习、感知和决策任务中的适应性，为真正自适应的AI系统提供了蓝图。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯反射框架为将预测编码理论转化为实际可扩展的AI算法提供了可行路径，实现了数学严谨性与大脑启发式计算原理的结合，有望推动新一代自适应人工智能的发展。

title: Pretraining on Call Graphs: When Binary Analysis Tasks Profit From Context
summary: Binary function embedding models are trained to encode the semantics of binary code in such a way that they can be generalized to a variety of reverse engineering tasks, such as binary code search, vulnerability detection, or malware classification. While many models only take the function in question as contextual input, there have been successful attempts to improve function embeddings by leveraging information from the call graph. In this study, we dissect the implications of these embedding refinements. We conduct experiments using a range of graph-based models on the embeddings generated by two state-of-the-art binary function embedding models. Integrating inter-procedural context, we show that improvements on binary code similarity detection (BCSD) will not necessarily generalize to downstream tasks, neither of semantic nor of syntactic nature. More generally, we find that optimizing for semantic similarity tasks correlates with worse performance on syntactic tasks. By conducting an explanatory analysis on the dataset, we find that the call graph-based enhancements significantly enhance the robustness of embeddings, particularly in scenarios where the initial models struggle. Furthermore, we observe that the added context is more beneficial for namespace-related functions than for those focused on individual logic, confirming that the call graph can be leveraged most effectively in context-dependent scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于调用图的嵌入细化对二进制函数嵌入模型的影响，发现调用图上下文在二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）上的改进并不会必然推广到下游任务，且优化语义相似性任务与语法任务性能之间存在权衡。
AI.motivation: 许多二进制函数嵌入模型仅以函数本身为上下文输入，但已有研究尝试利用调用图信息来改进函数嵌入。作者希望深入剖析这些嵌入细化的实际影响，探究调用图上下文是否真正有助于各类逆向工程任务。
AI.method: 在两种最先进的二进制函数嵌入模型生成的嵌入上，使用一系列基于图的模型进行实验。通过在嵌入中整合过程间（inter-procedural）上下文，评估对二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）及下游语义和语法任务的影响，并对数据集进行解释性分析。
AI.result: 调用图上下文对BCSD的改进不会必然推广到下游任务；优化语义相似性任务与语法任务性能呈负相关；调用图增强可显著提升嵌入鲁棒性，尤其在初始模型表现不佳的场景中；调用图上下文对与命名空间相关的函数比对单一逻辑函数更有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 调用图可以在上下文依赖的场景中发挥最有效的作用，但研究者需要谨慎对待嵌入细化在不同任务间的泛化性，并认识到语义与语法任务之间的性能权衡。

title: Poplar: A Scalable Pipeline for Human-Centric Image Dataset Synthesis
summary: Recent image generators can synthesize convincing human-centric images, yet producing a useful collection remains different from producing a single successful image. A human-centric dataset must cover varied people and contexts, avoid implausible attribute combinations, preserve an everyday photographic character, and expose quality-control decisions at scale. We present Poplar, a reproducible Specify--Render--Inspect pipeline for human-centric image dataset synthesis. Specify samples structured attributes under commonsense constraints and verbalizes them as photography-oriented prompts. Render uses a realism-adapted image generator across composition-aware aspect ratios and retries obvious technical failures. Inspect applies a single structured vision--language review to each candidate, preserving the original prompt while rejecting intrinsic image defects or material prompt mismatches. Using Poplar, we construct Poplar-9K: 9,401 curated human-centric image--text pairs retained from 11,765 reviewed candidates (79.9\% acceptance). We release the dataset together with the pipeline, configurations, immutable generation prompts, and auditable inspection records as a compact resource for building customizable human-centric collections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Poplar，一个可复现的"指定-渲染-审查"（Specify-Render-Inspect）流水线，用于合成以人为中心的图像数据集。基于该流水线构建了Poplar-9K数据集（9,401对图像-文本对），并公开了完整流水线、配置、不可变生成提示词和可审计的审查记录。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像生成器能够合成令人信服的人像图像，但生成一个有用的数据集与生成单张成功图像是不同的任务。人工中心数据集需要覆盖多样的人物和场景、避免不合理的属性组合、保持日常摄影风格，并且需要在规模化条件下暴露质量控制决策。这些需求促使作者开发一个系统化的、可复现的数据集合成方案。
AI.method: Poplar流水线包含三个阶段：(1) Specify：在常识约束下采样结构化属性，并将其转化为摄影导向的提示词；(2) Render：使用适应真实感的图像生成器，在构图感知的长宽比下渲染，并对明显的技术失败进行重试；(3) Inspect：使用单一结构化的视觉-语言模型对每个候选图像进行审查，保留原始提示词的同时拒绝内在图像缺陷或实质性提示词不匹配。
AI.result: 使用Poplar构建了Poplar-9K数据集：从11,765个被审查的候选中保留了9,401个精选的人为中心图像-文本对，接受率为79.9%。数据集连同流水线、配置、不可变生成提示词和可审计审查记录一起公开释放。
AI.conclusion: Poplar提供了一个紧凑且可复现的资源，用于构建可定制的人为中心图像集合，通过三阶段流水线解决了数据集合成中的质量控制和可审计性问题。

title: HyperODE: Zero-Shot Surrogate for Simulation and Inference of Dynamical Systems
summary: Understanding and controlling complex dynamical systems often requires executing thousands of numerical simulations across vast parametric landscapes, which is time-consuming. Machine learning surrogates significantly accelerate simulation by predicting state trajectories across different initializations and parameter values. However, surrogate models are specialized to one simulation model. Modifying the underlying differential equations - e.g., adding a physiological state or altering an epidemiological contact network - renders trained models obsolete and forces computationally expensive retraining from scratch. We introduce HyperODE, a surrogate capable of operating across an entire class of approximately mass-conserving compartmental models without retraining. By mapping the structure of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) into directed hypergraphs, HyperODE decouples the functional form of system interactions from the neural network architecture. HyperODE takes a compartmental model in the form of an ODE with an arbitrary parameter distribution defined through quantiles and transforms it into a hypergraph. It outputs the distribution of the trajectories for all the states in the original ODE in the form of quantiles. We then use this surrogate to build an encoder that takes a noisy trajectory and outputs a distribution over the parameters of the original ODE, thus calibrating the model in a single pass. On families and system sizes never seen in training, HyperODE produces calibrated quantile bands in a single forward pass, with weighted-interval score and coverage on par with specialized surrogates for each structure. For inverse inference, HyperODE produces calibration from noisy state trajectories in a few milliseconds with a single shared encoder, competitive with existing methods. HyperODE extends zero-shot to ODEs that break mass conservation and to external forcing.

AI.tldr: HyperODE是一种基于超图映射的机器学习替代模型，能够在不重训练的情况下跨整类近似质量守恒的舱室模型进行预测，同时支持正问题和逆问题（参数校准），并在未见过的模型结构和系统规模上实现零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习替代模型针对单一仿真模型定制，当底层微分方程发生变化（如添加生理状态或改变接触网络）时，已训练的模型失效，需要昂贵且耗时的重新训练。这严重限制了替代模型在复杂动力系统探索中的实用性。
AI.method: HyperODE将ODE结构映射为有向超图，将系统交互的功能形式与神经网络架构解耦。具体地，它将任意参数分布（以分位数定义）的舱室模型转换为超图，并输出所有状态轨迹的分位数分布。此外，利用该替代模型构建编码器，从带噪轨迹中输出原始ODE参数分布，实现单次前向传播的模型校准。
AI.result: 在训练中未见过的模型族和系统规模上，HyperODE通过单次前向传播产生校准的分位数带，加权区间分数和覆盖率与针对每个结构的专门替代模型相当。对于逆推理，HyperODE在几毫秒内通过单个共享编码器从带噪轨迹完成校准，性能与现有方法相当。此外，HyperODE可零样本扩展到打破质量守恒的ODE和外部强制场景。
AI.conclusion: HyperODE展示了通过在超图空间中解耦ODE结构与神经网络架构，可以构建具备跨模型泛化能力的通用替代模型，大幅降低复杂动力系统仿真与校准的计算成本，为科学机器学习中的零样本仿真建立了新范式。

title: TreeProbe : A Tibetan Medicine Benchmark for Cultural Bias in LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly viewed as a potential means of mitigating global health inequities, yet their outputs often reflect dominant high-resource medical traditions and provide limited coverage of traditional medical knowledge systems. Tibetan medicine, one of the world's four major traditional medical systems, has an independent and highly structured theoretical framework. When models lack grounded understanding of Tibetan medicine, they may fall back on dominant epistemic systems and distort the native knowledge structure during reasoning. However, quantitative tools for evaluating cultural bias in Tibetan medicine remain largely absent. To address this gap, we introduce TreeProbe, the first cultural-bias benchmark organized around the native Tree of Medicine framework in Tibetan medicine. It contains 4,719 expert-adjudicated items covering 467 diseases and 10 subtasks along the three roots. Experiments on representative LLMs show that current models remain limited in native Tibetan medical contexts and exhibit systematic external ontology drift. Further analysis reveals that models diverge in whether they drift toward biomedical or TCM reasoning, shaped by pretraining data composition and surface resemblance between TCM and Tibetan medicine. TreeProbe provides a diagnostic benchmark for developing medical AI systems that are both linguistically inclusive and epistemically fair. Code and data are available in an anonymous repository at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TreeProbe/.

AI.tldr: TreeProbe 是首个围绕藏医药学"药树"（Tree of Medicine）本土框架构建的文化偏见基准，包含4,719个专家审核条目、467种疾病和10个子任务，用于评估大语言模型在藏医药语境下的表现。实验表明当前LLM在藏医本土语境中能力有限，存在系统性外部本体漂移，且模型在不同外部推理体系（西医或中医）间的漂移方向受预训练数据构成和表面相似性影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被认为可以缓解全球健康不平等，但其输出往往反映高资源医学传统，对传统医学知识体系覆盖不足。藏医药作为世界四大传统医学体系之一，具有独立且高度结构化的理论框架，但缺乏量化评估文化偏见（特别是藏医）的工具，导致模型可能在推理中扭曲本土知识结构。
AI.method: 构建TreeProbe基准，以藏医药学"药树"框架为中心组织，包含4,719个专家审核条目，覆盖467种疾病、10个子任务（沿三条"根"展开）；对代表性LLM进行系统性评估，分析其在藏医本土语境下的表现及外部本体漂移现象。
AI.result: 当前LLM在藏医本土语境中能力有限，表现出系统性的外部本体漂移。模型在向生物医学还是中医推理漂移的倾向上存在差异，这种差异受到预训练数据构成以及中医与藏医之间表面相似性的影响。
AI.conclusion: TreeProbe 提供了一个诊断性基准，有助于开发在语言上具有包容性、在认识论上公平的医疗AI系统，并揭示了模型在跨传统医学体系推理时的文化偏见问题。

title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Aofan Liu and Jingxiang Meng contributed equally; Fangxin Liu and Yongbiao Chen are corresponding authors
summary: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a framework that transforms execution feedback into a dense per-turn test-pass-ratio reward under a consistent multi-turn interaction protocol. Across six models on 219 code-generation problems from LiveCodeBench, TaPR improves the pooled three-turn success rate (Pass@3) by 2.44 percentage points. In the predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy increases from 30.25% to 33.56% (+3.31 pp), with 42 improvements and 13 regressions in paired trials. On a matched Qwen3-8B ablation, the dense reward supplies nonzero feedback in all of the first ten steps and reaches a higher Hard-subset peak than outcome-only GRPO within the tested budget, although GRPO nearly matches pooled Pass@3 by step 300. Our primary contribution is a reward-decomposition framework and a turn-aware evaluation protocol that decouple first-shot generation quality from multi-turn repair competence.

AI.tldr: 提出了测试感知策略精炼（TaPR）框架，将执行反馈转化为密集的逐步测试通过率奖励，用于多轮代码智能体的强化学习训练，解决了单轮结果奖励与多轮自我修复能力之间的错配问题。
AI.motivation: 多轮代码智能体依赖执行反馈来修复错误程序，但标准强化学习范式主要用单轮结果奖励优化和评估策略。这种错配混淆了初始代码生成和反馈驱动的精炼，丢弃了中间轮次的细粒度执行信号，且无法评估策略是否真正获得了自我修复能力。
AI.method: 提出TaPR框架，将执行反馈转化为一致多轮交互协议下的密集逐步测试通过率奖励。通过在LiveCodeBench的219个代码生成问题上对6个模型进行训练和评估。
AI.result: TaPR将三轮成功率（Pass@3）提升2.44个百分点；在7B/8B高余量子集上，准确率从30.25%提升至33.56%（+3.31pp），配对试验中42次改进和13次回退；Qwen3-8B消融实验中，密集奖励在前十步均提供非零反馈，并在Hard子集上达到比仅结果奖励的GRPO更高的峰值。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出了奖励分解框架和轮次感知评估协议，能够将首轮生成质量与多轮修复能力解耦评估。

title: Lossless Tensor Compression as Program Synthesis
summary: Model checkpoints are growing in both number and size, which makes archival, transfer, and deployment increasingly costly. General-purpose compressors can reduce storage requirements but ignore tensor structure, whereas existing tensor-specific compressors rely on fixed and format-specific pipelines. We present Brevis, which formulates lossless tensor compression as program synthesis. We design a typed domain-specific language (DSL) that captures recurring tensor structures, such as repeated regions and floating-point fields, through a set of reversible operators. Given a tensor, Brevis synthesizes a self-contained DSL program that reconstructs it bit-exactly. A checkpoint-specific production prior, learned from a small representative sample of tensors, guides a bounded A* search to synthesize compact programs, which can later be executed directly for bit-exact decompression. On 10 public checkpoints spanning language, audio, and image generation models, Brevis reduces 2.13 TB of checkpoint data to 1.41 TB, a 33.93% storage reduction. It produces archives up to 30.87% smaller than those of four general-purpose compressors, including zstd and gzip, and smaller archives than the tensor-specific compressors ZipNN and DFloat11. Under a practical concurrency configuration, Brevis achieves 3.60 GB/s compression and 6.61 GB/s decompression while preserving every source byte.

AI.tldr: Brevis通过程序合成实现无损张量压缩，利用类型化DSL捕捉张量结构，结合A*搜索和检查点特定的生产先验，在10个公开检查点上实现33.93%的存储缩减，压缩率优于通用压缩器和现有张量专用压缩器。
AI.motivation: 模型检查点数量与规模持续增长，导致存档、传输和部署成本日益高昂。现有通用压缩器忽略张量结构，而张量专用压缩器依赖固定且格式特定的流水线，缺乏灵活性和普适性。
AI.method: 将无损张量压缩形式化为程序合成问题。设计类型化DSL，通过可逆算子捕捉重复区域、浮点字段等常见张量结构。从少量代表性样本学习检查点特定的生产先验，指导有界A*搜索合成紧凑的DSL程序，该程序可直接执行实现逐位精确解压。
AI.result: 在涵盖语言、音频和图像生成模型的10个公开检查点上，Brevis将2.13 TB数据压缩至1.41 TB，实现33.93%存储缩减。生成的存档比zstd、gzip等四种通用压缩器小最多30.87%，也优于ZipNN和DFloat11等张量专用压缩器。实际并发配置下达到3.60 GB/s压缩和6.61 GB/s解压吞吐，且保持字节级无损。
AI.conclusion: Brevis通过程序合成范式统一了张量压缩的灵活性与高效性，在压缩率、吞吐和通用性上均显著优于现有方法，为大规模模型检查点管理提供了实用解决方案。

title: Beyond Static Anchors: Bounded Prototype Conditioning for Language-Free Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: Medical anomaly detection identifies abnormal images and localizes lesions under scarce supervision while generalizing across organs and modalities. Existing CLIP-based methods reduce annotation requirements through vision--language alignment, but their normal and abnormal references, whether text prompts or learned visual tokens, remain fixed across test images. Such static references may not transfer reliably to unseen targets in a cross-domain medical imaging scenario. To address this, we propose ReCAP, a language-free framework that replaces static anchors with input-conditioned visual prototypes. ReCAP re-centers separated normal and abnormal prototypes for each image through a bounded gated modulation, enabling query-adaptive anomaly scoring while constraining context-induced prototype drift. For the few-shot setting, we introduce a non-parametric normal-reference memory to preserve instance-level target-domain variation and complement the conditional prototype branch. Across six medical benchmarks, ReCAP achieves the best image-level AUROC on all zero-shot and 23 of 24 few-shot settings, and the best zero-shot pixel-level AUROC on all three segmentation datasets. Particularly, it reduces inference latency by over 70% compared to the fastest baseline, without text prompts or test-time gradient updates.

AI.tldr: ReCAP是一个无语言框架的医学异常检测方法，用输入条件化的视觉原型替换固定的静态锚点（文本提示或学习到的视觉token），通过有界门控调制为每张图像重新居中分离的正常/异常原型，并在少样本场景中引入非参数正常参考记忆来保留目标域实例级变异。在六个医学基准上，所有零样本图像级AUROC和23/24少样本设置均达到最优，推理延迟降低70%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的医学异常检测方法虽然通过视觉-语言对齐减少了标注需求，但其正常和异常的参考（无论是文本提示还是学习到的视觉token）在测试图像上都是固定的。这种静态参考在跨域医学影像场景下可能无法可靠地迁移到未见的目标域，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 1) 提出ReCAP框架，摒弃语言提示，用输入条件化的视觉原型替代静态锚点；2) 通过有界门控调制为每张输入图像重新居中分离的正常和异常原型，实现查询自适应的异常评分，同时约束上下文引发的原型漂移；3) 在少样本场景引入非参数正常参考记忆，保留实例级目标域变异，与条件原型分支互补。
AI.result: 在六个医学基准数据集上，ReCAP在所有零样本图像级AUROC和23/24少样本设置中取得最优结果；在所有三个分割数据集的零样本像素级AUROC上也达到最优；推理延迟相比最快基线降低超过70%，且无需文本提示或测试时梯度更新。
AI.conclusion: ReCAP证明输入条件化的动态原型比固定静态参考在跨域医学异常检测中更有效，实现了高性能与低延迟的兼顾，且完全无语言依赖，具备更好的跨模态泛化能力。

title: SparseKAN: Compressing Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks Across Basis Functions, Neurons, and Bits
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace scalar edge weights with learnable univariate functions parameterized by multiple basis coefficients. This introduces a source of redundancy that conventional neural-network compression does not directly expose. We present \textbf{SparseKAN}, a unified approach that compresses KANs along three complementary axes: basis functions, neurons/channels, and numerical precision. SparseKAN equips the base branch, nonlinear basis branch, and individual basis terms with hierarchical learnable gates trained under a differentiable active-cost objective. The learned importance structure is subsequently hardened under explicit basis and width budgets, recovered in full or low precision, and physically compacted into smaller dense tensors rather than retained as sparse masks. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 across spline, polynomial, RBF, wavelet, and convolutional KAN variants show that the structural axes compose predictably in cost. We also find strong basis-dependent differences in term importance: coefficient-based selection outperforms matched low-order truncation by up to 15.25 accuracy points in the evaluated Gram-polynomial settings. Eight-bit quantization is broadly robust, whereas 4-bit convolutional KANs require quantization-aware adaptation. Physical compaction removes up to 73.0\% of parameters without accuracy loss on MNIST and reduces large-batch CUDA latency to as little as $0.51\times$ dense execution. On a ZCU104 FPGA, the resulting sparse low-bit models achieve up to $23.63\times$ lower inference latency, demonstrating that SparseKAN converts functional redundancy into measurable software and hardware efficiency. The SparseKAN implementation is available at https://github.com/OSU-STARLAB/SparseKAN.

AI.tldr: SparseKAN是一个统一的KAN压缩框架，从基函数、神经元/通道和数值精度三个维度对Kolmogorov-Arnold网络进行压缩。通过层次化可学习门控和可微激活成本目标学习重要性结构，并物理压缩为更小的密集张量，在多种KAN变体上验证了有效性，实现了最高73%参数削减和23.63倍的FPGA推理延迟降低。
AI.motivation: KAN用可学习单变量函数替代标量边权重，引入了传统神经网络压缩方法无法直接处理的冗余来源。需要一个能够针对KAN独特结构的统一压缩方案。
AI.method: SparseKAN沿着三个互补轴压缩KAN：（1）基函数压缩；（2）神经元/通道压缩；（3）数值精度压缩。为基分支、非线性基分支和单个基项配备层次化可学习门控，在可微激活成本目标下训练，然后根据显式基和宽度预算对学习的结构进行硬化，以全精度或低精度恢复，并物理压缩成更小的密集张量而非保留稀疏掩码。
AI.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上对样条、多项式、RBF、小波和卷积KAN变体的实验表明：结构轴在成本上可预测地组合；系数选择比匹配的低阶截断在Gram多项式设置中最多高15.25个精度点；8位量化普遍稳健，而4位卷积KAN需要量化感知适应；物理压缩在MNIST上无精度损失移除高达73.0%参数，并将大批量CUDA延迟降至密集执行的0.51倍；在ZCU104 FPGA上实现高达23.63倍更低的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: SparseKAN有效证明了KAN中的功能冗余可以被转化为可测量的软件和硬件效率提升，跨多种KAN架构和不同硬件平台均取得了显著效果。

title: Select-And-Extract: A Lightweight Plugin for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for language model (LM) systems fundamentally has two failure modes: retrieval failure and reading failure. The former fails to recall the right pieces of information from the external corpus, and the latter fails to produce the correct answer although the right information is retrieved. Some methods perform structured indexing for retrieval failure, but may suffer from limited generalization of the fixed structures. Some methods perform query-time structuring for reading failure, but typically require a lot of LM calls and rely heavily on the LM's capability. To this end, we propose Select-ANd-Extract (SANE), a simple yet effective plugin for RAG. For the retrieval failure, we retrieve a wide set of candidates with a semantic retriever, and leverage the LM to select the top candidates based on their synopses, which yields better recall than the original retriever. For the reading failure, we perform blueprint-guided query-time evidence extraction, which allows the generator LM to use only compact and structured key information so that it can perform better reasoning. Empirical results confirm that SANE brings solid improvements, while only introducing modest extra overhead. As a lightweight plugin for RAG, SANE offers a simple alternative to heavier approaches, and suggests a high-performance RAG framework need not be overly complex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SANE（Select-ANd-Extract），一个轻量级的RAG插件，通过"语义检索宽召回 + LM基于摘要选择候选"解决检索失败，以及"蓝图引导的查询时证据抽取"解决阅读失败，在引入适度额外开销的同时显著提升RAG系统性能。
AI.motivation: RAG系统存在两类根本性失败模式：检索失败（无法从外部语料中召回正确信息）和阅读失败（即使检索到正确信息也无法生成正确答案）。现有方法在解决这两类问题上各有局限：结构化索引方法受限于固定结构的泛化能力，查询时结构化方法则需要大量LM调用且过度依赖LM能力。因此需要一种简单高效的方法同时应对这两类失败。
AI.method: SANE包含两个核心组件：(1) 针对检索失败：使用语义检索器召回广泛的候选集，然后利用LM基于候选的摘要（synopses）选择top候选，从而获得比原始检索器更高的召回率；(2) 针对阅读失败：采用蓝图（blueprint）引导的查询时证据抽取，为生成LM提供紧凑且结构化的关键信息，使其能够进行更好的推理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SANE在各项指标上带来了稳定的改进，同时仅引入适度的额外开销。作为RAG的轻量级插件，SANE相比更重的方法提供了简单且高性能的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: SANE证明了高性能的RAG框架不一定要过于复杂，轻量级的方法同样可以取得出色的效果，为RAG系统的设计提供了一种简洁高效的范式。

title: BayesSeg: A Bayesian Optimization Framework for State Segmentation of Electricity Consumption Time Series
summary: In Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM), adaptive segmentation of electricity consumption time series is critical for appliance recognition. However, prevailing methods face challenges including heuristic parameter tuning, boundary sensitivity, and metric saturation. This paper proposes BayesSeg, a unified framework integrating time-series segmentation, multidimensional evaluation, and automatic parameter optimization. The segmentation layer employs a dual steady-state criterion based on the tail value and mean of preceding subsequences, combined with a sequential extraction and complement-set parsing strategy, to achieve precise unsupervised partitioning of steady-state and transition-state segments. The evaluation layer maps segmentation results to binary state sequences and formulates a composite metric integrating an event-level F1 score (event_F1) with Normalized Mutual Information (NMI). The event_F1 quantifies switching-event precision and recall via tolerance matching, while NMI captures global structural consistency, jointly overcoming the boundary sensitivity and limited discriminability of point-wise metrics. In the optimization layer, the composite score serves as the objective function for Bayesian optimization, which constructs a TPE surrogate model for efficient global parameter-space exploration. Experiments on the SustDataED2 dataset demonstrate that Bayesian optimization requires only ~100 objective evaluations to locate a parameter region within 0.35% deviation of the exhaustive grid-search optimum. The framework achieves a weighted composite score of 0.7149 and an event_F1 of 0.9340 while reducing optimization latency from ~5300 seconds to under 1 second, a speedup exceeding 5700x. BayesSeg automates segmentation configuration and provides a scalable, efficient solution for time-series analysis in NILM and related domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BayesSeg，一个用于非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）的统一框架，集成了时间序列自适应分割、多维评估和自动参数优化。该框架通过双稳态判据实现无监督分割，结合事件级F1分数与归一化互信息构建复合评估指标，并利用贝叶斯优化（TPE代理模型）实现高效参数搜索。在SustDataED2数据集上，仅需约100次目标评估即可达到全局网格搜索最优解0.35%偏差内，加权复合分数达0.7149，事件F1达0.9340，优化延迟从约5300秒降至1秒以内（加速超过5700倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有NILM中的时间序列自适应分割方法面临三大挑战：启发式参数调优困难、边界敏感性高以及评估指标易饱和（区分度不足），需要一种能够统一解决分割、评估和参数优化的框架。
AI.method: BayesSeg采用三层架构：（1）分割层：基于前序子序列的尾值和均值构建双稳态判据，结合顺序提取与补集解析策略，实现稳态和过渡态段的无监督精确划分；（2）评估层：将分割结果映射为二元状态序列，构建融合事件级F1分数（容忍匹配量化开关事件精度与召回率）和NMI（捕获全局结构一致性）的复合指标；（3）优化层：以复合分数为目标函数，采用TPE代理模型的贝叶斯优化进行全局参数空间高效探索。
AI.result: 在SustDataED2数据集上，贝叶斯优化仅需约100次目标函数评估即可定位到距全局网格搜索最优解仅0.35%偏差的参数区域。框架达到0.7149的加权复合分数和0.9340的事件F1分数，优化延迟从约5300秒降至1秒以内，实现超过5700倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: BayesSeg实现了分割配置的自动化，为NILM及相关领域的时间序列分析提供了可扩展且高效的解决方案，有效克服了传统方法的参数调优困难、边界敏感性和指标饱和问题。

title: ECLAIR: A Causally-Grounded AI Framework for Scientific Discovery in Empirical Software Engineering
summary: The scientific method has long guided empirical research in Software Engineering (SE), but the complexity of modern software systems often hinders its systematic application. This paper introduces _ECLAIR_, a causally grounded AI framework that integrates Large Language Models (_LLMs_) into every stage of the scientific process, from hypothesis generation to analysis and interpretation. _ECLAIR_ treats _LLMs_ as active **scientific agents** operating under the principles of causal inference, within a human-in-the-loop design that safeguards against the risks of unsound automated reasoning. We demonstrate the framework through a case study examining how prompt design influences code generation accuracy in two _LLMs_. Results show that, for both models, instruction-style, longer few-shot, and signature-augmented prompts yield small negative causal effects on accuracy, illustrating how causal reasoning provides a principled foundation for explaining _why_ software phenomena occur. This study presents the first causally grounded structured methodology for embedding _LLMs_ within the scientific method in SE, designed around the epistemological demands of empirical SE research, establishing a basis for rigorous AI-assisted research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECLAIR框架，将大语言模型作为科学代理集成到软件工程实证研究的全流程中，以因果推断为基础、人机协同为保障，并通过案例研究验证了提示设计对代码生成准确性的因果影响。
AI.motivation: 现代软件系统日益复杂，传统的科学方法在软件工程实证研究中难以系统化应用，且现有研究缺乏将因果推断与大语言模型相结合的严格方法论框架。
AI.method: ECLAIR框架将LLMs作为主动科学代理，在因果推断原则下运作，采用人在回路设计防止自动化推理风险，覆盖从假设生成到分析解释的科学流程全阶段。
AI.result: 通过案例研究发现，指令式风格、更长少样本和签名增强的提示对两种LLM的代码生成准确率均产生小幅负面因果效应，展示了因果推理如何解释软件现象。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次提出了将LLMs嵌入SE科学方法的因果基础结构化方法论，围绕实证SE研究的知识论需求设计，为严格的AI辅助研究奠定了基础。

title: Reconstruction-Shift Discrimination via Mask-Guided Latent Diffusion for Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: Unsupervised medical anomaly detection learns normal anatomical patterns from healthy training images and identifies deviations at test time. Reconstruction-based and diffusion-based methods commonly use the difference between an input image and its reconstruction as anomaly evidence. However, this residual can be ambiguous. Expressive models may preserve pathological structures, while benign anatomical variation, imaging noise, and acquisition differences may also produce large reconstruction errors. We propose discriminative mask-guided diffusion (DMD), a medical anomaly detection framework that complements residual-based localization with reconstruction-shift discrimination. DMD first learns a compact quantized latent representation of normal images. Localized masks then perturb selected latent regions, and a latent diffusion model reconstructs the perturbed representations. The resulting reconstructions are paired with their original normal images to define a self-supervised classification task. At inference, the classifier provides a learned image-level anomaly score, while the residual between the input and its diffusion-based reconstruction yields a pixel-level anomaly map. Experiments on five datasets spanning brain MRI, breast ultrasound, and chest radiography show that DMD achieves the best overall performance among the state-of-the-art baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DMD（判别式掩码引导扩散）框架，结合基于残差的定位与重建转移判别，用于无监督医学异常检测。DMD先学习正常图像的紧凑量化潜表征，再用局部掩码扰动潜区域，通过潜在扩散模型重建，并利用重建结果与原正常图像配对构建自监督分类任务。在推理时，分类器提供图像级异常分数，残差提供像素级异常图。在五个数据集（脑MRI、乳腺超声、胸部X光）上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的重建型和扩散型医学异常检测方法主要依赖输入图像与重建图像之间的残差作为异常证据，但该残差存在歧义性：表达能力强的模型可能保留病理结构，而良性解剖变异、成像噪声和采集差异也可能产生大的重建误差，导致检测不准确。
AI.method: DMD首先学习正常图像的紧凑量化潜表征，然后通过局部化掩码扰动选定的潜区域，利用潜在扩散模型重建被扰动的表征。重建结果与原正常图像配对，定义一个自监督分类任务。推断时，分类器输出图像级异常分数，输入与扩散重建之间的残差生成像素级异常图。
AI.result: 在涵盖脑MRI、乳腺超声和胸部X光的五个数据集上，DMD在整体性能上超越了现有的最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将残差定位与重建转移判别结合，DMD有效解决了传统残差方法的歧义性问题，实现了更精准的图像级和像素级医学异常检测。

title: Kilobyte Models: Neural Networks as a Seed and a Quantized Latent
summary: The cost of storing and transmitting a trained neural network scales with its parameter count, a bottleneck for over-the-air updates, on-device libraries, and other bandwidth-bound deployments. We study an extreme form of model compression in which the deployable artifact is not the weights but a short recipe for regenerating them. Building on Mapping Networks, which express a network's weights as a nonlinear function of a compact trainable latent and a fixed random basis, we observe that only the latent need be stored, because the basis and initialization center are reproducible from an integer seed. A model becomes a seed together with a quantized latent, whose size is set by the latent dimension and bit width rather than the parameter count. We formalize this artifact and introduce a seeded block-wise basis that scales to networks whose projection cannot be held in memory. In our experiments, a mapped model is as accurate as the same network quantized aggressively to a few bits per weight, while taking far fewer bytes to store. Reaching the most aggressive bit widths depends on fine-tuning the latent with quantization in the loop. The results do not depend on the particular random basis, and a structured basis lets the weights be regenerated almost for free even for large networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种极端模型压缩方法：不存储权重本身，而是存储一个"种子+量化潜变量"的短配方来重新生成权重。基于Mapping Networks的思想，权重被表示为紧凑可训练潜变量与固定随机基底的非线性函数，只需存储种子和潜变量即可在部署端重新生成整个网络。
AI.motivation: 训练好的神经网络存储和传输成本随参数数量线性增长，这成为无线更新（over-the-air updates）、设备端库（on-device libraries）等带宽受限部署场景的瓶颈。现有方法即使进行量化压缩，仍然需要存储所有权重，本文探索一种超越传统压缩范式的方法。
AI.method: 1）基于Mapping Networks框架，将网络权重表示为固定随机基底与紧凑可训练潜变量的非线性函数；2）提出"种子化块式基底"（seeded block-wise basis），可扩展到投影无法在内存中容纳的大规模网络；3）引入量化感知的潜变量微调（quantization in the loop）以实现极低比特宽度的压缩；4）结构化基底使得大网络权重几乎免费重新生成，且结果不依赖特定随机基底的选择。
AI.result: 实验表明：映射模型（mapped model）的准确率与激进量化到每权重几比特的同一网络相当，但存储字节数远少；达到最激进的比特宽度需要量化在环微调；结果对随机基底的选择不敏感，结构化基底可实现大网络权重的几乎零成本重新生成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作重新定义了模型压缩的下限——不再受参数数量限制，存储成本仅取决于潜变量维度与比特宽度。这一范式为带宽受限场景下的模型分发提供了新思路，且通过种子可复现的特性实现了部署灵活性。

title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
summary: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future. Unlike conventional language-model interactions, agent behavior is mediated through a shared state that is repeatedly modified and reused across long-horizon workflows. Current safety benchmarks often fail to capture these cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce OpenART, an open-ended arena for scalable agent red teaming through environment evolution. OpenART provides over 10,000 validated stateful scenarios across 50 domains, drawing from a pool of more than 500,000 tools and skills. These tasks require a median of 97 tool calls and enable unified evaluation across 75 different agent-model configurations. To systematically explore these evolving attack surfaces, we propose the Evolutionary Markov Hypergraph Attack (EMHA). EMHA is a black-box policy that performs feedback-driven environment evolution by coordinating authorized state transitions without requiring parameter updates.
