Throughout the evaluation, task objectives remain fixed while only the environment state changes. Across all configurations, EMHA achieves a pooled Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 85.0%. Its advantage over instruction-only evolution increases from approximately 2% on simple environments to over 17% on the most complex ones, demonstrating that environment evolution increasingly exposes safety failures as task complexity grows. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the specific runtime implementation of an agent explains a significant portion of safety variation beyond the underlying model's capabilities. These results establish OpenART as a scalable foundation for studying agent safety in complex, evolving environments.

AI.tldr: OpenART是一个开放式的智能体红队测试竞技场，通过环境演化的方式提供超过10,000个跨50个领域的有状态场景（中位数97次工具调用），并提出了EMHA（进化马尔可夫超图攻击）黑盒策略来实现反馈驱动的环境演化。EMHA在75种智能体-模型配置上实现85%的平均攻击成功率，且环境演化在复杂任务中显现的优势（超过17%）远大于简单环境（2%），证明环境状态演化是暴露智能体安全缺陷的关键途径。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准测试主要聚焦于短时、静态的任务，无法捕捉智能体在长时间、有状态环境中累积的安全风险。智能体的行为通过共享状态在长时序工作流中被反复修改和复用，这种累积性风险需要新的评估框架来系统探索。
AI.method: 1) 构建OpenART：整合超过500,000个工具和技能，提供10,000多个经过验证的有状态场景，覆盖50个领域，支持75种智能体-模型配置的统一评估。2) 提出EMHA（Evolutionary Markov Hypergraph Attack）：一种黑盒策略，通过协调授权状态转换实现反馈驱动的环境演化，无需参数更新，任务目标保持不变仅演化环境状态。
AI.result: EMHA在所有配置上实现85.0%的池化攻击成功率；相比仅指令演化，优势从简单环境的约2%增长到最复杂环境的17%以上；分析还发现智能体的运行时实现比底层模型能力更能解释安全差异的显著部分。
AI.conclusion: OpenART为在复杂演化环境中研究智能体安全提供了可扩展的基础，证明了环境演化是系统暴露智能体安全缺陷的有效手段，并指出智能体运行时实现是影响安全性的关键因素。

title: CURE: Local Uncertainty Repair for Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding mitigates the latency of sequential generation in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by interleaving draft generation with target verification. However, existing parallel drafting backends often suffer from rapid accuracy degradation over long horizons, leading to high rejection rates during verification and suboptimal wall-clock speedups. We observe that drafting errors are not uniformly distributed but typically stem from localized high-uncertainty tokens that destabilize downstream generation trajectories. Motivated by this token error pattern, we propose CURE, a budget-aware dynamic repair tree designed to repair errors at uncertainty focal points without incurring prohibitive tree-verification overheads. Specifically, our method uses predictive confidence margins to dynamically locate candidate error tokens within a block-parallel draft, expands bounded repair paths only at these fragile nodes, and employs a novel repair resynchronization mechanism to realign draft states post-verification. Evaluations on code-generation benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench-lite) and mathematical reasoning benchmark (GSM8K) demonstrate that CURE increases the average accepted length by 4.2-7.5% over parallel baselines without repair, translating to an end-to-end speedup of $2.66-3.49\times$ over target-only decoding. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play repair module compatible with standard parallel drafting frameworks. We also characterize the trade-off between draft compute and verification efficiency.

AI.tldr: CURE是一种预算感知的动态修复树方法，针对推测解码中并行草稿的局部高不确定性token错误进行定向修复，在代码生成和数学推理基准上平均接受长度提升4.2-7.5%，端到端加速比达2.66-3.49倍。
AI.motivation: 现有并行草稿后端在长距离推测中快速精度退化，导致验证时高拒绝率和次优的墙钟加速。观察到草稿错误并非均匀分布，而是源于局部高不确定性token干扰下游生成轨迹，因此需要针对性修复策略。
AI.method: 提出CURE方法：(1) 使用预测置信度边际动态定位块并行草稿中的候选错误token；(2) 仅在脆弱节点扩展有界修复路径；(3) 设计修复重同步机制在验证后对齐草稿状态。该方法可作为即插即用模块兼容标准并行草稿框架。
AI.result: 在HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite和GSM8K基准上，平均接受长度提升4.2-7.5%，相对无修复并行基线实现2.66-3.49倍端到端加速，并表征了草稿计算与验证效率之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: CURE通过精准定位和修复高不确定性token，有效提升了并行推测解码的长程草稿质量，在不引入过高验证开销的前提下显著提升端到端推理速度，且模块化设计便于集成到现有框架中。

title: On Automated and Explainable Provenance of AI-Generated Code
summary: Generative AI for code generation has transformed software development, but it has also introduced a critical transparency problem: the origins of AI-generated code are opaque to the developers who use it, the organizations that deploy it, and the compliance professionals responsible for ensuring its legal and quality standards. Existing mitigations flag problematic outputs after the fact without explaining why a model produced them or how future generation could be improved. We present a research vision, grounded in a U.S. NSF-funded research grant, that argues that the next generation of CodeGenAI tools must be built on a foundation of explainable provenance: automated, post-hoc traceability that links generated code back to the prompt components, training data instances, global data features, and internal model components that caused its generation. We grounded this vision in empirical evidence from studies of software developers, model users, and compliance/legal professionals, which show that provenance information is a practical necessity that current tools do not provide. We characterize the problem across four traceability dimensions, outline a research program combining large-scale empirical studies with post-hoc causal and interpretability techniques, and identify the key open challenges that the community must address to realize this vision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个研究愿景，主张下一代代码生成AI工具必须建立在可解释溯源的基础上，即通过自动化的事后追溯，将生成的代码连接到提示组件、训练数据实例、全局数据特征和内部模型组件。该愿景基于NSF资助的研究项目，并通过开发者、模型用户和合规专业人士的实证研究加以支持。
AI.motivation: AI代码生成虽然极大改变了软件开发，但引入了严重的透明度问题：AI生成代码的来源对开发者、组织和合规专业人士而言是不透明的。现有的缓解措施只能在事后标记问题输出，却无法解释模型为何产生这些输出，也无法指导未来生成的改进。
AI.method: 作者构建了四项可追溯性维度的研究框架，提出一个结合大规模实证研究与事后因果分析和可解释性技术的研究计划，并基于来自软件开发者、模型用户和合规/法律专业人士的实证证据来支撑其研究愿景。
AI.result: 实证研究表明，溯源信息是实际需求，但当前工具无法提供。作者识别了四项可追溯性维度，并指出了实现该愿景需要解决的关键开放性挑战。
AI.conclusion: 下一代CodeGenAI工具必须建立在可解释溯源的基础上，需要社区共同努力，将事后因果分析和可解释性技术集成到代码生成工作流中，以实现对AI生成代码的透明度和问责。

title: Structured Proxy Features for Multimodal NSCLC Survival Prediction from Pretreatment CT
summary: Lung cancer results in roughly 1.8 million fatalities annually worldwide, with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) comprising the majority of cases. Despite advancements in treatment, survival stratification remains challenging due to intratumoral heterogeneity inadequately captured by conventional descriptors. Standard radiomic and deep learning techniques regard imaging features as independent quantities, overlooking structured interactions between tumor characteristics. We evaluate whether structured proxy features can enhance multimodal NSCLC survival prediction by augmenting pretreatment computed tomography (CT) representations, radiomics, and clinical variables with six simulation-derived features designed to capture interactions between heterogeneity and morphology. A radiomic-parameterized cellular automaton generates growth-rate and necrosis-ratio proxy features from baseline CT by using entropy and sphericity to compute low-dimensional proxy parameters. The imaging backbone is a Transformer-based Masked Autoencoder (TMAE), which was chosen after a systematic evaluation with alternative encoders within the same pipeline and provides attention-based visualizations that highlight tumor regions receiving higher model attention. On the public Lung1 cohort (n = 390), the primary four-modality fusion attained a C-index of 0.641 (iAUC 0.731, log-rank p < 0.001). The primary result compares favorably with prior multimodal results on Lung1 (C-index 0.631; iAUC 0.592 [15]) under a comparable evaluation protocol, while a separate exploratory coefficient-optimization analysis achieved a best observed C-index of 0.662 (iAUC 0.748). These results indicate that, in addition to conventional radiomic, deep, and clinical representations within the Lung1 benchmark, simulation-derived proxy features may provide complementary predictive information within this fixed Lung1 benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多模态非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）生存预测方法，在传统CT影像、放射组学和临床变量基础上，引入通过辐射组学参数化元胞自动机生成的六个模拟衍生代理特征（生长速率和坏死比），利用Transformer掩码自编码器（TMAE）作为影像骨干网络。在公共Lung1队列（n=390）上取得C-index 0.641（iAUC 0.731），优于既往多模态结果（C-index 0.631）。
AI.motivation: 肺癌年致死约180万例，NSCLC占多数。传统放射组学和深度学习方法将影像特征视为独立量，忽略了肿瘤特征之间的结构化交互关系，导致生存分层不够准确，亟需捕捉肿瘤内异质性与形态学之间相互作用的补充特征。
AI.method: 1) 使用放射组学参数化元胞自动机，以熵和球形度计算低维代理参数，从基线CT生成生长速率和坏死比两类代理特征；2) 采用Transformer掩码自编码器（TMAE）作为影像骨干编码器，经系统评估优于其他编码器；3) 将模拟代理特征与CT表示、放射组学、临床变量融合，构建四模态预测框架；4) 提供基于注意力的可视化，突出模型高关注度的肿瘤区域。
AI.result: 在公共Lung1队列（n=390）上，四模态融合取得C-index 0.641（iAUC 0.731，log-rank p<0.001），优于先前多模态结果的C-index 0.631（iAUC 0.592）；探索性系数优化分析的最佳C-index达0.662（iAUC 0.748）。
AI.conclusion: 模拟衍生的代理特征在Lung1基准中可为传统放射组学、深度学习和临床特征提供互补的预测信息，支持将仿真驱动的特征纳入多模态NSCLC生存预测框架。

title: GeoArbiter: Verifiability-Guided Grounding for Remote-Sensing Multimodal LLMs
summary: Remote-sensing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often assert facts that imagery cannot establish, such as a facility's identity or function. Coordinate-keyed geographic retrieval can supply this missing knowledge, improving fMoW land-use accuracy by 12.06--17.19 points across three open MLLMs. However, retrieved records can also contradict visible evidence, and we find that models frequently follow the records even when the image is decisive. We argue that source trust should therefore depend on \emph{cross-modal verifiability}: geographic records are most useful for attributes the image cannot verify and most dangerous when they dispute visually verifiable attributes. We introduce GeoArbiter, a training-free pipeline that operationalizes this principle by injecting only image-unverifiable geographic facts. Unlike arbitration prompts, which leak across attribute types and bias yes/no responses, content-level filtering preserves 84.69--87.15\% of the full-retrieval accuracy gain, reduces claim-level hallucination by 9.58--26.34\% under a source-blinded judge, and improves robustness to conflicting records across all three models. These results identify verifiability-guided content selection as a simple, effective mechanism for grounding remote-sensing MLLMs in fallible geographic knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoArbiter，一种无需训练的流程，通过仅注入图像无法验证的地理事实来锚定遥感多模态大语言模型（MLLM），从而减少幻觉并提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 遥感MLLM经常断言图像无法证实的事实（如设施身份或功能），导致幻觉问题。虽然基于坐标的地理检索可以提供缺失知识并提升fMoW土地分类精度，但检索到的记录可能与图像证据冲突，模型会盲目跟随记录，即使图像信息已经足够明确。
AI.method: 作者提出跨模态可验证性（cross-modal verifiability）原则，认为地理记录对于图像无法验证的属性最有用，对于与视觉可验证属性冲突时最危险。GeoArbiter通过在内容层面过滤，仅注入图像无法验证的地理事实，而非使用会泄漏跨属性信息和偏置yes/no响应的仲裁提示（arbitration prompts）。
AI.result: GeoArbiter在三个开源MLLM上保留了全量检索精度增益的84.69-87.15%，在源盲判官下将声明级幻觉减少9.58-26.34%，并在所有三个模型上提升了面对冲突记录的鲁棒性。全量检索将fMoW土地分类精度提升12.06-17.19点。
AI.conclusion: 可验证性指导的内容选择是一种简单有效的机制，用于将遥感MLLM锚定在可能存在错误的地理知识上，为在不可靠外部知识下增强多模态模型的可靠性提供了新思路。

title: AttnLink: Turning Attention into Schema Links for Text-to-SQL
summary: Schema linking is a critical component of Text-to-SQL systems, but existing approaches often trade off contextual modeling capacity, score-based controllability, and inference efficiency. We introduce AttnLink, an attention-based framework that converts LLMs' internal attention into continuous relevance scores for schema items. AttnLink extracts the attention from the generation-start position to candidate schema spans, enabling all candidates to be ranked in a single prefill pass without autoregressive decoding. We develop two variants: AttnLink-U, which directly probes pretrained attention without parameter updates, and AttnLink-S, which aligns the attention distribution with gold schema items through direct supervision. To improve coverage of multiple relevant schema items, AttnLink-S combines a set-mass objective with an adaptive probability-floor regularizer. The resulting scores support post-hoc precision-recall control through temperature scaling and cumulative-mass selection. Experiments on Spider, BIRD, and Spider2-SQLite show that AttnLink-S achieves mAP scores of 99.22%, 95.95%, and 83.29%, respectively, with millisecond-scale schema-linking latency. It also yields the best or tied-best execution accuracy for downstream SQL generation in seven of nine generator-dataset settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AttnLink，一种基于注意力机制的Text-to-SQL模式链接（schema linking）框架。AttnLink将LLM的内部注意力转换为模式项目的连续相关性分数，通过单次预填充（prefill）即可对所有候选项目排序，避免了自回归解码。包含两种变体：AttnLink-U（零参数）和AttnLink-S（有监督对齐），在Spider、BIRD和Spider2-SQLite上分别达到99.22%、95.95%和83.29%的mAP，且延迟低至毫秒级。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统中的模式链接方法通常在上下文建模能力、基于分数的可控性和推理效率之间存在权衡。已有方法难以同时兼顾这三方面，需要一种新框架来打破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: AttnLink从生成起始位置提取LLM注意力到候选模式片段，将所有候选在一次prefill中排序。开发两种变体：AttnLink-U直接探测预训练注意力（无参数更新），AttnLink-S通过直接监督对齐注意力分布与黄金模式项目。AttnLink-S结合集合质量目标（set-mass objective）和自适应概率下限正则化（probability-floor regularizer）提高多相关项目覆盖率。最终分数支持通过温度缩放和累积质量选择实现事后精确率-召回率控制。
AI.result: 在Spider、BIRD和Spider2-SQLite上，AttnLink-S的mAP分别达到99.22%、95.95%和83.29%，模式链接延迟为毫秒级。在九个生成器-数据集组合中，有七个达到最佳或并列最佳的SQL生成执行准确率。
AI.conclusion: AttnLink验证了利用LLM内部注意力进行高效模式链接的可行性，在不牺牲精度的前提下实现了毫秒级延迟，并提供了可调节的分数控制机制，为Text-to-SQL的模式链接提供了新的高效方案。

title: Through the LENS: Local Geometric Decomposition of Vision-Language Model Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) process image patches and text tokens in a shared residual stream, but the local geometry through which the two modalities interact remains poorly understood. Most interpretability methods identify global linear directions, which may miss representations that are globally high-dimensional but locally low-dimensional. We introduce LENS (Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces), a method that decomposes VLM activations into local low-rank Gaussian neighborhoods using a Mixture of Factor Analyzers. Applied to LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, LENS reveals distinct depth-dependent fusion trajectories consistent with each model's fusion mechanism: LLaVA progressively mixes modalities at later layers, whereas Qwen3-VL mixes them early, partially re-segregates them, and recombines them near the output. An automated multimodal labeling pipeline assigns concise semantic descriptions to these neighborhoods. Interpolating activations toward neighborhood centroids causally redirects generation within and across modalities and outperforms difference-in-means and VL-SAE in most evaluated conditions; in one LLaVA vision-to-vision setting, MFA achieves 5.7 times the VL-SAE score. Human evaluation finds MFA steering competitive with prompting and substantially stronger than the other intervention baselines. Finally, the MFA coefficient space improves Qwen3-VL image-to-rendered-text retrieval at the deepest evaluated layer from 14.9% to 48.6% R@1. Ablations show that the reported fusion trajectories are stable across component counts, local ranks, and modality-purity thresholds. These results support local geometric neighborhoods as useful interpretable and causal units for analyzing cross-modal representations in the evaluated VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LENS（局部邻域子空间解释）方法，利用因子分析混合模型将VLM激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域，揭示了两类VLM（LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B）中不同的深度依赖融合轨迹，并展示了这些局部几何单元在因果干预、检索增强等任务上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在共享残差流中处理图像块和文本token，但两种模态交互的局部几何结构尚未被充分理解。现有可解释性方法多识别全局线性方向，可能遗漏"全局高维但局部低维"的表征，因此需要一种局部几何视角的分析方法。
AI.method: 提出LENS方法，使用混合因子分析器（Mixture of Factor Analyzers, MFA）将VLM激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域。结合自动多模态标注管线为邻域赋予语义描述，并通过向邻域质心插值激活实现因果干预，还利用MFA系数空间进行跨模态检索。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B上发现不同融合轨迹：LLaVA在后期逐层混合模态，而Qwen3-VL早期混合、部分重新分离、输出前再重组。MFA干预在大多数条件下优于均值差和VL-SAE方法，其中一个视觉到视觉场景中得分是VL-SAE的5.7倍；人类评估显示MFA引导与提示竞争性相当且优于其他基线；在Qwen3-VL图像到渲染文本检索中，最深层R@1从14.9%提升至48.6%。消融实验验证了轨迹的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 局部几何邻域是有用的可解释且可因果干预的分析单元，能够更好地理解VLM跨模态表征，并为后续的干预和检索任务提供更优的工具。

title: Profitability of Open-Source Software Product Development
summary: Many technology firms now build software products in the open, inviting outside developers to contribute alongside their employees on platforms like GitHub. Does this openness in product development pay off? Analyzing 977 U.S. high-tech firms from 2001 to 2025, this study finds that open-source adoption raised firms' gross margins by 4-5% on average. These gains flow largely through higher labor productivity, as firms integrate external contributors' diverse knowledge into internal workflows, broadening the organizational knowledge base without a commensurate rise in labor costs. However, the payoff emerges only when outside volunteers supply a meaningful share of the work (around 35% in this sample), and hinges on the firm's resource configuration. While there are multiple pathways to profitability, pairing open-source product development with sustained internal R&D is a core condition present in all high-profitability configurations. For managers, the lesson is to treat open source as a knowledge-integration strategy matched to the firm's resources, not merely a means of sourcing external effort at lower cost. For policymakers, the findings underscore the broad economic value of open-source ecosystems and the need for policies that foster skilled volunteer communities and public-private open-source infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析2001-2025年间977家美国高科技企业，发现采用开源开发模式可使企业毛利率平均提升4-5%，主要通过劳动生产率的提高实现。但这种收益仅在外部贡献者承担约35%工作量，且与企业资源配置相匹配时才显现，其中持续的内部研发投入是所有高盈利路径中的核心条件。
AI.motivation: 许多科技企业选择在GitHub等平台上开放产品开发，邀请外部开发者参与贡献，但"开放性"是否真的能带来经济回报尚未得到系统验证，需要严谨的实证研究来回答这一关键商业问题。
AI.method: 对2001至2025年间977家美国高科技企业的大样本数据进行实证分析，考察开源采用对企业毛利率的影响，并运用配置分析（配置理论）探究不同资源组合下实现高盈利的多元路径。
AI.result: 开源采用平均提升毛利率4-5%；收益主要通过劳动生产率的提升实现（外部贡献者多样化知识融入内部流程，扩大组织知识库而不相应增加劳动力成本）；但收益出现需外部志愿者贡献占比达约35%，且依赖企业资源配置；持续内部研发是所有高盈利配置中的核心条件。
AI.conclusion: 管理者应将开源视为与企业资源相匹配的知识整合战略，而非单纯降低外部劳动力成本的工具；政策制定者应重视开源生态系统的广泛经济价值，制定政策支持技能志愿者社区及公私合作的开源基础设施。

title: AOSpec: Action and Observation Co-Speculation for Low-Latency Agent Serving
summary: Large language model agents increasingly act through stateful tools, yet model generation and environment execution remain serialized at every step. As decoding accelerates, tool execution becomes a growing bottleneck. Existing action- or observation-only speculation leaves much of this latency exposed: value is concentrated in a few slow calls, some outcomes emerge only through execution, and longer lookahead typically requires an increasingly unlikely chain of action predictions. We present AOSpec, a lossless framework that co-speculates actions and observations across the full agent-environment loop. Expected Value Decoding (EVD) directs observation speculation toward outcomes with the greatest expected latency benefit, optimizing expected time hidden rather than hit rate. For outcomes only execution can reveal, AOSpec launches latency-critical target actions in isolated forks that contain their effects, while Joint Action-State Verification (JASV) verifies both the action and its origin state against committed execution before reuse. JASV recasts long-horizon action dependency from full-chain prediction into target action-state verification, breaking the lookahead--accuracy tradeoff and unlocking long-range overlap without sacrificing serial semantics. Across Terminal-Bench serving settings spanning four harnesses, five actor models, and five serving speeds, AOSpec outperforms every practical baseline, reducing mean end-to-end latency by 11.8-32.5% and p99 latency by up to 42.8%. Its gains increase as decoding accelerates, and its observation model transfers from Terminal-Bench to SWE-bench Verified without retraining.

AI.tldr: AOSpec是一个无损耗（lossless）的框架，通过协同推测（co-speculate）动作和观察结果来加速大语言模型智能体与有状态工具的交互循环。它避免了传统方法中生成与执行串行化的瓶颈，通过Expected Value Decoding（EVD）优化期望时间隐藏而非命中率，并通过Joint Action-State Verification（JASV）将长视界动作依赖从全链预测重构为目标动作-状态验证，从而实现更长的重叠而不牺牲串行语义。在Terminal-Bench基准上跨多个设置，AOSpec将平均端到端延迟降低11.8-32.5%，p99延迟降低最多42.8%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体通过有状态工具行动时，模型生成与环境执行在每个步骤都是串行化的。随着解码速度加快，工具执行成为日益增长的瓶颈。现有的仅推测动作或仅推测观察的方法暴露了大量延迟：价值集中在少数慢调用上，有些结果只能通过执行才能揭示，更长的前瞻通常需要越来越不可能的动作预测链。因此需要一个能覆盖完整智能体-环境循环的协同推测框架。
AI.method: AOSpec框架包含三个关键组件：1) Expected Value Decoding (EVD) - 将观察推测引导向具有最大期望延迟收益的结果，优化期望时间隐藏而非命中率；2) 对于只能通过执行揭示的结果，AOSpec在隔离的分支（forks）中启动延迟关键的目标动作，这些分支包含其效果；3) Joint Action-State Verification (JASV) - 在重用前同时验证动作及其来源状态与已提交执行的兼容性，将长视界动作依赖从全链预测重构为目标动作-状态验证。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench服务场景中，跨越4种harness、5种actor模型和5种服务速度，AOSpec在所有实用基线上表现最佳，将平均端到端延迟降低11.8-32.5%，p99延迟降低最多42.8%。增益随解码加速而增加，且其观察模型从Terminal-Bench迁移到SWE-bench Verified无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: AOSpec通过协同推测动作和观察，打破了前瞻-精度权衡（lookahead-accuracy tradeoff），在保持无损耗语义的同时实现长距离重叠。其效果随着解码加速而增强，并且具有良好的跨基准迁移能力，为加速LLM智能体-环境交互提供了有效方案。

title: Exploiting Intrinsic Duality for Multi-Hop Question Generation
summary: Multi hop question generation (MQG) aims to generate questions from multiple given documents and target answers, whereas question answering (QA) focuses on deriving answers from documents given specific questions. Although MQG and QA are inherently dual tasks, most existing MQG studies largely overlook this intrinsic duality. To address this limitation, we propose QQ, a novel framework that exploits the duality between Question and answer for multi hop Question generation. Specifically, QQ employs a unified architecture functioning simultaneously as both an MQG and a QA model to fully leverage their interdependence. Our framework is driven by two key mechanisms: (i) enforcing bidirectional alignment constraints to ensure strict mutual correspondence between the questions generated by the MQG model and the answers produced by the QA model; and (ii) applying contrastive learning to pull paired question answer representations closer while pushing unpaired ones apart, thereby reinforcing this correspondence. Extensive automatic and human evaluations on the HotpotQA and MuSiQue datasets demonstrate that the QQ framework significantly improves the quality of generated multi hop questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QQ框架，利用问答（QA）与多跳问题生成（MQG）之间的天然对偶性，通过统一架构同时扮演MQG和QA模型，并借助双向对齐约束和对比学习机制，显著提升了多跳问题生成的质量。
AI.motivation: MQG（多跳问题生成）与QA（问答）本质上是互为对偶的任务，但现有MQG研究大多忽视了这种内在对偶性，未能充分利用两者之间的相互依赖关系来提升问题生成质量。
AI.method: 提出QQ框架，包含两个关键机制：(i) 双向对齐约束，确保MQG生成的问题与QA产生的答案之间具有严格的相互对应关系；(ii) 对比学习，拉近匹配的问答对表示距离，同时推开不匹配的问答对，从而强化这种对应关系。框架采用统一架构同时充当MQG和QA模型。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA和MuSiQue数据集上进行的大量自动评估和人工评估表明，QQ框架显著提升了生成多跳问题的质量。
AI.conclusion: 利用问答对偶性是提升多跳问题生成质量的有效途径，QQ框架验证了这一思路的可行性和有效性。

title: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
summary: Stochastic world models are usually evaluated by the accuracy and calibration of their predicted futures. These criteria leave a decision-relevant ambiguity: the same conditional future distribution can arise because an observation aliases different physical states, or because the dynamics remain random after the declared full state is fixed. We prove that this attribution is not identifiable from ordinary transition data, even with an optimal probabilistic predictor. We introduce ClosurePairs, an interventional evaluation protocol that crosses compatible microstates with repeated exogenous disturbances. A two-way variance decomposition identifies state aliasing, process noise, and their nonlinear interaction; an independent-repeat variant applies when disturbances cannot be reused. On likelihood-equivalent Gaussian systems, paired supervision reduces alias-fraction error 15.96-fold at identical test NLL. Across 18 nonlinear Langevin conditions, it reduces attribution MAE from 0.372 to 0.051 and sensing regret from 0.0138 to 0.0003 without changing NLL. On a pixel-conditioned recurrent model, a frozen shared-state probe reduces alias-fraction MAE against a deep ensemble from 0.584 to 0.130 in distribution and from 0.630 to 0.170 out of distribution over ten seeds. Finally, in a matched-total-variance REFINE/BRANCH test, a total-variance router reaches 66.48 percent plus or minus 1.06 percent accuracy, whereas ClosurePairs reaches 99.99 percent plus or minus 0.02 percent and improves selected NLL from -2.087 to -2.717 over five seeds. ClosurePairs therefore measures why futures branch, information that proper forecast scores cannot identify.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClosurePairs，一种干预性评估协议，用于区分随机世界模型中预测不确定性来源（状态别名化 vs 过程噪声），并通过方差分解和配对监督实现可识别的归因。实验表明该方法在不改变NLL的情况下大幅降低归因误差，且优于仅依赖预测分数的传统评估方法。
AI.motivation: 传统随机世界模型的评估仅关注预测未来分布的准确性和校准度，但这些标准存在决策相关的歧义：相同的条件未来分布可能源于观测对不同物理状态的别名化（aliasing），也可能源于声明完整状态后动力学仍存在的随机性。这种归因（attribution）问题在普通转移数据中不可识别，即使使用最优概率预测器也无法区分，因此需要新的干预性评估协议。
AI.method: 提出ClosurePairs评估协议：(1) 交叉兼容微状态并施加重复外生扰动；(2) 通过双向方差分解识别状态别名化、过程噪声及其非线性交互；(3) 提供独立重复变体以处理扰动不可复用情形。在像素条件循环模型中使用冻结共享状态探针进行归因，以及在REFINE/BRANCH匹配总方差测试中使用总方差路由器作为基线对比。
AI.result: 在似然等价的高斯系统中，配对监督将别名分数误差降低15.96倍（测试NLL相同）；在18种非线性Langevin条件下，归因MAE从0.372降至0.051，感知遗憾从0.0138降至0.0003（NLL不变）；在像素条件循环模型中，冻结共享状态探针将别名分数MAE从0.584降至0.130（分布内）和0.630降至0.170（分布外）；在匹配总方差测试中，ClosurePairs达到99.99%±0.02%准确率（对比总方差路由器66.48%±1.06%），并将选定NLL从-2.087提升至-2.717。
AI.conclusion: ClosurePairs能够测量未来分支的原因（why futures branch），这是正确预测分数（如NLL）无法识别的信息。该协议为随机世界模型的评估提供了超越传统预测准确性和校准度的新维度，弥补了决策相关归因信息的缺失。

title: SWE-Touch: Benchmarking Coding Agents When Users Touch the Code
comment: Preprint. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SWE-Touch
summary: Real-world software development requires coding agents to operate in shared workspaces where users may inspect and modify code during an ongoing task, yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate agents working alone or restrict user participation to messages. This leads us to ask: how do coding agents understand and respond to code changes in a shared workspace? We introduce SWE-Touch, a framework that stress-tests this setting through validated Counter-Edits: plausible edits to task-relevant code that conflict with task completion. SWE-Touch mines task-critical regions from multiple repair trajectories, uses a separate User Patch Generator to construct the edits, and injects them with contextual user messages when agents reach the relevant code. We evaluate nine coding models on SWE-bench Verified, with additional experiments on longer-horizon tasks from SWE-Bench Pro and DeepSWE. Counter-Edit lowers average resolve rate by 7.7 percentage points on SWE-bench Verified, with degradation also persisting on both longer-horizon benchmarks. Trajectory analysis links these failures to limited awareness of the evolving workspace: agents may retain conflicting code or replace it without sufficiently re-inspecting the repository and validating the revised code with targeted tests. These findings show that strong autonomous performance does not yet ensure the state awareness and adaptive behavior needed for shared-workspace collaboration, and point to detecting workspace changes, reconciling conflicting edits with the task, and verifying the affected behavior as key capabilities for future optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWE-Touch框架，用于压力测试编码智能体在共享工作区中理解和响应代码变更的能力。通过生成与任务完成相冲突的"Counter-Edits"并注入上下文用户消息，评估了九个编码模型，发现Counter-Edits使SWE-bench Verified上的平均解决率下降7.7个百分点，且退化在更长时域基准上持续存在。轨迹分析表明失败源于智能体对动态工作区环境感知不足，无法充分重新检查代码库并验证修改。研究指出强自主性能并不等于状态感知和自适应协作能力，需发展检测工作区变化、协调冲突编辑和验证受影响行为等关键能力。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级基准测试通常评估智能体独立工作或将用户参与限制为消息形式，但真实软件开发中编码智能体需要在共享工作区运行，用户可能在任务进行中检查和修改代码。作者希望探究编码智能体在共享工作区中对代码变更的理解和响应能力。
AI.method: SWE-Touch框架包含三个步骤：1) 从多条修复轨迹中挖掘任务关键区域；2) 使用独立的用户补丁生成器（User Patch Generator）构造看似合理的Counter-Edits（与任务完成相冲突的编辑）；3) 当智能体到达相关代码时注入带有上下文的用户消息。在SWE-bench Verified上评估九个编码模型，并在SWE-Bench Pro和DeepSWE上进行更长时域的额外实验。
AI.result: Counter-Edits使SWE-bench Verified上平均解决率下降7.7个百分点，退化在更长时域基准（SWE-Bench Pro和DeepSWE）上持续存在。轨迹分析显示失败原因包括：智能体可能保留冲突代码，或替换代码但没有充分重新检查仓库和用针对性测试验证修改后的代码。
AI.conclusion: 强大的自主性能并不能保证共享工作区协作所需的状态感知和自适应行为。未来优化应聚焦于三个关键能力：检测工作区变化、协调冲突编辑与任务目标、验证受影响行为。

title: CrossProjection: Geometric Grounding Beyond Viewpoint Change in Architectural Drawings
comment: Initial controlled diagnostic study on 23 natural drawing sets and three VLMs; broader model, building, repeated-inference, and human coverage is planned for a subsequent version
summary:
Architectural drawings violate the usual assumption behind multi-view reasoning: plans and sections are cuts, while elevations are facade projections, so corresponding components change appearance in ways camera motion cannot explain. We introduce CrossProjection, an anchor-grounded diagnostic of whether vision-language models preserve component identity and externalize geometry across heterogeneous architectural views. It evaluates Matching, Registration, and Geometric Grounding through categorical judgments, candidate selection, and free point, line, and region localization.
  Across 23 real drawing sets and 1,954 categorical conditions per model, GPT-5.5 scores 82.4%, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 62.2%, and GLM-4.5V 57.2%. A matched 200-target study crosses natural and vector-text-suppressed drawings with closed-candidate and free-geometry outputs. Candidate-supported performance is often higher, but free localization remains fragile: on natural drawings, point/region PCK@.05 is 54-76% for GPT, 8-10% for Qwen, and 14-36% for GLM; line endpoint PCK@.05 is 22%, 4%, and 0%. A coordinate grid recovers some GPT point/region precision but not lines. Three architecture-trained participants reach 87.3-93.3% categorical accuracy and 76-92% GT-region hit, supporting task feasibility rather than a population-level human ceiling.
  Because the categorical families do not form a same-item Matching-Registration contrast and interface controls alter multiple burdens, we avoid mechanistic claims. The supported conclusion is narrower: closed-choice or marked-element success does not entail reliable explicit geometric grounding. For drawing-guided CAD/BIM systems, categorical correctness should not be treated as evidence of candidate-free spatial reliability. Reusable on-sheet anchors, fixed-denominator scoring, and hash-locked artifacts establish an audit trail for this gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossProjection基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在异构建筑视图（平面图、剖面图、立面图）间保持构件身份和几何外化的能力。测试发现GPT-5.5达到82.4%的类别准确率，但自由几何定位仍然脆弱（点/区域PCK@.05仅54-76%），行端点仅22%，而小模型表现更差。对比人类专家（87-93%）证明任务可行，结论是类别正确性不等于可靠的空间定位能力。
AI.motivation: 建筑图纸违背了多视图推理的常规假设：平面图和剖面图是切割（cuts），而立面图是立面投影（projections），对应的构件在不同视图中外观变化无法用相机运动来解释。现有基准未评估VLM在此类异构视图下是否真正保持构件身份并外化几何信息，需要专门的诊断工具。
AI.method: 引入CrossProjection基准，包含三个任务维度：Matching（匹配）、Registration（配准）、Geometric Grounding（几何基础），通过分类判断、候选选择以及自由点/线/区域定位来评估。使用23套真实图纸、每模型1954个分类条件，并结合200目标的对照研究（自然图纸 vs 矢量文本抑制图纸 × 闭候选 vs 自由几何输出），同时与3位建筑培训专业人员对比。
AI.result: GPT-5.5得82.4%，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct得62.2%，GLM-4.5V得57.2%。候选支持性能通常更高，但自由定位脆弱：自然图纸上的点/区域PCK@.05为GPT 54-76%、Qwen 8-10%、GLM 14-36%；线端点PCK@.05分别为22%、4%、0%。坐标网格可提升GPT的部分点/区域精度但对线无效。人类参与者达到87.3-93.3%分类准确率和76-92% GT区域命中率。
AI.conclusion: 作者避免过度机制性声明，因为分类族未构成同项Matching-Registration对比且界面控制改变了多重负担。支持的结论是：封闭选项或标记元素的成功并不意味着可靠的显式几何基础。对绘图引导的CAD/BIM系统，类别正确性不应被视为候选自由空间可靠性的证据。通过可复用的图纸锚点、固定分母评分和哈希锁定构件建立了审计链。

title: UpliftBench: Revealing Outcome-Regime and Objective Mismatch in Uplift Evaluation
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures. Code, data, and results: https://github.com/binshuangli/uplift-bench
summary: Uplift modeling (conditional-average-treatment-effect estimation) drives personalized targeting, yet published uplift benchmarks frequently disagree on which estimator performs best; we show the disagreement is substantially about metrics, not models. UpliftBench evaluates 12 uplift estimators under an outer-test-isolated, multi-objective protocol across seven dataset families; its two findings are identified where a reference objective exists -- F1 on the standard continuous benchmark (IHDP), F2 in a within-sample case study on Jobs. On that benchmark, Qini shows no detectable alignment with effect accuracy -- across all 100 IHDP realizations its mean rank correlation with effect accuracy is +0.07, 95% CI [-0.03, +0.16] -- while AUUC is consistently more aligned (paired prefix-mean-AUUC-over-Qini gap +0.49 [+0.40, +0.59]; the shipped cumulative-gain AUUC aligns better still, +0.73). On Jobs, ranking metrics are structurally insufficient for a sign-threshold policy because they discard the score level; empirically, within the released split-rotation analysis direct policy-risk selection yields lower benchmark regret than random model selection while Qini, AUUC, and uplift-at-$k$ do not (14-15% regret). Calibrating the decision threshold removes 81% of the Qini-selection regret. Both findings are bounded, not universal: F1 is not detected on either validation family (the ACIC and Revenue-Synthetic gaps are both indistinguishable from zero), and F2 vanishes under a budgeted-value objective where rank suffices. UpliftBench releases versioned loaders, fixed protocols, result artifacts, and a reproducible living leaderboard; the public repository accompanies the paper.

AI.tldr: UpliftBench是一个新的提升建模基准测试框架，通过对12种提升估计器在7个数据集家族上的评估，发现先前提升基准测试结果不一致的主要原因在于评估指标而非模型本身。核心发现是：在IHDP基准上，Qini指标与效果准确度几乎无相关性（秩相关+0.07），而AUUC显著更对齐（差距+0.49至+0.73）；在Jobs数据集上，排名类指标因忽略得分水平而结构性不足，校准决策阈值可消除81%的Qini选择遗憾。但这两个发现均有边界条件而非普适。
AI.motivation: 现有提升建模基准测试在最优估计器选择上经常产生互相矛盾的结果，这种不一致性阻碍了该领域研究的可信进展。作者希望查明这种分歧的根源——究竟是模型本身的差异，还是评估指标的缺陷，从而建立一个更可靠、可复现的评估协议。
AI.method: UpliftBench采用外层测试隔离的多目标评估协议，在7个数据集家族上评估12种提升估计器。它对比了Qini、AUUC等排名类指标与效果准确度之间的对齐程度，通过100次IHDP实现计算秩相关和配对差距；在Jobs数据集上通过拆分轮转分析比较直接策略风险选择与随机模型选择的基准遗憾，并测试决策阈值校准的作用。
AI.result: 两个关键发现：(1) F1：在IHDP上Qini与效果准确度无显著对齐（秩相关+0.07，95%CI[-0.03,+0.16]），而AUUC显著更对齐（差距+0.49，累积增益版AUUC差距+0.73）；(2) F2：在Jobs上排名类指标对符号阈值策略结构性不足，导致14-15%的基准遗憾，而阈值校准可去除81%的Qini选择遗憾。两个发现均在验证家族上受限：F1在ACIC和Revenue-Synthetic上未检出，F2在预算值目标下消失。
AI.conclusion: 提升基准测试的分歧主要源于指标选择而非模型差异。Qini作为常用排名指标可能严重误导估计器选择，AUUC相对更可靠。但研究也强调这些发现是有边界的而非普适的，需要针对具体目标函数选择匹配的评估指标。UpliftBench通过开放可复现的协议、版本化加载器和动态排行榜，为该领域提供了更严谨的评估基础设施。

title: Observatorio Lazaro: A self-populating database of anglicism usage in the Spanish press
summary: This paper describes Observatorio Lázaro, a language resource that monitors unassimilated lexical borrowings (predominantly English lexical borrowings or anglicisms) in the Spanish digital press. Since April 2020 the system has automatically processed the daily output of a collection of news outlets, detected borrowings with a neural sequence-labeling model, and made the results available through a public web interface and API. The result is a continuously updated diachronic database which, at the time of writing, records more than two million borrowings across 1.88 million articles and 993 million running tokens of text (2020-2026). The paper documents the resource: we describe the end-to-end pipeline (acquisition, detection, post-processing, storage and access), the data model and the terms of availability; we evaluate the resource through the detector's held-out performance (span-level F1=0.86 for the borrowing class), inter-annotator agreement on the training corpus (Cohen's kappa=0.91) and a manual precision audit of 1,000 spans from the deployed data; and we situate it with respect to Spanish borrowing lexicography, annotated borrowing corpora and neology-monitoring observatories. The data shows that unassimilated anglicisms are used in the Spanish press at a frequency of approximately two anglicisms per thousand tokens, and that this rate remains stable. Our statistical analysis over six years reveals that the anglicism vocabulary in Spanish behaves as an open and growing class, with 58.7% of its types attested only once (53.6% after correcting for detection precision), and that its density is highest in the fashion, technology and lifestyle sections and lowest in political and institutional news. The resource is intended to complement static borrowing dictionaries and one-off annotated corpora by providing a continuously updated record of borrowing in the Spanish press.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Observatorio Lázaro，一个自动监测西班牙语数字新闻中未同化外来词（主要是英语借词/英语化词）的语言资源系统。该系统自2020年4月起通过神经序列标注模型自动处理新闻机构每日输出，并通过公共网页界面和API发布结果，已建成包含200多万个借词的持续更新历时数据库（覆盖2020-2026年，188万篇文章、993亿词元）。
AI.motivation: 语言中的借词现象（尤其是英语借词进入西班牙语）是重要的社会语言学和语言规划主题，但现有资源多为静态借词词典或一次性标注语料库，缺乏持续更新的历时监测数据。作者旨在构建一种能自动、持续追踪西班牙语新闻中借词使用情况的资源，以补充静态资源的不足。
AI.method: 系统采用端到端流水线，包括：（1）新闻采集；（2）基于神经序列标注模型（span-level F1=0.86）的借词检测；（3）后处理；（4）存储与访问。数据通过公共网页界面和API提供，并进行了多维度评估：检测器持出性能、训练语料上的标注者间一致性（Cohen's kappa=0.91），以及部署数据中1000个跨度的手动精度审计。
AI.result: 研究发现：西班牙语新闻中未同化英语借词的使用频率约为每千词元两个，且该频率保持稳定。六年的统计分析显示，英语借词词汇在西班牙语中表现为一个开放且不断增长的类别，其中58.7%的类型仅出现一次（经检测精度校正后为53.6%）。借词密度在时尚、科技和生活方式板块最高，在政治和机构新闻中最低。
AI.conclusion: Observatorio Lázaro提供了持续更新的西班牙语新闻借词记录，弥补了静态借词词典和一次性标注语料库的不足。该资源不仅服务于语言监测和词典学，还为借词分布规律、板块差异及借词词汇增长模式等研究提供了数据基础。

title: Escaping Confidence Trap: Evolutionary Decoding for Mathematical Reasoning in Diffusion LLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, offering efficient generation through block-wise progressive unmasking. However, their strong general-purpose performance does not necessarily translate into reliable mathematical reasoning, where correctness depends on preserving coherent numerical-symbolic reasoning trajectories. In this work, we analyze the decoding trajectories of LLaDA 2.0 and identify a recurring diffusion confidence trap: local token confidence can become misaligned with global reasoning correctness during progressive block decoding. Our analysis reveals two representative failure regimes: sampling-sensitive failures, where correct paths exist but are unstable, and sampling-consistent failures, where repeated sampling converges to repetitive high-confidence but incorrect continuations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Evolutionary Decoding, a training-free test-time scaling framework that views diffusion decoding as an evolutionary process over candidate reasoning states. The framework combines step-wise selection, which preserves useful numerical-symbolic signals and suppresses repetitive patterns, with block-wise mutation, which introduces structured alternatives to escape incorrect high-confidence basins. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Evolutionary Decoding improves LLaDA 2.0 over confidence-based decoding, leading to more reliable mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在数学推理中的解码问题，识别出"扩散置信度陷阱"现象（局部token置信度与全局推理正确性错位），并提出一种无需训练的测试时扩展框架——进化解码（Evolutionary Decoding），通过逐步选择和块级变异结合的方式改进数学推理的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 扩散LLM虽然通用性能优秀，但在数学推理任务上不可靠。数学推理的正确性依赖于保持连贯的数值-符号推理轨迹，而现有的置信度解码策略可能导致局部置信度与全局正确性错位，因此需要专门针对扩散解码的推理改进方法。
AI.method: 提出进化解码框架，将扩散解码视为候选推理状态上的进化过程。包含两个关键组件：(1) 逐步选择（step-wise selection），保留有用的数值-符号信号并抑制重复模式；(2) 块级变异（block-wise mutation），引入结构化替代方案以逃离错误的高置信度盆地。该方法无需训练，属于测试时扩展策略。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，进化解码相比基于置信度的解码方法，能显著提升LLaDA 2.0的数学推理可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 进化解码作为一种训练免费且有效的测试时扩展方法，通过演化式搜索策略缓解扩散置信度陷阱，可实现更可靠的数学推理。

title: Decomposing the Doer Effect in Programming Practice: Code Writing Stands Out Among Active Practice
summary: The "doer effect" suggests that actively doing practice activities is more strongly associated with learning outcomes than passively viewing content. In the doer effect literature, "doing" refers specifically to active practice. However, this categorization treats different forms of active practice as equivalent, leaving open whether some types of active practice are more effective than others. In this paper, we investigate whether the doer effect extends to computer science instruction and whether some forms of doing stand out compared to other forms. We analyze log data from 334 students across 11 semesters of introductory and intermediate Java who used an interactive practice system with five content types: Code Writing, Code Tracing, Code Completion, Code Visualizations, and Code Explanations. Consistent with prior doer effect work, we find that active practice activities were associated with 3.2 times better learning outcomes than passive activities. Interestingly, among the active practice, code writing was the most strongly associated with improved posttest performance, while no other activity type showed a comparable association. These results highlight the importance of challenging, feedback-supported practice activities, such as code writing problems.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了"做者效应"（doer effect）是否适用于计算机科学教育，并区分不同形式的主动练习活动的效果差异。通过对334名学生在11个学期中使用互动练习系统的日志数据分析，发现主动练习活动与被动活动相比，学习效果提升3.2倍；其中代码编写（Code Writing）是与后测成绩提升关联最强的活动类型，其他主动练习类型均未显示出类似的显著关联。
AI.motivation: 以往"做者效应"研究将各类主动练习视为等同，未深入探究不同类型主动练习（如代码编写、代码追踪、代码补全等）之间是否有效果差异。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究在计算机科学教育中，"做"的不同形式是否具有不同的学习效果。
AI.method: 分析334名学生在11个学期（涵盖入门和中级Java课程）中使用互动练习系统的日志数据。该系统包含五种内容类型：代码编写（Code Writing）、代码追踪（Code Tracing）、代码补全（Code Completion）、代码可视化（Code Visualizations）和代码解释（Code Explanations）。通过比较不同活动类型与后测成绩的关联来评估学习效果。
AI.result: 主动练习活动与被动活动相比，学习效果提升了3.2倍，与先前"做者效应"研究结果一致。在各类主动练习中，代码编写与后测成绩提升的关联最强，而其他活动类型均未显示出可比的显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了具有挑战性且带有反馈支持的练习活动（如代码编写问题）的重要性，表明并非所有形式的主动练习都同等有效，教育者应优先设计能促进学生深度参与和主动建构的练习类型。

title: DreamTraj: Generating 6-DoF Object Trajectories by Reading Unrendered Video Diffusion Latents
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://whathappen0.github.io/DreamTraj/
summary: Accurate prediction of object trajectories during manipulation is essential for closing the perception-action loop. Progress is limited on two fronts: available datasets lack fine-grained language-to-motion annotations, and existing predictors either rely on privileged inputs such as video, depth, or CAD models, or recover motion from fully generated videos through costly, error-prone perception pipelines. We close the supervision gap with the MOVE dataset, 5,038 object-centric egocentric trajectories, each paired with a fine-grained natural-language instruction rather than a coarse verb-noun label. We further propose DreamTraj, which predicts a 6-DoF object trajectory from a single RGB image and a task instruction, requiring no video, depth, or CAD model at inference: rather than generating a video, it reads motion from the internal representations of a frozen image-to-video diffusion model at an early denoising step. A lightweight flow-matching Reader decodes query-key attention tracks and pooled hidden states into relative 6-DoF poses. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly decode object 6-DoF trajectories from intermediate video diffusion representations rather than generated pixels. DreamTraj sets a new state of the art on both translation and rotation against forecasters that consume multi-frame or privileged inputs, and runs 4.6x faster than generate-then-extract pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOVE数据集（5,038条带细粒度自然语言指令的物体中心化第一人称轨迹）和DreamTraj方法（从单张RGB图像和任务指令直接预测6-DoF物体轨迹，无需视频、深度或CAD模型），通过从冻结的图像到视频扩散模型的早期去噪内部表示中读取运动信息，而非生成视频后再提取。
AI.motivation: 操作过程中物体轨迹的准确预测对感知-行动闭环至关重要，但现有工作受限于两方面：一是数据集缺乏细粒度的语言-运动标注；二是现有预测器要么依赖特权输入（视频、深度或CAD模型），要么通过生成视频再经昂贵且有误差的感知管线恢复运动。
AI.method: 1) 构建MOVE数据集，包含5,038条物体中心的"第一人称"轨迹，每条配有细粒度自然语言指令（而非粗粒度的动词-名词标签）。2) 提出DreamTraj方法：利用冻结的图像到视频扩散模型，在早期去噪步骤从其内部表示中读取运动信息，通过轻量级流匹配Reader解码query-key注意力轨迹和池化隐藏状态为相对6-DoF位姿。
AI.result: DreamTraj在平移和旋转上都超越了使用多帧或特权输入的预测器，且比"先生成后提取"流水线快4.6倍，达到了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个直接从中间视频扩散表示而非生成像素中解码物体6-DoF轨迹的方法，证明了利用扩散模型内部表示进行高效、精确的运动预测的可行性。

title: Subtype Robustness Is Not Just Accuracy: Calibration Under Unseen Subtype Shift
summary: Subtype robustness asks whether a model keeps the correct coarse prediction when test examples come from fine-grained subtypes absent from training but still inside a known coarse category. Prior work studies this almost entirely through accuracy. We ask whether the model also stays calibrated. We present the first systematic study of the question across ImageNet, BREEDS, iNaturalist and CIFAR-100 with five architectures. Calibration breaks down on unseen subtypes, where accuracy drops while confidence barely follows, leaving the model systematically overconfident exactly where it has become less accurate. At matched accuracy loss, generic image corruption causes a much larger drop in confidence, so the effect is not a general consequence of losing accuracy. The model reacts to visible degradation but not to in-taxonomy novelty. Recalibration tuned on seen subtypes narrows the gap but does not close it, and out-of-distribution scores flag the affected inputs only weakly. Subtype robustness should therefore be evaluated through calibration, not accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统地研究了子类型鲁棒性中的校准问题，发现模型在面对训练中未见的细粒度子类型时，准确率下降但置信度几乎不变，导致系统性的过度自信。作者在ImageNet、BREEDS、iNaturalist和CIFAR-100上使用五种架构进行了验证，并指出校准应作为子类型鲁棒性的评估指标，而非仅看准确率。
AI.motivation: 先前关于子类型鲁棒性的研究几乎完全聚焦于准确率，忽略了模型置信度是否仍然可靠（校准性）这一问题。作者希望填补这一空白，探究模型在面对未见子类型时是否保持校准良好。
AI.method: 在ImageNet、BREEDS、iNaturalist和CIFAR-100四个数据集上，使用五种不同架构进行系统性实验，对比在未见子类型下准确率与置信度的变化，并与通用图像损坏（如噪声）引起的准确率损失进行对照分析。
AI.result: 发现在未见子类型上校准会崩溃：准确率下降但置信度几乎不跟随，模型在准确率变差的区域表现出系统性过度自信。与通用图像损坏相比，未见子类型引起的准确率下降导致的置信度下降幅度小得多，说明该效应并非失去准确率的一般后果。重新校准只能缩小差距但不能消除，OOD分数对该问题的检测能力也很弱。
AI.conclusion: 子类型鲁棒性应通过校准来评估，而非仅依赖准确率。模型能够对可见的退化做出反应，但对分类学内的新颖性缺乏感知。

title: RAGOCR: Optical Compression of Retrieval-Augmented Text via Visual Representation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become essential for knowledge-intensive question answering, yet scaling RAG pipelines remains challenging due to the prohibitive computational cost of processing lengthy retrieved contexts. Existing compression approaches face a fundamental trade-off: hard compression methods operate online in a query-aware fashion but achieve only modest compression rates and typically require fine-tuning the generative model, while soft compression methods attain higher ratios but rely on costly offline encoding that is entirely agnostic to the input query. To bridge this gap, we introduce RAGOCR, a novel framework that compresses retrieved documents into compact visual representations conditioned on the input query. To further balance compression rate and information fidelity, we introduce a query-aware dynamic resolution mechanism that adaptively allocates visual granularity based on each document's estimated relevance and complexity: highly relevant passages are rendered at higher resolution to preserve fine-grained details, while peripheral documents are aggressively compressed at lower resolution. Experiments on five QA benchmarks using the MedOmniKB retrieval corpus demonstrate that RAGOCR surpasses naive RAG by over 15\% in accuracy while requiring only one-eighth the number of input tokens, and consistently outperforms both hard and soft compression baselines across varying retrieval depths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGOCR框架，将检索到的文档压缩为查询感知的紧凑视觉表示，并通过查询感知的动态分辨率机制在压缩率和信息保真度之间取得平衡，在五个QA基准上超越朴素RAG超过15%的准确率，同时仅需八分之一的输入token数。
AI.motivation: RAG在知识密集型问答中至关重要，但扩展RAG流程因长上下文的计算成本过高而面临挑战。现有压缩方法存在根本性权衡：硬压缩方法以查询感知方式在线操作但压缩率有限且通常需要微调生成模型，而软压缩方法压缩率更高但依赖昂贵的离线编码且完全忽略输入查询。作者希望弥合这一差距。
AI.method: RAGOCR将检索文档压缩为基于输入查询的紧凑视觉表示。具体包含两个关键组件：(1) 查询感知的文档视觉压缩编码器；(2) 查询感知的动态分辨率机制，根据每篇文档的估计相关性和复杂度自适应分配视觉粒度——高相关段落以更高分辨率渲染以保留细粒度细节，外围文档以较低分辨率激进压缩。
AI.result: 在五个QA基准上使用MedOmniKB检索语料库的实验表明，RAGOCR相比朴素RAG在准确率上提升超过15%，同时仅需八分之一的输入token数；并且在不同的检索深度下稳定优于硬压缩和软压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: RAGOCR通过查询感知的视觉压缩策略有效弥合了硬压缩与软压缩之间的差距，在保持高压缩率的同时实现查询自适应的信息保真，为大规模RAG系统提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案。

title: Slides2MindMap: Reconstructing Cognitively Efficient Knowledge Hierarchies from Lecture Slides
summary: Generating mind maps from lecture slides can help learners efficiently assimilate fragmented knowledge, promising substantial benefits for intelligent education. However, dedicated automatic generation and evaluation frameworks remain underexplored and challenging, requiring a global-local knowledge focus balance and handling large-scale, heterogeneous slides. We formulate the Slides2MindMap task, which aims to reconstruct cognitively efficient knowledge hierarchies from a course's slide deck collection. For systematic evaluation, we introduce S2M-Bench, a benchmark comprising 12,774 slide pages with expert-annotated mind maps spanning 24 university courses. S2M-Bench includes a cognitive-science-grounded evaluation framework that integrates ground-truth-based comparison, structure conformity analysis, and VLM-as-a-Judge. To address this task, we propose AutoMindMap, an agentic framework inspired by the Structure Building Framework. AutoMindMap comprises Skeleton Laying for global scaffold anchoring, Iterative Knowledge Integration augmented by context-aware summarization, and Dual-Stage Refinement with a local-global decoupling mechanism. The framework reconciles local knowledge faithfulness with global coherence, and adapts to slide-specific features. Experiments on S2M-Bench demonstrate that AutoMindMap outperforms baselines and achieves superior robustness across different models and scenarios, underscoring its pedagogical application value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Slides2MindMap任务，从课程幻灯片集重建认知高效的思维导图。引入含12,774页幻灯片和专家标注思维导图的S2M-Bench基准，并提出受结构构建框架启发的AutoMindMap代理框架，包含骨架铺设、迭代知识整合和双阶段精炼，在基准上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 从讲座幻灯片自动生成思维导图能帮助学习者高效吸收碎片化知识，对智能教育有重大价值。然而，专门的自动生成和评估框架仍未被充分探索，面临全局-局部知识关注平衡以及大规模异构幻灯片处理等挑战。
AI.method: 提出AutoMindMap代理框架，受结构构建框架启发，包含三个核心模块：1) Skeleton Laying用于全局骨架锚定；2) Iterative Knowledge Integration结合上下文感知摘要；3) Dual-Stage Refinement采用局部-全局解耦机制。同时构建S2M-Bench基准，包含基于认知科学的评估框架：真值对比、结构一致性分析和VLM-as-a-Judge。
AI.result: 在S2M-Bench上的实验表明，AutoMindMap优于基线方法，在不同模型和场景下展现出优越的鲁棒性，证明了其教学应用价值。S2M-Bench包含24门大学课程、12,774张幻灯片页面的规模。
AI.conclusion: AutoMindMap有效调和了局部知识保真度与全局连贯性之间的平衡，并能适应幻灯片特定特征，为幻灯片到思维导图的自动生成提供了可行的解决方案和系统化的评估基准。

title: ACEM: A Cost Estimation Model for Agentic Software Engineering
summary:
Traditional software cost estimation models, such as COCOMO II, Function Points, and Story Points, assume that development effort is primarily driven by human labor in design, coding, and testing. Agentic software engineering, where autonomous AI agents perform substantial implementation work and humans focus on planning, specification, and validation, challenges this assumption. New cost dimensions arise: large language model (LLM) token consumption across agent actions, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) oversight effort, and infrastructure costs for agent orchestration and tooling. These costs are nondeterministic: identical tasks may consume different tokens, follow divergent reasoning paths, and require varying human correction, phenomena absent in traditional development. A new framework is needed to bridge standard sizing metrics with this cost structure.
  This paper proposes ACEM (Agentic Cost Estimation Model), which decomposes total agentic development cost into three additive dimensions: LLM, HITL, and infrastructure cost. ACEM introduces three constructs for agentic dynamics: the Revision Factor (RF), modeling token overhead from output rejection and retries; the Context Factor (CF), capturing rising token consumption as context accumulates; and the HITL Intensity Score (HIS), a four-level oversight classification scheme. It further maps Use Case Points, Story Points, and Function Points to estimated token consumption, enabling organizations to reuse existing project-scoping data for agentic cost forecasting.
  ACEM is presented as a fully specified model structure and calibration methodology, with constants left symbolic pending empirical grounding. As an early-stage proposal, it invites the research community to calibrate, test, and extend the model through real project data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACEM（智能体成本估算模型），将智能体软件开发的总体成本分解为LLM令牌消耗、HITL监督和基础设施三个可加维度，并引入Revision Factor、Context Factor和HITL Intensity Score三个核心构造来建模智能体开发中的非确定性成本动态，同时提供从传统度量（用例点、故事点、功能点）到令牌消耗的映射方法。
AI.motivation: 传统软件成本估算模型（如COCOMO II、功能点、故事点）假设开发工作量主要由人类在设计、编码和测试中的劳动驱动。然而智能体软件工程中，自主AI智能体承担大量实现工作，人类专注于规划、规范和验证，这颠覆了传统假设。新兴成本维度包括LLM令牌消耗、HITL监督工作量和基础设施成本，且这些成本具有非确定性——相同任务可能消耗不同令牌、走不同推理路径、需要不同的人类修正，这是传统开发中不存在的现象。因此需要新框架来桥接标准度量与这种成本结构。
AI.method: ACEM将总智能体开发成本分解为三个可加维度：LLM成本、HITL成本和基础设施成本。模型引入三个核心构造：1) Revision Factor (RF)建模因输出拒绝和重试导致的令牌开销；2) Context Factor (CF)捕获随上下文累积而上升的令牌消耗；3) HITL Intensity Score (HIS)提供四级监督分类体系。此外，ACEM将用例点、故事点和功能点映射到预估令牌消耗，使组织能够复用现有项目范围数据来预测智能体成本。模型以完全规格化的结构和校准方法论提出，常量保持符号形式待实证校准。
AI.result: ACEM以完全规格化的模型结构和校准方法论呈现，常量保持符号形式（symbolic）以待实证验证。作为早期阶段提案，论文邀请研究社区通过真实项目数据对模型进行校准、测试和扩展。
AI.conclusion: ACEM是一个早期阶段的智能体软件成本估算框架提案，通过将传统度量映射到令牌消耗并引入三个专门构造来捕捉智能体开发中的非确定性成本动态。该模型目前缺乏实证校准，作者明确将其定位为开放研究呼吁，期待社区通过真实数据验证和完善。

title: Practical Noise Modeling for SPAD Intensity Imaging
summary: Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras are promising for low-light and high-dynamic-range intensity imaging, but their practical use is limited by complex sensor-specific noise. Unlike time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC) systems, SPAD cameras record whether at least one detection occurred in each gate without photon timestamps in intensity imaging mode, making explicit noise decomposition difficult. We present a practical noise modeling and calibration framework for SPAD intensity denoising. Our forward model describes binary-frame accumulation with a Binomial observation process, models signal-independent dark noise as an exposure-dependent pure dark count term plus an exposure-independent dark-frame bias term, and incorporates pixel-wise response non-uniformity. We design a dedicated calibration procedure for the proposed model and use it to build a count-domain noise-synthesis pipeline for network training. For denoising, we further design a SPAD-specific dark-shading correction (SPAD-DSC) to remove most systematic noise before network training. We construct a real-world SPAD intensity dataset for testing. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed noise model.

AI.tldr: 提出针对SPAD相机强度成像的实用噪声建模与标定框架，通过二项式观测过程建模二进制帧累积，区分曝光依赖的暗计数和曝光无关的暗帧偏置，并引入像素响应非均匀性。设计了专门的标定流程、计数域噪声合成管道用于网络训练，以及SPAD特定暗阴影校正（SPAD-DSC）去除系统噪声，在真实SPAD强度数据集上验证了方法的优越性。
AI.motivation: SPAD相机在低光照和高动态范围成像方面有巨大潜力，但其传感器特有的复杂噪声严重限制了实际应用。与TCSPC系统不同，SPAD相机在强度成像模式下只记录每个门控是否至少发生一次探测，缺乏光子时间戳信息，导致噪声分解极其困难，亟需一种实用的噪声建模和校准方案。
AI.method: 1) 前向模型：用二项式观测过程描述二进制帧累积；2) 噪声建模：将信号无关的暗噪声分解为曝光依赖的纯暗计数项和曝光无关的暗帧偏置项，并建模像素响应非均匀性；3) 标定流程：设计专用标定程序；4) 合成管道：构建计数域噪声合成管道用于网络训练；5) 去噪：设计SPAD特定暗阴影校正（SPAD-DSC）在训练前去除大部分系统噪声；6) 构建真实SPAD强度数据集用于测试。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的噪声模型在真实SPAD强度数据集上优于现有方法，验证了该噪声建模框架在SPAD强度去噪任务中的有效性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一套完整的SPAD强度成像噪声建模、标定和去噪框架，有效解决了SPAD相机在强度模式下面临的传感器特定噪声问题，为SPAD相机的实际应用铺平了道路。

title: xMICD: Explainable Representation of Multiple ICD Codes
summary: Electronic Health Records (EHRs) are widely used for clinical risk prediction using machine learning. International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes provide structured information about patient diagnoses, but representing them effectively remains challenging. Existing approaches often face a trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability: grouping-based representations are interpretable but may lose information, while embedding-based representations achieve strong predictive performance but are difficult to interpret. We propose Explainable Representation of Multiple ICD Codes (xMICD), a method for constructing low-dimensional patient representations from sets of ICD codes. xMICD combines clinically meaningful diagnostic groupings with similarity in a pre-trained ICD embedding space. Instead of using binary group membership, the method assigns codes to groups via similarity-based relative assignments, yielding features that reflect how closely a patient's diagnoses align with each clinical group. Experiments on large-scale EHR datasets demonstrate that xMICD achieves predictive performance comparable to embedding-based representations such as ICD2Vec across multiple clinical prediction tasks. At the same time, the resulting features remain clinically interpretable because each dimension corresponds to a recognizable diagnostic group. xMICD therefore provides a practical way to integrate embedding-based semantic relationships into interpretable clinical feature spaces for machine learning models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出xMICD方法，用于从ICD编码集合构建低维度、可解释的患者表征。该方法结合了临床诊断分组和预训练ICD嵌入空间的相似性，通过基于相似度的相对分配而非二元组成员关系来编码代码，在大型EHR数据集上实现了与ICD2Vec等嵌入方法相当的性能，同时保持了临床可解释性。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录（EHR）中的ICD编码在临床风险预测中广泛使用，但现有表征方法面临预测性能与可解释性之间的权衡：基于分组的方法可解释但可能丢失信息，基于嵌入的方法性能强但难以解释。研究者希望找到一种能同时兼顾两者优势的患者表征方法。
AI.method: xMICD将临床上有意义的诊断分组与预训练ICD嵌入空间中的相似性相结合。与使用二元组成员关系不同，该方法通过基于相似度的相对分配将代码分配到各组，使得每个特征反映患者的诊断与每个临床组的对齐程度，从而构建低维度的可解释患者表征。
AI.result: 在大型EHR数据集上的多个临床预测任务中，xMICD达到了与ICD2Vec等嵌入方法相当（comparable）的预测性能。同时，由于每个维度对应一个可识别的诊断组，所得特征保持了临床可解释性。
AI.conclusion: xMICD为将基于嵌入的语义关系整合到可解释的临床特征空间提供了实用途径，使机器学习模型能够在临床预测中同时受益于嵌入方法的表达力和分组方法的可解释性。

title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to degraded performance, due to three underlying causes: not all samples benefit from distillation; fitting too quickly to the teacher undermines the exploratory capacity of RL; and OPD's advantages are asymmetric, suppressing most tokens. To address these challenges, we propose RSTG (Recovering Learning Signals via Adaptive Teacher Guidance), which applies distillation selectively and precisely where it matters most. At the sample level, OPD is restricted to negative zero-variance prompts with each sample weighted by the teacher's confidence score. At the token level, distillation targets only tokens with high student entropy or large teacher-student divergence. We further augment training with SFT on correct trajectories generated by the teacher model, injecting positive gradient signals where RL yields none. Experiments demonstrate that RSTG substantially outperforms naive GRPO+OPD by +4.02% on math and +3.05% on code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSTG框架，通过自适应教师引导来恢复RLVR训练中的学习信号，解决GRPO+OPD朴素组合的性能退化问题，在数学和代码任务上分别提升4.02%和3.05%。
AI.motivation: GRPO在RLVR中面临稀疏奖励问题（组内所有响应奖励相同时梯度完全丢失），而朴素地将OPD与GRPO结合会导致性能退化。退化原因有三：并非所有样本都能从蒸馏中受益；过快拟合教师会削弱RL的探索能力；OPD的优势具有不对称性，抑制了大多数token的学习。
AI.method: RSTG在样本层面和token层面选择性应用蒸馏：样本层面，仅对负零方差提示（即奖励无梯度的样本）进行OPD，并按教师置信度加权；token层面，仅对高学生熵或大师生分歧的token进行蒸馏。此外，使用教师生成的正确轨迹进行SFT增强，为RL无梯度的区域注入正梯度信号。
AI.result: 实验表明RSTG显著优于朴素的GRPO+OPD组合，在数学任务上提升4.02%，在代码任务上提升3.05%。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性、精准地在关键位置应用蒸馏，RSTG能够有效恢复RLVR训练中丢失的学习信号，同时避免朴素组合OPD带来的负面影响，为RLVR后训练提供了更优的范式。

title: DASH: Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate - Acquisition Harness for Automated Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) relies on a surrogate model and an acquisition function, yet the most suitable choices vary across tasks and optimization stages. Automated Bayesian optimization (AutoBO) addresses this variability by adapting BO components online. However, existing AutoBO methods either adapt one component, leaving the other mismatched and creating a bottleneck, or jointly select surrogate--acquisition pairs under a shared criterion, overlooking their distinct roles: surrogate selection depends on predictive reliability, whereas acquisition adaptation should respond to campaign context.In this paper, we propose DASH, a Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate--Acquisition Harness for large-language- model (LLM)-enhanced AutoBO. DASH selects surrogates by predictive reliability, uncertainty calibration, and ranking consistency; its two-stage acquisition controller periodically reallocates quotas across acquisition functions, builds a BO shortlist accordingly, and delegates final selection to an LLM. DASH also incorporates an integrated harness, consisting of knowledge-guided warm start and structured memory, to ground optimization in domain knowledge and accumulated feedback. Across four chemical optimization tasks, DASH outperforms the best AutoBO baseline by 12.51% in trajectory-level Acceleration Factor and 5.00% in endpoint Enhancement Factor. Results remain strong across LLM backbones, and ablations verify the complementary contributions of all components. Full-table and behavioral contamination checks find no detectable evidence that direct benchmark memorization or source-cell leakage explains these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DASH，一种解耦的自适应代理-采集函数协同框架，用于LLM增强的自动贝叶斯优化（AutoBO）。DASH分别针对代理模型和采集函数进行独立自适应，并结合知识引导的热启动和结构化记忆，在四个化学优化任务上超越了现有AutoBO基线。
AI.motivation: 现有AutoBO方法要么只自适应单一组件（导致另一个组件成为瓶颈），要么在共享准则下联合选择代理-采集函数对，忽视了二者的不同角色：代理模型的选择取决于预测可靠性，而采集函数的自适应应响应优化进程的上下文。因此需要一种解耦的自适应机制。
AI.method: DASH包含三个核心部分：(1) 代理模型通过预测可靠性、不确定性校准和排序一致性三个维度进行选择；(2) 两阶段采集函数控制器定期在多个采集函数间重新分配配额，构建BO候选清单，并交由LLM做最终决策；(3) 集成知识引导的热启动和结构化记忆，将优化锚定在领域知识和累积反馈上。
AI.result: 在四个化学优化任务中，DASH相比最佳AutoBO基线在轨迹级加速因子（Acceleration Factor）上提升12.51%，在终点提升因子（Enhancement Factor）上提升5.00%。结果在不同LLM主干上保持稳健，消融实验验证了所有组件的互补贡献。污染检查未发现基准记忆或源单元格泄漏可解释这些增益的证据。
AI.conclusion: DASH通过解耦代理模型选择和采集函数自适应，并利用LLM增强决策和领域知识整合，显著提升了AutoBO在化学优化任务中的表现，且排除了数据泄漏的解释，验证了方法的有效性和可靠性。

title: Image-Space Rule Discovery
summary: Can image-editing models discover visual rules in image space and complete problem-solving end-to-end? We tackle this question in the spirit of a human worksheet test (e.g., an IQ test), using problems that require models to read image-based instructions, recognize the problem, infer the answer, bind it to the correct destination, control output count, suppress unnecessary edits, and preserve the input and format. We introduce WISRD, a Worksheet Image-Space Rule Discovery benchmark with 11 core tasks under eight information conditions, spanning localized marking, filling, copying, counting, and no-edit suppression, together with four supplementary reasoning-stress probes for multi-step spatial manipulation, abstract pattern reasoning, logical inference, and constraint-based problem solving. We identify three key findings as follows. (i) Among the frontier image-editing models evaluated, Nano Banana Pro achieves the highest score. On the shared V0--V3 no-reference subset, the Auto-Strict proxy pass rates are 48.7% for Nano Banana Pro, 13.4\% for Qwen-Image-Edit, 11.5% for FLUX.2 Klein 4B API, 11.3% for FLUX.2 Klein 4B open-weight, and 0.0% for InstructPix2Pix. (ii) Analysis reveals that current image-editing models can partially rely on rendered in-image instructions even when the external prompt is absent or merely generic. (iii) In small supplementary diagnostics, Nano Banana Pro achieves 70.0% on 4-by-4 Sudoku and 22.9% on public RAVEN pattern-discovery items in image space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WISRD基准，用于评估图像编辑模型能否在图像空间中直接发现视觉规则并端到端解题，涵盖11个核心任务和4个推理压力测试。结果显示Nano Banana Pro表现最佳，但整体准确率仍然有限。
AI.motivation: 探索图像编辑模型是否具备在图像空间中自主发现视觉规则并完成端到端问题求解的能力，而非仅依赖外部文本提示。这类似于人类在试卷（如IQ测试）中读取图像指令、理解问题、推理答案并正确输出的综合能力。
AI.method: 构建WISRD基准，包含11个核心任务（覆盖局部标记、填充、复制、计数、无编辑抑制等）和8种信息条件，外加4个推理压力测试（多步空间操作、抽象模式推理、逻辑推理、约束求解）。评估多种前沿图像编辑模型（Nano Banana Pro、Qwen-Image-Edit、FLUX.2 Klein 4B等），采用Auto-Strict代理通过率等指标。
AI.result: Nano Banana Pro在V0–V3无参考子集上取得48.7%通过率，远高于其他模型（Qwen-Image-Edit 13.4%，FLUX.2 Klein 4B API 11.5%，FLUX.2 Klein 4B开源权重11.3%，InstructPix2Pix 0.0%）。Nano Banana Pro在4×4数独上达70.0%，在RAVEN模式发现任务上仅22.9%。
AI.conclusion: 当前图像编辑模型即使在没有外部提示或仅有泛化提示时，也能部分依赖图像内嵌指令进行推理。但在抽象模式发现和复杂推理任务上仍有明显不足，整体能力与人类解题水平存在差距。

title: Data-Driven Pinball-Loss Selection for Vertically Distributed Elastic-Net SVMs
summary: The pinball-loss support vector machine is robust, but its asymmetry parameter is usually fixed in advance. We propose a data-driven elastic-net support vector machine that learns simplex-constrained weights over candidate pinball losses while retaining one classifier. The weighted loss is equivalent to a pinball loss with a data-dependent effective parameter. An empirical oracle inequality shows that, when weight regularization and simplex truncation vanish, the classifier objective at a global minimizer does not exceed that of the best fixed candidate; otherwise, the excess is explicitly bounded. For high-dimensional data, we develop a column-partitioned variable-splitting solver. It converges with a best-iterate $O(1/T)$ squared-step residual rate. Under common initialization and global parameters, any column partition produces, in exact arithmetic, the same iterates and solution as centralized training. Experiments assess predictive behavior, numerical equivalence, and multi-process scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的弹性网支持向量机，通过学习单纯形约束的权重来自动适应多个候选pinball损失，同时保留单一分类器。加权损失等价于具有数据相关有效参数的pinball损失。文章提供了经验oracle不等式理论保证，并开发了适用于高维数据的列分区变量分裂求解器。
AI.motivation: 传统pinball损失SVM的鲁棒性依赖于预先固定的非对称参数，该参数通常难以事先确定，缺乏数据驱动的自适应机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出弹性网支持向量机，学习单纯形约束的权重以组合多个候选pinball损失；2) 证明加权损失等价于具有数据相关有效参数的pinball损失；3) 推导经验oracle不等式，当权重正则化和单纯形截断消失时，全局最小化器的目标不超过最佳固定候选；4) 开发列分区变量分裂求解器，适用于高维数据。
AI.result: 求解器以最佳迭代O(1/T)平方步残差速率收敛。在常见初始化和全局参数下，任意列分区在精确算术中产生与集中式训练相同的迭代和解决方案。实验评估了预测行为、数值等价性和多进程可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过数据驱动方式自动学习pinball损失的非对称参数，兼具理论保证和高效的高维求解能力，且具备分布式训练的等价性优势。

title: OoO-Spec: Out-of-Order Semantic Speculation for Fast Tool Calling
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; supplementary material included
summary: LLMs generate tool calls token by token, even though the function choice and argument values can often be predicted in parallel from the request and tool schema. ToolSpec reduces this cost by drafting schema tokens and retrieving earlier calls, but cannot propose request-specific values absent from either source. We present OoO-Spec, which computes these missing semantics out of order. At request arrival, a Qwen3-0.6B sidecar predicts the function choice and all schema-defined argument slots in one parallel request-level wave while the target begins ToolSpec decoding. The runtime joins the slot values, renders the resulting call as text, and exposes it to subsequent candidate-construction rounds. The target polls without blocking, re-tokenizes a ready hint with its own tokenizer, and remains the sole verifier and commit authority. The sidecar is trained once with LoRA on Qwen2.5-32B teacher traces and used unchanged across Qwen2.5, Qwen3, and Llama targets, without target-specific drafter training. Across seven fully ranked targets and three benchmarks under greedy batch-one decoding, OoO-Spec is fastest among all evaluated methods in all 21 target-benchmark cells, reaching 2.46x-5.34x over autoregressive decoding with an unweighted mean of 3.89x, versus 2.95x for ToolSpec. It also outperforms every evaluated released learned drafter in each comparable cell. Across Qwen3-4B, 8B, 14B, and 32B targets, the same sidecar improves on ToolSpec by 34.1% on average. Its compact semantic payload averages 85 bytes per request excluding protocol metadata, supporting effective split-GPU overlap.

AI.tldr: OoO-Spec是一种通过"乱序计算"来加速LLM工具调用生成的框架。它在请求到达时用一个小型侧车模型（Qwen3-0.6B）并行预测函数选择和所有参数槽位，而主目标模型同时进行ToolSpec解码。侧车模型生成的槽位值被拼接成完整调用、重新分词后供目标模型验证，目标模型仍是唯一验证和提交权威。该框架无需针对不同目标模型重新训练侧车，跨7个目标模型和3个基准上均达到最快速度，比自回归解码快2.46x-5.34x（平均3.89x），比ToolSpec快34.1%。
AI.motivation: LLM生成工具调用时逐token解码，但函数选择和参数值往往可以从请求和工具schema中并行预测。ToolSpec能草拟schema token和检索历史调用，但无法提出请求特有的、既不在schema也不在历史中的参数值。作者希望计算这些缺失的语义值以进一步加速。
AI.method: OoO-Spec在请求到达时用一个Qwen3-0.6B侧车模型以一次并行请求级波次预测函数选择和所有schema定义的参数槽位，同时主目标模型开始ToolSpec解码。运行时拼接槽位值并渲染为文本，暴露给后续候选构建轮次。目标模型采用非阻塞轮询，用自身tokenizer重新tokenize就绪的提示，并作为唯一验证和提交权威。侧车用LoRA在Qwen2.5-32B教师轨迹上训练一次，跨不同的Qwen2.5、Qwen3和Llama目标使用，无需目标特定的drafter训练。
AI.result: 在7个完全排名的目标模型和3个基准的贪心batch-one解码下，OoO-Spec在所有21个目标-基准组合中均为最快，达到自回归解码的2.46x-5.34x加速，未加权均值为3.89x（ToolSpec为2.95x）。在每个可比单元中均优于所有已评估的发布学习型drafter。在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B/32B目标上，同一侧车比ToolSpec平均提升34.1%。紧凑的语义载荷平均每请求85字节（不含协议元数据），支持有效的split-GPU重叠。
AI.conclusion: OoO-Spec通过引入一个轻量级侧车模型在请求级并行预测请求特有的参数语义，解决了ToolSpec在无法从schema或历史中获取参数值时的瓶颈。由于侧车只需训练一次且跨目标通用，该方法在速度、泛化性和部署效率上均有显著优势，为工具调用加速提供了一种实用的新范式。

title: HetGPS: Scalable Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Physics-Anchored Adaptive Safety for EV Charging
summary: Safety interventions for large populations of network-coupled agents must protect shared constraints without unnecessarily overriding task-oriented policy decisions. We present HetGPS, a hybrid graph-control framework synergizing learned graph risk with physics-anchored correction by separating intervention magnitude from corrective direction. An action-conditioned graph residual model schedules state-dependent intervention authority, while a physics model determines its direction. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, we couple this filter with a parameter-shared heterogeneous graph soft actor-critic policy, enabling topology-aware coordination with a learned model size independent of fleet size. Across five nested distribution networks with 200--3,218 EVs and 100 evaluation days, Adaptive Authority reduces bus--step voltage violations from 3.93--7.74\% without filtering to 0.52--3.44\%, while maintaining 99.06--100\% departure success. Relative to the same physics-directed projection with fixed authority, it improves mean reward on all five networks and lowers the mean safety score on four. The deployed policy-and-risk model contains 383,702 learned parameters at every scale; at 3,218 EVs, a matched centralized SAC actor is about $170\times$ larger. A policy trained on the eight-transformer system transfers zero-shot to the 16- and 32-transformer systems, attaining 0.57--0.75\% violation rates and at least 99.99\% departure success. These results show that learned graph risk can allocate intervention authority at scale while feeder physics anchors corrective action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HetGPS，一种混合图控制框架，将学习到的图风险与基于物理的修正相结合，通过分离干预幅度与修正方向，在保护共享约束的同时最小化对任务导向策略的干扰。在电动汽车充电场景中，该框架将电压违规率从3.93-7.74%降至0.52-3.44%，同时保持99%以上的离站成功率，且模型规模与车队规模无关。
AI.motivation: 大规模网络耦合智能体的安全干预需要在保护共享约束的同时，尽可能不覆盖任务导向的策略决策。传统的固定授权物理投影方法无法根据状态动态调整干预强度，导致过度干预或干预不足。
AI.method: HetGPS框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 动作条件图残差模型，用于调度状态依赖的干预权限（干预幅度）；(2) 物理模型，用于确定修正方向。在EV充电场景中，与参数共享的异构图软actor-critic策略耦合，实现拓扑感知协调，模型大小与车队规模无关。
AI.result: 在5个嵌套配电网（200-3,218辆EV，100个评估日）上，Adaptive Authority将母线-步电压违规从3.93-7.74%（无滤波）降至0.52-3.44%，同时保持99.06-100%离站成功率。与固定授权的物理投影相比，在全部5个网络上提升平均奖励，在4个网络上降低平均安全分数。模型仅含383,702个参数，而3,218辆EV的匹配集中式SAC actor大约大170倍。零样本迁移到更大系统时达到0.57-0.75%违规率和至少99.99%离站成功率。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的图风险能够在规模化场景中有效分配干预权限，而馈线物理锚定修正动作。HetGPS证明了将学习驱动的干预授权与物理驱动的修正方向相结合的有效性，在安全性和任务性能之间取得了良好平衡，并具备出色的可扩展性和迁移能力。

title: From AI Technical Debt to Agentic Technical Debt: A Systematic Mapping of Root Causes and Manifestations in Agentic AI Systems
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
summary: The emergence of Agentic AI systems, characterized by autonomous reasoning, multi-agent collaboration, tool orchestration, adaptive decision-making, and persistent memory, represents a fundamental shift from traditional AI pipelines to dynamic software ecosystems. While AI Technical Debt (AITD) has been widely studied in machine learning and software engineering, existing models assume static, component-level architectures and fail to capture the dynamic and emergent behaviors of agentic environments. To address this gap, this paper introduces Agentic Technical Debt (AgTD), defined as technical debt that emerges, accumulates, propagates, and amplifies due to the autonomous and collaborative nature of Agentic AI systems. Building on our prior systematic scoping review of 31 AITDs across seven root-cause categories, we employ a theory-informed transformation methodology to reinterpret these debts in Agentic AI through direct transformation, contextual transformation, and manifestation expansion. We present the first systematic mapping of established AITDs to their agentic manifestations, showing how conventional debts evolve into system-level liabilities, including memory inconsistencies, orchestration fragility, cascading failures, and unsafe autonomous decision-making. Our findings show that technical debt extends beyond software artifacts to encompass agent behaviors, coordination mechanisms, and interactions among agents, tools, and execution environments. We further examine its implications for AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM), highlighting impacts on trustworthiness, governance, security, operational resilience, and Sustainability Technical Debt. Overall, this work establishes AgTD as a foundational software engineering construct and provides a transformation framework, taxonomy, and research agenda for managing technical debt in autonomous multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出"智能体技术债务"(AgTD)概念，通过理论驱动的转化方法将传统AI技术债务映射到智能体AI系统，揭示其如何演变为系统性负债，并提供转化框架、分类体系和研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有AI技术债务(AITD)研究假设静态、组件级架构，无法捕捉智能体AI系统（如自主推理、多智能体协作、工具编排等）中动态涌现的行为特征，存在明显的理论空白。
AI.method: 基于先前对31种AITD的系统性范围审查，采用理论驱动的转化方法，包括直接转化、情境转化和表现扩展三种方式，将传统债务重新解读为智能体环境中的表现，并映射到AI TRiSM框架。
AI.result: 首次建立了AITD到智能体表现的系统映射，展示传统债务如何演变为记忆不一致、编排脆弱性、级联故障和不安全自主决策等系统性负债；证实技术债务超越软件工件，扩展至智能体行为、协调机制及交互关系。
AI.conclusion: 将AgTD确立为软件工程的基础性构建，提供转化框架、分类学和研究议程，为管理自主多智能体AI系统中的技术债务奠定基础，并强调其对信任、治理、安全、运营韧性和可持续性的影响。

title: Optical Flow from Photons
summary: Optical flow remains challenging in high-speed and low-light scenes, where the limited frame rate and sensitivity of conventional cameras lead to motion blur and underexposure. Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras offer single-photon sensitivity and extremely fine temporal sampling. However, individual slices in these high FPS binary photon streams are too sparse for dense correspondence. Temporal aggregation can provide the spatial cues required by optical flow, but accumulating photons at fixed coordinates blurs moving structures. Motion-aware aggregation can reduce this blur, yet it depends on the flow being estimated. To address this dependency, we propose QuantaFlow, the first method for dense optical flow directly from SPAD streams. Instead of constructing a fixed input representation, QuantaFlow embeds SPAD representation construction into iterative flow refinement. At each iteration, the current flow coarsely aligns the slices within the source and target sub-streams. A photon-flux transformation then constructs multi-scale representations containing intensity and structural cues, while adaptive multi-scale fusion balances photon noise and residual motion blur at each pixel. The fused representations drive a feature-warping flow update, and the refined flow guides representation construction in the next iteration. We further construct a synthetic dataset for SPAD optical-flow training and evaluation. Experiments on the synthetic dataset and real-world SPAD data demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of QuantaFlow.

AI.tldr: QuantaFlow是首个直接从SPAD光子流估计密集光流的方法。它摒弃了固定输入表示，而是将SPAD表示构建嵌入迭代光流精化过程中，通过当前光流粗对齐、光子通量变换构建多尺度表示、自适应多尺度融合平衡光子噪声与运动模糊，从而逐步精化光流。
AI.motivation: 高速和低光场景中，传统相机受限于帧率和灵敏度，导致运动模糊和欠曝光，光流估计困难。SPAD相机具备单光子灵敏度和极细时间采样能力，但单个高帧率二进制光子帧过于稀疏，难以进行稠密匹配。简单的时间聚合又会在运动区域产生模糊，而运动感知聚合又依赖于待估计的光流，形成循环依赖问题。
AI.method: QuantaFlow将SPAD表示的构建嵌入到迭代光流精化框架中。具体包括：(1) 在当前迭代中，用已有光流将源和目标子流中的时间片粗对齐；(2) 通过光子通量变换构建包含强度和结构线索的多尺度表示；(3) 自适应多尺度融合在每个像素处平衡光子噪声与残余运动模糊；(4) 融合表示驱动特征扭曲的光流更新，精化后的光流再指导下一次迭代的表示构建。此外，作者构建了用于SPAD光流训练和评估的合成数据集。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实SPAD数据上的实验验证了QuantaFlow的有效性和泛化能力，表明该方法能够直接从SPAD光子流中估计稠密光流。
AI.conclusion: QuantaFlow通过将表示构建与光流估计迭代耦合，解决了SPAD光流中准确表示与光流估计之间的循环依赖问题，为高速低光场景下的光流估计提供了新范式。

title: Interpretable machine learning for predicting splitting strength of asphalt concrete: insights from SHAP analysis
summary: This paper presents an interpretable machine-learning framework for predicting the splitting strength (ST) of asphalt concrete and supporting data-driven mixture design. A database consisting of 296 samples was established, and 14 input variables related to asphalt properties, aggregate gradation, and fiber characteristics were selected for modeling. Six machine-learning models, namely TabPFN, ANN, SVR, RF, XGBoost, and LightGBM, were developed and compared. Hyperparameter optimization was performed for five models using NSGA-II, while TabPFN was directly applied with its default configuration. The results show that all six models achieved satisfactory predictive capability, whereas TabPFN delivered the best overall performance on the testing set, with the lowest RMSE of 0.28, MAE of 0.21, MAPE of 18.01%, MAD of 0.14, the highest R^2 of 0.88, and the highest composite score of 0.91. SHAP analysis further revealed that nine dominant variables accounted for 92.0% of the total average contribution, among which Ag9.5, FT, Ag4.75, AC, and Du were the most influential. In addition, favorable parameter ranges for improving ST were quantified, such as Ag9.5 < 66.8%, Ag4.75 < 45.0%, AC < 5.4 wt.%, AV < 3.6%, and Du > 134.7 cm. Finally, a GUI platform integrating prediction and SHAP-based explanation was developed to improve the accessibility and practical applicability of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于预测沥青混凝土的劈裂强度（ST）并支持数据驱动的配合比设计。基于296个样本数据库和14个输入变量，构建并比较了六种机器学习模型，其中TabPFN表现最佳（R²=0.88）。通过SHAP分析识别出9个主导变量占92%的贡献，并量化了改善ST的有利参数范围。最后开发了集成预测与解释功能的GUI平台。
AI.motivation: 沥青混凝土劈裂强度是评估其力学性能的关键指标，传统预测方法往往依赖经验公式或复杂的试验，效率低且缺乏可解释性。因此需要一种既具有高预测精度又能提供机理解释的智能方法来支持实际的配合比设计决策。
AI.method: 建立296个样本数据库，选取14个输入变量（涵盖沥青性质、集料级配和纤维特征）。开发并比较六种ML模型：TabPFN、ANN、SVR、RF、XGBoost和LightGBM。对五种模型使用NSGA-II进行超参数优化，TabPFN采用默认配置。使用SHAP进行特征贡献分析，并开发GUI平台整合预测与解释功能。
AI.result: 所有六种模型均达到满意的预测能力，TabPFN在测试集上综合表现最佳（RMSE=0.28, MAE=0.21, MAPE=18.01%, R²=0.88, 综合得分0.91）。SHAP分析显示9个主导变量贡献了92.0%的平均贡献，其中Ag9.5、FT、Ag4.75、AC和Du影响最大。确定了改善ST的有利参数范围，如Ag9.5<66.8%、Ag4.75<45.0%、AC<5.4wt.%等。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明TabPFN结合SHAP分析能够有效预测沥青混凝土劈裂强度并提供机理层面的解释，GUI平台提升了该框架的可访问性和实际工程适用性，为数据驱动的配合比设计提供了有价值的工具。

title: Exemplars in Disguise: Pure Exemplar Models Mimic Abstraction-First Learning
summary: Whether idiosyncratic, item-specific knowledge is learned before abstract class-level generalizations, or vice versa, is a central question in language learning, with exemplar and abstraction-based theories making opposite predictions. Recent methods have claimed to show that, at least for large language models, abstract knowledge is learned first. We show that these methods fall short: pure memorizer models with no abstract representations can appear, by the same criteria, to learn either item-specific or class-level knowledge first, depending on their sensitivity to individual observations, with the transition point governed by the distributional properties of the input. We further argue that the distinction between item-specific and abstract knowledge may be ill-defined for distributed representations, as a word's class-level properties may not be separable from its item-specific properties.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了"大语言模型先学习抽象类级知识"的说法，证明纯记忆模型（无抽象表示）也能在相同标准下表现出先学习抽象知识的假象，并论证在分布式表示中，项目特定知识与抽象类级知识的区分本身可能是不明确的。
AI.motivation: 语言学习中"项目特定知识先学"还是"抽象类级泛化先学"是核心争议，近期方法声称LLM先学抽象知识，但作者认为这些方法存在缺陷，需要重新检验。
AI.method: 作者使用纯记忆模型（不具备任何抽象表示能力）作为对照，通过调整其对单个观测的敏感性，观察其在既有评价标准下的学习顺序表现；同时从理论上论证分布式表示中项目特定与类级属性不可分离。
AI.result: 纯记忆模型可以依据对个体观测的敏感度不同，在相同标准下表现出"先学项目特定"或"先学类级知识"两种结果，转变点由输入分布特性决定，证明既有方法的结论不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 既有方法无法有效区分抽象知识与项目特定知识的学习顺序；更深层地，分布式表示中这两类知识可能本质上是不可分离的，该二元区分本身存在概念问题。

title: Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC): A Theoretical Framework for Process-Oriented Cognitive Evaluation of Text-Based AI Systems
summary: Evaluating artificial intelligence systems has historically relied on outcome-based benchmarks that measure task accuracy, robustness, or fairness. While indispensable, these benchmarks provide limited diagnostic insight into the underlying cognitive processes that generate performance-leaving critical questions unanswered about how AI systems reason, integrate memory, manage complexity, or avoid generating false information. This paper introduces the Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC), a theoretically grounded framework for shifting evaluation from what text-based AI systems produce to how they think. MAAC defines nine cognitively motivated dimensions: Cognitive Load, Tool Execution, Content Quality, Memory Integration, Complexity Handling, Hallucination Control, Knowledge Transfer, Processing Efficiency, and Process-Outcome Alignment. Each dimension is grounded in established cognitive science theory-drawing on Marr's tri-level hypothesis, Baddeley's working memory model, Sweller's cognitive load theory, and unified theories of cognition. Five theoretical analyses provide initial support for the framework's coherence and empirical testability: dimension-to-theory mapping; a coverage matrix assessing breadth and non-redundancy; a formal gap analysis relative to current evaluation practice; a worked diagnostic illustration; and a set of a priori interdependency predictions for future empirical testing. MAAC provides a theoretical and operational framework for principled process-level cognitive assessment of text-based AI systems, complementing existing outcome-based benchmarks with cognitively grounded, multi-dimensional evaluation.
