AI.tldr: 本文提出了多维度人工智能认知评估框架（MAAC），将基于结果的AI评估转向基于过程的认知评估。MAAC定义了九个认知驱动的维度，并基于认知科学理论（Marr三层次假说、Baddeley工作记忆模型、Sweller认知负荷理论、统一认知理论）进行理论支撑，通过五项理论分析验证了框架的连贯性和可检验性。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI评估系统主要依赖基于结果的基准测试（准确率、鲁棒性、公平性），虽然不可或缺，但无法提供对AI底层认知过程的诊断性洞察，留下关于AI如何推理、整合记忆、管理复杂性或避免生成虚假信息等关键问题无法回答。
AI.method: MAAC框架定义了九个认知驱动的维度：认知负荷、工具执行、内容质量、记忆整合、复杂性处理、幻觉控制、知识迁移、处理效率和过程-结果对齐。每个维度都基于既有认知科学理论，并通过五项理论分析进行支撑：维度到理论的映射、覆盖矩阵分析、形式化差距分析、诊断性说明示例、先验依赖关系预测。
AI.result: 五项理论分析初步支持了MAAC框架的连贯性和经验可检验性，包括维度与理论的映射关系、评估覆盖广度与非冗余性、与现有评估实践的差距、工作诊断示例以及可供未来实证检验的依赖关系预测。
AI.conclusion: MAAC为基于文本的AI系统提供了理论性和可操作性的过程级认知评估框架，以认知驱动、多维度评估的方式补充现有的基于结果的基准测试，实现了评估从"产生什么"到"如何思考"的转变。

title: Who Belongs in the Eval Set? A Capability-Taxonomy-Driven Pipeline for Curating Regression Eval Sets in Agent-Extensibility Platforms
comment: Extended abstract accepted at the SERI 2026 Industry Track
summary: Platform teams hosting agent-extensibility surfaces face a regression-economics paradox: every onboarding customer ships an evaluation set tuned to their domain, but the platform's regression set must live under a hard query-count ceiling bounded by release cadence. To our knowledge, no published industrial pipeline addresses this platform-side curation problem: existing evaluation frameworks are customer-side, and benchmark-compression work treats benchmarks as fixed pools rather than streams of incoming sets. We describe a capability-taxonomy-driven curation pipeline applied to declarative agents with custom actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot. It takes an agent specification and a customer's eval set as input, projects each query into a platform-owned capability taxonomy, and outputs per-query decisions (admit, drop, swap, or human review), under the philosophy that a healthy regression set is the minimal set of queries capturing the maximal spread of capability signatures -- distinct combinations of capabilities a query exercises together. Three components instantiate this: a classifier producing per-(query, capability) verdicts via a hybrid of deterministic specification-based extraction and large-language-model (LLM) semantic inference; an Invocation Quality (IQ) rater scoring how thoroughly a query exercises each capability, so a new query sharing a signature with an existing entry can still be recognized as a better test and displace it; and a consolidator comparing incoming queries against the regression set on coverage and quality through a rule-based decision cascade, backed by a conservative curator that only suggests evictions. The mechanism is taxonomy-agnostic and applies to any regression eval-set curation problem with a typed capability taxonomy, including taxonomies that evolve in response to the very evidence the pipeline surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于能力分类学的平台侧回归测试集筛选流水线，用于微软365 Copilot中声明式代理的自定义操作。该流水线以代理规范和客户评估集为输入，将每个查询投影到平台拥有的能力分类学中，输出每个查询的决定（接纳、丢弃、替换或人工审查），目标是构建最小化但能力签名覆盖最大化的健康回归集。
AI.motivation: 平台团队面临"回归经济学悖论"：每个新客户都会带来针对其领域的评估集，但平台的回归集受发布节奏和查询数量硬性上限约束。现有的评估框架都是面向客户侧的，而基准压缩工作将基准视为固定池而非流入的流，没有发布任何面向平台侧的工业级流水线来解决这一策展问题。
AI.method: 流水线由三个组件构成：(1) 分类器——通过确定性规格提取与LLM语义推理的混合方式，产出每个(查询, 能力)对的判定；(2) 调用质量(IQ)评分器——评估查询对每个能力的调用彻底程度，使得共享相同能力签名的新查询仍可被识别为更优测试并替代现有条目；(3) 整合器——通过基于规则的决策级联比较新查询与回归集在覆盖率和质量上的差异，并由保守的策展器仅建议淘汰。
AI.result: 该机制是分类学无关的，适用于任何具有类型化能力分类学的回归评估集策展问题，包括那些会随流水线所呈现的证据而演化的分类学。本文提供了一种平台侧解决回归集策展的实际工业方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了平台侧回归评估集策展这一空白，以"最小查询集捕获最大能力签名覆盖"为核心理念，展示了一个可部署、分类学可演化的工业级流水线，直接解决了平台团队在评估集维护中的核心矛盾。

title: SpatialAfford: Teaching Compact VLMs Where to Look and Where to Ground for Affordance
summary: Affordance grounding aims to localize the functional region for interaction, such as the handle to grasp or the button to press, rather than the whole object. This makes it more challenging than generic visual grounding because the target region is smaller, more ambiguous, and more dependent on task context, especially for compact vision-language models (VLMs) used in embodied settings. Recent sequence-level supervision and reinforcement learning improve coordinate prediction quality, yet compact autoregressive VLMs still lack reliable affordance-aware visual focus before coordinate generation: the model can produce better coordinate tokens while its cross-modal attention remains diffuse and weakly anchored to the true affordance evidence. To address it, we propose SpatialAfford, a two-stage framework that first aligns attention to the ground-truth affordance region through Spatial Attention Alignment (SAA), then refines coordinate prediction with Spatial-Aware GRPO. By explicitly teaching the model where to look before optimizing where to ground, SpatialAfford turns affordance grounding from a purely output-constrained objective into attention-grounded spatial reasoning. Across ShareRobot-Bench, ReasonAff, and PartAfford, SpatialAfford consistently improves affordance grounding, with a compact 4B model outperforming stronger 7B+ baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialAfford，一个两阶段框架用于改进紧凑视觉语言模型（VLM）的affordance grounding能力。第一阶段通过Spatial Attention Alignment（SAA）将模型注意力对齐到真实affordance区域，第二阶段使用Spatial-Aware GRPO优化坐标预测。在ShareRobot-Bench、ReasonAff和PartAfford基准上，4B模型超越7B+基线。
AI.motivation: Affordance grounding（功能区域定位，如把手、按钮）比通用视觉接地更具挑战性，因为目标区域更小、更模糊且更依赖任务上下文。现有紧凑型自回归VLM在生成坐标前缺乏可靠的affordance感知视觉焦点——虽然能输出较好的坐标token，但跨模态注意力仍弥散且未锚定到真实affordance证据上。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架SpatialAfford：(1) 第一阶段通过Spatial Attention Alignment (SAA)将模型注意力显式对齐到ground-truth affordance区域；(2) 第二阶段使用Spatial-Aware GRPO进一步优化坐标预测。核心思想是先教会模型"看哪里"，再优化"接哪里"。
AI.result: 在ShareRobot-Bench、ReasonAff和PartAfford三个基准上，SpatialAfford一致性地提升了affordance grounding性能，紧凑的4B模型超越了更强的7B+基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式地在坐标生成前对齐注意力，SpatialAfford将affordance grounding从纯输出约束目标转变为注意力接地的空间推理，有效解决了紧凑VLM在affordance任务中注意力弥散的问题。

title: One-Sided Quantile Coupling for Flow Matching
summary: Flow Matching trains continuous-time generative models by regressing the velocity field of a probability path between a simple source distribution and a target data distribution. The coupling that pairs source and target samples strongly affects optimization and sample quality, but structured couplings typically rely on mini-batch transport or assignment procedures whose cost grows at least quadratically in batch size. We propose Quantile Coupling Flow Matching (QC-FM), a lightweight one-sided coupling: rather than matching two pre-sampled batches, it samples only the data batch and constructs each paired source directly. Data ranks projected along a small number of random orthogonal directions are mapped to Gaussian quantiles, and the latent code is completed in the orthogonal complement by conditional Gaussian sampling. The construction is one-dimensional per slice, so the coupling requires no pairwise cost matrix and no assignment to solve. We show that, for each drawn frame, this coupling eliminates the irreducible regression variance along every selected slice and makes the ideal flow exactly straight there, while leaving the sampling prior unchanged: generation still starts from the standard Gaussian, and the training source deviates from it only through the copula of the slice codes, whose transport cost we bound. For training, we apply QC to an anchor subset and complete the remaining source slots with exact Gaussian samples, retaining the QC bias while preserving an explicit signal from the Baseline coupling. Across CIFAR-10, CelebA, FFHQ, and ImageNet-64, QC-FM improves over the Baseline under matched training budgets, reducing FID by up to 12.9%, and outperforms OT-CFM on all four datasets. These results suggest that preserving projected rank structure is a simple and scalable way to inject useful geometric bias into FM couplings without solving a mini-batch transport problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分位数耦合流匹配（QC-FM），通过沿随机正交方向将数据排名映射到高斯分位数来构建一对一的源-目标耦合，无需成对成本矩阵或分配求解，在多个数据集上减少FID高达12.9%，并超越OT-CFM。
AI.motivation: 流匹配训练中源-目标样本的耦合方式显著影响优化和样本质量，但结构化耦合（如小批量最优传输）成本随批次大小至少呈二次方增长，限制了其可扩展性。
AI.method: QC-FM提出轻量级单侧耦合：仅采样数据批次，沿少量随机正交方向将数据排名映射到高斯分位数，并通过条件高斯采样在正交补空间中完成潜码。该构造在每个切片上是一维的，无需成对成本矩阵和分配求解。训练时对锚点子集应用QC，其余源槽位用精确高斯样本填充。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CelebA、FFHQ和ImageNet-64上，QC-FM在匹配训练预算下优于基线，FID最多降低12.9%，并在全部四个数据集上优于OT-CFM。
AI.conclusion: 在流匹配耦合中保留投影秩结构是一种简单且可扩展的方式，可以在不求解小批量传输问题的情况下注入有用的几何偏差。

title: Pruned BPE: Post-training Visibility Pruning and Token Reallocation for Byte Pair Encoding
summary: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is widely used for subword tokenization, but standard BPE exposes every learned merge token to the downstream model, including tokens that mainly serve as intermediate construction units and rarely appear in the final encoded corpus. This paper proposes Pruned BPE, a post-training visibility-pruning and token-reallocation method that separates merge construction from model-visible vocabulary selection. After standard BPE training, tokens are evaluated by final exposure. Low-exposure tokens are retained as internal-only merge nodes, while their visible vocabulary slots are reassigned to better-exposed candidates learned through resumed training. During encoding, internal-only tokens are recursively expanded into visible descendants while the original BPE merge order is preserved. Experiments on two non-overlapping English- and Chinese-dominated corpora and their combination show that Pruned BPE consistently reduces encoded length relative to Standard BPE at the same training corpus, evaluation corpus, and model-visible vocabulary size. At a 40\% exposure threshold, the reduction is approximately 0.27\%--0.36\% on same-corpus evaluations. In a vocabulary-only evaluation using a shared exact minimum-token dynamic-programming encoder, Pruned BPE retains an advantage of approximately 0.23\%--0.31\%, indicating that the improvement arises from a more efficient visible vocabulary. These gains represent a meaningful fraction of the approximately 1.5\%--3.8\% marginal reduction that would otherwise require adding another 2K Standard BPE tokens. Qualitative analysis shows that internal-only tokens include reusable English fragments, Chinese components, partial UTF-8 byte sequences, and structured-text fragments. The results indicate that post-training visibility pruning can improve BPE vocabulary efficiency without increasing the vocabulary exposed to the language model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pruned BPE，一种后训练可见性剪枝与token重新分配方法，将BPE的合并构建过程与模型可见词汇表选择分离。标准BPE训练后，低曝光度的token被保留为仅内部使用的合并节点，其可见词汇槽位重新分配给通过恢复训练学习到的曝光度更高的候选token。在编码时，内部token被递归展开为可见后代token，同时保持原始合并顺序。实验表明，在相同词汇表大小下，Pruned BPE相比标准BPE一致地减少了编码长度。
AI.motivation: 标准BPE将所有学习的合并token都暴露给下游模型，包括那些主要作为中间构建单元且很少出现在最终编码语料中的token，这浪费了有限的可见词汇表容量，降低了词汇表效率。
AI.method: 1) 标准BPE训练后，根据最终曝光度评估所有token；2) 低曝光token保留为仅内部合并节点，其可见词汇槽位重新分配给通过恢复训练学到的更好候选；3) 编码时内部token递归展开为可见后代，保持原始合并顺序。
AI.result: 在英语和中文主导的两个语料及其组合上，Pruned BPE在相同可见词汇表大小下一致地减少了编码长度。40%曝光阈值下，同语料评估减少约0.27%-0.36%；词汇表纯评估中仍有约0.23%-0.31%优势。这些收益相当于添加额外2K个标准BPE token所能获得的约1.5%-3.8%边际减少的有效部分。
AI.conclusion: 后训练可见性剪枝可以在不增加模型可见词汇表大小的情况下提升BPE词汇表效率。内部token包括可复用的英语片段、中文部件、部分UTF-8字节序列和结构化文本片段，验证了该方法的核心假设。

title: When Does LLM Orchestration Pay Off? A Controlled Evaluation of Accuracy, Cost, and Task Difficulty
summary: LLM orchestration is often assumed to improve reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation, yet its gains may not justify its cost. Existing comparisons also frequently overlook differences in optimization effort, making it difficult to isolate the value of orchestration itself. We conduct a controlled evaluation of Self-Refine, Best-of-$N$, and Debate against task-only and chain-of-thought (CoT) single-call baselines across five LLM backbones and three domains: competitive programming, chess puzzles, and mathematics. For comparability, we optimize each method with GEPA under the same optimization budget and evaluate all methods on the same difficulty-stratified benchmark items. Orchestration yields moderate but benchmark-dependent gains: averaged across backbones within each benchmark, the largest improvement is 4.6 percentage points over optimized CoT inference and 4.5 points over task-only inference, while requiring approximately 2 to 4 times the mean total tokens of task-only inference. Human-derived difficulty is associated with lower absolute accuracy in all three benchmarks, but within-benchmark analyses do not indicate that orchestration effects increase with task difficulty. By contrast, exploratory mixed-effects analyses reveal strong interactions between orchestration method and backbone model across all three benchmarks, showing that orchestration effectiveness depends substantially on the underlying model. Our results suggest that orchestration decisions should be model-specific and account for whether moderate accuracy gains justify the additional inference cost. More broadly, evaluations of LLM orchestrations should control optimization effort and report model-specific accuracy--cost trade-offs rather than treating additional inference-time structure as uniformly beneficial.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM编排方法（Self-Refine、Best-of-N和Debate）进行了受控评估，与任务专用和思维链单次调用基线进行比较，覆盖5个LLM骨干模型和3个领域。结果表明编排仅带来适度且因基准而异的收益（最大提升约4.6个百分点），但需要2-4倍的推理成本，且编排效果与骨干模型存在强烈交互作用，应基于模型特定进行决策。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM编排方法常被认为能通过增加推理时计算来提升推理能力，但其收益可能不值得额外成本。此外，已有比较往往忽略优化努力的差异，难以分离编排本身带来的价值。
AI.method: 采用受控评估框架：在5个LLM骨干模型和3个领域（竞赛编程、国际象棋谜题、数学）上，使用GEPA在相同优化预算下优化每种方法，并在相同的难度分层基准项目上评估Self-Refine、Best-of-N、Debate与任务专用和CoT单次调用基线。
AI.result: 编排带来适度但基准依赖的收益：跨骨干平均的最大提升为4.6个百分点（相对优化CoT）和4.5个百分点（相对任务专用基线），但需要约2-4倍的总token消耗。人类推导的难度与较低绝对准确率相关，但编排效果不随任务难度增加。混合效应分析显示编排方法与骨干模型间存在强交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 编排决策应针对具体模型制定，并权衡中等精度增益与额外推理成本。LLM编排评估应控制优化努力，并报告模型特定的精度-成本权衡，而非将额外推理时间结构视为普遍有益。

title: Don't Offer What Can't Be Done: Deterministic Executability Gating for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Preprint. Submitted to the ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Applied Data Science Track; currently under review
summary:
Production LLM agents that select from large skill libraries face a limitation that semantic relevance alone cannot resolve: a skill may match a user's topic yet be impossible to execute in the current account state. We present a deployed three-stage selection pipeline for Helpmate, Wix's customer-care assistant. First, a recall-oriented semantic matcher identifies messages related to a ten-skill domain family without consulting account state. Second, a deterministic executability gate removes candidates whose internal hard-stop conditions hold. Because the gate and the skill evaluate the same exit predicates, every blocked candidate would be unable to complete under the same account state, provided predicate parity is preserved and both checks observe fresh authoritative state. Finally, the LLM decides whether to invoke one of the remaining candidates.
  In a post-launch production analysis of 756.6K user messages across 267.6K conversations, semantic matching retained 174,927 messages (23.1%). Within this matched stream, the gate removed 1,039,462 of 1,749,270 skill-message pairs (59.4%), saving 228.8 million skill-description tokens -- 59.1% of the post-semantic skill-description footprint. Together, semantic matching and executability gating reduced skill-description context by 90.5% relative to exposing all ten skills to every message.
  To test whether this pruning affects model behavior rather than context size alone, we replayed a risk-enriched cohort of 1,000 conversations with all ten skills exposed. The model selected a production-blocked skill in 78 conversations (7.8%). This counterfactual result shows that deterministic gating prevents non-executable candidates from influencing model selection, while not claiming downstream tool execution or customer-outcome effects.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Wix客服助手Helpmate的三阶段技能选择流水线：语义匹配器筛选领域相关消息，确定性可执行性门控移除无法执行的技能候选，最后由LLM决定调用哪个技能。在267.6K对话、756.6K消息的生产分析中，该流水线将技能描述上下文减少了90.5%，并通过反事实实验证明确定性门控能防止不可执行候选影响模型决策。
AI.motivation: 大规模技能库中的生产LLM代理面临一个语义相关性无法解决的限制：一个技能可能在主题上匹配用户需求，但在当前账户状态下却无法执行。仅靠语义相关性筛选会导致LLM可能选择无法实际执行的技能，因此需要引入可执行性检查来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 提出三阶段选择流水线：(1) 面向召回率的语义匹配器，在不查询账户状态的情况下识别与十技能领域族相关的消息；(2) 确定性可执行性门控，移除内部硬性停止条件满足的候选技能，该门控与技能评估相同的退出谓词；(3) LLM在剩余候选中决定是否调用技能。通过保谓词一致性和观察最新权威状态来保证门控的可靠性。
AI.result: 在756.6K用户消息中，语义匹配保留了174,927条消息（23.1%）；门控移除了59.4%的技能-消息对（1,039,462/1,749,270），节省了228.8百万技能描述token（占语义后技能描述足迹的59.1%）。整体上语义匹配加可执行性门控将技能描述上下文减少90.5%。反事实实验显示，在风险富集队列中，模型在78个对话（7.8%）中选择了被生产环境阻止的技能。
AI.conclusion: 确定性可执行性门控能有效防止不可执行候选技能影响LLM的模型选择行为，而非仅仅减小上下文规模。该流水线在真实生产环境中成功部署，显著降低了上下文足迹，同时避免了不可执行技能的干扰，但作者不声称对下游工具执行或客户结果有直接影响。

title: RadYOLO: Computationally Efficient 3D Object Detection and Segmentation in CT and MRI
summary:
Object detection and segmentation in three-dimensional medical images is a very active area of research. However, most proposed deep learning models carry a high computational cost, and only few aim to be broadly applicable, achieve high detection performance, and remain fast to execute on resource-constrained hardware. To address this gap, we present RadYOLO, a 3D extension of YOLO11 tailored to medical images. We compare it with nnU-Net and nnDetection on five datasets comprising CT and MRI data with varying object sizes and prevalence. RadYOLO's detection performance surpasses that of nnDetection on four of five datasets and is comparable on one. Compared to nnU-Net, RadYOLO performs better on lesion detection tasks, while nnU-Net excels at detecting large organs when precise localization is required. When rough object localization is sufficient, RadYOLO matches or outperforms nnU-Net on all five datasets. Regarding inference time, RadYOLO is 8-46x faster than nnU-Net on a GPU. Compared to nnDetection the speedup is even higher. When executed on a CPU, RadYOLO's inference runs within seconds (still faster than nnU-Net on a GPU) offering a significant advantage for clinical and edge-device deployment.
  RadYOLO repository: https://github.com/FraunhoferMEVIS/RadYOLO

AI.tldr: 本文提出RadYOLO，一种针对3D医学图像检测和分割定制的YOLO11扩展。在五个CT/MRI数据集上与nnU-Net和nnDetection对比，RadYOLO在检测性能上超越nnDetection（4/5数据集），在病灶检测任务上优于nnU-Net，推理速度比nnU-Net快8-46倍，且可在CPU上秒级运行，非常适合临床和边缘设备部署。
AI.motivation: 现有3D医学图像检测与分割的深度学习模型计算成本高，缺乏兼具广泛适用性、高检测性能和资源受限硬件上快速运行的方案，存在明显的性能与效率缺口。
AI.method: 将YOLO11扩展到3D医学图像领域（RadYOLO），在CT和MRI的五个数据集上（涵盖不同物体尺寸和出现率）与nnU-Net和nnDetection进行系统对比评估。
AI.result: RadYOLO在4/5数据集上检测性能超过nnDetection；在病灶检测上优于nnU-Net；粗定位场景下在全部五个数据集上匹配或超越nnU-Net；GPU推理比nnU-Net快8-46倍，比nnDetection更快；CPU推理秒级完成，仍快于GPU上的nnU-Net。
AI.conclusion: RadYOLO在高性能检测与高效推理之间取得了良好平衡，是适合临床和边缘设备部署的有前景方案。大器官精确定位场景nnU-Net仍占优，但RadYOLO在病灶检测和快速粗定位方面更具优势。

title: Beyond Gene Reconstruction: Learning Cell Representations through Complementary Transcriptomic Views
summary: The rapid growth of single-cell transcriptomic data has enabled the development of foundation models pretrained primarily by reconstructing masked expression values. This objective encourages these models to learn gene dependencies but does not directly optimize whole-cell representations, which are essential for many downstream tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose a contrastive pretraining framework that learns cell representations through complementary transcriptomic views. Since standard contrastive learning is not readily applicable to single-cell pretraining, we introduce specific adaptations along three dimensions --- co-expression-guided gene partitioning, expression-aware contrast-set construction, and competence-gated contrastive onset. Specifically, we first construct two complementary views of each cell by partitioning its genes according to their co-expression structure. Then, to prevent the model from using gene-set identity as a shortcut, we construct hard negatives by permuting expression values while keeping gene identities unchanged. Finally, we introduce a competence-aware controller to determine how the contrastive objective is applied. Experiments on cell-type annotation and gene regulatory network inference demonstrate competitive transfer under the evaluated protocols. In the six-network GRN evaluation, our method records the highest mean AUROC and AUPRC point estimates among the compared variants, while the highest-scoring variant differs across individual networks. These results establish complementary-view contrastive learning as an effective direction for single-cell pretraining beyond gene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于互补视图对比学习的单细胞预训练框架，通过共表达引导的基因分区、表达感知的负样本构建和能力门控的对比学习起始三个维度的适配，学习整细胞表示，在细胞类型注释和基因调控网络推断任务中展现出竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞基础模型主要依赖掩码表达值重建作为预训练目标，虽然能学习基因依赖关系，但未直接优化整细胞表示，而整细胞表示对许多下游任务至关重要。标准对比学习无法直接应用于单细胞预训练，需要针对性适配。
AI.method: 提出对比预训练框架，包含三个关键适配：(1) 共表达引导的基因分区——根据基因共表达结构将基因划分为两个互补视图；(2) 表达感知的对比集构建——通过置换表达值但保持基因身份不变来构造硬负样本，防止模型利用基因集身份作为捷径；(3) 能力门控的对比学习起始——引入能力感知控制器决定何时以及如何应用对比目标。
AI.result: 在细胞类型注释和基因调控网络推断实验中展示了具有竞争力的迁移性能。在六网络GRN评估中，方法获得最高的平均AUROC和AUPRC点估计值，但不同网络间最高得分变体有所不同。
AI.conclusion: 互补视图对比学习被证明是单细胞预训练中超越基因重建范式的有效方向。

title: Practical Online KV Cache Compaction for LLM Agents: An Empirical Study
summary: LLM agents accumulate long trajectories of reasoning steps, tool calls, and environment feedback, making the KV cache a major inference bottleneck. KV cache compaction can reduce this cost, but most prior methods assume a static context where future queries are known or can be approximated offline. Agents instead require online compaction: new information must be compressed before future relevance is known, using proxy queries cheap enough for the inference path. We study online compaction across token eviction (TE) and attention matching (AM), adapting both to compact agent turns and comparing cheap proxy sources such as boundary, repeat-prefill, and delayed future-generation queries. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and WideSearch show that immediate compaction often hurts performance, whereas delaying compaction to use the agent's future queries recovers much of the gap. Moreover, TE is often more robust than AM under imperfect proxies. Across models at different scales, TE preserves most of the accuracy while reducing KV cache by 80%, and can improve throughput over the no compaction baseline. These results position proxy-query selection as a core design choice for practical online KV compaction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM智能体场景下的在线KV缓存压缩问题，对比了token驱逐（TE）和注意力匹配（AM）两种方法，发现延迟压缩（利用智能体未来查询作为代理）比立即压缩效果更好，且TE在代理不完美时比AM更鲁棒，可减少80% KV缓存并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体产生长时间序列的推理步骤、工具调用和环境反馈，导致KV缓存成为推理瓶颈。现有压缩方法大多假设静态上下文（未来查询已知或可离线近似），而智能体场景需要在线压缩——在未知未来相关性的情况下压缩新信息，且代理查询必须足够廉价以不增加推理成本。
AI.method: 将token驱逐（TE）和注意力匹配（AM）两种压缩方法适配到智能体场景，比较三类廉价代理查询来源：边界（boundary）、重复预填充（repeat-prefill）和延迟未来生成（delayed future-generation）查询。在BrowseComp-Plus和WideSearch数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 立即压缩通常损害性能，而延迟压缩（利用智能体未来查询）能恢复大部分性能差距。在不完美代理条件下，TE比AM更鲁棒。在不同规模的模型上，TE在减少80% KV缓存的同时保留了大部分准确率，并且相比无压缩基线可提升吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 代理查询的选择是实际在线KV压缩的核心设计决策，延迟压缩策略和TE方法为智能体场景下的KV缓存优化提供了实用方案。

title: Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化课程学习（ECL）策略，利用多序列比对中序列的进化距离结构，通过幂律扩展计划逐步将模型暴露于进化距离递增的序列，以改进生物序列VAE的训练。在蛋白质变异效应预测（EVE）和RNA家族序列生成（RfamGen）两个领域及两个架构不同的VAE模型上，ECL均提升了下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 标准生物VAE训练将所有序列视为可交换的，忽略了同源序列从进化相近到高度分歧的组织结构。作者认为这种进化结构可以作为有价值的训练信号，但现有方法未能利用这一归纳偏置。
AI.method: 提出Evolutionary Curriculum Learning（ECL），一种训练策略：以采样锚点为基准，按照幂律扩展计划，渐进式地将模型暴露于进化距离递增的序列。消融实验对比了固定大小邻域采样和均匀随机采样。
AI.result: 蛋白质方面：p53的ClinVar分类AUROC从0.981提升至0.989；PTEN在所有种子下达到1.000，而基线不稳定（均值0.905，最低0.54）。RNA方面：三个家族的协方差模型位分数均值提升，15次训练中12次超过种子匹配基线。消融实验证实渐进式扩展优于固定邻域采样和均匀随机采样。
AI.conclusion: 进化距离是排序生物序列建模训练课程的有用归纳偏置。ECL能显著提升蛋白质变异效应预测的稳定性和性能，对RNA生成也有积极但尚需更多家族数据验证的效果。

title: Post-Training on Office Work Improves Software Engineering: A Behavioral Account of Cross-Domain Transfer
summary: Long-horizon tasks require agents to maintain coherent state and goals across nested and branching work. We call this capability goal-directed execution (GDE): the repeated application of four behaviors, namely selecting goals, constructing task-relevant state, maintaining fidelity to higher-level objectives, and verifying completion against the environment. We hypothesize that long-horizon post-training strengthens these behaviors across domains. We test this by post-training Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on 363 Long-Horizon Multi-Tool Agent (LHMTA) tasks drawn from office workflows. The collection contained no software-engineering tasks, yet the model's pass@1 improved by 5.8 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Matched trajectory analysis shows gains in all four GDE behaviors in both office workflows and software repositories. Aggregate SWE-Bench Pro statistics showed related changes in information gathering, implementation, and verification. Together, the results support a behavioral interpretation in which long-horizon post-training changed how the model organized and applied knowledge across tasks, with effects extending beyond the training domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"目标导向执行"(GDE)概念，包括选择目标、构建任务相关状态、保持高层目标忠诚度、验证完成度四个行为。通过在363个长时域多工具代理(LHMTA)办公任务上对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B模型进行后训练，发现即使训练数据不含软件工程任务，模型在SWE-Bench Pro上的pass@1仍提升5.8个百分点，且四个GDE行为在办公和软件领域均有改善，支持长时域后训练可跨领域强化GDE能力的假设。
AI.motivation: 长时域任务要求智能体在嵌套和分支工作中维持连贯的状态与目标，但现有研究缺乏对这种能力的系统性理解和验证。作者提出GDE框架来刻画这一能力，并假设长时域后训练可以在不同领域间泛化强化这些行为。
AI.method: 提出GDE四行为框架（目标选择、状态构建、目标保真、环境验证），构造363个长时域多工具代理任务（LHMTA，基于办公工作流），对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B进行后训练，并通过匹配轨迹分析和SWE-Bench Pro统计进行跨领域评估。
AI.result: 在无软件工程训练数据的前提下，模型在SWE-Bench Pro上pass@1提升5.8个百分点；匹配轨迹分析显示四个GDE行为在办公工作流和软件仓库两个领域均有增益；SWE-Bench Pro的聚合统计显示信息收集、实现和验证环节发生相关变化。
AI.conclusion: 长时域后训练确实改变了模型组织和跨任务应用知识的方式，其效果超越了训练领域的边界，支持GDE作为跨领域可迁移能力的"行为学解释"。

title: Test-time Adaptation of Pelvic Bone Segmentation Models via Dynamic Reliability-Guided
comment: Provisionally accepted for presentation at MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable pelvic bone segmentation (PBS) from CT is essential for robot-assisted pelvic trauma surgery, yet deploying a source-trained model to a new hospital suffers from severe performance degradation due to cross-center domain shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) enables online model adaptation without accessing source data, existing methods show limited effectiveness for PBS, facing challenges including boundary degradation, anatomical inconsistency under domain shifts, and voxel-level class imbalance. To address these challenges, we propose a novel closed-loop dynamic Reliability-Guided TTA framework (ReGA) for PBS. Specifically, we introduce a pseudo-label reliability criterion termed Segmentation Inference Consistency Evaluation (SICE), which jointly measures region overlap and boundary deviation via dropout-based ensemble predictions. Based on SICE, a trust-weighted refinement module adaptively updates features to mitigate boundary errors in pseudo-labels. Furthermore, a confidence-weighted region-level contrastive learning strategy is proposed to enforce anatomical consistency. Finally, ReGA follows the teacher-student (TS) scheme to alleviate voxel-level class imbalance. Experiments on three heterogeneous 3D pelvic CT datasets demonstrate that ReGA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA methods, enabling effective adaptation of the source-trained PBS model to unseen clinical domains. The code is available at https://github.com/Ren-ling/ReGA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ReGA的闭环动态可靠性引导测试时自适应（TTA）框架，用于盆腔骨CT分割。该框架通过引入分割推理一致性评估（SICE）作为伪标签可靠性准则，结合信任加权细化模块和置信度加权区域级对比学习策略，有效解决了跨中心域偏移下边界退化、解剖不一致和体素级类别不平衡等问题，在三个异构3D盆腔CT数据集上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人辅助盆腔创伤手术依赖可靠的盆腔骨CT分割，但源域训练模型部署到新医院时因跨中心域偏移导致性能严重下降。现有TTA方法在盆腔骨分割任务中效果有限，面临边界退化、解剖不一致和体素级类别不平衡三大挑战。
AI.method: 提出ReGA框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) SICE伪标签可靠性准则，通过dropout集成预测联合度量区域重叠和边界偏差；(2) 信任加权细化模块，自适应更新特征以缓解伪标签边界误差；(3) 置信度加权区域级对比学习策略，通过闭环动态机制强制解剖一致性，并采用教师-学生（TS）架构缓解体素级类别不平衡。
AI.result: 在三个异构3D盆腔CT数据集上的实验表明，ReGA在跨中心域适配任务中一致优于现有SOTA TTA方法，能够有效将源域训练的盆腔骨分割模型适配到未见过的临床域。
AI.conclusion: ReGA通过闭环动态可靠性引导的TTA框架，为盆腔骨分割提供了一种无需源数据的有效跨域适配方案，具有良好的临床应用前景，代码已开源。

title: FinHardBench: Can LLMs Generate Latency-Aware Hardware for Financial Computing?
comment: 16 pages (10 pages main text). Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/owenfucell/FinHardBench
summary: Can large language models generate not just correct, but fast hardware? This paper investigates the question in financial FPGA design, where 5-10 nanoseconds of latency determines competitive advantage and designs iterate continuously as protocols, strategies, and regulations evolve. FinHardBench, a benchmark of 33 financial computing tasks, is presented together with three experiments that mirror the real-world FPGA iteration cycle: generating new modules from specifications, tuning system-level configurations across a 6-stage trading pipeline, and adapting existing modules to specification changes. Evaluation of six LLMs on 1530+ experiment rounds yields three findings: (1) models achieve 19-61% functional correctness with timing degradation up to 13.7$\times$ on specific tasks; (2) in system-level design space exploration, top LLMs converge to the optimal configuration with higher reliability than random search, simulated annealing, and Bayesian optimization baselines (5/5 seeds vs. 0-4/5 at the same 24-round budget); (3) strategy-level specification changes remain unsolved for most models. Across the six models, generation and DSE rankings overlap moderately: the strongest code generator is not the fastest architecture optimizer, and the weakest code generator (MiniMax M2.7) still reaches the system optimum on 4 of 5 seeds. On the tasks in FinHardBench, difficulty tracks training data pattern availability more closely than abstraction level. FinHardBench is released as an open-source benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FinHardBench基准，包含33个金融计算任务，用于评估大语言模型在FPGA硬件生成中的能力。通过对6个LLM进行1530+轮实验，发现模型在功能正确性上达到19-61%，但在时序上可退化至13.7倍；在系统级设计空间探索中，最强的LLM比传统优化方法更可靠；而策略级规格变更对大多数模型仍是未解难题。
AI.motivation: 在金融FPGA设计中，5-10纳秒的延迟决定竞争优势，且设计需要随协议、策略和监管变化持续迭代。然而，大语言模型能否生成不仅正确而且快速的硬件这一问题尚未被系统研究，现有工作缺乏针对金融领域FPGA迭代循环的基准测试。
AI.method: 构建了包含33个金融计算任务的FinHardBench基准，并设计三个镜像真实FPGA迭代周期的实验：(1)从规格生成新模块；(2)在6阶段交易流水线中调整系统级配置；(3)将现有模块适配到规格变化。评估6个LLM在1530+轮实验中的表现，并与随机搜索、模拟退火和贝叶斯优化等传统方法对比。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1)模型功能正确率19-61%，部分任务时序退化高达13.7倍；(2)系统级设计空间探索中，顶级LLM以5/5种子收敛到最优配置，优于传统方法（0-4/5）；(3)策略级规格变更对大多数模型仍然无解。代码生成与DSE排名仅中度重叠，最弱的代码生成器MiniMax M2.7仍在4/5种子上达到系统最优。
AI.conclusion: LLM在金融FPGA硬件生成中展现出有前景但参差不齐的能力。任务难度与训练数据模式可用性的相关性高于抽象层级。最强的代码生成器未必是最快的架构优化器。FinHardBench已开源，为后续研究提供了标准化评估平台。

title: Scikit-fingerprints: Python library for scikit-learn compatible molecular fingerprints and chemoinformatics
summary: We present scikit-fingerprints, a comprehensive, fully scikit-learn compatible library for molecular machine learning in Python, based on RDKit. Molecular fingerprints and related functionalities are workhorses of chemoinformatics, yet the widely used open-source frameworks are not compatible with the wider Python machine learning ecosystem based on scikit-learn conventions. scikit-fingerprints closes this gap, bringing molecular fingerprints, molecular filters, similarity and distance measures, applicability domain estimation, data splitting strategies, and more under a single, familiar interface. Scikit-learn compatibility means that an entire chemoinformatics workflow, from a raw SMILES string to a deployable model, can be assembled from composable building blocks and can reuse the mature tooling of the surrounding ecosystem. The underlying RDKit code makes it familiar and extensible for custom chemoinformatics use cases. We put a strong focus on unified interfaces, ease of use, computational efficiency, customization, and extensibility. scikit-fingerprints makes molecular machine learning faster to prototype, easier to reproduce, and simpler to deploy.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 scikit-fingerprints，一个完全兼容 scikit-learn 的分子机器学习 Python 库，基于 RDKit 构建，弥合了化学信息学工具与 scikit-learn 机器学习生态系统之间的鸿沟，提供统一的接口来使用分子指纹、过滤器、相似度度量、适用域估计和数据分割等工具。
AI.motivation: 分子指纹是化学信息学的核心工具，但现有的开源框架不兼容基于 scikit-learn 约定的广泛 Python 机器学习生态系统，导致化学信息学工作流难以与主流机器学习工具无缝集成。
AI.method: 构建一个完全兼容 scikit-learn 接口的库，将分子指纹、过滤器、相似度/距离度量、适用域估计、数据分割策略等结合到统一接口下，底层使用 RDKit 代码以确保熟悉性和可扩展性，强调统一接口、易用性、计算效率、定制化和可扩展性。
AI.result: 该库使完整的化学信息学工作流（从原始 SMILES 字符串到可部署模型）可通过可组合的构建模块组装，并复用成熟生态系统的工具，使分子机器学习原型开发更快、复现更容易、部署更简单。
AI.conclusion: scikit-fingerprints 通过 scikit-learn 兼容性弥合了化学信息学与机器学习生态系统之间的差距，为分子机器学习提供了更高效、可复现且易于部署的解决方案。

title: GuideGround: VLM-guided Semantic Understanding and Viewpoint-aware Reasoning for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding aims to localize the target object in a 3D scene from a natural language query, requiring both fine-grained semantic understanding and viewpoint-dependent spatial reasoning. Existing methods typically formulate semantic understanding as an auxiliary closed-set object classification task and rely on multi-view feature aggregation for viewpoint reasoning, limiting semantic generalization and weakening viewpoint-specific evidence. We observe that vision-language models naturally provide complementary capabilities through open-vocabulary semantic understanding and global scene perception. Based on this insight, we propose GuideGround, a VLM-guided framework that complements rather than replaces task-specific grounding models by leveraging VLMs for semantic enhancement and viewpoint-specific hypothesis verification. Specifically, we replace auxiliary closed-set object classification with VLM-generated object semantic descriptions to enhance semantic understanding. Meanwhile, instead of directly aggregating multi-view representations, we preserve viewpoint-specific grounding hypotheses through per-view grounding and explicitly verify them using VLMs across candidate viewpoints. Extensive experiments on the ReferIt3D benchmark demonstrate that GuideGround consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of both the proposed semantic understanding and viewpoint reasoning strategies.

AI.tldr: GuideGround是一个VLM引导的3D视觉定位框架，通过VLM生成的开放词汇语义描述替代封闭集物体分类来增强语义理解，并通过逐视角假设验证替代多视角特征聚合来进行视点推理，在ReferIt3D基准上超越现有最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉定位方法存在两个问题：(1) 将语义理解公式化为辅助的封闭集物体分类任务，限制了语义泛化能力；(2) 依赖多视角特征聚合进行视点推理，削弱了视角特定的证据。作者观察到视觉语言模型（VLM）天然具备开放词汇语义理解和全局场景感知的互补能力。
AI.method: 提出GuideGround框架，以互补而非替代的方式使用VLM：(1) 语义增强：用VLM生成的物体语义描述替代辅助的封闭集物体分类任务来增强语义理解；(2) 视点假设验证：不直接聚合多视角表示，而是通过逐视角定位保留视角特定的定位假设，并使用VLM在候选视角间显式验证这些假设。
AI.result: 在ReferIt3D基准上的大量实验表明，GuideGround一致性地超越了之前的SOTA方法。全面的消融研究进一步确认了所提出的语义理解和视点推理策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VLM可以在不取代任务特定定位模型的前提下，通过语义增强和视点假设验证两种互补策略显著提升3D视觉定位性能，为VLM与专用模型的有效融合提供了新思路。

title: Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction: An Unbounded Machine Learning Model
summary:
Solomonoff Induction, or SolInd, provides an ideal unbounded model of a priori sequence prediction but cannot naturally describe extrapolation from a given training dataset, as performed by Large Language Models. We apply de Finetti's theorem on exchangeable distributions to SolInd to produce what we call Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction, or HSI, which maintains a hyperprior over all Solomonoff priors that can be conditioned on previously observed sequences.
  We extend Wood et al.'s proof that universal mixtures of semimeasures are equivalent to SolInd to show that universal mixtures of these mixtures are also equivalent, proving that HSI=SolInd. We also prove that HSI's excess error on any distribution, compared to its true generator, is bounded by that generator's complexity in the hyperprior. This result is directly comparable to SolInd's prediction error being bounded by the Kolmogorov complexity of the sequence being predicted, and forces HSI's average excess error to converge to 0 as a dataset grows, leading to optimal prediction in the limit. We claim that HSI is an ideal unbounded model of sequence prediction given a dataset in the same way that SolInd is ideal over individual sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次 Solomonoff 归纳（HSI），通过将 de Finetti 定理应用于 Solomonoff 归纳（SolInd），在 Solomonoff 先验之上构建超先验，使其能够在给定训练数据集条件下进行预测，并证明 HSI 与 SolInd 在预测能力上等价，同时其超额误差受生成器复杂度的约束。
AI.motivation: Solomonoff Induction (SolInd) 作为先验序列预测的理想无界模型，无法自然描述从给定训练数据集中进行外推的任务——这正是大型语言模型（LLM）所执行的。需要一个能够显式利用训练数据集的理想模型，同时保持 SolInd 的最优性。
AI.method: 1. 将 de Finetti 定理应用于 SolInd，构造层次 Solomonoff 归纳（HSI），在超先验中维护所有 Solomonoff 先验的混合，并可在观察到序列后进行条件化。2. 扩展 Wood 等人的证明，证明通用半测度混合的混合仍等价于 SolInd。3. 证明 HSI 在任意分布上的超额误差受该生成器在超先验中复杂度的约束。
AI.result: 1. 证明 HSI = SolInd（两者预测能力等价）。2. 证明 HSI 相对于真实生成器的超额误差以该生成器的复杂度为界。3. 证明随着数据集增长，HSI 的平均超额误差收敛到 0，达到极限最优预测。
AI.conclusion: HSI 是给定数据集条件下序列预测的理想无界模型，正如 SolInd 是单个序列预测的理想模型。该工作将 Solomonoff 归纳的理论框架扩展到了能够处理训练数据外推的场景，为理解 LLM 等数据驱动模型提供了理论基准。

title: Gaokerena: A Small Persian Medical Language Model Family
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence into medical question-answering systems has advanced rapidly; however, research remains predominantly focused on English, leaving low resource languages like Persian significantly underserved. To address this gap, this paper introduces Gaokerena, a novel family of compact Persian medical language models optimized for deployment on consumer grade hardware. As a foundational step toward localized digital healthcare, we first present Gaokerena-V, developed by training a baseline model on a newly curated 90-million-token Persian medical corpus and 20,000 expert-vetted physician Q&A pairs, which improved performance on a translated medical MMLU benchmark from 46.28% to 49.31%. Second, recognizing the critical demands of clinical reasoning, we developed Gaokerena-R by integrating a Chain-of-Thought approach with two novel Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback (RLAIF) frameworks to optimize preference-based reasoning. Despite utilizing the same baseline architecture and a smaller dataset than Gaokerena-V, Gaokerena-R achieved a superior benchmark score of 52.98%. Furthermore, both models are equipped with custom-developed uncertainty heads that predict the model's confidence in its responses based solely on internal hidden states. While these results demonstrate significant progress in Persian medical language modeling and proactive safety estimation, current performance levels remain insufficient for direct clinical application, highlighting the necessity for further research into robust knowledge acquisition and rigorous safety verification prior to real world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Gaokerena，一个面向波斯语医疗领域的紧凑型语言模型家族，包含Gaokerena-V（基于90M token波斯语医疗语料和2万条医生问答对训练）和Gaokerena-R（引入CoT和两种新型RLAIF框架），在医疗MMLU基准上分别达到49.31%和52.98%的准确率，并配备了基于内部隐状态的不确定性预测头。但作者明确指出当前性能不足以直接用于临床，仍需进一步研究。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗问答AI研究主要集中在英语等高资源语言上，波斯语等低资源语言的医疗AI严重缺乏。作者旨在填补这一空白，开发能够在消费级硬件上部署的波斯语医疗语言模型，为本地化数字医疗奠定基础。
AI.method: 1）构建90M-token波斯语医疗语料库和20,000条专家审核的医患问答对训练Gaokerena-V；2）在基础架构上引入Chain-of-Thought及两种新颖的RLAIF（Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback）框架训练Gaokerena-R，优化基于偏好的推理；3）为两个模型设计自定义不确定性头部，仅基于内部隐状态预测模型回答置信度。
AI.result: Gaokerena-V在翻译版医疗MMLU基准上从基线46.28%提升至49.31%；Gaokerena-R尽管使用相同架构和更小数据集，却达到52.98%的更高分数。同时两个模型均具备不确定性预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明在低资源语言医疗建模和主动安全估计方面取得了显著进展，但当前性能仍不足以直接用于临床应用，未来需要更稳健的知识获取和严格的安全验证，才能实现实际部署。

title: Tracing the Cascade: A Topology-Aware Evaluation Framework for Scientific Agent Hallucinations
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in scientific research, where reliability is critical and the underlying knowledge is densely interconnected. In such settings, hallucinations are particularly damaging: a single erroneous claim on a foundational concept can propagate through multi-step reasoning and corrupt entire trajectories. Existing hallucination benchmarks largely operate at the surface level, treating facts in isolation and relying on uniform accuracy metrics that ignore this topological structure. We address this gap with SCHEMA, the first evidence-grounded, topology-aware evaluation framework for hallucinations in scientific agents. SCHEMA automatically constructs scientific concept graphs from benchmark seeds and literature evidence, synthesizes graph-grounded tasks spanning claim verification, multi-hop reasoning, open-ended explanation, and experimental code generation, and evaluates agents with two complementary diagnostics. A trajectory hallucination pipeline audits intermediate reasoning at scale via a topology-weighted severity score, while a multi-agent counterfactual attribution module pinpoints the causal mechanism behind selected failures. SCHEMA reveals that hallucinations concentrate at a small set of highly connected knowledge hubs, and that final-answer accuracy decouples from trajectory honesty; models often reach correct conclusions through structurally flawed reasoning. These results indicate that for high-stakes scientific applications, terminal accuracy alone is an insufficient signal of agent reliability, motivating mechanism-level evaluation grounded in knowledge topology. Code is available at https://github.com/circles-post/SCHEMA.

AI.tldr: SCHEMA是首个基于证据、拓扑感知的科学智能体幻觉评估框架。它自动构建科学概念图，合成多种图接地任务，并通过轨迹幻觉管线（拓扑加权严重度评分）和多智能体反事实归因模块两种互补诊断方法评估智能体。研究发现幻觉集中在高度连接的知识枢纽，且最终答案准确性与轨迹诚实性脱钩。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉基准在表面层面运作，将事实孤立处理，依赖统一的准确率指标，忽略了科学知识密集互联的拓扑结构。在科学研究中，单个基础概念的错误声明会通过多步推理传播并破坏整个轨迹，因此需要更细粒度的、考虑知识拓扑的评估框架。
AI.method: SCHEMA框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 从基准种子和文献证据自动构建科学概念图；(2) 合成涵盖声明验证、多跳推理、开放解释和实验代码生成的图接地任务；(3) 两种互补诊断方法——轨迹幻觉管线通过拓扑加权严重度评分审计中间推理，多智能体反事实归因模块定位选定失败背后的因果机制。
AI.result: SCHEMA揭示两个关键发现：幻觉集中在一小撮高度连接的知识枢纽上；最终答案准确性与轨迹诚实性脱钩——模型常通过结构上有缺陷的推理得出正确结论。
AI.conclusion: 对于高风险科学应用，终端准确性本身不足以作为智能体可靠性的信号，需要基于知识拓扑的机制级评估。

title: Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Includes appendices with full controls and ablations
summary: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive adoptions expose variable-length semantic phases, and no milestone vocabulary, gold patch, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenter places a boundary. Because the agent names its conjecture, a reviewer can negate it by name, which lets our protocol manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions that recorded work rarely contains; one collection then yields four supervised targets, including audit supervision from exactly the failed regions an episode label discards. We then ask what survives deleting the declaration. Given the cut points but not the hypothesis, a model attributes action blocks to their governing hypothesis at over twice chance, beating equal-length blocks over the same trajectories (paired sign test $p = 0.0002$), surviving a lexical control and collapsing under label permutation. Asked instead to place boundaries, a code-blind annotator matches 24 of 40 where random placement matches 11.5, while a mechanical test-event rule beats chance at neither end of a strict-to-permissive sweep. The segments are therefore coherent and not cheaply reproducible. Downstream, DPO on 2,551 phase-boundary pairs changes no decision on 91 adversarial held-out items, while four of 60 change on matched-construction items, all wrong to right, where two controls change none: with 1,825 pairs from one generator, the variable to vary next is corpus diversity, not the boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"采集时语义自分割"方法：在轨迹生成过程中，由智能体自身通过可证伪的因果假设来暴露语义边界，从而将长时程编码轨迹划分为可变的语义阶段。该方法无需里程碑词汇、金标补丁、环境回放、教师logits或回溯式分割器即可获得高质量的监督信号，并能制造"错误原因-修正"转换。实验表明这些分割具有语义一致性，且基于这些分割的DPO训练能有效提升模型表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体轨迹与可用的训练信用单元之间存在严重不匹配：单一动作没有稳定的价值，完整回合标签混淆了有效的探索和废弃的方向，固定窗口切割则破坏了日志记录的边界。这导致监督信号质量低下，难以有效训练长时程编码智能体。
AI.method: 核心方法是"采集时语义自分割"：在轨迹生成时，让智能体通过声明式契约暴露自己的边界。具体而言，智能体在运行过程中命名其因果假设（conjecture），使得后续审查者能够按名否定这些假设，从而制造出"错误原因-修正"转换。该协议一次采集可产生四种监督目标，包括从被丢弃的失败区域中提取的审计监督。
AI.result: 1) 给定切分点但不知道假设时，模型将动作块归因于其主导假设的正确率超过随机两倍（配对符号检验p=0.0002），通过词法对照，且在标签置换下失效；2) 代码盲标注者在边界放置任务中匹配24/40（随机为11.5）；3) DPO训练使用2,551对相位边界对，在91个对抗性保留项上无决策改变，在60个匹配构建项中4项从错误转为正确（两个对照组均为0）。
AI.conclusion: 语义分割是连贯的且不易廉价复现，验证了该方法的有效性。实验结果还表明，当使用来自单个生成器的1,825对数据时，下一个需要变化的变量是语料库多样性而非边界本身，为后续研究指明了方向。

title: Unleashing the Power of Text: Text-Guided Flow Matching for Image Fusion under Complex Degradations
summary: Infrared-visible image fusion under realistic degradation scenarios is a challenging task, as degradations not only cause a loss of reliable modality-specific information in observed images but also hinder the fusion process. Recent studies indicate that text can provide prior information about degradation characteristics, complementing the limited evidence available from corrupted input images and facilitating fusion. However, existing methods typically inject fixed global text representations into visual features, making it difficult for textual guidance to adapt to spatially varying degradations, local structures, and thermal saliency. To this end, we propose TGFusion, a text-guided latent-space flow matching framework that unifies degradation suppression and cross-modal fusion. TGFusion encodes task, degradation, and generation cues into structured prompts. To fully exploit these priors, we design a Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer that represents text as an independent semantic stream alongside fusion, visible, and infrared streams. Joint attention enables token-level bidirectional interaction and layer-wise updating among semantic and visual representations, allowing degradation semantics to dynamically guide reliable information selection and fusion latent generation. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and complex degradation scenarios demonstrate that TGFusion achieves superior or competitive performance in perceptual quality, image naturalness, structural-detail preservation, and infrared-saliency retention, while remaining robust across diverse single and compound degradations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TGFusion，一个文本引导的潜在空间流匹配框架，用于在真实退化场景下统一进行红外-可见光图像退化抑制和跨模态融合。通过将任务、退化和生成线索编码为结构化提示，并设计Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer实现文本与视觉特征在token层面的动态交互，从而克服现有方法中固定全局文本表示无法适应空间变化退化的问题。
AI.motivation: 红外-可见光图像融合在真实退化场景下具有挑战性，因为退化不仅导致观测图像丢失可靠的模态特定信息，还阻碍融合过程。虽然已有研究利用文本提供退化特征先验来辅助融合，但现有方法通常将固定的全局文本表示注入视觉特征，难以适应空间变化的退化、局部结构和热显著区域。
AI.method: 提出TGFusion框架：(1) 将任务、退化和生成线索编码为结构化文本提示；(2) 设计Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer，将文本作为独立的语义流与融合、可见光、红外流并行处理；(3) 通过联合注意力实现token级别的双向交互和逐层更新，使退化语义能够动态引导可靠信息选择和融合潜在表示生成。
AI.result: 在公开基准和复杂退化场景上的大量实验表明，TGFusion在感知质量、图像自然度、结构细节保留和红外显著性保持方面取得了优越或具有竞争力的性能，并且在多种单一和复合退化下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TGFusion通过文本引导的流匹配框架有效实现了退化抑制与跨模态融合的统一，验证了结构化文本提示和多流联合注意力机制在动态引导融合过程中的有效性。

title: Fused Bayesian Flow Networks for Dual-Target Molecular Design
summary: Dual-target drug design aims to generate 3D molecules that can simultaneously interact with two target proteins, offering a promising route for discovering polypharmacological compounds against complex diseases. While recent generative models have shown encouraging performance in single-target drug design, existing dual-target approaches either focus on sequence generation or introduce an additional predictive drift term into the diffusion-based generative trajectory, which limits their ability to fully integrate feature information from both targets. We propose FusedBFN, a fused Bayesian flow network (BFN) for dual-target molecular design. FusedBFN formulates dual-target generation as distribution fusion in a unified continuous parameter space and employs a product-of-experts formulation to incorporate dual-target information throughout the generative process. To address the scarcity of dual-target structural data, we leverage a pretrained target-aware BFN model as the shared backbone. We further introduce a chemically aware prior-based alignment method and a prior-free pocket alignment strategy to construct aligned dual-target contexts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FusedBFN generates molecules with strong binding affinity toward dual targets while maintaining favorable molecular properties.

AI.tldr: 提出FusedBFN，一种基于融合贝叶斯流网络（BFN）的双靶点分子设计方法，通过在产品专家（product-of-experts）框架下融合双靶点信息，在统一连续参数空间中进行分布融合，并利用预训练的靶点感知BFN作为共享主干网络，结合化学感知和口袋对齐策略，生成对双靶点具有强结合亲和力且保持良好分子性质的3D分子。
AI.motivation: 双靶点药物设计旨在生成能同时与两个靶蛋白相互作用的3D分子，对多药理学化合物发现具有重要意义。现有方法要么局限于序列生成，要么在扩散模型的生成轨迹中引入额外的预测漂移项，未能充分整合两个靶点的特征信息，因此需要一种能够更全面融合双靶点信息的新方法。
AI.method: FusedBFN将双靶点生成表述为统一连续参数空间中的分布融合问题，采用product-of-experts公式在生成过程中整合双靶点信息。为解决双靶点结构数据稀缺问题，利用预训练的靶点感知BFN模型作为共享骨干网络；同时引入化学感知先验对齐方法和无先验口袋对齐策略，构建对齐的双靶点上下文。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FusedBFN生成的分子对双靶点具有强结合亲和力，同时保持良好的分子性质。
AI.conclusion: FusedBFN通过分布融合和专家乘积机制成功实现了双靶点分子设计，有效克服了双靶点结构数据稀缺的挑战，证明了该方法在多药理学化合物发现中的潜力。

title: Mind the Gap: Zero-Query Jailbreaks via Filter-Generator Discrepancy in Text-to-Image Systems
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems typically have prompt-level safety filters before the generator to block unsafe requests, yet such systems remain vulnerable to malicious jailbreak prompts. Transfer-based attacks construct adversarial prompts offline without querying the target, but they tend to overfit to a single surrogate. Moreover, they explore a large search space in which semantic or perceptual similarity alone cannot guarantee both filter evasion and preservation of the unsafe generation intent, wasting effort on low-potential candidates. We observe that the filter and the generator process the same prompt under different objectives and representations, and term this gap the Filter-Generator Discrepancy (FGD), which allows a perturbation to reduce a prompt's perceived risk to the filter while preserving the visual concept needed by the generator. Building on FGD, we propose a zero-query jailbreak framework that screens perturbations into a high-potential candidate set via observable discrepancy rules at the tokenization and semantic stages, and then performs a surrogate-ensemble evolutionary search that requires no access to the target. Experiments on six black-box pipelines and a commercial online service show that our method consistently outperforms representative baselines, raising the average attack success rate to 29.2\% (MHSC) and 33.3\% (Q16) across the six pipelines and improving over the strongest baseline by about 8 and 12 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于"过滤器-生成器差异"(FGD)的零查询越狱攻击框架，用于文本到图像(T2I)系统。通过筛选高潜力扰动并利用替代模型集成进化搜索，在不查询目标系统的情况下，将六个黑盒管线的平均攻击成功率提升至29.2%(MHSC)和33.3%(Q16)。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I系统虽有提示级别的安全过滤器，但仍易受恶意越狱提示攻击。基于迁移的攻击方法离线构建对抗提示，但容易过拟合单一替代模型，且在大搜索空间中仅依赖语义或感知相似性无法同时保证过滤器规避和保留不安全生成意图，浪费大量算力在低潜力候选上。
AI.method: 1) 提出FGD(过滤器-生成器差异)概念：安全过滤器与生成器对同一提示采用不同目标与表征处理，利用这一差距使扰动降低过滤器感知风险的同时保留生成器所需的视觉概念。2) 基于FGD构建零查询越狱框架：先在标记化和语义阶段通过可观测的差异规则筛选高潜力候选扰动集合，然后执行无需访问目标的替代模型集成进化搜索。
AI.result: 在六个黑盒管线和一个商业在线服务上，该方法一致优于代表性基线，平均攻击成功率分别达到29.2%(MHSC)和33.3%(Q16)，相比最强基线提升了约8和12个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用过滤器与生成器之间的表征差异作为筛选扰动的高效信号，结合替代模型集成搜索，可以在零查询条件下实现有效的越狱攻击，显著优于现有方法。

title: AI-Based Thesis Assessment: An Empirical Study of Human Evaluation Priorities and Their Impact on Automated Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education Technology (AIET 2026), Zagreb, Croatia
summary: Rubric-based AI systems for thesis assessment use criterion weights to assign different levels of importance to evaluation criteria. These weights are typically defined through expert judgment, although little empirical evidence exists regarding how thesis supervisors actually prioritize evaluation criteria. Consequently, this study investigates supervisor-derived criterion weights in thesis assessment and evaluates their impact on AI-based assessment. We surveyed 84 thesis supervisors across four academic disciplines and collected weighting data for 35 thesis assessment criteria. Comparison with the default criterion weights of the AI assessment system RubiSCoT [1] revealed substantial divergences between supervisor-derived and default criterion weights. To evaluate the practical implications of these differences, the supervisor-derived weights were integrated into multiple calibration configurations and evaluated on a corpus of 80 German-language theses. The best-performing configuration reduced the mean relative deviation between AI-generated and supervisor-assigned evaluations from 11.18% to 10.85%, although the improvement was not statistically significant. Human supervisors showed substantially stronger agreement with each other, exhibiting a mean inter-supervisor relative deviation of 4.44%. The findings indicate that criterion-weight calibration alone does not substantially improve alignment between AI-generated and human assessments.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了84位论文导师对35个评估标准的权重偏好，并将其与AI评估系统RubiSCoT的默认权重进行比较。尽管发现两者存在显著差异，但将导师权重整合到AI系统中仅将平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%，且改善在统计上不显著。相比之下，人类导师之间的平均相对偏差仅为4.44%，表明仅校准标准权重并不能显著改善AI与人类评估的一致性。
AI.motivation: 基于规则的AI论文评估系统使用标准权重来区分评价标准的重要性，但这些权重通常由专家主观设定，缺乏关于论文导师实际如何优先排序评估标准的实证证据。因此需要调查导师真实的权重偏好，并检验其对AI评估系统的影响。
AI.method: 对4个学科领域的84位论文导师进行问卷调查，收集35个论文评估标准的权重数据；将导师推导的权重与AI评估系统RubiSCoT的默认权重进行比较；将导师权重整合到多种校准配置中，在80篇德语论文语料库上进行评估。
AI.result: 导师推导的权重与系统默认权重存在显著差异；最佳配置将AI生成与导师评分的平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%，但改善不具统计显著性；人类导师间的平均相对偏差仅为4.44%，远低于AI与人类之间的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过标准权重校准无法显著改善AI评估与人类评估之间的一致性。AI系统与人类评估之间的差距更多可能源于评估本质的复杂性，而非简单的权重设置问题，未来需要探索其他校准策略。

title: Real-Time Detection and Repair of LLM Agent Failures
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Code, data and demo: github.com/sunnydubey1111/agent-trajectory-sentinel Walkthrough: youtu.be/a05n_000klE
summary:
LLM agents fail mid-episode -- they loop, cascade tool errors, drift off goal, fabricate results, or silently absorb corrupted content -- and the standard remedy, judging every step with a second LLM, costs more than the agent itself. We ask how much detection is achievable from observable step telemetry alone, using monitors costing microseconds per step and trained only on healthy runs.
  On 2,823 committed agent episodes across three frameworks, three local models (qwen2.5 7b/3b, llama3.1 8b) and a commercial API (gemini-2.5-flash), a one-class echo-state-network ensemble with CUSUM alarms detects 0.71 of failures at a 5% false-alarm budget (AUROC 0.872). Its advantage over a memoryless baseline is a monotone function of post-onset horizon (+0.09 at <=3 steps, +0.40 at >=9), predicting its own failure region out of sample on AFTraj-2K. Ranking transfers with no retraining to two corpora from other groups (AFTraj-2K 0.745, ATBench 0.779).
  Monitors carry two burdens: a per-deployment healthy null (they do not transfer -- AUROC 0.527 cold against 0.885 recalibrated) and a residual false-alarm rate. We add a layer carrying neither: deterministic verification, which recomputes a run's stated total from the tool results it actually received and confirms every required call was made. Head-to-head it catches 60% of failures (96% with the coverage check) at 0 of 63 false positives against the monitor's 54% at 17%, transfers unchanged to llama3.1:8b (110 of 110 at 0 of 10), and trips on 0 of 1825 healthy episodes.
  Detection is then closed into repair: each flagged run is rolled back and re-run live, recovering 45% of failures against a 16% resampling control (p=0.0005) and lifting task success from 52% to 73% for about one extra model call per run. The system runs at ~200 microseconds per step, three orders of magnitude below a judge call. Code, traces and results are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于步骤遥测数据的轻量级LLM代理故障检测与修复系统，使用单类回声状态网络集成+CUSUM警报（微秒级监控）和确定性验证两种互补方法，在不使用昂贵LLM评判器的情况下实现高精度故障检测，并通过回滚重跑来修复检测到的故障。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在执行过程中频繁失败（循环、级联工具错误、偏离目标、捏造结果等），且中段失败难以提前预判。现有标准方案是用第二个LLM逐步骤判断，但成本高于代理本身。作者希望探究仅从可观测的步骤遥测数据出发，能否用微秒级成本的监控器实现有效的故障检测。
AI.method: 方法包含两层检测：(1) 基于单类回声状态网络集成（echo-state network ensemble）的异常检测器，配合CUSUM警报，在健康运行上训练，内存开销约200微秒/步；(2) 确定性验证层，通过重新计算运行的声称结果与实际工具返回值是否一致，以及确认所有必需调用是否完成，实现零误报的检测。检测到故障后通过回滚并重新执行来修复。
AI.result: 在2,823个代理片段（覆盖3个框架、3个本地模型和1个商业API）上，集成监控器在5%误报预算下检测到0.71的失败（AUROC 0.872），优势随故障后时间跨度单调增加（短时+0.09，长时+0.40），并可跨语料库无训练迁移。确定性验证以0/63误报捕获60%故障（含覆盖率检查为96%），且零健康片段误报。修复机制恢复45%故障（对照组16%，p=0.0005），任务成功率从52%提升至73%，每运行仅需约一次额外模型调用。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的轻量级遥测监控足以在极低成本下实现高效的LLM代理故障检测，且检测结果能有效闭环到修复环节。系统运行速度比LLM评判器快三个数量级，代码、轨迹和结果已开源。

title: DocPO: Advancing Document Policy Optimization via Tailored Step-Aware Rewards
comment: 14 pages. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026). Yunhao Wang and Binghong Wu contributed equally
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for document parsing often relies on reference-based rewards rooted in edit distance (e.g., tree edit distance), yet it remains hard to optimize in the high-accuracy regime because such rewards become weakly discriminative: near-correct outputs receive very similar scores, providing limited learning signal for hard cases. We propose Step-Aware Annealing (SAA), a plug-and-play reward sharpening mechanism that progressively increases reward curvature during training, amplifying subtle quality differences among high-scoring samples while preserving stability in early learning. Built on SAA, we introduce DocPO, a document policy optimization framework with element-specific, reference-based rewards anchored by edit-distance signals: normalized string edit distance (NED) for text, tree edit distance similarity (TEDS) for tables, and a hybrid Rubric+edit reward for formulas. Experiments on OmniDocBench and DocElemHard show that SAA consistently improves GRPO-style RL across document elements over non-annealed rewards, without requiring additional human supervision for reward construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Step-Aware Annealing (SAA)，一种即插即用的奖励锐化机制，通过渐进增加奖励曲率来强化高精度区域的判别力，并基于此构建DocPO文档策略优化框架，在文档解析任务上实现了比传统编辑距离奖励更强的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于编辑距离的参考奖励在文档解析的高精度区域存在弱判别性问题：接近正确的输出得分非常相似，难以提供有效的学习信号，导致强化学习难以优化困难样本。
AI.method: 提出SAA奖励锐化机制，在训练过程中渐进增加奖励曲率，放大高得分样本间的细微质量差异，同时保持早期学习的稳定性。基于SAA构建DocPO框架，使用元素特定的参考奖励：文本用归一化字符串编辑距离(NED)，表格用树编辑距离相似度(TEDS)，公式用混合Rubric+编辑奖励。
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench和DocElemHard基准上，SAA一致地提升了GRPO风格强化学习在各类文档元素上的性能，且无需额外的人工监督来构建奖励。
AI.conclusion: SAA是一种有效的奖励锐化方法，能解决高精度区域奖励判别力不足的问题，提升文档解析强化学习的性能，且具有即插即用的通用性。

title: Caliber: Cross-Architecture Extraction-Cost Control for Score-Returning APIs
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ProvSec 2026
summary: We present Caliber, an output-perturbation defense against model extraction that formulates noise selection as a calibration problem: how much the defense degrades the supervision signal used to train a surrogate, and the provable per-input query cost of recovering the clean logits. To defend against an attacker that uses returned scores for knowledge distillation, Caliber adds independent and identically distributed Gaussian noise to the internal logits. We establish two properties of the resulting perturbed predictions. Monotone agreement degradation: When the clean logits have a unique maximizer, agreement with the clean prediction decreases strictly with the noise scale, so every target in $(1/K,1)$ corresponds to a unique positive scale; task accuracy is bounded by computable lower and upper envelopes. Per-input recovery cost: We derive a closed-form minimax lower bound on the repeated queries needed to recover the clean logits for a fixed input. Caliber normalizes noise variance by the squared median top-two logit margin and fits the resulting noise-utility relationship with a logistic curve, either per model or shared within a task. Across more than thirty model-dataset combinations, per-model calibration achieves mean absolute relative errors of 0.6-1.4%. End-to-end experiments show that surrogate performance generally tracks the configured degradation, while fixed-input averaging follows the expected variance reduction.

AI.tldr: Caliber是一种针对模型提取攻击的输出扰动防御方法，它将噪声选择形式化为校准问题，通过添加高斯噪声到内部logits来防御基于知识蒸馏的攻击。该方法建立了两个关键性质：单调一致性退化（预测一致性随噪声规模严格递减）和单输入恢复成本（推导出恢复干净logits所需重复查询的闭式极小极大下界）。在30多个模型-数据集组合中，逐模型校准实现了0.6-1.4%的平均绝对相对误差。
AI.motivation: 模型提取攻击允许攻击者通过查询目标模型并利用返回的分数进行知识蒸馏来训练替代模型，从而窃取模型能力。现有的输出扰动防御缺乏系统性的噪声选择方法，需要在防御强度（降低攻击者获得的监督信号质量）和模型自身效用（保持良性用户的预测准确性）之间进行可控的权衡。作者旨在将噪声选择转化为可校准的问题。
AI.method: Caliber向内部logits添加独立同分布的高斯噪声，并建立了两个理论性质：(1) 单调一致性退化——当干净logits有唯一最大值时，与干净预测的一致性随噪声规模严格递减，每个目标一致性值对应唯一正噪声规模；任务准确率有可计算的上下包络线。(2) 单输入恢复成本——推导出固定输入恢复干净logits所需重复查询的闭式极小极大下界。Caliber通过平方中位数top-2 logit边际归一化噪声方差，并用逻辑曲线拟合噪声-效用关系，支持逐模型或任务内共享校准。
AI.result: 在超过30个模型-数据集组合中，逐模型校准实现了0.6-1.4%的平均绝对相对误差。端到端实验表明，替代模型的性能通常与配置的退化程度一致，固定输入平均化的效果符合预期的方差缩减。
AI.conclusion: Caliber提供了一种可校准的输出扰动防御框架，使防御者能够精确控制噪声对模型提取攻击的防御强度，同时保持对良性用户的可接受效用。其理论保证（单调退化性质和恢复成本下界）以及实证校准精度使其成为模型提取防御领域的一个实用且有理论依据的方法。

title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
summary: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its grammar with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). Each system event is discretized into an 8-token representation spanning event type, process, argument skeleton, path category, parent process, user, destination, and inter-event timing. The model learns the conditional distribution of normal behavior in a purely self-supervised manner, and anomaly scores are derived from per-slot negative log-likelihood (NLL) statistics, yielding a mathematically bounded false-positive rate. We augment this prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution, second-order temporal analysis for cadence-based detection, self-learning pattern extraction, and a five-network fusion pipeline. Against an Adaptive Adversarial Agent (AAA)--a threat that learns survival strategies under defensive pressure, performs behavioral mimicry, and matches host event rates--our system achieves 93% detection at 3.84% onboarding false-positive rate. The strongest discriminative signal arises not from any single event but from the coefficient of variation of inter-event intervals: the AAA stepping cadence exhibits CV=0.310 versus 9.786 for benign sleep intervals, a 30x separation reflecting a fundamental stealth-functionality trade-off. We frame these findings within a coevolutionary economics model, arguing that behavior-grammar detection shifts the evasion cost from rule circumvention (cheap) to distribution matching (expensive), establishing a structural asymmetry favoring the defender.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Behavioral Grammar，一种将主机运行时行为视为结构化语言、用仅0.88M参数的因果Transformer（TinyGPT）学习其语法的检测架构。系统将每个系统事件离散化为8-token表示，以自监督方式学习正常行为的条件分布，通过逐槽位负对数似然推导异常分数，并集成原型学习、二阶时间分析、自学习模式提取及五网络融合。针对自适应对抗Agent（AAA），系统达到93%检测率、3.84%初始误报率，最强判别信号是事件间隔变异系数（CV=0.310 vs 9.786，30倍差异）。文章用协同进化经济学模型论证行为语法检测将规避成本从规则绕过转向分布匹配，形成利于防御方的结构性不对称。
AI.motivation: 传统端点检测面临根本性矛盾：基于签名的方案易被多态或自适应威胁绕过，而重型深度学习模型难以审计且无法大规模部署。需要一个既轻量可审计、又能应对自适应威胁的检测方案。
AI.method: 1) 将系统事件离散化为8-token表示（事件类型、进程、参数骨架、路径类别、父进程、用户、目的地、事件间时序）；2) 用0.88M参数的TinyGPT因果Transformer自监督学习正常行为条件分布；3) 基于逐槽位NLL统计得出异常分数（数学上有界误报率）；4) 集成原型学习（已知攻击归因）、二阶时间分析（节律检测）、自学习模式提取、五网络融合流水线。
AI.result: 对自适应对抗Agent（AAA）达到93%检测率、3.84%初始误报率。最强判别信号来自事件间隔变异系数：AAA步进节律CV=0.310，良性睡眠间隔CV=9.786，呈30倍分离。
AI.conclusion: 行为语法检测将对抗者的规避成本从规则绕过的低成本转向分布匹配的高成本，建立了结构性不对称，从根本上有利于防御方。检测的基础是隐身与功能之间的固有权衡。

title: Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems via Latent Flow Matching
summary: Latent Flow Models have revolutionized compressed-space image synthesis, yet their application to high-fidelity inverse problems remains bottlenecked. In this paper, we trace this dilemma to a fundamental geometric limitation of pre-trained autoencoders, which we term \emph{First-Order Manifold Blindness}. Severe decoder compression (e.g., retaining only $\sim\!2\%$ of the original degrees of freedom) produces a rank-deficient Jacobian, rendering high-frequency measurement residuals in its orthogonal complement invisible to latent gradients even when the decoder can represent the target image. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling (HDPS), a decoupled inference framework that disentangles physical measurement consistency from semantic prior modeling. HDPS diverges into the pixel space, leveraging Langevin dynamics to absorb precise orthogonal measurement gradients, and subsequently projects these structural corrections back onto the generative manifold. An optimization-based latent alignment is introduced to filter pixel-space artifacts while avoiding the semantic drift of direct encoding. Extensive experiments on diverse inverse problems demonstrate that HDPS establishes a new state-of-the-art, successfully recovering the high-frequency structural precision that latent-only solvers inherently discard. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合域后验采样（HDPS）框架，解决潜流模型在逆问题中因预训练自编码器的一阶流形盲视（First-Order Manifold Blindness）导致的高频细节丢失问题。该方法将物理测量一致性（像素空间Langevin动力学）与语义先验建模（潜空间生成流形）解耦，并通过优化对齐避免语义漂移，在多种逆问题上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 潜流模型在压缩空间图像合成中表现出色，但在高保真逆问题中的应用受限于预训练自编码器的几何局限——解码器严重压缩（仅保留约2%自由度）导致Jacobian秩亏，使得高频测量残差在正交补空间中无法被潜空间梯度感知，即使解码器本身能表示目标图像。
AI.method: 提出HDPS框架：(1) 将物理测量一致性与语义先验建模解耦；(2) 在像素空间使用Langevin动力学吸收精确的正交测量梯度；(3) 将结构修正投影回生成流形；(4) 引入基于优化的潜空间对齐来过滤像素空间伪影，避免直接编码带来的语义漂移。
AI.result: 在多种逆问题上的大量实验表明，HDPS达到新的SOTA，成功恢复潜空间-only求解器固有丢失的高频结构精度。
AI.conclusion: HDPS通过解耦像素空间测量一致性与潜空间语义建模，有效克服了预训练自编码器的一阶流形盲视瓶颈，为高保真逆问题提供了新范式。

title: The Fourth Quadrant: A Stylized View of Benign Misfitting
comment: 82 pages, 6 figures, full version of paper accepted at ITW2026
summary:
Training error is what we can observe on a training set; test error is the quantity we actually care about. We study linear regression with squared-error in a deterministic $(d+1)$-dimensional single-spike model. Each stylized training vector has the same informative spike coordinate, of amplitude $\sqrtγ$ with $γ>1$. The remaining directions are nuisance, and the nuisance components of distinct training vectors all have equal norm and are mutually orthogonal. The training labels are all $1$. Fresh test points are drawn from $\vec{x}_{\rm test} \sim \mathcal{N}(\vec{0},\operatorname{diag}(γ,1,\ldots,1))$, with the noise-free test labels being the normalized spike coordinate $x_{\rm test}[1]/\sqrtγ$. We focus on linear predictors in the span of the training vectors, the class naturally reached by zero-initialized linear gradient methods.
  We exhibit a range of training-set sizes $n$ in which every span predictor that generalizes well must fit the training data \emph{worse} than the zero predictor. We call this regime \emph{benign misfitting}, or the fourth quadrant. The best span predictor begins to generalize when $n\gg d/γ^2$, while interpolation does not generalize until the later threshold $n\gg d/γ$. In the window $d/γ^2 \ll n \ll d/γ$, useful prediction within the linear span lies beyond interpolation: predictions on the training points overshoot the labels. We show that one-pass stochastic gradient descent (SGD), with a large constant learning rate, reaches small test error throughout this window---matching the best span predictor up to a logarithmic factor. We also verify directly that it indeed has \emph{large} empirical training error (despite the descent premise in its name). Finally, we show that the unavoidable nuisance component responsible for the training misfit also controls the predictor's adversarial sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究确定性(d+1)维单峰模型下的线性回归，发现了一个被称为"良性错配"（第四象限）的新机制：在特定训练集规模范围内，所有能泛化的跨度预测器必须比零预测器拟合得更差。在该区间内，单次随机梯度下降（SGD）即使训练误差很大，仍能达到接近最优的测试误差。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为训练误差与测试误差密切相关，但该论文想要探索一种相反的情况：在某些问题设置中，良好的泛化反而要求更大的训练误差。这种"良性错配"现象挑战了过拟合与欠拟合的传统二分法，有助于更深入地理解梯度方法的泛化机制。
AI.method: 论文构建了一个确定性的(d+1)维单峰线性回归模型：训练向量共享一个幅度√γ的尖峰坐标，其余方向为干扰项且互相正交；测试标签为归一化尖峰坐标。作者分析了跨度预测器（由梯度方法自然达到的预测器类别），给出了泛化阈值（n≫d/γ²）与插值阈值（n≫d/γ）之间的窗口，并证明在这个窗口内，具有大常数学习率的单次SGD能够匹配最优跨度预测器（对数因子以内），同时具有大训练误差。
AI.result: 1. 发现了"良性错配"区间：d/γ² ≪ n ≪ d/γ，在此区间内最佳跨度预测器的训练预测超过标签（过大预测）；2. 证明了单次SGD（大常数学习率）在该窗口内达到接近最优的测试误差，尽管其训练误差很大；3. 训练错配所需的不可避免的干扰项同时控制着预测器的对抗敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了"良性错配"现象：在特定问题设置下，训练误差大反而是泛化的必要条件而非障碍。这一发现扩展了人们对偏差-方差权衡的理解，表明在某些数据结构中，过度拟合训练数据（插值）反而会损害泛化，而SGD的隐式正则化效应使其能够利用这一窗口获得良好性能。同时，这也暗示了泛化能力与对抗鲁棒性之间的内在联系。

title: MedUPS: Towards Diagnostic Assistance in Uncommon Medical Cases with Large Language Models
summary: Uncommon and off-guideline cases are difficult for clinical decision support, because physicians must make a series of management decisions under diagnostic uncertainty and rarely see the full case at once. Most large language model (LLM) benchmarks for medicine score only the final diagnosis, yet much of clinical care turns on the next appropriate action: the next test to order, the imaging study to obtain, the specialist to involve, or the differential to pursue. We introduce MedUPSQA, a dataset of 21,874 mid-stream clinical decision points built from 5,535 real case reports, and MedUPS, an alignment framework that supervises models on these intermediate decisions as they unfold along a patient's trajectory. We segment free-text case presentations into chronologically ordered, accumulating clinical chunks and align models to predict the next step with reinforcement learning (GRPO), using an external LLM-as-a-Judge reward. This objective mirrors how clinicians actually meet patients, reasoning forward from accumulating evidence toward the next decision, rather than committing to a final label. Across three backbones, mid-stream alignment raises next-step accuracy from 55.2 to 66.7 for Qwen3.6-27B, from 47.2 to 57.8 for Qwen3.5-9B, and from 37.8 to 44.4 for HuatuoGPT-3-8B, with 95% CI. In several model scales we test the objective improves accuracy more than scale, with smaller models surpassing larger, frontier models we evaluate. We further train supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on the mid-stream task, SFT improves all backbones above base, indicating the target framwork carries signal independently of the optimizer. We release the dataset, code, and aligned checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedUPSQA数据集（21,874个中途临床决策点，基于5,535个真实病例报告）和MedUPS对齐框架，通过GRPO强化学习在患者病程的时间序列上监督模型的下一步决策预测。实验显示该方法在三种骨干模型上将下一步决策准确率提升10个百分点以上，且小模型超越大规模前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 现有医学LLM基准仅评估最终诊断，但真实临床决策的关键在于每次行动的选择（下一步检查、影像、专科会诊等）。罕见和非指南病例需要在诊断不确定下做系列管理决策，现有方法无法捕捉这种渐进式推理过程。
AI.method: 1) 将自由文本病例按时间顺序切分为累积的临床片段（chunks）；2) 构建MedUPSQA数据集包含21,874个中途决策点；3) 使用GRPO强化学习对齐模型预测下一步行动，以外部LLM-as-a-Judge作为奖励；4) 同时训练SFT基线对比验证框架有效性。
AI.result: 三种骨干模型上中途对齐提升显著：Qwen3.6-27B从55.2→66.7，Qwen3.5-9B从47.2→57.8，HuatuoGPT-3-8B从37.8→44.4（95% CI）。小模型在多个规模下超越更大规模的前沿模型，SFT基线也一致提升，证明目标任务本身携带独立信号。
AI.conclusion: 中途临床决策对齐比传统最终诊断评分更能反映真实临床实践，强化学习目标带来的收益在部分规模上超过模型扩展带来的收益。作者将数据集、代码和对齐权重开源发布。

title: FinDeepIndicator: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in End-to-End Financial Indicator Construction
summary: Financial indicators are essential tools for transforming raw financial data into interpretable measures for various downstream tasks, such as valuation, risk assessment, and economic analysis. However, existing financial benchmarks largely focus on answer-level accuracy and often assume that relevant data are already provided, leaving the assessment of the intermediate process of indicator construction underexplored. In this work, we propose FinDeepIndicator, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating Deep Research (DR) agents in end-to-end financial indicator construction. Specifically, FinDeepIndicator evaluates DR agents across four stages in indicator construction: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation, and covers fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic indicators organized into 21 fine-grained sub-categories. It contains 3,350 curated question-answer (QA) pairs derived from both U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical financial data, and 800 listed companies. Extensive experiments on search-equipped Large Language Models (LLMs) and DR agents show that, while LLMs generally perform well in formula specification, their accuracy drops substantially during data retrieval and numerical execution. DR agents consistently outperform search-equipped LLMs, yet remain unreliable in realistic financial analysis settings. These findings provide insights for developing more capable and trustworthy DR agents in finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinDeepIndicator，这是首个专门用于评估深度研究（DR）智能体在端到端金融指标构建过程中表现的基准。该基准覆盖公式规范、数据收集、指标计算和答案生成四个阶段，包含3,350个QA对、10年历史金融数据和800家上市公司数据，并发现当前LLM和DR智能体在数据检索与数值执行环节仍存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准大多只关注答案层面的准确性，并假设相关数据已经预先提供，忽略了对指标构建中间过程的评估。这种评估缺口导致无法全面衡量模型在真实金融分析场景中的能力。
AI.method: 提出FinDeepIndicator基准，涵盖四个评估阶段（公式规范、数据收集、指标计算、答案生成），覆盖基本面、技术面和宏观经济三类指标共21个细分类别。数据来源于美国和中国市场，包含3,350个QA对、10年历史数据和800家上市公司。对搜索增强LLM和DR智能体进行了系统实验评估。
AI.result: 实验表明：LLM在公式规范阶段表现良好，但在数据检索和数值执行阶段准确率大幅下降；DR智能体整体优于搜索增强LLM，但在真实金融分析场景中仍不够可靠。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在金融指标构建的中间环节仍存在明显短板，需要开发更强大和可信的金融DR智能体。该基准为金融领域深度研究智能体的改进提供了有价值的评估框架和基准数据。

title: DiffuseAgent-MI: Distributionally-Grounded,Tool-Integrated Self-Evolving Agents for Faithful Visual Reasoning
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ICML 2026 manitrack
summary: Tool-integrated vision-language agents have made remarkable progress on compositional and multi-step visual reasoning. Yet their outputs frequently exhibit unfaithfulness: the stated reasoning path diverges from the computation that actually produced the answer, undermining reliability in safety-critical applications. We present DiffuseAgent-MI, a self-evolving agent whose perceptual grounding is governed by a KL-minimal energy model over feature units, providing a distributional view of visual mechanistic interpretability. The agent learns an energy landscape that softly constrains generated samples to lie near the native prior conditioned on the chosen interpretable unit, closing the gap between the explanation and the internal representation. A verifier then supplies trajectory-level faithfulness rewards, and a repair branch re-conditions the energy when the verifier flags an unfaithful step. On GeoQA, SciVis, VQA-v2 and an in-house multimodal reasoning set, DiffuseAgent-MI improves accuracy by up to 5.1 points over prior self-evolving agents while more than doubling mutual-information faithfulness and human-interpretability agreement. Our analysis shows the energy term and the verifier are complementary: the former guarantees distributional faithfulness, the latter trajectory-level faithfulness, and only their combination closes both gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffuseAgent-MI，一个自进化视觉语言智能体，通过KL最小能量模型约束感知基础，结合验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励和修复分支，在多个基准上提升准确率高达5.1点，并将互信息忠实度和人类可解释性一致性提高一倍以上。
AI.motivation: 工具集成的视觉语言智能体在组合和多步视觉推理上取得显著进展，但其输出常存在不忠实问题：表述的推理路径与实际产生答案的计算过程不一致，这削弱了在安全关键应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: DiffuseAgent-MI是一个自进化智能体：(1)通过KL最小能量模型对特征单元进行感知基础调节，提供视觉机械可解释性的分布视角；(2)学习能量景观，软性约束生成样本接近条件于选定可解释单元的本地先验，弥合解释与内部表示之间的差距；(3)验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励；(4)当验证器标记不忠实步骤时，修复分支重新调节能量。
AI.result: 在GeoQA、SciVis、VQA-v2及自建多模态推理集上，DiffuseAgent-MI相比先前自进化智能体准确率提升最多5.1点，互信息忠实度和人类可解释性一致性提高一倍以上。分析表明能量项保证分布级忠实度，验证器保证轨迹级忠实度，两者互补且需组合才能同时弥合两种差距。
AI.conclusion: 能量的分布级忠实度约束与验证器的轨迹级忠实度监督具有互补性，只有两者的结合才能同时弥合分布级和轨迹级的忠实度差距，从而提升视觉语言智能体在复杂推理任务中的可靠性和可解释性。

title: Characterizing Bias in Post-Bandit Inference under Index Algorithms
summary: Bandit algorithms generate data for downstream inference, but adaptive sampling biases post-bandit sample means. We analyze this bias for stable index algorithms, including UCB1 and its generalizations, and derive sharp leading-order expressions for the sample-mean bias and expected $Z$-statistic. Our characterization reveals the algorithmic origin of bias through a key index-function-dependent quantity, which we term effective exploration rate. For example, under UCB1, the effective exploration rate is of order $\sqrt{\log T}$, and the standardized bias of any arm (that is not uniquely optimal) decays at the extremely slow rate $1/\sqrt{\log T}$. We also show how the choice of the index function affects both regret and bias, which reveals a regret-bias trade-off: more exploratory algorithm reduces bias but increases regret. Our sharp characterization for bias uses a novel empirical fluid approximation of the algorithm's sampling dynamics, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了稳定索引bandit算法（如UCB1及其推广）在自适应采样下对样本均值估计造成的偏差，推导出样本均值偏差和期望Z统计量的精确前沿阶表达式，提出了"有效探索率"这一关键概念来解释偏差的算法根源，并揭示了遗憾与偏差之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: Bandit算法在实践中不仅用于在线决策，其生成的数据也常被用于下游统计推断（如估计各臂的均值）。然而，自适应采样会使样本均值产生系统性偏差，破坏传统统计推断的有效性。现有文献对这一偏差缺乏精确的理论刻画，尤其是对于稳定索引类算法（如UCB1）的偏差阶数、机制和与算法参数的关系尚不清楚，这限制了研究者理解和控制此类偏差。
AI.method: 作者针对稳定索引算法（包括UCB1及其推广）推导了样本均值偏差和期望Z统计量的精确前沿阶（sharp leading-order）表达式。核心创新是提出并识别出一个由索引函数决定的关键量——"有效探索率"（effective exploration rate），用以刻画偏差的算法起源。此外，作者提出了一种新颖的经验流体近似（empirical fluid approximation）方法来描述算法的采样动力学，这是获得精确偏差刻画的关键技术工具。
AI.result: 以UCB1为例，其有效探索率的阶数为√log T，任何非唯一最优臂的标准化偏差以极慢的速率1/√log T衰减。研究还表明索引函数的选择同时影响遗憾和偏差，揭示了遗憾-偏差权衡：更具探索性的算法能降低偏差但会增加遗憾。精确的偏差刻画依赖于新型经验流体近似方法，该方法本身具有独立的研究价值。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次为稳定索引bandit算法提供了样本均值偏差的精确前沿阶刻画，阐明了偏差的算法来源（有效探索率）以及遗憾-偏差之间的内在权衡。这些发现对使用bandit数据进行统计推断的实践者有重要指导意义，同时也为设计兼顾统计性质和决策质量的算法提供了理论基础。经验流体近似方法为后续研究开辟了新方向。

title: Cloud-ScPO: Hidden-State Geometry for Semi-Supervised Preference Optimization in LLM Reasoning
summary: Preference optimization improves mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but reliable chosen-rejected pairs usually require verified answers, human annotations, or external reward models. We investigate whether preference supervision can instead be derived from the model's internal representation geometry in a semi-supervised setting. Our analysis shows that reasoning trajectories generated across different mathematical problems form structured global point clouds in which correct and incorrect trajectories exhibit different geometric organization. Based on this observation, we propose Cloud--ScPO, a topology-guided preference-mining framework that uses a small labeled set to construct multiple correct and incorrect reference Clouds. Each trajectory is represented by a mean-pooled hidden state and scored against connectivity-induced components using a component-level soft $k$-nearest-neighbor measure averaged across reference banks.
