We combine this cross-problem Cloud signal with prompt-level self-consistency: self-consistency determines the answer-level preference direction, while Cloud scoring selects concrete trajectories and filters pairs by their score margin. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH-Numeric across four model settings show that Cloud--ScPO consistently improves over ScPO, with gains of up to 4.49\% on GSM8K and 4.19\% on MATH-Numeric. Pair-level analyses further show that Cloud--ScPO maintains comparable correctness reliability while more effectively separating informative chosen trajectories from incomplete, repetitive, or otherwise low-quality rejected responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cloud–ScPO框架，利用模型内部表示的几何结构（拓扑引导的参考簇）在无需外部奖励模型的前提下从半监督设置中挖掘偏好对，用于提升LLM的数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的偏好优化方法依赖可靠的chosen-rejected对，这些对通常需要验证答案、人工标注或外部奖励模型，成本高昂。作者希望利用模型自身内部表示的几何结构，在半监督设置下直接挖掘偏好监督信号，从而减少对外部标注的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 观察到不同数学问题生成的推理轨迹形成结构化的全局点云，正确与错误轨迹在几何组织上存在差异。2) 提出Cloud–ScPO框架：用少量标注集构建多个正确/错误参考簇（Clouds）；每条轨迹用均值池化的隐状态表示，并通过基于连通分量的软k近邻度量在多个参考库上打分。3) 将跨问题的Cloud信号与提示级别的自一致性结合：自一致性决定答案级别的偏好方向，Cloud评分选择具体轨迹并按分数差过滤偏好对。
AI.result: 在GSM8K和MATH-Numeric上、四种模型设置下的实验表明，Cloud–ScPO持续优于ScPO，在GSM8K上提升最高达4.49%，在MATH-Numeric上达4.19%。成对分析显示，Cloud–ScPO在保持相当的正确答案可靠性同时，能更有效地区分信息丰富的chosen轨迹与不完整、重复或低质量的rejected响应。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部表示的几何结构可以作为一种无需外部监督的有效偏好信号来源，拓扑引导的参考簇与自一致性结合能显著提升偏好优化的效果，为半监督数学推理优化提供了新方向。

title: Measurement Without Validity: The Compounding Reliability Problem in Agentic AI Evaluation
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to a peer-reviewed journal
summary:
Agentic AI systems are evaluated using automated benchmarks whose scores justify deployment decisions, safety certifications, and regulatory compliance claims. We present an empirical analysis demonstrating that these scores are systematically less trustworthy than current practice acknowledges.
  The problem operates at three compounding layers. First, tasks are increasingly generated by language models: audits of ten popular benchmarks found validity flaws in seven and reporting gaps in all ten. Second, human users are replaced by LLM simulators, but calibration studies document inter-simulator variance up to 9 percentage points and systematic directional miscalibration, particularly for non-Standard American English speakers. Third, our structured survey of 55 papers finds that approximately 82% apply structurally mismatched, incomplete, or absent inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics.
  These failures compound multiplicatively rather than additively. Under independence, a pipeline retaining 70% of valid signal at task generation, 80% at simulation, and 65% at judgment is at most 36% valid against the intended construct; the bound spans 0.22--0.54 across the empirical estimate range. We formalize this as $V_{\text{total}} \leq V_1 \times V_2 \times V_3$ and show it tightens further under correlated failures when the same model family operates across all three layers.
  We derive eight prescriptions grounded in psychometric science: a simulation calibration floor of $\text{ICC}(A,1) \geq 0.70$; domain-stratified reliability thresholds ($α\geq 0.67$ / $0.70$ / $0.80$ by consequence level); structured IRR metric selection rules based on pipeline design; and IRR as a mandatory reporting field. The measurement tools exist; the field's task is to apply them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析揭示Agentic AI系统在自动化基准评估中的分数系统性不可信问题。问题存在于三个叠加层面：LLM生成任务存在有效性缺陷（10个基准中7个有缺陷）、LLM模拟人类用户存在校准偏差（模拟器间方差高达9个百分点）、以及约82%的论文使用结构不匹配/不完整/缺失的评分者间信度（IRR）指标。这些失败以乘法方式复合，即使在中等信号保留率下总体有效性上限也仅约36%。作者提出八项基于心理测量学的改进处方，包括模拟校准下限、领域分层信度阈值和IRR作为强制报告字段。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI系统通过自动化基准评估来支撑部署决策、安全认证和法规合规主张，但这些评估分数实际上比当前实践认知的更不可信。作者旨在揭示评估流程中各层级的系统性问题，并证明这些问题的复合效应远超单独发生的影响。
AI.method: 本文采用三层实证分析方法：(1) 审计10个流行基准的效度缺陷和报告空白；(2) 审查LLM模拟器校准研究，量化模拟器间方差和方向性校准偏差；(3) 结构化调查55篇论文，评估IRR指标的使用是否匹配。同时形式化有效性复合模型V_total ≤ V1 × V2 × V3，并分析独立与相关失败情形下的有效性边界。
AI.result: 审计发现10个基准中7个存在效度缺陷，全部10个存在报告空白；模拟器间方差高达9个百分点，且对非标准美国英语使用者存在系统性方向性校准偏差；约82%的论文IRR指标使用不当。在独立失败假设下，各层保留70%/80%/65%信号时总体有效性上限仅36%，复合边界范围为0.22-0.54，且在多层使用同一模型家族时相关失败会使边界进一步收紧。
AI.conclusion: Agentic AI评估的有效性受三层失败叠加的乘法性侵蚀，当前评估分数的可信度被系统性高估。作者提出八项基于心理测量学的可操作处方（ICC(A,1)≥0.70校准下限、按后果分层的可靠性阈值α≥0.67/0.70/0.80、结构化的IRR指标选择规则、IRR作为强制报告字段等），认为测量工具已经存在，关键在于领域需要实际应用这些标准。

title: Zero-Cost Virtual RNA: Approximating Immunotherapy Signatures via Cross-Modal WSI Retrieval
comment: Accepted to MIDL 2026 Short Paper track
summary: Identifying the ``Inflamed'' immunophenotype in Gastric Adenocarcinoma predicts immunotherapy response but requires an expensive 10-gene RNA signature. While deep learning on standard H\&E slides offers a scalable alternative, conventional binary classifiers oversimplify continuous RNA data and introduce label noise. To resolve this, we propose VITA (VIrtual Transcriptomic Approximation). By aligning H\&E and RNA into a joint latent space during training, VITA requires only standard H\&E at inference to retrieve morphologically similar historical cases and approximate the continuous RNA signature. Achieving 0.72 classification accuracy and a 0.66 Spearman correlation, VITA provides a cost-effective ``virtual transcriptomics'' pre-screening tool that preserves the continuous phenotypic spectrum without requiring genomic sequencing.

AI.tldr: VITA是一种虚拟转录组近似方法，通过将H&E切片与RNA表达数据在联合潜在空间中对齐，仅使用标准H&E染色切片即可在推理时检索形态相似的历史病例并近似连续RNA表达特征，以预测胃癌的"炎症"免疫表型，实现了0.72的分类准确率和0.66的Spearman相关性，为免疫治疗响应预测提供了无需基因组测序的经济高效预筛查工具。
AI.motivation: 识别胃癌中的"炎症"免疫表型对于预测免疫治疗响应至关重要，但传统方法需要昂贵的10基因RNA表达签名检测。虽然基于H&E切片的深度学习提供了可扩展的替代方案，但传统的二元分类器会过度简化连续的RNA数据并引入标签噪声。
AI.method: VITA通过联合训练将H&E组织学图像与RNA表达数据对齐到共享的潜在空间中。在推理阶段，仅需标准H&E切片即可检索形态学相似的历史病例，并基于这些相似病例近似出连续的RNA表达签名，从而保留完整的表型谱信息。
AI.result: VITA在胃癌数据集上实现了0.72的分类准确率和0.66的Spearman相关系数。
AI.conclusion: VITA提供了一种经济高效的"虚拟转录组学"预筛查工具，无需基因组测序即可保留连续的免疫表型谱，有望在临床中作为免疫治疗响应预测的低成本预筛查手段。

title: Logit-Origin Centering for Singleton Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Tabular data is used extensively in many real-world use cases. Deep learning models have been developed to deal with tabular data, but generally perform poorly when the test data distribution differs from that of the training data. Researchers have proposed test-time adaptation approaches to deal with this problem. The fully test-time adaptation (FTTA) setting involves adapting deployed classifiers to shifted target distributions using only unlabeled test data. Leading FTTA methods inherit a batch-dependent approach from computer vision literature. This paper demonstrates for the first time that such approaches degrade sharply in strict streaming regimes where examples arrive and must be classified one at a time. This occurs because at a batch size of one, batch-level statistics become unavailable or poorly estimated. We argue that singleton tabular FTTA is not merely a small-batch variant of ordinary FTTA, but a distinct identifiability problem where only the location of the model's score stream remains directly observable. To address this, we propose Prequential Logit-Origin Centering (PLOC), a lightweight approach that keeps the source model frozen and shifts the logit space at each step. PLOC stores only a single running number (the mean of past logits), requires no labels, estimates no priors, and bypasses weight updates entirely. A deferred variant applies a static shift that preserves the source ranking, and thus the AUROC, exactly. Evaluated across five tabular benchmarks, three architectures (MLP, FT-Transformer, and TabTransformer), and five independent source checkpoints, PLOC significantly outperforms strong tabular and entropy-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文首次发现全测试时适应（FTTA）方法在严格流式表格数据场景（每次只处理一个样本）下性能严重下降，原因是批大小为1时批统计量不可用或估计不准确。作者提出了一种轻量级方法Prequential Logit-Origin Centering (PLOC)，通过冻结源模型并在每步平移logit空间来应对这一挑战，仅需存储一个运行均值，无需标签、无需估计先验、无需更新权重。在五个表格基准、三种架构和五个独立源检查点上，PLOC显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 表格数据在实际应用中广泛使用，但深度学习模型在测试分布偏移时表现不佳。现有的FTTA方法继承自计算机视觉领域，依赖批处理方式，在严格流式场景（样本逐个到达）下会失效。作者认为单样本表格FTTA不仅是小批量变体，而是一个独特的可识别性问题，需要专门的方法。
AI.method: PLOC方法的核心思想是：保持源模型权重不变，在每一步对logit空间进行移位。具体地，只存储一个运行数值（过去logit的平均值），每步根据该均值对logit进行中心化处理。还提出了一个延迟变体，采用静态移位以保留源排序，从而精确保持AUROC指标。
AI.result: 在五个表格基准数据集、三种架构（MLP、FT-Transformer、TabTransformer）和五个独立源检查点上，PLOC显著优于强表格基线和基于熵的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 单样本表格FTTA是一个独特的可识别性问题，PLOC通过极轻量级的logit移位方法有效解决了这一问题，无需权重更新或复杂的估计过程，仅需存储一个运行均值即可实现优异性能。

title: Why LLMs Give In: Conversational Factors and Reasoning Behind Medical Sycophancy
summary: A language model that abandons a correct medical answer under user pushback is more dangerous than one that was simply wrong, because it lends the credibility of a correct answer to the user's misinformation. Such model behavior, described as medical sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, but we find it is a property of the conversation, not the model. We study medical sycophancy in language models with a fully crossed factorial design over four conversational factors, user role, the evidence behind a false claim, whether the challenge precedes or follows the model's answer, and whether the correct answer is grounded in the prompt, across five open-weight models and 500 MedQuAD questions (1.2M trials). The factors interact sharply: fabricated sources raise sycophancy 2.0x when they accompany the question but halve it once the model has answered, so the same evidence helps or hurts depending only on timing. Sycophancy varies far more across questions than across models (67x vs. 3x), so a single rate reflects the conversation and the questions sampled as much as the model. Chain-of-thought traces explain why. Models that re-examine their own prior answer concede, while those that reason about the medical facts hold, and only a model that has already answered can spend a round auditing the fabricated source.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全因子实验设计研究医学语言模型中的"医学谄媚"现象，发现它是对话属性而非模型固有属性。跨四个对话因素和五个模型、120万次试验，结果表明用户角色、虚假主张证据、挑战时机和答案依据等因素存在强烈交互作用，且问题间的变异性远大于模型间的变异性（67倍vs 3倍）。思维链分析揭示了模型如何通过重新审视自己的答案而让步，或通过推理医学事实而坚持。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在用户施压下放弃正确医学答案比直接答错更危险，因为这会为用户的错误信息增添可信度。以往研究仅将医学谄媚报告为单一路率，忽略了其对话依赖的本质，本研究旨在揭示这种谄媚行为实际上由对话因素而非模型本身决定。
AI.method: 采用全因子设计，操控四个对话因素：用户角色、虚假主张背后的证据、挑战发生在模型回答之前还是之后、正确答案是否基于提示内容。跨越五个开放权重模型和500个MedQuAD医学问题，共进行120万次试验，并结合思维链追踪分析模型推理过程。
AI.result: 发现因素间存在强烈交互：虚构来源在伴随问题时使谄媚率提高2倍，但在模型回答后则使其减半，同一证据因时间点不同反而产生相反效果。谄媚率在问题间的差异（67倍）远大于模型间的差异（3倍），表明单一数值无法反映真实情况。思维链分析揭示模型重新审视自身答案时让步，而推理医学事实时坚持，只有已回答的模型才会花时间审计虚构来源。
AI.conclusion: 医学谄媚是对话属性而非模型固有属性，评估时不能仅报告单一路率。理解对话中各因素间的交互作用对提升医疗AI的安全性和可靠性至关重要，模型可以学会在推回时坚持正确的医学答案。

title: AgentSLABench: Evaluating and Benchmarking Agentic Systems Under Resource Constraints
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code, sealed test sets, and profiling artifacts available at: https://github.com/MeherBhaskar/agentslabench
summary: We present AgentSLABench, a resource-aware evaluation framework for autonomous AI agents that measures correctness alongside latency, cost, compute, memory, and network usage under declared resource budgets. Unlike standard benchmarks that report only accuracy, AgentSLABench produces a multi-dimensional profile per agent per task - the same way systems profilers (perf, pprof, cProfile) measure resource consumption of code, but extended with task correctness as a first-class dimension. AgentSLABench provides 16 task environments across 6 categories (5 core: multi-hop QA, retail substitution, code generation, web shopping, travel planning; 11 extended) with isolated Docker containers, declared CPU/memory/time/network budgets, sealed test sets with SHA256 hashes, and a standardized profiling protocol. We profile 5 general-purpose baseline agents (ReAct, PlanAndSolve, Reflexion, CoT, Random) plus 4 task-specialized agents, finding that specialized agents achieve 100% success on 3/5 core tasks (fact_qa, web_shopping, travel_planning) and 66.7-83.3% on retail and code_gen, while general baselines fail entirely on 4/5 domain tasks. Crucially, we report the Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate (EASR) - success weighted by resource consumption relative to declared budgets - revealing that high accuracy at unbounded cost is not production-viable. We release the full infrastructure, sealed test sets, and profiling results to enable reproducible, resource-aware agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: AgentSLABench 是一个面向自主 AI Agent 的资源感知评估框架，不仅衡量任务正确性，还同时测量延迟、成本、计算、内存和网络使用情况，并在声明的资源预算下进行评估。该框架包含 16 个任务环境（5 核心 + 11 扩展）、Docker 隔离容器、带哈希封印的测试集和标准化性能分析协议。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅报告准确率，忽略了 AI Agent 在实际生产环境中运行时的资源消耗（延迟、成本、计算、内存、网络）。高准确率但资源消耗无界的 Agent 在生产环境中不可行，因此需要一个像系统性能分析器（如 perf、pprof）一样，将正确性与资源使用同时作为一维进行多维度评估的框架。
AI.method: AgentSLABench 提供 16 个任务环境（6 大类：多跳问答、零售替换、代码生成、网页购物、旅行规划等），每个 Agent 在每个任务上生成多维性能画像。框架特点包括：隔离的 Docker 容器、声明的 CPU/内存/时间/网络预算、使用 SHA256 哈希封印的测试集、标准化性能分析协议。此外提出 Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate (EASR) 指标，将成功率按资源消耗相对于声明预算的比率加权。
AI.result: 对 5 个通用基线 Agent（ReAct、PlanAndSolve、Reflexion、CoT、Random）和 4 个任务专用 Agent 进行性能分析。专用 Agent 在 5 个核心任务中的 3 个（fact_qa、web_shopping、travel_planning）达到 100% 成功率，在零售和代码生成任务上达到 66.7-83.3%；而通用基线在 4/5 领域任务上完全失败。EASR 指标揭示了高准确率但资源消耗无界的方案在生产中不可行。
AI.conclusion: AgentSLABench 提供了首个资源感知的 Agent 评估框架，将系统性能分析的思路引入 AI Agent 基准测试。框架、封印测试集和性能分析结果全部开源，以实现可复现、资源感知的 Agent 评估。核心洞见是：仅追求准确率而不考虑资源约束的 Agent 不适合生产环境部署。

title: DrawAI: Agentic Benchmark and Workflow for Making Raster Images Editable
summary: Recent image-generation models and multimodal agents can produce high-quality visuals for increasingly complex visual communication tasks. Yet their raster outputs remain difficult to use directly because meaningful content and relationships are flattened into pixels, preventing users from inspecting, modifying, rearranging, or reusing individual components. We formulate image-to-editable reconstruction, which recovers a structured, directly manipulable artifact from a raster image while preserving its visual and semantic content. The central challenge is to jointly satisfy Fidelity and Editability, which often trade off in practice. To study this task, we introduce DrawAI, comprising an agentic benchmark, DrawAI-Bench, and a reconstruction workflow, DrawAI-Flow. DrawAI-Bench spans scientific figures, presentation slides, posters, and diagrams, combining real and AI-generated images to reflect practical visual-creation scenarios. It evaluates Fidelity and Editability through a hybrid protocol of 39 criteria: deterministic rule-based metrics measure properties with direct correspondences, while asset-specific vision-language rubrics capture semantic and perceptual qualities for which exact matching is misleading. Besides, we propose DrawAI-Flow, a two-stage agentic workflow in which a Parser Agent turns extracted elements evidence into an explicit reconstruction plan, and a Reconstruction Agent realizes the plan as executable graphics code through an iterative code-render-validate-revise loop. On DrawAI-Bench, we systematically evaluate thirteen models across five agent harnesses to study the effects of model capability, harness choice, and workflow design. The results show that reconstruction quality and costs vary substantially across model-harness configurations, while DrawAI-Flow consistently improves editable structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图像到可编辑重建任务，并引入DrawAI框架，包含基准测试DrawAI-Bench和重建工作流DrawAI-Flow，通过39条混合标准评估保真度与可编辑性，系统评估13个模型在5种代理框架上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像生成模型和多媒体代理能生成高质量的复杂视觉内容，但其栅格输出难以直接使用——有意义的语义内容和关系被扁平化为像素，用户无法对单个组件进行检查、修改、重排或复用。因此需要一种能从栅格图像恢复结构化、可直接操作工件的方法。
AI.method: 提出DrawAI框架：(1) DrawAI-Bench基准测试，涵盖科学图表、演示幻灯片、海报和示意图，评估39项标准（基于规则的确定性指标与基于视觉语言模型的资产特定评分相结合）；(2) DrawAI-Flow两阶段代理工作流，包含Parser Agent（将元素证据转化为显式重建计划）和Reconstruction Agent（通过迭代代码-渲染-验证-修正循环执行计划生成可执行图形代码）。系统评估了13个模型在5种代理框架上的表现。
AI.result: 重建质量和成本在不同模型-代理框架配置间差异显著，DrawAI-Flow在各类配置下均能一致地提升可编辑结构质量。
AI.conclusion: 图像到可编辑重建是一个重要且具有挑战性的任务，保真度和可编辑性在实践中往往相互权衡。两阶段代理工作流方法（明确规划+迭代代码生成）是提升可编辑性的有效途径，为视觉内容的后编辑和复用提供了结构化解决方案。

title: Breaking Diversity Collapse in Spiking Pseudo-Ensembles for Efficient OOD Detection in Remote Sensing
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are attractive for resource-constrained remote-sensing systems, but reliable out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging. Deep ensembles provide strong predictive uncertainty, yet require multiple complete models and backbone evaluations. We propose an efficient spiking pseudo-ensemble that attaches multiple lightweight classification heads to a frozen SNN backbone. Naively training these heads with cross-entropy can lead to diversity collapse, where independently parameterized heads may produce correlated predictions. To address this, we introduce an agree--disagree objective that preserves correct predictions on clean in-distribution samples while encouraging diversity on structured, uncertainty-inducing transformations of the same inputs. This provides a diversity-promoting training signal without requiring external OOD data. Experiments with Spikformer and ResNet19-SNN on EuroSAT demonstrate consistent improvements over conventionally trained pseudo-ensembles. Using three backbones with five heads each matches or improves upon a five-model deep ensemble on UCM and AID, while requiring approximately 38% fewer parameters and 40% fewer backbone evaluations. These results show that explicit diversity promotion can recover useful ensemble-style uncertainty at substantially lower deployment cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效的尖峰伪集成方法，通过在一个冻结的SNN骨干网络上附加多个轻量级分类头，并引入"同意-分歧"（agree-disagree）训练目标来促进预测多样性，从而在不增加外部OOD数据的情况下实现可靠的分布外检测，性能接近甚至超越深度集成，同时显著降低参数和计算开销。
AI.motivation: SNN因低资源消耗适合遥感等资源受限系统，但可靠的分布外检测仍然困难。深度集成能提供强预测不确定性但需要多个完整模型和骨干网络多次推理，部署成本高，不符合SNN资源受限的应用场景。
AI.method: 提出尖峰伪集成方法：1) 在冻结的SNN骨干上附加多个轻量级分类头；2) 针对传统交叉熵训练导致的多样性坍缩问题，设计"同意-分歧"目标函数，在干净分布内样本上保持正确预测，同时鼓励对结构化、不确定性诱导的输入变换产生多样性预测；3) 无需外部OOD数据即可提供促进多样性的训练信号。
AI.result: 在Spikformer和ResNet19-SNN上的EuroSAT实验中显示比传统训练的伪集成一致改进。使用三个骨干网络各配五个分类头，在UCM和AID上匹配或超越五模型深度集成，同时参数减少约38%，骨干网络评估次数减少约40%。
AI.conclusion: 显式促进多样性可以在大幅降低部署成本的情况下获得类集成式的有效不确定性估计，验证了多样性促进策略对于高效SNN分布外检测的价值。

title: Opt.Gear Technical Report
summary: We introduce Opt.Gear, a foundation model designed for efficient on-device deployment, real-tim inference, and strong task capability. It includes a dense model (1M, 270M, and 1B) with a context length of 64K. We designed a new hybrid architecture that combines a convolutional key-value gated mixer with local-global attention to reduce the KV-cache memory that tends to increase exponentially with long context. This architecture delivers up to X4.9 faster prefill and decoding speeds on the NPUs compared to models of a similar scale models. From a 2T tokens candidate corpus, Opt.Gear is trained on a curated 0.5T tokens subset without knowledge distillation. This is the most data-efficient of the existing foundation models. All models are released with open weights and deployment binaries for ONNX, Qualcomm NPU, and Apple ANE making Opt.Gear a practical base for edge applications that need fast, memory-efficient inference and strong task capabilities. Furthermore, to expand the ecosystem of on-device generative language models, we are introducing the Opt.Gear-1M that can be deployed on Micro-Controller Units (MCUs), a Tiny Language Model (TLM). Opt.Gear-1M is the first generative language model to achieve 20 TPS with W4A32 quantization on the ARM Cortex-M7 CPU of the STM32H747I-DISCO.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Opt.Gear，一个面向端侧设备部署的基础模型系列，包含1M、270M和1B三种规模的稠密模型，上下文长度达64K。该模型采用卷积键值门控混合器与局部-全局注意力相结合的新混合架构来降低KV缓存，在NPU上实现最高4.9倍的前缀填充和解码加速。模型仅用0.5T token子集训练（从2T候选语料中精选），无需知识蒸馏，实现现有基础模型中最高的数据效率。
AI.motivation: 端侧部署的生成式语言模型面临两大核心挑战：一是长上下文场景下KV缓存内存随序列长度指数增长，严重制约部署可行性；二是现有模型在资源受限设备（如MCU、NPU）上推理速度不足。作者旨在设计一个兼具实时推理速度、内存效率和强任务能力的基础模型，同时解决数据效率问题。
AI.method: 1) 设计新型混合架构：结合卷积键值门控混合器（convolutional key-value gated mixer）与局部-全局注意力（local-global attention），有效降低KV缓存内存开销；2) 数据策略：从2T token候选语料中精选0.5T token子集进行训练，无需知识蒸馏，实现高数据效率；3) 多尺度发布：提供1M、270M、1B三种规模的稠密模型；4) 全链路部署支持：开放权重并提供ONNX、Qualcomm NPU、Apple ANE的部署二进制文件。
AI.result: 1) 在NPU上相比同规模模型实现最高4.9倍的前缀填充和解码速度提升；2) 实现现有基础模型中最高的数据效率（0.5T token训练）；3) Opt.Gear-1M成为首个在ARM Cortex-M7 CPU（STM32H747I-DISCO）上通过W4A32量化达到20 TPS的生成式语言模型。
AI.conclusion: Opt.Gear通过创新的混合架构和高效数据策略，为端侧（从MCU到NPU）提供了一套快速、内存高效且任务能力强的生成式语言模型解决方案。开放权重和多种硬件部署支持使其成为边缘应用的实用基础模型，推动了端侧生成式语言模型生态的扩展。

title: Large language models improve physician accuracy but lead to false reliance
summary: Retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) promise source-linked clinical support, but their value depends on whether displayed evidence guides rather than distorts physician reliance. We developed CORA, an agentic retrieval-augmented LLM, to investigate how source-linked assistance affects physician decision-making. CORA maintained benchmark performance and achieved larger gains on cases published after the models' training-data cutoffs. In a study of 46 physicians, accuracy increased from 70.8% unaided to 82.6% with CORA. Supporting citations predicted correct answers (87.7% vs 65.5%), but citations created an important asymmetry: perceived support increased adoption of correct advice from 34% to 76.9% but when an incorrect LLM answer appeared citation-supported, physician resistance to it fell from 92% to 34.8%. These findings show that source-linked LLM assistance can improve physician accuracy while introducing a grounding-dependent safety risk.

AI.tldr: CORA是一个智能体检索增强LLM系统，在46名医生的研究中将诊断准确率从70.8%提升至82.6%。虽然引用来源能提升正确建议的采纳率（34%→76.9%），但也降低了医生对错误答案的抵抗力（从92%降至34.8%），揭示了基于来源的AI辅助存在潜在安全风险。
AI.motivation: 检索增强的LLM承诺提供具有来源链接的临床支持，但其价值取决于展示的证据是否能正确引导医生的决策而非误导。研究旨在探究带来源链接的AI辅助对医生决策的影响，特别是其对正确与错误建议采纳率的非对称效应。
AI.method: 开发了CORA（智能体检索增强LLM系统），在保持基准性能的同时测试训练数据截止日期后的病例。进行了一项包含46名医生的研究，比较无辅助与CORA辅助下的诊断准确率，并分析引用来源对医生采纳或拒绝建议的影响。
AI.result: 无辅助时准确率70.8%，使用CORA后升至82.6%。支持性引用能预测正确答案（87.7% vs 65.5%）。但存在关键不对称性：引用支持使正确建议采纳率从34%升至76.9%，同时使医生对错误答案的抵抗力从92%骤降至34.8%。
AI.conclusion: 来源链接的LLM辅助能显著提高医生诊断准确率，但引入了一个与证据基础相关的安全风险：不当的引用支持可能导致医生对错误建议过度信任，削弱其独立判断能力。

title: Test-Time Curriculum for Open-Set AIGC Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors deployed in open-world environments inevitably face distribution shifts as new and stronger generative models continue to emerge. Although existing methods improve cross-generator generalization through better representations or training data construction, they typically follow a static train-once-and-deploy paradigm and cannot adapt after deployment. In this work, we study open-set AIGC image detection from a test-time adaptation perspective. We propose Test-Time Curriculum (TTC), a simple and model-agnostic framework that adapts a detector on unlabeled test data through curriculum-based self-training. TTC starts from highly reliable pseudo-labeled samples and progressively incorporates harder yet informative cases, while enforcing class-balanced selection to reduce biased updates under generator shift. To further improve pseudo-label quality, we introduce Cross-Scale Pseudo-Label Refinement, which aggregates complementary evidence across multiple resolutions for more reliable adaptation, and applies noisy-or fusion at inference to strengthen final predictions. In addition, we construct AIGCGuard, a new benchmark containing 3,100 representative real images and 124,000 generated images from 40 of the most advanced open-source and proprietary text-to-image models. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TTC substantially improves overall detection performance under diverse unseen-generator shifts, establishing a practical and effective test-time adaptation framework for open-set generated image detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTC（Test-Time Curriculum）框架，从测试时适应的视角解决开放世界中AIGC图像检测的分布偏移问题。TTC通过基于课程的自训练逐步利用高可靠伪标签并引入困难样本，配合跨尺度伪标签精炼和噪声或融合，显著提升检测器面对未知生成器时的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC图像检测方法虽通过改进表示或训练数据构建提升了跨生成器泛化能力，但都遵循一次性训练后静态部署的范式，无法在部署后适应不断涌现的新型生成模型带来的分布偏移。
AI.method: 提出Test-Time Curriculum (TTC)框架：1）基于课程的自训练，从高可靠伪标签样本开始逐步纳入困难但信息量大的样本；2）类平衡选择以减少生成器偏移下的偏差更新；3）跨尺度伪标签精炼，聚合多分辨率互补证据提升伪标签质量；4）推理时使用噪声或融合增强最终预测；5）构建AIGCGuard基准，包含3,100张真实图像和来自40个先进模型的124,000张生成图像。
AI.result: 在五个基准上的广泛实验表明，TTC在多样未见生成器偏移场景下显著提升了整体检测性能。
AI.conclusion: TTC建立了一个实用且有效的测试时适应框架，为开放集生成图像检测提供了新的解决思路，证明测试时适应是应对AIGC检测中分布偏移问题的可行方向。

title: Factorized AdaBoost.MH Achieves the Same Convergence Rate as AdaBoost.MH
summary: AdaBoost.MH reduces multi-class classification to a collection of binary subproblems and enjoys the classical boosting-type convergence guarantee under a weak learning condition. A more structured variant, Factorized AdaBoost.MH, uses base classifiers of the form $\mathbf{h}(x)=α\mathbf{v} \bm{\varphi}(x)$, where a single binary classifier $\bm{\varphi}$ is shared across all classes and the label dependence is carried by a vote vector $\mathbf{v} \in\{\pm1\}^K$. This factorization is algorithmically attractive and achieves better performance in practice, but its convergence depends on whether one can always choose a vote vector with sufficiently large induced binary weight mass. Previous work resolved this question with a lower bound $\max\{1/n,1/\sqrt{2K}\}$, which still leaves a dimension-dependent slowdown relative to the original AdaBoost.MH analysis. In this paper, we sharpen this combinatorial step. For the minimax quantity $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ governing the factorized edge, we prove $\max\{1/n,C_K\}\le\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}\le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$, where $C_q=1$ for $q=1$, $C_q=q/(3q-4)$ for even $q\ge2$, and $C_q=(q+1)/(3q-1)$ for odd $q\ge2$. Since $C_q\downarrow 1/3$, our bounds show that $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=Θ(1)$ uniformly over $n$ and $K$. Consequently, Factorized AdaBoost.MH achieves the same boosting-type convergence rate as AdaBoost.MH up to a universal constant factor, removing the previously suggested additional dependence on $n$ or $K$ in the number of boosting rounds.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了Factorized AdaBoost.MH的收敛性分析。通过精化组合学步骤，作者证明了控制因子化边距（edge）的极小极大量$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$满足$\max\{1/n, C_K\} \le \mathfrak{W}_{n,K} \le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$，其中$C_q$单调递减至$1/3$。这证明$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$在$n$和$K$上一致成立，从而表明Factorized AdaBoost.MH与原始AdaBoost.MH具有相同的boosting型收敛速率（仅差一个通用常数因子），消除了先前分析中存在的对$n$或$K$的额外依赖。
AI.motivation: Factorized AdaBoost.MH在算法上更具吸引力且实际性能更好，但其收敛性分析依赖于投票向量的选择问题。先前的工作给出了$\max\{1/n, 1/\sqrt{2K}\}$的下界，这暗示存在维度相关的减速。作者希望消除这一差距，证明因子化版本的收敛速率与原始AdaBoost.MH本质上相同。
AI.method: 作者对控制因子化边距的极小极大量$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$进行了精确的组合学分析。证明了下界$\max\{1/n, C_K\}$和上界$C_{\min\{n,K\}}$，其中常数$C_q$有闭式表达式（偶数$q$时为$q/(3q-4)$，奇数$q$时为$(q+1)/(3q-1)$），且$C_q \downarrow 1/3$，从而证明$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$一致地为常数阶。
AI.result: 证明了$\max\{1/n, C_K\} \le \mathfrak{W}_{n,K} \le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$，其中$C_q$单调收敛于$1/3$。因此$\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$对$n$和$K$一致成立。Factorized AdaBoost.MH由此获得与AdaBoost.MH相同（仅差常数因子）的boosting型收敛速率，消除了此前对$n$或$K$的额外依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为Factorized AdaBoost.MH提供了与原始AdaBoost.MH相当的理论保证，弥合了理论与实践性能之间的理论上界差距。

title: DeBERTa-Sentinel: Toward Transparent and Trustworthy Detection of AI-Generated Text
summary: The rapid spread of large language models (LLMs) across the web raises concerns about misinformation, academic integrity, automated content manipulation, and risks to vulnerable online communities. Existing transformer-based detectors, such as GPT-Sentinel, show promise but struggle to generalize to diverse model outputs and paraphrasing attacks, limiting their role in building trustworthy web ecosystems. This work introduces DeBERTa-Sentinel, a responsible AI-generated text detection framework leveraging DeBERTa-v3's disentangled attention to capture subtle structural irregularities in synthetic content. A central design principle is transparency: unlike black-box commercial detectors, DeBERTa-Sentinel exposes token-level explanations of its decisions, enabling affected stakeholders journalists, educators, and platform trust and safety teams to audit, challenge, and contextualize detection outcomes. Using the GLC-AIText dataset of 28,057 human and LLM-generated samples (GPT, LLaMA, and Claude) with a 60-20-20 split, DeBERTa-Sentinel achieves 98.21\% validation accuracy and surpasses the RoBERTa-Sentinel baseline from NeurIPS 2025, achieving 97.53\% test accuracy, 95.89\% precision, 99.33\% recall, and 99.53\% ROC-AUC, and maintaining a 0.665\% false negative rate. The model's interpretability reveals linguistic markers such as academic phrasing and formal transitions associated with synthetic text, directly supporting stakeholder needs for verifiable, auditable content-authenticity decisions. By advancing responsible detection methods that reduce bias and enhance explainability, DeBERTa-Sentinel promotes trustworthy, ethical, and human-centric AI systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeBERTa-Sentinel，一个基于DeBERTa-v3的可解释AI生成文本检测框架，在GLC-AIText数据集上达到97.53%测试准确率，并通过token级解释实现透明化检测，超越RoBERTa-Sentinel基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在Web上的快速普及引发了错误信息、学术诚信受损、自动化内容操纵等担忧。现有基于Transformer的检测器（如GPT-Sentinel）在泛化到多样化模型输出和应对释义攻击方面存在不足，且商业检测器作为黑盒缺乏透明度，无法满足记者、教育工作者和平台安全团队等利益相关者对可审计、可验证检测结果的需求。
AI.method: DeBERTa-Sentinel利用DeBERTa-v3的解耦注意力机制捕捉合成内容中细微的结构性异常。核心设计原则是透明性：通过暴露token级决策解释，使利益相关者能够审计、质疑和情境化检测结果。使用GLC-AIText数据集（28,057个样本，60-20-20划分）进行训练与评估。
AI.result: DeBERTa-Sentinel在GLC-AIText数据集上达到98.21%验证准确率，测试准确率97.53%，精度95.89%，召回率99.33%，ROC-AUC 99.53%，假阴性率仅0.665%，全面超越NeurIPS 2025的RoBERTa-Sentinel基线。
AI.conclusion: DeBERTa-Sentinel通过结合高性能检测与可解释性，同时解决了AI文本检测的泛化问题和透明度问题。其token级解释揭示了学术措辞和正式过渡语等与合成文本相关的语言标记，支持利益相关者做出可验证、可审计的内容真实性决策，推动负责任、伦理和人本主义的AI系统发展。

title: The Scaling Paradox in Human-AI Collaboration
summary: The discovery of scaling laws has highlighted the extraordinary potential of AI systems with a striking empirical pattern: as AI systems scale, their capabilities tend to improve predictably. Yet, in real-world applications, AI rarely operates in isolation; instead, it often works alongside humans, raising the question of whether these gains persist in human-AI collaboration. In this work, we develop an analytical model to examine when the empirical scaling benefits of AI translate into improved human-AI joint system performance. We demonstrate that the performance of a human-AI system can scale positively as the AI scales up-provided that humans have an accurate perception of the AI's capabilities. Human misperception, however, can fundamentally alter this relationship: i) when humans over-perceive the AI's capabilities, a scaling paradox may arise, in which greater AI scale reduces overall system performance and amplifies firm-level profit losses, and (ii) when humans under-perceive the AI's capabilities, performance still improves with scale but at a substantially slower rate. We further show that firms can actively manage these distortions through operational policies such as cost internalization and perception alignment, whose effectiveness depends on the economics of AI deployment and the direction of human misperception. These findings suggest that organizations may benefit more from managing the human-AI interface than from simply investing in larger, more expensive AI systems. More broadly, our results suggest that AI scaling should be viewed not only as a technological challenge, but also as a behavioral and operational one, and caution against the view that larger AI systems will automatically lead to better operational outcomes. Whether AI scaling creates value ultimately depends on how increased AI capabilities shape human beliefs and collaborative efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个分析模型，研究AI规模扩展的收益能否转化为人机协作系统的性能提升。研究发现，只有当人类对AI能力有准确认知时，AI规模扩展才能正向提升系统性能；人类认知偏差会根本上改变这种关系——高估AI能力会导致"规模悖论"（更大的AI反而降低系统性能），低估AI能力则使性能提升速度大幅放缓。企业可通过成本内化和认知对齐等运营策略来管理这些偏差。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI扩展定律表明更大的AI系统能力更强，但在实际应用中AI常与人类协作，现有研究未充分探讨AI规模扩展的收益能否在人机协作环境中持续存在。人类对AI能力的认知偏差可能从根本上改变规模扩展的效果，这一机制尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个分析模型（analytical model），将人类对AI能力的感知纳入人机协作系统的性能分析框架，考察人类认知准确性如何调节AI规模与系统整体性能之间的关系，并分析运营政策（成本内化、认知对齐）在管理认知偏差中的作用。
AI.result: 研究揭示了三个关键发现：(1) 当人类准确感知AI能力时，AI规模扩展能正向提升系统性能；(2) 当人类高估AI能力时，产生"规模悖论"——更大的AI规模反而降低系统性能和公司利润；(3) 当人类低估AI能力时，性能仍随规模提升但速度显著放缓。此外，成本内化和认知对齐等运营政策可以有效管理这些认知偏差，其效果取决于AI部署的经济性和偏差方向。
AI.conclusion: AI规模扩展不仅是技术挑战，更是行为与运营挑战。组织从管理人机交互中获得的收益可能大于单纯投资更大、更昂贵的AI系统。AI扩展能否创造价值，最终取决于AI能力提升如何塑造人类信念和协作行为。

title: Beyond Token-Level Cross-Entropy: Fréchet Distributional Post-Training for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive image generators are commonly pretrained with token-level cross-entropy under teacher forcing, yet evaluated by the distributional quality of decoded images. This creates an objective mismatch, because categorical errors have unequal image-level consequences, and a context mismatch, because inference conditions on model-generated histories. We introduce FD-loss post-training, which adapts a pretrained discrete generator using representation-space Fréchet distance as the sole objective. A dual-pass scheme first constructs detached rollout contexts through gradient-free generation under the model's native inference configuration, then performs differentiable replay with a probability-level straight-through estimator (STE) that preserves hard argmax decoding in the forward pass while propagating image-level gradients through temperature-scaled probabilities. Only the generator is updated, while the tokenizer and feature extractors remain frozen. Across eight completed configurations from four generator families on class-conditional ImageNet at $256\times256$, FD-loss post-training reduces FID and $\mathrm{FD}_{r6}$ by 41.4% and 52.0% on average. The strongest FID result improves from 2.42 to 1.43 without adding parameters or inference steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FD-loss后训练方法，针对自回归图像生成器中"逐token交叉熵训练"与"图像级分布评估"之间的目标和上下文不匹配问题。该方法利用表示空间中的Fréchet距离作为唯一优化目标，通过双通道方案（先梯度无关生成构造rollout上下文，再用概率级直通估计器进行可微重放）来适应预训练离散生成器，仅更新生成器参数。在ImageNet 256×256上的八种配置中，平均降低FID和FD_r6分别达41.4%和52.0%，最强配置FID从2.42提升至1.43且不增加参数或推理步骤。
AI.motivation: 自回归图像生成器在预训练时采用teacher forcing下的token级交叉熵，但评估时却关注解码图像的分布质量。这导致两个不匹配：(1)目标不匹配——不同类别的分类错误对图像质量的影响不均等；(2)上下文不匹配——推理时模型面对的是自身生成的历史而非真实token序列。这两种不匹配使得预训练目标与实际评估目标之间出现系统性的偏差。
AI.method: 提出FD-loss后训练方法，核心包括：(1)以表示空间中的Fréchet距离作为唯一优化目标；(2)双通道方案：第一通道通过模型原生推理配置进行梯度无关的自回归生成，构造detached rollout上下文；第二通道执行可微重放，使用概率级直通估计器（STE），在前向传播中保持硬argmax解码，同时通过温度缩放的soft概率传播图像级梯度；(3)仅更新生成器参数，tokenizer和特征提取器保持冻结。
AI.result: 在类条件ImageNet 256×256上对四个生成器家族的八种配置进行评估，FD-loss后训练平均降低FID 41.4%和FD_r6 52.0%。最强FID结果从2.42改进到1.43，且不增加任何参数或推理步骤。
AI.conclusion: FD-loss后训练有效弥合了自回归图像生成器的训练目标与评估目标之间的差距，通过直接在表示空间中优化图像级分布距离，显著提升生成质量且无需额外推理开销。

title: FL-OA: A Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning Framework with Outsourced Auditing for Intelligent Devices
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple intelligent devices to collaboratively train a high-accuracy model without sharing raw data. However, due to its distributed nature, FL is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks. Existing defense methods rely on strong assumptions, such as the proportion of malicious devices not exceeding 50\%, or the server having an additional root dataset that matches the training task. Moreover, they show limited efficacy as they overlook $(i)$ the divergence among benign updates and $(ii)$ the curse of dimensionality involved in comparing two high-dimensional updates. To solve these concerns, we propose FL-OA, a Byzantine-robust federated learning framework utilizing outsourced auditing. In FL-OA, the server collaborates with third-party organization that holds an additional root dataset to perform outsourced auditing, thereby enabling the server to achieve robust aggregation without strong assumptions. Additionally, FL-OA introduces a gradient ascent step and a correction term during local training to mitigate the divergence among benign updates, and designs a parameter importance indicator to extract critical parameters for auditing, alleviating the curse of dimensionality. We further provide a detailed theoretical analysis of FL-OA. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FL-OA outperforms existing defense methods against Byzantine attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FL-OA，一种基于外包审计的拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习框架。通过第三方组织提供根数据集进行审计，结合梯度上升和修正项缓解良性更新差异，并设计参数重要性指标降低高维比较的复杂度，实验证明其优于现有防御方法。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习拜占庭防御方法存在两方面的局限：(1)依赖强假设，如恶意设备比例不超过50%或服务器需持有与训练任务匹配的额外根数据集；(2)忽略良性更新之间的差异以及高维更新比较带来的维度灾难问题，导致防御效果有限。
AI.method: FL-OA框架包含三个核心设计：(1)服务器与持有根数据集的第三方组织协作执行外包审计，实现无需强假设的鲁棒聚合；(2)在本地训练中引入梯度上升步骤和修正项，以缓解良性更新之间的发散；(3)设计参数重要性指标来提取关键参数进行审计，从而缓解高维比较中的维度灾难问题。
AI.result: 论文提供了FL-OA的详细理论分析，并通过大量实验证明FL-OA在抵御拜占庭攻击方面优于现有的防御方法。
AI.conclusion: FL-OA通过外包审计机制有效解决了现有拜占庭防御方法对强假设的依赖，并通过缓解良性更新发散和维度灾难问题提升了防御效果，为联邦学习的鲁棒性提供了新的解决方案。

title: Attend to Your Own Thoughts: Breaking the Barrier for Post-Training Quantization of Reasoning LLMs through the Lens of 1.58-Bit Quantization
comment: This research work was completed and submitted for publication in early May 2026. The project page: https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern
summary: We propose ScaleQ-1.58, a scalable ternary post-training quantization (PTQ) framework for reasoning LLMs. Its core insight stems from an empirical finding: although modern LLMs are typically trained to exhibit chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities, in the PTQ regime, even the latest CAT-Q method based on learning-based differentiable ternarization still leads to performance collapse on challenging mathematics and coding tasks when using conventional calibration schemes that ignore the model's reasoning process. Driven by this finding, we introduce a simple calibration approach, Attend to Your Own Thoughts (AYOT), where reasoning traces and final answers generated by the pre-trained high-precision target LLM on a proper set of calibration samples are used as the context input during the ternarization process, along with the corresponding questions. ScaleQ-1.58 is formed by simply integrating AYOT with CAT-Q, which demonstrates several scaling properties: (1) with only 4M calibration tokens, Qwen3-1.7B ternarized by ScaleQ-1.58 reaches over 90.52% of the performance of the prior best BitNet b1.58 2B4T averaged over 4 mathematics and coding tasks, and our ternary Qwen3-4B shows an absolute gain of 8.97%, while requiring 1,000,000x fewer calibration tokens for quantization; (2) ScaleQ-1.58 generalizes well to both dense and MoE architectures, with performance improving as model scale increases (up to 235B parameters); (3) ScaleQ-1.58 demonstrates strong generalization across tasks of varying difficulty levels, including mathematics, coding and scientific logic reasoning, as well as commonsense reasoning and basic language generation; (4) its performance continues to improve as the number of calibration tokens increases. Notably, AYOT also exhibits strong generalization ability across other quantization bit-widths. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern.

AI.tldr: ScaleQ-1.58是一个面向推理型大语言模型的可扩展三值后训练量化（PTQ）框架，其核心创新在于提出"关注自己的思考"（AYOT）校准方法——利用预训练高精度目标模型生成的推理轨迹和最终答案作为校准上下文输入到三值化过程中，仅需400万校准token即可在多项数学和编码任务上超越此前最佳方法，且适用于多种架构和位宽。
AI.motivation: 现有的后训练量化方法（包括最新的基于可微三值化的CAT-Q）在采用忽视模型推理过程的传统校准方案时，会导致推理型大语言模型在数学和编码等具有挑战性的任务上性能崩溃。尽管现代LLM通常具有链式思考推理能力，这一能力在量化过程中被忽视。
AI.method: 核心方法是AYOT校准策略：将预训练高精度目标LLM在适当校准样本上生成的推理轨迹和最终答案，连同问题一起作为三值化过程中的上下文输入。将AYOT与CAT-Q简单集成即形成ScaleQ-1.58，一种简单而有效的三值PTQ框架。
AI.result: （1）仅用400万校准token，Qwen3-1.7B经ScaleQ-1.58三值化后达到此前最佳BitNet b1.58 2B4T平均性能的90.52%，Qwen3-4B获得8.97%的绝对增益，且校准token需求减少1,000,000倍；（2）在稠密和MoE架构上均表现良好，性能随模型规模增大而提升（最高235B参数）；（3）在数学、编码、科学逻辑推理、常识推理及基础语言生成等不同难度任务上均展现出强泛化能力；（4）性能随校准token数量增加而持续提升。AYOT在其他量化位宽上也表现出良好的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: ScaleQ-1.58通过将模型的推理过程纳入校准环节，实现了推理型LLM的高效可扩展三值量化，在极少的校准数据条件下就能达到甚至超越现有方法水平，验证了"关注推理过程"这一校准思路的有效性，为推理型大模型的极低位宽量化和高效部署提供了新路径。

title: Isotropy Cliffs: The Geometric Signature of Decision-Making in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate the geometry of decision-making in Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) through the lens of isotropy. Analyzing five open-weight models across diverse datasets, we identify decision-critical transition layers characterized by a shift in isotropy, coinciding with a major representational change and the emergence of task-relevant clusters. We demonstrate that this synchronized geometric behavior is strongly correlated with downstream accuracy ($r\approx0.84$), displaying its relevance for successful decision-making. Furthermore, we show that this transition is robust to prompt variations, suggesting that it reflects a general mechanism of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过各向同性（isotropy）的视角研究多选题问答（MCQA）中的决策几何特性。作者分析五个开源模型和多个数据集，发现存在"决策关键转换层"——其特点为各向同性发生突变，伴随表征重大变化和任务相关聚类的涌现。该几何行为与下游准确率高度相关（r≈0.84），且对提示变化具有鲁棒性，揭示了一种通用的模型决策机制。
AI.motivation: 理解大语言模型如何做决策一直是可解释性研究的核心问题。现有研究多关注注意力机制或神经元层面，缺乏对模型内部表征几何结构如何支撑决策的系统性理解。本文希望通过各向同性这一几何度量，揭示MCQA任务中模型从中间表征到最终决策的关键转换机制。
AI.method: 本文方法包括：(1) 在五个开源权重模型和多种数据集上，逐层计算表征的各向同性指标；(2) 定位各向同性发生显著变化的"转换层"；(3) 分析该层同时出现的表征变化和任务相关聚类的形成；(4) 计算转换层行为与下游准确率之间的相关性；(5) 通过改变提示验证该发现的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 模型存在决策关键的转换层，该层各向同性发生突变；(2) 该突变与表征重大变化和任务相关聚类涌现同步发生；(3) 转换层行为与下游准确率强相关（r≈0.84）；(4) 该转换对不同提示变体具有鲁棒性，表明是模型的通用机制而非提示特异现象。
AI.conclusion: 各向同性转变是MCQA模型决策的关键几何标志，反映了模型从通用表征到任务特定表征的转换过程。这一发现为理解LLM内部决策机制提供了新的几何视角，且该现象的鲁棒性暗示其可作为分析模型能力的一般性工具。

title: Relax Within, Balance Across: Geometry-Guided Load Balancing for Vision-Language Mixture-of-Experts
comment: 22 pages, including appendices. Code available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA
summary: Vision-language MoE batches contain different numbers of image and text tokens. Image resolution, image count, tiling, and prompt length all change this token mix. We call the standard token-level Switch auxiliary loss Std-Aux. Std-Aux balances only the mixed load, so large image and text load errors can cancel at one mix. On our main model, the same trained router shows more than a fivefold change in load imbalance across image resolutions. We hold the image and text load profiles fixed and derive the exact load curve as the token mix varies. The image-text load gap controls sensitivity to the token mix. Physical preprocessing can also change the conditional profiles. The fixed-profile law excludes such changes. To design a remedy, we examine the router input structure. Image and text occupy distinct regions, while visual tokens group strongly by source image. The modality boundary motivates separate image and text terms. The image boundary motivates one equal-weight routing instance per image. ReBA, or Relax Within, Balance Across, implements both choices. Across four split backbones, ReBA lowers load on every reported benchmark input while keeping mean task accuracy comparable to Std-Aux. ReBA also lowers average load over the tested range and worst physical load under resolution and tiling shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReBA（Relax Within, Balance Across）方法，针对视觉-语言混合专家（MoE）模型中图像和文本token数量不同导致的负载不均衡问题。标准Switch辅助损失（Std-Aux）仅平衡混合负载，导致在图像分辨率等物理预处理变化时出现严重的负载失衡。ReBA基于路由输入的模态边界和图像边界，分别设计图像/文本独立的均衡项以及每张图像独立的等权重路由实例，在保持任务精度的同时显著降低负载。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言MoE批次中图像和文本token数量比例高度可变（受图像分辨率、图像数量、拼接方式和提示词长度影响）。标准Switch辅助损失只平衡混合负载，导致图像和文本的负载误差在特定混合比例下相互抵消，而路由器在图像分辨率变化时表现出超过5倍的负载不平衡变化。这种负载不均衡严重影响MoE的训练和推理效率。
AI.method: ReBA包含两个关键设计：(1) 基于模态边界（modality boundary），分别设置独立的图像和文本负载均衡项，避免跨模态负载误差相互抵消；(2) 基于图像边界（image boundary），为每张图像设置一个等权重路由实例，使视觉token按源图像分组路由。作者还通过固定图像和文本负载剖面，推导了负载随token混合比例变化的精确曲线，论证了图像-文本负载差距是敏感性的关键因素。
AI.result: 在四个分割主干网络上，ReBA在所有报告的基准输入上都降低了负载，同时平均任务准确率与Std-Aux相当。ReBA还降低了测试范围内的平均负载，并在分辨率和拼接变化下降低了最差物理负载。
AI.conclusion: ReBA通过将模态感知和图像感知的约束引入辅助损失，有效解决了视觉语言MoE中token混合比例变化导致的负载不均衡问题，在不牺牲精度的前提下鲁棒地控制了负载，代码已开源。

title: When Do Surrogate Updates Improve Decisions? A Local Theory of Trajectory-Wise Transfer
comment: 22 pages in total, including references and appendices; 3 composite figures (9 panels) and 4 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/Ethan-Shen-Individual-Lab/surrogate-to-decision-transfer
summary: A broad range of models face the mismatch where they are updated through trajectory losses but are evaluated by downstream task reward. Here, a trajectory is a training instance that induces a surrogate loss whose reduction might not track the model's decision utility update. Theoretically, we ask when one step of trajectory training reduces both population surrogate loss and decision risk, and how transfer accumulates along repeated updates. To formalize this, we first fix a checkpoint and a restricted update space, and define the reductions in population surrogate risk and decision risk induced by a trajectory as its learnability and decision utility, respectively. On this basis, our theory yields four main results. First, a one-step transfer bound separates their discrepancy into first-order gradient misalignment after nonnegative calibration and second-order curvature; and a pathwise extension accumulates the same terms over repeated updates. Second, when the accessible surrogate gradient is nonzero, universal first-order transfer over every accessible direction holds exactly when the accessible surrogate and decision gradients are positively collinear. Third, the calibration gap bounds the decision regret of learnability-based trajectory selection, while a candidate-difference refinement tightens this guarantee by retaining only directions that affect pairwise rankings. Finally, we establish an approximation--calibration trade-off across nested update spaces. Controlled gridworld and LLM post-training experiments yield results consistent with our predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了轨迹训练（通过替代损失更新）与下游任务奖励（决策效用）之间的不匹配问题，从理论上分析了单步及多步更新中替代风险与决策风险的转移关系，提出了learnability与decision utility两个核心概念，并给出了四个主要理论结果，包括一阶梯度错位与二阶曲率的转移界、正共线条件、校准差距对轨迹选择的遗憾界，以及近似-校准的权衡。
AI.motivation: 许多模型在训练时通过轨迹损失（surrogate loss）进行优化，但最终评估却基于下游任务奖励（decision reward），两者之间存在不一致。作者希望从理论层面回答：何时单步轨迹训练能同时降低替代损失和决策风险，以及这种转移在多次更新中如何累积。
AI.method: 作者形式化定义了learnability（轨迹引起的总体替代风险降低）和decision utility（轨迹引起的决策风险降低），在此基础上推导出一阶转移界（分离梯度错位和二阶曲率贡献）、路径扩展（累积多步更新）、通用一阶转移条件（正共线）、轨迹选择的决策遗憾界及其细化，最后建立近似-校准权衡，并通过gridworld和LLM后训练实验验证。
AI.result: 四个主要理论结果：（1）单步转移界将替代与决策风险的差异分解为一阶梯度错位（经非负校准后）和二阶曲率项，路径扩展在多次更新中累积相同项；（2）当替代梯度非零时，所有可达方向的通用一阶转移当且仅当替代梯度与决策梯度正共线；（3）校准差距给出基于可学习性的轨迹选择的决策遗憾界，候选差分细化通过仅保留影响成对排名的方向收紧该界；（4）嵌套更新空间下存在近似-校准权衡。实验与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文为轨迹训练与下游决策效用之间的不匹配提供了系统的理论框架，首次明确了转移发生的条件、累积方式以及选择策略的保障，对理解RLHF、LLM后训练等场景中代理损失与真实目标的偏差具有重要指导意义。

title: Morphology Aware Reversible Semantic Tokenization and Hierarchical Word Composition for Tamil Language Models
summary:
Statistical subword tokenizers can process arbitrary text, but their units need not align with lexical or grammatical structure. This is especially important for Tamil, where a written word may encode stem changes, case, number, tense, agreement, voice, clitics, and linked verbs. We present a Tamil morphology system extending the open-source ThamizhiMorph analyzer and generator, together with a byte-exact semantic tokenizer and a learned hierarchical word composer. Twelve finite-state transducers analyze words into lemmas and grammatical features, while character and byte fallbacks preserve exact reconstruction.
  We compare a flat morphology tokenizer, a signal-preserving word composer, and tokenizers based on Sarvam-1, AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2, and BrahmicTokenizer-131K. All systems use the same 69,591 Tamil-English training pairs, 18.97-million-parameter encoder-decoder, 40,000 updates, target tokenizer, optimizer, positional method, and generation settings.
  On a protected 3,539-row IN22 and FLORES+ evaluation, morphology-flat achieves the best pooled scores: 10.63 BLEU, 35.26 chrF++, and 0.6276 COMETKiwi. Relative to AI4Bharat, the strongest external-tokenizer baseline, these are improvements of 7.2%, 3.2%, and 2.6%. The word composer scores 10.30, 34.88, and 0.6241, improving on AI4Bharat by 3.8%, 2.1%, and 2.0%.
  The composer reduces mean global source states from 71.48 to 29.08, a 59.3% reduction, and is estimated to require 9-21% fewer inference FLOPs depending on decoder caching. Its remaining quality gap is concentrated in longer FLORES+ sentences. These results show that explicit Tamil morphology improves translation under a fixed small-model budget, while hierarchical composition substantially reduces sequence length and estimated inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对泰米尔语的形态学系统，包括开源的ThamizhiMorph分析器和生成器、逐字节精确的语义分词器以及学习的分层词组合器。在固定的小模型预算下，形态学平坦分词器在英泰翻译任务中取得了最佳效果（BLEU 10.63），相比最强的外部分词器基线AI4Bharat提升了7.2%的BLEU，而词组合器虽然质量略有差距，但将序列长度减少了59.3%，推理FLOPs降低了9-21%。
AI.motivation: 统计子词分词器可以处理任意文本，但其单元不一定与词汇或语法结构对齐。这对泰米尔语尤其重要，因为泰米尔语的一个书面词可能编码词干变化、格、数、时态、一致关系、语态、附着词和连动动词等复杂形态信息，现有通用分词器无法很好地捕捉这些语言学结构。
AI.method: 1）扩展开源ThamizhiMorph分析器和生成器，构建泰米尔语形态学系统；2）12个有限状态转换器（FST）将词分析为词干和语法特征，配合字符和字节回退机制确保精确重建；3）提出逐字节精确的语义分词器；4）提出学习的分层词组合器；5）比较平坦形态分词器、信号保持词组合器以及基于Sarvam-1、AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2和BrahmicTokenizer-131K的分词器，所有系统使用完全相同的训练配置（69,591对训练数据、18.97M参数编解码器、40,000次更新等）。
AI.result: 在受保护的3,539行IN22和FLORES+评估集上，形态学平坦分词器取得最佳综合得分：BLEU 10.63、chrF++ 35.26、COMETKiwi 0.6276，相对AI4Bharat基线分别提升7.2%、3.2%和2.6%。词组合器得分10.30、34.88、0.6241，提升3.8%、2.1%和2.0%，同时将平均全局源状态从71.48降至29.08（减少59.3%），推理FLOPs减少9-21%。质量差距集中在更长的FLORES+句子中。
AI.conclusion: 显式泰米尔语形态学在固定小模型预算下能提升机器翻译质量，而分层词组合可以大幅缩短序列长度并降低推理成本，但在较长句子上的质量仍有提升空间。

title: Similarity Weighted Aggregation with Global Differential Privacy for Federated Brain Lesion Segmentation
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across multiple institutions without sharing sensitive data, making it particularly suitable for medical imaging applications. However, heterogeneous data distributions across institutions and potential information leakage through model updates remain important challenges. In this work, we propose DP-SimAgg, a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that integrates similarity-weighted aggregation with a server-side differential privacy mechanism. The proposed method applies L2 clipping to bound collaborator updates, computes similarity-based aggregation weights to mitigate the effects of non-IID data distributions, and injects calibrated Gaussian noise at the central server, providing per-round privacy guarantees under the assumed sensitivity bound. The framework is implemented using Intel's OpenFL platform and evaluated on the FeTS 2022 dataset consisting of 1251 multi-modal MRI scans for brain tumor segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that DP-SimAgg maintains competitive segmentation performance while providing privacy protection. Under a strict per-round privacy budget (epsilon = 1, cumulative epsilon_total = 20 over 20 rounds), the method achieves Dice scores of 0.6357, 0.5305, and 0.5274 for the enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT) regions, respectively. With a more relaxed per-round budget (epsilon = 10, cumulative epsilon_total = 200), performance approaches that of the non-private baseline while incorporating a central Gaussian mechanism with per-round (epsilon, delta)-DP accounting under the assumed sensitivity bound. These results highlight the potential of DP-SimAgg for enabling privacy-preserving collaborative learning in medical imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-SimAgg，一个结合相似度加权聚合与服务器端差分隐私的联邦学习框架，用于医学影像中的隐私保护协作学习。该方法通过L2裁剪、相似度权重计算和中心化高斯噪声注入，在FeTS 2022脑肿瘤分割数据集上验证了其隐私保护与分割性能的平衡。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽适用于医学影像的多机构协作训练，但面临两个关键挑战：机构间数据分布异质（non-IID）导致模型性能下降，以及模型更新可能泄露敏感信息。现有方法难以同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: DP-SimAgg框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 对协作方更新进行L2裁剪以限制敏感度；(2) 计算相似度加权的聚合权重来缓解non-IID数据分布的影响；(3) 在中心服务器注入校准的高斯噪声，在假定敏感度界下提供每轮(epsilon, delta)-DP保障。框架基于Intel OpenFL平台实现。
AI.result: 在FeTS 2022数据集（1251例多模态MRI脑肿瘤分割）上，严格隐私预算（每轮epsilon=1，20轮累计epsilon_total=20）下，ET/TC/WT区域的Dice分数分别为0.6357、0.5305和0.5274；宽松预算（每轮epsilon=10，累计epsilon_total=200）下性能接近非隐私基线。
AI.conclusion: DP-SimAgg在隐私保护与分割性能之间取得了有效平衡，展示了其在医学影像领域实现隐私保护协作学习的潜力。通过在更宽松的隐私预算下接近非私有基线的性能表现，验证了该框架的实际可行性。

title: Element-Aware Group Learning for E-Commerce Image Generation
summary: Recent advances in image generation and editing have made prompt quality a key bottleneck for e-commerce creatives. Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate image-editing prompts from product images and metadata, but further improving their prompt-writing capabilities requires post-training with feedback from the generated images. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a natural framework for such outcome-level reward optimization. However, it assigns credit only at the full-prompt level, even though image quality often depends on specific design elements such as composition, background, and the presentation of selling points. Existing fine-grained credit assignment methods typically require step-level supervision or learned critics. To address this, we propose EAGLE-GRPO (Element-Aware Group Learning for E-Commerce Image Generation), which decomposes the group-centered reward over predefined elements. We cast element-level credit assignment as a kernel ridge regression problem and derive a closed-form solution, without additional rollouts or separate credit-assignment models. This yields interpretable per-element advantages and more precise policy updates. Experiments show that EAGLE-GRPO sustains performance gains over more training steps before plateauing and generates prompts that produce higher-quality e-commerce images than competitive VLM prompt-writing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出EAGLE-GRPO框架，将组级GRPO奖励分解为基于预定义元素的细粒度信用分配，通过核岭回归闭式解实现无需额外rollout或独立模型的元素级优势估计，从而提升电商图像生成提示词质量。
AI.motivation: 电商广告中图像生成提示词质量成为关键瓶颈。虽然VLM可以从产品图像和元数据生成编辑提示词，但进一步提升需要基于生成图像反馈的后训练。现有GRPO框架仅在完整提示词层面分配信用，无法捕捉图像质量对不同设计元素（如构图、背景、卖点呈现）的依赖。
AI.method: 提出EAGLE-GRPO（Element-Aware Group Learning for E-Commerce Image Generation），将组心奖励分解为预定义元素上的奖励。将元素级信用分配建模为核岭回归问题，推导出闭式解，无需额外rollout或单独的信用分配模型，得到可解释的逐元素优势值。
AI.result: 实验表明EAGLE-GRPO在更多训练步数上能持续保持性能增益，在达到平台期前优于竞争性VLM提示词生成基线，生成的提示词能产生更高质量的电商图像。
AI.conclusion: EAGLE-GRPO通过元素级信用分配有效提升了电商图像生成提示词的质量，相比传统的全提示词级GRPO方法更加精确和可解释，且没有额外的计算开销。

title: Policy Optimality Measurement for Multi-Vehicle Decision-Making: From Extrinsic Indicators to Intrinsic Quality
summary: Evaluating Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policies in autonomous driving fundamentally relies on extrinsic statistical indicators (e.g., reward curves and success rates), which often mask intrinsic policy degradation and algorithmic blind spots. To break this black-box evaluation, this letter proposes a novel information-theoretic diagnostic framework. By leveraging a fully converged Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) as an asymptotic oracle, we establish a theoretical ground-truth baseline distribution. We formulate a bounded policy optimality score ($\mathcal{M}_{opt}$) using the forward KL divergence to rigorously penalize fatal collaborative omissions. Crucially, we semantically decouple this metric into lateral and longitudinal dimensions, creating a granular "semantic microscope". Extensive spatial and temporal diagnostics on state-of-the-art MARL architectures and exploration mechanisms demonstrate that our framework conclusively exposes hidden directional biases, identifies temporal average-policy traps, and transforms heuristic hyperparameter tuning into a visually trackable trajectory optimization. This framework establishes a rigorous, model-agnostic standard for benchmarking intrinsic multi-agent policy quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信息论的多智能体强化学习（MARL）策略诊断框架。该框架利用完全收敛的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）作为渐进最优基准，通过前向KL散度构建有界的策略最优性得分（M_opt），并从横向和纵向维度进行语义解耦，实现对自动驾驶MARL策略的细粒度内在质量评估，突破了传统外部统计指标（如奖励曲线和成功率）的黑盒评估局限。
AI.motivation: 现有MARL策略评估主要依赖外在统计指标（如奖励曲线、成功率），这些指标往往掩盖了策略的内在退化问题和算法盲区，缺乏对策略质量的深入诊断能力。
AI.method: 1) 利用完全收敛的MCTS作为渐近最优Oracle，建立理论上的基线分布；2) 使用前向KL散度构建有界策略最优性得分M_opt，严格惩罚致命协作遗漏；3) 将指标在语义上解耦为横向和纵向两个维度，形成细粒度的"语义显微镜"。
AI.result: 在先进的MARL架构和探索机制上的广泛时空诊断表明，该框架能够揭示隐藏的方向性偏差，识别时间上的平均策略陷阱，并将启发式超参数调优转化为可视化的轨迹优化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为基准测试内在多智能体策略质量建立了严谨、模型无关的标准，为自动驾驶MARL策略评估提供了全新的理论工具。

title: PlainMedScale: A Corpus of Multi-Level Simplified Medical Texts in German and English
summary: We introduce PlainMedScale, a topic-aligned medical corpus spanning four levels of comprehensibility in German and English, drawn from MSD (professional and consumer), Gesund.Bund, Apotheken Umschau Einfache Sprache, and the NHS. The four tiers correspond to distinct communicative functions --- reference, explanation, decision support, and access --- and move beyond the binary expert--lay contrast of prior corpora. In two pilot studies enabled by the alignments, we show that many readability metrics established on two registers fail to generalize across the full gradient, and that a SOTA open-weight LLM prompted for Plain Language still partially preserves the difficulty of its input. Code (https://github.com/GS-Uni-Heidelberg/PlainMedScale) and data (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21728290) are made available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PlainMedScale，一个覆盖德语和英语四种可理解性层级的医学语料库（来源于MSD、Gesund.Bund、Apotheken Umschau和NHS），其四个层级对应参考、解释、决策支持和获取四种不同交际功能，超越了以往二元专家-外行对比的语料。通过两个试点研究，作者发现许多基于两种语域确立的可读性指标难以在整个梯度上泛化，且SOTA开源权重LLM在提示生成简单语言时仍部分保留输入难度。代码和数据已公开发布。
AI.motivation: 现有医学语料库通常仅区分专家与大众（二元对立），无法反映医疗文本可理解性的完整光谱；同时，可读性指标和LLM简化能力的评估缺乏覆盖多层级难度的对齐语料支持。
AI.method: 构建了一个主题对齐的四层级医学语料库（参考、解释、决策支持、获取），分别从专业和消费者MSD、Gesund.Bund、Apotheken Umschau Einfache Sprache及NHS等来源抽取德语和英语文本；随后开展两项试点研究：一是评估既有可读性指标在多层级梯度上的适用性，二是测试SOTA开源权重LLM在提示生成简单语言时的难度保持情况。
AI.result: 试点研究发现：基于两种语域（二元分类）建立的可读性指标在完整梯度上无法良好泛化；SOTA开源LLM在受提示生成简单语言时，仍部分保留输入文本的难度水平。
AI.conclusion: PlainMedScale提供了更细致的医学文本可理解性基准，为可读性指标的重新校准和LLM文本简化能力的评估提供了更严谨的多层级测试平台，并为未来医学内容本地化和自动简化研究奠定基础。

title: Assuming You Knew: Fixing an Epistemic Semantics for Flow Policies Using Agentic AI
summary: Many high-level security requirements are about the allowed flow of information in programs and are difficult to make precise because they involve selective downgrading. Notions from epistemic logic have emerged as a good approach to policy semantics but a robust general framework remains elusive. A paper appearing in CSF 2018, entitled ``Assuming You Know: Epistemic Semantics of Relational Annotations for Expressive Flow Policies'', attempted to provide a unifying framework---but the formalization was sketchy and a correction was announced during the conference presentation. With aid from an agentic AI coding assistant, a corrected formalization has been machine checked in the Rocq proof assistant. The simplicity and generality of the framework may help compare different policy specification styles and enforce them by leveraging existing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CSF 2018论文中关于关系注释的认识论语义形式化不严谨的问题，借助智能体AI编码助手在Rocq证明助手中完成了修正后的形式化验证，提供了一个更简单、通用的框架来统一表达信息流安全策略。
AI.motivation: 许多高层安全需求涉及程序中的信息流控制，但由于涉及选择性降级（selective downgrading）而难以精确表述。认识论逻辑为策略语义提供了良好途径，但缺乏稳健的通用框架。此前CSF 2018论文试图提供统一框架，但其形式化不够严谨，且在会议演示时宣布了修正，因此需要一个经过完全验证的修正版本。
AI.method: 借助智能体AI编码助手的辅助，对原论文的框架进行了修正和重新形式化，并在Rocq证明助手中完成了机器验证（machine-checked），确保形式化推导的正确性。
AI.result: 得到了一个经过机器验证的、简单且通用的形式化框架，可用于比较不同的策略规范风格，并可借助现有技术加以执行。
AI.conclusion: 该修正后的框架的简洁性和通用性有助于统一不同策略规范风格的比较与实施，为信息流策略的认识论语义提供了稳健基础。

title: Representation Transfer of Foundation Models for Ultra-Widefield Retinal Imaging
summary: Despite the widespread adoption of foundation models as feature extractors for medical imaging, relatively little is understood about how different pretraining strategies influence the transferability of learned representations to weakly supervised ophthalmic imaging tasks. We investigate this question in ultra-widefield (UWF) retinal imaging by evaluating foundation model representations within a patch-based multiple instance learning (MIL) framework for disease classification on UWF images. We compare Vision Transformer encoders pretrained with supervised, Masked Autoencoder (MAE), and self-distillation objectives, while keeping the downstream aggregation architecture unchanged. Within a controlled comparison of ViT-B encoders pretrained on ImageNet-1k, the choice of pretraining objective substantially influenced frozen representation transfer, with supervised and self-distillation-based models outperforming MAE. A contemporary DINOv3 model pretrained at a larger scale achieved the strongest overall performance, with a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.863 for five-class diabetic retinopathy grading, comparable with DINOv1. Attention analysis further revealed distinct patch-aggregation behaviours associated with the different pretrained representations, while partial fine-tuning substantially reduced the performance gap for MAE. These findings suggest that pretraining strategy influences both representation transferability and the subsequent aggregation of patch-level evidence within MIL, resulting in differences in downstream classification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不同预训练策略对基础模型在超广角（UWF）视网膜图像弱监督分类任务中表征迁移能力的影响，通过补丁级多实例学习（MIL）框架比较了监督学习、MAE和自蒸馏三种预训练目标的ViT编码器，发现预训练策略显著影响冻结表征的迁移性能及后续补丁聚合行为。
AI.motivation: 尽管基础模型已广泛用作医学影像的特征提取器，但不同预训练策略对弱监督眼科影像任务中表征迁移能力的影响尚不清楚。理解这一差异对于在医学影像领域选择和应用基础模型至关重要。
AI.method: 在UWF视网膜图像上构建补丁级MIL框架进行疾病分类，使用ViT-B编码器进行受控对比：比较监督学习、MAE、自蒸馏三种预训练目标（均在ImageNet-1k上预训练），并使用更大规模预训练的当代DINOv3模型；通过部分微调实验及注意力分析深入研究预训练表征的影响。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1k上预训练的ViT-B中，监督学习和自蒸馏目标显著优于MAE；大规模预训练的DINOv3取得了最佳整体性能，在五类糖尿病视网膜病变分级中二次加权kappa达0.863，与DINOv1相当；注意力分析显示不同预训练表征具有不同的补丁聚合行为；部分微调大幅缩小了MAE的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 预训练策略不仅影响表征的迁移能力，还影响MIL中补丁级证据的后续聚合方式，最终导致下游分类性能的显著差异。这一发现对医学影像领域基础模型的选型和预训练策略设计具有重要指导意义。

title: EulerLoRA: Rank-Driven Jump Dynamics for Calibrated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning, but standard LoRA produces a single deterministic model and does not directly support predictive uncertainty estimation. We introduce EulerLoRA, a stochastic extension of LoRA that generates multiple predictive trajectories by sampling structured variations along the rank-one components of shared low-rank adapters, while preserving the deterministic LoRA transformation in expectation. We evaluate EulerLoRA with vision transformers on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and HAM10000, together with out-of-distribution detection on SVHN. Across these benchmarks, EulerLoRA achieves comparable or improved performance relative to strong LoRA-Ensemble baselines. Using two rank-20 adapters, EulerLoRA requires approximately 3 million trainable adapter parameters, compared with about 10 million for a rank-8, 16-adapter LoRA-Ensemble, corresponding to roughly 69% fewer trainable parameters. These results show that useful predictive diversity can be obtained from a small number of shared adapters.

AI.tldr: EulerLoRA是LoRA的随机扩展，通过沿共享低秩适配器的秩一分量采样结构化变化来生成多条预测轨迹，同时保持确定性LoRA变换的期望不变。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、HAM10000及SVHN OOD检测上，EulerLoRA达到或优于LoRA-Ensemble基线，并使用约300万可训练参数（比LoRA-Ensemble少约69%）获得有用的预测多样性。
AI.motivation: 标准LoRA只能产生单一确定性模型，无法直接支持预测不确定性估计，而传统集成方法（如LoRA-Ensemble）需要大量独立适配器，参数效率不高。作者希望在不显著增加参数的情况下获得预测多样性。
AI.method: EulerLoRA是LoRA的随机扩展，通过在共享低秩适配器的秩一分量上采样结构化变化来生成多条预测轨迹，同时保证期望上仍等同于确定性LoRA变换。该方法用少量共享适配器（如2个rank-20适配器）即可产生多样化的预测。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、HAM10000基准上，EulerLoRA性能与强LoRA-Ensemble基线相当或更好；在SVHN上的OOD检测也表现良好。使用2个rank-20适配器时需约300万可训练参数，远少于rank-8、16适配器LoRA-Ensemble的约1000万参数，减少约69%的可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 少量共享适配器即可获得有用的预测多样性，EulerLoRA在保持参数效率的同时实现了与LoRA-Ensemble相当的不确定性估计能力，为LoRA提供了一种高效的随机扩展方案。

title: Does Machine "know" interpersonal pragmatics? Evidence from MARBERT's learning of emoji pragmatics in Arabic digital discourse
summary: This study examines Transformer-based models' ability to learn emoji pragmatics in Arabic digital discourse (ADD), providing evidence from MARBERT's behavior with interpersonal pragmatic functions (IPFs). A corpus of 8,504 unique emoji-posts collected from Facebook via Python was used in the study. These posts were manually annotated, developed, and labeled for five IPFs: Politeness, Respect, Solidarity, Empathy, and Encouragement. A mixed-method approach was employed comprising statistical methods and interpretative analyses involving speech act theory, politeness theory, and rapport management theory. MARBERT was fine-tuned to model these context-dependent pragmatic functions. Findings demonstrate MARBERT's ability to learn these IPFs, achieving strong performance on unseen data, with an accuracy of 93%, a micro F1-score of 0.61, and a macro F1-score of 0.56, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing interpersonal functions beyond conventional sentiment analysis. Function-level evaluation showed that Politeness and Respect were identified more accurately than Solidarity, reflecting differences in the explicitness and contextual dependence of IPFs. The study concludes that Transformer-based models learn patterns of face management and relational communication but remain challenged by highly implicit social meanings. It contributes a novel computational approach to modeling emoji pragmatics and advances the integration of interpersonal pragmatics with NLP for digital communication research.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于Transformer的模型（MARBERT）在阿拉伯语数字话语中学习表情符号语用功能的能力，使用8,504条经过人工标注的表情符号帖子，对五种人际语用功能（礼貌、尊重、团结、共情、鼓励）进行建模，取得了93%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注情感分析，而忽视了表情符号在数字话语中承载的语用功能（如面子和关系管理）。该研究旨在填补表情符号语用学与NLP交叉领域的空白，探索Transformer模型能否学习超越传统情感分析的复杂人际语用功能。
AI.method: 从Facebook收集8,504条表情符号帖子构建语料库，人工标注五种IPFs；采用混合方法，结合统计分析和基于言语行为理论、礼貌理论、关系管理理论的解释性分析；微调MARBERT模型来建模上下文相关语用功能。
AI.result: MARBERT在未见数据上取得93%准确率、微F1分数0.61、宏F1分数0.56；功能级评估显示礼貌和尊重的识别准确率高于团结，反映不同IPF在显性程度和上下文依赖性上的差异。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型能学习面部管理和关系沟通的模式，但对高度隐含的社会意义仍有挑战；该研究为表情符号语用学建模提供了新的计算方法，推动了人际语用学与NLP在数字传播研究中的整合。

title: Neuro-Evolved Heuristics for Variable Gapped Common Subsequence Identification
summary:
This study addresses the Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence Problem (VGLCSP), a variant of the classical longest common subsequence problem with additional gap constraints and applications in sequence alignment and time-series analysis. While the two-sequence version has been widely studied using dynamic programming, the generalized multi-sequence form is usually solved with beam search-based heuristics, whose hand-crafted designs often lack robustness.
  To overcome this limitation, we propose a learning-based approach for automatically designing more effective data-driven heuristics. The heuristics are represented by a neural network with predefined architecture, whose weights are optimized by a genetic algorithm within a neuro-evolutionary framework. The learning process alternates between weight optimization and evaluation within an iterative multi-source beam search procedure, a state-of-the-art method for the problem. Rather than constructing solutions directly, the neural network learns to guide the search process, producing a neuro-evolved heuristic. We further introduce an ensemble heuristic that combines the scores of learned and the best-performing hand-crafted heuristic. Integrated into the iterative multi-source beam search framework, the resulting hybrid approach outperforms existing methods on both synthetic benchmark instances and newly introduced real-world instances with data-driven gap constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于学习的神经进化方法来自动设计启发式算法，用于解决多序列的可变间隙最长公共子序列问题（VGLCSP）。通过遗传算法优化神经网络权重，并在迭代多源束搜索框架中引导搜索过程，同时引入集成启发式结合学习与手工设计的优势，在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: VGLCSP的多序列版本通常依赖基于束搜索的启发式算法，但这些手工设计的启发式往往缺乏鲁棒性，难以在不同数据分布下保持稳定性能。现有方法在设计启发式时依赖于人工经验和直觉，缺乏系统性的自动优化手段。
AI.method: 提出一个神经进化框架：1）使用预定义架构的神经网络表示启发式，权重通过遗传算法优化；2）学习过程在权重优化和迭代多源束搜索评估之间交替进行；3）神经网络不直接构造解，而是学习引导搜索过程；4）进一步引入集成启发式，将学习到的启发式分数与最佳手工启发式分数结合。
AI.result: 混合方法（学习启发式+手工启发式融合）在合成基准实例和引入的带数据驱动间隙约束的真实世界实例上均超越了现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 神经进化的数据驱动启发式设计可以替代手工设计的启发式，通过自动化方式生成更鲁棒、更有效的搜索引导策略，为VGLCSP及其他组合优化问题提供了一种新的解决范式。

title: InstancePin: Instance-Addressable Layout-to-Image Diffusion via Coordinate Pinning
summary: Layout-to-image diffusion models have achieved impressive semantic controllability by conditioning generation on category-level segmentation maps. However, such category-aligned control is not necessarily instance-addressable: multiple nearby objects from the same category are often treated as a shared semantic region, leading to ambiguous boundaries, averaged appearances, and feature confusion among instances. This limitation is particularly evident in urban scene synthesis, where small and crowded pedestrians or vehicles require fine-grained instance separation while preserving global scene consistency. In this paper, we propose InstancePin, an instance-addressable layout-to-image diffusion framework that pins each object instance with an explicit coordinate anchor. Instead of directly injecting instance masks into the pretrained backbone, InstancePin introduces an independent instance-aware adapter to preserve the category-level generation prior while learning instance-specific spatial control. For each instance, its center coordinate is encoded with Fourier features and projected into a coordinate token, which serves as a spatial anchor queried by latent image features through coordinate pinning attention. To make these anchors spatially meaningful, we further supervise the coordinate attention maps with instance regions, encouraging each coordinate token to activate its corresponding object area. Finally, an instance-mask guided fusion module routes pretrained backbone features to non-instance regions and adapter features to instance regions, enabling local instance refinement without sacrificing global semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments on Cityscapes demonstrate that InstancePin mitigates instance entanglement in dense layouts and improves both image fidelity and semantic consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InstancePin，一个实例级可寻址的布局到图像扩散框架。通过为每个目标实例添加坐标锚点，并结合独立实例感知适配器、坐标固定注意力和实例掩码引导融合模块，解决同一类别中多个邻近实例被当作共享语义区域导致的边界模糊、外观平均化和特征混淆问题，在Cityscapes数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的布局到图像扩散模型虽然通过类别级分割图实现了语义可控生成，但无法实现实例级寻址——同一类别的多个邻近对象常被视为共享语义区域，导致实例间边界模糊、外观趋于平均、特征混淆。尤其在城市场景合成中，拥挤的小型行人和车辆需要细粒度实例分离，同时需保持全局场景一致性。
AI.method: InstancePin由三个关键组件构成：(1) 独立实例感知适配器，不直接注入实例掩码到预训练骨干，而是保留类别级生成先验的同时学习实例级空间控制；(2) 每个实例的中心坐标通过傅里叶特征编码并投影为坐标token，作为空间锚点，由潜在图像特征通过坐标固定注意力（coordinate pinning attention）查询；(3) 通过监督坐标注意力图与实例区域对齐，使每个坐标token激活对应目标区域；最后实例掩码引导融合模块将预训练骨干特征路由到非实例区域、适配器特征路由到实例区域，实现局部实例细化而不牺牲全局语义保真。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes数据集上的大量实验表明，InstancePin缓解了密集布局中的实例纠缠问题，同时提升了图像保真度和语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: InstancePin通过引入显式坐标锚点实现了实例级可寻址的布局到图像生成，在保持类别级生成先验的同时实现了细粒度实例控制，为城市场景等密集布局合成提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Differentiable Lifting for Topological Neural Networks
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026 (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=eC89CbINIw). 20 pages, 4 figures
summary: Topological neural networks (TNNs) enable leveraging high-order structures on graphs (e.g., cycles and cliques) to boost the expressive power of message-passing neural networks. In turn, however, these structures are typically identified a priori through an unsupervised graph lifting operation. Notwithstanding, this choice is crucial and may have a drastic impact on a TNN's performance on downstream tasks. To circumvent this issue, we propose $\partial$lift (DiffLift), a general framework for learning graph liftings to hypergraphs and cellular- and simplicial complexes in an end-to-end fashion. In particular, our approach leverages learned vertex-level latent representations to identify and parameterize distributions over candidate higher-order cells for inclusion. This results in a scalable model which can be readily integrated into any TNN. Our experiments show that $\partial$lift outperforms existing lifting methods on multiple benchmarks for graph and node classification across different TNN architectures. Notably, our approach leads to gains of up to 45% over static liftings, including both connectivity- and feature-based ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出∂lift（DiffLift），一个用于端到端学习图提升（graph lifting）到超图、胞腔复形和单纯复形的通用框架。通过利用学习到的顶点级潜在表征来识别和参数化候选高阶单元的分布，该方法可无缝集成到任意拓扑神经网络（TNN）中，在多个图与节点分类基准上优于现有的静态提升方法，最高可获得45%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 拓扑神经网络（TNNs）利用图上的高阶结构（如环、团）来增强消息传递神经网络的表达能力。然而，这些高阶结构通常需要通过无监督的图提升操作预先识别，这一选择对TNN在下游任务上的性能至关重要，但目前缺乏可学习的方式来优化这一过程。
AI.method: 提出∂lift框架，利用学习到的顶点级潜在表征来识别和参数化候选高阶单元的分布，以端到端方式学习图提升到超图、胞腔复形和单纯复形，实现可扩展且可集成到任意TNN中的提升方法。
AI.result: 在多个图与节点分类基准上，∂lift在多种不同的TNN架构中均优于现有的提升方法。相比静态提升（包括基于连通性和基于特征的方法），性能提升最高可达45%。
AI.conclusion: ∂lift证明了将图提升操作从无监督的先验选择转变为端到端可学习的组件，能够显著提升TNN在各类下游任务中的表现，为拓扑深度学习提供了一种更灵活、更优的提升策略。

title: When Words Divide: Diachronic Ideological Polarization in Political Discourse on Social Media
summary: Political polarization has become a defining feature of online discourse, yet its long-term evolution remains poorly understood. We present a longitudinal analysis of ideological polarization in Reddit discussions by measuring semantic differences in the language used by opposing political communities. We construct temporally aligned community-specific word embeddings and quantify ideological polarization as the semantic divergence of political concepts over time. Our analysis shows that ideological polarization has increased substantially during the study period, both at the concept- and topic-level. Unlike prior computational work, which has largely focused on cross-sectional analyses or affective dimensions of polarization at a single point at time, our approach captures the evolution of ideological differences in semantic framing. The proposed framework provides a scalable method for studying the temporal dynamics of ideological polarization in large-scale social media discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种纵向分析方法，通过构建时间对齐的社区特定词嵌入，量化Reddit上对立政治社区之间的意识形态极化随时间的演变，发现研究期间意识形态极化在概念和主题层面都显著增加。
AI.motivation: 政治极化已成为在线话语的显著特征，但其长期演变过程仍缺乏深入理解。现有计算研究多聚焦于横截面分析或单一时间点的情感维度，无法捕捉意识形态差异在语义框架上的动态演化。
AI.method: 构建时间对齐的社区特定词嵌入，测量对立政治社区使用语言中的语义差异，将意识形态极化量化为政治概念随时间推移的语义分歧程度。
AI.result: 研究发现研究期间意识形态极化在概念层面和主题层面均显著增加。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展的方法，用于研究大规模社交媒体话语中意识形态极化的时间动态，弥补了以往横截面研究在时间维度上的不足。

title: CADIR: A Cross-Backend Editable Intermediate Representation for Agentic CAD Generation
summary: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADIR，一种基于OCCT几何内核的可执行中间表示，用于CAD程序生成和跨后端编辑。它通过显式组合建模操作、构造图记录和几何签名匹配技术，实现了不同CAD系统（FreeCAD、SolidWorks、Fusion 360）间的可靠重建与编辑，同时支持基于构造图的文本/图像检索。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD生成方法要么使用后端特定的顺序脚本（隐含依赖关系，难以跨系统编辑），要么使用静态几何（丢失构建历史）。缺乏一种能同时保留构建历史、稳定拓扑引用和特征级可编辑性的统一表示。
AI.method: 1) 构建CADIR中间表示：基于OCCT几何内核（通过OCP），提供显式组合建模操作和细粒度执行诊断。2) 程序执行时记录建模操作、参数依赖、约束和拓扑选择，形成构造图。3) 提出几何签名匹配（Geometric Signature Matching）方法，识别跨参数变化和后端差异的对应边/面，实现跨后端原生可编辑特征历史重建。4) 提出构造图检索方法，支持全文和子图检索用于文本/图像查询。
AI.result: 实验表明CADIR在几何保真度和执行可靠性上优于现有CAD表示；构造图检索进一步提升了模型生成质量；跨后端编辑在多个CAD环境中实现了可靠的模型重建和重建后编辑。
AI.conclusion: CADIR作为代理友好的可执行中间表示，成功解决了CAD生成中的跨后端一致性问题，为多CAD环境下的可编辑模型生成提供了新的范式，同时构造图检索为代理利用已有模型知识提供了有效途径。

title: Diagnosing Under-Development of Irreversible Processes in Video Generation
summary: Many physical attributes are \emph{irreversible}: ice melts but does not re-freeze, paper chars but does not un-burn. Do video generators respect this? We show the question is hard to measure, and that what can be measured reliably is \emph{development} rather than reversal. Metrics of local reversal are null-degenerate: a per-clip violation rate scores $0.50$ on pure noise, and a variance-normalized reversal residual sits at its noise ceiling. What survives null-testing is a two-part protocol: progress (a directional attribute correlation) and a stasis rate. Under this protocol, generated video separates cleanly from real footage, and the gap is human-validated. Across seven text-to-video models, real reference footage advances ($ρ{=}{+}0.40$, $35\%$ static) while every generator shows near-zero progress and $92$--$100\%$ stasis; nine annotators rate real footage far above generated ($2.75$ vs.\ $0.99$ on a $0$--$4$ scale). The reliable finding is \emph{under-development}: generators barely advance irreversible attributes rather than reversing them. As a complementary mechanism, we show that post-hoc readout guidance is gameable, whereas enforcing monotonicity by construction in a disentangled attribute latent removes the gameable readout, validated in controlled and semi-synthetic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视频生成模型是否尊重"不可逆物理属性"（如冰融化、纸燃烧）。作者发现测量"逆转"本身不可靠（存在噪声退化问题），转而提出"进展"与"停滞率"两部分协议进行可靠测量。结果显示真实视频在不可逆属性上显著进展，而7个文生视频模型几乎零进展且92-100%停滞，证明生成器的问题是"欠发展"而非"逆转"。
AI.motivation: 物理世界中的许多属性是不可逆的（冰融化不会重新冻结），但视频生成模型是否尊重这一基本物理规律尚不清楚。然而作者发现直接测量"逆转"在方法论上存在根本困难（指标对噪声退化、统计检验失效），因此需要一个可靠且可验证的测量协议来评估生成视频与真实视频在这方面的差异。
AI.method: 1) 提出两部分协议：进展（方向性属性相关性ρ）和停滞率；2) 通过null-testing排除噪声退化指标；3) 跨7个文生视频模型进行评估；4) 使用9名标注者进行人类验证；5) 提出两种机制校正：后验读出引导（被发现可被博弈）和构造性单调性约束（在解耦属性隐空间中强制单调性，去除可博弈读出），在受控和半合成设置中验证。
AI.result: 真实参考视频在不可逆属性上表现出进展（ρ=+0.40，35%停滞），而所有7个视频生成模型几乎零进展，92-100%停滞。9名标注者对真实视频的评分（2.75/4）远高于生成视频（0.99/4）。此外，后验读出引导方法可被博弈操控，而构造性单调性约束则更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 生成式视频模型的可靠缺陷是"欠发展"——它们在不可逆属性上几乎不推进而非逆转。这一发现通过严格的统计检验和人类验证确认，并指明了一种更稳健的约束机制（构造性单调性）来改善生成模型对物理不可逆性的尊重。

title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Traffic Congestion Prediction: Unveiling the Impact of Different COVID-19 Periods
summary: Traffic congestion prediction is essential for congestion mitigation, but the COVID-19 pandemic and related control measures altered travel behavior and increased prediction complexity. This study predicts congestion in Alameda County, California, during pre-lockdown, lockdown, and post-lockdown periods. Weather, seasonality, and COVID-19 variables are incorporated, and Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation is used to select important features and reduce overfitting. Support vector regression, multiple linear regression, recurrent neural networks, and long short-term memory networks are trained and optimized. Because LSTM is more sensitive to hyperparameter settings, an adaptive parameter selection approach is used, while SVR and RNN are manually tuned. Performance is evaluated using Normalized Root Mean Square Error. Bidirectional LSTM consistently performs best across all periods because it captures temporal dependence in both directions. Integrated Gradients is used to interpret Bi-LSTM predictions, and SHapley Additive exPlanations is applied to SVR. New COVID-19 cases have a mainly negative effect on congestion during lockdown and post-lockdown, likely due to greater risk awareness, voluntary travel reduction, and compliance with mobility restrictions. In the post-pandemic period, higher hospitalization reduces travel and congestion, while higher fuel prices do not prevent a shift toward private vehicles and therefore increase congestion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国加州阿拉米达县在疫情封锁前、封锁中和封锁后的交通拥堵预测，融合天气、季节性和COVID-19变量，比较多种机器学习模型，发现双向LSTM表现最佳，并用可解释性方法揭示COVID-19病例、住院率和油价对拥堵的影响。
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情及其防控措施改变了人们的出行行为，导致交通拥堵预测变得更加复杂困难。需要专门研究疫情期间不同阶段的拥堵预测，并理解疫情相关因素对交通拥堵的影响。
AI.method: 融合天气、季节性和COVID-19变量构建预测特征；使用递归特征消除与交叉验证（RFECV）进行特征选择和防过拟合；训练并优化支持向量回归（SVR）、多元线性回归（MLR）、循环神经网络（RNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）；对LSTM采用自适应参数选择，SVR和RNN采用手动调参；使用归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）评估性能；运用Integrated Gradients解释Bi-LSTM，SHAP解释SVR。
