title: FreqAnchorAD: Language-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection via Frequency-Deviation Anchoring
summary: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) aims to detect anomalies and localize defective regions in unseen target domains without target training data. Recent ZSAD methods build on pretrained vision models, particularly CLIP, and construct normal and anomaly references from textual prompts or learnable visual representations. These methods perform anomaly discrimination primarily in spatial feature spaces, where subtle changes in texture, boundaries, and local structures can be confused with normal appearance variations. Although inconspicuous spatially, such defects can disrupt local texture regularity or boundary continuity, inducing response deviations across frequency bands. However, existing ZSAD methods do not explicitly model these frequency-dependent characteristics. Our image-domain analysis reveals that local defects exhibit spatial-frequency deviations from normal references across low-, middle-, and high-frequency bands, indicating that anomaly evidence is not universally dominated by high-frequency responses. Motivated by this observation, we propose FreqAnchorAD, a frequency-aware framework that organizes frequency-enhanced responses for anchor-relative anomaly discrimination. Specifically, the Local Frequency Compensation Module (LFCM) enhances intermediate patch tokens with local spatial-frequency cues. The Frequency-Deviation Anchor Projector (FDAP), our core discrimination module, organizes enhanced responses along a source-derived channel coordinate and measures anomaly evidence through relative similarity to normal and anomaly anchors. Finally, Asymmetric Anchor Supervision (AAS) stabilizes normal-anchor alignment while preserving diverse anomaly patterns. Experiments on thirteen industrial and medical benchmarks show that FreqAnchorAD achieves state-of-the-art mean performance in image-level anomaly recognition and pixel-level defect localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FreqAnchorAD，一种频率感知的零样本异常检测框架。通过对图像域的空间-频率分析，发现局部缺陷在低、中、高频带上均表现出与正常参考的偏差，而非传统认知中仅由高频响应主导。FreqAnchorAD通过局部频率补偿模块(LFCM)、频率偏差锚点投影器(FDAP)和不对称锚点监督(AAS)三个组件，在13个工业和医学基准上实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本异常检测方法主要在空间特征空间中进行异常判别，忽略了频率域信息。局部缺陷虽然空间上不明显，但会扰乱局部纹理规律或边界连续性，导致跨频带的响应偏差。然而现有方法未显式建模频率依赖特性，因此需要一种频率感知框架来捕捉这些细微异常线索。
AI.method: 提出FreqAnchorAD框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) LFCM增强中间patch token的局部空间-频率线索；(2) FDAP作为核心判别模块，沿源域导出的通道坐标系组织增强响应，通过与正常/异常锚点的相对相似度测量异常证据；(3) AAS稳定正常锚点对齐同时保留多样的异常模式。
AI.result: 在13个工业和医学基准数据集上，FreqAnchorAD在图像级异常识别和像素级缺陷定位方面均达到最先进的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模频率域响应偏差，并将其与锚点相对判别相结合，FreqAnchorAD有效弥补了现有方法忽略频率信息的不足，为零样本异常检测提供了新的频率感知范式。

title: Spatiotemporal Proximal Causal Inference under Hidden Confounding and Interference
summary: Estimating causal effects from real-world spatiotemporal data is challenging due to hidden confounders and interference. Standard causal identification methods assume conditional exchangeability given observed covariates, which fails whenever hidden confounders affect both treatment and outcomes - a common setting in domains such as climate, environmental policy, epidemiology, and regional economics. In this paper, we propose a novel spatiotemporal proximal causal inference framework that extends proximal identification theory to spatiotemporal settings. The proposed method jointly captures local and neighborhood-level confounding information by introducing treatment- and outcome-inducing proxies, and we derive a spatiotemporal outcome confounding bridge function that identifies the potential outcome without requiring direct recovery of the hidden confounder. We establish the identifiability of this bridge function under proxy exclusion restrictions and a spatiotemporal completeness condition, and show that the resulting estimator recovers the outcome through a proximal generalization of the g-computation formula. To operationalize this identification result, we propose a neural architecture that learns proxies via transformer-based spatiotemporal encoders - coupled with a conditional mutual information critic to enforce exclusion restrictions and a moment-matching network to guarantee that the learned bridge function satisfies the underlying identifying equation. We further introduce a stabilized weighting scheme to address treatment support imbalance. Experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves comparable performance to baseline causal inference methods, while providing, to our knowledge, the first theoretically grounded outcomes for the hidden confounding in the presence of spatiotemporal interference through a proximal causal inference framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种时空近端因果推断框架，通过引入处理诱导和结果诱导代理变量来捕捉局部和邻域级的隐藏混杂信息，推导出时空结果混杂桥函数以识别潜在结果，并设计了一种基于Transformer的神经架构（结合互信息critic和矩匹配网络）来实现该识别结果。
AI.motivation: 时空数据中的因果效应估计面临隐藏混杂和干扰的挑战，标准因果识别方法依赖条件可交换性假设，但在气候、环境政策、流行病学等领域中隐藏混杂因素同时影响处理和结果，导致现有方法失效。
AI.method: 1) 扩展近端识别理论到时空设置，引入处理诱导和结果诱导代理变量；2) 推导时空结果混杂桥函数识别潜在结果，无需直接恢复隐藏混杂；3) 在代理排除限制和时空完备性条件下建立可识别性；4) 提出近端g-计算公式的时空推广；5) 设计Transformer编码器学习代理、条件互信息critic执行排除限制、矩匹配网络保证桥函数满足识别方程；6) 引入稳定加权方案处理处理支持不平衡。
AI.result: 在合成数据集上的实验表明，该方法与基线因果推断方法性能相当，并提供了首个在时空干扰下通过近端因果推断框架处理隐藏混杂的理论上有根据的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次为时空干扰场景下的隐藏混杂问题提供了近端因果推断框架的理论依据，通过代理变量和桥函数实现了无需恢复隐藏混杂的有效因果效应估计，为气候、流行病学等领域的实际应用奠定了理论基础。

title: LongChart VQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLMs with Complex Multi-Chart Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving with expanded context windows and stronger reasoning capabilities, enabling multi-chart understanding and multi-step inference. These abilities are increasingly important as MLLMs are adopted in complex agentic tasks. However, existing benchmarks largely emphasize single-chart perception, while simple chart-to-chart connections are insufficient to evaluate these capabilities. To capture multi-chart complexity while ensuring consistency and validity, we design a synthesis pipeline supported by latent graphs. Building on this pipeline, we introduce LongChart, a benchmark whose VQA sets contain an average of 6.5 images and 31.2 questions. We evaluate 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs and examine three factors that influence performance: reasoning patterns, auxiliary tools, and robustness to image perturbations. Our results show that MLLM accuracy decreases and varies substantially as computational complexity increases, highlighting directions for future research in multi-chart reasoning.

AI.tldr: 针对多图理解与多步推理能力的评估需求，本文提出LongChart基准，通过潜在图支持的合成流水线生成包含平均6.5张图像和31.2个问题的VQA数据集，并评估了10个最先进MLLM在推理模式、辅助工具和图像扰动鲁棒性三个因素下的表现，发现计算复杂度增加时准确率显著下降且波动增大。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM基准大多仅强调单图感知能力，即使涉及多图也仅考察简单的图间连接，无法充分评估MLLM在多图理解和多步推理方面的能力，而随着MLLM在复杂智能体任务中的部署，这些能力变得越来越重要。
AI.method: 设计了一个由潜在图（latent graphs）支持的合成流水线，以此确保多图数据的一致性和有效性。基于该流水线构建了LongChart基准，其VQA集合平均包含6.5张图像和31.2个问题，并对10个最先进MLLM进行评估。
AI.result: 实验考察了推理模式、辅助工具和图像扰动鲁棒性三个影响性能的因素。结果表明，随着计算复杂度增加，MLLM的准确率下降且性能波动显著增大。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLM在多图推理任务上仍面临挑战，计算复杂度的增加会显著影响模型表现，这为未来多图推理研究指明了方向。

title: Toward Fine-Grained Forgetting:Attribute Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit strong vision--language capabilities but may also memorize and disclose sensitive information. Machine unlearning seeks to remove designated knowledge without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. Existing privacy-oriented benchmarks primarily adopt profile-level deletion, whereas practical requests are often finer grained: a model should forget a specified attribute while retaining non-sensitive information about the same identity. We therefore introduce attribute-level MLLM unlearning as a finer-grained task and construct a benchmark spanning long-text, numeric, and short-text targets, multiple forget ratios, and diverse question types. Our evaluation reveals that target and retained attributes share identity-specific and visual evidence, making selective forgetting susceptible to residual leakage or collateral degradation; accordingly, existing methods exhibit unstable forgetting--retention trade-offs in this setting. To address this challenge, we propose Causal Localization and Retain-Aware Projection (CLRP), a lightweight training-free framework. CLRP uses activation patching to identify the layer that causally mediates target-attribute disclosure, then applies a retain-aware projection that removes the target-attribute subspace while preserving same-identity evidence. Experiments across multiple widely used MLLMs with distinct architectures and parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness of CLRP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出属性级多模态大模型（MLLM）机器遗忘任务，构建了涵盖长文本、数值和短文本目标的基准，并提出CLRP（因果定位与保留感知投影）这一轻量级免训练框架，通过激活修补定位因果层并执行保留感知投影，在遗忘目标属性的同时保留同身份的非敏感信息。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私导向基准主要采用档案级删除，但实际请求通常更细粒度——模型应遗忘特定属性而保留同一身份的非敏感信息。现有方法在属性级遗忘场景下因目标和保留属性共享身份特定及视觉证据，导致选择性遗忘易受残留泄漏或附带退化影响，遗忘-保留权衡不稳定。
AI.method: 提出CLRP框架，包含两个核心步骤：(1) 使用激活修补（activation patching）识别因果调节目标属性泄露的层；(2) 应用保留感知投影（retain-aware projection），移除目标属性子空间同时保留同身份证据。该框架为轻量级、免训练方案。
AI.result: 在多种广泛使用的MLLM（架构和参数量各不相同）上进行的实验证明了CLRP的有效性，相比现有方法在遗忘-保留权衡中表现更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 属性级MLLM遗忘是一项更具挑战性的细粒度任务，CLRP通过因果定位和保留感知投影有效解决了选择性遗忘中的泄漏与退化问题，为MLLM隐私保护提供了可行的免训练方案。

title: AeroLLE: Constrained Pseudo-Supervision for Nighttime Aerial Image Enhancement with the AeroNight-1.5K Benchmark
summary: Nighttime aerial image enhancement is challenged by spatially nonuniform exposure, mixed illumination, and weak structural evidence, while registered normal-light targets are difficult to capture from moving platforms. Generated normal-light images provide practical appearance guidance but may alter geometry or texture. We introduce \aeronight{}, comprising 1,500 real nighttime aerial RGB images: 1,300 inputs are associated with manually screened pseudo-references, and 200 inputs support unpaired evaluation. We propose AeroLLE, a two-stage framework that first recovers visibility with an HVI Base Enhancer and then performs Spatially Adaptive Exposure--Color Calibration (SAECC). After the Base Enhancer is selected and frozen, SAECC predicts bounded, low-resolution RGB gain and bias fields, restricting the magnitude and spatial variation of the second-stage correction. Experiments under complementary pseudo-paired and unpaired protocols demonstrate improved agreement with screened appearance targets, together with more balanced exposure and color correction across diverse nighttime aerial scenes. These results support constrained, stage-specific calibration as a practical strategy for learning from generated appearance guidance when registered aerial references are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AeroNight数据集（1,500张真实夜间航拍RGB图像）和AeroLLE两阶段增强框架，在缺少配准真值的情况下利用生成伪参考图进行可见性恢复与空间自适应曝光-颜色校正。
AI.motivation: 夜间航拍图像增强面临空间不均匀曝光、混合光照和弱结构信息等挑战；同时由于平台移动，难以获得配准的正常光照目标，而生成的正常光照图像虽然能提供外观参考，但可能改变几何或纹理信息。
AI.method: 提出AeroLLE两阶段框架：第一阶段使用HVI基础增强器恢复可见性，第二阶段进行空间自适应曝光-颜色校正（SAECC）。先选择并冻结基础增强器，然后SAECC预测有界、低分辨率的RGB增益和偏置场，限制第二阶段校正的幅度和空间变化。
AI.result: 在互补的伪配对和无配对协议下进行实验，结果表明与筛选后的外观目标一致性更好，在多样化夜间航拍场景中曝光和颜色校正更均衡。
AI.conclusion: 约束的、阶段特定的校准是在缺乏配准航拍参考时，从生成外观指导中学习的实用策略。

title: Do Neural Networks Really Beat the Curse of Dimensionality? A Bit-Complexity View
summary:
Traditional approximation theory measures convergence rates in terms of the number of parameters or degrees of freedom. However, practical computation operates under finite precision: parameters must be encoded using a finite number of bits. Therefore, approximation efficiency should be evaluated in terms of computational bit complexity, which is intrinsically connected to the metric entropy of the underlying function class.
  In this work, we develop a unified approximation framework based on binary encoding and metric entropy. We analyze classical methods (including polynomial approximation, sparse grids, and finite elements) as well as shallow and deep neural networks, and compare their approximation rates for function classes with comparable metric entropy. We observe that, when evaluated in terms of bits, most classical methods are in general suboptimal relative to the intrinsic limits dictated by metric entropy, while neural network methods may exhibit different behaviors. We show that when complexity is measured in bits rather than parameters, no method fundamentally exceeds the approximation order achieved by classical approaches.
  Our results also indicate that many seeming advantages of neural networks, including dimension-independent rates and superconvergence phenomena, stem from differences in function class complexity rather than intrinsic architectural superiority. In this sense, the traditional curse of dimensionality can be misleading; the fundamental limitation is instead a curse of bit complexity, governed by metric entropy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于二进制编码和度量熵的统一近似框架，从计算比特复杂度的角度重新审视经典逼近方法（多项式、稀疏网格、有限元）和神经网络方法的逼近效率，指出许多神经网络看似优越的性质实际上源于函数类复杂度的差异而非架构本身的优势。
AI.motivation: 传统逼近理论仅以参数数量来衡量收敛速度，但实际计算受限于有限精度，参数必须以有限比特编码。因此逼近效率应依据计算比特复杂度来评估，这本质上与函数类的度量熵相关。作者希望纠正以参数数量衡量逼近效率的偏差。
AI.method: 建立基于二进制编码和度量熵的统一逼近框架，对经典方法（多项式逼近、稀疏网格、有限元）以及浅层和深度神经网络进行对比分析，从比特复杂度角度评估它们在具有可比度量熵的函数类上的逼近率。
AI.result: 在比特维度评估时，大多数经典方法相对于度量熵所决定的内在极限通常是次优的；神经网络方法可能表现出不同行为，但以比特衡量复杂度时，没有任何方法能从根本上超越经典方法所达到的逼近阶。许多神经网络的优势（如维度无关速率和超收敛现象）源于函数类复杂度的差异而非架构优越性。
AI.conclusion: 传统维度灾难的概念可能具有误导性；根本的限制应被理解为由度量熵主导的比特复杂度灾难（"比特复杂度诅咒"），而非单纯受维度影响的维度灾难。

title: Prompt-Induced Waste in Large Reasoning Models: A Preregistered Two-Harness Benchmark of Coding Agents
summary: Large reasoning models used as coding agents incur costs from deliberation, tool calls, and repeated agent turns, yet the causal effect of prompt wording on this spend has not been measured systematically. We present a preregistered benchmark across six large reasoning models, two real agent harnesses, and 24 deterministic coding tasks with hidden evaluators. Across 4,643 valid runs, including screening, stress, holdout, replication, and cross-provider studies, we find that prompt formulation can multiply reasoning cost without improving correctness. Asking the model to develop and compare several approaches is the most consistently wasteful instruction, increasing reasoning tokens by 2.4-7.4x across all models. Generic "think deeply" cues also increase deliberation by 1.6-2.2x, while a bounded-efficiency template specifying scope, acceptance criteria, and a stop condition is cost-neutral and can halve reasoning. Harness choice matters even more: identical model-task-prompt triples cost 5-30x more per success under Claude Code than under pi, mainly because of larger static prefixes and more turns. Misleading architectural hints are far costlier than irrelevant prose, and provider-side caching reduces billed cost without changing behavior, so it must not be treated as efficiency. Replications on Kimi-K3 and Claude Sonnet 5 preserve the main effect directions while revealing model-specific sensitivity to thinking and certainty cues. Overall, prompt wording and harness design materially affect agent cost, often with no gain in task success.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册基准实验，系统测量了提示词措辞和智能体框架对大型推理模型编码成本的因果影响。研究发现提示词表述可使推理成本增加数倍但不提升正确率，"开发并比较多个方案"的指令最浪费资源（推理token增加2.4-7.4倍），框架选择比提示词影响更大（成本差异5-30倍），误导性架构线索比无关文本成本高得多。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型用作编码智能体会产生大量成本（推理、工具调用、多次代理回合），但提示词措辞对这些支出的因果效应从未被系统测量过。作者希望填补这一空白，为实际使用提供经济性指导。
AI.method: 预注册基准实验：跨越6个大型推理模型、2个真实智能体框架、24个确定性编码任务（含隐藏评估器），共4,643次有效运行，涵盖筛选、压力、保留、复制和跨供应商研究。
AI.result: 1) "开发并比较多个方案"指令使推理token增加2.4-7.4倍但无正确率提升；2) 通用"深入思考"提示增加1.6-2.2倍推理；3) 有界效率模板成本中性甚至可减半推理；4) 框架选择比提示词更关键：Claude Code比pi贵5-30倍/成功；5) 误导性架构线索远贵于无关文本；6) 供应商端缓存降低计费成本但不改变行为。
AI.conclusion: 提示词措辞和智能体框架设计都会显著影响智能体成本，且往往不带来任务成功率的提升。研究复制实验（Kimi-K3和Claude Sonnet 5）验证了主要效应方向，同时揭示了模型对思考和确定性提示的敏感性差异。

title: FactorJEPA: Factorizing Monolithic Futures into Layout-Agent-Interaction Channels for Crowded and Chaotic Global South Urban Worlds
summary:
World models have attracted significant attention for their ability to capture and predict the structure and dynamics of the physical world. In this emerging landscape, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer a particularly compelling direction.
  We study a largely unexplored regime: populous, crowded, and chaotic Global South urban environments, which we call DENSEWORLD. Unlike the lower-density, lane-structured settings that dominate existing evaluations, these scenes exhibit soft spatial boundaries, extreme agent heterogeneity, persistent occlusion, and rapid social negotiation under mixed traffic. We introduce the first large-scale dataset for this regime: 1,000 hours of drive-through, walk-through, and aerial video across 22 cities. Existing JEPA formulations struggle to preserve dense interaction dynamics under heterogeneity and partial observability.
  We introduce FactorJEPA, which makes world structure a first-class predictive primitive. Rather than encoding the future in a monolithic latent, it composes layout, entities, and interactions, using a visibility gate and separated subspaces to preserve partially observed agents and discourage cross-factor shortcuts. FactorJEPA improves (i) future-latent accuracy (Future-frame L1), (ii) intervention-sensitive prediction (Causal L1), and (iii) robustness to reduced visual evidence (Mask-ratio slope), while exposing (iv) a reproducible motion-information trade-off (Motion cosine). Method rankings replicate across 2B and 1B V-JEPA 2.1 backbones, with rho = 0.895 to 0.978.
  We publicly release the DENSEWORLD-115k dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/denseworld-115k) and the surgery-trained FactorJEPA checkpoints (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/factorjepa-outputs/tree/main/outputs/full/vjepa_2_1_vitg_1B/train/m09c_surgery_3stage_DI_diheavy_encoder).

AI.tldr: 本文提出DENSEWORLD-115k，这是首个针对全球南方拥挤混乱城市环境的大规模驾驶数据集（1000小时、22个城市视频），并引入FactorJEPA架构，通过将布局、实体和交互作为预测原语，配合可见性门控和分离子空间，在密集异质场景中显著提升未来潜在表示精度、因果敏感预测精度和遮挡鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型和JEPA研究主要聚焦于低密度、车道结构化的驾驶场景，而全球南方城市的拥挤、混乱、异质性强的环境（软空间边界、极端异质agent、持续遮挡、混合交通下的快速社会协商）被严重忽视。现有JEPA在异构和部分可观测条件下难以保持密集交互动态。
AI.method: FactorJEPA将世界结构作为一等预测原语：不将未来编码为单一整体潜变量，而是将布局、实体和交互分开建模；引入可见性门控和分离子空间来保留部分观测的agent，并防止跨因素捷径。同时发布DENSEWORLD-115k数据集，包含1000小时、22个城市的行车、步行和航拍视频。
AI.result: FactorJEPA在三个维度上优于现有方法：（i）未来潜在空间精度（Future-frame L1）、（ii）干预敏感预测（Causal L1）、（iii）减少视觉证据时的鲁棒性（Mask-ratio slope），并暴露了（iv）可复现的运动信息权衡（Motion cosine）。方法排名在2B和1B V-JEPA 2.1骨干上一致（rho=0.895-0.978）。
AI.conclusion: 因子化结构表示是处理密集、异质、部分可观测城市场景的关键，该工作和数据集为世界模型研究开辟了全球南方城市这一被忽视但极具挑战性的领域。

title: Coverage-Driven Adaptive Keyframe Selection for Video Understanding
summary: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have enabled long-video understanding and analysis. However, processing the large number of frames in a video incurs substantial computational overhead. Existing methods reduce LVLM inference costs by scoring frame-query relevance before inference and selecting keyframes accordingly. Nevertheless, the distribution of relevant frames varies across queries, and these methods often need to score hundreds or thousands of frames. To address this limitation, we propose CSES, a training-free semantic keyframe selector that adaptively determines the numbers of frames to score and keyframes to select. CSES estimates the prominence of the frame-query relevance profile to guide active acquisition and adapt the temporal coverage of each input. It then formulates keyframe selection as a coverage problem that jointly accounts for semantic relevance, temporal redundancy, and visual redundancy. Active acquisition and keyframe selection terminate based on coverage saturation. The selection objective is monotone and submodular, enabling greedy optimization with a standard approximation guarantee. Experiments with four LVLMs on two benchmarks show that our method preserves accuracy while scoring $4$-$13\times$ fewer frames and selecting $18.4\%$-$20.5\%$ fewer input keyframes than existing baselines. CSES further achieves a $3.1$-$5.4\times$ speedup in frame selection over baselines.

AI.tldr: CSES是一个无需训练的语义关键帧选择器，通过自适应决定需要评分的帧数和选择的关键帧数，利用活动采集和覆盖问题建模，在保持精度的同时显著减少帧评分和关键帧选择数量，并加速帧选择过程。
AI.motivation: 大规模视觉语言模型（LVLMs）处理长视频时计算开销巨大。现有方法虽通过在推理前对帧与查询的相关性进行评分来选择关键帧，但相关帧的分布因查询而异，且这些方法往往需要对成百上千帧进行评分，效率低下。
AI.method: CSES通过估计帧-查询相关性分布的显著性来引导活动采集并自适应调整时间覆盖范围；将关键帧选择建模为覆盖问题，联合考虑语义相关性、时间冗余和视觉冗余；活动采集与关键帧选择基于覆盖饱和终止；选择目标满足单调子模性质，可通过贪婪优化获得标准近似保证。
AI.result: 在四个LVLM和两个基准上的实验表明，CSES在保持精度的同时，比现有基线少评分4-13倍的帧，少选择18.4%-20.5%的输入关键帧，并实现3.1-5.4倍的帧选择加速。
AI.conclusion: CSES通过自适应活动采集和覆盖优化，有效解决了长视频关键帧选择中帧评分效率低、关键帧数量冗余的问题，为LVLMs长视频理解提供了高效、无需训练的解决方案。

title: When May a Model Replace the Experiment? Audits, Licenses, and the Price of Trust in Surrogate-Driven Design
comment: 47 pages (18 pages main text, 29 pages Supporting Information), 9 figures, 2 tables, 70 references. SI contains complete proofs of all theorems, extended experiments, and the verification methodology
summary: Design campaigns in chemistry, materials science, and machine learning share a bottleneck: determining how good a candidate truly is requires an expensive evaluation - an experiment, a first-principles simulation, or a full training run. Machine-learning surrogates that predict these outcomes are increasingly used not only to propose candidates but to grade them, and even to feed their own predictions back into the search as though they were measurements. Through mathematical analysis validated on three exhaustively ground-truthed design tasks, we establish when this practice is safe, what any certificate of safety must cost, and when the substitution provably pays. Predictive accuracy cannot anchor trust: near-perfect R^2 is compatible with worst-possible selections, and screening N candidates inflates the over-prediction at the selected candidate by a quantifiable "selection tax" with matching upper and lower bounds. Safety follows instead from an architectural rule - predictions may propose and train without restriction, but every certified conclusion must rest on true evaluations - which is sufficient with no assumptions on the surrogate, and necessary, since admitting predictions into certification with the standing of measurements opens a deterministic self-confirmation failure mode. We derive the minimal criterion under which a model may act as an oracle (rank preservation, not accuracy), show that trust must be purchased through selection-aware audits that are optimal in query complexity, and prove a dichotomy fixing when audited surrogates cut certified evaluation cost. Across 432 surrogate fits over six task-regime conditions, the audit statistic tracks deployed search performance at Spearman rank correlation 0.80-0.99, while the rank correlation of R^2 with deployed regret falls as low as 0.33; audited screening reduces certified oracle cost by a measured factor of 25.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数学分析和三个穷尽ground-truth的设计任务验证，系统研究了机器学习代理模型在实验设计中被用于"打分"和"自我反馈"的安全性问题。核心发现是：预测准确性（R²）不能作为信任的基础，必须通过"真实评估"来认证结论；模型作为oracle的准则是秩保持而非准确性；信任需要通过选择感知审计来购买，经审计的代理筛选可将认证oracle成本降低25倍。
AI.motivation: 在化学、材料科学和机器学习的设计战役中，昂贵的评估（实验、第一性原理模拟或完整训练）是瓶颈。机器学习代理模型被越来越广泛地用于提议候选、打分评估，甚至将自身预测反馈回搜索流程当作真实测量。作者质疑这一实践的安全性，希望从数学上明确何时这种替代是安全的、安全证书必须付出什么代价、以及何时这种替代确实能带来收益。
AI.method: 作者通过数学分析（推导选择税的上下界、证明架构规则的充分性和必要性、证明审计最优性、证明代理审计效果的二分律）并在三个穷尽ground-truth的设计任务上对432个代理拟合进行验证。具体方法包括：定义"选择税"以量化筛选N个候选时被选中最优者的过度预测膨胀；提出架构规则（预测可用于提议和训练，但认证结论必须基于真实评估）；推导模型的oracle资格准则为秩保持而非精度；提出选择感知审计并证明其在查询复杂度上的最优性。
AI.result: 主要结果：1）近乎完美的R²可能与最坏情况的选择相容，筛选N个候选会使被选中的过度预测产生可量化的"选择税"（上下界匹配）；2）建立安全性架构规则（充分且必要），违反该规则会导致确定性的自我确认失败模式；3）代理模型的oracle资格准则是秩保持而非精度；4）选择感知审计在查询复杂度上最优；5）在432个代理拟合中，审计统计量与部署搜索性能的Spearman秩相关达0.80-0.99，而R²与部署后悔的秩相关低至0.33；6）经审计的筛选将认证oracle成本降低25倍。
AI.conclusion: 预测精度不能锚定信任；设计筛选的安全认证必须建立在真实评估之上，而非代理预测。安全可以通过架构规则保证（无需对代理做任何假设），但要获得信任则需要选择感知审计来购买。该框架提供了何时可安全使用代理、审计的最优查询复杂度以及何时代理确实能降低认证成本的完整理论，并得到大规模实证验证。

title: HopRefusalBench: Diagnosing Refusal Failures in Search-Augmented Agents for Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Search-augmented large language model agents are increasingly capable of solving knowledge-intensive tasks, but their behavior when a multi-hop question is fundamentally unanswerable remains poorly understood. Existing abstention benchmarks largely expose defects at the surface of single-hop queries and therefore cannot reveal failures that emerge only after valid intermediate reasoning and retrieval. We introduce HopRefusalBench, the first controlled benchmark of refusal within multi-hop search, comprising 889 unanswerable questions constructed from KILT-grounded entity paths. It crosses three causes of unanswerability (answer unknown, false premise, and underspecified context) with root, middle, and terminal topologies, making premise verification, intermediate-bridge validation, and terminal stopping separately observable. We further propose a final-outcome taxonomy spanning target-aware refusal, pseudo-refusal, hallucinated completion, and search-budget exhaustion, together with source-aware trajectory metrics for post-trigger continuation and token waste. Across ten frontier proprietary and open-weight models in search-augmented mode, the best model achieves a target-aware correct halting rate (TCHR) of only 42.9%. Root and middle items are consistently harder than terminal items, and all models attain their highest TCHR on false premises and their lowest on underspecified questions. Yet when pooled across categories, 84.7--98.4% of each model's explicit refusal-like responses identify the correct rationale, localizing the main bottleneck to committing to an appropriate non-answer; failed trajectories instead diverge into hallucination or search-budget exhaustion. These results establish refusal in multi-hop search as a consequential evaluation problem and provide a foundation for diagnosing and improving the reliability of search-augmented agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HopRefusalBench，首个针对多跳搜索中模型拒答（refusal）行为的受控基准，包含889个从KILT实体路径构建的不可回答问题，并引入最终结果分类法和轨迹指标。实验表明即使最强模型的目标感知正确停止率（TCHR）仅为42.9%，主要瓶颈在于模型难以承诺做出适当的"不回答"决策。
AI.motivation: 现有弃答（abstention）基准主要暴露单跳查询的表层缺陷，无法揭示多跳搜索中只有在有效的中间推理和检索之后才会出现的失败模式。当多跳问题本质上不可回答时，搜索增强型LLM代理的行为仍未被充分理解。
AI.method: 构建HopRefusalBench基准：(1) 从KILT实体路径生成889个不可回答的多跳问题；(2) 交叉三个不可回答原因（答案未知、错误前提、上下文不充分）与三种拓扑结构（根节点、中间节点、末端节点）；(3) 提出最终结果分类法（目标感知拒答、伪拒答、幻觉式补全、搜索预算耗尽）和源感知轨迹指标（触发后延续、token浪费）。
AI.result: 在十个前沿专有和开源模型的搜索增强模式下，最佳模型TCHR仅为42.9%；根节点和中间节点问题比末端节点更难；所有模型在错误前提上TCHR最高，在上下文不充分问题上最低；但跨类别汇总时，84.7-98.4%的显式拒答式响应识别了正确理由，说明主要瓶颈在于承诺做出适当的非答案响应，失败轨迹则分化为幻觉或搜索预算耗尽。
AI.conclusion: 多跳搜索中的拒答是一个重要的评估问题，为诊断和提升搜索增强代理的可靠性提供了基础。

title: Generated Images Are Easier to Forget: A Machine Unlearning Perspective for Synthetic Image Detection
summary: Robust detection of generated images is critical to counter the misuse of generative models. Existing methods primarily depend on learning from human-annotated training datasets, limiting their generalization to unseen distributions. In contrast, large-scale vision models (LVMs) pre-trained on web-scale datasets exhibit exceptional generalization power through exposure to diverse distributions, offering a transformative paradigm for this task. However, our experimental results reveal that LVMs pre-trained on natural-image-dominated data can effectively capture the features of both natural and generated images, yielding comparably low losses and thus limited discriminative capacity between them. This prompts a key question: When and how do LVMs exhibit different behaviors when capturing features of natural and generated images? This investigation reveals an insight: during unlearning, LVMs exhibit disparate forgetting dynamics with feature degradation for generated images escalating faster than natural ones. Inspired by the disparate dynamics, we introduce two detection methods: 1) data-free detection, which prunes model parameters to induce unlearning without data access, and 2) data-driven detection, which optimizes LVMs to unlearn knowledge tied to generated images. Extensive experiments conducted on various benchmarks demonstrate that our unlearning-based approach outperforms conventional detection methods. By recasting the detection task as a problem of machine unlearning, our work establishes a new paradigm for generated image detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器遗忘（machine unlearning）的生成图像检测新范式。通过观察大模型在遗忘过程中对自然图像和生成图像表现出不同的遗忘动力学（生成图像特征退化更快），作者设计了两种检测方法：无数据检测（通过剪枝参数诱导遗忘）和数据驱动检测（通过优化模型遗忘生成图像相关知识）。实验表明该方法优于传统检测方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成图像检测方法依赖人工标注训练集，泛化能力差。虽然大模型（LVMs）具有强大的泛化能力，但论文发现这些模型对自然图像和生成图像都产生相似的较低损失，难以直接区分。因此需要探索大模型在什么条件下、如何对两类图像表现出不同行为，从而找到新的检测途径。
AI.method: 1) 关键洞察：在机器遗忘过程中，生成图像的特征退化速度比自然图像更快，两类图像表现出不同的遗忘动力学。2) 方法一：无数据检测（data-free），通过剪枝模型参数诱导遗忘，无需访问数据。3) 方法二：数据驱动检测（data-driven），优化模型以遗忘与生成图像相关的知识。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，基于遗忘的方法在生成图像检测任务上优于传统检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将生成图像检测任务重新定义为机器遗忘问题，本文建立了生成图像检测的新范式，为领域提供了新的研究视角和方法论基础。

title: On the Identifiability of Masked Prediction: Mode Blindness and Mask Schedules
summary: Masked prediction learns representations by fitting a schedule-weighted family of conditional laws, but it remains unclear when near-optimal conditional prediction pins down the underlying joint law. We study this question for data with two well-separated global modes, outside the reach of rapid-mixing recovery guarantees, and show that the answer is decided by the mask schedule alone. Under large-context mode pinning, reweighting the two modes can move the joint law by a constant in total variation while perturbing the masked objective exponentially little in the visible-context size: mask schedules dominated by large contexts are provably blind to the global mode weights. To quantify this, we introduce an $\varepsilon$-identifiability modulus, the largest distributional error consistent with a given excess risk, and prove that it remains macroscopic at an excess risk that is exponentially small. An exact information decomposition pinpoints what restores identifiability: mode-weight sensitivity is governed by the residual mode uncertainty given the visible context. Consequently, low-visibility masks recover this sensitivity, and positive full-mask mass anchors the joint law over all admissible models with no assumption on the data law. Empirically, we test our theory at three levels: enumeration on computable laws verifies the predicted rates, gradient training reproduces both the mode blindness and the recovery, and measurements on real corpora place natural text between the two certified regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了掩码预测（masked prediction）何时能从近最优条件预测中恢复底层联合分布的问题，聚焦于具有两个分离全局模态的数据。作者发现答案仅由掩码调度（mask schedule）决定：被大规模可见上下文主导的掩码调度对全局模态权重"失明"，而低可见性掩码和正的全掩码质量可以恢复可辨识性。
AI.motivation: 掩码预测通过拟合调度加权的条件分布族来学习表示，但尚不清楚近最优的条件预测何时能确定底层的联合分布。此前快速混合恢复保证的方法无法覆盖具有两个分离全局模态的数据，本文正是要填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 作者引入ε-可辨识模量（ε-identifiability modulus）来量化给定超额风险下最大的分布误差，并证明其在超额风险指数级小时仍保持宏观量级。通过精确的信息分解揭示：模态权重敏感性由给定可见上下文后的残差模态不确定性决定，由此推导出低可见性掩码恢复敏感性、正全掩码质量锚定联合分布的结论。
AI.result: 理论证明大上下文主导的掩码调度对模态权重失明（指数级小的扰动），而低可见性掩码和正全掩码质量可恢复可辨识性。实验在三个层面验证：可计算分布上的枚举验证预测速率、梯度训练复现失明与恢复现象、真实语料显示自然文本位于两个认证区间之间。
AI.conclusion: 掩码预测的可辨识性完全由掩码调度决定：大上下文掩码失明于全局模态权重，而低可见性掩码和全掩码质量可以锚定联合分布，且恢复可辨识性不需要对数据分布做任何额外假设。

title: EviSD: Evidence-Conditioned Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Agents
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning enables search-augmented language agents to learn from verifiable final answers, but its trajectory-level credit cannot distinguish the contributions of individual actions in a multi-turn search process. We propose EviSD, an evidence-conditioned self-distillation framework that uses instance-level supporting evidence as privileged information for search actions and golden answers as complementary privilege for answer actions. During training, the student samples actions from the original context, while the same model re-scores them as a privileged teacher under an action-aligned context. EviSD converts the detached teacher--student gap into a bounded correction to the outcome-derived GRPO advantage and applies it only to generated action spans. This design localizes privileged guidance while preserving the update direction determined by the outcome reward, without an auxiliary distillation objective or any change at inference time. Across seven question-answering benchmarks and three backbones spanning model scales and generations, EviSD achieves the highest macro-average Exact Match in all evaluated settings, outperforming the strongest compared methods by 1.3--2.3 points while modulating only 6.7%--15.1% of response tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/JiananXie/EviSD.

AI.tldr: EviSD是一个基于证据条件自蒸馏的框架，利用实例级支持证据作为搜索动作的特权信息，金标答案作为回答动作的补充特权，通过将教师-学生差距转化为有界校正来改进GRPO优势，在不改变推理过程的情况下提升搜索增强语言智能体的多轮搜索学习效果。
AI.motivation: 基于结果的强化学习虽然能让搜索增强语言智能体从可验证的最终答案中学习，但轨迹级别的信用分配无法区分多轮搜索过程中单个动作的贡献，这是现有方法的核心局限。
AI.method: EviSD框架包含：(1) 使用实例级支持证据作为搜索动作的特权信息，金标答案作为回答动作的补充特权；(2) 训练中学生从原始上下文采样动作，同一模型作为特权教师在动作对齐的上下文中重新评分；(3) 将解耦的教师-学生差距转化为对结果派生的GRPO优势的有界校正，仅应用于生成的动作片段；(4) 不需要辅助蒸馏目标或在推理时做任何改变。
AI.result: 在7个问答基准和3个覆盖不同模型规模与代际的基座上，EviSD在所有评估设置中取得最高的宏平均精确匹配，比最强对比方法高出1.3-2.3个百分点，且仅调制6.7%-15.1%的响应词元。
AI.conclusion: EviSD通过局部化特权引导，同时保留结果奖励决定的更新方向，有效解决了轨迹级信用分配问题，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升了搜索增强语言智能体的性能。

title: Control Under Compression: Reliability Frontiers for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using language-model agents are governed not only by task prompts but also by persistent system-side instructions that specify tools, arguments, policies, execution protocols, and recovery. Compressing these agent control contexts (ACCs) can reduce input cost and context use, yet existing prompt-compression evaluations do not reveal whether the resulting control remains operationally reliable. We introduce CompressAgent, an environment-verified benchmark for ACC compression across nine independently constructed ACCs, three task families, three fixed Qwen API model identifiers, six retained-context budgets, and 15,525 runs. We uncover a nonlinear, method-dependent reliability frontier. At 75% retained context, generic rewriting and section-based compression achieve 92.7% and 92.4% success, close to the 93.8% full-context baseline. Between 50% and 35%, methods diverge sharply; at 35%, section-based, obligation-aware, and generic rewriting achieve 47.0%, 39.0%, and 19.9%. At retained-context budgets from 25% to 10%, executable protocols become fragile. Reliability also varies substantially across ACCs, making universal compressor rankings inappropriate and motivating per-context qualification. Failure analysis shows that compression primarily surfaces as tool-execution and action-parsing errors. These findings recast ACC compression from token reduction into a runtime-reliability problem that must be evaluated through executable outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CompressAgent，一个环境验证的基准，用于评估工具型语言模型智能体的代理控制上下文（ACC）压缩。通过在9个独立构建的ACC、3个任务族、3个Qwen API模型、6个保留上下文预算和15,525次运行中进行测试，发现压缩可靠性存在非线性、方法依赖的前沿：在高保留率下性能接近基线，但在低保留率下方法间差异显著，且不同ACC间可靠性差异大，因此通用压缩器排名不合适，需按上下文逐例评估。
AI.motivation: 现有提示压缩评估无法揭示压缩后代理控制上下文（ACC）的操作可靠性。ACC作为系统侧指令，控制工具使用、参数、策略、执行协议和恢复机制，其压缩不仅关乎token缩减，更关乎运行时可靠性，需要新的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建CompressAgent基准：包含9个独立构建的ACC、3个任务族、3个固定的Qwen API模型、6个保留上下文预算，通过环境验证的方式评估压缩后的执行结果，共进行15,525次运行，系统性地对比不同压缩方法在不同保留率下的成功率。
AI.result: 发现非线性、方法依赖的可靠性前沿：75%保留率时通用改写和分节压缩分别达92.7%和92.4%成功率，接近93.8%全上下文基线；50%-35%区间方法间差异显著拉大，35%时分节、义务感知和通用改写分别为47.0%、39.0%和19.9%；25%-10%时可执行协议变得脆弱。可靠性在不同ACC间差异大，失败主要表现为工具执行和动作解析错误。
AI.conclusion: ACC压缩应被重新定义为运行时可靠性问题而非单纯的token缩减问题，必须通过可执行结果进行评估。通用压缩器排名不合适，需要根据具体上下文进行逐例资格认证。

title: Foveated Probes Recover Localized Binding Information in Vision Foundation Models
summary: Frozen vision foundation models are commonly evaluated through a single global image embedding, but this interface can conflate missing information with information lost at readout time. We study this distinction by keeping a pretrained vision encoder frozen and varying only the readout applied to its final patch tokens. We compare standard global readouts against a lightweight foveated readout, which attention-pools patch tokens using a learned or question-conditioned query, and against an oracle readout with access to the annotated target region. We evaluate these interfaces on three localized binding problems: a controlled synthetic color--shape binding task under clutter, a color-free crowded shape-detection variant, and a GQA-derived natural-image task where paired questions ask for the colors of different same-category objects in the same image. Global readouts perform near perfectly when the synthetic target appears alone, but collapse under clutter and counterfactual target edits, whereas the foveated readout recovers most of the oracle-accessible signal. On the GQA-derived task, question-independent global image vectors improve only modestly over question-only priors, while question-conditioned foveation substantially improves paired localized color accuracy. A counterfactual nuisance-to-signal ratio explains the synthetic failures: global pooling dilutes localized label-changing evidence while exposing the probe to nuisance variation from irrelevant objects. These results indicate that apparent spatial blindness in frozen vision models can arise from the global embedding interface rather than from an absence of spatial information in the frozen patch tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文研究冻结视觉基础模型的空间感知能力，发现全局图像嵌入这一读出接口本身会丢失局部空间信息，导致模型看似"空间盲"。通过仅改变读出方式（全局读出 vs 轻量级中心凹读出 vs 神谕读出），证明冻结的patch token中其实保留了可用的空间信息，问题出在全局池化接口上。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉基础模型通常通过单一全局图像嵌入进行评估，但这种接口可能将"信息缺失"与"读出时丢失信息"混为一谈。研究者希望区分这两种情况，探究模型表面上的空间盲症究竟源于编码器本身缺乏空间信息，还是源于全局读出接口的局限。
AI.method: 保持预训练视觉编码器冻结，仅改变对最终patch token的读出方式。比较三种读出：(1)标准全局读出；(2)轻量级中心凹读出（通过学习或问题条件化的查询进行注意力池化）；(3)可访问标注目标区域的神谕读出。在三个局部绑定任务上评估：受杂波干扰的合成颜色-形状绑定任务、无颜色拥挤形状检测变体、以及基于GQA的自然图像任务。
AI.result: 全局读出在目标单独出现时表现接近完美，但在杂乱场景和反事实目标编辑下性能崩溃；中心凹读出恢复了神谕可访问信号的大部分。在GQA任务中，与问题无关的全局图像向量仅比仅用问题先验略有提升，而问题条件化的中心凹读出显著提高了配对局部颜色准确率。反事实噪声-信号比解释了合成任务的失败：全局池化稀释了局部标签改变的证据，同时使探针暴露于无关物体的噪声变化。
AI.conclusion: 冻结视觉模型中表现出的空间盲症可以源于全局嵌入接口，而非冻结patch token中缺乏空间信息。全局池化会稀释局部关键信息并引入无关噪声，而适当的注意力池化读出可以恢复大部分空间信息。

title: TabDPT-Turbo: Efficient In-Context Learning for Tabular Prediction
comment: Presented as a poster at the non-archival ICML workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD)
summary: Tabular foundation models, driven by in-context learning, have rapidly grown in quality and popularity. However, recent approaches with either cell-based architectures or retrieval have sacrificed efficiency for raw performance, restricting their utility in situations where compute is limited or inference speed is crucial. We adopt an alternate approach, sticking with row-based attention while incorporating long context pre-training to eliminate the need for retrieval. By combining this with architectural improvements and SSL pre-training on a newly-sourced, larger corpus of real data results, we present TabDPT-Turbo, a model that provides comparable default performance to TabDPT v1.1 on TabArena-Lite, CC18, and CTR23, at orders of magnitude faster. In our experiments, TabDPT-Turbo is the fastest model overall among leading foundation models. We have released the new model as TabDPT v1.2 at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference.

AI.tldr: TabDPT-Turbo（即TabDPT v1.2）是一个表格基础模型，采用基于行的注意力机制与长上下文预训练，在保持与TabDPT v1.1相当性能的同时，实现了数量级更快的推理速度，并在主流基础模型中以最快速度运行。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型（如基于细胞架构或检索的方法）虽然性能优异，但推理效率低下，限制了在计算资源有限或对推理速度敏感场景中的实用性。作者希望在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅提升效率。
AI.method: 放弃检索机制，坚持基于行的注意力架构；引入长上下文预训练以消除对检索的需求；结合架构改进、自监督学习（SSL）预训练，以及在一个新采集的更大规模真实数据语料上进行训练。
AI.result: TabDPT-Turbo在TabArena-Lite、CC18和CTR23基准上取得了与TabDPT v1.1相当的默认性能，但推理速度快了数量级；在主流基础模型中整体速度最快。
AI.conclusion: 通过长上下文预训练替代检索策略，可以在保持表格基础模型性能的同时实现显著的效率提升，为资源受限场景下的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Language Equality has a Price: A Systematic Investigation of Multi-turn LLM Performance for EU-24+
summary: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) as language agents playing goal-directed dialogue games in self-play across 30 languages: the 24 official EU languages plus six others. Unlike static or preference-based evaluation, this paradigm is multi-turn, reference-free and programmatically scored, and because the game mechanics are language-agnostic it extends to a new language by localising a fixed set of prompt and word-list files. Evaluating nine open-weight and commercial LLMs, we find that no open-weight model covers the EU-24 well: in every official language both commercial systems outscore every open-weight model, and the two weakest average below 40 points across the EU-24. The commercial systems stay ahead even in languages with four orders of magnitude less public web text, showing that linguistic parity is achievable, but not from public crawls alone. A model's home region lifts it without closing the gap: Chinese is the strongest of all 30 languages for two Chinese-developed models, yet the best Chinese score of any model belongs to a US commercial system. Coverage is also not parity of service. Pooled over models and languages, the median non-English language costs 31% more to run than English, and scores 10% lower.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了9个大语言模型作为语言代理在30种语言（24种欧盟官方语言+6种其他语言）的自博弈目标导向对话游戏中的表现。这是一种多轮、无参考、程序化评分的评估范式，可扩展到新语言。研究发现：没有任何开源模型能很好覆盖EU-24（所有官方语言中商业系统均胜过所有开源模型）；商业系统在公开网络文本少四个数量级的语言中仍保持优势；模型母语区域有提升但不足以缩小差距；非英语语言的中位数运行成本比英语高31%，得分低10%。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM评估通常基于静态或偏好判断，无法充分反映模型在真实交互环境中的语言能力，且多语言覆盖评估不足。作者希望提出一种更接近真实使用场景、可程序化评分且易于扩展到多语言的评估范式。
AI.method: 采用目标导向的自博弈对话游戏范式，语言无关的游戏机制通过本地化固定的提示词和词表文件即可扩展到新语言。评估9个开源和商业LLM在30种语言上的表现，涵盖24个欧盟官方语言和6种其他语言。
AI.result: 没有任何开源模型能覆盖EU-24；两个最弱的模型在EU-24中平均低于40分。商业系统在公开网络文本少四个数量级的语言中仍保持领先。两个中国开发的模型在中文上表现最强，但中文的最佳成绩仍属于美国商业系统。非英语语言的中位数运行成本比英语高31%，得分低10%。
AI.conclusion: 语言公平性是可以实现但仅靠公开网络爬取数据是不够的；覆盖不等于服务平价，多语言服务在成本和性能上仍存在显著差距。

title: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals: Separating Matching and Content Retrieval Across Depth
summary: Depth-routing residual architectures allow Transformer layers to retrieve earlier representations instead of inheriting only the immediately preceding state. Existing Block Attention Residuals, however, use a single content-dependent depth mixture to construct the inputs to queries, keys, and values. This design couples two functionally different decisions: queries and keys determine where attention matches, whereas values determine what content is retrieved. We therefore ask whether matching and content retrieval should be forced to read from the same depth. We introduce Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes), a minimal extension that shares one depth route between queries and keys while learning an independent value route over the same residual sources. Tying the two routing queries exactly recovers the parent architecture, while decoupling them adds only one model-width vector per layer and introduces no additional token-to-token attention operation. We evaluate RD-AttnRes using a frozen, paired pretraining protocol on FineWeb-Edu with five matched seeds for both 120M- and 343M-parameter models and a 2.0B-token training budget. RD-AttnRes improves validation negative log-likelihood in all 10 matched comparisons. The mean reductions are 0.0301 and 0.0247, corresponding to perplexity reductions of 2.97 percent and 2.43 percent at 120M and 343M parameters, respectively. Early-budget controls indicate that neither the additional parameter count, duplicated routing execution, nor a fixed value route reproduces the improvement. Routing diagnostics further reveal persistent divergence between the query-key and value depth distributions. These results suggest that, within the evaluated training regime, attention matching and content retrieval benefit from distinct reads over the residual hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出角色解耦注意力残差（RD-AttnRes），将残差路由中查询/键与值的深度选择解耦，使其分别从残差层级中读取不同深度的信息。在120M和343M参数模型、20亿token的预训练设置下，所有10次对比中均改进了验证集负对数似然。
AI.motivation: 现有的Block Attention Residuals使用单一的内容相关深度混合来构造查询、键和值的输入，但这将两个功能上不同的决策耦合在一起：查询和键决定注意力匹配的位置，而值决定检索的内容。作者质疑这两类功能是否应当被强制从相同深度读取信息。
AI.method: RD-AttnRes是最小化的扩展：查询和键之间共享一条深度路由，而值为相同的残差源学习独立的深度路由。将两条路由绑定可精确恢复父架构，解耦仅每层增加一个模型宽度向量，且不引入额外的token间注意力操作。
AI.result: 在FineWeb-Edu上使用冻结的配对预训练协议，5个匹配种子分别训练120M和343M参数模型，2.0B token预算。RD-AttnRes在所有10个匹配对比中均改善验证NLL，平均降低0.0301和0.0247，对应困惑度分别降低2.97%和2.43%。早期预算对照表明改进并非来自额外参数、重复的路由执行或固定值路由。
AI.conclusion: 路由诊断显示查询-键与值的深度分布在持续发散，表明在评估的训练机制中，注意力匹配与内容检索确实受益于对残差层级的不同读取。

title: MDTD-ArtIR: Benchmarking Image Editing and Restoration Models for Art Image Restoration under Texture-Overlay Degradations
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier Journal of Visual Communication and Image Representation
summary: Restoring severely degraded visual media still remains a formidable challenge, as existing methods often hallucinate unnatural textures and contents, struggle with preserving color and texture, or fail to leverage partially retained image information. Existing restoration benchmarks assume known degradation operators and fail to capture the complex characteristics of artistic damage such as cracks, stains, and color/texture deviation. We introduce a controlled benchmark for blind restoration of semantic, semi-transparent image media degradations, accompanied by a new, publicly open degradation alpha texture mask dataset MDTD-Art. We present a new dataset and benchmark evaluating state-of-the-art universal restoration models against image editing and vision-language models across varying mask opacity levels. Our experiments demonstrate that image editing models consistently outperform specialized restoration architectures for arbitrary degradations, with performance gains amplified by structured prompt engineering emphasizing detail preservation and structural consistency. These findings position recoverable semantic information and prompt controllability as critical factors in art image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对艺术图像盲恢复的新基准和数据集MDTD-Art，用于评估半透明语义退化（如裂纹、污渍、颜色/纹理偏差）。实验发现图像编辑模型在任意退化恢复中优于专用修复架构，且结构化提示工程能进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有恢复方法在处理严重退化的视觉媒体时存在纹理/内容幻觉、颜色与纹理保持困难、未能利用部分保留信息等问题；同时现有基准假设已知退化算子，无法捕捉艺术损伤（裂纹、污渍等）的复杂特征。
AI.method: 构建受控的盲恢复基准，涵盖语义性半透明图像介质退化；发布公开的退化alpha纹理掩码数据集MDTD-Art；在不同掩码不透明度级别下评估最新的通用恢复模型、图像编辑模型和视觉-语言模型。
AI.result: 图像编辑模型在任意退化任务中持续优于专门的恢复架构，且通过强调细节保持和结构一致性的结构化提示工程，性能增益进一步放大。
AI.conclusion: 可恢复的语义信息和提示可控性应被视为艺术图像恢复中的关键因素，这为未来的恢复模型设计提供了新的方向。

title: Cluster-Aware Over-the-Air Federated Learning with Energy-Harvesting Devices: From Global Training to Model Personalization
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables distributed optimization and learning across decentralized edge devices while preserving data privacy, but its performance is fundamentally constrained by heterogeneous data distributions, limited communication resources, and energy availability. In practical wireless networks, mobile devices (MDs) often exhibit diverse data and learning objectives, naturally forming clusters of users with jointly trainable models. When devices rely on energy harvesting (EH), stochastic energy arrivals further complicate participation and scheduling under communication constraints. In this work, we study over-the-air (OTA) FL with EH MDs under heterogeneous data distributions, and investigate two closely related learning objectives within a unified framework: one aiming for a more representative global model by reducing data bias, and the other learning more personalized cluster-specific models by exploiting this bias. In the global training mode, cluster information guides energy- and diversity-aware scheduling, ensuring that the scheduled active users provide a more representative aggregate update. In the personalization mode, the same cluster structure defines cluster-level learning objectives and OTA recovery targets, enabling the parameter server to train multiple cluster-specific models through simultaneous transmissions over the wireless multiple-access channel. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed unified framework improves fairness or personalization, depending on the operating mode, while reducing communication overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能量收集设备（EH MDs）在异构数据分布下的空中计算联邦学习（OTA FL），提出一个统一框架，支持两种学习目标：全局模型训练（利用簇信息进行能量与多样性感知调度，减少数据偏差）和个性化簇级模型训练（利用簇结构定义簇级学习目标与OTA恢复目标，通过无线多址信道同时训练多个簇专属模型）。数值结果表明该框架根据运行模式分别提升公平性或个性化，并降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习的性能受异构数据分布、通信资源和能量可用性的根本性制约。在实用无线网络中，移动设备的数据和学习目标天然形成可联合训练的簇结构。当设备依赖能量收集时，随机的能量到达进一步使参与调度复杂化。现有工作缺乏在统一框架下同时处理全局代表性模型和个性化簇级模型的能力。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，包含两种运行模式：(1) 全局训练模式：利用簇信息指导能量与多样性感知调度，确保被调度的活跃用户提供更具代表性的聚合更新；(2) 个性化模式：利用同一簇结构定义簇级学习目标和OTA恢复目标，使参数服务器通过无线多址信道上的同时传输训练多个簇专属模型。整个框架在OTA FL框架下集成能量收集、异构数据和簇结构。
AI.result: 数值结果表明该统一框架根据运行模式可提升公平性或个性化性能，同时降低通信开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过一个统一框架将簇结构与OTA FL相结合，既能通过多样性感知调度提升全局模型的代表性（公平性），也能通过同时多簇训练实现个性化，为能量收集无线网络中异构数据下的联邦学习提供了灵活的解决方案。

title: When Retrieval Helps and Distracts: Evaluating Evidence-Generating LLMs for Biomedical Claim Verification
summary: Biomedical fact-checking systems must do more than predict whether a claim is supported, contradicted, or unaddressed: they should also produce evidence that is faithful, complete, and useful for verification. We study this evidence-generation setting on CARE-XAI, a unified benchmark spanning five biomedical and health fact-checking sources. We compare base instruction LLMs, PubMed retrieval-augmented LLMs, fine-tuned LLMs, label-only LLMs, and biomedical encoder classifiers under a shared evaluation protocol. Biomedical classifiers remain strongest for verdict-only prediction, while fine-tuned LLMs are the strongest evidence-generating systems. PubMed retrieval is mixed: it helps PubMed-aligned sources such as PubMedQA and SciFact, but can distract models on broader public-health claims. We introduce Bio-GRACE, a gold-reference-normalized diagnostic for measuring whether retrieved evidence recovers the decision benefit of reference evidence. Bio-GRACE shows that retrieval utility is source-dependent, motivates selective retrieval, and exposes why retrieval recall and lexical evidence overlap are insufficient for biomedical fact-checking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生物医学事实核查中的证据生成问题，在CARE-XAI基准上比较了多种LLM和分类器，发现微调LLM在证据生成上最强，而生物医学分类器在纯类别预测上最优。作者还提出了Bio-GRACE诊断指标，用于衡量检索证据相对于参考证据的决策收益。
AI.motivation: 生物医学事实核查系统不仅需要预测声明是否被支持、反驳或未涉及，还应生成忠实、完整且对验证有用的证据。现有工作缺乏对不同方法在证据生成能力上的系统性比较，也缺少衡量检索证据实际效用的诊断指标。
AI.method: 在CARE-XAI统一基准（涵盖五个生物医学与健康事实核查来源）上，使用统一评估协议比较了五类系统：基础指令LLM、PubMed检索增强LLM、微调LLM、仅标签LLM和生物医学编码器分类器。并提出了Bio-GRACE——一种基于金标准参考归一化的诊断指标，衡量检索到的证据能否恢复参考证据的决策收益。
AI.result: 生物医学分类器在仅预测标签（verdict-only）任务上表现最强；微调LLM是证据生成最强的系统。PubMed检索效果因来源而异：对PubMed对齐的源（如PubMedQA和SciFact）有帮助，但对更广泛的公共健康声明可能造成干扰。Bio-GRACE揭示了检索效用具有来源依赖性，并表明检索召回率和词汇证据重叠不足以评估生物医学事实核查。
AI.conclusion: 证据生成与标签预测需要不同的方法选择；检索增强并非总是有益，需要选择性检索策略；Bio-GRACE提供了比传统检索指标更可靠的评估工具，用于指导生物医学事实核查中的证据利用。

title: Inter-Residue Geometry Attention for Antibody-Specific Epitope Prediction
summary: Antibody-specific epitope prediction aims to identify which antigen residues are recognized by a given antibody, a task that depends on the three-dimensional complementarity between antibody CDRs and the antigen surface. Existing methods usually leverage PLM embeddings and inject structure through additional graph, surface, or point-cloud encoders, where the positional mechanism inside attention remains largely tied to one-dimensional sequence order. For proteins, the analogue of a token offset is not only sequence separation, but also the three-dimensional displacement between residues after folding. This raises a question, can folded residue geometry serve as the positional mechanism of attention itself? We propose Local-Frame 3D Rotary Position Encoding (LF3DRoPE), which expresses inter-residue displacements in backbone-defined local frames and injects them directly into rotary attention. This design preserves continuous directional geometry while ensuring invariance to global $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ transformations. On the AsEP benchmark, LF3DRoPE achieves state-of-the-art $\mathrm{MCC}$ on both ratio and epitope-group splits. Ablations and rigid transformation tests show that local three-dimensional geometry provides information beyond sequence-order attention while preserving invariance to arbitrary global coordinate systems. Mutation ranking results further indicate that LF3DRoPE captures antigen-specific structural compatibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LF3DRoPE，一种将蛋白质折叠后的三维残基几何结构直接注入旋转注意力机制的位置编码方法，用于抗体特异性表位预测。在AsEP基准上达到SOTA MCC性能，并验证了三维几何信息超越序列顺序注意力的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有表位预测方法通常利用PLM嵌入并通过额外的图、表面或点云编码器注入结构信息，但注意力内部的位置机制仍依赖于一维序列顺序。然而蛋白质中token偏移不仅包括序列间距，还包括折叠后的三维位移，因此需要探索将折叠后的残基几何结构直接作为注意力机制本身的位置编码。
AI.method: 提出局部框架三维旋转位置编码（LF3DRoPE），将残基间位移在骨架定义的局部框架中表达，并直接注入旋转注意力机制。该设计保留连续方向几何信息，同时保证对全局SE(3)变换的不变性。
AI.result: 在AsEP基准上，LF3DRoPE在ratio和epitope-group两种分割下均达到SOTA MCC。消融实验和刚性变换测试表明，局部三维几何提供的信息超越序列顺序注意力，同时保持对任意全局坐标系统的不变性。突变排序结果进一步表明LF3DRoPE能捕捉抗原特异性结构相容性。
AI.conclusion: 折叠后的残基三维几何结构可以作为注意力机制本身的位置编码，为抗体特异性表位预测提供了新的范式，无需额外结构编码器即可获得SOTA性能。

title: LUT: Latent Utility Training for Visual Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models have advanced visual understanding, yet perception-intensive reasoning remains challenging. Recent latent visual reasoning methods introduce hidden-space computation before answering, but they often rely on costly intermediate supervision, such as bounding boxes, sketches, or interleaved rationales. These strategies focus on how latent states should be shaped, but do not explicitly assess whether the latent is useful for the final answer. We propose LUT, a latent reasoning framework trained with only standard VQA pairs. LUT centers training on Latent Utility at two levels. At the trajectory level, we propose Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT, which explores answer-relevant latent trajectories, selects qualified trajectories by their information gain, and distills more reliable and learnable supervision through curriculum learning. At the step level, we propose Latent Attribution Policy Optimization, which uses answer-to-latent attribution to differentially optimize latent steps during reinforcement learning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that LUT outperforms previous latent reasoning methods and remains competitive with latent-text interleaved methods with lower annotation cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LUT，一个仅使用标准VQA数据训练的潜在推理框架，通过轨迹层面的Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT和步骤层面的Latent Attribution Policy Optimization两个层级关注潜在状态的效用（Latent Utility），在感知密集型视觉推理基准上优于以往潜在推理方法，并与潜在-文本交错方法竞争力相当但标注成本更低。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉理解方面取得进展，但感知密集型推理仍具挑战性。现有潜在视觉推理方法虽引入隐藏空间计算，但依赖昂贵的中间监督（如边界框、草图、交错推理文本）。更关键的是，这些方法只关注潜在状态应如何被塑造，却未显式评估潜在状态对最终答案是否有用。
AI.method: LUT框架包含两个层级的Latent Utility训练：(1) 轨迹层面——Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT，探索答案相关的潜在轨迹，基于信息增益筛选合格轨迹，并通过课程学习蒸馏更可靠和可学的监督；(2) 步骤层面——Latent Attribution Policy Optimization，利用答案到潜在状态的归因来在强化学习中对潜在步骤进行差异化优化。
AI.result: 在感知密集型视觉推理基准上，LUT优于之前的潜在推理方法，并且与潜在-文本交错方法相比更具竞争力，同时标注成本更低。
AI.conclusion: LUT证明了仅使用标准VQA配对数据即可有效训练潜在推理，关键在于显式评估和优化潜在状态的效用而非仅关注其形态，为低标注成本下的潜在推理提供了新方向。

authors: Srinivasa Rao P Vangmayi P Reddy
title: Statistical Mechanics of Learning on Product Wasserstein Manifolds
summary: Normally the statistical mechanics of learning treats constraints on weight distributions as restrictions that shrink the space of possible solutions. Therefore, it reduces model capacity. In this paper we would like to take a contrary approach, which, however, is based on the earlier work on distribution-constrained perceptrons. Rather than treating a prescribed weight distribution as a mere restriction, we propose that it defines the intrinsic geometry upon which learning naturally unfolds. We formulate both deep neural networks and variational quantum circuits as gradient flows on a product of Wasserstein manifolds -- one classical Wasserstein space for each layer and one quantum Wasserstein space for the circuit parameters. Within this geometry, the capacity reduction, which was previously associated with distributional constraints, appears as the metric structure of the constraint manifold itself. We develop a hierarchical mean-field description for deep networks, extend the framework to the quantum setting using the quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1, and introduce two such practical algorithms, Hierarchical DisCo-SGD and Quantum DisCo, that follow approximate geodesics on the manifold of the product itself. Experiments on teacher-student problems, standard image classification tasks, and small variational quantum classifiers show that respecting these distributional geometries improves generalization, stabilizes training, and reduces the severity of barren plateaus compared with unconstrained and purely norm-based baselines. This approach firstly reframes structural constraints as geometric priors and suggests a route for incorporating biological, spectral, or hardware-derived distributional information into both learning systems, viz., classical and quantum learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将深度神经网络和变分量子电路建模为Wasserstein流形上的梯度流，将分布约束重新诠释为内在几何结构而非容量限制，并提出了Hierarchical DisCo-SGD和Quantum DisCo两种算法，实验表明该方法能改善泛化、稳定训练并减轻量子场景中的贫瘠高原问题。
AI.motivation: 传统统计力学视角将权重分布约束视为限制解空间、降低模型容量的因素。作者试图颠覆这一观点，基于分布约束感知机的前期工作，提出分布约束应被理解为学习过程展开的内在几何，而非单纯限制。
AI.method: 将深度神经网络和变分量子电路形式化为乘积Wasserstein流形上的梯度流（每层对应一个经典Wasserstein空间，量子电路参数对应一个量子Wasserstein空间）。开发了深度网络的层次化平均场描述，利用1阶量子Wasserstein距离扩展到量子场景，并引入两种遵循流形上近似测地线的实用算法：Hierarchical DisCo-SGD和Quantum DisCo。
AI.result: 在teacher-student问题、标准图像分类任务和小型变分量子分类器上的实验表明：尊重分布几何相比无约束和纯范数基线的基线方法，能改善泛化性能、稳定训练过程，并降低量子场景中贫瘠高原（barren plateaus）的严重程度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法首次将结构约束重新定义为几何先验，为将生物、谱域或硬件相关的分布信息融入经典和量子学习系统提供了新路径。

title: QR-Erase: Efficient Subspace-Based Machine Unlearning with Layer Localization
summary: Machine unlearning seeks to remove targeted information from trained models without requiring costly retraining. Existing optimization-based methods often degrade unrelated capabilities, while subspace-based approaches rely on computationally expensive singular value decompositions (SVD). We introduce QR-Erase, a subspace-based framework that uses Pivoted QR decomposition to identify and remove task-specific representations directly from model parameters. We further propose Layer-Localized QR-Erase, which restricts updates to layers containing the highest concentration of task-specific information. We show that Pivoted QR provides accurate subspace recovery with bounded error, and that under a mild spectral gap condition, the recovered subspace approaches the optimal SVD solution. Across task-level, cross-lingual, and speech unlearning, QR-Erase achieves a stronger forgetting-retention tradeoff than optimization-based methods while remaining within 5% of SVD across all metrics. Exploiting low-rank and layer-localized structure further improves forgetting (for example, reducing speech forget-set accuracy from 53.1% to 15.7%). These results demonstrate that accurate subspace recovery, rather than optimal reconstruction, is sufficient for effective unlearning and provides an efficient and general alternative to SVD-based methods for modern foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QR-Erase，一种基于Pivoted QR分解的子空间机器学习遗忘框架，通过识别并移除模型参数中的任务特定表示实现高效遗忘，避免传统SVD方法的计算开销。进一步的Layer-Localized变体仅更新信息集中层，在多项任务（任务级、跨语言、语音）遗忘中取得比优化方法更好的遗忘-保留权衡，性能接近SVD（差异在5%以内），且利用低秩结构可将语音遗忘集准确率从53.1%降至15.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习遗忘方法存在两个主要问题：基于优化的方法会损害模型无关能力；基于子空间的方法（如SVD）计算成本高昂，难以适用于现代大规模基础模型。作者希望找到一种既高效又能准确恢复任务特定子空间的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) QR-Erase：使用Pivoted QR分解替代SVD，直接从模型参数中识别并移除任务特定表示；2) Layer-Localized QR-Erase：限制更新范围至任务特定信息浓度最高的层；3) 理论保证：证明Pivoted QR在温和谱间隔条件下能以有界误差逼近最优SVD解。
AI.result: 在任务级、跨语言和语音遗忘场景中，QR-Erase在遗忘-保留权衡上优于优化方法；在所有指标上与SVD的差距在5%以内；利用低秩和层局部结构进一步提升遗忘效果（语音遗忘集准确率从53.1%降至15.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 准确的子空间恢复（而非最优重建）即可实现有效的模型遗忘。QR-Erase提供了一种高效、通用且可扩展的SVD替代方案，适用于现代基础模型。

title: Fighting Fire with Fire: On the Feasibility of Protecting Exercises Against AI Cheating
summary: The widespread adoption of generative AI enables students to outsource cognitive effort to increasingly capable assistants, creating an illusion of competence while undermining the independent reasoning that education aims to cultivate. We investigate whether adversarial machine learning can be repurposed to protect educational exercises against such corrosive reliance. Our approach uses multimodal multiple-choice questions whose visual components can be protected with subtle visual perturbations that steer AI solvers toward designated incorrect answers. These responses form a statistical fingerprint: students who blindly copy a solver reproduce the induced answer pattern more frequently than genuine students. We study the feasibility of this paradigm under realistic black-box assistant assumptions using three of the most common state-of-the-art multimodal language models: Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, and OpenAI's ChatGPT. By using accessible surrogate models, we optimize adversarial perturbations that induce consistent response patterns. Those patterns enable principled detection through statistical hypothesis testing. These findings establish both the promise and the limitations of fighting machine-assisted reasoning with the vulnerabilities of the machines themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用对抗机器学习技术保护教育习题免受生成式AI辅助作弊的侵害，通过在多模态选择题的视觉组件上施加微妙的对抗扰动，诱导AI解答器得出指定错误答案，从而形成统计指纹来识别盲目抄袭AI的学生。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的广泛普及使学生能够将认知任务外包给越来越强大的AI助手，造成"能力错觉"，破坏了教育旨在培养的独立思考能力。作者希望利用对抗机器学习来保护教育习题免受这种腐蚀性的依赖。
AI.method: 使用多模态多项选择题，在视觉组件上施加微妙视觉扰动，引导AI求解器（Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT）走向指定错误答案。这些错误答案形成统计指纹：盲目复制AI答案的学生会比真实学生更频繁地复现诱导的答案模式。使用可访问的替代模型优化对抗扰动，并通过统计假设检验实现原理性检测。
AI.result: 在三种最先进的多模态语言模型（Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT）上验证了该范式在现实黑盒助手假设下的可行性，证明了对抗扰动能诱导一致的响应模式，且这些模式可通过统计假设检验实现检测。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果既展示了利用机器自身脆弱性对抗机器辅助推理的希望，也揭示了其局限性。

title: NISF++: Geometrically-grounded implicit representations of 3D+time cardiac function from 2D short- and long-axis MR views
summary: Clinical acquisition in cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging involves obtaining cross-sectional planes of the heart along the radial and longitudinal directions. Despite these planes being 2D cross-sectional images of the heart, radiologists understand the 3D spatial and continuous temporal nature of the organ being imaged. The same can not be said about the conventional deep learning architectures used to process CMR images, which rely on in-plane and grid-based operations, and are hence unable to organically integrate information from all imaging planes. This paper builds upon previous work on neural implicit segmentation functions (NISF) to overcome unaddressed challenges in cardiac function modeling in the CMR domain. For a given subject, our architecture builds a shared 3D+time representations from all available acquisition planes regardless of orientation. By design, predictions along any imaging plane orientation are cross-sections of the same 3D representation, leading to spatio-temporal consistency across all slices. Moreover, our architecture makes the rotation and translation parameters of imaging planes learnable, allowing us to correct for the commonplace respiratory and patient motion between slice acquisitions under a rigid assumption. Furthermore, interpolation of intensities and segmentation can be performed in 4D at any desired resolution. We perform our study on a 120 subject sub-cohort of CMR imaging data from the UK-Biobank. Our in-plane segmentation performance is on-par with existing CMR segmentation methods and explore how the majority of failure cases arise from limitations in the ground-truth segmentation, for which our representations make predictions with better anatomical accuracy than its original training data. We also evaluate our motion-correction capabilities, displaying quantitative and qualitative improvements in slice alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经隐式分割函数（NISF）的4D（3D+时间）心脏磁共振成像分割方法，该方法构建共享的3D+时间表示，整合所有采集平面的信息，并通过可学习的旋转和平移参数校正呼吸和患者运动导致的层间错位。在UK-Biobank 120名受试者子队列上，平面内分割性能与现有方法相当，且运动校正能力在定量和定性上均有改善。
AI.motivation: 传统CMR深度学习架构依赖平面内和网格化操作，无法有机整合所有成像平面（径向和纵向）的信息。虽然CMR采集的是2D横断面图像，但放射科医生能理解器官的3D空间和连续时间特性，而传统架构不具备这种能力，导致跨层面的时空一致性缺失。
AI.method: 基于神经隐式分割函数（NISF）构建共享的3D+时间表示，从所有可用采集平面学习（无论方向如何）。预测沿任意成像平面方向的输出都是同一3D表示的横截面，保证时空一致性。此外，将成像平面的旋转和平移参数设为可学习，在刚性假设下校正呼吸和患者运动；支持在4D空间中按任意分辨率插值强度和分割结果。
AI.result: 在UK-Biobank的120名受试者子队列上，平面内分割性能与现有CMR分割方法相当；多数失败案例源于标注数据本身的局限，而本文方法的表示在解剖精度上优于训练数据。运动校正功能在定量和定性上均显示层面对齐的改善。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过统一的4D神经隐式表示解决了CMR领域中平面间信息整合和运动校正的问题，证明了隐式神经表示在心脏功能建模中的潜力，其分割性能在解剖精度上甚至能超越原始训练数据。

title: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) is a distribution-free framework for uncertainty quantification that has recently been adapted to large language models (LLMs), providing prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees under exchangeability. Yet for LLMs, nonconformity scores are often induced by an inference pipeline, not just a fixed model, making them depend not only on the data distribution but also on configurable factors such as the prompt template, decoding parameters, and deployment setting. Since such configurations are routinely modified in practice but rarely treated as a source of shift, their impact on CP validity remains poorly understood. We call this \emph{configuration shift} and study it systematically along three axes: prompt template, decoding temperature, and weight quantization. In a broad empirical study spanning $9$ LLMs, $4$ datasets, and $4$ nonconformity scores, we find that configuration shift consistently erodes CP validity, often driving empirical coverage below the target. By contrast, efficiency is largely preserved: valid prediction sets remain close in size to the i.i.d. baseline. We derive coverage lower bounds that attribute this loss to a discrepancy between calibration and test score distributions, and use their finite-sample plug-in versions as empirical diagnostics of shift severity. We further show that these findings lead to practical mitigations: bound-inspired recalibration is effective with limited test examples, while fragility-aware calibration ensembling recovers much of the lost coverage without test data.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大语言模型中配置变化（prompt模板、解码温度、权重量化）对共形预测有效性的影响，发现配置偏移会持续侵蚀CP的覆盖率，但效率基本保持；并提出了基于覆盖率下界的诊断方法和两种缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 共形预测已适配到LLM，但其非一致性分数由推理管线（而非固定模型）诱导，依赖于可配置因素如prompt模板、解码参数和部署设置。这些配置在实践中经常修改，却很少被视为偏移来源，导致其对CP有效性的影响未被充分理解。作者将其定义为"配置偏移"（configuration shift）并系统研究。
AI.method: 沿三个维度（prompt模板、解码温度、权重量化）系统研究配置偏移；在9个LLM、4个数据集、4种非一致性分数上进行广泛实验；推导覆盖率下界将覆盖率损失归因于校准与测试分数分布之间的差异，并使用有限样本插件版本作为偏移严重程度的经验诊断；提出两种缓解方法：基于下界启发重校准（bound-inspired recalibration）和脆弱性感知的校准集成（fragility-aware calibration ensembling）。
AI.result: 配置偏移持续侵蚀CP的有效性，经验覆盖率经常低于目标值；但效率基本保留，有效预测集大小与i.i.d.基线接近。基于下界启发重校准在少量测试样本下有效，脆弱性感知校准集成无需测试数据即可恢复大部分丢失的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 配置偏移是影响LLM共形预测有效性的关键但常被忽视的因素，覆盖率下界可作为有效诊断工具，且所提出的两种缓解方法能显著恢复覆盖率。

title: PALMs: Using Multi Construct-Grounded Rationales for Modeling Population Preferences in LLMs
summary: Large language models are being extensively used to simulate individual user behavior, yet faithfully representing a population requires capturing the systematic variation in values, beliefs, and cultural norms that distinguish one group from another. We introduce Population Aligned Language Models (PALMs), a suite of models each aligned to specific populations, covering five countries: USA, India, Brazil, France and Italy. PALMs are created by synthesizing rationales grounded in psychological and cultural constructs and using these as latent supervision during preference tuning for population-specific alignment. Evaluated across four dimensions: personality, values and beliefs, cultural norms, and morality, PALMs consistently outperform baselines, including culture-specialized models, achieving an average of 8.59% relative improvement over the best baseline across all five populations. Notably, construct-grounded rationales outperform both demographic prompting and survey-based fine-tuning, suggesting that grounding preference learning in psychology and culture provides a richer inductive signal than surface-level response distributions. We further demonstrate strong generalization to downstream applications with- out task-specific supervision: outperforming best baselines by 5.19% in personalized reward modeling, 6.34% in population simulation, and showing strong transfer to social reasoning tasks. Datasets and code are available at: https://github.com/limenlp/PALMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PALMs（Population Aligned Language Models），一套针对五个国家（美国、印度、巴西、法国、意大利）特定人群对齐的大语言模型。通过将基于心理学和文化构念的推理作为偏好调优的潜在监督信号，PALMs在人格、价值观与信念、文化规范、道德四个维度上均优于基线模型，平均相对提升8.59%，并展现出良好的下游任务泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常被用于模拟个体用户行为，但忠实表征整个人群需要捕捉不同群体之间在价值观、信念和文化规范上的系统性差异。现有方法缺乏将心理学和文化构念融入人群对齐的有效手段。
AI.method: 提出PALMs方法：1）综合心理学与文化构念知识生成推理（rationales）；2）将这些推理作为偏好调优过程中的潜在监督信号，实现人群特异性对齐；3）覆盖五个国家人口，在人格、价值观、文化规范、道德四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: PALMs在四个评估维度上一致优于包括文化特化模型在内的所有基线，平均相对提升8.59%。在个性化奖励建模上超基线5.19%，人口模拟上超6.34%，并展现出向社交推理任务的强迁移能力。构建导向的推理优于人口统计提示和基于调查的微调。
AI.conclusion: 将偏好学习植根于心理学和文化构念，相比表面响应分布提供了更丰富的归纳信号。PALMs证明了无需任务特定监督即可在多种下游应用中实现强泛化，为人群级模型对齐提供了新的范式。

title: MA-HEAD-Net: Adaptive Rule-Guided Multi-Agent DRL for AoI Minimization in UAV-Assisted Emergency Networks
summary: In post-disaster scenarios, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are critical for establishing emergency communication networks. For time-critical rescue missions, information freshness is crucial because decisions based on outdated data may lead to ineffective control actions. This paper investigates age of information (AoI) minimization for UAV-assisted emergency communications with heterogeneous emergency services. We model bursty packet arrivals using a Markov-modulated Poisson process and adopt finite blocklength theory to capture the coupling among transmission duration, packet completion, and AoI evolution. To balance delay-tolerant long-packet transmission and urgent short-packet response, we propose a mini-slot-embedded scheduling mechanism with adaptive checkpoint-interval selection. We formulate the joint optimization of UAV trajectory control, user scheduling, and checkpoint-interval selection as a multi-agent decision problem, and develop MA-HEAD-Net, an adaptive rule-guided multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework. MA-HEAD-Net incorporates communication-domain rule priors into a gated multi-head policy, where adaptive gates regulate the contributions of rule-prior and learned-policy logits for different subtasks. The policy and gating components are jointly optimized under multi-agent proximal policy optimization. Simulation results show that MA-HEAD-Net improves policy-formation efficiency compared with representative multi-agent deep reinforcement learning baselines and achieves lower AoI than both learning-based and heuristic methods in dynamic UAV-assisted emergency communication scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无人机辅助应急通信中信息年龄（AoI）的最小化问题。针对异构应急服务，采用马尔可夫调制泊松过程建模突发数据包到达，并用有限块长理论刻画传输时长、数据包完成与AoI演化的耦合关系。提出嵌有微时隙的调度机制及自适应检查点间隔选择，并将无人机轨迹控制、用户调度与检查点间隔选择的联合优化建模为多智能体决策问题，开发了MA-HEAD-Net自适应规则引导的多智能体深度强化学习框架。
AI.motivation: 灾后场景中无人机对建立应急通信网络至关重要，且救援任务对信息新鲜度（AoI）高度敏感，基于过时数据的决策可能导致无效的控制行动，因此需要最小化AoI以保障时效性。
AI.method: 1) 用马尔可夫调制泊松过程建模突发流量，采用有限块长理论耦合传输时长、数据包完成与AoI演化；2) 提出微型微时隙嵌入式调度机制，兼顾时延容忍的长包传输与紧急短包响应，并引入自适应检查点间隔选择；3) 将联合优化建模为多智能体决策问题；4) 提出MA-HEAD-Net，将通信域规则先验嵌入门控多头策略网络，自适应门控调节规则先验与学习策略logits在不同子任务中的贡献；5) 采用多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）联合优化策略与门控组件。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，MA-HEAD-Net相比代表性的多智能体深度强化学习基线提升了策略形成效率，并在动态无人机应急通信场景中实现了比基于学习的和启发式方法更低的AoI。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的规则引导多智能体强化学习框架MA-HEAD-Net能有效融合领域先验知识提升学习效率，在异构应急服务的动态无人机通信场景中优于现有方法，实现了更低的信息年龄。

title: ChordVideo: One-Step, Training-Free, Temporally Consistent Video Editing via Low-Energy Transport
summary: One-step text-to-image models enable training-free, inversion-free editing with only 1--2 network function evaluations (NFE), while ChordEdit stabilizes such edits through low-energy smoothing along sampling time. Applied independently to video frames, however, it produces temporal flicker and edit-strength drift. We introduce \textbf{ChordVideo}, which extends the same low-energy principle to video time through shared noise, motion-aligned causal aggregation of per-frame Chord fields, and an optional temporally smoothed proximal correction. We derive a warping-error bound that separates motion bias from stochastic flicker and predicts diminishing returns with larger temporal windows. On TGVE/DAVIS with two one-step backbones, ChordVideo reduces warping error by \textbf{78\%} and flicker by \textbf{49\%}, improves CLIP frame consistency by \textbf{9--10 points}, and increases background PSNR by about \textbf{1.5,dB}, while retaining \textbf{2 NFE/frame}. Compared with seven multi-step editors, it achieves competitive temporal consistency and source preservation using \textbf{10--60$\times$ fewer model steps per clip

AI.tldr: ChordVideo 将单步文本到图像模型的时间一致性编辑扩展到视频领域，通过共享噪声、运动对齐的因果聚合和时域平滑的近端校正，在保持每帧仅 2 次网络函数评估（NFE）的同时，显著降低闪烁和编辑强度漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有单步文本到图像编辑方法（如 ChordEdit）在视频帧上独立应用时会产生时间闪烁和编辑强度漂移，亟需一种既能利用单步编辑高效性、又能保持视频时间一致性的方法。
AI.method: 将 ChordEdit 的低能量平滑原则从采样时间扩展到视频时间维度，采用三种策略：共享噪声初始化、运动对齐的因果聚合（将每帧的 Chord 场沿光流对齐后聚合）以及可选的时域平滑近端校正。同时推导了翘曲误差界，将运动偏差与随机闪烁分离。
AI.result: 在 TGVE/DAVIS 数据集和两个单步骨干网络上，ChordVideo 将翘曲误差降低 78%，闪烁降低 49%，CLIP 帧一致性提升 9-10 分，背景 PSNR 提升约 1.5dB，同时保持每帧 2 NFE。与七个多步编辑方法相比，使用少 10-60 倍的模型步数即可达到相当的时间一致性和源内容保持。
AI.conclusion: ChordVideo 证明了将单步文本到图像编辑的低能量原则扩展到视频时间维度是有效的，能够在极低的计算成本下实现高质量的视频一致编辑，并提供了理论误差界指导时间窗口的选择。

title: Plasticity of Growing and Elastic Neural Networks in Online Continual Learning
summary: Neural networks that can grow or both grow and shrink during learning, referred to as growing neural networks and elastic neural networks, respectively, have recently been explored in offline continual learning with a particular focus on catastrophic forgetting. Driven by the observations that 1) online continual learning closely resembles how animals learn; 2) loss of plasticity---the progressive decline in a learning network's ability to learn---is another crucial challenge facing continual learning; and 3) incremental introduction of randomly initialized hidden units was recently shown to help preserve plasticity, in this paper, we study the plasticity of several foundational growing and elastic networks in online continual learning. Our experiments in supervised learning settings show that adaptive growing networks, which incrementally incorporate new, randomly initialized units to the network while keeping all existing connections adaptive, can maintain high prediction accuracy without losing plasticity despite the continuous increase in the dead hidden unit proportion. Furthermore, we demonstrate that adaptive elastic networks, which in addition to progressively adding new hidden units also prune estimated dead hidden units at the beginning of each new task, can achieve excellent accuracy without loss of plasticity while simultaneously maintaining a near-constant, compact size. Our results suggest that growing and elastic networks, which exhibit the ability to adapt its structure to the relevant learning objectives, can be a promising class of algorithms also for preserving high plasticity in online continual learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了成长型神经网络和弹性神经网络在在线持续学习中的可塑性表现。实验表明，自适应成长网络（增量添加随机初始化的隐藏单元）能在不损失可塑性的情况下保持高预测精度，而自适应弹性网络（同时添加新单元并剪枝死单元）能在保持紧凑模型尺寸的同时实现优异精度和可塑性。
AI.motivation: 在线持续学习更接近动物的学习方式，而可塑性丧失（学习能力随训练逐渐下降）是持续学习面临的另一关键挑战。尽管成长型/弹性网络已在离线持续学习中用于缓解灾难性遗忘，但其在在线持续学习中的可塑性表现尚未被系统研究。此外，已有研究表明逐步引入随机初始化的隐藏单元有助于保持可塑性。
AI.method: 在监督学习的在线持续学习设置下，系统研究了几种基础成长型网络和弹性网络的可塑性表现。具体包括：1）自适应成长网络——逐步向网络中增量添加随机初始化的新单元，同时保持所有现有连接可自适应；2）自适应弹性网络——在每个新任务开始时，除逐步添加新隐藏单元外，还剪枝估计为死亡的隐藏单元，以维持紧凑的模型规模。
AI.result: 1）自适应成长网络尽管死隐藏单元比例持续增加，仍能保持高预测精度而不损失可塑性；2）自适应弹性网络在添加新单元的同时剪枝死单元，实现了优异的精度和无可塑性损失，同时保持近似恒定且紧凑的模型尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 成长型和弹性网络具有动态调整网络结构以适应学习目标的能力，是同时保持在线持续学习中高可塑性的有前景的算法类别。

title: Retrieval Augmented Biomedical Question Answering with Weak Question Recovery and Neural Reranking for BioASQ Task 14b
summary: This work presents DS@GT ARC BioASQ team's work for a biomedical question answering pipeline, integrating multi-source query expansion, neural reranking, retrieval refinement, and OpenBioLLM-assisted answer generation. The system combines PubMed retrieval with fine-tuned MiniLM-based semantic reranking, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and feature-based relevance scoring to improve document ranking quality. To address challenging queries with weak retrieval performance, we introduce a conditional weak-question recovery strategy that applies semantic expansion, relationship-aware augmentation, and selective result merging. A post-retrieval pruning stage further removes redundant or low-relevance snippets while preserving evidence coverage for downstream answer generation. Experimental results on BioASQ evaluation batches demonstrate that the proposed recovery and cleanup strategies substantially improve retrieval robustness and MAP@10 performance on difficult question sets. The final system also incorporates output validation and post-processing steps to ensure formatting consistency and submission reliability across BioASQ phases.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DS@GT ARC BioASQ团队构建的生物医学问答流水线，整合了多源查询扩展、神经重排序、检索优化和OpenBioLLM辅助答案生成，并通过条件性弱问题恢复策略和检索后剪枝提升困难问题的检索鲁棒性，在BioASQ评测中显著改善MAP@10性能。
AI.motivation: 生物医学问答中，困难查询往往检索性能较弱，影响下游答案生成的准确性。作者旨在通过多阶段优化（查询扩展、重排序、检索精炼）以及针对弱检索问题的恢复策略，提升系统在BioASQ基准上的整体表现。
AI.method: 系统采用PubMed检索结合微调MiniLM语义重排序，使用倒数排名融合（RRF）和基于特征的关联性评分进行文档排序。针对困难问题引入条件性弱问题恢复策略，包括语义扩展、关系感知增强和选择性结果合并；同时加入检索后剪枝阶段，去除冗余或低关联性片段，保留证据覆盖，最终由OpenBioLLM生成答案并配合输出验证和后期处理保证格式一致性。
AI.result: 在BioASQ评估批次上的实验结果表明，所提出的恢复和清理策略显著提升了困难问题集上的检索鲁棒性和MAP@10性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了多源查询扩展与条件性弱问题恢复策略在生物医学问答检索中的有效性，同时通过输出验证和后期处理确保系统在BioASQ各阶段的提交可靠性。

title: PATH-Bench: Path-Dependent Evaluation of Lifelong Agents
summary: Lifelong LLM agents increasingly adapt through external learning states that store past interactions as retrievable memories or reusable skills, yet existing benchmarks rarely account for how the path of accumulated experience shapes what agents transfer and retain. In this work, we establish PATH-Bench, a benchmark for path-dependent evaluation of lifelong agents. PATH-Bench estimates directed task relationships via multi-model in-context learning, constructs probe-centered sequences with controlled helpful and interfering histories, and repeatedly evaluates probe tasks to measure average performance, forward transfer, backward transfer, and forgetting. We evaluate eight representative agents on single-turn code generation and multi-turn tool-use tasks under positive- and negative-dominant histories. Benchmark results show that experience utility depends jointly on how experience is represented and on the task's interaction structure, that strong transfer does not ensure retention, and that later experience can reshape gains acquired earlier in the learning path. Based on these findings, we propose Selective Experience Use (SEU), an agent harness that regulates how path-accumulated experience influences each new task, admitting helpful items while filtering out potential interference. SEU consistently reduces forgetting while improving forward transfer in the majority of settings. The PATH-Bench provides both a controlled evaluation framework and actionable guidance for designing more selective and robust lifelong agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PATH-Bench，一个用于评估终身学习智能体路径依赖行为的基准测试框架。它通过多模型上下文学习估计任务间的有向关系，构建受控的探针中心序列（包含有益和干扰历史），并反复评估探针任务来测量平均性能、前向迁移、后向迁移和遗忘。在此基础上提出选择性经验使用（SEU）机制，通过调节路径积累经验的影响来减少遗忘并提升前向迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有终身学习智能体评测基准很少考虑经验积累路径如何影响智能体的迁移和保留能力，缺乏对路径依赖效应的系统评估。
AI.method: 1) 通过多模型内上下文学习估计任务间的定向关系；2) 构建包含受控有益/干扰历史序列的探针中心测试序列；3) 反复评估探针任务以测量平均性能、前向迁移、后向迁移和遗忘；4) 提出SEU智能体框架，选择性接受有益经验并过滤干扰。
AI.result: 在8种代表性智能体上的评估表明：经验效用同时取决于经验表示方式和任务交互结构；强迁移能力不保证良好的知识保留；后期经验可以重塑前期获得的收益。SEU在大多数设置中一致减少遗忘并提升前向迁移。
AI.conclusion: PATH-Bench提供了受控的评估框架和可操作的指导，用于设计更具选择性和鲁棒性的终身学习智能体。

title: CADENA: Stepwise CAD Reverse Engineering
summary: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) underpins modern engineering, yet converting existing shapes into editable models still demands substantial expert effort. Most AI systems emit the entire CAD program in a single pass, never inspecting the intermediate geometry. In contrast, human engineers build a part feature by feature, checking after each operation what remains to be modeled.
