We introduce CADENA (Spanish for "chain"), a model that reconstructs a 3D mesh as a parametric CAD program, growing its sequence of operations one at a time and comparing the target with the currently predicted geometry at every step. We also address the lack of benchmarks for evaluating reverse-engineering methods on mechanical parts, introducing CADENA-Bench, a benchmark that measures performance across categories of mechanical parts. CADENA outperforms prior methods on CADENA-Bench and on the DeepCAD, Fusion 360, and MCB datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/zhemdi/cadena, model weights at https://huggingface.co/kulibinai/cadena, and CADENA-Bench at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kulibinai/cadena-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADENA，一种逐步生成CAD程序的模型，通过在每一步将当前预测几何与目标网格进行比较，实现从3D网格到参数化CAD程序的重建。同时引入CADENA-Bench基准，在多个数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统通常一次性输出完整CAD程序，从不检查中间几何状态，而人类工程师是逐步构建特征的。这种"一次性生成"的方式导致重建精度不足，因为模型无法在生成过程中根据中间几何结果进行校正。
AI.method: CADENA采用逐步（chain）的方式生成CAD操作序列：每一步只生成一个操作，并与当前预测几何和目标的网格进行比较，根据差异指导下一步的生成。此外，还构建了CADENA-Bench基准，用于在机械零件类别上评估逆向工程方法的性能。
AI.result: CADENA在CADENA-Bench以及DeepCAD、Fusion 360和MCB数据集上均优于现有方法，展示了逐步生成策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过模仿人类工程师逐步构建的工作方式，将几何反馈融入CAD程序生成过程，CADENA显著提升了网格到CAD程序重建的性能，并提供了更完善的基准来推动该领域发展。

title: Interpretable MEG Decoding of Perceived Speech: Cortical Sources and the Stimulus Features That Drive Retrieval
summary:
Short segments of perceived speech can be retrieved from non-invasive magnetoencephalographic (MEG) recordings by deep networks trained with a CLIP-style objective against wav2vec 2.0 audio embeddings. Yet their weights do not map onto electrophysiological quantities, and it remains unclear which speech properties drive retrieval.
  We build on a high-performing MEG-to-audio retrieval architecture but redesign both its front end and decoder. Its spatial attention operates on a flattened sensor layout; we replace it with spherical harmonics defined on the three-dimensional MEG helmet geometry. We reduce the subject-specific representation from 270 to 25 branches, add a temporal filter to each branch to match it to a neuronal source in space and time, and make the convolutional decoder shallower. Ocular and cardiac components are removed before training to reduce the risk of stimulus-locked shortcuts.
  On MEG-MASC, the model reaches 39.75 +/- 0.34% Top-1 accuracy among 1005 candidates across six trained solutions, with about 20 times fewer decoder parameters. Its weights map to source space, recovering generators consistent with the speech-perception network, while left-lateralized branches carry higher-frequency rhythmic components not evident on the right. Paired MEG occlusion shows that 15 of 19 stimulus features contribute, with the largest effects for silence, sound intensity, vowels, and acoustic onsets. Random word lists behave oppositely: substituting narrative MEG into them improves retrieval, indicating that activity without narrative structure carries less recoverable information than activity during coherent speech. The wav2vec target can be reduced to about twelve learned feature dimensions without loss of accuracy, whereas strong temporal compression causes a clear loss.
  Together, source mapping and input interventions reveal what drives retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进的MEG到音频检索架构，通过球谐函数替代扁平传感器注意力、压缩分支数量并添加时间滤波器，使模型权重可映射到源空间。模型在MEG-MASC上达到39.75% Top-1准确率，同时参数减少约20倍，并揭示了驱动检索的语音特征（静音、声音强度、元音、声学起始）以及叙事结构对检索的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有MEG到音频检索的深度网络虽然表现良好，但其权重无法映射到电生理量上，且不清楚哪些语音属性驱动了检索过程，缺乏可解释性和神经生理学对应关系。
AI.method: 对高表现MEG到音频检索架构进行重新设计：(1) 将扁平传感器布局上的空间注意力替换为基于三维MEG头盔几何的球谐函数；(2) 将主题特定表示从270个分支压缩到25个，并为每个分支添加时间滤波器以匹配空间和时间上的神经源；(3) 使用更浅的卷积解码器；(4) 训练前去除眼动和心电成分以减少刺激锁定捷径。
AI.result: 在MEG-MASC上达到39.75±0.34%的Top-1准确率（1005个候选中），解码器参数减少约20倍。权重映射到源空间，恢复的生成器与语音感知网络一致；左侧化分支携带高频节律成分。19个刺激特征中15个有贡献，最大效应来自静音、声音强度、元音和声学起始。随机词表替换显示叙事结构携带更多可恢复信息。wav2vec目标可压缩至约12个特征维度而不损失精度，但强时间压缩会导致明显损失。
AI.conclusion: 通过源空间映射和输入干预，揭示了驱动MEG检索的具体语音特征和神经机制，实现了可解释且参数高效的MEG到语音检索模型，并证明叙事性语音内容比无结构语音携带更多可恢复的神经信息。

title: Two-Stage Bengali Sentiment Classification: Domain Adaptation Through Continual Learning and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Understanding sentiment in low-resource languages remains a key challenge for Natural Language Processing (NLP), particularly when domain-specific data is scarce. In this work, we present SentiBanglaBERT, a two-stage Bengali sentiment classification framework combining domain-adaptive continual pretraining and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The approach enables contextual adaptation to news-style data while remaining computationally efficient through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Beyond performance, SentiBanglaBERT integrates SHAP-based interpretability, offering linguistic insights into how Bengali morphological cues, such as negation suffixes and aspectual markers, influence sentiment predictions. Experiments demonstrate stable performance comparable to strong baselines while providing greater transparency and interpretive depth. This framework highlights the potential of domain-adaptive continual learning as a foundation for interpretable, resource-efficient NLP in morphologically rich, underrepresented languages.

AI.tldr: SentiBanglaBERT是一个两阶段的孟加拉语情感分类框架，结合领域自适应持续预训练和参数高效微调（LoRA），并集成SHAP可解释性分析，在保持与强基线相当性能的同时提供更透明的语言洞察。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的情感分析仍是NLP的关键挑战，特别是在领域特定数据稀缺的情况下。现有方法缺乏对孟加拉语这类形态丰富的低资源语言的有效处理，且缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 采用两阶段框架：1) 领域自适应持续预训练，使模型适应新闻风格数据；2) 使用Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)进行参数高效微调，降低计算成本。同时集成SHAP可解释性方法，分析孟加拉语形态特征（如否定后缀、体标记）对情感预测的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在性能上与强基线相当，同时提供更高的透明度和解释深度，揭示了孟加拉语形态线索对情感预测的影响。
AI.conclusion: 领域自适应持续学习可以作为形态丰富、代表性不足语言中可解释且资源高效NLP的基础，SentiBanglaBERT展示了这一范式的可行性。

title: The Graph Language: How Knowledge Graphs Speak to Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at reasoning but benefit from grounding provided by Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, integrating these paradigms is challenging. We introduce GRALAN, which enables KGs to speak directly in the LLM's semantic space through relational tokens that preserve graph structure. GRALAN-s trainable language mediator generates structured tokens for any frozen LLM, creating a foundation for knowledge-intensive applications. We demonstrate its effectiveness in question-answering by re-framing the task as entity classification over question-focused subgraphs. Experiments show that GRALAN significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex multi-hop reasoning tasks, establishing a new paradigm for KG-LLM integration that maintains structural fidelity while leveraging LLMs' reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: GRALAN提出了一种新颖的知识图谱与大型语言模型集成方法，通过可训练的语言中介器将知识图谱结构转化为关系令牌（relational tokens），使冻结的LLM能够直接理解和推理图结构信息，在复杂多跳推理的问答任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型擅长推理但缺乏外部知识支撑，知识图谱能提供结构化知识但难以与LLM直接集成。如何将这两种互补的范式有效结合是一个核心挑战，现有方法往往牺牲图结构保真度或限制LLM的推理能力。
AI.method: GRALAN包含一个可训练的语言中介器（trainable language mediator），将知识图谱中的关系与结构信息编码为关系令牌（relational tokens），这些令牌保留图的结构特性，可以直接输入任何冻结的LLM。在问答任务中，将问题重构为基于问题聚焦子图的实体分类任务。
AI.result: 实验表明GRALAN在问答任务上显著优于现有方法，尤其在复杂的多跳推理任务上表现突出，同时保持了图结构的完整性并充分发挥了LLM的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: GRALAN建立了KG-LLM集成的新范式，通过关系令牌实现知识图谱在LLM语义空间中的直接表达，既保持结构保真度又利用LLM的推理能力，为知识密集型应用奠定了基础。

title: AIMold: An Autonomous AI-based Pipeline for Complex Mold Design
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/tb2-sy/AIMold
summary: Injection molding is the cornerstone of mass-producing plastic components. While current algorithms can automate mold design for basic geometries using standard two-piece molds, complex parts featuring undercuts, side holes, or re-entrant features present a significant challenge. These geometries often necessitate auxiliary components beyond the primary upper and lower molds. In practice, designing these intricate assemblies is a laborious process that relies heavily on expert knowledge. Furthermore, the scarcity of public datasets has hindered the development of effective learning-based solutions. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MoldCAD, a curated dataset that pairs complex single-body CAD parts with industry-standard mold assemblies. Each entry includes the upper and lower molds, parting surfaces, demolding orientations, and necessary auxiliary components. The dataset comprises 4,934 CAD models and over 3,850 mold assemblies, totaling more than 23k individual models. Building upon this dataset, we propose a comprehensive pipeline that predicts demolding orientations, identifies auxiliary components, and constructs parting surfaces to derive a complete, manufacturing-ready mold assembly for downstream CAD/CAM workflows. Our results demonstrate a promising path toward fully automated industrial mold design and contribute to the broader advancement of manufacturing-aware CAD generation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍MoldCAD数据集，包含4,934个复杂CAD零件与3,850+套工业级模具装配（超23k个模型），并提出了一个完整流水线来自动预测脱模方向、识别辅助组件并构建分型面，从而实现全自动模具设计。
AI.motivation: 现有算法只能自动化设计标准两片式模具，对于含有倒扣、侧孔或重入特征等复杂零件，需要额外的辅助组件，设计过程高度依赖专家经验且耗时。此外，缺乏公开数据集阻碍了基于学习的方案发展。
AI.method: 构建MoldCAD数据集（包含上下模、分型面、脱模方向和辅助组件的标注），并在此基础上提出一套完整流水线：预测脱模方向→识别辅助组件→构建分型面，最终生成可直接用于下游CAD/CAM的完整模具装配。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该流水线在自动模具设计上展现出了有前景的性能，为全自动工业模具设计提供了可行性路径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了复杂模具设计公共数据集的空白，为制造感知的CAD生成和全自动模具设计铺平了道路。

title: BiKAN: Restoring Collapsed Basis of Binary Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks
summary: Binarizing a polynomial Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN) not only changes parameter precision, but also alters the function space available to each layer. When activations are restricted to ${-1,+1}$, all even powers reduce to $1$ and all odd powers reduce to $x$, causing the elementwise polynomial basis to collapse to constant and first-order responses. We refer to this structural failure as Spatial Orthogonality Collapse. Our proposed BiKAN addresses this critical issue by augmenting each binary KAN layer with selected degree-2 Walsh characters. Fixed circular channel rolls generate pairwise parities, and learned binary projections mix them using the same XNOR--popcount operations as the remaining W1A1 paths. This restores explicit pairwise coordinates without learned routing or multiplier-based feature generation. Experiments on CIFAR-10 confirms that removing parity reduces accuracy by $1.23$ points over five paired seeds ($p=0.003$), the gain increases as width decreases, and accuracy improves monotonically as more parity planes are added. At an equal $\sim$11.9M-parameter budget, parity outperforms conventional widening by $3.09$ points ($p<10^{-4}$). At W1A1, BiKAN reaches $99.48\%$, $84.38\%$, and $55.81\%$ on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100, respectively. Post-route Zynq-7020 FPGA results show that the repair remains hardware-efficient; the convolutional design cuts DSP usage from 164 to 72 and estimated compute-core latency from 401 to 54.8 ms, while the power-of-two-aware dense design achieves zero-DSP inference with a 0.03-point accuracy loss. The BiKAN implementation is available at https://github.com/OSU-STARLAB/BiKAN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiKAN，解决二值化多项式KAN中因激活函数被限制为{-1,+1}而导致的多项式基函数退化问题（称为空间正交性坍缩）。通过引入二阶Walsh字符（parity平面）恢复成对坐标交互，并使用XNOR-popcount硬件友好操作实现，在W1A1条件下达到与全精度相当甚至更优的精度，同时显著降低硬件开销。
AI.motivation: 二值化KAN不仅改变参数精度，还会改变每层可用的函数空间：当激活被限制在{-1,+1}时，所有偶数次幂退化为常数1，所有奇数次幂退化为x，导致逐元素多项式基坍缩为常数和一次响应，丢失高阶特征表达能力。
AI.method: 在每个二值KAN层中增强选定的2阶Walsh字符。固定圆形通道滚动生成成对奇偶校验（pairwise parities），通过学习到的二值投影使用XNOR-popcount操作进行混合，与其余W1A1路径保持一致。这无需学习的路由或多路选择器即可恢复显式的成对坐标交互。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上，去除parity会导致平均1.23个百分点精度下降（p=0.003）；宽度越小增益越大，且随parity平面数量增加精度单调提升。在相同约11.9M参数预算下，parity比传统加宽提升3.09个百分点（p<10^-4）。W1A1下BiKAN在MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100上分别达到99.48%、84.38%和55.81%。Zynq-7020 FPGA结果表明：卷积设计将DSP从164降至72，计算核心延迟从401降至54.8ms；2的幂感知密集设计实现零DSP推理，仅损失0.03个百分点精度。
AI.conclusion: BiKAN通过Walsh字符增强有效修复了二值KAN的空间正交性坍缩问题，在不引入额外计算开销（XNOR-popcount）的前提下恢复了高阶成对特征表达能力，且在硬件部署上保持高效，验证了"修复功能性退化"比"单纯扩大网络"更有效。

title: Discriminative Axis, Not Data Volume: What a Contrastive Corpus Teaches an Audio Embedding
summary: Scaling the corpus is the default remedy when a contrastive representation lacks an attribute. We report a case where it does nothing, and identify what does: adding a lexical-speech round to a frozen-base multimodal embedding model raises zero-shot keyword spotting by 76 points while reducing speech-emotion recognition by 14. The loss is not a capacity limit: fine-tuning on 7,442 clips from a prosody-controlled corpus recovers emotion past its pre-speech level at a five-point keyword cost. Nor is it data volume: 29,428 mined clips whose captions explicitly name emotions, at matched exposure, move emotion by -0.0007. The difference is structural: a contrastive objective encodes an attribute only when the in-batch negatives cannot be separated without it; the controlled corpus holds sentence content fixed, so prosody is the only separating signal, whereas mined captions name emotion yet remain separable by scene content. Intervention on the same audio confirms causality: raising caption similarity does not recover emotion, but collapsing caption diversity so that emotion becomes the only separating axis recovers it by 8.9 points across three seeds, with a smaller, same-signed gain on a non-acted corpus, while keyword accuracy trades back. Corpus structure, not size or caption vocabulary, controls what a contrastive audio embedding encodes.

AI.tldr: 本文发现扩展语料规模并不能弥补对比学习表征中缺失的属性。通过给冻结的基础多模态嵌入模型添加词汇-语音轮次，零样本关键词识别提升了76点，但语音情感识别下降了14点。通过受控语料（7442个片段）微调可在5点关键词代价下恢复情感，而大规模挖掘语料（29428个片段）因结构问题无效。核心发现：对比目标只有在批内负样本无法不借助某属性分离时才会编码该属性，语料结构而非规模或词汇控制着对比音频嵌入的内容。
AI.motivation: 探究对比学习表征中属性缺失的补救方法，挑战"扩大语料规模即可解决"的默认假设，揭示语料结构在决定对比学习编码内容上的因果作用。
AI.method: 在冻结基础多模态嵌入模型上添加词汇-语音轮次；使用受控语料（固定内容变化韵律）与大规模挖掘语料（显式命名情感的标题）分别微调；通过操纵标题相似度与多样性进行干预实验验证因果关系。
AI.result: 词汇-语音轮次提升关键词识别76点但情感识别降14点；受控语料微调恢复情感且仅损失5点关键词性能；大规模挖掘语料在匹配曝光下几乎无情感提升（-0.0007）；干预实验表明提升标题相似度无效，而压缩标题多样性使情感成为唯一分离轴后恢复8.9点。
AI.conclusion: 对比音频嵌入编码什么属性由语料结构决定，而非语料规模或标题词汇。对比目标仅在批内负样本无法不借助某属性区分时才编码该属性，因此构建语料时应控制内容使目标属性成为唯一分离信号。

title: Models as Tools: An Agentic Coordination Framework for Unified Multimodal Visual Tracking
summary: Most current visual trackers adopt a matching-based architecture trained exclusively on tracking datasets, whose performance gains depend heavily on the length of the input context, and have now reached a bottleneck. While high-performance tracking increasingly relies on foundation models, existing methods use them monolithically, adapting a foundation model into a tracker or modify a segmentation foundation model into a tracking pipeline, which fails to exploit complementary strengths. Matching-based trackers excel at instance-level correspondence but lack semantic discrimination and fine-grained foreground perception, whereas segmentation foundation models produce precise masks yet struggle with instance discrimination and multimodal extension. Both paradigms also lack error-correction capabilities for long-term tracking. To address these issues, we propose ACTrack, an agentic coordination framework that treats heterogeneous models as invocable tools under an event-triggered mechanism. ACTrack coordinates a Tracker-based Instance Matching Tool for target discrimination, a SAM3 Motion Tool for mask-derived motion priors, a SAM3 Perception Tool for detecting distractors and instance-conflict cues, and a VLM Reprompt Tool activated only under persistent conflict to mitigate error accumulation. We design a complete tool-invocation trigger mechanism and an inter-tool coordination mechanism, enabling the complementary strengths of different model tools to be fully integrated. Experiments show that ACTrack substantially surpasses the strongest and the largest trackers on eight RGB benchmarks. Furthermore, a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy enables parameter sharing and reuse across tools, achieving unified multimodal tracking with only 30\% trainable parameters while substantially outperforming prior methods on multimodal benchmarks such as LasHeR, VisEvent, TNL2K, and DepthTrack.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACTrack，一种智能体协调框架，将异构模型（匹配追踪器、SAM3分割模型、VLM视觉语言模型）视为可调用的工具，通过事件触发机制协调各工具的优势互补，在RGB和多模态追踪基准上显著超越现有最强追踪器，仅需30%可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 现有匹配式追踪器基于单一架构，仅依赖追踪数据集训练，性能受限于输入上下文长度且已到达瓶颈；而基于基础模型的方法要么将基础模型整体改造为追踪器，要么修改分割基础模型，未能充分利用各模型互补优势。匹配式追踪器缺少语义判别和细粒度前景感知，分割基础模型缺少实例判别和多模态扩展能力，两者都缺乏长期追踪的错误修正能力。
AI.method: ACTrack采用智能体协调框架，将异构模型作为可调用的工具，包括：1) 基于追踪器的实例匹配工具（目标判别）；2) SAM3运动工具（掩码派生运动先验）；3) SAM3感知工具（检测干扰物和实例冲突线索）；4) VLM重提示工具（仅在持续冲突下激活以缓解误差累积）。设计了完整的工具调用触发机制和工具间协调机制，并采用参数高效适配策略实现参数共享与复用。
AI.result: ACTrack在八个RGB基准上大幅超越最强和最大的追踪器；在LasHeR、VisEvent、TNL2K、DepthTrack等多模态基准上以仅30%可训练参数显著优于先前方法，实现统一多模态追踪。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体协调机制将不同模型工具互补整合，能够突破单一架构追踪器的性能瓶颈，同时以参数高效方式实现多模态追踪，为视觉追踪提供了一种新的范式。

title: Stochastic Sequential Search in Very-High-Dimensional Feature Selection
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Ancillary files: a standalone implementation of sSFFS (MIT license, verified bit-identical to the reference implementation), a checksum-verified converter building the exact experiment datasets from the UCI originals, the derived Reuters-21578 term matrix used in the experiments (research use only), and the configuration files of all experiments
summary: Sequential subset search -- forward selection with floating backtracking and its descendants -- remains the quality reference in feature selection, but every member of the family sweeps the full pool of remaining candidate features at each step, which excludes it from very-high-dimensional problems; there, only individual-feature ranking remains practical, and it models feature interplay weakly or not at all. We introduce a budgeted sampled step operator pair that replaces the full sweeps by a fixed number of candidate evaluations per step. Candidates are drawn by temperature-controlled softmax sampling from dependency-aware per-feature statistics learned online from every criterion evaluation the search performs, guarded by a uniform exploration floor; per-step cost becomes independent of dimensionality. Substituting the operators turns any sequential method into its stochastic counterpart, defining the Stochastic Sequential Search (SSS) family; we study the stochastic counterpart of floating search, sSFFS. On 500-dimensional madelon, sSFFS retains at least 97% of the full-SFFS criterion value at every subset size at about a quarter of its evaluations, while uniform sampling at the same budget collapses on madelon's synergistic features. On 5,000-dimensional gisette, far beyond full-SFFS reach, sSFFS exceeds the saturated criterion level of DAF and BIF ranking at matched budgets; holdout validation shows that at 500 training samples the binding constraint beyond the sequential frontier becomes the criterion, not the search. On 10,105-dimensional reuters, under a trustworthy multinomial filter criterion, sSFFS dominates BIF and DAF on the search objective and on holdout accuracy at every subset size, in about two minutes of single-core evaluation work. A verified standalone implementation accompanies the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机序贯搜索（SSS）框架，通过预算化采样步操作替代传统序贯子集搜索中的全量扫描，使搜索成本与特征维度解耦，并将浮动搜索转化为其随机对应物sSFFS，在极高维特征选择问题上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 序贯子集搜索（如前向选择与浮动回溯）是特征选择的质量参考，但每一步都需要扫描全部剩余候选特征，导致无法应用于极高维问题。而仅有的实际可行方案——单特征排序——对特征间交互建模能力很弱。这一矛盾促使研究者寻找一种既能保持序贯搜索质量、又能将计算成本与维度解耦的方法。
AI.method: 引入预算化采样步操作对（budgeted sampled step operator pair）：每一步仅进行固定次数的候选评估，代替全量扫描。候选通过温度控制的softmax采样从依赖感知的逐特征统计量中抽取，这些统计量由搜索过程中每次准则评估在线学习得到，并辅以均匀探索下限保证覆盖。用该操作替换任何序贯方法中的原有操作即可得到其随机对应物，形成SSS家族；论文重点研究浮动搜索的随机对应物sSFFS。
AI.result: 在500维的madelon上，sSFFS在约四分之一的计算评估量下保留全量SFFS准则值的至少97%，而均匀采样在相同预算下在协同特征上崩溃。在5000维的gisette上（远超全量SFFS可达范围），sSFFS以匹配预算超越DAF和BIF排序的饱和准则水平；500个训练样本的留出验证显示瓶颈已从搜索转移到准则。在10105维的reuters上，sSFFS在搜索目标和留出准确率上全面支配BIF和DAF，仅需约两分钟单核评估。
AI.conclusion: 预算化采样序贯搜索成功弥合了序贯子集搜索的质量与单特征排序的可扩展性之间的鸿沟，使高质量特征选择扩展到极高维场景，并提供了可验证的独立实现。

title: DocNavRAG: Document-Structured Graph RAG with Stateful Evidence Construction for Complex Document Question Answering
summary: Answering complex questions over large document collections requires assembling complementary evidence across sections and documents. GraphRAG offers structured retrieval but typically uses fixed traversal, while agentic RAG operates over weakly structured interfaces. Our key insight is that agents should navigate document structure within and across documents rather than repeatedly search from scratch. We introduce DocNavRAG, which organizes document hierarchies and cross-region relations into a navigable graph, exposes graph operations for locating, navigating, expanding, and fetching, and maintains an evolving evidence state to guide retrieval until sufficient evidence is collected. Across four long- and multi-document QA benchmarks, DocNavRAG improves answer quality and context sufficiency over the strongest baseline by 7.8\% and 17.7\% on average.

AI.tldr: DocNavRAG提出了一种基于可导航图结构的检索增强生成方法，通过组织文档层级和跨区域关系，让智能体在文档内部和跨文档间进行结构化导航而非反复从头搜索，在四个长文档/多文档问答基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 回答复杂问题需要跨文档和文档内部整合互补证据。现有GraphRAG使用固定遍历方式，而agentic RAG在弱结构化接口上操作，两者均未能充分利用文档结构进行高效导航。核心洞察是智能体应导航文档结构而非反复从头搜索。
AI.method: DocNavRAG将文档层级和跨区域关系组织为可导航图，暴露四种图操作（定位、导航、展开、获取），并维护动态演化的证据状态以引导检索，直至收集到足够证据。
AI.result: 在四个长文档和多文档QA基准上，DocNavRAG相比最强基线，答案质量平均提升7.8%，上下文充分性平均提升17.7%。
AI.conclusion: DocNavRAG验证了基于文档结构导航的检索策略优于固定遍历和盲目搜索，能有效提升复杂文档问答的质量与证据充分性。

title: MIDAL: Math Image Descriptions for Accessible Learning
summary: Many open educational resources are lacking in accessibility, especially in-depth image descriptions. In subjects like Science and Mathematics, however, it can be particularly difficult to write image descriptions since there can be many complicated expressions and names depending upon the course level. To help fill that gap in a small way, we introduce Math Image Descriptions for Accessible Learning (MIDAL), a math image-description dataset of 2,020 mathematical images spanning multiple educational levels, to aid in training vision language models to create image descriptions following accessibility best practices. We hope MIDAL is a valuable resource in enhancing the conversation and innovation regarding accessibility of STEM content in higher education. This dataset is however not just limited in math description generation but can also be used to fine-tune language models that can have improved mathematical reasoning and answers.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MIDAL，一个包含2,020张数学图像的数据集，跨越多个教育层级，用于训练视觉语言模型生成符合无障碍最佳实践的图像描述，旨在提升STEM内容在高等教育中的可访问性。
AI.motivation: 许多开放教育资源缺乏可访问性，尤其是缺乏深入的图像描述。在科学和数学等学科中，由于存在许多复杂的表达式和名称，编写图像描述尤为困难，因此需要专门的资源来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建了一个名为Math Image Descriptions for Accessible Learning (MIDAL)的数学图像描述数据集，包含2,020张跨越多个教育层级的数学图像，用于训练视觉语言模型生成遵循无障碍最佳实践的图像描述。
AI.result: MIDAL数据集不仅可用于数学描述生成，还可用于微调语言模型，以提升其数学推理和问答能力。
AI.conclusion: 作者希望MIDAL能成为推动高等教育中STEM内容可访问性对话与创新的宝贵资源。

title: Question Begets Question: Self-Evolving Curriculum for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning on Competition Mathematics
summary: Teaching a language model a skill it has not mastered is obstructed by three recurring difficulties: training data is scarce, ground-truth reasoning traces are usually unavailable, and models often exhibit an apparent ceiling beyond which additional data yields no further improvement. We study these difficulties in a controlled setting, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on competition mathematics (AIME), a task on which it initially solves only 5.6\% of problems (pass@1). To address data scarcity, we introduce Question-begets-Question (QbQ), a scalable procedure in which a teacher transforms existing problems into diverse variants that probe the same underlying skills; to model the absence of oracle reasoning, we train exclusively via reinforcement learning on problem statements and final answers, never on teacher reasoning traces. Static training on such data, however, plateaus well short of the task: real-plus-synthetic augmentation and non-curriculum QbQ generated synthetic data training cap pass@1 at 12.5\% and 14.5\% respectively, despite large increases in data. Our central finding is that this ceiling is not intrinsic to the model. We propose a self-evolving curriculum that, each round, evaluates the current checkpoint, seeds QbQ from the problems it can mostly get right, and trains on the resulting variants; under an identical data budget, this breaks the ceiling and lifts pass@1 to 16.5\% with no sign of saturation after 20 rounds. Counterintuitively, we find that models improve when trained on variants of problems they can mostly get right, and that models trained this way go on to solve harder problems never seen during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QbQ（Question-begets-Question）数据扩充方法，结合自进化课程学习（self-evolving curriculum），在竞争数学（AIME）任务上突破了语言模型微调的性能天花板，将Qwen2.5-Math-7B的pass@1从5.6%提升至16.5%，且20轮后未见饱和迹象。
AI.motivation: 训练语言模型学习新技能面临三大难题：训练数据稀缺、缺乏真实推理轨迹（ground-truth reasoning traces）、模型存在性能天花板（额外数据无法带来进一步改进）。作者希望在一个受控环境中（AIME竞赛数学）系统性地研究并解决这些问题。
AI.method: (1) 提出QbQ（Question-begets-Question）可扩展数据生成流程：教师模型将现有问题转化为探测相同底层技能的不同变体；(2) 仅通过强化学习在问题陈述和最终答案上训练，不使用教师推理轨迹；(3) 提出自进化课程：每轮评估当前检查点，从模型能大部分做对的题目中生成QbQ变体，并基于这些变体训练。
AI.result: 静态训练（真实+合成数据增强）pass@1为12.5%，非课程式QbQ合成数据训练为14.5%，均远低于任务目标。自进化课程在相同数据预算下将pass@1提升至16.5%，20轮后无饱和迹象。反直觉发现：训练于模型能大部分做对的题目变体反而能提升性能，且能泛化到训练中未见过的更难题目。
AI.conclusion: 模型存在的性能天花板并非模型本身的固有属性，而是可以通过自进化课程学习来突破。基于"适切难度"（模型大部分能做对的题目变体）进行训练的课程策略，比简单的静态数据扩充更有效，且能带来向更难问题的泛化能力。

title: Characterizing Treatment-Context Medication Evidence Across Clinic Notes and Structured EHR Medication History
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE BIBM 2026
summary: Clinic notes and structured electronic health record (EHR) medication history often contain different medication information. Same-visit disagreement between these sources may result from note-side normalization errors, differences in terminology or timing, or actual differences in documentation. We developed a note-grounded approach that uses large language model (LLM) assisted reference construction, targeted and random human review, deterministic medication normalization, and semantic and temporal comparisons with structured medication history. We evaluated all normalization results on a patient-level held-out test set to limit adaptation to the study cohort. On 5,403 held-out mention rows, exact canonical agreement improved from 0.7226 with surface-exact matching to 0.8429 after lexical cleanup and curated alias mapping. In a random audit of previously unaudited rows, canonical-label agreement was 0.9210 among evaluable valid medication mentions, whereas treatment-action attribution was lower at 0.5326. In the full-cohort characterization analysis, only 16.44% of note-derived rows had same-visit exact overlap with structured medication history, but 55.17% had same-visit semantic overlap, 90.34% had same-visit or +/-30-day overlap, and only 3.97% remained in the strict no-structured-overlap bucket under broad project-level mapping. An ontology-backed sensitivity analysis further showed that held-out strict Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP)-backed no-overlap fell from 43.99% to 36.68% after a development-derived alias supplement. These results show that note-to-structured-medication mismatch can arise from normalization errors, differences in terminology, and differences in documentation timing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于临床笔记的（note-grounded）方法，结合LLM辅助参考构建、人工审核、确定性药物标准化以及语义和时间维度的比较，来分析临床笔记与结构化EHR药物史之间的差异。通过患者级别的留出测试集评估，该方法将药物规范化准确率从0.7226提升至0.8429，并揭示出笔记与结构化药物史不匹配主要源于规范化错误、术语差异和记录时间差异。
AI.motivation: 临床笔记和结构化电子健康记录（EHR）药物史中包含不同的药物信息，同一次就诊中这两种来源之间的不一致可能由多种因素引起，包括笔记侧规范化错误、术语或时间差异，以及文档记录的实际差异。理解这些差异的来源对于提高临床数据质量和医疗决策支持至关重要。
AI.method: 开发了一种基于笔记的方法，该方法包括：（1）使用LLM辅助参考构建；（2）针对性和随机人工审核；（3）确定性药物规范化；（4）与结构化药物史进行语义和时间比较。方法采用患者级别的留出测试集来评估所有规范化结果，以避免对研究队列的过度适应。
AI.result: 在5,403条留出提及行中，精确规范一致性从0.7226（表面精确匹配）提高到0.8429（词汇清理和别名映射后）。随机审计中，规范标签一致性为0.9210，但治疗行为归因仅0.5326。全队列中仅16.44%的笔记派生行与结构化药物史有同次就诊精确重叠，55.17%有语义重叠，90.34%有同次或±30天重叠，仅3.97%无任何重叠。严格OMOP无重叠从43.99%降至36.68%（添加别名补充后）。
AI.conclusion: 笔记与结构化药物信息之间的不匹配主要源于三个方面：规范化错误、术语差异和文档记录时间差异。该研究系统性地量化了这些差异的来源，为改进临床笔记药物信息与结构化数据的整合提供了方法学基础。

title: PhenoStitch: Training-Free Panoptic Crop Mapping from Satellite Image Time Series
summary: Panoptic crop mapping requires both delineating individual agricultural parcels and assigning a crop type to each parcel from satellite image time series. Existing approaches typically rely on dense parcel-level annotations and task-specific model training, which limits their applicability to new regions and growing seasons. We introduce PhenoStitch, a panoptic crop-mapping pipeline that requires no task-specific gradient-based training. A frozen Segment Anything model first oversegments each patch into class-agnostic regions. For each region, optical NDVI and Sentinel-1 backscatter series are summarized by an analytic double-harmonic phenological signature. Adjacent regions are then merged into parcels by minimizing a Potts graph energy, and each parcel is classified by nearest-prototype matching using only (k) labeled parcels per class. A final topology-closure step produces the panoptic map. Under a matched budget of (k=20) parcels per class, corresponding to less than 1% of the available labels, PhenoStitch achieves 20.0 crop mIoU, 76.2 segmentation quality, and 6.2 panoptic quality on PASTIS-R under a 5-fold, 3-seed evaluation. It outperforms the evaluated frozen foundation-model, few-shot, and matched-budget supervised baselines under the same protocol, with a consistent ranking also observed on ZueriCrop. Ablation studies show that radar observations contribute the largest performance gain, while the graph-energy merge and compact phenological signature provide further improvements. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining label-free parcel delineation with few-shot phenological recognition for panoptic crop mapping under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: PhenoStitch是一个无需梯度训练的全景作物制图管线，结合冻结的SAM模型进行区域分割、解析双谐波物候特征、Potts图能量合并地块和最近原型匹配分类，在仅需每类20个标记地块（<1%标签）的情况下，在PASTIS-R上达到20.0 crop mIoU和6.2 panoptic quality，优于冻结基础模型、少样本及匹配预算的监督基线。
AI.motivation: 现有全景作物制图方法依赖密集的地块级标注和任务特定模型训练，限制了其在新区域和新生长季节的适用性。作者希望减少对大量标注和逐任务训练的依赖，实现低监督条件下的作物制图。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结的Segment Anything模型对图像块进行类别无关的过分割；2) 对每个区域提取光学NDVI和Sentinel-1后向散射序列，用解析双谐波物候特征进行摘要；3) 通过最小化Potts图能量将相邻区域合并为地块；4) 利用每类k个标注地块进行最近原型匹配分类；5) 最后通过拓扑闭合步骤生成全景图。
AI.result: 在k=20（每类标记地块占比<1%）的匹配预算下，PhenoStitch在PASTIS-R上实现20.0 crop mIoU、76.2分割质量和6.2全景质量（5折、3种子评估），优于同协议下的冻结基础模型、少样本和匹配预算监督基线；在ZueriCrop上也保持一致的排名。消融实验表明雷达观测贡献最大性能增益，图能量合并和紧凑物候特征带来进一步改进。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明，将无标签的地块分割与少样本物候识别相结合，能够在有限监督条件下有效实现全景作物制图，为跨区域和跨季节应用提供了可行方案。

title: Gram-Space: Structure-Preserving Codebook Compression for Memory-Efficient Neuro-Symbolic AI
summary: Vector symbolic architectures (VSA) are widely used for reasoning in neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI, yet high-dimensional codebooks often create severe memory bottlenecks that limit scalability and deployment. In this paper, we propose Gram-Space, a compression framework that applies Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to represent codebook vectors in a compact orthonormal coordinate system. Gram-Space preserves the dot-product structure required by matrix-based VSA operators, which supports numerically equivalent execution of matrix similarity, probability vectorization, and attention score computations. We provide a correctness analysis showing that inner products are preserved under the orthonormal basis representation. Using modern GPU hardware, we benchmark the Gram-Space framework on standard neuro-symbolic reasoning datasets. Experimental evaluations across state-of-the-art VSA models show that Gram-Space reduces model-level GPU memory usage by up to 15.75x and improves inference latency by up to 3.62x. Profiling results further indicate that Gram-Space reduces allocation-heavy overhead in codebook-associated stages and improves hardware utilization for NeSy workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gram-Space，一个基于Gram-Schmidt正交化的压缩框架，将高维码本向量表示为紧凑的标准正交坐标系，在保持点积结构的前提下显著降低GPU内存占用（最高15.75x）并提升推理速度（最高3.62x）。
AI.motivation: 向量符号架构（VSA）在神经符号AI推理中被广泛使用，但其高维码本会造成严重的内存瓶颈，限制模型的可扩展性和实际部署能力。
AI.method: 提出Gram-Space压缩框架，核心思想是应用Gram-Schmidt正交化将码本向量表示为紧凑的正交坐标系。该方法理论保证内积在正交基表示下保持不变，因此能够数值等价地支持矩阵相似度、概率向量化和注意力分数计算等VSA核心操作。
AI.result: 在现代GPU硬件上的基准测试中，Gram-Space在多种SOTA VSA模型上将模型级GPU内存使用量降低最高15.75x，推理延迟提升最高3.62x。性能分析表明该方法减少了码本相关阶段的高分配开销，并提升了NeSy工作负载的硬件利用率。
AI.conclusion: Gram-Space通过正交化压缩有效解决了VSA高维码本带来的内存瓶颈，同时保证了操作的数值等价性，为神经符号AI的可扩展部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Semantic Alignment of AI Models: Concept Collapse, Checkpoint Dynamics, and Cross-Lingual Transfer
summary: Language model benchmarking is a difficult task. Outcome reasoning alone does not test the model's conceptualization of language and popular open-source benchmarks are quickly saturated or ingested as training data. It is important to test the model's output, but augmenting these tests by characterizing semantic structure gives more insight to how models relate abstract concepts. However, the high dimensional embedding spaces are not easy to interpret. This work demonstrates how topological methods can be used to rigorously compare these spaces to low dimensional and interpretable baselines like ontologies and curated knowledge graphs. These multi-modal alignment tests make it possible to track model adaptations and test phrase understanding across multiple languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用拓扑方法（如持续同调）来比较语言模型的高维嵌入空间与低维可解释基准（如本体论和知识图谱）的结构，从而实现对模型语义概念理解的多模态对齐测试。
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型基准测试存在局限：结果推理无法测试模型对语言的概念化理解，开源基准很快饱和或被纳入训练数据。需要更深入的表征语义结构分析，但高维嵌入空间难以解释。
AI.method: 使用拓扑方法（持续同调等）严格比较语言模型的高维嵌入空间与低维可解释基线（本体论、精选知识图谱），构建多模态对齐测试。
AI.result: 这些多模态对齐测试能够追踪模型适应过程，并测试跨多种语言的短语理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑方法为语言模型语义理解提供了一种超越传统基准测试的可解释评估框架，能够揭示模型内部概念结构组织方式。

title: Perspectives on Tsallis Statistics for Artificial Intelligence
summary: Tsallis statistics generalizes Boltzmann-Gibbs statistical mechanics through a single real parameter $q$ that controls the weight assigned to rare and frequent events. Originally proposed to describe physical systems with long-range correlations, multifractal geometry, and heavy-tailed fluctuations, the framework has become a recurring ingredient in modern artificial intelligence (AI): it underlies sparse attention mechanisms (\textsc{sparsemax} and $α$-\textsc{entmax}), maximum-entropy reinforcement learning with controllable exploration, robust and heavy-tailed probabilistic models, and a family of generalized loss functions and regularizers. This paper offers a structured perspective on where Tsallis statistics meets AI. We first review the mathematical core: $q$-entropy and its variational (maximum-entropy) foundation, the $q$-exponential and $q$-logarithm, the $q$-central limit theorem, $q$-Gaussian distributions, and their dynamical origin in superstatistics, emphasizing the properties that matter for machine learning. We then survey applications across softmax generalization, reinforcement learning, sequential and graph neural models, generative and probabilistic modeling, loss design, and optimization, extracting the recurring design pattern in each case: a tunable interpolation between dense/uniform and sparse/peaked behavior governed by $q$. We further argue that the heavy-tailed weight spectra and gradient-noise statistics empirically observed in deep networks are themselves nonextensive signatures, placing modern learning dynamics within the scope of $q$-statistics. Finally, we discuss methodological pitfalls, the relationship to information geometry and $q$-exponential families, and open directions, arguing that $q$ should be treated as a learnable inductive bias rather than a fixed hyperparameter.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了Tsallis统计（q-统计）与人工智能的交汇点，涵盖q-熵、q-指数分布等数学基础，并调研了其在稀疏注意力、强化学习、图神经网络、生成模型、损失函数设计等AI领域的应用，提出深度网络中的重尾权重谱和梯度噪声本身就是nonextensive特征的证据，主张将q视为可学习的归纳偏置而非固定超参数。
AI.motivation: Tsallis统计最初为物理系统提出，但其在AI中的应用日益增多且分散，缺乏统一的结构化视角。作者希望将来自各自领域的应用（稀疏注意力、强化学习、鲁棒概率模型等）整合在一个统一的数学框架下，并揭示贯穿这些应用的共同设计模式：由q控制的稠密/均匀与稀疏/尖峰行为的可调插值。
AI.method: 本文是一篇综述性论文。首先回顾q-统计的数学核心（q-熵、q-指数函数、q-中心极限定理、q-高斯分布、超统计），然后按应用领域分类调研（softmax泛化、强化学习、序列与图神经网络、生成与概率建模、损失设计、优化），提取每种情况下的可复现设计模式，并讨论方法论陷阱及与信息几何、q-指数族的关系。
AI.result: 论文识别出Tsallis统计在AI中多个应用领域的统一设计模式——通过参数q在稠密/均匀与稀疏/尖峰行为之间插值；论证了深度网络中观察到的重尾权重谱和梯度噪声统计本质上属于nonextensive（q-统计）特征；并指出了将q视为学习参数而非固定超参数的开放方向。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为Tsallis统计为理解现代深度学习中的多种现象（如稀疏注意力、可控探索、鲁棒建模）提供了一个统一的数学视角，并主张在未来的AI研究中应将q作为可学习的归纳偏置来对待，而非预先固定的超参数。

title: MBO Scheme for Local Chan--Vese Segmentation
comment: Accepted to Image Processing On Line; Github link to code: https://github.com/kbui1993/Official_LCV_Code
summary: Robust to intensity inhomogeneity, the local Chan--Vese (LCV) model extends the classical Chan--Vese (CV) image segmentation method by incorporating local statistical information around each pixel. Originally, the LCV model was solved using a finite difference scheme, following the approach used for the CV model. As an alternative to the finite difference scheme, a more efficient algorithm based on the Merriman-Bence-Osher (MBO) scheme was later developed for the CV model. In this paper, we derive a similar MBO-based algorithm to solve the LCV model and propose an efficient implementation. The algorithm is developed for both two-phase and multiphase segmentation, and an extension to color images is also discussed. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, we apply it to a variety of grayscale and color images, including medical and microscopy images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Merriman-Bence-Osher（MBO）方案的高效算法来求解局部Chan-Vese（LCV）图像分割模型，该算法适用于两相和多相分割，并扩展至彩色图像，在多种灰度和彩色图像（包括医学和显微图像）上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: LCV模型通过引入局部统计信息改进了经典CV模型对强度不均匀图像的鲁棒性，但其原始求解采用有限差分格式，效率较低。已有基于MBO方案的更高效算法用于CV模型，但尚未推广到LCV模型，因此需要开发类似的高效求解算法。
AI.method: 论文推导了一种基于MBO方案来求解LCV模型的算法，并提出了高效实现方式。算法同时覆盖两相和多相分割场景，并讨论了扩展到彩色图像的方法。
AI.result: 将所提方法应用于多种灰度图像和彩色图像，包括医学图像和显微图像，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于MBO方案的高效算法能够有效求解LCV模型，在保持对强度不均匀性鲁棒性的同时显著提升计算效率，并适用于多相及彩色图像分割任务。

title: Rethinking Personalized Reward Modeling for LLMs under Preference Heterogeneity via Group-Debiased Federated Learning
summary: Large language models are increasingly aligned to human preferences via reward modeling, but user preference data are sensitive and often cannot be centralized. Federated learning keeps such data local while learning a shared initial reward model, which is later personalized for each client through local fine-tuning. Because users often assign opposite labels to the same pair of responses, existing federated methods address preference heterogeneity by clustering similar clients and training one reward model per group, assuming that each group requires its own initialization. We show that this assumption is unnecessary. Under balanced preference groups, a single FedAvg model, despite starting at nearly random accuracy, surpasses reward models trained separately for each ground-truth group after only a few local optimization steps. We attribute this phenomenon to the flatness of the shared initialization: averaging across all clients learns richer shared representations that distinguish responses while canceling conflicting preference directions, leaving the model near a decision boundary that can be rapidly adapted. Group imbalance breaks this effect as the cancellation becomes asymmetric and leaves minority clients too far from the boundary to recover. Motivated by this observation, we propose FedGD (Federated Learning with Group Debiasing), which discovers latent preference groups during federated training and learns a single reward model using group-debiased client sampling. By counteracting the effect of group imbalance, FedGD learns an initialization that remains highly adaptable, enabling effective personalization without prior knowledge of the underlying groups.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联邦奖励模型中的偏好异质性，发现平衡偏好组下单个FedAvg模型通过局部微调即可超越为各组单独训练的模型，并提出FedGD（联邦分组去偏采样）方法来解决组不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 用户偏好数据敏感无法集中，需用联邦学习；但用户偏好异质性导致现有方法聚类客户端并分组训练奖励模型，假设每组需要独立初始化。作者质疑这一假设的必要性。
AI.method: 首先分析FedAvg在平衡偏好组下的flatness（平坦性）现象：跨客户端平均学到丰富共享表示且抵消冲突偏好方向。针对组不平衡破坏此效应的问题，提出FedGD方法：在联邦训练过程中发现潜在偏好组，采用组去偏客户端采样（group-debiased client sampling）训练单一奖励模型。
AI.result: 在平衡偏好组下，单一FedAvg模型经过少量本地优化步骤后超越了为每个ground-truth组单独训练的奖励模型。组不平衡会破坏此效应，使少数派客户端离决策边界太远而无法恢复；FedGD通过组去偏采样抵消组不平衡影响，保持初始化高度可适应性。
AI.conclusion: 分组训练并非联邦偏好异质性问题的必要方案；共享初始化的平坦性才是关键。FedGD能在无需先验组知识的情况下实现有效个性化，同时保护数据隐私。

title: PICTURE: Enhancing Theory-of-Mind in Large Language Models by Revealing, Not Hiding, Characters' Lack of Knowledge
summary: Simulating human-like Theory of Mind (ToM) has been a longstanding problem in natural language processing (NLP). To address this, existing works introduce a reasoning step of event hiding (a.k.a. perspective-taking), where events unknown to a character are removed before question answering. However, resorting to event hiding for ToM reasoning presents a performance degradation issue due to the strict output format constraints involved in event hiding. To mitigate this issue, we propose generating perspective-taking outputs as free-form explanations without event hiding, but this poses a notable yet underexplored challenge: LLMs need to inhibit responses to events unknown to characters, because the absence of event hiding exposes LLMs to these events throughout reasoning. To address this challenge, we hypothesize and empirically verify that LLMs can achieve such inhibition if a character's lack of knowledge about events is made explicit during reasoning. Based on this finding, we introduce PICTURE, a new prompting method that enables LLMs to generate a character's lack of knowledge within free-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Experimental results show that PICTURE outperforms existing prompting methods by an average of 7.3% on false-belief tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PICTURE提示方法，通过让LLM在自由格式的思维链中显式生成角色对事件的无知状态，而非传统的事件隐藏步骤，从而提升心智理论推理中错误信念任务的性能，平均提升7.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于事件隐藏（perspective-taking）的心智理论推理方法存在输出格式约束严格导致性能下降的问题；而直接采用自由格式解释又面临新挑战——LLM需要抑制对角色未知事件的响应，因为没有了事件隐藏的保护，这些事件在整个推理过程中始终暴露给模型。
AI.method: 提出假设并实证验证：如果推理过程中显式表明角色对事件缺乏知识，LLM就能实现对该类事件的抑制响应。基于此发现，提出PICTURE提示方法，使LLM在自由格式的思维链（CoT）推理中生成角色对事件的无知状态（lack of knowledge），替代传统的事件隐藏步骤。
AI.result: 在错误信念任务上，PICTURE方法相比现有提示方法平均提升7.3%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式表达角色对事件的无知状态是替代事件隐藏的有效策略，PICTURE为LLM心智理论推理提供了一种更灵活且性能更优的路径。

title: CT-PrepAgent: Bounded Policy and Controlled Execution for Adaptive CT Data Preparation
summary: Heterogeneous computed tomography (CT) acquisitions and diverse downstream task requirements limit the transferability of fixed data preparation workflows across data sources and tasks. Existing approaches typically rely on manually designed or dataset-specific rules, making it difficult to accommodate changes in acquisition conditions and analytical objectives without manual intervention. Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown promise for automating medical workflows, yet their potential for adaptive CT data preparation remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose CT-PrepAgent, which enables adaptive CT data preparation through a bounded policy and controlled deterministic execution. Deterministic inspection constructs structured data--task profiles, from which a policy decides an eligible DICOM series or predefined preprocessing profile, while the controlled execution flow guards, resolves, executes, and verifies the decision with bounded recovery when enabled and safe quarantine otherwise. Across three public CT segmentation tasks, CT-PrepAgent derived data-task adaptive preprocessing decisions and achieved the highest macro-average Dice. On two private raw-DICOM cohorts, CT-PrepAgent increased verified output yield from 61.7\% to 70.0\% and yielded similar registration metrics on common verified outputs. Controlled fault and replay tests validate bounded recovery, safe quarantine, and policy-free replay under tested fault and drift settings.

AI.tldr: CT-PrepAgent是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，用于异构CT数据的自适应预处理。它通过有界策略和受控确定性执行，构建结构化数据-任务画像，决策选择适合的DICOM序列或预处理配置，并具备有界恢复和安全隔离机制，在三个公开CT分割任务和两个私有原始DICOM队列上均取得最优或更优性能。
AI.motivation: 异构CT采集条件和多样化的下游任务需求使得固定数据预处理流程难以跨数据源和任务迁移。现有方法依赖人工设计或数据集特定规则，无法灵活适应采集条件和分析目标的变化。虽然LLM智能体在医学工作流自动化方面展现出潜力，但它们在自适应CT数据准备中的应用仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: CT-PrepAgent包含三个核心组件：(1) 确定性检查（Deterministic Inspection）：构建结构化数据-任务画像；(2) 有界策略（Bounded Policy）：基于画像决定合适的DICOM序列或预处理配置；(3) 受控执行流程（Controlled Execution Flow）：对决策进行守护、解析、执行和验证，启用时提供有界恢复，否则进行安全隔离。
AI.result: 在三个公开CT分割任务上，CT-PrepAgent实现了最高的宏平均Dice。在两个私有原始DICOM队列上，验证输出产出率从61.7%提升至70.0%，且在共同验证输出上取得了相近的配准指标。受控故障与回放测试验证了有界恢复、安全隔离及在故障和漂移条件下的无策略回放能力。
AI.conclusion: CT-PrepAgent通过结合LLM智能体的灵活性和受控确定性的安全保障，实现了真正自适应的CT数据准备，既提升了跨数据源和任务的迁移能力，又保证了流程的可靠性、可恢复性和可回放性，为医疗影像数据准备自动化提供了新的范式。

title: PeCA: Palette Context Assisted Inference for Test-Time Paint-Bucket Colourisation on Animation Videos
summary: In animation production, paint-bucket colourisation for hand-drawn animation is a labour-intensive procedure that assigns each enclosed region in line sketches a colour from reference design sheets. Recent automatic paint-bucket colourisation pipelines mirror this workflow via region correspondence, but correspondences can be brittle when regions are ambiguous fragments without proper context. In this paper, we propose Palette Context Assisted (PeCA), a new training-free, plug-and-play framework for animation video colourisation that aims to close this gap at test-time via reasoning over spatial and temporal contexts. Extensive experiments on existing benchmarks and a newly introduced long-video test case show consistent performance boosts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PeCA，一个无需训练、即插即用的动画视频着色框架，通过在测试时推理空间和时间上下文来改善手绘动画中油漆桶着色的区域对应脆弱性问题，在现有基准和新引入的长视频测试上均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 手绘动画制作中，油漆桶着色是一项劳动密集型工作，需要将线条草图上的每个封闭区域根据参考设计稿分配颜色。现有的自动化管线通过区域对应来模拟这一流程，但当区域是缺乏上下文的不明确碎片时，对应关系往往很脆弱，导致着色效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出PeCA（Palette Context Assisted）框架，这是一个训练无关（training-free）、即插即用（plug-and-play）的方法，通过在测试阶段推理空间和时间上下文来改善动画视频着色，弥补区域对应在图元碎片场景下的不足。
AI.result: 在现有基准数据集及新引入的长视频测试用例上进行了大量实验，结果表明PeCA在不同场景下均能带来一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PeCA通过引入空间和时间上下文推理，在不需额外训练的情况下有效提升了动画视频着色的鲁棒性和准确性，是一种通用且有效的即插即用解决方案。

title: Meganeura: Portable GPU Training and Inference through Vulkan and Metal
summary:
Training and deployed inference often cross export, conversion, and platform-specific runtime boundaries. Meganeura asks whether one compact native compiler can span both phases on consumer GPUs. Its typed static graph, automatic differentiation, optimizer, checkpoint, memory planner, and runtime lower specialized programs through Vulkan and Metal.
  We compare five matched workloads with PyTorch on NVIDIA and AMD discrete GPUs, an AMD APU, Apple silicon, and an Intel iGPU. The protocol separates strict f32 from validated fast paths and gates forward and backward independently. Forty-eight of 50 device-workload-mode cells pass both gates; the other two share one unresolved backward-reference disagreement on a newly supported APU. In strict f32, Meganeura wins 12 of 20 GPU-referenced minimal-latency cells and has a median valid training gap of 1.8x. On the discrete AMD GPU, four of five inference workloads are within 1.10x of compiled ROCm PyTorch and three training workloads are faster. Under accelerated contracts, the worst training gap is 4.6x.
  Compilation takes 0.1-2.4 seconds versus 6-96 seconds for torch.compile on supported GPU paths; the stripped binary is 13 MiB. Dispatch profiles localize the largest gaps to convolution derivatives and attention backward. A physical Android XR case study transfers a Meganeura-trained decoder into an Adreno/OpenXR application sharing the graphics queue. The results show that general consumer graphics APIs can support a compact shared train-to-deploy stack at useful, sometimes vendor-competitive performance. The measured gaps point to kernel coverage, scheduling, and arithmetic policy rather than an identified API limitation.

AI.tldr: Meganeura是一个基于类型化静态图和自动微分的紧凑原生编译器，能够同时覆盖训练和部署推理阶段，通过Vulkan和Metal在消费级GPU上运行。在50个设备-工作负载-模式组合中，48个通过严格验证；严格f32模式下在20个GPU最小延迟测试中赢得12个，训练性能中位数差距为1.8x，编译速度(0.1-2.4秒)远超torch.compile(6-96秒)，生成的二进制仅13MiB。研究证明消费级图形API可以支撑一个紧凑的端到端训练到部署栈。
AI.motivation: 训练和部署推理通常需要跨越导出、格式转换和平台特定运行时等重重边界，导致开发复杂化和性能损失。作者希望探索是否可以用一个紧凑的原生编译器同时覆盖训练和部署两个阶段，在消费级GPU上实现统一且高效的解决方案，避免传统方案中多个工具链之间的割裂。
AI.method: Meganeura构建了一个类型化静态图编译器，集成了自动微分、优化器、检查点、内存规划器和运行时。它通过Vulkan和Metal图形API将程序编译到消费级GPU上。评估协议严格区分f32精确验证与加速快速路径，并独立门控前向和后向传播，在NVIDIA/AMD独立GPU、AMD APU、Apple Silicon和Intel iGPU上与PyTorch进行五组匹配工作负载的对比。
AI.result: 50个设备-工作负载-模式组合中48个通过两个门控，仅2个失败于新支持的APU上的一个未解决的反向引用分歧。严格f32模式下Meganeura赢得20个GPU最小延迟测试中的12个，训练中位差距1.8x。在AMD独立GPU上，4/5推理工作负载在1.10x以内，3个训练负载更快。加速契约下最差训练差距为4.6x。编译仅需0.1-2.4秒（对比torch.compile的6-96秒），二进制13MiB。
AI.conclusion: 消费级通用图形API（Vulkan/Metal）能够支持一个紧凑的共享训练到部署技术栈，性能表现实用且在某些场景下可媲美厂商优化实现。性能差距主要源于内核覆盖率、调度和算术策略方面的不足，而非图形API本身的固有限制。Android XR物理案例研究进一步验证了该方案的实用性。

title: Not the Dimension, the Norm: What Matters in Gradient-Free Weight Perturbation of Language Models
summary: Adapting a language model to a task no longer requires training all of its weights, and a line of parameter-efficient methods has driven the trainable count from billions down to a handful of scalars. Gradient-free adaptation, which samples random weight perturbations and keeps the ones that score well, has not followed that trajectory and still perturbs every entry of the weight tensor. It is unknown whether that full-weight search is necessary, and more fundamentally which property of a perturbation makes it work at all, because existing methods vary the search space, the perturbation scale, and the aggregation together. We resolve this by intervening on one factor at a time inside a fixed pipeline, holding candidate scoring and voting constant while we vary the search dimension, the subspace that carries the perturbation, and its norm. Perturbing a frozen frame of 12 to 16 scalars stays 1.8 accuracy points behind full-weight search on average across 49 model-benchmark cells, trailing it in 36 of them. Neither the dimension nor the choice of basis explains that performance. A random frame whose Grassmann overlap with the SVD frame is at chance level performs identically once a single scale factor is matched, and at large scales the SVD directions collapse first. What survives is the perturbation norm, whose usable range closes within a factor of five across seven models and stays flat inside. The perturbation norm is therefore the one factor with a failure mode, and its safe region transfers across scale and family. The design question narrows from which subspace to perturb to how hard to shake.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制变量的方法，在固定流程中逐一干预搜索维度、扰动子空间和扰动范数三个因素，揭示梯度无关自适应方法中决定扰动效果的关键因素。研究发现，在49个模型-基准组合中，仅扰动12到16个标量的冻结框架比全权重搜索平均落后1.8个精度点，但这一差距既不由维度也不由基的选择解释——随机框架与SVD框架在Grassmann重叠度处于随机水平时表现一致。真正起作用的是扰动范数，其可用范围在七个模型中收敛于五倍以内，且安全区间可跨规模和家族迁移。
AI.motivation: 参数高效方法已成功将可训练参数从数十亿降至少量标量，但梯度无关自适应方法仍需要扰动权重张量的每个条目。此前研究存在混淆问题：现有方法同时改变搜索空间、扰动尺度和聚合方式，无法区分哪个因素真正决定扰动效果。研究者希望通过单因素干预来解耦这些因素，从根本上回答"什么属性使扰动有效"这一问题。
AI.method: 采用控制变量的干预方法：在固定流水线中保持候选评分和投票机制不变，逐一改变三个因素——(1)搜索维度（全权重vs.冻结的12~16个标量框架）；(2)携带扰动的子空间（SVD框架vs.随机框架，通过Grassmann重叠度验证）；(3)扰动范数（匹配单一缩放因子）。通过49个模型-基准单元格进行系统比较。
AI.result: 实验发现：冻结的12~16标量框架比全权重搜索平均落后1.8个精度点（36/49个单元格落后），但这一性能差距既不由搜索维度也不由子空间基的选择解释。随机框架在Grassmann重叠度处于随机水平时表现与SVD框架相同（只需匹配单尺度因子），且在大尺度下SVD方向最先崩溃。真正决定性因素是扰动范数：其可用范围在七个模型中收敛于五倍因子以内，内部平坦；安全区间可跨模型规模和家族迁移。
AI.conclusion: 扰动范数是唯一具有失败模式的因素，其安全区域可跨规模和家族迁移。这极大简化了梯度无关自适应的设计问题：不再需要纠结于选择哪个子空间进行扰动，只需关注"扰动多大力度"这一单一问题。设计问题从"扰动哪个子空间"收窄为"该用多大的扰动强度"。

title: Learning What to Remember and What to Internalize in LLM Self-Evolution via Adaptive Memory-Parameter Coordination
summary: Large language model agents increasingly operate in dynamic environments where tool interfaces, APIs, and user requirements change after deployment. Existing self-evolution methods mainly follow two paradigms: harness-based approaches, which externalize feedback into editable memories or skills for rapid adaptation, and parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters for deeper capability improvement. However, using either mechanism alone creates a trade-off between flexibility and performance. This paper asks how an agent can coordinate both channels to achieve robust self-evolution. We present COVE, a unified agent self-evolution framework that combines harness-based and parameter-based learning through task-aware routing, stage-aware scheduling, and knowledge optimization. Through this design, COVE treats self-evolution not as indiscriminate accumulation of experience, but as a coordinated process that matches tasks and knowledge types to appropriate learning mechanisms. Experiments across multiple task categories show that COVE outperforms single-channel evolution strategies, demonstrating more robust and efficient improvement under changing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COVE框架，统一了基于工具（harness-based）和基于参数（parameter-based）两种智能体自我进化机制，通过任务感知路由、阶段感知调度和知识优化实现二者的协同，从而在动态环境中获得更稳健高效的进化。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体自我进化方法分为两类：基于工具的方法将反馈外部化为可编辑记忆或技能以获得快速适应性，基于参数的方法将经验内化为模型参数以提升深层能力。然而单独使用任一机制都会在灵活性和性能之间产生权衡，需要探索二者协同的方式。
AI.method: COVE框架通过三个核心组件实现双通道协同：任务感知路由（task-aware routing）将任务匹配到合适的学习机制，阶段感知调度（stage-aware scheduling）管理不同进化阶段的学习策略，知识优化（knowledge optimization）优化知识获取与利用效率。
AI.result: 在多个任务类别上的实验表明，COVE优于单一通道的进化策略，在动态变化环境下展现出更稳健和更高效的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 自我进化不应被视为经验的盲目累积，而应是一个协调过程，需要将任务和知识类型与合适的学习机制相匹配，从而实现灵活性和性能之间的最优平衡。

title: Look Up and Look Back: Hidden Attention and Latent Orientation in a Frozen Foundation Model for Panoramic SLAM
summary: Monocular panoramic SLAM benefits from substantial visual overlap under large camera rotations, yet remains prone to errors caused by camera tilt, scale drift, and false loop closures. We show that a frozen panoramic geometry foundation model provides useful internal cues beyond its explicit geometric outputs: intermediate tokens encode gravity in the camera frame, while cross-view attention provides a compatibility cue for potential revisits. Building on these cues, we present HALO-SLAM. A gravity readout enables IMU-free spherical upright canonicalization. For loop closure, we introduce a cost-aware three-stage cascade combining DBoW2 event-level retrieval, attention-based compatibility filtering, and dense geometric validation through symmetric submap augmentation. Accepted revisits yield pixel-aligned 3D--3D correspondences in both local gauges, from which robust $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ constraints are estimated and jointly optimized with sequential constraints in a global pose graph. Across 125 sequences from five real-world panoramic benchmarks, our method achieves \textbf{100\%} sequence success (\textbf{125/125}) under the stated criterion and the lowest ATE among the evaluated methods on all five benchmarks, reducing ATE by \textbf{30--88\%} relative to the best ERP-native baseline on each benchmark.

AI.tldr: HALO-SLAM是一个单目全景SLAM系统，利用冻结的全景几何基础模型的内部线索（中间token编码重力信息、跨视图注意力提供回环兼容性提示），实现无IMU的球面直立规范化，并通过成本感知的三阶段级联回环检测（DBoW2检索+注意力过滤+稠密几何验证）来提升定位精度。在5个真实全景基准的125个序列上达到100%成功率，ATE降低30-88%。
AI.motivation: 单目全景SLAM在大旋转下具有大视野重叠的优势，但容易受到相机倾斜、尺度漂移和错误回环检测的影响。现有方法缺乏对全景几何基础模型内部表示的有效利用，且回环检测在鲁棒性和精度上不足。
AI.method: 1) 重力线索读头：从冻结的全景几何基础模型的中间token中提取相机坐标系下的重力方向，实现无IMU的球面直立规范化。2) 三层级联回环检测：DBoW2事件级检索、跨视图注意力兼容性过滤、稠密几何验证（对称子图增强），生成像素对齐的3D-3D对应关系，估计鲁棒的Sim(3)约束并在全局位姿图中联合优化。
AI.result: 在5个真实全景基准的125个序列上，达到100%（125/125）序列成功率，并在所有5个基准上取得最低ATE，相比各基准上最优的ERP原生基线，ATE降低30-88%。
AI.conclusion: 全景几何基础模型的内部表示（中间token和注意力）可以提供超越显式几何输出的有价值线索，用于重力估计和回环验证，结合成本感知的级联回环策略，可显著提升全景SLAM的鲁棒性和精度。

title: Measuring in-context algorithmic reasoning in language models against an exact Bayes-optimal standard
summary: Whether large language models perform genuine algorithmic reasoning or mere pattern completion is hard to test, because most benchmarks lack a ground truth for correct inductive inference. We introduce F-ICL, an in-context-learning benchmark that supplies one exactly. Using the Turing-complete machine F, complement-symmetrised into sF to remove output-polarity bias, we exhaustively enumerate all 1.5 billion programs of length $L\le13$ and compute the Bayes-optimal posterior in closed form under a bounded universal (Levin--Solomonoff) prior; models are scored by how closely their served distributions approach it at matched evidence. Each task is paired with its bitwise complement, on which the optimum scores identically, so an original-twin gap isolates the model's inductive bias. Across 105 serving configurations spanning 37 open models (0.8B--675B) and frontier systems from four laboratories, models answer up to 92\% of queries correctly, yet 45 of 46 models yield distributions farther from the optimum than a keystroke reference, and their behaviour is bracketed by low-order prefix statistics fitted only on visible evidence. That reference is itself an algorithmic mixture, induced by a print-only machine with no loops, so the panel's implied measure sits closer to a loop-free mixture than to the loop-bearing optimum, independently of the reference machine. Updating is also non-monotone, which no prior explains: a Bayes-rational solved set can only grow in this realisable, noiseless setting, yet added examples produce $6{,}545$ solved-to-unsolved transitions against $13{,}702$ gains. The gap is not predicted by accuracy (Spearman $ρ=-0.19$, $p=0.21$), does not close with scale or across frontier generations in the serving modes that expose distributions, and is widened by instruction and reasoning post-training. F-ICL is released as an open, reproducible benchmark and toolkit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出F-ICL基准，基于图灵完备机器F（及其对称化版本sF）穷举枚举15亿个程序并计算贝叶斯最优后验，用于精确测试大语言模型是否具备真正的算法推理。结果显示45/46个模型在分布距离上劣于按键参考，模型行为更接近无循环的打印机混合体而非循环最优体，且更新非单调（6545次解决到未解决的转变），指令和推理后训练反而扩大差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏正确归纳推理的ground truth，难以区分大语言模型是在做真正的算法推理还是模式补全。作者希望通过提供一个具有精确贝叶斯最优后验的基准，来严格测试模型的算法推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 构造图灵完备机器F，补充对称化形成sF以消除输出极性偏差；2) 穷举所有长度L≤13的15亿个程序，在Levin-Solomonoff有界通用先验下计算闭合形式的贝叶斯最优后验；3) 每个任务配对其按位补码，通过原始-孪生差距分离模型的归纳偏差；4) 评估105种服务配置下37个开源模型及前沿系统的分布匹配度；5) 提供F-ICL作为开源可复现基准工具包。
AI.result: 模型能正确回答多达92%的查询，但45/46个模型的分布与最优解的距离超过按键参考；模型行为受仅基于可见证据的低阶前缀统计约束；其隐含度量更接近无循环混合体而非含循环最优体。更新非单调：6545次已解决转为未解决（对比13702次增益），这在可实现的、无噪声的设置中违背贝叶斯理性。差距与准确率无显著相关（ρ=-0.19, p=0.21），不随规模缩小，跨前沿代际不关闭，且在暴露分布的服务模式中，指令和推理后训练反而扩大差距。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的出色表现主要来自模式补全而非真正的算法推理。即使准确率高，其生成的分布也系统性偏离贝叶斯最优，且归纳行为更接近无循环的简单混合。当前的后训练（指令微调、推理增强）扩大了这种偏差，提示需要新的训练范式才能实现真正的算法推理能力。

title: Human-LLM Alignment in Language Attitudes Toward Non-Native Japanese
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly evaluate human writing in high-stakes domains such as hiring and academic assessment, putting non-native speakers at particular risk. Drawing on the language attitudes framework, we compared human and LLM evaluations of parallel L1- and L2-written Japanese emails on three dimensions: fluency, status, and solidarity. Japanese raters rated L2 texts significantly lower on all three dimensions, with a fluency gap roughly twice the size of the status and solidarity gaps. Six LLM judges reproduced the direction of this bias, and five reproduced its ordering across dimensions. The models diverged from humans in two ways: all understated the solidarity gap, the most socially grounded dimension, and all differentiated among learner L1 backgrounds where humans did not. LLM judges thus reproduce native speakers' language attitudes in a structured yet attenuated form, and the language attitudes framework offers a ready-made yardstick for auditing them beyond English.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了人类和LLM对日语L1与L2写作文本的评价，发现LLM在流畅度、地位和团结三个维度上复现了人类对非母语者的偏见方向及排序，但低估了社会性最强的"团结"维度差异，并对学习者母语背景做出了人类未做的区分。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于评估人类写作，尤其是在招聘和学术评估等高 stakes 领域，这使非母语者面临特殊风险。以往对LLM语言偏见的研究多集中于英语，缺乏基于语言态度理论框架的系统性比较。
AI.method: 采用语言态度框架，让日语母语评分者（人类）与六种LLM评判者分别对平行的L1和L2日语邮件在流畅度、地位和团结三个维度上进行评分，并比较两者的偏见方向、程度排序及跨L1背景的区分能力。
AI.result: 日语评分者对L2文本在三个维度上的评分均显著更低，其中流畅度差异约为地位和团结差异的两倍。六种LLM中，所有模型复现了偏见的总体方向，五种复现了跨维度的排序，但所有模型都低估了团结维度的差异，且对学习者L1背景做出了人类未做出的区分。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判者以结构化但衰减的形式复现了母语者的语言态度；语言态度框架为超越英语范围审计LLM的评估偏见提供了现成的衡量标准。

title: Cognitive Demand Steering for Adaptive Meta-Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Recent meta-reasoning frameworks improve LLM reasoning by wrapping chain-of-thought generation in an iterative control loop, allowing more effective backtracking, termination of reasoning loops, and injection of promising reasoning patterns, among other strategy adjustments. Despite promising results, methods often rely on backward-looking reward functions, utilize coarse search actions, or require additional reasoning controller training requiring many-shot supervision. We introduce Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS), a training-free meta-reasoning framework equipped with residual demand assessment: at each step, an LLM-based progress evaluator characterizes the residual reasoning required to arrive at a solution rather than merely evaluating the previous step. This allows a meta-controller to select reasoning interventions comprising both general-purpose exemplars and actions (e.g., general guidance for quantitative reasoning) that directly tackle this forward-looking demand signal. This shift eliminates the need for any trained component while enabling zero-shot transfer across models and tasks with no adaptation. Rather than relying on coarse characterizations, we employ cognitive scales to both design interventions as well as profile initial problem complexity and residual demand signal over 16 dimensions motivated by cognitive science (e.g., attention and scan, learning and abstraction, spatio-physical reasoning), giving the controller a fine-grained vocabulary for diagnosing. Averaged across three frontier LLMs and six reasoning benchmarks, CDS improves accuracy by $21.9\%$ over direct calls and $9\%$ over standard CoT reasoning, with the largest gains on difficult mathematics and coding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS)，一个无需训练的元推理框架。核心创新在于用"前向残差需求评估"替代传统的"后向奖励评估"，通过16个认知科学维度的认知量表来刻画问题复杂度和剩余推理需求，使元控制器能够精准选择推理干预策略（如通用示例和行动）。在三个前沿LLM和六个推理基准上平均提升21.9%（对比直接调用）和9%（对比标准CoT）。
AI.motivation: 现有元推理框架存在三个主要局限：(1) 依赖后向奖励函数（评估已完成的步骤），无法前瞻性地指导推理；(2) 使用粗糙的搜索动作，粒度不足；(3) 需要额外的推理控制器训练，依赖大量带监督数据，难以跨模型跨任务泛化。
AI.method: CDS框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 前向残差需求评估器：每个步骤评估到达解决方案所需的剩余推理量，而非评估前一步质量；(2) 16维认知量表（源自认知科学，如注意力与扫描、学习与抽象、时空物理推理等），用于细粒度描述问题初始复杂度和残差需求信号；(3) 元控制器根据需求信号选择干预策略，包括通用示例和行动（如定量推理的一般性指导），完全无需训练。
AI.result: 在三个前沿LLM和六个推理基准上，CDS相比直接调用平均提升21.9%，相比标准CoT推理提升9%，在困难的数学和编程任务上提升最为显著。该方法实现零样本跨模型、跨任务迁移，无需任何适应。
AI.conclusion: CDS通过将元推理的焦点从后向评估转向前向需求评估，并利用认知科学提供的细粒度诊断词汇，实现了无需训练、可跨模型跨任务迁移的高效元推理框架，为LLM推理控制提供了新的范式。

title: Swimm3R: Splatting with Medium-aware SfM for Underwater 3D Reconstruction
summary: We propose Swimm3R, a unified framework that combines medium-aware structure-from-motion (SfM) with Underwater Beta Splatting to address scattering- and attenuation-induced failures in underwater 3D reconstruction. Swimm3R distills in-air geometric priors into a feed-forward backbone and uses a physics head to regress underwater image-formation parameters, camera poses, and restored point clouds. Additionally, we introduce Underwater Beta Splatting, which extends Gaussian splatting with Beta primitives and scattering-aware geometric gradients for stable underwater geometry representation. We further establish the Barbados underwater video dataset to demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in challenging underwater environments. On this dataset, Swimm3R robustly recovers underwater scene structure under challenging scattering conditions, yielding coherent seafloor geometry. Using these predicted point clouds, the proposed Underwater Beta Splatting improves average PSNR by $1.47$ dB over WaterSplatting while increasing downstream localization performance by $2.0$ and $2.4$ percentage points in RRA@15 and RTA@15, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Swimm3R，一个统一框架，结合了介质感知的运动恢复结构（SfM）与水下Beta样条（Underwater Beta Splatting），解决水下3D重建中由散射和衰减引起的失败问题。
AI.motivation: 水下3D重建面临散射和衰减导致的严重退化问题，现有方法无法有效恢复水下场景结构，需要一种能够处理水下成像物理过程的统一重建框架。
AI.method: 1) Swimm3R将空气中的几何先验蒸馏到前馈主干网络，并使用物理头部回归水下图像形成参数、相机位姿和恢复的点云；2) 提出Underwater Beta Splatting，将高斯样条扩展为Beta基元，并引入散射感知的几何梯度以实现稳定的水下几何表示；3) 建立巴巴多斯水下视频数据集用于评估。
AI.result: 在该数据集上，Swimm3R在复杂散射条件下稳健恢复水下场景结构并生成连贯的海底几何。Underwater Beta Splatting相比WaterSplatting将平均PSNR提升1.47 dB，同时下游定位性能在RRA@15和RTA@15指标上分别提升2.0和2.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Swimm3R结合介质感知SfM与Underwater Beta Splatting，有效应对了水下散射和衰减带来的重建挑战，在重建质量和下游定位任务上均优于现有方法。

title: RING: Retrieval-Internalized Generation for Continual Large-Scale Knowledge Injection
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality but adds latency and engineering overhead at serving time. We propose RING (Retrieval-Internalized Generation), a holistic paradigm spanning both architecture and training that injects large-scale external knowledge into a \textit{Mixture-of-Memory Experts} and learns parametric search over this internal memory via reinforcement learning, removing the external retriever entirely. Training proceeds in three stages: continued pre-training injects new corpora into a Knowledge Expert via our novel \textit{Dual Causal Attention}; supervised fine-tuning teaches a ``search-then-answer'' pattern; and reinforcement learning with hierarchical rewards optimizes the routing-and-search policy over the parametric memory. Unlike prior parametric injection methods that pair internal memory with a fixed or rule-based retriever, RING {learns} its retrieval policy directly from task signals. We further frame RING theoretically as a search-free approximation to the classical RAG objective. To evaluate large-scale injection of genuinely {new} knowledge without test-time leakage, we further construct News-2025, a benchmark built from news strictly post-dating the base LLM's pretraining cutoff. RING matches or surpasses both search-based RAG and parametric injection baselines in accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: RING提出了一种名为"检索内化生成"的全新范式，通过混合记忆专家架构和强化学习训练，将外部知识直接注入大模型参数中，完全移除外部检索器，在准确性和效率上均达到或超越传统RAG方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的检索增强生成（RAG）虽然能提升事实准确性，但在服务阶段引入了额外的延迟和工程开销。现有的参数化注入方法虽然将知识内化到模型中，但仍依赖固定或基于规则的检索器，无法从任务信号中学习检索策略。作者希望设计一种完全消除外部检索器的方案，同时让模型能够自主学习和优化其内部记忆的检索策略。
AI.method: RING采用三阶段训练：1）继续预训练阶段，通过新颖的Dual Causal Attention机制将新语料注入"知识专家"（Knowledge Expert）；2）监督微调阶段，教会模型"先搜索后回答"的模式；3）强化学习阶段，使用分层奖励优化参数化记忆上的路由与搜索策略。模型架构采用Mixture-of-Memory Experts，并通过理论框架将RING表述为经典RAG目标的免搜索近似。此外，作者构建了News-2025基准，使用严格晚于基础模型预训练截止日期的新闻数据来评估真正的新知识注入。
AI.result: RING在准确性和效率两方面均匹配或超越了基于搜索的RAG方法和参数化注入基线。通过在News-2025基准上的评估，验证了其对大规模全新知识注入的有效性，且避免了测试时的知识泄漏问题。
AI.conclusion: RING证明了通过学习式参数化检索可以完全取代外部检索器，在保证事实准确性的同时消除服务延迟和工程开销。这一"检索内化"范式为RAG提供了一种新的演进方向，使模型能够自主决策如何从内部记忆中检索知识。

title: G-ReAct: Graph-Guided Deep Search via Structure-State Co-Evolution
summary: Deep search has become a fundamental capability of large language models (LLMs) for solving open-domain complex tasks. However, existing approaches typically rely on linear sequential reasoning for both trajectory generation and inference, making it difficult to consistently preserve intermediate states and constraints throughout long-horizon multi-hop search. Consequently, they often suffer from context forgetting, search drift, and inefficient exploration. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{G-ReAct}$, a reasoning framework for deep search that organizes reasoning as $\textbf{state evolution over a fixed-topology query graph}$. The evolving graph state explicitly tracks search progress and guides subsequent decisions, transforming exploratory search driven by textual history into graph-guided reasoning under explicit constraints. G-ReAct supports both training and inference: it generates high-quality deep-search trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and provides structured guidance for inference-time search without additional fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate that with only 1.9K generated trajectories for fine-tuning, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 achieves $52.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-ZH and $79.0\%$ on XBench, outperforming comparable open-source methods trained on substantially larger datasets, including RL-enhanced methods. Furthermore, when applied at inference time, G-ReAct consistently improves the performance of existing strong LLMs on deep-search tasks. We will publicly release all code and model weights.

AI.tldr: G-ReAct是一个用于大语言模型深度搜索的推理框架，将推理组织为固定拓扑查询图上的状态演化，显式跟踪搜索进度并指导后续决策，从而解决长跨度多跳搜索中的上下文遗忘、搜索漂移和低效探索问题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索方法依赖线性顺序推理，难以在长跨度多跳搜索中一致地保持中间状态和约束，导致上下文遗忘、搜索漂移和低效探索等问题。
AI.method: G-ReAct将推理组织为固定拓扑查询图上的状态演化，用演化中的图状态显式跟踪搜索进度并指导后续决策，将基于文本历史的探索性搜索转变为在显式约束下的图引导推理。该框架同时支持训练（生成高质量深度搜索轨迹用于监督微调）和推理（无需额外微调即可提供结构化指导）。
AI.result: 仅用1.9K生成的轨迹微调，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507在BrowseComp-ZH上达到52.6%的准确率，在XBench上达到79.0%，优于在更大数据集上训练的可比开源方法（包括RL增强方法）。推理时应用G-ReAct也能一致提升现有强LLM在深度搜索任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: G-ReAct通过图状态演化机制有效解决了深度搜索中的状态保持和约束跟踪问题，以极少的训练数据取得了显著优于大规模训练方法的效果，并可作为即插即用的推理引导工具。

title: MonitorVLM-v2: A Deployed Vision-Language Framework for Real-Time Safety Violation Detection
summary: Large vision--language models (VLMs) can reason step by step about complex visual scenes, but this open-ended, autoregressive chain-of-thought (CoT) approach is poorly suited to safety-critical, rule-governed settings such as industrial surveillance, where decisions must be bounded, deterministic, and low-latency. Because CoT inference cost scales jointly with reasoning length and the number of concurrent streams, it creates a throughput bottleneck that precludes the real-time, multistream monitoring required for industrial accountability. Here we present MonitorVLM-v2, a deployment-oriented framework that recasts VLM-based safety assessment as probabilistic inference over a finite regulatory decision space, compressing multimodal reasoning into single-step rule-ID predictions and reducing decoding from a variable-length sequence to a single token. We introduce symbolic policy optimization (SymPO), a novel contrastive policy optimization algorithm that sharpens decision boundaries within this finite symbolic space, together with an entropy-driven triage mechanism that routes uncertain predictions to human reviewers for expert confirmation. In a four-month prospective deployment across 10 concurrent camera feeds in an operational underground mining facility, MonitorVLM-v2 achieved a 19.45-fold increase in inference speed and identified 2.78 times as many confirmed violations as the site's routine manual inspection workflow, demonstrating the practical value of compressed symbolic decision-making for real-time, auditable industrial monitoring.

AI.tldr: MonitorVLM-v2 是一个面向部署的工业监控框架，将 VLM 的开放式思维链推理重构为有限监管决策空间上的概率推断，将多模态推理压缩为单步规则ID预测。通过符号策略优化（SymPO）锐化决策边界，并引入熵驱动的分诊机制将不确定预测路由给人工审核。在地下矿场的10路并发摄像头四个月前瞻部署中，实现了19.45倍的推理速度提升和2.78倍的违规检出量增长。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽能对复杂视觉场景进行逐步推理，但其开放式的自回归思维链方式不适合安全关键、规则约束的工业场景（如工业监控），因为推理成本随推理长度和并发流数量联合增长，产生吞吐瓶颈，无法满足实时多流监控需求。
AI.method: 1) 将VLM的安全评估重构为有限监管决策空间上的概率推断；2) 将多模态推理压缩为单步规则ID预测，解码从变长序列简化为单token；3) 提出符号策略优化（SymPO），一种对比策略优化算法，用于锐化有限符号空间内的决策边界；4) 引入熵驱动的分诊机制，将不确定预测路由给人工审核员确认。
AI.result: 在运营中的地下采矿设施的4个月前瞻部署（10路并发摄像头）中，MonitorVLM-v2实现了19.45倍的推理速度提升，并识别出2.78倍于现场常规人工检查流程确认的违规数量。
AI.conclusion: 压缩后的符号决策方法对于实时、可审计的工业监控具有实际价值，证明了将开放端推理转化为有限决策空间推断的有效性。

title: Latent-Regime Bias Auditing for Volatility Forecasting
comment: Accepted for publication at the IEEE Conference on Computational Intelligence for Financial Engineering & Economics (CIFEr 2026)
summary: Volatility forecasts are commonly evaluated with aggregate accuracy metrics such as RMSE and MAE, but these metrics can hide conditional failures that matter for risk management. This paper proposes a model-agnostic audit framework for evaluating whether volatility forecasts remain reliable across latent market regimes. We learn time-series representations of market-state windows, cluster them into regimes using only training information, assign regimes out of sample, and compare aggregate forecast behavior with regime-conditional bias, tail-underprediction, and underprediction-sensitive economic losses. Applied to daily volatility forecasting across cryptocurrency and ETF assets, the audit shows that models with competitive aggregate accuracy can still exhibit substantial regime-specific bias and severe tail underprediction. The results suggest that volatility forecasting should be evaluated not only by average error, but also by where and how forecasts become unreliable. Our framework shifts forecast evaluation from asking which model is most accurate on average to identifying the market regimes in which apparently accurate forecasts fail conditionally. Reproducibility: https://github.com/arthurchagas1/Latent-Regime-Bias-Auditing-for-Volatility-Forecasting

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模型无关的审计框架，用于评估波动率预测在不同潜在市场制度（regime）下的可靠性，弥补了传统聚合指标（如RMSE、MAE）在风险管理中可能掩盖条件性失败的不足。通过时间序列表示学习、聚类制度划分、样本外分配以及制度条件偏差/尾部低估/经济损失比较，该框架在加密货币和ETF资产的日度波动率预测实验中表明，聚合精度优秀的模型仍可能存在显著的制度特定偏差和严重尾部低估。
AI.motivation: 传统波动率预测评估仅依赖RMSE和MAE等聚合精度指标，但这些指标无法揭示预测在特定市场制度下的条件性失败，而这对风险管理至关重要。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的审计框架，包含四个步骤：1) 学习市场状态窗口的时间序列表示；2) 仅使用训练信息将表示聚类为潜在制度；3) 对样本外数据进行制度分配；4) 比较聚合预测行为与制度条件偏差、尾部低估概率及低估敏感的经济损失。
AI.result: 在加密货币和ETF资产的日度波动率预测中，聚合精度表现竞争的模型仍可能表现出显著的制度特定偏差和严重的尾部低估。
AI.conclusion: 波动率预测评估不应只看平均误差，还应关注预测在哪些市场制度下、以何种方式变得不可靠。该框架将预测评估从"哪个模型平均最准确"转向"识别表观准确的模型在哪些市场制度下会条件性失败"。

title: Does Accuracy Equal Evidence? Reasoning Faithfulness under KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is commonly evaluated by final-answer accuracy, implicitly assuming that preserving the answer also preserves the reasoning that supports it. We test this assumption for large reasoning models and show that it can fail: under compression, correct answers and the validity of their visible supporting rationales can be preserved at different rates. We study this failure with a controlled fixed-trace replay protocol, which holds reasoning content fixed and isolates whether compression preserves usable information from an already available trace. We evaluate ten token-eviction KV compression methods and one quantization method on three models across mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, clinical calculation, and long-context retrieval. We measure final accuracy, answer-chain consistency, and perturbation faithfulness. Across tasks, token-eviction methods can preserve competitive final-answer accuracy while substantially degrading chain support or perturbation faithfulness. We call this the answer-evidence gap. A coverage-preserving quantization control is substantially less affected, suggesting that the failure is tied less to KV memory reduction itself than to losing access to parts of the reasoning trace. Code is available at https://github.com/famous-blue-raincoat/Safe_KV_Compress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究KV缓存压缩对大型推理模型推理过程的影响。作者发现一个"答案-证据差距"现象：token淘汰类压缩方法可以保持最终答案准确率，但同时会显著损害推理链的一致性和扰动忠实度。通过对照实验，作者发现保持覆盖率的量化压缩方法受影响较小，表明问题不在于KV内存减少本身，而在于推理轨迹部分信息的丢失。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩评估主要关注最终答案准确率，隐含假设"答案被保留就意味着支撑答案的推理也被保留"。作者质疑这一假设，并通过实验证明在压缩条件下，正确答案的保留和可见推理链的有效性可以以不同速率被保持，即两者可能脱节。
AI.method: 作者采用受控的固定轨迹重放协议，保持推理内容不变，隔离压缩是否保留来自已存在轨迹的可用信息。评估了10种token淘汰KV压缩方法和1种量化方法，在3个模型上覆盖数学推理、科学问答、临床计算和长上下文检索任务。衡量指标包括最终准确率、答案-链一致性和扰动忠实度。
AI.result: 跨任务表明，token淘汰方法可以在保持有竞争力的最终答案准确率的同时，显著降低推理链支持或扰动忠实度，即"答案-证据差距"。相比之下，保持覆盖率的量化控制方法受影响显著更小。
AI.conclusion: 压缩导致的失败更多与推理轨迹部分信息的丢失相关，而非KV内存减少本身。这提示KV压缩评估应超越最终答案准确率，同时考虑推理质量指标。

title: 402Pilot: An x402 Decision Layer for Autonomous Agent Micropayments
summary: Programmable-payment protocols such as x402 enable per-request micropayments, but they do not determine which payable service an autonomous agent should buy under a finite wallet. We formulate this buyer-side problem as agent-native payment decision-making: contextual provider selection under wallet pressure, chosen-only paid feedback, and changing market conditions. We propose 402Pilot, a protocol-agnostic buyer-side decision layer between autonomous agents and payment execution that implements purchasing policies for selecting among payable providers. We instantiate it with PA-DCT, a payment-aware discounted contextual Thompson-sampling policy that adapts purchasing decisions under wallet pressure while learning from post-payment feedback. To evaluate buyer-side payment policies, we introduce 402Pilot-Bench, a frozen-replay benchmark spanning 823 tasks, five heterogeneous provider pipelines, and three market regimes, each evaluated over 30 paired seeds. PA-DCT achieves the strongest fixed-wallet adaptive trade-off among non-oracle policies: it maintains competitive service quality while spending only 39 to 43 percent of the wallet and reallocates spending as market conditions change. It attains the best non-oracle PA-gap/T under the price shock and the best mean and worst-case ranks across the nine scenario-metric combinations of quality, ROI, and PA-gap/T. Comparisons with learning baselines and component ablations further support the effectiveness and design of the proposed decision policy. These results suggest that programmable payment must be complemented by buyer-side decision-making capable of learning service value and adapting purchasing decisions accordingly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出402Pilot，一个协议无关的买方侧决策层，解决自主代理在有限钱包下如何选择可付费服务的问题。其核心策略PA-DCT（支付感知折扣上下文汤普森采样）在823个任务、五种提供商管线和三种市场机制下，实现了最强的固定钱包自适应权衡，仅花费钱包的39-43%即保持竞争性服务质量。
AI.motivation: 可编程支付协议（如x402）支持按请求微支付，但没有解决买方侧的核心决策问题：在有限钱包约束下，自主代理应购买哪个可付费服务。这涉及上下文提供商选择、钱包压力下的决策、仅对已选择服务获得付费反馈，以及多变的市场条件——这些挑战此前未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出402Pilot，一种协议无关的买方侧决策层，位于自主代理与支付执行之间，实现提供商选择的购买策略。核心策略为PA-DCT（支付感知折扣上下文汤普森采样），在钱包压力下自适应调整购买决策，同时从支付后反馈中学习。并构建402Pilot-Bench基准，包含823个任务、五种异构提供商管线、三种市场机制，每个场景用30对配对种子评估。
AI.result: PA-DCT在非甲骨文策略中取得最强固定钱包自适应权衡：保持竞争性服务质量的同时仅花费钱包的39-43%，并能在市场条件变化时重新分配支出。在价格冲击下取得最佳非甲骨文PA-gap/T，在质量、ROI和PA-gap/T的九种场景-指标组合中取得最佳均值与最差情况排名。与学习基线和组件消融的对比进一步验证了策略的有效性和设计。
AI.conclusion: 可编程支付必须辅以能够学习服务价值并相应调整购买决策的买方侧决策机制。这为自主代理经济中的支付决策提供了一个新的研究方向和实用框架。

title: Location-Aware Fine-Grained Representation Learning for Medical Vision Foundation Models
summary: Fine-grained visual representations are essential for medical image analysis, particularly when diagnostically relevant evidence is subtle and spatially localized. Modern transformer-based medical vision encoders must therefore learn patch-level representations that are both clinically meaningful and spatially consistent. Without these properties, large vision-language models (LVLMs) operate on an ambiguous visual foundation, limiting their ability to generate clinically reliable and spatially grounded responses. However, existing training strategies for medical vision encoders rarely achieve both objectives. Image-text alignment provides clinically meaningful supervision primarily at the image level, leaving the spatial localization of diagnostic evidence weakly constrained. In contrast, self-supervised learning promotes spatial consistency but lacks the semantic supervision needed to distinguish visually similar yet clinically distinct regions. To address this gap, we present LoFi, a medical vision foundation model built on location-aware fine-grained representation learning. LoFi trains a vision encoder with a lightweight large language model under grounding and grounded captioning objectives. Because these objectives require predicting location from clinical text and vice versa, spatial consistency emerges without any explicit patch-level regularization. To enable training at scale, we construct MedG, a large-scale medical grounding dataset of 4.48M image-text-box triplets curated from 84 datasets spanning 7 modalities. Across phrase grounding, visual question answering, and region-based organ classification under perturbations, LoFi consistently outperforms general-purpose and medical vision foundation models as well as state-of-the-art LVLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/myeongkyunkang/lofi-medg.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoFi，一个基于位置感知细粒度表示学习的医学视觉基础模型。通过轻量级大语言模型在接地和接地描述目标下训练视觉编码器，无需显式patch级正则化即可实现空间一致性。同时构建了包含448万图像-文本-框三元组的MedG数据集（84个数据集、7种模态），在短语接地、视觉问答和区域器官分类等任务上优于通用和医学视觉基础模型及SOTA LVLMs。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分析需要细粒度视觉表示，但现有编码器训练策略难以同时实现临床意义和空间一致性：图像-文本对齐只在图像级别提供临床语义监督，缺乏对诊断证据空间定位的约束；自监督学习虽有空间一致性但缺乏区分视觉相似但临床不同区域的语义监督。
AI.method: LoFi使用接地（从临床文本预测位置）和接地描述（从位置预测临床文本）两个目标训练视觉编码器与轻量级大语言模型，使空间一致性自然涌现而无需显式patch级正则化。同时构建MedG大规模医学接地数据集（4.48M图像-文本-框三元组，来自84个数据集、7种模态）支持大规模训练。
AI.result: 在短语接地、视觉问答和扰动下区域器官分类任务中，LoFi一致优于通用和医学视觉基础模型以及SOTA LVLMs。
