Monitorability is thus a joint property of the display and the reader, so any monitorability claim, including for faithfulness, should specify both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可观测性阶梯"框架，研究在不同信息访问级别（仅响应、自摘要、完整推理轨迹、内部信号）下，线性预测器判断大语言模型回答正确性的能力。研究发现：无提示时摘要保留了轨迹大部分排序信号，但有提示可见时摘要优势大幅消失，完整轨迹仍优于摘要；可观测性是显示与读者的联合属性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通常只向用户展示最终响应和简短推理摘要，而完整推理轨迹保持隐藏。现有研究缺乏一个系统框架来评估不同信息访问级别对判断回答正确性的贡献，以及提示（prompt）的存在如何影响这些判断。作者希望澄清摘要、轨迹和内部信号各自的可观测性价值。
AI.method: 作者设计了可观测性阶梯（observability ladder），在3个基准和5个开源模型（Qwen3和gpt-oss系列）上，固定每次完整运行，仅变化读者可检视的内容级别（响应、自摘要、轨迹、内部信号，各含/不含提示）。在每个访问级别上训练匹配的线性正确性预测器，评估AUROC。
AI.result: 无提示时摘要的AUROC为0.774，轨迹为0.813，摘要比仅响应提高+0.156；有提示时摘要增益降至+0.019，而轨迹仍增加+0.041。在MMLU-Pro上，线性摘要读者接近随机水平（0.503-0.545），轨迹读者信号也有限（0.544-0.590）。轨迹信号大量与长度相关。GPT-5-mini读者能恢复更多信号，但轨迹仍保持+0.034优势。
AI.conclusion: 当用户已经持有提示时，摘要对于监控正确性的帮助不如完整推理轨迹。可观测性是显示和读者的联合属性，任何可观测性声明（包括忠实的）都应同时指明显示内容和读者模型。

title: MemSIF: From Structured Interactions to Dual-Track Fact Memory for LLM Agents
comment: Submitted to AAAI 2027. 19 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables
summary: Long-term memory is critical for LLM agents operating over long-horizon interactions. However, several persistent limitations of existing memory systems can be traced to two recurring misalignment patterns in long-term interaction settings: Temporal-Structural Misalignment (TSM) and Delayed Utility Manifestation (DUM). TSM arises when temporal proximity does not reliably align with topical or event-level relatedness, whereas DUM arises when write-time salience does not reliably predict future query utility. To mitigate these misalignment patterns, we propose MemSIF (Memory with Structured Interactions and Facts), a structured interaction-to-fact memory framework. Structured Interaction Memory organizes raw interactions into Topical Segments that preserve local topical coherence and Event Trajectories that maintain cross-time event continuity. Dual-Track Fact Memory uses two complementary tracks: CoreFact memory consolidates stable, schema-guided information at write time, whereas ActiveFact memory forms facts on demand and promotes those supported by multiple historical sources and recurring query demand for reuse. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across five backbone LLMs show that MemSIF achieves the highest Total ACC in all settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.29%-8.79% on LoCoMo and 2.87%-6.15% on LongMemEval-S. These results support the effectiveness of combining Structured Interaction Memory with Dual-Track Fact Memory to mitigate TSM and DUM. Code is available at https://github.com/luoyufeihaha/MemSIF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemSIF框架，通过结构化交互记忆（Topical Segments与Event Trajectories）和双轨事实记忆（CoreFact与ActiveFact）来缓解长期交互中LLM代理记忆系统的两大错配问题（TSM与DUM），在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上均取得最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的长期记忆系统存在两个反复出现的错配模式：1）时序-结构错配（TSM）：时间邻近性与主题/事件级关联性不一致；2）延迟效用显现（DUM）：写入时的显著性无法可靠预测未来的查询效用。这两个问题限制了记忆系统在长期交互场景中的表现。
AI.method: 提出MemSIF框架，包含两大核心组件：1）结构化交互记忆：将原始交互组织为Topical Segments（保持局部主题连贯性）和Event Trajectories（维持跨时间事件连续性）；2）双轨事实记忆：CoreFact记忆在写入时整合稳定的、基于模式引导的信息，ActiveFact记忆按需形成事实，并推广那些由多个历史来源支持且反复查询需求的事实。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S两个基准上、跨越五种骨干LLM进行实验，MemSIF在所有设置中均取得最高Total ACC：在LoCoMo上超越最强基线2.29%-8.79%，在LongMemEval-S上超越2.87%-6.15%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了将结构化交互记忆与双轨事实记忆相结合能有效缓解TSM和DUM问题，为LLM代理长期记忆系统的设计提供了新的思路。

title: Prompt-Driven Simulation with Feature Perturbation for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection
summary: Data augmentation, which simulates diverse visual variations to expand the source distribution and induce synthetic domain shifts, is a simple yet effective strategy for mitigating severe domain shifts and limited labeled target data in cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD). Existing approaches rely on conventional data augmentation, such as Color-Jitter, Mosaic, and background-centric adaptation (e.g., Domain-RAG), which are limited in modeling complex domain shifts and often lead to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose PSP-FSOD, a principled framework that integrates prompt-driven domain simulation with feature perturbation regularization to improve generalization in CD-FSOD. To enable controllable domain synthesis, we design a prompt-driven strategy that leverages the visual grounding capability of large VLMs to jointly model foreground and background variations, generating semantically consistent yet domain-diverse training samples. Moreover, we adopt a grounding-aware generation scheme that guides object placement and alleviates semantic-spatial misalignment, thereby improving foreground adaptation. To ensure training stability and robustness, we further introduce a noise-induced feature perturbation mechanism that injects Gaussian noise into multi-scale intermediate features with distribution correction, encouraging consistent predictions under perturbations and reducing reliance on domain-specific cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PSP-FSOD produces high-quality domain-diverse supervision and learns domain-invariant representations, consistently improving performance across CD-FSOD benchmarks.

AI.tldr: PSP-FSOD是一个用于跨域少样本目标检测的框架，通过提示驱动域模拟和特征扰动正则化来增强泛化能力。它利用大型视觉语言模型的视觉基础能力联合建模前景和背景变化，生成语义一致但域多样的训练样本，并通过高斯噪声注入的中间特征扰动机制提升训练稳定性和域不变表征学习。
AI.motivation: 跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）面临严重域偏移和有限标注目标数据两大挑战。现有数据增强方法（如Color-Jitter、Mosaic及背景中心自适应方法如Domain-RAG）在建模复杂域偏移方面能力有限，常常导致次优性能。因此需要一种更有效的策略来模拟多样化域变化并提升模型泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出提示驱动域模拟策略：利用大型视觉语言模型的视觉基础能力，联合建模前景与背景变化，生成语义一致但域多样的训练样本；2) 采用基础感知（grounding-aware）生成方案：引导物体放置位置，缓解语义-空间错位问题，提升前景适应能力；3) 引入噪声诱导特征扰动机制：向多尺度中间特征注入高斯噪声并进行分布校正，鼓励模型在扰动下保持一致的预测，减少对域特定线索的依赖。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PSP-FSOD能够生成高质量的域多样监督信号，并学习域不变表征，在多个CD-FSOD基准上持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: PSP-FSOD通过提示驱动域模拟与特征扰动正则化的有机结合，有效解决了CD-FSOD中现有数据增强方法建模复杂域偏移不足的问题，为跨域少样本目标检测提供了一种原则性的、可泛化的解决方案。

title: One QK Channel, Many Sources: Guarding Low-Precision Attention Collapse
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/xieTwim/one-qk-channel-artifact
summary: A bfloat16 transformer can train normally for many steps and then collapse abruptly. Distinct low-precision errors can trigger the same failure, leaving unclear whether each source needs its own repair or one shared route can be blocked. We isolate a reproduced GPT-2-class collapse to the streaming-softmax accumulator, where fp32 accumulation repairs it, and use the fault as an assay for moving controlled errors across sources. Errors placed outside attention still drive the same query-key (QK) spectral runaway, while correcting only QK keeps training stable with the source fault active. This source-channel dissociation shows that fault source is not failure channel. It holds across the tested architectures and scales and reproduces on a second GPU architecture. A causal probe projects each update off the current QK weights' leading three singular directions: the query projection's largest singular value stays at 11.1, whereas removing equal energy elsewhere leaves it at 237. The QK channel therefore drives the early runaway rather than merely tracking it. Entry depends on temporal sign-coherence across steps, not aggregate deviation. QK-Guard closes the channel with a dormant controller that switches on parameter-free QK normalization when attention-logit saturation begins. It contains every tested runaway and matches always-on QK normalization over 60k steps, while non-QK actions at the same trigger fail. The results support intervention at the shared QK locus rather than separate repair at each fault source.

AI.tldr: bfloat16 Transformer在训练中会突然崩溃。研究发现尽管故障源多样（如流式softmax累积器），但崩溃的共性通道是QK（查询-键）权重谱失控。通过在QK通道上施加参数无关的归一化（QK-Guard），可以阻断所有测试的崩溃，且性能与始终开启QK归一化相当，支持"在共享QK位点干预而非逐一修复故障源"的结论。
AI.motivation: bfloat16训练崩溃来源多样且表现相似，难以判断是需要逐一修复还是存在共同可阻断路径；需要厘清"故障源"与"失效通道"的关系，以指导修复策略。
AI.method: 受控错误注入实验：将错误放置在不同位置（注意力内外）观察是否触发相同崩溃；通过因果探针（将更新投影到当前QK权重前三个奇异方向）验证QK通道因果性；提出QK-Guard，即当注意力对数饱和时启动参数无关的QK归一化的休眠控制器。
AI.result: QK谱失控是共享故障通道：源故障存在时仅修正QK即可保持稳定；因果探针显示QK主导早期失控（最大奇异值保持11.1，而移除等能量可达237）；崩溃入口依赖时间符号一致性而非聚合偏差；QK-Guard阻挡了所有测试崩溃，60k步表现与始终开启的QK归一化相当，而非QK操作在相同触发下失败。
AI.conclusion: 故障源与失效通道解耦：不同低精度错误共享QK失效通道，应在共享QK位点进行统一干预而非针对每个源单独修复，该结论在多种架构、规模及GPU架构下均成立。

title: RL-Lock: Reinforcement Learning for Generating Interlocking Assemblies
summary: An interlocking assembly is an assembly in which component parts are connected purely through their geometric arrangement, without relying on external connectors such as glue and nails. Such assemblies have been widely used in a variety of real-world applications due to their structural stability. The problem of generating interlocking assemblies is generally formulated as a shape decomposition problem, where a target 3D object represented as a voxel grid is partitioned into a prescribed number of interlocking pieces. We observe that generating interlocking assemblies is inherently a sequential decision-making problem, where an agent repeatedly decides which piece each voxel should be assigned to. Inspired by the observation, we propose the first reinforcement learning framework RL-Lock for generating interlocking assemblies, without relying on handcrafted search heuristics as existing works did. RL-Lock combines structured action chunking with MCTS-guided policy-value learning to efficiently navigate the large combinatorial search space for interlocking assembly generation. We demonstrate through experiments that RL-Lock allows effective generation of interlocking assemblies, especially for challenging cases in which existing approaches take too long or even fail to find a valid solution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RL-Lock，这是首个用于生成互锁装配体的强化学习框架。它将互锁装配体生成问题建模为序列决策问题，结合结构化动作分块与MCTS引导的策略-价值学习，在无需手工设计搜索启发式的情况下，高效地在大规模组合搜索空间中生成互锁装配体。
AI.motivation: 互锁装配体通过纯几何排列实现结构连接，不依赖外部连接件，在现实应用中广泛使用。现有方法将互锁装配体生成问题视为形状分解问题，但依赖手工设计的搜索启发式，在复杂场景下耗时长甚至无法找到有效解。作者观察到该问题本质上是序列决策问题（agent反复决定每个体素属于哪个部件），因此引入强化学习框架来解决。
AI.method: RL-Lock框架包含两个关键组成部分：(1) 结构化动作分块（structured action chunking），用于高效处理大规模动作空间；(2) MCTS引导的策略-价值学习，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索来指导策略网络和价值网络的训练，从而在大规模组合搜索空间中高效导航，无需手工设计搜索启发式。
AI.result: 实验表明，RL-Lock能够有效生成互锁装配体，尤其在现有方法耗时长甚至无法找到有效解的挑战性案例中表现出色。
AI.conclusion: RL-Lock首次将强化学习引入互锁装配体生成问题，证明了序列决策建模在该问题上的有效性，并显著提升了挑战性场景下的生成能力。

title: PixVL: Self-Supervised Training of Pixel-Level MLLMs via a Unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle
summary: Recent studies develop pixel-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that support both Region Segmentation and Region Understanding, extending multimodal interaction from whole images to specific objects and regions. However, these methods face two fundamental challenges. First, the scarcity of high-quality mask--text pairs leaves abundant mask annotations without corresponding language supervision. Second, discrepancies in supervision formats and learning-signal densities induce optimization interference between Region Segmentation and Region Understanding. To address these challenges, we propose PixVL, a self-supervised post-training framework that introduces a unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle, enabling pixel-level MLLMs to generate and self-verify regional descriptions and learn from unlabeled data. We found that direct cycle based solely on geometric reconstruction is unreliable because re-segmentation IoU does not faithfully reflect the semantic quality and referring sufficiency. PixVL therefore introduces confuser-aware semantic verification, which uses the model's confidence when it correctly chooses the target among highly similar candidate regions, and assigns zero reward to an incorrect choice. Meanwhile, PixVL performs cross-view verification using temporally separated video frames or geometrically transformed image views, preventing cyclic learning from collapsing to positional and shape shortcuts. Finally, a quality-coupled bidirectional learning strategy uses the highest-reward description to guide Text-to-Mask learning. This strategy transforms Region Understanding and Region Segmentation from competing tasks into mutual generators and verifiers. Experiments demonstrate that PixVL improves both region understanding task and segmentation task.

AI.tldr: PixVL 是一个自监督后训练框架，通过统一的 Mask-Text 一致性循环，使像素级多模态大语言模型能够从未标注数据中生成并自我验证区域描述，同时解决 mask-text 对稀缺和分割/理解任务间优化干扰的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有像素级 MLLM 面临两个核心挑战：一是高质量 mask-text 配对数据稀缺，大量掩码标注缺乏对应的语言监督；二是区域分割与区域理解在监督格式和学习信号密度上的差异导致优化干扰。
AI.method: 提出 PixVL 框架：1) 统一的 Mask-Text 一致性循环实现自监督学习；2) 引入混淆器感知的语义验证机制，通过模型在高度相似候选区域中正确选择目标时的置信度来评估语义质量；3) 使用时间分离的视频帧或几何变换的图像视图进行跨视角验证，防止循环学习崩溃到位置和形状捷径；4) 质量耦合的双向学习策略，用最高奖励的描述引导文本到掩码学习，将分割与理解从竞争任务转化为相互生成和验证器。
AI.result: 实验表明 PixVL 同时提升了区域理解任务和区域分割任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过自监督循环学习和语义验证机制，PixVL 有效解决了像素级 MLLM 中数据稀缺和任务干扰的问题，实现了分割与理解任务的协同提升。

title: Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for Verifiable Reasoning in Autonomous Driving VLMs
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving (AD) increasingly utilize chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision to enhance the reasoning capabilities of their Vision-Language Model (VLM) components, yet existing annotation pipelines commonly expose the teacher model to the logged ground-truth (GT) future trajectory. We empirically show that this induces trajectory anchoring bias: teacher models rationalize the revealed outcome rather than infer a decision from scene evidence, producing less causally faithful CoTs and substantially more severe hallucinations, especially in causally challenging scenes. Removing the GT trajectory eliminates this shortcut, but open-ended trajectory generation entangles high-level decision-making with precise geometric synthesis and low-level dynamics. To make trajectory-level driving decisions verifiable without requiring open-ended trajectory synthesis, we introduce Autonomous-Driving Multiple-Choice Question (AD-MCQ), which casts planning as selection among explicit trajectory candidates. Taking this a step further, we propose Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for RLVR (DEFT-RLVR) to transform future trajectories from pre-decision anchors into post-decision verification targets. Experimental results show that DEFT-RLVR improves AD reasoning while preserving or even enhancing general visual capabilities. With VLM-only inference and controllable difficulty through candidate construction, AD-MCQ provides a flexible, scalable, and extensible foundation for future research on verifiable AD reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现VLA自驾模型中常见的CoT标注管线由于暴露了真实未来轨迹，导致教师模型产生轨迹锚定偏差（trajectory anchoring bias），即模型合理化已知结果而非从场景证据推理，从而生成因果性较差的CoT并加剧幻觉。为解决此问题，作者提出AD-MCQ（将规划转化为多选轨迹候选的选择问题）与DEFT-RLVR（将未来轨迹从决策前的锚点转变为决策后的验证目标），实验表明该方法在不牺牲甚至提升通用视觉能力的同时改善了自驾推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA自驾模型中广泛使用的CoT监督标注管线存在根本性缺陷：教师模型在生成CoT时能直接看到日志中的真实GT未来轨迹，这引入了轨迹锚定偏差，使教师模型倾向于为已知结果编造合理化解释而非真正基于场景证据进行因果推理。这导致生成的CoT缺乏因果保真度，并在因果挑战性场景下产生更严重的幻觉。同时，直接移除GT轨迹又会引发开放式轨迹生成中高层决策与低层几何/动力学综合纠缠的难题。因此需要一种既能消除锚定偏差、又不依赖开放式轨迹合成的可验证自驾推理方案。
AI.method: 本文提出两种核心方法：1) AD-MCQ（Autonomous-Driving Multiple-Choice Question），将规划任务转化为在显式轨迹候选中进行选择的MCQ形式，避免开放式轨迹生成，使规划决策可验证且难度可通过候选构造来调节；2) DEFT-RLVR（Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for RLVR），将未来轨迹从决策前暴露给模型（pre-decision anchor）重构为决策后的验证目标（post-decision verification target），配合RLVR（可验证奖励的强化学习）使模型先基于场景推理做决策，再用轨迹进行事实验证。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，DEFT-RLVR在提升自驾推理能力的同时，能够保持甚至增强模型的通用视觉能力。AD-MCQ在仅使用VLM推理且难度可控的前提下，表现出了良好的灵活性、可扩展性和可扩展性，为可验证自驾推理研究提供了新基础。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了CoT标注中GT轨迹暴露所导致的轨迹锚定偏差问题，并通过AD-MCQ与DEFT-RLVR的组合方案将轨迹从预决策锚点转化为验证目标，实现了可验证的自驾推理。这项工作为VLA模型中CoT数据标注与决策推理提供了更具因果保真度和可验证性的新范式。

title: CORTIVA: Candidate-Score Fusion of Complementary Visual Teachers for EEG- and MEG-to-Image Retrieval
comment: 31 pages, 19 figures; includes supplementary information. Code: https://github.com/Fuyunhan/CORTIVA
summary: Decoding visual experience from non-invasive brain activity is central to neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) offers fine spatial detail, but its slow hemodynamics and burdensome acquisition limit temporally resolved decoding. Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide millisecond resolution, making image retrieval compelling: identify the viewed image from one neural response and a fixed candidate bank. Contrastive alignment to pretrained visual representations enables zero-shot retrieval from EEG and MEG, but most systems collapse heterogeneous visual supervision into a single embedding before ranking. This early consolidation imposes one similarity geometry on every candidate order and removes encoder-specific disagreements from the final ranking. We propose CORTIVA, a candidate-score fusion framework that preserves this complementary evidence. Three decoding routes are aligned to heterogeneous visual targets, score the same indexed candidates independently, and combine only their temperature-scaled score vectors before ranking. On the 200-way THINGS-EEG2 benchmark, CORTIVA reaches 73.5% Top-1 and 95.3% Top-5 across ten participants, exceeding the strongest reported baseline by 10.3 and 5.4 percentage points. With a modality-specific neural encoder, the same fusion principle reaches 42.4% Top-1 on THINGS-MEG. Matched route-removal retraining and four weight controls demonstrate that CORTIVA's gain arises from integrating complementary route scores and persists with uniform weighting, without requiring a specialized weighting rule. Independent DINOv2 analyses further reproduce the local error neighborhoods and posterior neural-visual correspondence. These results establish candidate-score fusion as a simple and testable alternative to embedding-level consolidation for neural image retrieval.

AI.tldr: CORTIVA提出了一种候选分数融合框架，用于神经图像检索。不同于传统方法将异构视觉监督信号合并为单一嵌入，CORTIVA将三种解码路径分别与异构视觉目标对齐，独立对候选图像打分后仅融合温度缩放的分数向量再排序。在THINGS-EEG2基准上达到73.5% Top-1和95.3% Top-5，显著超越最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的EEG/MEG神经图像检索系统将异构视觉监督（如不同预训练视觉表示）折叠进单一嵌入中再进行排序，这种早期合并强制所有候选顺序共享一个相似度几何，且丢失了各编码器之间的分歧信息，限制了检索性能。
AI.method: CORTIVA框架包含三条解码路线，每条路线与不同的视觉目标对齐；各路线独立对相同的候选图像索引打分，仅将温度缩放的分数向量在排序前进行融合。通过消融实验（路线移除重训练和四种权重控制）验证融合增益来源于互补路线的分数整合。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG2的200-way基准上达到73.5% Top-1和95.3% Top-5（跨越10名被试），超过最强基线10.3和5.4个百分点；在THINGS-MEG上达到42.4% Top-1。增益在均匀权重下依然保持，不依赖专门设计权重规则。
AI.conclusion: 候选分数融合是一种简单且可测试的替代方案，优于嵌入式级别的合并策略。独立DINOv2分析进一步验证了局部误差邻域和后验神经-视觉对应关系，确立了该方法在神经图像检索中的有效性。

title: CoRe-GNN: Multilevel Message passing on Coarsened graphs
summary: Training Graph Neural Networks on large graphs is challenged by the memory cost of storing all node representations across layers. We show that several existing scalable approaches can be written as structured modifications of the GNN propagation matrix, providing a unified perspective that exposes their respective limitations. In particular, graph coarsening replaces it by a low-rank approximation that enables spectral guarantees but assigns uniform representations to clustered nodes, while Cluster-GCN restricts the propagation matrix to intra-cluster connections that allow efficient batching but sever long-range information. These are complementary failures of the \emph{same} decomposition of the graph into groups of nodes. To obtain the best of both worlds, we propose \textbf{CoRe-GNN}, which performs both propagations in parallel at each layer: a coarsened inter-cluster term capturing long-range structure, and a local intra-cluster term preserving per-node discriminability. We prove that CoRe-GNN inherits analogous approximation guarantees to those of graph coarsening, and introduce a natural cluster-based \emph{batching scheme} that scales to graphs with millions of nodes. On node classification benchmarks spanning homophilic, heterophilic, large-scale, and long-range graphs, CoRe-GNN outperforms both graph coarsening and Cluster-GCN baselines. Notably, CoRe-GNN reaches competitive accuracy on \emph{long-range} tasks, while remaining memory-efficient through batching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRe-GNN，一种结合图粗化与Cluster-GCN优点的新型GNN扩展方法。该方法在每个层中并行执行两种传播：粗化的簇间项捕捉长程结构，局部的簇内项保留节点级别的区分度，从而在保持内存高效（通过基于簇的批处理）的同时获得了图粗化的谱近似保证。
AI.motivation: 大规模图上训练GNN面临存储所有节点表示的内存挑战。现有的可扩展方法（图粗化和Cluster-GCN）各有局限：图粗化通过低秩近似获得谱保证但给同簇节点分配均匀表示，Cluster-GCN通过限制簇内连接实现高效批处理但切断长程信息。作者发现这两种失败源于同一个图分解操作的不同侧面，因此希望设计一种方法能兼顾两者的优点。
AI.method: CoRe-GNN在每一层并行执行两种传播：1) 一个粗化的簇间（coarsened inter-cluster）项，用于捕捉长程结构信息；2) 一个局部的簇内（intra-cluster）项，保留每个节点的可区分性。同时引入基于簇的自然批处理方案，使方法可扩展到百万节点规模的图。
AI.result: 在同质性、异质性、大规模和长程图等多种节点分类基准上，CoRe-GNN均优于图粗化和Cluster-GNN基线。特别地，CoRe-GNN在长程任务上达到了有竞争力的准确率，同时通过批处理保持内存高效。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-GNN通过并行结合粗化传播与局部传播，有效地弥补了图粗化和Cluster-GCN各自的缺陷，证明了在可扩展性和性能之间可以达到更好的平衡，特别是证明了内存高效的方法也可以处理需要长程信息传播的任务。

title: Leveraging AI for fine-grained food safety risk forecasting in sparse data conditions
summary: Ensuring food safety represents a critical public health challenge, particularly when inspection resources are limited and regional sampling data are sparse. This study proposes a Transformer-based framework capable of forecasting fine-grained, city-level food safety risks by unifying over 11 million inspection records with supplemental demographic, economic, and environmental indicators extracted from the Statistical Yearbook. A three-stage pretraining design leverages partial supervision from the Wilson interval (capturing both safety and risk rankings), together with semi-supervised label refinement, to effectively utilize historical records even when local sample sizes are insufficient. Experimental evaluations on data from 2022 show that the proposed approach outperforms baselines significantly. A subsequent field experiment in collaboration with the Zhejiang Provincial Administration for Market Regulation further demonstrates improved detection rates and more efficient allocation of inspection resources compared to a manually developed plan. Observations of regulatory decision-making reveal a threshold-based heuristic employed by inspectors, hinting that additional training or decision-support interfaces could further enhance the impact of AI-generated risk scores. Overall, these findings underscore that a rigorous integration of large-scale public inspection data, Wilson interval-based confidence modeling, and advanced deep learning can facilitate earlier and more granular identification of food safety threats. By reducing reliance on reactive measures alone, the proposed framework has the potential to advance proactive, data-driven oversight of the global food supply.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Transformer的框架，通过整合超过1100万条食品检查记录与人口、经济和环境指标，实现对城市级食品安全风险的细粒度预测。采用三阶段预训练设计（Wilson区间部分监督+半监督标签细化），在2022年数据上显著优于基线，并通过与浙江省市场监管局的实地实验验证了更高的检出率和更高效的资源分配。
AI.motivation: 食品安全是重大公共卫生挑战，尤其在检查资源有限和区域采样数据稀疏的情况下，难以进行有效的风险预测和资源分配。
AI.method: 基于Transformer的框架，统一整合1100万+检查记录与统计年鉴中的补充指标；采用三阶段预训练：利用Wilson区间提供部分监督（捕获安全性与风险排名），结合半监督标签细化，在样本量不足时充分利用历史记录。
AI.result: 在2022年数据上显著优于基线；与浙江省市场监管局合作的实地实验表明检出率提升、检查资源配置效率高于人工方案。
AI.conclusion: 大规模公共检查数据、Wilson区间置信度建模与深度学习的严谨整合，可实现更早期、更细粒度的食品安全威胁识别，推动从被动应对向主动的数据驱动监管转变。

title: Harnessing Adversarial Distillation to Customise Debiased, Disease-Specific Pathology Foundation Models for Breast Cancer
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to MICCAI 2026 (early accept)
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tissue representations and have become central to digital pathology. However, deployment in disease-specific settings is limited by 1) the high computational cost of billion-parameter PFMs and 2) distribution mismatch and non-biological bias inherited from pan-cancer, multi-centre pre-training, including site-specific signatures and imbalanced disease prevalence. These factors can encourage shortcut learning and under-emphasise subtle morphology required for reliable modelling of a specific cancer type. We present SmartStu (a Smart Student), a framework to customise compact, breast-cancer-specific PFMs via distillation whilst mitigating confounding. SmartStu distils representations from multiple teacher PFMs into a lightweight student backbone. Crucially, we introduce adversarial distillation that leverages a dedicated noise model trained to predict nuisance, edge-dominated cues on the distillation set. Using this noise model as a counterexample, the adversarial objective encourages the student to recognise, yet suppress, features predictive of nuisance targets. We further incorporate multi-teacher ensemble distillation and an auxiliary self-supervised objective with artefact injection. We validate SmartStu on three external cohorts (Yale HER2, SLN-Breast, and BRACS) with multiple tiny backbones. SmartStu yields breast-cancer-specific PFMs that are over $30\times$ smaller than general PFMs whilst largely preserving, and sometimes improving, downstream performance measured by balanced accuracy (bAcc) and AUC. Code is available at https://github.com/zwchen03/advDistall.

AI.tldr: SmartStu是一种通过对抗性蒸馏定制紧凑型乳腺癌专用病理基础模型的框架，将多个教师PFM的知识蒸馏到轻量级学生骨干网络中，同时利用噪声模型抑制混杂特征，模型比通用PFM小30倍以上且性能几乎不损失。
AI.motivation: 通用病理基础模型（PFMs）在疾病特定场景部署受限，主要因为：(1) 十亿参数级PFM计算成本过高；(2) 跨癌种、多中心预训练带来的分布不匹配和非生物学偏差（如位点特异性特征、疾病患病率不平衡），导致捷径学习和低估特定癌种所需的关键细微形态学特征。
AI.method: SmartStu框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 多教师集成蒸馏——从多个教师PFM中蒸馏表征到轻量级学生骨干；(2) 对抗性蒸馏——训练一个专门的噪声模型来预测干扰性边缘主导线索，将其作为反例，通过对抗目标鼓励学生识别但抑制这些预测噪声目标的特征；(3) 辅助自监督目标——结合伪影注入增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在三个外部队列（Yale HER2、SLN-Breast、BRACS）上使用多种微型骨干网络进行验证，SmartStu生成的乳腺癌专用PFM比通用PFM小30倍以上，同时基本保持甚至有时提升下游性能（以平衡准确率bAcc和AUC衡量）。
AI.conclusion: SmartStu成功证明了通过对抗性蒸馏可以在大幅压缩模型规模的同时，定制癌症特异性的基础模型，并有效缓解预训练中继承的混杂偏差，为病理基础模型的实用化部署提供了可行方案。

title: RamanPFN: learning from Raman spectral structure with a tabular foundation model
summary: Raman spectroscopy enables non-destructive, label-free molecular characterization across materials science, biomedicine and process monitoring. Predictive Raman datasets often contain few labelled spectra and thousands of ordered wavenumbers, with informative variation within bands and across distant spectral regions. Latent-variable chemometrics accommodates collinear small-sample data but can obscure fine peak morphology, whereas deep spectral networks resolve this structure only after task-specific training. TabPFN avoids task-specific parameter fitting through pretrained in-context inference, but processes very wide inputs as feature-subsampled views that do not preserve joint visibility of related bands. We present RamanPFN, a spectral representation framework that encodes these dependencies before TabPFN inference. Global Compositional Unmixing constructs non-negative coordinates over the complete spectrum so that distant bands with shared latent variation occupy a common predictive axis. Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding represents contiguous wavenumber regions with multiple orthogonal modes that retain independent changes in peak shape, intensity and position. The representations are evaluated separately and combined at the prediction level. Evaluation covered 150 tasks from 74 public Raman datasets. RamanPFN reduced root-mean-square error by 19.6% on average across 129 regression targets relative to direct TabPFN inference and further reduced the remaining classification error by 9.0% across 21 classification tasks. These results establish explicit spectral representation as an effective interface between high-dimensional Raman measurements and reusable tabular inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RamanPFN，一个面向Raman光谱数据的谱表示框架，通过全局成分分解（GCU）和局部振动子空间编码（LVSE）两种表示方法，将高维光谱数据转化为适合TabPFN推理的表示，在129个回归任务上平均降低RMSE 19.6%，在21个分类任务上进一步降低9.0%的分类误差。
AI.motivation: Raman光谱数据存在两个核心挑战：一是标签样本少而波长维度高（数千个有序波数点）；二是信息既存在于谱带内部的细微形态（峰形、强度、位置）又分布于远距离谱区之间的关联中。现有方法中，潜在变量化学计量学（如PCA/PLS）能处理共线小样本但会掩盖精细峰形态；深度谱网络能解析精细结构但需要任务特定训练；TabPFN无需任务特定参数拟合但将超宽输入切分为特征子采样视图，破坏了相关谱带的联合可见性。
AI.method: RamanPFN包含两部分表示：1) 全局成分分解（Global Compositional Unmixing, GCU）：在完整光谱上构建非负坐标，使具有共享潜在变化的远距离谱带映射到共同的预测轴上；2) 局部振动子空间编码（Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding, LVSE）：将连续波数区域用多个正交模式表示，保留峰形、强度和位置的独立变化。两种表示可单独评估，也可在预测层面组合（decision-level combination）。
AI.result: 在74个公开Raman数据集的150项任务上评估：相对于直接使用TabPFN推理，RamanPFN在129个回归目标上平均降低RMSE 19.6%，并在21个分类任务上进一步降低剩余分类误差9.0%。
AI.conclusion: 明确的谱表示是高维Raman测量与可复用表格推理之间有效的接口。RamanPFN通过显式编码光谱中的全局组成依赖和局部振动结构，弥补了TabPFN对超宽光谱输入处理的不足，在广泛任务上验证了该表示学习的通用性和有效性。

title: FRAMES: Guarded and Dual-Objective Skill Evolution for Agents in Policy-Governed Enterprise Workflows
summary: LLM agents increasingly run policy-bound enterprise workflows such as document auditing, where they must apply rules consistently, ground every value, and stay auditable. Improving these agents is hard: operational feedback is sparse and unlabeled, edits to one rule can regress unrelated cases, and accuracy must improve without inflating inference cost or losing auditability. We present FRAMES, a closed-loop framework that cold-starts deployable skills from existing assets and then evolves them through consensus-based mutation, Pareto selection over accuracy and cost, and an anti-regression guarantee, all while preserving auditability. Deployed on our internal production system, FRAMES attains the best accuracy-cost trade-off among baselines, with the same gains reproduced on tau-bench.

AI.tldr: FRAMES是一个面向策略约束型企业工作流（如文档审计）的智能体闭环优化框架。它从现有资产冷启动可部署技能，通过基于共识的变异、基于准确率和成本的Pareto选择以及防回归保障来持续演进技能，同时保持可审计性。在生产系统和tau-bench上均取得了最优的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地执行受策略约束的企业工作流（如文档审计），需要一致地应用规则、验证每个值并保持可审计性。然而改进这些智能体很困难：运营反馈稀疏且无标注，修改一条规则可能导致无关案例回归，且准确率提升不能以推理成本和可审计性为代价。
AI.method: FRAMES是一个闭环框架，包含三个关键机制：(1) 从现有资产冷启动可部署技能；(2) 通过共识驱动的变异生成候选技能；(3) 在准确率与成本两个维度上进行Pareto选择，并带有防回归保证，同时保持整个流程的可审计性。
AI.result: 在内部生产系统上，FRAMES在所有基线中取得了最优的准确率-成本权衡，并且在tau-bench基准上也复现了同样的收益。
AI.conclusion: FRAMES验证了在真实企业环境的高约束条件下（稀疏反馈、防回归、成本敏感、可审计性要求），通过闭环自主演进的方式可以持续提升策略绑定型LLM智能体的准确率-成本效率。

title: Understanding Synergistic Interactions among Pathology Foundation Models via Adaptive Fusion
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tile-level representations via self-supervised pre-training on large-scale pathology images. Yet, PFMs are developed under diverse and often opaque data, architecture, and objective choices, inducing latent representational biases that limit robustness and obscure what each model specialises in. We present AdaFusion, a lightweight adaptive fusion framework that integrates complementary signals from multiple frozen PFMs through (1) low-dimensional feature compression and (2) a sample-conditioned gating module that reweights model-wise (and optionally channel-wise) contributions. Beyond improving predictive accuracy, AdaFusion provides contribution-driven interpretation that offers evidence consistent with model-specific preferences and synergistic interactions across tissue phenotypes. We evaluate AdaFusion on three public benchmarks spanning treatment response prediction, prostate cancer grading, and spatial gene expression inference. AdaFusion consistently outperforms individual PFMs and other fusion baselines, while providing interpretable tissue visualisation which aligns model preferences with morphological patterns. Code is available at: https://github.com/xyx-98/PathoOracle.

AI.tldr: AdaFusion是一个轻量级自适应融合框架，通过低维特征压缩和样本条件门控模块整合多个冻结病理基础模型（PFM）的互补信号，在三个公开基准上均优于单个PFM和其他融合基线，同时提供可解释的贡献驱动分析。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型（PFM）在自监督预训练中因数据、架构和目标选择多样且不透明，引入了潜在表示偏差，限制了鲁棒性，且难以理解每个模型的专长。现有PFM各自携带互补信息但缺乏有效的整合与解释机制。
AI.method: AdaFusion包含两个核心组件：(1)低维特征压缩，降低计算开销；(2)样本条件门控模块，根据输入样本自适应地重新加权不同PFM的贡献（模型级加权，可选通道级加权）。框架保持各PFM冻结，仅训练轻量级融合模块。
AI.result: 在治疗反应预测、前列腺癌分级和空间基因表达推断三个公共基准上，AdaFusion一致性地优于单个PFM和其他融合基线方法，并且提供了与模型特定偏好和组织表型协同交互一致的贡献驱动解释，可视化结果能对齐模型偏好与形态学模式。
AI.conclusion: AdaFusion证明了多PFM自适应融合的有效性，不仅提升了预测精度，还通过贡献驱动的解释机制揭示了各模型在不同组织表型上的专长与协同关系，为病理AI的可解释性和鲁棒性提供了新思路。

title: Empowering Credit Risk Detection in Weixin Pay with Billion-Scale Deep Graph Learning
summary: Credit risk detection, particularly mitigating individual fraud, is crucial for maintaining the stability of digital financial ecosystems. Accurately identifying credit fraud among billions of users is critical for minimizing financial losses and safeguarding the sustainability of inclusive financial services. Given that credit fraud risks are often concealed within heterogeneous user-risk graphs, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as an effective tool for risk mining by capturing complex dependencies. To address the scalability bottleneck of industrial GNNs, distributed training based on subgraphs is indispensable. However, existing strategies often compromise topological integrity for load balancing. This can be catastrophic for risk detection, as it indiscriminately severs the long-tail evidence chains essential for risk propagation. Overlapping subgraphs can restore severed risk contexts but inevitably introduce redundancy and noise, while overlooking the representation alignment across different local subgraphs. In this paper, we propose a risk-aware overlapping subgraph learning framework for large-scale credit risk detection. We first construct base partitions to ensure load balance. Then, we perform budget-constrained sampling that selects informative long-tail nodes, thereby preserving critical risk diffusion patterns while filtering out noise. To mitigate representation inconsistency, we design a cross-subgraph consistency alignment mechanism. By enforcing alignment constraints on the overlapping nodes, we harmonize the local representations into a globally consistent latent space. Extensive experiments on Weixin Pay's production dataset demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms existing strategies for risk detection, offering a scalable and effective solution for industrial graph learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种风险感知的重叠子图学习框架，用于大规模信用风险检测。通过保持负载均衡的基础分区、预算受限采样的长尾节点选择以及跨子图一致性对齐机制，解决了工业级GNN在分布式训练中因割裂拓扑结构导致风险传播链丢失和表征不一致的问题，并在微信支付生产数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 大规模信用风险检测中，工业级GNN面临可扩展性瓶颈，需采用基于子图的分布式训练。但现有策略在负载均衡与拓扑完整性之间存在权衡矛盾：非重叠子图会切断对风险传播至关重要的长尾证据链；而重叠子图虽能恢复风险上下文，却引入冗余和噪声，且忽略了不同局部子图间表征对齐的问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建基础分区以保证负载均衡；2) 采用预算受限采样，选择信息丰富的长尾节点，保留关键风险扩散模式并过滤噪声；3) 设计跨子图一致性对齐机制，对重叠节点施加对齐约束，将各局部表征统一到全局一致的潜在空间中。
AI.result: 在微信支付生产数据集上的大量实验表明，该模型在风险检测方面显著优于现有策略，为工业级图学习提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了工业级GNN分布式训练中拓扑割裂与表征不一致的问题，在保证可扩展性的同时提升了信用风险检测的准确性，为大规模金融风控场景提供了可靠的工程实践方案。

title: REFLEX: Rethinking MoE Inference as Refinement-Aware Compute Allocation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models increase parameter capacity by activating only a small subset of experts for each token. This conditional-computation paradigm has enabled autoregressive language models to scale model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. In diffusion language models (DLMs), however, each denoising forward jointly revisits all token positions despite their sharply different refinement demands, while the default fixed token-choice routing assigns them a uniform expert budget, creating a mismatch between expert computation and refinement demand. We argue that MoE inference in DLMs should therefore be viewed as refinement-aware compute allocation across heterogeneous token refinement states. We propose REFLEX (\textbf{RE}finement-aware \textbf{FLEX}ible expert allocation), a training-free method that keeps the default router unchanged while reorganizing expert computation around the evolving refinement process. Specifically, REFLEX introduces a coarse-to-fine hierarchy for expert-budget allocation that aligns computation with block-relative refinement roles while using the Frontier-Progress Score to resolve active-block priorities. Across multiple widely used benchmarks on two representative MoE-based DLMs, LLaDA-MoE and LLaDA2.0-mini, REFLEX reduces allocated expert computation by 15\% on average while preserving or even improving generation quality on most benchmarks relative to default routing. Compared with autoregressive-style variable-expert routing methods, REFLEX also yields a more consistent quality--computation trade-off, further supporting the importance of allocating expert computation according to the heterogeneous refinement demands exposed within each denoising forward.

AI.tldr: REFLEX是一种无需训练的专家分配方法，通过粗到细的层级结构将MoE专家计算与扩散语言模型的细化需求对齐，平均减少15%的专家计算量，同时保持或提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）中，每个去噪步骤会联合处理所有token位置，但不同token的细化需求差异很大。现有的固定token选择路由为所有token分配统一的专家预算，导致专家计算与细化需求不匹配。作者认为应将DLM中的MoE推理视为跨异构token细化状态的细化感知计算分配问题。
AI.method: REFLEX采用训练无关的方法，保持默认路由器不变，但围绕逐渐演化的细化过程重组专家计算。具体包括：(1) 粗到细的层级结构用于专家预算分配，将计算与块级细化角色对齐；(2) 使用先锋进展分数（Frontier-Progress Score）解决活跃块的优先级问题。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-MoE和LLaDA2.0-mini两个代表性MoE-based DLM上，跨多个广泛使用的基准测试，REFLEX平均减少15%的专家计算量，同时在大多数基准上保持甚至提升生成质量。相比自回归风格的可变专家路由方法，REFLEX产生更一致的"质量-计算"权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持了按每个去噪前向过程中暴露的异构细化需求来分配专家计算的重要性，表明DLM中的MoE推理应被重新概念化为细化感知的计算分配问题。

title: FineMoLA: Towards Fine-Grained Motion-Language Alignment from Clip-Level Supervision
summary: Text-conditioned human motion generation has made rapid progress with the emergence of large-scale motion--language datasets. However, even datasets with rich long-form descriptions typically provide supervision only at the clip level, without explicit temporal correspondence between motion frames and language. This limits fine-grained motion--text grounding and temporally precise generation. We propose FineMoLA, a weakly supervised framework that learns fine-grained frame--phrase correspondence directly from clip-level annotations. Our method first segments long-form descriptions into action-bearing phrases, and then formulates motion--language alignment as an optimal transport problem, which naturally models many-to-many relations between motion frames and text under global constraints. With entropic regularization and Sinkhorn iterations, FineMoLA efficiently infers pseudo frame-level alignments without human labeling. Experiments on SnapMoGen demonstrate that the learned alignments outperform baselines in motion--text grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FineMoLA，一个弱监督框架，通过将动作短语与运动帧的最优传输对齐，直接从片段级标注中学习细粒度的帧-短语对应关系，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模运动-语言数据集仅在片段级别提供监督，缺乏运动帧与语言之间的显式时间对应关系，这限制了细粒度运动-文本grounding和时间精确生成的能力。
AI.method: FineMoLA首先将长描述分割为动作短语，然后将运动-语言对齐建模为最优传输问题，利用熵正则化和Sinkhorn迭代在全局约束下推断帧与文本之间的多对多伪对齐。
AI.result: 在SnapMoGen数据集上的实验表明，学习到的对齐在运动-文本grounding任务上优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督的帧-短语对齐可以通过最优传输实现，无需人工标注即可获得细粒度的运动-文本对应关系，从而提升运动生成的时序精度。

title: Start Classifying: Categorical Critics for LLM Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at COLM 2026. 26 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/ZhijianZhou/HL-guass-ppo
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for large language models typically trains its critic by mean-squared-error (MSE) regression on scalar value targets. Although scalar MSE is statistically valid for estimating the conditional expected return, sparse binary rewards in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make critic optimization and calibration especially consequential: small value errors directly distort the scalar advantages used by PPO. We study whether a classification-based training objective can improve this critic signal. HL-Gauss PPO replaces the scalar MSE head with a categorical predictor over a discretized value support, trained by cross-entropy against smoothed HL-Gauss targets. Its output is decoded to a scalar expectation for standard GAE and PPO; the actor update is therefore unchanged and is not distributional. Across mathematical reasoning, tool-augmented math, and Search-R1, and on both Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 backbones, HL-Gauss PPO consistently improves over strong PPO and DAPO baselines. Controls with one-hot, two-hot, and Bernoulli two-bin critics show that neither a larger output head nor binary classification alone explains the gains. On a common collection of reasoning prefixes, HL-Gauss improves Brier score and calibration error and yields more symmetric, lower-variance advantages. These results position categorical value learning as an effective optimization surrogate for PPO critics in RLVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HL-Gauss PPO，将PPO的critic从标量MSE回归改为基于离散化价值支持的分类交叉熵训练，以改进RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）中稀疏二元奖励下的优势估计质量，在数学推理等多个任务上一致优于强PPO和DAPO基线。
AI.motivation: PPO训练LLM时通常用MSE回归训练critic预测标量价值。在RLVR场景下奖励为稀疏二元信号，小的价值误差会直接扭曲标量优势估计，影响策略更新质量。因此需要探索更好的critic训练目标来提升价值估计的校准性和稳定性。
AI.method: 将critic从标量MSE头替换为分类器，在离散化价值支撑上预测分布，使用交叉熵对平滑的HL-Gauss目标进行训练。输出解码为标量期望后用于标准GAE和PPO，actor更新保持不变（非分布式的）。
AI.result: 在数学推理、工具增强数学、Search-R1任务上，以及Qwen2.5和Qwen3骨干上，HL-Gauss PPO一致优于强PPO和DAPO基线。消融实验（one-hot、two-hot、Bernoulli两bin）表明增益并非来自更大输出头或二元分类本身。HL-Gauss改善了Brier分数和校准误差，产生更对称、更低方差的优势。
AI.conclusion: 分类式价值学习是RLVR中PPO critic的一个有效优化替代方案，能提升价值估计质量与优势信号的可靠性。

title: Can You Trust the Confidence? ConfBench for Vision-Language Models on Document Extraction
summary: Intelligent document processing (IDP) with vision-language models (VLMs) hinges on confidence scores trustworthy enough to route extractions between automation and human review. Existing document benchmarks are dominated by clean, high-quality samples, leaving low accuracy regions too sparse for calibration assessment. We introduce ConfBench, the first calibration-specific benchmark for key information extraction (KIE), built by applying 20 controlled degradation pipelines to a diverse document set, yielding 1,346 variants and 70K+ entity-level evaluations spanning the full accuracy spectrum. We evaluate four proprietary and three open-weight VLMs under verbalized and log-probability confidence estimation methods across three input modalities, and find: (i) OCR+Image modality results in more accurate confidence estimates; (ii) model capability is the dominant factor: within the Claude family confidence quality scales monotonically with capability, while across families parameter count is a poor predictor; (iii) calibration quality varies widely across models, from near-perfect to severely overconfident, and per-model post-hoc correction rescales these absolute confidence values for threshold-based routing without altering ranking-based operational metrics; and (iv) log-probability with first-token aggregation consistently outperforms mean-token and margin aggregations. We also introduce ECARB, a review-budget metric translating discriminative gains into operational savings. We release ConfBench publicly to enable systematic study of confidence estimators and calibration methods for trustworthy IDP application deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConfBench，这是首个专门用于关键信息提取（KIE）校准评估的基准，通过20种受控退化流程生成1,346个变体及70K+实体级评估，覆盖完整的准确率谱系。作者评估了4个闭源和3个开源VLM在多种置信度估计方法下的表现，并引入ECARB指标来衡量审阅预算节省。
AI.motivation: 现有文档基准过于依赖干净、高质量的样本，导致低准确率区域的样本过于稀疏，无法有效评估模型置信度校准。而智能文档处理（IDP）依赖可靠的置信度分数在自动化与人工审阅之间进行路由，因此需要一个覆盖完整准确率谱系的校准专用基准来系统研究置信度估计与校准方法。
AI.method: 构建ConfBench基准：对多样化文档集应用20种受控退化流程，生成1,346个文档变体和70K+实体级评估。评估设置包括4个闭源与3个开源VLM、口头化置信度与对数概率两种估计方法，以及三种输入模态（OCR+Image、纯文本等）。同时提出ECARB（审查预算指标）来将判别性收益转化为运营节省。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(i) OCR+Image模态产生更准确的置信度估计；(ii) 模型能力是主导因素，Claude系列内置信度质量随能力单调提升，但跨家族时参数数量预测能力差；(iii) 校准质量在模型间差异巨大，从接近完美到严重过度自信，逐模型的事后修正可将绝对置信度值缩放以支持阈值路由，而不改变排序型运营指标；(iv) 首token聚合的对数概率方法持续优于均值token和边际聚合方法。
AI.conclusion: ConfBench作为首个校准专用KIE基准，为系统研究置信度估计与校准方法提供了平台。ECARB指标将置信度判别能力的提升转化为实际审阅预算节省，有助于可信赖的智能文档处理应用部署。ConfBench已公开供社区使用。

title: Training-Free Out-of-Distribution Detection for Pathology Whole-Slide Images
comment: Under review. The code is available in https://github.com/muskahya/ZIO
summary: Safe deployment of AI methods in medicine requires robust guardrails that detect when input data deviate from the training distribution to ensure that models provide predictions only within their scope of expertise and abstain otherwise. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection can provide such safeguards and is extensively studied in general computer vision. Yet, it remains underdeveloped in computational pathology, where gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs), subtle differences between disease subtypes, and variability in tissue preparation pose unique challenges for conventional OOD methods. We propose ZIO, a training-free, multimodal OOD detector for pathology WSIs that leverages vision--language pathology foundation models (FMs). ZIO constructs text and visual prototypes of in-distribution classes and integrates their complementary information through a prototype shrinkage mechanism to derive OOD scores. We provide the ZIO formulation for both slide- and patch-level FMs. We evaluate ZIO across diverse clinically relevant domain shifts, including rare diseases and near-OOD settings. Extensive evaluation of over 14,700 WSIs from five independent consortia shows that ZIO consistently outperforms both unimodal prototypes and 40 state-of-the-art OOD methods. These results demonstrate the benefits of multimodal representation for OOD detection and pave the way towards safer AI deployment in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZIO，一种无需训练的、基于多模态病理基础模型的分布外（OOD）检测方法，用于计算病理学中的全切片图像（WSI）。ZIO通过构建文本和视觉原型，并利用原型收缩机制整合多模态信息来生成OOD分数。在超过14,700张WSI、五个独立联盟的多项临床域偏移评估中，ZIO一致优于单模态原型和40种现有最先进的OOD检测方法。
AI.motivation: 在医学AI的安全部署中，需要可靠的检测机制来识别输入数据偏离训练分布的情况，确保模型只在其专业范围内进行预测，否则应放弃预测。虽然OOD检测在通用计算机视觉中已被广泛研究，但在计算病理学中仍发展不足。这是因为千兆像素级的全切片图像、疾病亚型间的细微差异以及组织制备的变异性，给传统OOD方法带来了独特挑战。
AI.method: ZIO是一种无需训练的多模态OOD检测器，利用视觉-语言病理基础模型。具体方法包括：（1）为分布内类别构建文本和视觉原型；（2）通过原型收缩机制整合文本与视觉模态的互补信息；（3）基于整合后的信息推导OOD分数。ZIO同时支持切片级和块级基础模型的公式化。
AI.result: 在超过14,700张来自五个独立联盟的WSI上进行了广泛评估，涵盖罕见疾病和近OOD等多样临床相关域偏移场景。结果表明ZIO一致优于单模态原型以及40种最先进的OOD检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了多模态表征在OOD检测中的优势，为AI在临床实践中的更安全部署铺平了道路。

title: CRIP: Channel Level Representation Injection for Personalized One-Shot Federated Learning
summary: One-shot federated learning (OSFL) has emerged as a promising collaborative model learning framework with only a single round of communication, offering significant advantages in communication efficiency and privacy preservation. However, OSFL often faces inherent limitations under severe domain heterogeneity across clients due to the lack of iterative knowledge exchange. Most existing OSFL methods require an auxiliary public dataset for knowledge distillation or leverage statistical information for parameter-level aggregation, overlooking feature shift caused by domain heterogeneity. To address these challenges, we propose CRIP, a personalized OSFL framework that operates in the representation space via channel-level feature alignment. To achieve this, each client uploads its feature extractor to the server, which broadcasts all extractors back to every client. Since not all source clients share compatible feature distributions with the target client, indiscriminate fusion of cross-client features would introduce domain-specific noise. Therefore, CRIP effectively measures the channel-wise representational similarity between the target client and each source client on a small local mini-batch, and selectively fuses only the most compatible features. Extensive experiments on domain-heterogeneous benchmarks such as DomainNet, PACS, and Office-Home demonstrate that CRIP consistently outperforms local models and state-of-the-art baselines, validating the effectiveness of representation-space personalization under extreme domain heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRIP，一种基于通道级特征对齐的个性化单次联邦学习（OSFL）框架。客户端上传特征提取器，服务器广播所有提取器，CRIP通过测量目标客户端与源客户端之间通道级表征相似度，选择性融合最兼容的特征，从而应对极端域异质性下的特征偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有OSFL方法在严重的域异质性下表现受限：多数方法需要辅助公开数据集进行知识蒸馏，或依赖统计信息进行参数级聚合，忽略了域异质性导致的特征偏移。由于OSFL缺少迭代知识交换，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: CRIP在表征空间中进行操作，通过通道级特征对齐实现个性化。具体流程：每个客户端上传其特征提取器至服务器，服务器将全部提取器广播回每个客户端。为避免不相容源客户端的域特定噪声干扰，CRIP在本地小批量数据上测量目标客户端与各源客户端之间的通道级表征相似度，仅选择性融合最相容的特征。
AI.result: 在DomainNet、PACS和Office-Home等域异质性基准上的大量实验表明，CRIP一致优于本地模型和最先进的基线方法，验证了其在极端域异质性下表征空间个性化方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CRIP通过通道级特征对齐和选择性特征融合，有效解决了OSFL在严重域异质性下面临的特征偏移问题，为单次联邦学习下的个性化提供了可行方案。

title: CoNav-UAV: Cooperative Dual-Altitude Aerial Navigation via Stackelberg Learning
summary: Target-oriented vision-and-language navigation (VLN) on aerial platforms is attracting growing attention for missions such as disaster rescue, infrastructure inspection, and security patrol. In this task, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) needs to locate targets given only a concise description of their appearance and surroundings. This requires global exploration and grounding as well as collision-free close-range approach, two interleaved processes difficult to reconcile within a single agent. Most existing methods transfer the ground VLN paradigm to a low-altitude UAV and compensate for its inefficient exploration with external assistance. A recent attempt deploys two UAVs at complementary altitudes yet still relies on privileged information and trains its two agents independently, precluding any mutual adaptation essential for cooperation. Here we propose CoNav-UAV, which explicitly models the task as a Stackelberg game between a high-altitude leader and a low-altitude follower, with the system operating on onboard visual and linguistic inputs alone. To solve this game, we introduce Iterative Stackelberg Learning. The leader's high-level vision-language reasoning is refined via memory-based in-context learning, while the follower's precise motion control is updated via DAgger-style expert distillation. The alternation drives both agents toward a Stackelberg equilibrium. CoNav-UAV consistently outperforms single- and dual-agent baselines across three high-fidelity urban scenes from the AerialVLN benchmark. Success rate improves by up to 30.8 points on the learning scene, and 9.0 points under cross-scene transfer while using about 3x less adaptation data. Further analyses validate the complementary gains of the leader and follower updates and reveal robust gains yet distinct learning dynamics across VLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoNav-UAV，一种面向空中平台的协作式视觉语言导航（VLN）方法。该方法将任务建模为高空领航者（leader）与低空跟随者（follower）之间的Stackelberg博弈，仅依赖机载视觉和语言输入。通过迭代Stackelberg学习，领航者利用基于记忆的上下文学习进行高层视觉语言推理，跟随者通过DAgger风格专家蒸馏更新精确运动控制，二者交替优化直至Stackelberg均衡。在AerialVLN基准的三个高保真城市场景中，CoNav-UAV在多个指标上持续优于单智能体和双智能体基线，在学习场景中成功率提升高达30.8个点，跨场景迁移下提升9.0个点，且适配数据量减少约3倍。
AI.motivation: 空中平台的视觉语言导航任务需要同时解决全局探索与目标定位（需要高空俯瞰视角）以及无碰撞的近距离接近（需要低空精确控制）两个相互交织的过程，而现有方法要么将地面VLN范式直接迁移到低空无人机（探索效率低下），要么依赖外部辅助或特权信息，且双智能体独立训练缺乏协作适应性。因此需要一种仅依赖机载输入的、能够实现两个智能体相互协同的方法。
AI.method: CoNav-UAV将任务显式建模为高空领航者与低空跟随者之间的Stackelberg博弈。系统仅使用机载视觉和语言输入。求解该博弈采用迭代Stackelberg学习：领航者的高层视觉语言推理通过基于记忆的上下文学习精炼，跟随者的精确运动控制通过DAgger风格的专家蒸馏更新，两者的交替优化推动系统趋近Stackelberg均衡。
AI.result: 在AerialVLN基准的三个高保真城市场景中，CoNav-UAV持续优于单智能体和双智能体基线。在已学习场景中成功率提升最高达30.8个点，在跨场景迁移下提升9.0个点，同时适配数据使用量减少了约3倍。进一步分析验证了领航者和跟随者更新带来的互补增益，并揭示了不同VLM骨干网络下稳健的收益以及不同的学习动态。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了将空中VLN任务建模为Stackelberg博弈的双智能体框架能够有效协调高空探索与低空接近这两个相互矛盾的过程，仅凭机载输入即可实现显著优于现有方法的性能，同时大幅降低数据需求。该方法展示了VLM推理与强化学习式控制更新的协同潜力。

title: PackingGPT: 3D Packing Agent for Real Furniture in Last-Mile Delivery
summary: 3D bin packing rectangular items into standardised containers to maximise space utilisation under geometric shipping automation. Loading a furniture purchase into a personal vehicle is the same task, but under more complex conditions that standard container loading algorithms ignore. This paper addresses the physically stable placement under these realistic conditions with heterogeneous boxes (e.g. varying dimensions and weights) and occupied containers (e.g. groceries). This paper provides a real-world benchmark dataset and baseline model for the Heterogeneous furniture-in-vehicle packing task. The dataset uses real furniture company flat-pack packaging data covering a large number of catalogue products via family-level extrapolation with diversity length, widths, heights, and weights. We also propose a PackingGPT framework for packing as a sequential placement inspired by the Lego assembly process, where heterogeneous boxes of varying dimensions (bricks) are placed step-by-step into the irregular remaining cargo space (creations). Five baseline packing methods were tested on our dataset without considering the Centre-of- Mass (CoM) constraints. In sedan car simulations, 10-40% of placed boxes failed the stability check on average. When the LLP model was trained on packing sequences with CoM constraints enforced during placement, the failure rate dropped to 0.67% (SUV-500).

AI.tldr: 本文针对家具装入个人车辆这一3D装箱任务，提出了一个真实世界的基准数据集和PackingGPT框架，解决异质箱体在占用容器中的物理稳定放置问题，解决了标准集装箱装载算法忽视的复杂条件。
AI.motivation: 标准集装箱装载算法忽略了现实中的复杂条件，如异质箱体（不同尺寸和重量）和已占用容器（如已有杂货）。家具装车是一个被忽视但普遍的实际问题，且缺乏真实世界的数据集和专门针对此任务的基线模型。
AI.method: 提出PackingGPT框架，将装箱建模为序列化放置任务，灵感来源于乐高组装过程——将不同尺寸的异质箱体（砖块）逐步放置到不规则的剩余货舱空间（作品）中。设计了一个真实世界基准数据集，基于真实家具公司的扁平包装数据，通过家族级外推生成具有多样性长宽高和重量的目录产品。
AI.result: 在轿车模拟中，五种不考虑质心约束的基线方法平均有10-40%的放置箱体未通过稳定性检查。而使用质心约束训练的LLP模型在SUV-500场景下失败率降至0.67%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了在放置过程中强制执行质心约束能显著提高家具装车的物理稳定性，证明了PackingGPT框架和数据集对于解决实际异质家具装箱任务的有效性。

title: Constrained Co-Design for Photonic Bayesian Neural Networks
summary: Classical neural networks frequently produce overconfident predictions on ambiguous or out-of-distribution (OOD) data, a liability that grows with each AI system deployed in safety-critical real-world scenarios. Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) provide a principled framework for uncertainty-aware prediction by replacing deterministic parameters with probability distributions, but repeated sampling increases latency, memory traffic, and energy consumption. Photonic probabilistic computing offers a promising alternative by exploiting intrinsic optical stochasticity for fast and parallel sampling. However, photonic BNNs are not ideal samplers: analog constraints on quantization, programming error, dynamic range, and representable mean and variance restrict the variational families that can be implemented in hardware. In this work, we study which hardware-imposed constraints limit scalable photonic BNN inference, how these constraints can be represented, and which ranges can be tolerated by photonic BNNs beyond small proof-of-concept networks. We formulate photonic BNN inference as constrained stochastic variational inference and perform a systematic ablation study over stochasticity location, stochasticity modality, quantization, programming error, and mean/variance bounds. From these results, we derive concrete co-design guidelines that distinguish hardware constraints that can be compensated by training from those requiring hardware or architecture intervention. We validate these guidelines under coupled, hardware-realistic constraints on Dirty-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CINIC-10, using Fashion-MNIST and SVHN as OOD benchmarks, showing that hardware-aware training recovers predictive performance and uncertainty quality whenever the required variational family remains representable, whereas violations of representational limits require targeted hardware modifications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了光子贝叶斯神经网络（Photonic BNN）推理中硬件约束的影响，提出了受约束的随机变分推断框架，并通过系统消融实验得出了软硬件协同设计指南，用于区分可通过训练补偿的约束与需要硬件干预的约束。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络通过概率分布替代确定性参数来提供不确定性感知预测，但在安全关键场景中面临延迟、内存和能耗问题。光子概率计算虽能利用光学随机性实现快速并行采样，但模拟硬件约束（量化、编程误差、动态范围、均值/方差表示限制）限制了可实现的变分族，目前缺乏对这些约束的系统研究。
AI.method: 将光子BNN推理形式化为受约束的随机变分推断，对随机性位置、随机性模态、量化、编程误差、均值/方差边界进行系统消融研究，并在硬件真实耦合约束下（Dirty-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CINIC-10数据集，Fashion-MNIST和SVHN作为OOD基准）验证得到的协同设计指南。
AI.result: 研究发现可区分两类约束：当所需变分族仍可表示时，硬件感知训练可恢复预测性能和不确定性质量；当违反表示限制时，则需要针对性的硬件修改。在多个数据集和OOD基准上验证了这些结论。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出了具体的软硬件协同设计指南，为可扩展的光子BNN推理提供了设计框架，明确了哪些硬件约束可通过训练补偿、哪些必须通过硬件或架构干预解决，推动了光子BNN从概念验证走向实际大规模应用。

title: CockpitHAT: Dependency-Graph-Driven Hierarchical Attribution for Embodied Multi-Agent Cockpits
summary: LLM multi-agent systems suffer from Correctness Collapse, where high task-level accuracy conceals severe process-level failures. This is especially hazardous in safety-critical embodied settings such as automotive cockpits, where lexically correct utterances may trigger dangerous physical operations. Existing attribution methods rely on text traces alone, missing dependency structure, multi-channel evidence, and safety-aware evaluation. We introduce CockpitHAT, a hierarchical attribution framework that replaces positional windows with dependency-distance thresholds from interaction DAGs, integrates multi-channel evidence via an embodied adapter, and applies a safety-uplift to high-risk failures during confidence-weighted analyst consensus. We further release CockpitBench, a benchmark of 212 annotated failure traces spanning dialogue, vehicle-state, environmental, and memory channels, each labeled with ISO 26262 ASIL severity via three-expert consensus. On the public Who&When benchmark, CockpitHAT achieves agent-level / step-exact accuracies of 77.9% / 37.8% on the Hand-Crafted split and 86.5% / 46.0% on the Algorithm-Generated split, surpassing the text-only SOTA ECHO by up to 17.6 / 16.7 points. On CockpitBench, it attains 78.3% agent-level and 38.2% step-exact accuracy. These results establish dependency-aware, multi-channel, risk-calibrated attribution as an effective paradigm for reliable failure diagnosis in real-world embodied LLM multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CockpitHAT，一种针对LLM多智能体系统的层次化归因框架，通过依赖距离阈值、多通道证据融合和安全加权共识来解决"正确性坍缩"问题（高任务精度掩盖过程失败），并发布CockpitBench基准数据集。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统存在"正确性坍缩"问题——任务级准确率高但过程级失败严重，在汽车座舱等安全关键场景中，表面上正确的文本可能触发危险物理操作。现有归因方法仅依赖文本痕迹，忽略了依赖结构、多通道证据和安全感知评估。
AI.method: CockpitHAT采用三层次化归因框架：(1) 用依赖距离阈值替代位置窗口，基于交互有向无环图(DAG)进行归因；(2) 通过具身适配器整合多通道证据（对话、车辆状态、环境、记忆）；(3) 在置信度加权分析师共识中应用安全提升因子，对高风险失败给予更高权重。同时发布包含212条标注失败轨迹的CockpitBench基准，按ISO 26262 ASIL严重度进行标注。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准上，CockpitHAT的agent级/步骤精确准确率分别达到77.9%/37.8%（手工构造子集）和86.5%/46.0%（算法生成子集），比文本基线SOTA ECHO最高提升17.6/16.7个点。在CockpitBench上达到78.3% agent级和38.2%步骤精确准确率。
AI.conclusion: 依赖感知、多通道、风险校准的归因范式为真实世界具身LLM多智能体系统的可靠失败诊断提供了有效方案，验证了超越纯文本痕迹的归因方法的重要性。

title: Long-Horizon Embodied Decision-Making via Multimodal Memory Compression
summary: Agents are increasingly expected to act not only as task executors, but also as decision-makers on behalf of human users. This shift requires agents to accumulate evidence over long horizons, interpret implicit user preferences, and compare multiple candidates under partial observations. In this work, we propose DunphyBench, a new benchmark for evaluating agents on long-horizon human-centered embodied decision-making, where the agent must navigate through multiple embodied housing environments and make decisions that align with multi-dimensional human preferences. Unlike standard embodied reasoning tasks that often focus on procedural planning or immediate goal completion, our setting requires agents to integrate multimodal, multi-source input into coherent knowledge that supports complex reasoning across long horizon. The evaluation results reveal that there is a substantial gap between current agents and human performance. Furthermore, our diagnosis of state-of-the-art VLM-driven agents reveals that memory management is one of the bottlenecks, where raw multimodal history introduces noise that hinders decision quality. Motivated by this finding, we design MeMento, a preference-conditioned multimodal memory compressor that selectively compresses decision-relevant information from long-horizon history based on user preferences with a fixed set of memory tokens. Experiments show that MeMento helps VLM-driven agents improve accuracy by 7.18%, while reducing memory usage by 85.38% compared to the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DunphyBench基准，用于评估智能体在长时程、人类中心的具身决策任务中的表现；同时提出MeMento，一种基于用户偏好的多模态记忆压缩器，能在降低85.38%内存开销的同时将决策准确率提升7.18%。
AI.motivation: 智能体正从单纯的任务执行者转变为代表人类用户的决策者，这要求其在长时程中积累证据、理解隐含的用户偏好，并在部分观测下比较多个候选方案。现有具身推理基准大多只关注程序性规划或即时目标完成，缺乏对长时程、多维人类偏好对齐的评估，因此需要一个新基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建DunphyBench基准：智能体需在多个具身居住环境中导航，做出符合多维人类偏好的决策，要求整合多模态、多源信息进行长时程复杂推理；2) 通过对SOTA VLM驱动智能体的诊断发现记忆管理是瓶颈，原始多模态历史中的噪声会损害决策质量；3) 据此设计MeMento：一种偏好条件化的多模态记忆压缩器，基于用户偏好使用固定数量的记忆token选择性压缩长时程历史中与决策相关的信息。
AI.result: 实验表明，MeMento帮助VLM驱动智能体将准确率提升7.18%，同时相比最强基线将内存使用减少85.38%。评估结果还揭示了当前智能体与人类表现之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 目前的VLM智能体在长时程人类中心决策任务上仍与人类存在显著差距，记忆管理（尤其是多模态历史中的噪声问题）是关键的瓶颈之一。MeMento通过偏好条件化的记忆压缩有效缓解了这一问题，为提升智能体在长时程决策中的表现提供了一条可行路径。

title: Assessing the Impacts of Imperfect Datasets on Client Selections in Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a popular distributed learning framework where multiple clients perform local training and a server aggregates the locally updated models. FL enables decentralized training while preserving the privacy of clients' datasets. However, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) or noisy datasets can lead to low model accuracy or high convergence latency. Precluding these clients through client selection may mitigate the problem, but heavily biased client selections may also degrade the learning performance. In this study, we first experimentally measure the impact of non-IID data (including skews in data quantity and label distribution), noisy data, and fairness in client selection on model accuracy and convergence. We then propose a privacy-preserving scoring method to assess each client's contribution in FL, with experiments conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了联邦学习中非独立同分布（non-IID）数据、噪声数据及客户端选择公平性对模型精度和收敛性的影响，并提出了一种隐私保护的客户端贡献评估打分方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中，non-IID数据和噪声数据会导致模型精度下降或收敛延迟，而通过客户端选择来排除这些问题客户端可能引入严重的偏倚，反而降低学习性能。因此需要定量理解这些因素的影响，并提出公平且有效的客户端贡献评估方法。
AI.method: 首先通过实验测量non-IID数据（包括数据量偏斜和标签分布偏斜）、噪声数据以及客户端选择公平性对模型精度和收敛速度的影响；随后提出一种隐私保护的评分方法，用于评估每个客户端在联邦学习中的贡献。
AI.result: 实验结果表明所提出的隐私保护客户端贡献评估方法能够有效评估各客户端在FL中的贡献，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为联邦学习中的客户端贡献评估提供了隐私保护的解决方案，有助于缓解non-IID和噪声数据带来的性能问题，同时兼顾客户端选择的公平性。

title: SearchMaster: Grounded and Regulated Self-Play for Search Agents
summary: Training LLM-based search agents requires high-quality search data: tasks that demand genuine multi-hop retrieval and trajectories that use search tools effectively. Existing pipelines often depend on human-written tasks, expert demonstrations, or stronger teacher models. We present SearchMaster, a self-play framework that trains a single LLM from search tasks it generates, solves, and verifies in a local search environment. The key challenge is that self-generated tasks and rollouts can yield misleading signals: pseudo multi-hop questions, success-rate difficulty estimates that ignore search depth, and rollouts with excessive opening but little targeted evidence acquisition. SearchMaster addresses these failure modes with three controls. An Evidence-Chain Generator (ECG) grounds task generation in explicit cross-document evidence chains to reduce pseudo multi-hop questions. A Search-Depth Reward (SDR) scores task difficulty by the search depth of successful rollouts rather than success rate alone, keeping retained tasks search-intensive. An Over-Opening Penalty (OOP) regulates tool use by discouraging excessive document opening, avoiding long but shallow browsing. Verified Proposer and Solver rollouts are then jointly optimized with GRPO. Across six deep-search benchmarks, SearchMaster improves a Qwen3.5-9B backbone from 38.19% to 51.52% average accuracy, with a 30.1-point gain on BrowseComp-Plus. These results show that grounded and regulated self-play can provide effective search-agent training data without human-labeled QA pairs or expert demonstrations. The code is available at https://github.com/WentaoTan/SearchMaster.

AI.tldr: SearchMaster是一个自对弈框架，通过让单一LLM在本地搜索环境中生成、解决并验证搜索任务来训练搜索智能体，无需人工标注或专家示范。它通过三个控制机制（证据链生成器、搜索深度奖励、过度打开惩罚）解决自生成数据的误导信号问题，在六个深度搜索基准上将Qwen3.5-9B的平均准确率从38.19%提升到51.52%。
AI.motivation: 训练基于LLM的搜索智能体需要高质量搜索数据（真实多跳检索任务和有效工具使用轨迹），而现有方法依赖人工编写任务、专家示范或更强的教师模型，成本高且难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出自对弈框架SearchMaster：单个LLM在本地搜索环境中生成、解决并验证自身任务。针对三个失败模式设计三个控制机制：(1) 证据链生成器(ECG)基于跨文档证据链生成任务以减少伪多跳问题；(2) 搜索深度奖励(SDR)依据成功轨迹的搜索深度而非成功率评估任务难度；(3) 过度打开惩罚(OOP)限制过多文档打开以避免浅层浏览。最后通过GRPO联合优化验证过的Proposer和Solver轨迹。
AI.result: 在六个深度搜索基准上，SearchMaster将Qwen3.5-9B骨干模型的平均准确率从38.19%提升到51.52%，在BrowseComp-Plus上获得30.1个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 有约束和调节的自对弈能够提供有效的搜索智能体训练数据，无需人工标注的QA对或专家示范，证明了自生成数据作为训练源的可行性。

title: VGER: Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking for Event Cloud Attribution
summary: Event cameras produce sparse and asynchronous event streams that provide rich spatio-temporal information for efficient perception. Recent advances in event-based models have demonstrated strong performance by directly modeling asynchronous events without dense frame reconstruction. However, identifying the event-level evidence behind their predictions is crucial for improving model transparency and reliability. Directly adapting point-level saliency methods from point clouds provides fine-grained attribution but overlooks event-specific spatio-temporal structures. To address this limitation, we propose Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking (VGER), a training-free attribution framework for point-based event cloud networks. VGER combines event-level gradient evidence with task-aware voxel perturbation evidence, transferring regional contribution into event-level attribution scores while preserving fine-grained resolution. Furthermore, VGER introduces a unified event ranking strategy, where high-ranked events are expected to be prediction-critical and low-ranked events are expected to have limited influence on predictions. We evaluate VGER on three event-based benchmarks with PointNet, PointNet++, and EventMamba. Across nine dataset-backbone settings, VGER consistently improves both high-tail and low-tail deletion performance over point-level saliency baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出VGER框架，一种无需训练的基于事件的点云网络归因方法，通过结合事件级梯度证据与任务感知的体素扰动证据，实现事件级归因评分，并在九个数据集-骨干网络设置中一致优于点级显著性基线。
AI.motivation: 事件相机产生稀疏异步事件流，基于事件的模型表现出色，但缺乏事件级预测证据的解释性。直接适配点云的点级显著性方法忽略了事件特有的时空结构，需要一种能够保留细粒度同时捕捉事件时空结构的归因方法。
AI.method: VGER包含三个核心组件：1) 事件级梯度证据提取；2) 任务感知的体素扰动证据，将区域贡献转化为事件级归因分数；3) 统一事件排序策略，对事件按预测重要性进行排序。
AI.result: 在三个事件基准数据集上，结合PointNet、PointNet++和EventMamba三种骨干网络，在九种数据集-骨干网络组合下，VGER在高尾和低尾删除性能上均一致优于点级显著性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VGER成功弥合了点级归因与事件级时空结构之间的差距，提供了一种无需训练、保留细粒度分辨率且具有更好解释性的事件级归因框架，可提升基于事件模型的可信度和透明度。

title: Z-PEFT: Zero-shot Backdoor Detection in Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Canonical Spectral Signatures
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuned (PEFT) models are frequently downloaded from open repositories by practitioners. This widespread practice creates a significant attack surface, as malicious actors can publish backdoored models that induce specific behaviors in response to predefined triggers. We study the problem of weight-space backdoor detection, where a detector classifier predicts whether a model is malicious using only its weights, enabling a lightweight safety mechanism. Most existing methods are designed and evaluated in a closed-world setting, where the detector is trained and tested on the same attack type. In contrast, we evaluate backdoor detection under novel conditions, including previously unseen attacks and datasets. We propose Z-PEFT, a lightweight meta-classifier that relies exclusively on layer-wise spectral measures for classification. Our experiments show that strong performance in the closed-world setting does not necessarily translate to high accuracy in zero-shot backdoor detection. Among weight-space detectors, Z-PEFT achieves the best performance while maintaining low and scalable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究参数高效微调（PEFT）模型在权重空间中的后门检测问题，提出了一种轻量级元分类器Z-PEFT，仅基于逐层谱特征进行检测，并在零样本（未见攻击类型和数据集）条件下评估性能。
AI.motivation: PEFT模型被广泛从开源仓库下载，恶意攻击者可发布带有后门的模型，造成严重安全威胁。现有后门检测方法大多在封闭世界设置下训练和测试（即检测器与攻击类型相同），无法应对实际场景中未见过的攻击类型和新数据集，缺乏泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出Z-PEFT，一个轻量级元分类器，仅利用逐层谱度量（layer-wise spectral measures）作为特征进行分类，无需访问模型训练数据或推理过程，仅通过模型权重即可判断是否包含后门。
AI.result: 实验表明：封闭世界下的强性能并不能保证零样本后门检测的准确率；在权重空间检测器中，Z-PEFT在不同（未见）攻击和数据集条件下取得最佳性能，同时计算成本低且可扩展。
AI.conclusion: Z-PEFT提供了一种轻量、可扩展且泛化能力强的权重空间后门检测方案，能够在实际开放场景中有效保护PEFT模型供应链安全，并揭示了封闭世界性能与零样本泛化之间的差距。

title: Rewriting or Reweighting? A Geometric Account in Language Models
summary: Post-training can substantially alter language-model behavior, yet aggregate behavior rates do not reveal whether training removes an existing mechanism, creates a new one, or changes how an inherited mechanism is used. We study this question through two mechanistically distinct failures, repetition as a decoding-attractor pathology and sycophancy as a preference-related alignment failure. We introduce behavioral manifold analysis, which isolates behavior-specific geometry by selecting sparse behavior-associated coordinates and lifting them into low-dimensional local charts. We construct these charts in two complementary spaces. ACT captures runtime activation states, while NOC quantifies how strongly the model routes functional information flow through the shared behavior-associated subspace. Across multiple model families, the resulting charts are highly compressed and partially alignable across architectures. Contribution-space charts expose a more architecture-robust shared core, whereas activation-space charts retain stronger family-specific structure. Tracking these charts through controlled post-training reveals a consistent asymmetry. Supervised fine-tuning substantially alters the inherited behavioral geometry, whereas reward optimization changes behavior while largely preserving the underlying chart. This geometric perspective provides a unified framework for understanding the mechanistic distinction between the two objectives. SFT tends to rewrite behavioral geometry, whereas reward optimization primarily reweights it. Code is available at https://github.com/ronglingze/Manifold-Analysis

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为流形分析（behavioral manifold analysis）方法，通过行为相关的稀疏坐标构建低维局部图表（charts），在激活空间（ACT）和贡献空间（NOC）两个互补空间中研究模型后训练对行为机制的改变。通过分析重复（repetition）和谄媚（sycophancy）两类机制性失效，发现监督微调（SFT）会重写行为几何结构，而奖励优化（如RL）主要重新加权现有几何结构。
AI.motivation: 后训练可以大幅改变语言模型行为，但传统的聚合行为率无法揭示训练究竟是移除了现有机制、创造了新机制，还是改变了继承机制的使用方式。作者希望从机制层面理解不同训练目标（SFT vs 奖励优化）对模型内部行为的本质影响。
AI.method: 提出行为流形分析方法：1）通过选择稀疏行为相关坐标并提升为低维局部图表来隔离行为特定几何；2）在两种互补空间中构建图表——ACT（运行时激活状态）和NOC（功能信息流经共享行为相关子空间的强度）；3）在多个模型家族上追踪受控后训练过程中的图表变化。
AI.result: 行为图表高度压缩且在跨架构间部分可对齐。贡献空间图表（NOC）暴露了更架构鲁棒的共享核心，而激活空间图表（ACT）保留了更强的家族特定结构。发现一致的不对称性：SFT大幅改变继承的行为几何，而奖励优化改变行为但基本保留底层图表。
AI.conclusion: 这一几何视角提供了理解SFT与奖励优化机制性区别的统一框架：SFT倾向于重写行为几何，而奖励优化主要重新加权。代码已开源。

title: Slot2Text: Object-Centric Visual Tokenization for Efficient and Spatially Traceable Surgical MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLM) for surgical scene understanding typically inject hundreds of dense visual tokens into a language model, leading to costly inference and limited spatial traceability for generated answers. We present Slot2Text, a dual-mode surgical MLLM that replaces dense representations of visual input with a compact set of regions encoded as slot latents. Instead of relying on contrastive alignment of the visual encoder with language, Slot2Text groups self-supervised vision features into a few regions--slots that are consumed by the language model as area-labeled visual tokens. Slot2Text-Fast uses the slot prefix to answer surgical questions. Slot2Text-Reason also identifies and locates areas relevant for reasoning, linking language outputs to corresponding slot tokens, masks or regions. Experiments on multiple visual question answering and visual grounding benchmarks show that Slot2Text-Fast is competitive with state-of-the-art baseline at a much lower cost, reducing the average total token consumption by a 91.8\% and the visual prefix from 1,295 to 47 tokens (a 96.4\% reduction). Slot2Text-Reason trades additional tokens and latency for explicit area identities, locations, and traceable spatial evidence. These results establish compact slot latents as an efficient default visual interface for surgical MLLMs, with grounded reasoning invoked when greater spatial traceability is required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Slot2Text，一种双模式手术多模态大语言模型（MLLM），用紧凑的槽位潜变量（slot latents）替代密集视觉token，将视觉输入压缩为少量区域标签化的视觉token，显著降低推理成本（视觉前缀从1295降至47个token，减少96.4%），同时保持与最先进基线相当的问答性能，并提供可追踪的空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有手术场景理解MLLM通常将数百个密集视觉token注入语言模型，导致推理成本高昂且生成答案缺乏空间可追踪性。这促使研究者探索更紧凑的视觉表示方式。
AI.method: Slot2Text包含两种模式：(1) Slot2Text-Fast：通过自监督视觉特征聚类将视觉输入分组为少量槽位（slots），作为带区域标签的视觉token供语言模型消费；(2) Slot2Text-Reason：在Fast基础上进一步识别和定位与推理相关的区域，将语言输出链接到对应的槽位token、掩码或区域。该方法不依赖视觉编码器与语言的对比对齐。
AI.result: 在多个视觉问答和视觉定位基准上，Slot2Text-Fast以远低于基线的成本达到与SOTA基线相当的性能，平均总token消耗减少91.8%，视觉前缀从1295降至47个token（96.4%的减少）。Slot2Text-Reason以额外token和延迟换取明确的区域身份、位置和可追踪的空间证据。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的槽位潜变量可作为手术MLLM高效的默认视觉接口，在需要更高空间可追踪性时可启用接地推理（grounded reasoning），在效率与可解释性之间提供了灵活的权衡。

title: BRiG-AFA: Bellman Risk-to-Go Learning for Non-Myopic Active Feature Acquisition
summary: Active feature acquisition (AFA) asks which unobserved feature to measure next for each test instance under a budget. Greedy rules are easy to train but can overlook context features whose value is realized only through later acquisitions, while reinforcement-learning and generative approaches introduce difficult optimization or conditional-density estimation. We introduce \method, a deployable, supervised alternative that learns a separate candidate-conditioned risk-to-go function for every remaining budget. Starting from the one-step terminal classification risk, the functions are fitted backward with Bellman targets; inference greedily minimizes the learned terminal risk using only observed values, the mask, candidate identity, and remaining budget. A controlled non-myopic benchmark shows the expected mechanism: at budgets two and three, \method improves accuracy over its one-step ablation by $4.84\pm2.17$ and $4.39\pm1.10$ percentage points (mean $\pm$ standard error over five seeds). On Fashion-MNIST with 20 candidate pixels, it improves accuracy at every nontrivial reported budget on average, including $10.20\pm0.74$ points at four acquisitions; its mean paired gain across budgets $\{2,4,8,12,16\}$ is $3.50\pm0.37$ points. A three-seed MiniBooNE study is mixed at small budgets but positive at 8 and 16 acquisitions, identifying a current boundary rather than supporting a universal claim. These results establish a reproducible mechanism-level case for direct Bellman risk regression and delimit the experiments still needed for state-of-the-art comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为\method的监督学习方法来解决主动特征获取（AFA）问题。该方法为每个剩余预算学习一个独立的、以候选特征为条件的风险函数（risk-to-go function），从单步终端分类风险出发，通过Bellman目标反向拟合，推理时贪婪地最小化学习到的终端风险。实验表明该方法在非贪婪基准和真实数据集上均优于其单步消融版本。
AI.motivation: 主动特征获取（AFA）需要在预算限制下决定下一步测量哪个未观测特征。现有的贪婪规则容易训练但会忽略那些只有通过后续获取才能实现其价值的上下文特征；而强化学习和生成式方法则面临困难的优化或条件密度估计问题。作者希望找到一种既部署友好（supervised）又能捕捉非短视行为的方法。
AI.method: \method为每个剩余预算学习一个独立的候选条件风险函数（candidate-conditioned risk-to-go function）。具体来说：1）从单步终端分类风险开始；2）利用Bellman目标进行反向拟合（backward fitting）；3）推理时仅使用观测值、掩码、候选特征身份和剩余预算，贪婪地最小化学习到的终端风险。
AI.result: 在受控非短视基准上，预算为2和3时，\method相较于其单步消融版本分别提升4.84±2.17和4.39±1.10个百分点。在Fashion-MNIST（20个候选像素）上，4次获取时提升10.20±0.74个百分点，在预算{2,4,8,12,16}上的平均配对增益为3.50±0.37个百分点。在MiniBooNE上小预算表现参差不齐，但在8和16次获取时表现积极。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果建立了直接Bellman风险回归可行的机制级证据，同时指出当前方法的局限性边界——在小预算的MiniBooNE上表现不稳定，说明仍需更充分的实验才能做出最先进水平的比较性结论。

title: PCSD: Persistent Consistency for Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language model agents have shown strong potential in complex interactive tasks, yet their reinforcement learning (RL) is often hindered by sparse rewards, as a long multi-turn trajectory may receive only a single outcome-level signal. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision from a privileged teacher, but the teacher may not be reliable at every position. Existing methods commonly rely on isolated token-level discrepancies, which can be sensitive to noise, or assign a shared step-level weight that may overlook positional variation. We propose Persistent Consistency Self-Distillation (PCSD), which derives token-level distillation weights from the local persistence of teacher-favoring signals. PCSD combines adaptive windows with exponentially decayed aggregation to capture persistent relative teacher support, applies trend-aware modulation to attenuate locally declining support, and produces continuous weights through sigmoid gating. The resulting objective is jointly optimized with GRPO, combining dense teacher guidance with sparse environmental feedback. Without inference-time skills, PCSD achieves the best ALFWorld Overall results among all baselines on both backbones, exceeding GRPO by 15.6 and 13.3 points and SDAR by 6.2 and 5.5 points, while remaining competitive on WebShop and gaining 15.8 points over GRPO on unseen ALFWorld split.

AI.tldr: 提出PCSD方法，利用局部持续性教师信号生成token级蒸馏权重，结合GRPO联合优化，在ALFWorld上超越GRPO和SDAR。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在复杂交互任务中的RL常受稀疏奖励困扰，现有OPSD方法存在教师信号不可靠、孤立token级差异对噪声敏感、共享step级权重忽视位置差异等问题。
AI.method: PCSD从教师偏好信号的局部持续性中推导token级蒸馏权重，结合自适应窗口与指数衰减聚合捕捉持续相对教师支持，通过趋势感知调制衰减局部支持，用sigmoid门控产生连续权重，并与GRPO联合优化。
AI.result: PCSD在ALFWorld上两种骨干网络中均达到最优Overall结果，超过GRPO 15.6和13.3分，超过SDAR 6.2和5.5分，在WebShop上保持竞争力，在未见ALFWorld划分上超过GRPO 15.8分。
AI.conclusion: PCSD通过捕捉教师信号的局部持续性生成更稳健的token级蒸馏权重，有效结合密集教师引导与稀疏环境反馈，无需推理时技能即可显著提升智能体RL性能。

title: Towards Compact Unified Multimodal Tracking: Synergizing Knowledge Distillation with Structural Pruning
summary: Unified multimodal object tracking has achieved remarkable robustness by leveraging complementary sensor data (e.g., RGB, Thermal, Depth), yet the heavy computational burden of state-of-the-art models hinders their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. In this work, we identify the prediction head as a critical but often overlooked efficiency bottleneck. By strategically streamlining the decoder architecture, we unlock the potential for real-time inference but simultaneously introduce a capacity gap between the lightweight student and the heavy teacher. To resolve this, we conduct a systematic analysis of 17 distillation strategies and introduce a Dual-Alignment Distillation framework. Our key insight is that effective compression requires decoupling knowledge transfer into two complementary streams: (1) Spatial Representation Alignment, which employs feature distillation to sharpen the student's spatial focus on foreground targets ("Where to track"); and (2) Semantic Distribution Alignment, which utilizes logit-based distillation to align decision boundaries and transfer discriminative dark knowledge ("What to track"). Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms complex state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our distilled model achieves 91.5% MPR on RGBT234 and operates at 54 FPS on a single RTX 4090, representing a 5x speedup over the teacher model while maintaining superior accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双对齐蒸馏（Dual-Alignment Distillation）框架，用于压缩多模态目标跟踪模型的预测头，通过空间表征对齐和语义分布对齐两条互补的蒸馏流，在保持精度的同时实现5倍加速（54 FPS），并在RGBT234等五个基准上超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态目标跟踪（RGB、热红外、深度）虽鲁棒性强，但现有SOTA模型计算负担沉重，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。已有工作忽视了预测头这一关键效率瓶颈，且轻量学生模型与重型教师模型之间存在能力差距，需要有效的蒸馏策略来弥补。
AI.method: (1) 识别预测头为效率瓶颈，通过精简解码器架构实现实时推理；(2) 系统分析17种蒸馏策略，提出Dual-Alignment Distillation框架，解耦知识迁移为两条互补流：空间表征对齐（特征蒸馏，强化前景目标的空间聚焦，解决"在哪里跟踪"）和语义分布对齐（logit蒸馏，对齐决策边界并迁移判别性暗知识，解决"跟踪什么"）。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，所提方法显著优于复杂的SOTA方法。蒸馏模型在RGBT234上达到91.5% MPR，在单张RTX 4090上运行54 FPS，相比教师模型获得5倍加速，同时保持更优的精度。
AI.conclusion: 预测头解耦蒸馏策略（空间+语义双对齐）能够有效弥合轻量学生与重型教师间的能力差距，实现多模态目标跟踪模型的高效压缩，在边缘部署场景中兼具实时性和高精度。

title: Diffusion Policy with Behavioral Advantage Correction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: In offline reinforcement learning (RL), the distribution shift between behavioral data and the learned policy can lead to erroneous \emph{Q}-value estimation, thereby misguiding the direction of policy optimization. To address this issue, we develop a behavioral advantage corrected policy evaluation (BAC-PE) approach, which utilizes the \emph{Q}-function of the behavior policy to correct the learned policy's \emph{Q}-function, thus mitigating pessimistic conservatism and overestimation bias. Furthermore, the convergence of BAC-PE is analyzed theoretically, and an upper bound on the difference between the learned \emph{Q}-function and the true \emph{Q}-function is derived. To alleviate distribution shift, this work employs diffusion models to represent both the behavior policy and the learned policy, performing distribution matching for accurate policy regularization. Additionally, \emph{Q}-value guidance is incorporated into the training process to achieve effective policy improvement. By combining BAC-PE with diffusion policy modeling, we propose the diffusion policy with behavioral advantage correction (DPBAC) algorithm. Compared to existing offline methods, DPBAC demonstrates stronger policy representation capabilities and effectively mitigates the bias in \emph{Q}-value estimation.
