Experimental results on multiple domains of D4RL tasks show that DPBAC achieves superior performance, with notable advantages over state-of-the-art (SOTA) algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPBAC算法，结合行为优势校正策略评估（BAC-PE）与扩散模型，解决离线强化学习中的分布偏移和Q值估计偏差问题，在D4RL多个任务域上超越现有SOTA算法。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习中，行为数据与学习策略之间的分布偏移会导致Q值估计错误，从而误导策略优化的方向，造成过估计偏差或过度保守。
AI.method: 1) 提出BAC-PE方法，利用行为策略的Q函数校正学习策略的Q函数，缓解悲观保守和过估计偏差；2) 采用扩散模型表示行为策略和学习策略，通过分布匹配进行策略正则化以减轻分布偏移；3) 在训练过程中引入Q值引导实现有效的策略改进；4) 将BAC-PE与扩散策略建模结合，形成DPBAC算法。
AI.result: 理论上分析了BAC-PE的收敛性，并推导出学习Q函数与真实Q函数之间差异的上界。在D4RL基准的多个任务域上，DPBAC取得了优于现有SOTA算法的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: DPBAC通过行为优势校正和扩散策略建模，有效缓解了离线强化学习中的Q值估计偏差，具备更强的策略表征能力，在离线强化学习任务中展现出显著优势。

title: FOCUS: FP4 Optimization via Coupled-Relaxation and Dual-Granularity Scaling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance but are expensive to deploy due to their enormous size. FP4 quantization, with formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4, offers an appealing solution with native hardware support on modern accelerators. However, maintaining accuracy under FP4 precision remains difficult. A key bottleneck lies in scale optimization: existing methods tightly couple the quantization and dequantization scales, forcing both to conform to the discrete low-precision format required by hardware, such as E8M0 in MXFP4. Yet the quantization scale is never stored and need not obey this constraint, suggesting a significant untapped optimization space. In this work, we propose FOCUS, a post-training quantization framework with end-to-end scale learning for FP4 Optimization via Coupled-Relaxation and Dual-Granularity Scaling. Coupled-Relaxation Scaling (CRS) relaxes the tight coupling between quantization and dequantization scales with a learnable full-precision coefficient, enabling more effective optimization without breaking hardware compliance. Dual-Granularity Scaling (DGS) further refines the quantization scale at a finer sub-block granularity, allowing more precise adaptation to local weight distributions. Experiments across multiple LLM families and benchmarks show that FOCUS achieves state-of-the-art FP4 accuracy under both MXFP4 and NVFP4 formats, while introducing no additional inference overhead. Code and quantized models will be released at https://github.com/tencent/AngelSlim.

AI.tldr: FOCUS是一个面向FP4量化的后训练量化框架，通过耦合松弛缩放（CRS）和双粒度缩放（DGS）实现端到端规模学习，在MXFP4和NVFP4格式下取得最先进的FP4量化精度，且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: LLM虽然性能出色但部署成本高昂，FP4量化是硬件原生支持的解决方案。然而现有方法将量化和反量化缩放因子紧密耦合，都受限于硬件要求的离散低精度格式（如MXFP4中的E8M0），但量化缩放因子实际上不需要存储，不必遵守此约束，因此存在未被开发的优化空间。
AI.method: 提出FOCUS框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 耦合松弛缩放（CRS）：通过可学习的全精度系数松弛量化和反量化缩放因子之间的紧耦合，在不破坏硬件兼容性的前提下实现更有效的优化；(2) 双粒度缩放（DGS）：在更细的子块粒度上优化量化缩放因子，更精确地适应局部权重分布。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族和基准测试上的实验表明，FOCUS在MXFP4和NVFP4两种格式下均达到最先进的FP4精度，且不引入额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦量化与反量化缩放因子的约束并引入多粒度缩放，FOCUS有效提升了FP4量化的精度，为低成本LLM部署提供了新的途径。代码和量化模型将开源。

title: GaussianSelector: Lightweight Human-Guided Object Selection in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Graph Optimization
summary: Selecting a complete 3D object from a reconstructed scene with minimal user effort is essential for practical scene editing and embodied interaction. Existing 3DGS-based methods either retrain the Gaussian representation to embed per-object labels, or build dense multi-view SAM observations, both requiring heavy computation and dense viewpoint coverage that is rarely available in practice. We present GaussianSelector, a training-free framework for interactive 3D object selection from sparse views and sparse scribble guidance. Operating directly on native Gaussian primitives, we coarsen dense Gaussians into geometrically coherent superpoints and construct a continuity-weighted graph using appearance and spatial cues. Sparse user scribbles are lifted into 3D via visibility-aware transmittance coverage, and selection is solved as a global graph-cut energy minimization that propagates sparse evidence to a complete 3D object. This design naturally supports multi-round refinement, where users iteratively correct the selection from additional viewpoints to progressively improve the result. Experiments demonstrate that GaussianSelector achieves competitive selection quality against state-of-the-art multi-view SAM-based methods, while requiring significantly fewer interaction views and substantially lower computational overhead. These properties make it well suited for human-in-the-loop 3D scene editing and 3D asset extraction in real-world deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: GaussianSelector 是一种无需训练的交互式 3D 物体选择框架，直接基于高斯原语操作，通过超点粗化、连续性加权图和全局图割能量最小化，仅需稀疏视图和稀疏涂鸦即可完成完整 3D 物体选择，支持多轮交互优化，在降低计算开销的同时达到了与 SOTA 多视图 SAM 方法相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 物体选择方法要么重训高斯表示以嵌入逐对象标签，要么构建稠密多视图 SAM 观测，两者都需要大量计算和密集视角覆盖，实际场景中难以满足。因此需要一个从稀疏视图和稀疏交互中高效完成 3D 物体选择的训练无关方案。
AI.method: 1) 将稠密高斯原语粗化为几何一致的超点；2) 利用外观和空间线索构建连续性加权图；3) 通过可见性感知透射覆盖率将稀疏用户涂鸦提升到 3D；4) 将选择问题建模为全局图割能量最小化，将稀疏证据传播到完整 3D 物体；5) 支持多轮细化，用户可从额外视角迭代修正。
AI.result: 在物体选择质量上与基于多视图 SAM 的最先进方法相当，但所需交互视角显著更少，计算开销大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: GaussianSelector 以低计算成本和少量交互实现了高质量的 3D 物体选择，非常适合人机协同的 3D 场景编辑和 3D 资产提取等真实部署场景。

title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
summary: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its scaffold maintains up to 20 active screenshots and folds older visual history in fixed-size blocks to retain recent evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes. For training, we build a cloud rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments, construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks, and collect personalized long-horizon workflows across everyday and professional software. We optimize complete trajectories with verifiable rewards and trajectory slicing, while iterative training runs refresh supervised data and recalibrate reinforcement-learning tasks. Across eight benchmarks, Qwen-CUA outperforms Qwen3.7 and remains competitive with leading proprietary systems, reaching 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified and 18.5/48.4 binary/partial completion on OSWorld 2.0. Scaling the same recipe to a model with over one trillion parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, improving these scores to 87.6 and 21.2/53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7. Efficiency analyses, a browser deployment, and Bash-augmented experiments further characterize practical behavior. These results establish native computer use as a broadly capable agent foundation and highlight scalable verifiable interaction and hybrid tool use as key directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Qwen-CUA，一个基于397B-A17B Qwen MoE骨干的原生计算机使用智能体。它仅通过截图观察、以键盘鼠标事件操作，不依赖DOM树或API。通过云端rollout舰队（约10万vCPU）收集约4万可验证任务，采用可验证奖励和轨迹切分优化完整轨迹。在8个基准上超越Qwen3.7，与顶级专有系统竞争，OSWorld-Verified达86.2；扩展至万亿参数得到Qwen-CUA-Max（87.6）。同时将RedTeamCUA攻击成功率从36.6降至16.4。
AI.motivation: 原生计算机使用为智能体提供了操作几乎所有软件的统一界面，但面临长时程状态追踪、大规模交互经验获取以及从稀疏可验证结果中学习的三大挑战。现有方法多依赖DOM树、辅助功能元数据或任务特定API，限制了通用性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 1) 模型架构：397B-A17B Qwen MoE骨干，仅以截图作为输入，通过键盘鼠标事件输出操作；2) Scaffold：维护最多20个活跃截图，以固定大小块折叠旧视觉历史，保留近期证据同时维持可复用前缀；3) 训练数据：构建云端rollout舰队（近10万vCPU、数万并发环境），构造约4万个可验证任务，收集日常和专业软件中的个性化长时程工作流；4) 优化策略：用可验证奖励和轨迹切分优化完整轨迹，迭代训练运行刷新监督数据并重新校准RL任务；5) 扩展：将相同配方扩展到万亿参数得到Qwen-CUA-Max。
AI.result: 在8个基准上，Qwen-CUA超越Qwen3.7，与顶级专有系统竞争力相当。OSWorld-Verified达86.2，OSWorld 2.0上二元/部分完成率为18.5/48.4。Qwen-CUA-Max进一步提升至87.6和21.2/53.3。RedTeamCUA攻击成功率从36.6降至16.4。效率和浏览器部署及Bash增强实验进一步验证了实际行为。
AI.conclusion: 原生计算机使用可作为一种广泛适用的智能体基座，可验证交互的可扩展性和混合工具使用是关键的前进方向。该工作证明了无需DOM等结构化信息，仅通过截图和通用操作即可实现强大的计算机使用能力。

title: Exploring and Bridging Knowledge Holes in Unlearned Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Machine unlearning offers a promising approach to remove unsafe content from Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet ensuring the precision of unlearning remains a persistent challenge. One reason is that current MLLM unlearning evaluation paradigms suffer from a critical blind spot: they assess model utility through benchmarks whose representations are distant from the forget set, failing to capture knowledge holes---severe degradation on benign adjacent inputs. To probe knowledge holes in unlearned MLLMs, we construct a benchmark that captures unintended degradation on benign inputs sharing generic patterns with the forget set, and confirm through controlled experiments that they are a systematic consequence of commonly used approaches. Furthermore, to bridge this gap, we propose Selective Protection with Anchored Regularization, which protects generic patterns via anchored activation filtering while reinforcing them through entity-abstracted enhancement. Our experiments on SafeEraser demonstrate that SPAR recovers over 98% of vanilla response quality compared to below 50% for standard baselines---while achieving 0.00% attack success rate and competitive model utility. These results underscore the necessity of more fine-grained evaluation for trustworthy MLLM unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态大模型（MLLM）机器遗忘评估中存在"知识空洞"盲区——当前评估范式未能捕捉遗忘模型在良性相邻输入上的严重退化。作者构建了专门基准来探测这一问题，并提出选择性保护与锚定正则化（SPAR）方法，在SafeEraser上恢复98%以上的原始响应质量，同时实现0%攻击成功率和有竞争力的模型效用。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLM机器遗忘评估存在关键盲区：评估基准与遗忘集的表征距离过远，无法捕捉"知识空洞"（良性相邻输入上的严重退化）。作者旨在证明这一系统性问题并开发更细粒度的评估与解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建探测"知识空洞"的基准：通过构造与遗忘集共享通用模式但内容良性的输入来检测意外退化；2) 提出SPAR方法：通过锚定激活过滤保护通用模式，并通过实体抽象增强进行强化。
AI.result: 在SafeEraser基准上，SPAR恢复了超过98%的原始响应质量（标准基线仅低于50%），同时达到0.00%的攻击成功率和有竞争力的模型效用。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明需要更细粒度的评估方法来实现可信赖的MLLM机器遗忘，并证明了SPAR在保持遗忘效果的同时有效避免知识空洞。

title: Probing the 3D Object-Level Understanding of Pre-Trained Detection Transformers
summary: Detection transformer models, including DETR and its extensions, learn to output a set of object-level embeddings that can be simultaneously decoded into 2D bounding boxes and class distributions. In this paper, we investigate what pre-trained 2D detection transformers understand about the 3D properties of objects. Specifically, we investigate the extent to which properties including the depth of objects from the camera and the 3D location of objects relative to the camera can be recovered from object-level embeddings using linear and non-linear probes. Across a range of detection transformer models, our results show a surprisingly strong and previously unknown ability of 2D DETR models to represent useful information about the 3D properties of objects, despite the complete lack of 3D supervision during model pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2D检测Transformer模型（如DETR及其变体）的物体级嵌入中是否包含三维物体属性信息。通过线性和非线性探针实验，发现这些模型虽然从未接受过3D监督训练，但其嵌入中却惊人地编码了丰富的3D信息（如物体深度和相对相机的3D位置）。
AI.motivation: 探究预训练的2D检测Transformer模型是否在物体嵌入中隐含地学到了3D物体的属性，这是一个此前未被发现的潜在能力，有助于理解这些模型的表征能力和泛化特性。
AI.method: 使用线性和非线性探针（probing）方法，从多种检测Transformer模型的物体级嵌入中恢复物体深度和3D位置信息，并进行系统评估。
AI.result: 发现2D DETR模型在完全缺乏3D监督预训练的情况下，其物体级嵌入包含出人意料地强且此前未知的3D属性表征能力。
AI.conclusion: 2D检测Transformer模型的无监督3D表征能力远超预期，这一发现对迁移学习、多模态理解和3D感知任务具有潜在价值。

title: GLAIM: Learning Global and Local Adaptive Inter-Variable Dependency for Multivariate Time Series Imputation
summary: Multivariate time series imputation is fundamental to downstream analysis, yet modeling inter-variable dependencies with incomplete observations remains challenging. Existing methods learn global dependencies across samples or dynamic local dependencies per sample. Global dependencies are stable but adapt poorly to sample variations and temporal non-stationarity, whereas local dependencies are adaptive yet unreliable when observations are insufficient, causing erroneous information propagation. To address these limitations, we propose GLAIM, a Global-Local Adaptive Inter-variable Dependency Modeling framework for multivariate time series imputation. GLAIM comprises two complementary components. The Stable Global Dependency Constructor derives robust global inter-variable dependencies from complementary temporal representations, providing a stable backbone less affected by sample-specific missingness and noise. The Sample-Conditioned Dependency Refiner adapts this backbone to each sample and time step using its temporal state and available observations, enabling reliable local refinement under incomplete observations. Extensive experiments on nine real-world datasets demonstrate that GLAIM achieves state-of-the-art performance under random and block missingness, remains robust to missing-rate shifts, and benefits from its complementary global and local components. Code is available at https://github.com/LuRenjias/GLAIM.

AI.tldr: 提出GLAIM框架，通过全局稳定依赖构造器和样本条件依赖细化器相结合，解决多变量时间序列插补中变量间依赖建模的全局-局部适应性难题，在9个真实数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么学习全局依赖（稳定但难以适应样本变化和非平稳性），要么学习动态局部依赖（适应性强但在观测不足时不可靠）。两种方法都存在局限，需要同时兼顾稳定性和适应性的依赖建模方法。
AI.method: GLAIM包含两个互补组件：1) 稳定全局依赖构造器（Stable Global Dependency Constructor），从互补的时间表示中提取稳健的全局变量间依赖关系；2) 样本条件依赖细化器（Sample-Conditioned Dependency Refiner），利用样本时间状态和可用观测对全局依赖进行逐样本、逐时间步的局部细化。
AI.result: 在9个真实数据集上的随机缺失和块缺失场景下均达到最先进性能，对缺失率变化保持稳健，且两个互补组件的组合带来性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 全局-局部自适应的依赖建模框架能够同时兼顾依赖的稳定性和适应性，是多变量时间序列插补的有效解决方案。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Complex Eigenfrequency Identification and Mode Structure Reconstruction of the Ground-State ITG Branch
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) combine sparse observations with physical equations, providing an important approach for modeling complex plasma processes and inferring unknown physical quantities. The steep-gradient pedestal of high-confinement-mode tokamaks is closely linked to plasma confinement and edge transport. Analyzing ion-temperature-gradient (ITG) drift waves in this region requires jointly identifying complex eigenfrequencies and reconstructing two-dimensional complex-valued mode fields. Localized high-frequency oscillations, strong real-imaginary coupling, and nonlinear coupling between the mode field and eigenfrequency challenge PINN representation and joint optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a physics-informed neural framework combining Fourier feature encoding, complex-valued feature propagation, and three-stage training. Under sparse observations and physical constraints, it jointly solves for the complex eigenfrequency and mode field of a representative ground-state ITG branch. Experiments show that the framework accurately recovers the target complex eigenfrequency and two-dimensional complex-valued mode field and outperforms representative PINN baselines. It also provides a basis for analyzing higher-order and multiple-branch drift-wave modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合傅里叶特征编码、复值特征传播和三阶段训练的物理信息神经网络框架，用于在托卡马克高约束模式台基区联合识别离子温度梯度（ITG）漂移波的复本征频率并重构二维复值模场。在稀疏观测和物理约束下，该框架能准确恢复目标复本征频率和模场，优于代表性PINN基线，并为高阶及多分支漂移波分析奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 高约束模式托卡马克的陡峭梯度台基区与等离子体约束和边缘输运密切相关，分析该区域的ITG漂移波需要联合识别复本征频率并重构二维复值模场。然而，局部高频振荡、强实虚部耦合以及模场与本征频率之间的非线性耦合给传统PINN的表征和联合优化带来了巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种结合三方面技术的物理信息神经框架：(1) 傅里叶特征编码以处理局部高频振荡；(2) 复值特征传播以自然表征复值模场并处理实虚部耦合；(3) 三阶段训练策略以应对模场与本征频率间的非线性耦合联合优化问题。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架在稀疏观测和物理约束下能准确恢复代表性基态ITG分支的复本征频率及二维复值模场，并优于典型的PINN基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为托卡马克台基区漂移波分析提供了有效的PINN解决方案，并为后续分析高阶和多分支漂移波模式奠定了基础。

title: Rolling Shutter Camera Self-Calibration
summary: Rolling shutter (RS) cameras are widely used in consumer devices, but their row-wise exposure causes distortions under motion, making geometric 3D vision problems dependent on both camera intrinsics and readout time ratio. Existing RS calibration methods rely on calibration targets or specialised hardware, limiting their use in unconstrained settings. We present the first self-calibration method for RS cameras that directly estimates camera intrinsics and the readout time ratio from image sequences, without requiring calibration targets. The method is implemented as a self-calibrating bundle adjustment (BA), which critically depends on the RS imaging model. We combine two known complementary models. The first formulates RS imaging as continuous-time trajectory estimation under a row-wise pose representation. The second interprets RS images as temporally distorted global shutter (GS) images and requires to estimate correction fields. The combination is non-trivial and results in a unified dual-projection model, in which each 3D point is simultaneously constrained at both row-dependent and reference timestamps along a shared continuous trajectory, enforcing stronger geometric and temporal consistency. Extensive simulations analyse the applicability of several implementations under varying conditions, and real data experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and practical effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个无需标定板的卷帘快门（RS）相机自标定方法，直接从图像序列中估计相机内参和读出时间比。该方法通过统一的双投影模型，结合连续时间轨迹估计与时域畸变全局快门图像校正两种互补模型，在共享连续轨迹上同时约束3D点在行相关和参考时间戳的位置，实现了更强的几何与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 卷帘快门相机广泛应用于消费设备，但其行曝光机制在运动下产生畸变，使得3D视觉问题同时依赖相机内参和读出时间比。现有RS标定方法依赖标定靶或专用硬件，难以在无约束场景下使用，亟需一种无需标定目标的RS自标定方法。
AI.method: 将RS自标定实现为自标定光束法平差（BA），结合两种互补的RS成像模型：1）将RS成像表示为行方向位姿表示的连续时间轨迹估计；2）将RS图像解释为时域畸变的全局快门图像，需估计校正场。两者的非线性组合形成统一的双投影模型，每个3D点在共享连续轨迹上同时受行相关时间戳和参考时间戳约束，强制几何和时间一致性。
AI.result: 广泛仿真实验分析了多种实现在不同条件下的适用性，真实数据实验验证了所提方法的精度、鲁棒性和实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法首次实现了无标定目标条件下直接从图像序列对RS相机进行自标定，同时估计内参和读出时间比，为无约束场景下的RS相机标定提供了实用有效的解决方案。

title: Gecko: Fast Private Inference via Secure Public Encoder Offloading
summary:
Private inference protects both user inputs and server models during neural network inference, but existing solutions remain too slow for practical deployment. This motivates recent efforts to run a public encoder, such as a pretrained backbone, outside the protection boundary and evaluate only a small private predictor cryptographically. While appealing for efficiency, this design is not inherently secure: naively offloading a public encoder may create a feature-space shortcut: an extraction adversary may learn the remaining private predictor's feature-to-output mapping more easily than the original model's input-to-output behavior.
  We present Gecko, designed to limit this additional risk while retaining a compact encrypted predictor. We leverage a frozen backbone that contributes hierarchical features, fixed Fastfood projections that compress them, and private feature gating that prepares them for prediction. We formalize ideal independence and information-preservation conditions as design guidance, then separately evaluate component-reuse extraction attacks. Across image and audio tasks, Gecko achieves 0.4-2.2 second inference with at most 10.8 MB communication and accuracy comparable to transfer-learning baselines. Under the evaluated attacks, reusing the offloaded public encoder provides no significant advantage to model-extraction adversaries. Source code and a demo are available at https://github.com/CassiniHuy/gecko-infer.

AI.tldr: Gecko是一种面向私有推理的架构，通过将冻结的公共骨干网络（提供分层特征）、固定的Fastfood投影（压缩特征）和私有特征门控（为预测准备特征）相结合，在保持高效推理的同时限制模型提取攻击的风险。在图像和音频任务上，Gecko实现了0.4-2.2秒的推理延迟和最多10.8 MB的通信开销，准确率与迁移学习基线相当，且评估显示复用公共编码器对提取攻击者没有显著优势。
AI.motivation: 私有推理需要保护用户输入和服务器模型，但现有方案推理速度过慢，难以实际部署。近期工作尝试在保护边界外运行公共编码器（如预训练骨干网络），仅对小型私有预测器进行密码学评估。虽然这种设计高效，但并非天然安全：将公共编码器移到边界外可能产生特征空间捷径，使得提取攻击者学习剩余私有预测器的特征到输出的映射比学习原始模型的输入到输出行为更容易。
AI.method: Gecko采用三个关键组件：(1) 冻结的骨干网络提供分层特征；(2) 固定的Fastfood投影用于压缩特征；(3) 私有特征门控（private feature gating）为预测准备特征。作者形式化了理想的独立性和信息保持条件作为设计指导，并分别评估了组件复用提取攻击（component-reuse extraction attacks）。
AI.result: 在图像和音频任务上，Gecko实现了0.4-2.2秒的推理延迟，通信开销最多10.8 MB，准确率与迁移学习基线相当。在评估的攻击下，复用卸载的公共编码器对模型提取攻击者没有提供显著优势。
AI.conclusion: Gecko证明了可以在保持紧凑加密预测器的同时，限制因公共编码器边界外移而引入的额外提取风险，实现了可部署的效率与可接受的隐私安全之间的平衡。代码和演示已开源。

title: EchoChange: A Diffusion Language Model with Dual Pass Remasking for Factual Remote Sensing Disaster Change Captioning
summary: Bi-temporal remote-sensing disaster change captioning often needs to identify sparse and spatially localized changes across large pre- and post-event scenes and then translate them into coherent, factual descriptions. However, existing change captioning methods always follow an autoregressive decoding paradigm to generate the change description and thus an early misinterpretation of the changed object, event, or spatial relation becomes an irreversible premise for subsequent text, amplifying visual ambiguity into cascading factual errors. To address this limitation, we propose EchoChange, a multimodal discrete diffusion language model that formulates change captioning as iterative masked-token denoising rather than left-to-right generation. By repeatedly revising the entire caption while conditioning on the image pair, EchoChange can reconsider uncertain content and correct imperfect intermediate predictions. We further introduce draft-aware dual-pass training, a progressive masking curriculum, and confidence-guided remasking to align training with iterative inference. Extensive experiments on the RSCC benchmark show that EchoChange substantially outperforms both general-purpose and remote-sensing-specific baselines across lexical and semantic metrics. The EchoChange Project is at https://github.com/sundongwei/EchoChange_Project

AI.tldr: EchoChange提出了一种基于多模态离散扩散语言模型的遥感灾害双时相变化描述方法，通过迭代掩码去噪替代自回归解码，有效减少级联事实错误，在RSCC基准上显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有变化描述方法采用自回归解码范式，早期对变化目标、事件或空间关系的误解会成为后续文本的不可逆前提，将视觉模糊性放大为级联事实错误。遥感灾害场景中变化通常稀疏且空间局部化，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出EchoChange多模态离散扩散语言模型，将变化描述建模为迭代掩码去噪而非从左到右生成。在图像对条件下反复修订完整描述以纠正不完美中间预测。引入草稿感知双通道训练、渐进掩码课程和置信度引导的重掩码，使训练与迭代推理对齐。
AI.result: 在RSCC基准上的大量实验表明，EchoChange在词法和语义指标上均大幅超越通用和遥感专用基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 迭代式重建范式相比自回归范式能有效克服早期错误传播问题，为遥感变化描述任务提供了更可靠的新思路。

title: UCBound-Net: Uncertainty-Guided Boundary-Aware Continual Learning for Domain-Incremental Ultrasound Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 CLiMeM Workshop
summary: Continual learning in clinical imaging faces a dual challenge: a model must assimilate knowledge from new anatomical domains while retaining representations learned from prior tasks, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation strategies, including regularization and knowledge distillation, treat all spatial regions equally, ignoring the fact that prediction uncertainty is strongly correlated with the propensity for forgetting. We introduce UCBound-Net, a continual segmentation framework that exploits Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout uncertainty as a spatial proxy for forgetting risk. Our method contributes three synergistic components: (i) uncertainty-weighted boundary distillation, which amplifies the knowledge transfer signal at high-entropy regions of the frozen teacher; (ii) uncertainty-calibration regularization, which explicitly penalizes overconfident erroneous predictions; and (iii) uncertainty-guided exemplar selection, a memory buffer that preferentially stores samples whose boundary regions exhibit the highest predictive entropy. Evaluated on a sequential domain-incremental benchmark comprising breast ultrasound (BUSI, Task 1) followed by thyroid ultrasound (TN3K, Task 2), UCBound-Net reduces forgetting relative to naive fine-tuning, achieving a backward transfer (BWT) of -0.098 compared with -0.173, while obtaining an average Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.755 across both tasks. The proposed framework outperforms baseline methods without requiring task-boundary supervision. An ablation study further demonstrates that each component contributes independently to forgetting mitigation, providing a practical pathway toward uncertainty-aware continual learning for clinical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: UCBound-Net是一个面向临床影像连续分割的框架，利用MC Dropout不确定性作为空间遗忘风险的代理，通过不确定性加权边界蒸馏、不确定性校准正则化和不确定性引导的样本选择三个协同组件来缓解灾难性遗忘。在乳腺超声→甲状腺超声的领域增量基准上，该方法将BWT从-0.173提升至-0.098，平均DSC达0.755，且无需任务边界监督。
AI.motivation: 临床影像连续学习面临双重挑战：模型需要从新解剖域学习知识，同时保留先前任务表征（灾难性遗忘）。现有缓解策略（正则化、知识蒸馏）对所有空间区域一视同仁，忽略了预测不确定性与遗忘倾向强相关这一事实。
AI.method: 提出UCBound-Net连续分割框架，包含三个协同组件：(i)不确定性加权边界蒸馏——在冻结教师的高熵区域放大知识迁移信号；(ii)不确定性校准正则化——显式惩罚过度自信的错误预测；(iii)不确定性引导的样本选择——优先存储边界区域预测熵最高的样本到记忆缓冲区。
AI.result: 在乳腺超声(BUSI)→甲状腺超声(TN3K)的顺序领域增量基准上，BWT从朴素微调的-0.173提升至-0.098，两任务平均DSC达0.755，优于基线方法且无需任务边界监督。消融实验验证每个组件对遗忘缓解均有独立贡献。
AI.conclusion: UCBound-Net提供了一条面向不确定性的临床影像连续分割实际路径，验证了利用空间不确定性引导遗忘缓解的有效性。

title: From fragmented data to actionable design: Physics-calibrated learning for plastic upcycling
summary: Thermochemical upgrading of plastic waste is a key upcycling pathway, yet the experimental literature is fragmented by heterogeneous conditions and incomplete reporting. Complete-case learning would retain only 10.99% of the curated experiments, while target imputation can introduce biased supervision. Here we develop a Physics-Calibrated, Missingness-Gated, and Load-Balanced Mixture-of-Experts (PC-MG-MoE) framework that converts structured missingness into an informative learning signal. PC-MG-MoE learns directly from partially observed experiments without target imputation, reconstructs physically consistent product distributions, accommodates cross-laboratory heterogeneity, and provides interpretable model behaviour rather than black-box prediction alone. Under stringent source-grouped validation, it achieved the lowest aggregate absolute error among the evaluated models, supporting engineering screening under cross-laboratory heterogeneity. Wet-lab experiments provide an external comparison, showing key composition-dependent trends. Implemented as an interactive web-based workflow, PC-MG-MoE enables forward screening, physics-grounded constrained inverse design, targeted experimental planning that supports reduced experimental workload and trial-and-error, and laboratory-specific adaptation with new platform-specific data. This work establishes a transferable framework for converting fragmented literature data into experimentally actionable guidance for model-guided plastic upcycling and broader thermochemical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PC-MG-MoE框架，用于处理塑料废弃物热化学升级实验中高度碎片化的文献数据。该方法将结构化缺失转化为信息学习信号，无需目标插补即可从部分观测实验中学习，重建物理一致的产物分布，并适应跨实验室异质性。在严格的源分组验证中取得了最优性能，并提供了交互式网页工作流支持正向筛选、逆设计和实验规划。
AI.motivation: 塑料废弃物热化学升级是关键的升级回收途径，但实验文献因实验条件异质和报告不完整而碎片化。完整数据学习仅能保留10.99%的策划实验，而目标插补会引入有偏监督，传统方法难以在缺失数据条件下有效学习。
AI.method: 提出PC-MG-MoE（物理校准、缺失门控、负载均衡的混合专家）框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 物理校准模块确保产物分布重建的物理一致性；(2) 缺失门控机制将结构化缺失转化为信息学习信号；(3) 负载均衡的混合专家结构适应跨实验室异质性。同时实现为交互式网页工作流。
AI.result: 在严格的源分组验证下，PC-MG-MoE在评估模型中实现了最低的聚合绝对误差，支持跨实验室异质性下的工程筛选。湿实验提供了外部对比，展示了关键组分依赖趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了将碎片化文献数据转化为实验可操作指导的可迁移框架，支持模型引导的塑料升级回收及更广泛的热化学系统，可减少实验工作量和试错成本。

title: Wnuan: Staged Post-Training for Question Answering over Proprietary Enterprise Knowledge
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures. Includes Supplementary Appendices A--L. Xiaofeng Shi and Xiaosong Qiu contributed equally
summary: Enterprise question answering requires models to acquire proprietary knowledge without discarding general capabilities. We present Wnuan, a three-stage pipeline that constructs task-oriented supervision from documents, performs supervised fine-tuning with general-data replay, and applies reinforcement learning to residual errors. On the 707-question WnuanBench, the primary 32B route raises acceptable-answer rate (AAR) from 52.76% before adaptation to 80.06% after SFT and 91.51% after RL. Under a matched 100-update protocol, residual-error sampling outperforms full-pool and size-matched random sampling by 3.11 and 2.97 points, respectively. Source-cluster bootstrap intervals remain above zero for both contrasts, and a same-domain validation set preserves the ordering. The general-benchmark average decreases by 5.17 points across the route, concentrated in instruction following. The automatic evaluation ensemble agrees with an authoritative domain expert on 90.5% of a stratified Wnuan-Inst response sample. These results characterize both the gains and the general-capability cost of staged enterprise adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Wnuan，一个三阶段流水线（文档构建监督、带通用数据回放的SFT、针对残差错误的RL），用于企业问答系统的领域适应。在707题WnuanBench上，32B路线将可接受答案率从52.76%提升到SFT后的80.06%和RL后的91.51%，同时定量刻画了通用能力下降约5.17分的代价。
AI.motivation: 企业问答需要在获取专有知识的同时不损失通用能力，这是一个关键的平衡问题。现有方法缺乏系统的分阶段适应方案，也缺乏对通用能力代价的定量刻画。
AI.method: 提出Wnuan三阶段流水线：(1) 从文档构建任务导向的监督数据；(2) 使用通用数据回放进行监督微调（SFT）；(3) 对残差错误应用强化学习（RL）。同时设计了残差错误采样策略，并通过源簇自助法和同域验证集进行统计分析。
AI.result: 32B路线AAR从52.76%提升至SFT后80.06%、RL后91.51%。残差错误采样在100更新协议下优于全池随机采样3.11点和大小匹配随机采样2.97点，自助法置信区间均包含正区间。通用benchmark平均下降5.17分（集中在指令跟随），自动评估与领域专家在90.5%样本上一致。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段企业适应能显著提升领域问答性能，但对通用能力（尤其指令跟随）存在可量化的损失，需要在部署时权衡取舍。残差错误采样是更高效的RL训练数据选择策略。

title: ST-LoRA: Single Trajectory LoRA Ensemble for Uncertainty Aware Agricultural Segmentation
comment: Submitted to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (Elsevier). Currently under review (first revision round)
summary: Reliable decision-support in digital agriculture requires accurate predictions and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, particularly for dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation. Ensemble methods provide strong uncertainty quantification, but their computational and memory demands limit practical use, while single-model approximations often trade off uncertainty quality for efficiency. We propose ST-LoRA, a parameter-efficient ensemble framework that builds diverse ensemble members from a single training trajectory by combining Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with snapshot ensembling. Each member shares a frozen pretrained backbone and differs only in lightweight low-rank adapters, reducing trainable parameters to under 10% of the full model while preserving ensemble diversity. We evaluate across two agricultural datasets - GrowliFlower-L (cauliflower, open field) and BUP20 (sweet pepper, glasshouse) - using SegFormer and Mask2Former, covering in-distribution performance, calibration under distribution shift, and out-of-distribution detection. Ablations show feed-forward layers, not attention layers, are the critical LoRA target for dense prediction, contrary to the attention-only convention from language models. ST-LoRA matches or exceeds full-rank ensembles in segmentation accuracy and calibration across both datasets and architectures, while substantially reducing training time, inference latency, memory footprint, and storage requirements. Against efficient baselines - Snapshot Ensemble, MC Dropout, and Deep Deterministic Uncertainty - ST-LoRA consistently matches or outperforms them in image/pixel-level OoD detection, calibration stability under shift, and cross-seed variance, with far fewer parameters and lower compute. These results show LoRA-efficient ensemble adaptation is a highly effective, practical approach for uncertainty-aware agricultural vision systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ST-LoRA，一种参数高效的集成学习框架，通过将低秩自适应(LoRA)与快照集成相结合，从单一训练轨迹中构建多样化的集成成员，用于农业图像语义分割中的不确定性量化，在保持集成多样性的同时将可训练参数减少到全模型的10%以下。
AI.motivation: 数字农业中的可靠决策支持需要准确的预测和良好的不确定性估计，特别是在语义分割等密集预测任务中。集成方法虽然提供强大的不确定性量化能力，但计算和内存需求过高限制了实际应用；而单模型近似方法往往在不确定性质量与效率之间做出权衡。
AI.method: ST-LoRA将LoRA与快照集成结合：每个集成成员共享冻结的预训练骨干网络，仅通过轻量级低秩适配器区分彼此。消融实验发现前馈层（而非注意力层）是密集预测中关键的LoRA目标，这与语言模型中以注意力层为主的惯例相反。在SegFormer和Mask2Former两种架构上进行评估。
AI.result: 在两个农业数据集（GrowliFlower-L和BUP20）上，ST-LoRA在分割准确性和校准方面匹配或超过全秩集成，同时显著减少训练时间、推理延迟、内存占用和存储需求。与快照集成、MC Dropout和深度确定性不确定性等高效基线相比，ST-LoRA在OoD检测、分布偏移下的校准稳定性以及跨种子方差方面持续匹配或超越，且参数和计算量更少。
AI.conclusion: LoRA高效集成适配是构建不确定性感知农业视觉系统的极具有效性和实用性的方法，为资源受限场景下的可靠决策支持提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Deep Learning-Based Estimation of Ground Reaction Forces in Parkinsonian Gait Using an Optimized Set of IMU Data
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Published in IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering
summary: Accurate gait analysis in Parkinson's disease (PD) typically relies on laboratory-based systems to capture biomechanical data, such as ground reaction forces (GRFs). Estimating GRFs using inertial measurement units (IMUs) provides a feasible alternative. However, this approach remains challenging in pathological gait like PD due to its high variability and complexity. Moreover, existing monitoring approaches often require multiple body-mounted sensors, which limit practicality and reduce patient compliance. To date, no study has investigated the application of deep learning approaches to address this challenge. This study proposes, for the first time, a deep learning framework to estimate bilateral vertical GRFs (vGRFs) in PD using an optimized set of wearable IMUs. A hybrid CNN-BiLSTM model was trained separately on data from 61 PD patients and 65 healthy controls (HC) using 13 IMUs. The model achieved high intra-subject accuracy ($R^2$ = 0.98) and strong inter-subject generalization ($R^2$ = 0.93 for HC, $R^2$ = 0.91 for PD). Sensor configuration was found to significantly influence estimation accuracy, with optimal sensor placement varying between PD patients and HC. For PD patients, estimation accuracy dropped markedly when reducing to a single IMU. The optimal configuration for PD used four IMUs. We identified a minimal setup with only two IMUs still enabled robust estimation. This compact setup offers a practical and scalable solution. Overall, the proposed approach supports the development of wearable vGRF-based gait analysis systems for Parkinsonian gait and potentially other pathological conditions, enabling accessible clinical assessments, remote monitoring, and personalized rehabilitation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出使用深度学习框架（混合CNN-BiLSTM模型）从优化配置的穿戴式IMU传感器中估计帕金森病患者的双侧垂直地面反作用力（vGRFs），在61名PD患者和65名健康对照者上训练，实现了高精度的个体内估计（R²=0.98）和良好的跨个体泛化能力（HC: R²=0.93, PD: R²=0.91），并发现PD患者使用4个IMU为最优配置，最少仅需2个IMU即可实现稳健估计。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病的步态分析通常依赖实验室设备（如GRF测量），但实验室方法不便于临床推广。使用IMU估计GRF虽然是一种可行替代方案，但在PD这种高变异性和复杂性的病理性步态中具有挑战性。此外，现有方法常需多个身体传感器，影响实用性和患者依从性，且此前尚无研究将深度学习方法应用于这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种混合CNN-BiLSTM深度学习框架，利用优化后的穿戴式IMU传感器估计双侧垂直地面反作用力。模型分别在61名PD患者和65名健康对照组的数据上进行训练，使用13个IMU采集数据。通过消融实验评估不同传感器数量和摆放位置对估计精度的影响。
AI.result: 模型在个体内估计达到高精度（R²=0.98）；跨个体泛化表现良好（HC: R²=0.93, PD: R²=0.91）。传感器配置显著影响估计精度，且PD患者与HC的最优传感器放置位置不同。PD患者减少到单个IMU时精度明显下降，最优配置为4个IMU，最少2个IMU即可实现稳健估计。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种实用且可扩展的可穿戴vGRF步态分析方案，支持帕金森病及其他病理条件下的临床评估、远程监测和个性化康复，为可穿戴步态分析系统的开发奠定了基础。

title: ReasonCast: Towards Explainable Time Series Forecasting with Reasoning
summary: Most time series (TS) models are specialized for a single task, either understanding (i.e., returning text answers about a TS) or generation (i.e., returning a numeric forecast). Only recently have unified models begun to handle the two within a single architecture. Even these models, however, produce the two outputs as task-separated paths and cannot predict a series and explain why that prediction arises within a single coherent response. In this paper, we argue for a task-fused model that jointly produces 1) prediction (generation) and 2) selfexplanation (understanding), thereby integrating 1) numerical TS forecasting and 2) interpretable text reasoning within a single response. To enable the systematic study of this capability, we present both a benchmark and a recipe that jointly address the two tasks. The benchmark, ReasonTS-Bench, identifies five fundamental patterns underlying TS and enables the joint evaluation of both tasks. ReasonCast, our recipe for finetuning any LLM to perform both tasks jointly, yields a model that generates a reasoning chain and a forecast together in a single autoregressive pass. Extensive experiments show that ReasonCast outperforms both LLMs and TS models on prediction accuracy while producing verifiable, causal reasoning. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/reasoncast.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务融合的时间序列模型ReasonCast，将数值预测（生成）与可解释文本推理（理解）统一到单个自回归响应中，并配套推出ReasonTS-Bench基准，用于联合评估这两个任务。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列模型大多专精于单一任务（理解或生成），即便最新的统一模型也采用任务分离的路径，无法在单一连贯响应中同时给出预测及其解释。作者主张任务融合模型，以同时实现预测和自解释能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出ReasonTS-Bench基准，识别时间序列中的五种基本模式，支持对两个任务的联合评估；2) 提出ReasonCast配方，可微调任意LLM联合执行预测与推理任务，在单次自回归过程中同时生成推理链和预测结果。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ReasonCast在预测准确度上优于现有LLM和时间序列模型，同时能产生可验证的因果推理。
AI.conclusion: 任务融合的时间序列模型是可行的，能够在单一响应中同时提供高质量数值预测和可解释的文本推理，代码已开源。

title: Recursive Vision Language Models for General Symbolic Reasoning
summary: Hard symbolic-reasoning tasks such as Sudoku, maze pathfinding, and ARC remain challenging for LLMs due to their fixed-depth autoregressive reasoning, which limits systematic search, refinement, and backtracking. While recursive models such as Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) and Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) address this limitation through iterative latent-state refinement, they are typically task-specific and do not leverage pretrained language priors. We propose R-Qwen, a recursive reasoning framework built upon a pretrained Qwen backbone. R-Qwen repeatedly refines a candidate solution through programmatic self-recursion and deep supervision, combining the structured iterative computation of recursive models with the linguistic and reasoning priors of pretrained LLMs. We further adapt Hierarchical Supervision Weighting (HSW) to autoregressive models by exponentially weighting losses across recursive steps. HSW reduces gradient variance by at least 50\%, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of stochastic gradients, and accelerates convergence. Across eight challenging benchmarks, R-Qwen consistently outperforms prior recursive reasoning models and substantially larger LLMs while using a comparable number of trainable parameters. Notably, on ARC-AGI dataset, our model achieves a 27.6\% improvement over the baseline, highlighting the effectiveness of recursive refinement for general symbolic reasoning. These results suggest that recursive reasoning mechanisms and pretrained language model priors are complementary approaches for improving symbolic puzzle-solving. Code and models will be released after acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R-Qwen，一种基于预训练Qwen骨干的递归推理框架，通过程序性自我递归和深度监督反复细化候选解，将递归模型的结构化迭代计算与预训练LLM的语言和推理先验相结合，在八个符号推理基准上优于现有递归推理模型和更大规模的LLM。
AI.motivation: LLM在处理Sudoku、迷宫寻路、ARC等硬符号推理任务时表现不佳，因其固定深度的自回归推理限制了系统性搜索、细化和回溯能力。现有递归模型（如HRM、TRM）虽能解决此问题，但通常针对特定任务构建，且无法利用预训练语言先验。
AI.method: 提出R-Qwen递归推理框架：1）基于预训练Qwen骨干，通过程序性自我递归反复细化候选解；2）结合深度监督进行训练；3）将层级监督加权（HSW）适配到自回归模型，在递归步骤间对损失进行指数加权，以降低梯度方差、提升随机梯度信噪比并加速收敛。
AI.result: 在八个挑战性基准上，R-Qwen以相当的参数量一致优于先前递归推理模型和显著更大的LLM。在ARC-AGI数据集上较基线提升27.6%，HSW使梯度方差降低至少50%。
AI.conclusion: 递归推理机制与预训练语言模型先验是互补的，二者结合能显著提升符号谜题求解能力，为通用符号推理提供了有效路径。

title: Why Large Language Models Fail at Tabular Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become the default tool for a remarkable range of tasks, yet they have had conspicuously little success at one of the most common machine learning workloads: predictive analytics over tabular data. This gap is the founding premise of the fast-growing field of tabular foundation models, but the question of why generic LLMs fail has remained open. We study a frontier LLM in its purest inference regime - a single generation pass over a prompt containing the full training and test data, with no tools, no agentic scaffolding, and no fine-tuning - and systematically evaluate five hypotheses for the failure: (a) an inability to handle noisy or non-linearly-separable data; (b) the linearised CSV format obscuring column structure; (c) the tokenisation of numeric values; (d) the number of test points classified per query; and (e) the dimensionality of the input. Controlled experiments falsify (a)-(d). Dimensionality, in contrast, is decisive: sweeping random linear projections of thirty-one benchmark datasets, the LLM is the only method among nine whose accuracy decreases as dimensionality grows, while every classical baseline stays flat or improves. A behavioural comparison against 252 configured classical models finds that in two dimensions the LLM predicts like a local, distance-based method (up to 91.6% grid agreement), but in higher dimensions no classical model - even when augmented with tuned, dimension-dependent noise - reproduces its predictions. We do not claim to have identified the internal mechanism; our results show, more modestly, that the LLM's capability dissolves with dimension in a way no noise-corrupted classical learner mimics - which explains why LLMs, so capable elsewhere, keep losing to fifty-year-old baselines on tables, while leaving the mechanism of the prediction as an open question.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了为什么大型语言模型（LLM）在表格数据预测分析任务上表现不佳。通过控制实验，作者排除了噪声数据、CSV格式、数值分词、测试点数量等假设，发现数据维度是决定性因素：随着维度增加，LLM是唯一精度下降的方法，而所有经典基线保持平稳或提升。进一步行为对比发现，二维时LLM表现得像局部距离方法，但在高维时没有任何经典模型（即使加入噪声）能复现其预测行为。
AI.motivation: LLM已成为许多任务的默认工具，但在表格数据预测分析这一最常见的机器学习场景中表现不佳。虽然表格基础模型领域正在快速发展，但"为什么通用LLM在此任务上失败"的根本原因一直未被解答。理解这一失败机制对于改进LLM在表格任务上的表现至关重要。
AI.method: 在纯推理模式下（单次生成，无工具、无代理脚手架、无微调），对前沿LLM系统性地评估五种失败假设：(a)噪声或非线性可分数据、(b)CSV格式导致列结构模糊、(c)数值分词、(d)每次查询的测试点数量、(e)输入维度。通过控制实验逐一验证，并对31个基准数据集进行随机线性投影扫描，与9种方法对比；同时用252个经典模型配置进行行为对比分析。
AI.result: 控制实验否定了假设(a)-(d)。维度是决定性因素：在31个基准数据集上，LLM是唯一随维度增长精度下降的方法，而所有经典基线保持平稳或提升。行为对比显示，二维时LLM与局部距离方法（如KNN）有高达91.6%的网格一致性，但在高维时没有任何经典模型（即使加入维度相关的调优噪声）能复现LLM的预测行为。
AI.conclusion: LLM在表格预测上的能力随维度增加而瓦解，其方式不同于任何添加噪声的经典学习器所能模拟的。这解释了为什么LLM在其他任务上能力强大，却在表格数据上输给几十年的经典基线。作者明确指出未声称找到内部机制，将预测机制问题留作开放问题。

title: CoEvoKG: Co-Evolving Knowledge Graphs with Self-Evolving Search Agents
summary:
Large language models can improve with reinforcement learning for search agents, yet existing self play agents repeatedly generate tasks while discarding the knowledge gained during successful searches. We introduce CoEvoKG, a framework that turns a
  knowledge graph into both a source of verifiable training tasks and a persistent evidence memory for agent evolution. CoEvoKG jointly trains a task generator and a search agent: the generator creates multihop questions from entity chains sampled
  from the knowledge graph, while the agent learns from rewards for answer correctness and search trajectories whose entity paths are supported by graph evidence. When a search succeeds, CoEvoKG verifies and deduplicates the retrieved evidence, then
  writes it back to the corresponding graph nodes and edges. Future rounds reuse this enriched graph for task generation and reward computation, closing the loop between model self evolution and knowledge accumulation. Experiments on six QA benchmarks
  (NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and Bamboogle) with three backbone models show that CoEvoKG improves macro average accuracy over the corresponding base models by +11.2, +10.1, and +11.6 points on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct,
  Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively. Under matched training budgets, CoEvoKG further improves over competitive self play baselines and RL baselines for search agents by +2.6 to +3.7 macro average points across the three
  backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/lazzy1225/CoEvoKG.

AI.tldr: CoEvoKG是一个将知识图谱同时用作可验证训练任务来源和持久化证据记忆的框架，通过联合训练任务生成器与搜索智能体，将成功搜索获得的证据写回知识图谱，形成模型自我进化与知识积累的闭环。在六个QA基准和三个骨干模型上，相比基线模型分别提升了+11.2、+10.1和+11.6的宏平均准确率，并优于竞争性的自对弈和强化学习基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型可通过强化学习提升搜索智能体性能，但现有的自对弈智能体在反复生成任务时，会丢弃成功搜索过程中获得的知识，导致知识无法积累和复用，限制了智能体的持续进化能力。
AI.method: CoEvoKG将知识图谱作为双重角色：(1)作为可验证训练任务的来源，通过从知识图谱采样实体链生成多跳问题；(2)作为持久化的证据记忆。框架联合训练任务生成器和搜索智能体，智能体从答案正确性奖励和图谱证据支持的搜索轨迹中学习。当搜索成功时，系统验证并去重检索到的证据，将其写回对应的图节点和边，未来轮次复用丰富后的图谱进行任务生成和奖励计算，形成闭环。
AI.result: 在六个QA基准（NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、Bamboogle）上，使用三个骨干模型（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct），CoEvoKG相比对应基础模型分别提升宏平均准确率+11.2、+10.1、+11.6点。在匹配训练预算下，相比竞争性的自对弈基线和RL基线，跨三个骨干模型额外提升+2.6至+3.7个宏平均点。
AI.conclusion: CoEvoKG通过将知识图谱作为训练任务来源和持久化证据记忆的桥梁，有效解决了自对弈搜索智能体中知识丢弃的问题，实现了模型自我进化与知识积累相互促进的良性循环，在多个QA基准上验证了其有效性。

title: STAR-VLM: Spatiotemporal Grounding Vision-Language Models for Motion and Velocity Estimation via Automotive Radar Supervision
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are emerging as a key component of embodied intelligence, with growing applications in auto-labeling and end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing approaches for improving spatiotemporal reasoning in VLMs often rely on complex preprocessing pipelines, expensive human annotations, or synthetic data, which limit scalability and introduce potential sim-to-real gaps. Moreover, although these methods have improved spatiotemporal understanding, they still lack strong metric reasoning capabilities for dynamic scenes, such as estimating object motion in real-world units. Prior work has explored LiDAR-based metric depth supervision to enhance spatial perception, but it does not directly address temporal reasoning. We introduce STAR-VLM, an automotive radar-supervised framework that enhances spatiotemporal VLMs with motion reasoning and metric velocity estimation for autonomous driving. Automotive radar is a low-cost and widely deployed sensor that provides complementary spatiotemporal supervision through range and Doppler measurements. By leveraging these measurements as label-free ground truth during training, STAR-VLM improves the metric spatiotemporal reasoning ability of VLMs. Through experiments on driving scenarios, we show that STAR-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both motion classification and metric velocity estimation, outperforming even task-specific methods designed for each task. These results highlight automotive radar as a scalable and cost-effective source of supervision for building metric-aware spatiotemporal VLMs for real-world autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAR-VLM，一种利用汽车雷达作为无标签监督信号来增强视觉语言模型（VLM）时空推理能力的框架，通过雷达的距离和Doppler测量提供度量级速度估计和运动分类，在自动驾驶场景中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有提升VLM时空推理的方法依赖复杂预处理、昂贵人工标注或合成数据，存在扩展性差和仿真到现实的差距问题。此外，已有方法虽改善了时空理解，但缺乏对动态场景的度量级推理能力（如以真实世界单位估计物体运动）。LiDAR度量深度监督只解决空间感知，未直接解决时间推理问题。
AI.method: STAR-VLM利用汽车雷达（低成本、广泛部署的传感器）作为训练监督信号。雷达通过距离和Doppler测量提供互补的时空监督，作为无标签的地面真值，无需人工标注即可提升VLM的度量级时空推理能力。框架同时支持运动分类和度量级速度估计两个任务。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶场景实验中，STAR-VLM在运动分类和度量速度估计两个任务上均达到最先进性能，甚至超越了每个任务专门设计的模型。
AI.conclusion: 汽车雷达是可扩展且经济高效的监督信号来源，能够构建具备度量感知能力的时空VLM，适用于真实世界的自动驾驶应用。

title: Foundations of Reinforcement Learning and Control:Connections and New Perspectives
summary: Reinforcement learning and control theory are two adjacent scientific fields that focus on optimizing the controller of unknown dynamical systems using feedback. While both fields have common roots in dynamic programming, they have evolved with distinct methodologies, goals, and cultures. Despite decades of mutual influence, a significant gap persists between the two communities. This tutorial introduces adaptive control, actor-critic reinforcement algorithms, and a new way to combine these two paradigms for data-driven decision making on a classical locomotion control problem. Our aim is to provide a foundation for understanding the core differences between the two approaches and insights to help experts in each field better understand and engage with the tools and approaches of the other.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇教程，介绍了强化学习与控制理论两个相邻领域在动态系统控制器优化上的异同，并展示了一种将自适应控制与actor-critic强化学习算法相结合的新方法，应用于经典的运动控制问题。
AI.motivation: 强化学习与控制理论虽然同源于动态规划，但在方法论、目标和研究文化上存在显著差异，两个社区之间长期存在沟通鸿沟。作者希望通过这篇教程帮助两个领域的专家互相理解、取长补短。
AI.method: 本文采用教程形式，系统地介绍自适应控制、actor-critic强化学习算法，并提出一种将这两种范式结合起来的新方法，在经典运动控制问题（如locomotion）上验证数据驱动的决策制定。
AI.result: 提供了一种新的融合两种范式的途径，并在经典运动控制问题（locomotion control）上展示了结合后的效果，为跨领域的研究提供了实践基础和指导。
AI.conclusion: 尽管强化学习与控制理论存在文化和方法上的差异，但通过教程和实际案例的融合展示，两个领域可以更好地相互理解与协作，从而推动数据驱动决策制定的发展。

title: Enhancing Visual Perception in Foggy Conditions via Multiclass Fog Density Modeling
summary: Autonomous driving (AD) systems have advanced rapidly over the past decade; however, robust perception under adverse weather conditions remains a major challenge, particularly in dense fog. In this work, we investigate fog-aware perception using synthetically generated fog data derived from the Waymo dataset. To support fog simulation, depth images are generated using an iterative learning approach. We consider five fog-density levels: clear, light fog, moderate fog, heavy fog, and very heavy fog. Instead of training a single unified model across all conditions, we train separate perception models for each fog-density level. Experimental results show that density-specific training improves performance in severe fog conditions. In particular, for the very heavy fog class, recall improves from 0.076 to 0.232, corresponding to an absolute gain of 15.6 percentage points. These findings suggest that deploying multiple specialized models, rather than a single general-purpose model, can improve perception robustness for autonomous vehicles under challenging visibility conditions. Future work will extend this strategy to additional sensing modalities, including LiDAR and radar, and evaluate generalization across diverse weather scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自动驾驶在浓雾条件下的感知鲁棒性问题。基于Waymo数据集生成五级密度的合成雾数据（清晰、轻雾、中雾、重雾、极重雾），通过迭代学习方法生成深度图，并针对每个雾密度级别分别训练专用感知模型。实验表明，密度专用训练在重度雾条件下显著提升性能：极重雾类别的召回率从0.076提升至0.232，绝对值增加15.6个百分点。研究建议部署多个专用模型而非单一通用模型可提升恶劣能见度下的感知鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统在恶劣天气（特别是浓雾）下的感知鲁棒性仍是重大挑战，传统上训练单一通用模型难以应对不同雾密度条件下的视觉退化问题。
AI.method: 1）使用Waymo数据集通过迭代学习方法合成雾数据并生成深度图像；2）定义五级雾密度（清晰、轻雾、中雾、重雾、极重雾）；3）为每个雾密度级别分别训练独立的感知模型，而非训练一个统一模型。
AI.result: 密度专用训练在严重雾条件下显著提升了感知性能。极重雾级别的召回率从0.076提升至0.232，绝对增益达15.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 部署多个针对特定雾密度优化的专用模型比单一通用模型更能提升自动驾驶在挑战性可见度条件下的感知鲁棒性。未来将扩展到LiDAR和雷达等多模态感知，并评估在多样化天气场景下的泛化能力。

title: Aggregate-then-Calibrate for Human-centered Assessment with Theoretical Guarantees
summary: Human-centered assessment tasks, which are essential for systematic decision-making, rely heavily on human judgment and typically lack verifiable ground truth. Existing approaches face a dilemma: methods using only human judgments suffer from heterogeneous expertise and inconsistent rating scales, while methods using only model-generated scores must learn from imperfect proxies or incomplete features. We propose Aggregate-then-Calibrate (AtC), a two-stage framework that combines these complementary sources. Stage-1 aggregates heterogeneous comparative judgments into a consensus ranking using a rank-aggregation model that accounts for annotator reliability. Stage-2 calibrates any predictive model's scores by an isotonic projection onto the order, enforcing ordinal consistency while preserving as much of the model's quantitative information as possible. Theoretically, we show: (1) modeling annotator heterogeneity yields strictly more efficient consensus estimation than homogeneity; (2) isotonic calibration enjoys risk bounds even when the consensus ranking is misspecified; and (3) AtC asymptotically outperforms model-only assessment. Across semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, AtC consistently improves accuracy and robustness over human-only or model-only assessments. Our results bridge judgment aggregation with model-free calibration, providing a principled recipe for human-centered assessment when ground truth is costly, scarce, or unverifiable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Aggregate-then-Calibrate (AtC)两阶段框架，用于人类中心的评估任务。第一阶段通过考虑标注者可靠性的排名聚合模型，将异质的比较判断聚合为共识排名；第二阶段通过等距投影将预测模型的分数校准到该序上，实现序一致性与定量信息的平衡。理论上证明了标注者异质性建模、等距校准的风险界及优于纯模型评估的性质，实验验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 人类中心评估任务缺乏可验证的ground truth，现有方法陷入两难困境：纯人类判断存在专业知识异质性和评分标准不一致问题，纯模型评分则需从不完美的代理或残缺特征中学习。两种互补信息源需要被有效结合以提升评估质量。
AI.method: AtC两阶段框架：(1) 阶段一使用考虑标注者可靠性的排名聚合模型，将异质比较判断聚合为共识排序；(2) 阶段二通过等距投影（isotonic projection）将任意预测模型的分数校准到该排序上，保持序一致性同时最大程度保留模型的定量信息。
AI.result: 理论结果：(1) 建模标注者异质性比同质性假设获得更严格的共识估计效率；(2) 等距校准在共识排序错误设定时仍具有风险界；(3) AtC在渐进意义下优于纯模型评估。在半合成和真实数据集上，AtC一致地优于纯人类或纯模型评估的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AtC框架桥梁式地连接了判断聚合与无模型校准，为ground truth昂贵、稀缺或不可验证的人类中心评估任务提供了有原则的解决方案，兼具理论保证和实证有效性。

title: ProWorld: Progress-Aware Hyperbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Visual Goal Reaching
summary: JEPA-style visual world models offer an effective paradigm for visual goal planning by predicting future latent representations. Existing methods typically learn local transition consistency through next-step representation prediction. However, in long-horizon tasks, accurate local prediction alone need not ensure sustained progress toward the goal. First, multi-step rollouts can remain locally plausible while drifting away from goal-relevant trajectories. Second, locally similar future states can correspond to substantially different long-term progress, making them difficult to distinguish in a latent space optimized mainly for local consistency. To address these challenges, we introduce goal-conditioned progress order, a relative ordering of states according to how they advance toward a given goal. This order exhibits an asymmetric, coarse-to-fine structure: early states retain broader future possibilities, while later states concentrate on more specific goal-relevant regions. Such a structure is well suited to hyperbolic geometry. Motivated by this observation, we propose ProWorld, a progress-aware hyperbolic visual world model. ProWorld leverages goal-conditioned progress order to organize visual latent-space dynamics, maintains directional progress within trajectories via hyperbolic entailment learning, and mitigates progress ambiguity among locally similar future states via hyperbolic future discrimination. Furthermore, we design a progress-aware planning objective that scores candidate rollouts by jointly considering proximity to the goal and sustained progress across intermediate states. Experiments on four visual goal-reaching tasks demonstrate that ProWorld achieves an average absolute success-rate gain of 9.67 over LeWM. The code will be released after the paper is accepted.

AI.tldr: ProWorld提出了一种基于双曲几何的进度感知视觉世界模型，通过目标条件进度排序来组织潜在空间动力学，解决长时程视觉目标规划中局部预测良好但全局漂移的问题，在四个视觉目标到达任务上平均绝对成功率比LeWM提升9.67。
AI.motivation: 现有的JEPA风格视觉世界模型通常只学习局部转移一致性（即下一步表示预测），但在长时程任务中存在两个关键问题：1）多步rollout可能局部合理却偏离目标相关轨迹（全局漂移问题）；2）局部相似未来状态可能对应截然不同的长期进度，在主要优化局部一致性的潜在空间中难以区分。这些挑战促使需要引入考虑目标进度的建模方式。
AI.method: 1）提出目标条件进度排序（goal-conditioned progress order），即根据状态推进目标的程度对状态进行相对排序，该排序具有不对称的从粗到细结构（早期状态保留更宽泛的未来可能性，后期状态聚焦于更具体的目标相关区域），该结构天然适配双曲几何。2）提出ProWorld进度感知双曲视觉世界模型，包含三个核心组件：利用目标条件进度排序组织视觉潜在空间动力学；通过双曲蕴含学习（hyperbolic entailment learning）保持轨迹内的方向性进度；通过双曲未来判别（hyperbolic future discrimination）缓解局部相似未来状态间的进度模糊性。3）设计进度感知规划目标，联合考虑候选rollout到目标的接近度和中间状态的持续进度来评分。
AI.result: 在四个视觉目标到达任务上，ProWorld相比LeWM取得了平均9.67的绝对成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: ProWorld通过将目标条件进度排序与双曲几何相结合，有效解决了长时程视觉目标规划中局部一致性不足以保证全局进度的问题，验证了双曲空间在组织进度感知动力学方面的有效性。

title: D^2-4DGS: Dual-Depth Guided Sparse-Camera 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting has emerged as an efficient representation for dynamic novel view synthesis through explicit scene modeling and real-time rendering. However, existing methods typically require dense multi-view videos for sufficient geometric constraints, making capture expensive and limiting sparse-camera deployment. Reducing input views lowers acquisition cost but weakens geometry supervision, often causing missing structures and floating Gaussians. Depth priors provide geometric cues, yet no single source offers both dense coverage and reliable geometry. Monocular depth provides dense structure but is scale-ambiguous and locally biased, whereas multi-view geometric depth provides incomplete anchors consistent with the reconstruction coordinate system. To exploit their complementarity, we propose D$^2$-4DGS, a sparse-camera dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting framework guided by dual-source depth priors. We align monocular estimates with valid multi-view geometric depths and verify their consistency to identify reliable geometric anchors. These verified anchors support consistency-aware pruning and depth supervision, while verified geometric depths and aligned mono-only estimates provide candidate geometry for densification in under-reconstructed regions. Finally, RGB-D joint optimization improves appearance fidelity and geometric consistency under sparse-view supervision. Across all nine dataset--view settings, D$^2$-4DGS achieves the highest PSNR, improving by 1.33 dB on average over the best competing method in each setting.

AI.tldr: D²-4DGS是一个面向稀疏相机动态4D高斯泼溅的框架，通过融合单目深度与多视角几何深度作为双源深度先验，解决稀疏输入下几何监督不足的问题，并在九个数据集-视图设置下均取得最优PSNR，平均提升1.33 dB。
AI.motivation: 现有动态4D高斯泼溅方法通常需要密集多视角视频提供足够的几何约束，采集成本高昂且限制了稀疏相机部署。减少输入视图会削弱几何监督，导致结构缺失和漂浮高斯问题。虽然深度先验能提供几何线索，但单一来源无法同时兼顾密集覆盖和可靠几何：单目深度密集但尺度模糊、存在局部偏差；多视角几何深度虽与重建坐标系一致但覆盖不完整。
AI.method: 提出D²-4DGS框架，核心思路是利用双源深度先验的互补性：(1) 将单目深度估计与有效的多视角几何深度对齐，并通过一致性验证识别可靠几何锚点；(2) 利用验证后的锚点进行一致性感知剪枝和深度监督；(3) 结合验证的几何深度与对齐后的单目估计为欠重建区域提供致密化候选几何；(4) 采用RGB-D联合优化提升稀疏视图监督下的外观保真度和几何一致性。
AI.result: 在全部九个数据集-视图组合设置中，D²-4DGS均取得最高PSNR，相比各设置下最优的对比方法平均提升1.33 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过深度融合双源深度先验（单目深度与多视角几何深度），有效缓解了稀疏相机设置下动态高斯泼溅的几何不完整问题，为低成本的稀疏相机动态场景重建提供了可行方案。

title: RoMeRL: Balancing Feedback Coverage and the Memory-Reward Trap in Self-Evolving Agent Memory via Reduced-Order Utility States
summary: Learning-based memory systems for self-evolving LLM agents face two tightly coupled challenges. First, trajectory-indexed utilities grow with the interaction history, thereby dispersing limited feedback over an ever-expanding state space. Second, because trajectory-level rewards are jointly assigned to co-retrieved memories, irrelevant experiences may receive misleading utility updates and consequently enter the memory-reward trap. To address these challenges, we introduce Reduced-Order Memory Reinforcement Learning (RoMeRL), which represents the growing trajectory-indexed utility space using a fixed-dimensional per-task memory state factorized by outcome polarity and memory dynamics. RoMeRL incorporates new experiences through a fixed set of semantic coordinates whose contents are updated or replaced over time, thereby concentrating feedback over a bounded utility support. Theoretically, we show that this reduced-order parameterization increases the average feedback received by each utility coordinate and characterize the steady-state occupancy of erroneous coordinates under a generic coordinate-transition model. Empirically, across ALFWorld and LifelongAgentBench, RoMeRL improves task performance, reduces the Cold-Q ratio by 80.0%, increases feedback density by approximately 6.0 times, reduces the maintained memory size by 84.4%, and cuts LLM calls by 21.1%. These results show that reduced-order utility states support efficient self-evolving agent memory while limiting persistent reward contamination. Code is available at: https://github.com/YOUNG-fnxm/RoMeRL

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoMeRL（降阶记忆强化学习）方法，通过将不断增长的轨迹索引效用空间降维为基于任务、结果极性和记忆动态的固定维度状态，解决自进化LLM智能体记忆系统中的反馈分散和记忆奖励陷阱两大挑战，在ALFWorld和LifelongAgentBench上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 学习型记忆系统面临两个紧密耦合的挑战：1）轨迹索引效用随交互历史增长而膨胀，导致有限反馈被分散到不断扩大的状态空间中；2）轨迹级奖励被联合分配给共同检索的记忆，无关经验可能收到误导性的效用更新，从而陷入记忆奖励陷阱。
AI.method: RoMeRL通过将增长的轨迹索引效用空间表示为固定维度的每任务记忆状态，该状态由结果极性和记忆动态进行因子分解。新经验通过一组固定语义坐标融入，坐标内容随时间更新或替换，从而将反馈集中在有限的效用支持上。理论上证明了降阶参数化增加了每个效用坐标接收的平均反馈量，并在通用坐标转移模型下刻画了错误坐标的稳态占用率。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和LifelongAgentBench基准上，RoMeRL提升了任务性能，将Cold-Q比率降低80.0%，反馈密度提高约6.0倍，维护的记忆大小减少84.4%，LLM调用次数减少21.1%。
AI.conclusion: 降阶效用状态支持高效的自进化智能体记忆，同时限制了持续性的奖励污染，为LLM智能体的记忆系统设计提供了一种有效方案。

title: A Contractualist Argumentation Framework for Moral Decision-Making
comment: 9 pages; to appear in the proceedings of the Fourth International Workshop on Value Engineering in AI (VALE 2026)
summary: Autonomous agents operating in shared environments must make decisions that affect multiple individuals with potentially conflicting interests. We propose a formal framework for moral decision-making grounded in Scanlon's contractualism, an ethical theory that evaluates the permissibility of actions in terms of principles that no one could reasonably reject. To operationalise contractualist reasoning, we use ASPIC+, a structured argumentation framework, extended with value-based filtering to model how each agent's values determine which reasons are morally relevant in the first place. The result is a Contractualist Argumentation Framework in which agents' reasons are formally represented, compared, and evaluated through argumentation semantics. We illustrate the approach through a worked example in a domestic setting and discuss its relation to existing value-based argumentation approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Scanlon契约主义的道德决策形式化框架，利用ASPIC+结构化论证框架结合基于价值的过滤机制，构建了"契约主义论证框架"，用于在共享环境中对多个个体可能存在冲突利益的自主代理进行道德推理。
AI.motivation: 自主代理在共享环境中做出的决策会影响多个可能具有冲突利益的个体，因此需要一种形式化的道德决策框架来处理这种多主体、多利益冲突的情境。
AI.method: 基于Scanlon的契约主义伦理理论，使用ASPIC+结构化论证框架，并扩展了基于价值的过滤机制来建模每个代理的价值观如何决定哪些理由在道德上是相关的，最终形成契约主义论证框架（Contractualist Argumentation Framework）。
AI.result: 通过一个家庭场景的具体示例展示了该框架的运作方式，并讨论了其与现有基于价值论证方法的关系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在形式上表示、比较和评估代理的理由，通过论证语义进行道德决策推理，为自主代理的道德决策提供了一种新的形式化途径。

title: When Measurement Conventions Masquerade as Calibration Gains in Cardiac Digital Twins
comment: Accepted at the 2nd International Workshop on Digital Twin for Healthcare (DT4H 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. 10 pages, 2 figures
summary: Cardiac digital twins convert clinical images into physiological measurements through observation operators, yet calibration studies often assume a fixed reference convention. Across four shared-backbone echocardiographic EF front-ends, phase conditioning appears to remove CAMUS baseline bias. Matched-reference analysis rejects this gain: singleplane ground-truth EF error is statistically indistinguishable across models, while single-plane ground-truth EF exceeds CAMUS biplane clinical EF by +6.30 points, explaining nearly all baseline bias. A prespecified EchoNet-Dynamic replication, with released data and our extractor aligned to the apical four-chamber plane, removes baseline overestimation and reverses the CAMUS ranking. We also quantify haemodynamic effects, conformal residual-width budgets, and EF-stratum changes, yielding a Convention-Aware EF Audit protocol that separates genuine observation operator calibration from measurement artefacts. GitHub: EjectionFraction-Bias-in-Cardiac-Digital-Twin.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出"约定感知EF审计协议"(Convention-Aware EF Audit Protocol)，通过匹配参考系分析揭示心脏数字孪生中超声心动图射血分数(EF)的测量偏差主要源于参考约定差异（单平面与双平面）而非真实算法性能差异，并提供可复现的EchoNet-Dynamic复制实验来分离真实校准与测量伪影。
AI.motivation: 心脏数字孪生通过观察算子将临床图像转换为生理测量值，但现有校准研究常假设固定参考约定，忽略了不同EF测量参考（如单平面vs双平面、超声心动图所在切面）可能引入的系统性偏差，导致模型评估和排名失真。
AI.method: 1) 在四个共享骨干的超声EF前端上应用相位条件化；2) 进行匹配参考分析，对比单平面真实EF与CAMUS双平面临床EF；3) 预注册的EchoNet-Dynamic复制实验，将提取器对齐至心尖四腔平面；4) 量化血流动力学效应、共形残差宽度预算和EF分层变化，制定约定感知EF审计协议。
AI.result: 相位条件化看似消除了CAMUS基线偏差，但匹配参考分析证明这种增益是虚假的：各模型单平面真实EF错误在统计上无显著差异；单平面真实EF比CAMUS双平面临床EF平均高+6.30个百分点，解释了几乎全部基线偏差。EchoNet-Dynamic复制消除了基线过高估计并逆转了CAMUS排名。
AI.conclusion: EF测量中的基线偏差主要源于参考约定差异而非算法本身的校准改进。提出的约定感知EF审计协议能够区分真正的观察算子校准与测量伪影，为心脏数字孪生的EF评估提供了更严谨的方法论框架。

title: Analytic Planning under Uncertainty with Moment Closure
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026), PMLR
summary: Effective model-based reinforcement learning in stochastic environments requires planning that accounts for predictive uncertainty. Propagating full state distributions analytically offers a principled way to do this, but has traditionally required restrictive policy or reward structures to remain tractable. Consequently, modern deep reinforcement learning has largely retreated to either stochastic sampling, which introduces significant target variance, or deterministic point estimates that ignore predictive covariance entirely. We investigate whether distribution-aware planning is possible without these constraints. Using a quadratic action-value parameterization, we first reduce the Bellman backup to an expectation over the state-value function alone; the key idea is then a compatibility principle between the predictive transition distribution and the value function class, under which this expectation is analytic in the distribution's moments. We instantiate this principle with a Gaussian transition model paired with a radial-basis value function, yielding a closed-form backup that propagates both predictive mean and covariance. Empirically, our approach reduces target variance and yields well-calibrated predictive uncertainty under stochastic observations in continuous control, providing a principled framework for planning with learned distribution models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在随机环境中进行分布感知规划的模型强化学习方法。通过二次动作值参数化将Bellman备份简化为状态值函数的期望，并提出"兼容性原则"使该期望在预测分布矩下可解析计算。具体实现采用高斯转移模型配合径向基值函数，实现封闭形式的备份，同时传播预测均值和协方差，在连续控制任务中降低目标方差并实现校准良好的预测不确定性。
AI.motivation: 在随机环境中，基于模型的强化学习规划需要考虑预测不确定性。传统的全分布解析传播方法受限于严格的结构假设（如策略或奖励结构），而现代深度强化学习要么依赖随机采样（引入高目标方差），要么使用确定性点估计（完全忽略预测协方差）。因此需要一个无需这些约束的分布感知规划框架。
AI.method: 1) 使用二次动作值参数化，将Bellman备份化简为仅对状态值函数的期望；2) 提出预测转移分布与值函数类别之间的"兼容性原则"，使该期望在分布矩上解析可计算；3) 具体实例化：Gaussian转移模型 + 径向基值函数，得到封闭形式的备份，同时传播预测均值和协方差。
AI.result: 在连续控制的随机观测环境中，该方法降低了目标方差（相对于随机采样），并产生校准良好的预测不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为使用学习得到的分布模型进行规划提供了一个原则性的框架，证明了无需严格的结构约束即可实现分布感知规划。

title: Long-Horizon Autonomous Architecture Research with a Language-Model Agent: A Behavioural Case Study
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: We study what happens when a single general-purpose large language model acts as the sole researcher on a long-horizon neural architecture design problem. The agent receives a scientific question, an initial hypothesis and motivation, a compute budget, and research affordances (source and experiment management, experiment tracking, literature access, and persistent memory), then autonomously proposes, implements, evaluates, and records experiments over an extended period. The study comprises three phases, separated by human-declared transitions, that progressively expand the agent's tool surface or problem scale. Across approximately 100 sequential experiments, the agent improves a non-standard Vision Transformer from a weak baseline to a stronger, efficient model on small benchmarks and a usable but sub-SOTA model on ImageNet-1K, while producing a dense behavioural trace. We report four findings.(i)Productivity exhibits a clear phase structure: rapid early gains, a multi-dozen-hypothesis saturation wall, and recovery, with recovery triggered by expanding the action surface rather than changing the underlying model.(ii)A single early hypothesis contributes more to accuracy gain, with later improvements long-tailed.(iii)The preference for greedy, incremental hypotheses is largely workflow-induced: a commit-or-discard evaluation rule is isomorphic to greedy hill-climbing; the remainder reflects risk aversion after bold failures and anchoring on familiar literature. (iv)The agent independently rediscovers established results and, in the unfamiliar regime of pure channel attention, overturns a standard design choice. We conclude that workflow design was at least as influential as agent capability in this study and propose diversified search, budgeted moonshot hypotheses, explicit forks, and regime-aware re-validation as testable directions for future autonomous research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单个通用大语言模型作为唯一研究者，在长时间跨度的神经架构设计问题上的自主研究行为。在约100个顺序实验中，代理将非标准Vision Transformer从弱基线提升到更强模型，并在ImageNet-1K上达到可用但非SOTA的水平。研究揭示四个发现：生产率具有明显的阶段结构（快速早期收益、饱和墙、恢复）；单一早期假设贡献最大；贪婪增量假设偏好主要源于工作流设计；代理能独立重新发现已有结果并在新领域推翻标准设计选择。结论认为工作流设计与代理能力同等重要。
AI.motivation: 当前AI研究者关注单个大语言模型能否在长时间跨度内自主进行科学研究，但缺乏对其长期行为模式、探索策略局限性以及工作流设计影响的系统理解。该论文旨在通过研究一个代理在神经架构设计问题上的长期自主行为，揭示自主研究的动力学特征和工作流设计的关键作用。
AI.method: 研究设计为三阶段实验，包含约100个顺序实验。代理配备科学问题、初始假设与动机、计算预算以及研究工具（源码与实验管理、实验跟踪、文献访问、持久记忆）。三阶段由人工声明转换分隔，逐步扩展代理的工具面或问题规模。代理自主提出、实现、评估并记录实验，产生密集的行为轨迹供分析。
AI.result: 四个核心发现：（i）生产率呈现阶段结构：快速早期收益、多打十种假设的饱和墙、以及通过扩展行动面而非改变底层模型触发的恢复；（ii）单个早期假设对精度提升贡献最大，后期改进呈长尾分布；（iii）代理偏好贪婪增量假设主要是工作流导致（提交或丢弃评估规则同构于贪婪爬山），剩余部分反映风险规避和对熟悉文献的锚定；（iv）代理独立重新发现已有结果，并在纯通道注意力的陌生领域推翻了标准设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 工作流设计在该研究中的影响力至少与代理能力相当。论文提出多样化搜索、预算化"登月"假设、显式分叉以及机制感知的重新验证作为未来自主研究的可测试方向，为改进自主人工智能研究系统的设计提供了实证基础。

title: Linear Multi-Timescale Retention as a Memory-Efficient Vision-Language Bridge
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face a critical computational bottleneck when processing high-resolution imagery due to the $O(N^2)$ memory complexity of Softmax Multi-Head Attention (MHA). While substituting MHA with independent Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) achieves $O(N)$ scaling, it strips the architecture of spatial sequence routing, severely degrading global scene understanding and object permanence. In this paper, we propose the Linear Multi-Timescale Retention (LIA-MTR) module, a memory-efficient cross-modal bridge. By integrating an ELU-based positive feature mapping with adaptive write-gating and log-linearly distributed recurrent decays, LIA-MTR mathematically compresses continuous visual sequences into bounded memory states. Theoretical analysis proves the architecture operates with strict $O(N)$ sequence-interaction complexity. Empirically, synthetic retrieval evaluations demonstrate that LIA-MTR flawlessly routes context across 16,000 tokens, eliminating the "Lost in the Middle" degradation typical of naive linear attention. Hardware benchmarking reveals infinite-context scaling capabilities, natively processing 262,144 visual patches within an 11.2 GB VRAM footprint, whereas standard MHA suffers out-of-memory failure at 16,384 patches. Furthermore, following instruction tuning on 665K conversational samples, LIA-MTR significantly outperforms an industry-standard MLP baseline on the MME benchmark (71.00% vs. 68.11%), driven by a 10% absolute improvement in object permanence and superior global semantic extraction. This work establishes a mathematically rigorous, computationally flat foundation for infinite-context Vision-Language integration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出线性多时间尺度保留模块（LIA-MTR），通过ELU特征映射、自适应写门控和对数线性分布的循环衰减，将视觉序列压缩为有界记忆状态，实现O(N)复杂度的跨模态桥梁，支持无限上下文视觉-语言整合。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）处理高分辨率图像时，Softmax多头注意力（MHA）的O(N²)内存复杂度成为关键计算瓶颈。虽然用独立MLP替代MHA可实现O(N)扩展，但会失去空间序列路由能力，严重损害全局场景理解和物体永存性。
AI.method: 提出LIA-MTR模块：集成ELU正向特征映射、自适应写门控和对数线性分布的循环衰减，通过数学上压缩连续的视觉序列为有界记忆状态，实现严格的O(N)序列交互复杂度。该模块作为内存高效的跨模态桥梁替代MHA。
AI.result: 合成检索实验证明LIA-MTR可在16,000个标记间完美路由上下文，消除"中间丢失"退化；硬件基准测试显示可原生处理262,144个视觉补丁（仅需11.2GB显存），而标准MHA在16,384个补丁时即内存溢出；经过665K对话样本的指令微调后，LIA-MTR在MME基准上以71.00%显著超过MLP基线（68.11%），物体永存性绝对提升10%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为无限上下文的视觉-语言整合奠定了数学严谨、计算平坦的基础，证明了线性复杂度架构可以在不牺牲全局场景理解的前提下实现远超MHA的上下文扩展能力。

title: Uncertainty Is Not Enough: Value-of-Information Routing for Mixtures of LoRA Experts
summary: Mixtures of low-rank adaptation experts increase parameter-efficient capacity by routing each input through a subset of adapters. Recent dynamic routers activate more experts when the router or prediction is uncertain. This rule silently equates uncertainty with useful additional computation: an uncertain example may contain complementary, unqueried expert evidence, but it may instead remain ambiguous after every expert agrees. We formulate routing as certified value-of-information allocation. VI-MoLE learns the counterfactual risk remaining after each expert prefix, converts these predictions into simultaneous upper-risk certificates on held-out calibration data, and spends a global adapter budget on the token--layer action with the largest certified marginal risk reduction per unit cost. A terminal certificate then decides whether to answer or abstain. Unlike an uncertainty gate, this procedure distinguishes present ambiguity from recoverable and residual risk. We prove simultaneous certificate validity, optimal greedy allocation under diminishing certified gains, and allocation regret under value-estimation error. The evaluation protocol tests matched-compute accuracy, certificate coverage, risk--coverage, distribution shift, and tail latency against fixed and dynamic MoE-LoRA routers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VI-MoLE，将混合低秩适配器专家（MoE-LoRA）的路由问题形式化为"认证信息价值分配"（certified value-of-information allocation）。该方法学习每个专家前缀后的反事实风险，将其转化为校准数据上的同时上界风险认证，并在全局适配器预算下，将资源分配给每单位成本下认证边际风险降低最大的token-层动作。终端的认证决定是回答还是弃权，从而区分"当前的模糊性"与"可恢复风险"和"残余风险"。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态路由方法在路由器或预测不确定时激活更多专家，但这种做法隐含地将"不确定性"等同于"有用的额外计算"。然而，一个不确定的例子可能包含互补的专家证据，也可能在所有专家都同意后仍然是模糊的。因此需要一种更严谨的方法来区分不确定性是否真正值得投入额外计算资源。
AI.method: 1. 将路由形式化为认证信息价值分配问题；2. 学习每个专家前缀后的反事实风险（counterfactual risk）；3. 将风险预测转化为校准集上的同时上界风险认证（simultaneous upper-risk certificates）；4. 在全局适配器预算约束下，贪心地选择每单位成本认证边际风险降低最大的token-层动作；5. 终端认证决定是回答还是弃权（abstain）。同时证明了同时认证有效性、认证收益递减下贪心分配的最优性，以及值估计误差下的分配遗憾界。
AI.result: 评估协议测试了匹配计算量下的准确性、认证覆盖率、风险-覆盖率权衡、分布偏移和尾部延迟，并与固定和动态的MoE-LoRA路由方法进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 与单纯的不确定性门控不同，VI-MoLE能够区分三种不同的风险类型：当前的模糊性、可通过更多计算恢复的风险、以及即使增加计算也无法消除的残余风险，从而更合理地分配计算预算并支持可靠的弃权决策。

title: Evolving in the Agent Jungle via History-Informed Opponent Awareness
summary: Learning to adapt strategies through interaction is a key step toward more general and autonomous LLM agents. Existing approaches typically achieve behavioral adaptation by revising skill libraries. However, in multi-agent environments, opponents may simultaneously update their strategies, causing the environment itself to evolve continuously. Applying skill-revision methods designed for static environments in such settings therefore amounts to updating against an obsolete reference. To address this challenge, we introduce OASE (Opponent-Aware Selective Evolution), which identifies and adopts genuinely beneficial skill revisions in dynamic multi-agent environments. Specifically, OASE conducts paired comparisons between a candidate skill and the incumbent under identical conditions anchored by historical snapshots of opponent strategies, and adopts the candidate only when its estimated payoff gain exceeds an acceptance threshold. We evaluate OASE in two decision-making scenarios: first-price auctions and private-cost Cournot competition. Experimental results show that, compared with a Reflexion-style baseline, OASE achieves a lower final equilibrium distance in both environments while accepting substantially fewer skill revisions, thereby suppressing strategy changes that lack sufficient payoff support. OASE therefore replaces blind updating with evidence-anchored selection, allowing agents to adapt stably and efficiently even as opponents continuously evolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OASE（对手感知选择进化）方法，解决多智能体动态环境中技能库更新的问题。OASE通过将候选技能与现有技能在对手策略历史快照锚定的相同条件下进行配对比较，仅当收益增益超过接受阈值时才采纳候选技能。在首价拍卖和私人成本古诺竞争中，OASE比Reflexion风格基线达到更低的最终均衡距离，同时接受更少的技能修订，实现稳定高效的策略适应。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过修订技能库实现行为适应，但在多智能体环境中对手会同时更新策略，导致环境本身持续演化。直接应用为静态环境设计的技能修订方法，本质上是针对过时的参照进行更新，无法有效应对动态对手环境。
AI.method: OASE方法的核心是：（1）将候选技能与现有技能（incumbent）进行配对比较；（2）比较在由对手策略历史快照锚定的相同条件下进行；（3）仅当候选技能的估计收益增益超过接受阈值时才采纳该技能。这种基于证据锚定的选择机制，取代了盲目的技能更新。
AI.result: 在首价拍卖和私人成本古诺竞争两个决策场景中，与Reflexion风格基线相比，OASE在两个环境中都实现了更低的最终均衡距离，同时接受了显著更少的技能修订，有效抑制了缺乏足够收益支撑的策略变更。
AI.conclusion: OASE用基于证据锚定的选择取代盲目更新，使智能体即使在对手持续演化的情况下也能稳定高效地适应。

title: Motion Beyond Morphology: Bootstrapping Cross-Category Motion Transfer from Abstract Motion Representations
summary: Video motion transfer aims to animate a target object using dynamics from a reference video. Existing formulations largely rely on fixed structural correspondence, which becomes ill-defined when reference and target objects differ substantially in morphology, articulation, or deformation mechanisms. We introduce Motion Beyond Morphology, a perspective that seeks to transfer motion beyond fixed structural correspondence, by preserving dynamics that remain meaningful across different target morphologies. To realize this, we propose a two-stage framework. Stage~I learns complementary multi-granularity abstract motion views and uses them to bootstrap cross-category video pairs that preserve transferable dynamics across diverse morphologies. Stage~II internalizes this supervision into direct reference-video-conditioned generation, removing the need for explicit motion extraction at inference. We further introduce OpenVMT-Dataset and OpenVMT-Bench for training and evaluating image- and text-conditioned motion transfer across Same, Near, and Far category gaps, and plan to release both upon acceptance. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art motion fidelity and target preservation. Project page: https://miniz233.github.io/MotionBeyondMorphology/

AI.tldr: 本文提出"超越形态的运动迁移"（Motion Beyond Morphology）视角，旨在打破传统视频运动迁移对固定结构对应的依赖，使运动能够跨不同形态（如不同物体类别、结构差异大的物体）进行迁移。方法分两阶段：第一阶段学习多粒度抽象运动视图并引导生成跨类别视频配对，第二阶段将监督内部化为直接的参考视频条件生成。同时提出OpenVMT-Dataset和OpenVMT-Bench用于训练与评估，实验表明达到了最先进的运动保真度和目标保持效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频运动迁移方法依赖固定的结构对应关系，当参考视频和目标物体的形态、关节结构或形变机制差异较大时，这种对应关系定义模糊甚至失效，限制了运动迁移在跨类别场景下的适用性。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：Stage I学习互补的多粒度抽象运动视图，利用这些视图引导跨类别视频对的生成，保留在不同形态间可迁移的动态信息；Stage II将这种监督内部化为直接的参考视频条件生成，推理时无需显式提取运动。同时构建了涵盖Same、Near、Far三种类别差距的训练数据集和基准。
AI.result: 在图像和文本条件下的运动迁移任务上（涵盖Same、Near、Far类别差距），实验表明该方法在运动保真度和目标保持方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 运动迁移可以超越固定的结构对应关系，通过抽象多粒度运动表示和跨类别监督，实现不同形态之间的有效运动迁移，为跨类别视频生成提供了新的思路。

title: Benchmarking Sheaf Neural Networks for Inductive Tasks
summary: Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) generalize message passing by replacing scalar edge weights of standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with learnable, edge-dependent restriction maps between node stalks. Despite their strong theoretical foundations and promising transductive results, SNNs have been evaluated almost exclusively on transductive node classification, leaving their behaviour under inductive protocols unknown. We address this gap through the first systematic benchmark of the sheaf design space, evaluating three diffusion mechanisms (neural sheaf diffusion, sheaf attention, and sheaf attention with Graph Attention Network v2), three restriction-map parameterizations, three stalk dimensions, and six modern GNN architectural components, within a message-passing reformulation that never assembles the heavy sheaf Laplacian, making the full design space trainable under cross-graph batching. Across $1{,}890$ controlled experiments on 14 inductive datasets, multiple insights emerge: restriction maps are the dominant design choice and general maps are preferable, larger stalks add capacity but not long-range reach, architectural components explain more performance variation than the entire sheaf-specific design space itself. Under a matched protocol, SNNs transfer to inductive settings but do not reach the strongest baselines, with gaps being dataset-dependent. Practically, a single sheaf configuration can generalize across datasets, so effort is better spent tuning the surrounding architectural recipe than the sheaf operator itself.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对Sheaf神经网络（SNNs）在归纳式设置下进行系统基准测试，通过1,890个受控实验发现：限制映射是主导设计选择且一般映射更优，更大的茎维度增加容量但未提升长程传播能力，架构组件对性能的影响超过sheaf特定设计空间本身。SNNs在匹配协议下可迁移到归纳设置，但未达到最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的Sheaf神经网络虽具有坚实的理论基础和有前景的转导式结果，但其评估几乎完全局限于转导式节点分类任务，在归纳式协议下的行为尚属未知。这一空白使得该设计空间在更广泛场景中的适用性缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 在消息传递重公式化框架下（避免组装庞大的sheaf拉普拉斯算子），系统评估三种扩散机制（神经sheaf扩散、sheaf注意力、带GATv2的sheaf注意力）、三种限制映射参数化、三种茎维度以及六种现代GNN架构组件，并在14个归纳式数据集上进行1,890个受控实验，支持跨图批处理训练。
AI.result: 实验揭示：限制映射是主要设计选择且一般映射优于其他参数化；较大茎维度增加容量但未扩展长程信息传递能力；架构组件对性能变化的解释力大于整个sheaf特定设计空间；SNNs可迁移到归纳设置但在匹配协议下未达到最强基线，差距因数据集而异。
AI.conclusion: 工程实践中不存在通用最优的sheaf配置——一个单独的sheaf配置可跨数据集泛化，因此调优工作应更多投入外围架构配方而非sheaf算子本身。

title: HALT: Verification-Aware Stopping for Retrieval-Augmented Search Agents
summary: Retrieval-augmented search agents answer multi-hop questions by repeatedly issuing search queries and accumulating evidence. This creates a stopping problem: after the necessary evidence has appeared, further retrieval often adds cost, latency, and distracting context rather than useful information. We frame stopping as evidence coverage rather than generator confidence, and introduce HALT, a lightweight verification-aware policy that leaves the search agent unchanged. Given expected hop claims, HALT stops only when cumulative evidence supports each required claim. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks, HALT reduces redundant search while largely preserving exact match. We separate a deployable setting, where hop claims are generated from the question, from a diagnostic upper bound that uses gold supporting-fact annotations: generated claims give smaller but still exact-match-preserving savings, while gold claims show the larger savings available when hop targets are clean. Baseline comparisons and ablations show that this behavior is driven by claim-evidence alignment rather than generic sufficiency, fixed stop positions, or lexical overlap. Open-corpus pilots further suggest that HALT abstains when coverage cannot be reliably verified.
