Overall, evidence coverage provides a practical runtime control signal for improving retrieval-augmented agents without retraining or modifying the host agent.

AI.tldr: HALT是一个轻量级的验证感知策略，通过基于证据覆盖率而非生成器置信度来决定检索增强搜索代理何时停止检索。该方法在不需要重训练或修改主代理的情况下，显著减少了冗余搜索，同时基本保持精确匹配性能。
AI.motivation: 检索增强的搜索代理通过反复发出搜索查询来回答多跳问题，但存在停止问题：在必要证据出现后，继续检索只会增加成本、延迟和干扰性上下文，而非有用信息。现有方法基于生成器置信度判断停止，不够可靠。
AI.method: HALT将停止问题框定为证据覆盖率而非生成器置信度。给定预期的跳数声明（hop claims），HALT仅在累积证据支持每个所需声明时才停止。论文区分了可部署设置（跳数声明从问题生成）和诊断上界（使用金标准支持事实标注）两种场景。
AI.result: 在三个多跳QA基准上，HALT减少了冗余搜索同时基本保持精确匹配。金标准声明显示出更大的节省空间，而生成声明提供较小但仍保持精确匹配的节省。消融实验表明行为由声明-证据对齐驱动，而非通用充分性、固定停止位置或词汇重叠。开放语料试点表明HALT在覆盖率无法可靠验证时会弃权。
AI.conclusion: 证据覆盖率提供了一种实用的运行时控制信号，无需重训练或修改宿主代理即可改进检索增强代理，是一种轻量且有效的停止策略。

title: Mitigating Visual Degradation in MLLMs via Spatial-Spectral Visual Anchor Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted by ACM MM 2026
summary: Despite the progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), they continue to exhibit deficiencies in visual perception. Following visual instruction tuning, internal MLLM representations rapidly deviate from their original semantic states during inference, causing severe information degradation. While existing methods attempt to leverage external vision foundation models (VFMs) to align internal representations, we find that direct alignment with VFMs enhances visual semantics but fails to mitigate representation deviation. To address this, we propose Spatial-Spectral Visual Anchor Learning (SSVAL). The core of SSVAL is Visual Anchor Prompt Injection (VAPI), which introduces prompts that absorb rich knowledge from external VFMs during training, enabling them to serve as stable visual anchors that mitigate representation deviation during inference. Additionally, we incorporate auxiliary spatial and frequency-domain representation alignment losses to provide complementary vision-specific supervision at intermediate LLM layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SSVAL significantly outperforms existing methods. Code are available on our \href{https://msls38.github.io/SSVAL/}{project page}.

AI.tldr: SSVAL通过视觉锚点提示注入（VAPI）和空间-频域表示对齐损失，解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在推理过程中内部表示偏离语义状态导致视觉信息退化的问题，在视觉感知任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在视觉指令微调后，推理时内部表示会迅速偏离原始语义状态，造成严重的视觉信息退化。已有的方法尝试利用外部视觉基础模型（VFMs）对齐内部表示，但发现直接对齐虽能增强视觉语义，却无法缓解表示偏差问题。
AI.method: 提出Spatial-Spectral Visual Anchor Learning (SSVAL)，核心是Visual Anchor Prompt Injection (VAPI)——在训练时注入能够吸收外部VFM丰富知识的提示，使其在推理时充当稳定的视觉锚点来缓解表示偏差。同时引入辅助的空间域和频域表示对齐损失，为中间LLM层提供互补的视觉特定监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SSVAL在视觉感知任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉锚点注入与空间-频域双重对齐损失，SSVAL有效解决了MLLM推理过程中视觉表示偏差问题，为提升多模态模型的视觉感知能力提供了新思路。

title: Before Reasoning Fails: Pre-Evidence Procedural Failures in Agentic RAG
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can fail before evidence-conditioned reasoning is tested: an agent may retrieve candidate snippets but finalize without inspecting them. We study this failure mode as a procedural property of the agent trajectory, decomposing wrong answers into pre-evidence discipline failures and post-gold-read failures using saved tool-call traces, retrieved evidence, read passages, and final answers. Across 12,000 paired trajectories on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, the two failure types are largely non-redundant: the both-trigger rate is in [11.2%, 13.1%] across regex and spaCy entity extractors. We then evaluate Read-Gate, a minimal runtime invariant requiring an agent to read after search and before finalization. Forced reading improves LLM-Acc by 14.9-19.9 points on trajectories that would otherwise skip reading and by 3.2-9.4 points on full minimal-reasoning cells. Additional diagnostics show that larger hidden thinking budgets do not necessarily increase evidence inspection. Together, these results indicate that evidence-gathering should be evaluated as a trajectory-level control problem, separately from answer-side reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Agentic RAG系统中"检索到证据但未阅读就给出答案"的失败模式，将其分解为证据前纪律失败和黄金证据读取后失败两类。通过12000个配对轨迹的实证分析，发现两类失败基本不重叠（同时触发率仅11.2%-13.1%）。提出Read-Gate这一最小运行时约束，强制智能体在搜索后、最终回答前必须阅读证据，在原本跳过阅读的轨迹上提升LLM-Acc 14.9-19.9点，在完整最小推理单元上提升3.2-9.4点。结论认为证据收集应作为轨迹级控制问题单独评估，而非仅看答案侧推理。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评估主要关注"证据条件下的推理"是否出错，但忽略了更根本的问题：智能体可能在检索后根本不去阅读证据就直接给出答案。这种"证据前纪律失败"不能被答案侧评估捕捉到，需要将失败分解为不同的程序性失败类型来理解。
AI.method: 采用保存的工具调用轨迹、检索证据、阅读段落和最终答案来分解错误答案为两类：(1) 证据前纪律失败（检索后未阅读即答题）；(2) 黄金证据读取后失败（读取了黄金证据但仍答错）。在此基础上提出Read-Gate，一个最小的运行时不变式，强制要求智能体在搜索后、最终化前必须执行阅读操作。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上12000个配对轨迹中，两类失败基本不冗余（同时触发率11.2%-13.1%）。Read-Gate在原本会跳过阅读的轨迹上提升LLM-Acc 14.9-19.9点，在完整最小推理单元上提升3.2-9.4点。额外诊断显示更大的隐藏思考预算并不必然增加证据检查行为。
AI.conclusion: 证据收集应被视为轨迹级控制问题，与答案侧推理分开评估。Read-Gate这样的强制阅读机制能有效弥补智能体的证据消费纪律缺失，暗示未来RAG系统设计需要在轨迹层面对证据处理行为进行显式控制和评估。

title: Dynamic Resolution Routing for Efficient Egocentric Grounding
summary: Egocentric visual grounding requires high-resolution inputs to localize small objects. However, scaling Multimodal Large Language Models to this domain is constrained by the excessive cost of visual token processing. We identify that current efficient strategies based on token reduction are unreliable for selecting object-centric spatial evidence. To overcome this, we propose SmartRes, a framework that performs efficiency optimization in the pixel space via dynamic resolution routing. SmartRes first encodes a low-resolution view for global context and uses a lightweight router to activate high-resolution patches in object-centric regions and constructs an order-preserving visual sequence. To further enable robust routing under severe foreground-background imbalance, we introduce a margin-regularized routing objective that increases foreground-background logit separation and improves foreground recall. Experiments on Ego4D and EgoIntention show that SmartRes reduces visual tokens by up to 67% while retaining 86.4% of full-resolution performance, and achieves up to 1.66X faster inference than state-of-the-art token reduction methods with higher accuracy. Furthermore, strong performance on small object grounding indicates the effectiveness of SmartRes towards egocentric applications. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SmartRes框架，通过在像素空间进行动态分辨率路由来实现高效的第一人称视角视觉定位。该方法先用低分辨率图像捕捉全局上下文，再用轻量级路由器激活目标区域的局部高分辨率块，同时引入边距正则化目标以应对前后景不平衡问题，在Ego4D和EgoIntention数据集上减少多达67%的视觉token，同时保留86.4%的全分辨率性能，推理速度比现有token缩减方法快1.66倍。
AI.motivation: 第一人称（自我中心）视觉定位需要高分辨率输入来定位小物体，但将多模态大语言模型扩展到该领域受限于视觉token处理的过高成本。现有基于token缩减的高效策略在选择目标中心空间证据时不可靠，难以在压缩时保留关键的目标区域信息。
AI.method: SmartRes包含两个核心组件：1) 动态分辨率路由：先编码低分辨率视图获取全局上下文，通过轻量级路由器激活目标中心区域的高分辨率图像块，并构建保序的视觉序列；2) 边距正则化路由目标：增加前景与背景的logit间隔，提高前景召回率，以应对严重的前后景不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在Ego4D和EgoIntention数据集上，SmartRes减少了高达67%的视觉token，同时保留了86.4%的全分辨率性能；相比最先进的token缩减方法，推理速度提升1.66倍且准确率更高；在小物体定位任务上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: SmartRes证明了在像素空间而非token空间进行效率优化的有效性，通过智能分辨率路由策略，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持了较高的定位精度，尤其适用于第一人称应用中的小物体定位场景。

title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/happyflatfish/prng-diffusion-learnability
summary: Diffusion models rely on stochastic inputs, yet on finite-precision hardware, the "randomness" they consume is realized as deterministic numerical orbits generated by pseudorandom rules. Accessible orbit structure can become a learnable input and affect both training and generation because the realized loss and its gradient depend on the concrete pseudorandom values consumed at each optimization step. A small multilayer perceptron predicts the next value of an orbit from its recent history, measuring general sequence predictability. A diffusion probe replaces real images with online random tensors while preserving the diffusion architecture and training objective, measuring whether the target system can exploit orbit structure. After controlling marginal statistics and screening out clear dynamical and finite-precision failures, the remaining orbits still produce markedly different diffusion losses and generation quality on MNIST and CIFAR-10. Both measures show strong rank correlations with macroscopic generation degradation, although their local rankings differ. After normalization by the IID baseline, the probe loss and the real-data diffusion loss approximately follow an empirical power law, with different exponents on the two datasets. These results suggest that a pseudorandom source is not only a distributional choice, but also a model-dependent structured input.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了伪随机数生成器（PRNG）在有限精度硬件上为扩散模型提供的"随机性"并非真正随机，而是确定性的数值轨道。这些轨道结构可被模型学习，从而影响扩散模型的训练和生成质量。作者通过MLP预测器测量序列可预测性，以及用扩散探针测量系统对轨道结构的利用能力，发现不同PRNG轨道在MNIST和CIFAR-10上产生显著不同的扩散损失和生成质量，且这些差异与宏观生成退化呈强秩相关。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型依赖随机输入，但在有限精度硬件上，这些"随机性"实际是由伪随机规则生成的确定性数值轨道。如果这些轨道具有可被学习/利用的结构，它们就会成为模型化相关的结构化输入，影响训练和生成效果。现有研究忽视了这一因素，因此需要系统评估伪随机源对扩散模型的影响。
AI.method: 1）使用小型多层感知机（MLP）从近期历史预测轨道下一值，衡量序列的可预测性；2）设计扩散探针（diffusion probe），用在线随机张量替换真实图像，但保留扩散架构和训练目标，衡量系统能否利用轨道结构；3）控制边际统计量并筛除明显的动力学和有限精度失败案例后，在MNIST和CIFAR-10上比较不同PRNG轨道的扩散损失和生成质量；4）通过与IID基线归一化，分析探针损失与真实数据扩散损失之间的经验幂律关系。
AI.result: 在控制边际统计和排除失败案例后，不同伪随机轨道仍导致显著的扩散损失差异和生成质量差异。MLP可预测性与扩散探针损失均与宏观生成退化呈强秩相关，但局部排名有所不同。经IID基线归一化后，探针损失与真实数据扩散损失近似服从经验幂律，且两个数据集上的指数不同。
AI.conclusion: 伪随机源不仅是分布选择，更是一种模型依赖的结构化输入。这一发现意味着扩散模型的性能评估需要考虑所采用的伪随机数生成器，PRNG的选择可能成为影响模型表现的一个实际且可控的因素。

title: EduZone: A Framework for Evaluating LLM Safety for K-12 Students and Teachers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used across diverse tasks in K-12 education, yet existing safety evaluations rarely examine how harmful or inappropriate content appears in interactions between LLMs and students or teachers. To address this, we present EduZone, an evaluation framework for LLM safety across diverse educational scenarios. Our framework systematically combines (1) student- and teacher-facing LLM usage contexts, (2) fine-grained curriculum concepts, and (3) 6 risk categories and 28 subcategories spanning both conventional and education-specific harms to generate contextually grounded adversarial interactions. We construct these interactions in three settings: single-turn requests, static multi-turn conversations, and dynamic multi-turn conversations. Using these interactions, we evaluate ten LLMs using four safety levels: refusal, safe assistance, risky assistance with safety guidance, and fully risky assistance. Our results reveal greater vulnerability to education-specific risks and dynamic multi-turn interactions, while existing safety guardrails fail to adequately address these risks. EduZone advances LLM safety in education by providing an automated, scalable evaluation framework that supports the development and deployment of safer LLMs in K-12 education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EduZone，一个面向K-12教育场景的LLM安全评估框架，系统性地结合师生使用场景、细粒度课程概念和6大类28小类风险类别，在单轮、静态多轮和动态多轮三种交互设置下评估十种LLM，发现教育特定风险和动态多轮交互下模型更易出现安全问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在K-12教育中被广泛应用，但现有安全评估很少考虑LLM与学生、教师互动中可能出现的伤害或不适当内容，缺乏针对教育场景的系统性安全评估框架。
AI.method: EduZone框架通过组合三个方面（师生使用场景、细粒度课程概念、6大类28小类风险类别）来生成情境相关的对抗性交互，并在单轮请求、静态多轮对话和动态多轮对话三种设置下构建这些交互，用四种安全级别（拒绝、安全协助、带安全指引的风险协助、完全风险协助）评估十种LLM。
AI.result: 研究发现模型在教育特定风险和动态多轮交互中表现出更大的脆弱性，现有安全护栏未能充分应对这些风险。
AI.conclusion: EduZone通过提供自动化、可扩展的评估框架，推进了教育领域LLM安全研究，支持K-12教育中更安全LLM的开发与部署。

title: StreamTalk: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Key-Pose Anchoring
summary: Real-time co-speech gesture generation must produce 3D motion clip by clip as speech arrives. Existing streaming methods are open-loop: each clip depends on past context, but the model cannot check or correct its trajectory. Small errors therefore accumulate and cause drift over long sequences. We observe that this failure is mainly caused by the lack of a forward constraint rather than poor short-clip quality. A plausible key pose at the end of each clip provides a destination anchor that limits drift. Based on this observation, we propose StreamTalk, a closed-loop framework with a periodic generate-retrieve-refine cycle. Streaming Pose-Guided Generation first predicts a coarse clip, retrieves a plausible tail pose from a speaker-specific motion database, and refines the clip using this pose before continuing to the next window. During training, Stochastic Anchor Masking randomly masks pose and translation frames, teaching the model to recover complete motion from sparse boundary conditions. A part-aware DiT separates hand, body, and translation streams to reduce interference between global displacement and local articulation. On BEAT2, StreamTalk achieves state-of-the-art FGD, reduces long-horizon drift relative to open-loop baselines, and runs in real time at 76 FPS. Project page: https://xiangyue-zhang.github.io/StreamTalk/.

AI.tldr: StreamTalk提出了一种闭环的流式共语手势生成框架，通过"生成-检索-精炼"的周期性循环来锚定每段运动片段的末端姿态，有效解决了开放环路方法中长期漂移的问题，同时在BEAT2数据集上达到SOTA效果并支持76 FPS实时运行。
AI.motivation: 现有流式共语手势生成方法采用开放环路设计，每个片段仅依赖过去上下文生成，模型无法检查或纠正其轨迹，导致小误差随时间累积并产生长期漂移。作者观察到该问题主要源于缺乏前向约束，而非短片段质量差。
AI.method: 提出StreamTalk闭环框架：(1) 流式姿态引导生成：先预测粗片段，从说话者特定动作数据库中检索合理的尾部姿态作为锚点，然后精炼该片段；(2) 随机锚定掩码训练策略：在训练中随机掩蔽姿态和位移帧，教会模型从稀疏边界条件恢复完整运动；(3) 部位感知的DiT（Diffusion Transformer）：分离手部、身体和位移流，减少全局位移与局部关节运动之间的干扰。
AI.result: 在BEAT2数据集上，StreamTalk在FGD指标上达到SOTA水平，相比开放环路基线显著减少长时域漂移，并以76 FPS的速度实现实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 通过在闭环中引入尾部姿态锚点和部位感知的架构设计，StreamTalk有效解决了流式共语手势生成的长期漂移问题，验证了"前向约束缺失是漂移主因"这一观察的正确性。

title: Smooth Reparameterizations of Functions on Simplicial Product Spaces: Applications to Probabilistic Tensor Decomposition and Functional Data Registration
comment: submitted to Journal of Optimization Theory and Applications (JOTA)
summary: We consider optimization problems defined on product spaces of simplices. Examples of this class of problems include learning low-rank discrete multivariate probability distributions via simplex constrained tensor decomposition and performing functional data registration under the Square Root Velocity Function (SRVF) representation. In this work, we demonstrate the feasibility of replacing the product simplex with a smooth, elementwise strictly convex reparameterization, resulting in an unconstrained optimization problem on a manifold. We show that performing such a reparameterization results in the second order Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points on the smooth manifold being mapped to the weak second order KKT points on the product simplex. This leads to a Riemannian Gradient Descent (RGD) algorithm for solving the reparameterized problem, which outperforms Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), and provides a more faithful representation of the original function shapes while performing curve registration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了定义在单纯形乘积空间上的优化问题，提出用光滑、逐元素严格凸的重参数化方法将其转化为流形上的无约束优化问题，并证明了流形上的二阶KKT点映射回单纯形乘积空间后对应弱二阶KKT点，进而提出黎曼梯度下降（RGD）算法，优于投影梯度下降（PGD）。
AI.motivation: 许多实际问题（如低秩离散多元概率分布学习、SRVF函数配准）的优化目标定义在单纯形乘积空间上，直接求解具有约束，投影方法效率较低或表示不够精确，需要寻找更好的求解策略。
AI.method: 将乘积单纯形通过光滑、逐元素严格凸的映射重参数化为流形上的无约束问题；理论证明了流形二阶KKT点与单纯形上弱二阶KKT点的对应关系；基于此设计Riemannian Gradient Descent（RGD）算法求解重参数化后的优化问题。
AI.result: RGD算法在求解重参数化问题时性能优于Projected Gradient Descent（PGD），并且在曲线配准任务中能够更忠实保留原始函数形状。
AI.conclusion: 单纯形乘积空间上的约束优化问题可以通过严格凸光滑重参数化转化为流形上的无约束问题，RGD算法在该框架下既高效又有更好的几何保真度。

title: HPFA: Hypergraph-Based Paired Failure Attribution for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reflection is a powerful mechanism for LLM reasoning, yet its effectiveness hinges on accurately attributing failures to specific reasoning steps, a capability that current models notably lack. Existing failure attribution methods either require expensive step-by-step counterfactual testing that scales poorly with trajectory length, or treat reasoning traces as flat sequences that ignore the inherent non-linear logical dependencies. We propose a hypergraph-based paired failure attribution (HPFA) framework that attributes the failure root cause by comparing the hyperedges of the targeted failure reasoning path against a reference successful path. By reducing the search space, our method efficiently localizes root causes and enables scalable synthesis of attribution data for training a lightweight attributor model via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and agentic coding tasks demonstrate that HPFA can dramatically increase attribution accuracy and efficiency, and the trained attributor consistently improves reasoning accuracy at test time, outperforming baselines that lack graph structure or paired analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于超图的配对失败归因（HPFA）框架，通过比较失败推理路径与成功参考路径的超边来定位推理失败的根本原因，并利用该归因数据训练轻量级归因模型，从而提升LLM推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 反思机制对LLM推理至关重要，但现有模型缺乏将失败准确归因到具体推理步骤的能力。现有方法要么需要昂贵的逐步反事实测试（随轨迹长度增加而扩展性差），要么将推理轨迹视为扁平序列而忽略非线性的逻辑依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出HPFA框架：1) 用超图建模推理轨迹，捕捉非线性逻辑依赖；2) 通过比较失败路径与参考成功路径的超边来定位失败根本原因；3) 缩小搜索空间以提高定位效率；4) 利用归因数据通过监督微调和强化学习训练轻量级归因模型。
AI.result: 在数学推理和智能体编码任务上的实验表明，HPFA显著提高了归因准确性和效率，训练得到的归因模型在测试时能够持续提升推理准确性，优于缺乏图结构或配对分析的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: HPFA通过超图结构和配对分析有效解决了失败归因中的非线性逻辑依赖问题，实现了高效、可扩展的归因数据合成，并验证了训练归因模型对提升LLM推理性能的价值。

title: CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens for Vision-Language Models
summary: In video understanding, vision-language models (VLMs) must ingest massive numbers of visual tokens, causing the computational and memory cost of the prefill stage to rise sharply. Such visual sequences are highly redundant along the spatio-temporal dimension, yet a high compression ratio is often accompanied by the loss of critical details. Existing token-compression methods either employ heuristic, training-free compression with limited content adaptivity or introduce additional modules that require expensive alignment training, leaving the trade-off between efficiency and adaptivity unresolved. To alleviate this limitation, we propose CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens. CRAFT recursively merges tokens by decoupling parameter-free token selection from learnable token fusion: global similarity determines which tokens to merge, while a position-aware weighting module and a content-adaptive channel-wise gate learn how to fuse them. The whole compression pipeline is query-agnostic. Because every retained token is a linear combination of the original tokens, CRAFT preserves their true spatio-temporal coordinates and stays aligned with the pre-trained language model's input distribution. Experiments on multiple representative video benchmarks show that CRAFT consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art token-compression methods. At about $8\times$ compression, it retains roughly $97\%$ of the backbone's average accuracy and shows significant efficiency improvement.

AI.tldr: CRAFT提出了一种递归自适应视频token融合压缩方法，通过将无参数token选择与可学习token融合解耦，在约8倍压缩率下保留约97%的骨干网络平均准确率，同时显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 视频理解中VLMs需要处理海量视觉token，导致prefill阶段计算和内存成本急剧上升。现有token压缩方法面临两难：启发式免训练压缩缺乏内容自适应性，而模块化方法需要昂贵的对齐训练，效率和自适应性之间的平衡未得到解决。
AI.method: CRAFT通过递归地合并token实现压缩，核心是将参数自由的token选择与可学习的token融合解耦：全局相似度决定合并哪些token，位置感知加权模块和内容自适应通道门控学习如何融合它们。整个压缩流程与查询无关（query-agnostic），因为每个保留的token都是原始token的线性组合，因此保留了真实的时空坐标并与预训练语言模型的输入分布保持一致。
AI.result: 在多个代表性视频基准测试上，CRAFT一致优于先前的SOTA token压缩方法。在约8倍压缩率下，保留了约97%的骨干网络平均准确率，并表现出显著的效率提升。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT通过解耦选择与融合的递归自适应策略，有效解决了视频token压缩中效率与自适应性之间的权衡问题，在保持高压缩率的同时实现了下游任务准确率的最小损失。

title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
summary: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, however, typically connect these states to the reasoning trajectory through decoded tokens, making sequence-level credit assignment indirect and obscuring how latent updates shape subsequent reasoning. We introduce GradCuit (gradient through circuit), which inserts optimizable latent states at a selected Transformer layer between the hidden representations of the prompt and the generated continuation. Causal self-attention provides every continuation-token log-probability with a differentiable path to every preceding latent state through the remaining Transformer blocks, enabling reward-weighted gradients from the entire continuation to be assigned directly to the latents. Across five instruction-tuned backbones, three reasoning benchmarks, and two answer formats, GradCuit achieves an average accuracy of 64.5%, outperforming chain-of-thought prompting by 6.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method by 2.4 points. GradCuit also demonstrates greater robustness: across seven learning-rate settings, it consistently outperforms LatentSeek while reducing the standard deviation of accuracy from 1.53 to 0.82, and even its random-walk variant remains competitive with LatentSeek. For interpretability, token-level gradient attribution reveals that latent influence concentrates on reasoning-connector tokens, while layer analysis identifies early-to-middle Transformer layers as the most effective optimization space. By directly optimizing internal reasoning from outcome feedback, GradCuit opens a new axis of robust and interpretable test-time scaling, where LLMs adapt how they reason rather than merely regenerate, sample, or rerank outputs.

AI.tldr: GradCuit提出一种新的测试时推理优化方法，通过在Transformer层间插入可优化的连续潜变量，使得整条推理解码路径的奖励加权梯度可以直接分配到潜变量上，从而提升LLM推理准确率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于优化的潜在推理方法通过解码token将潜在状态与推理轨迹连接，导致序列级信用分配是间接的，难以清晰理解潜在更新如何影响后续推理。
AI.method: 在选定的Transformer层中，于提示的隐藏表示和生成的延续之间插入可优化的潜在状态。利用因果自注意力机制，使每个延续token的对数概率都能通过剩余的Transformer块与每个前置潜在状态形成可微路径，从而实现从整个延续到潜在变量的直接奖励加权梯度分配。
AI.result: 在5个指令微调骨干模型、3个推理基准和2种答案格式上，平均准确率达64.5%，比链式思维提示高6.6个百分点，比最强竞争方法高2.4个百分点。在7种学习率设置下，鲁棒性优于LatentSeek，准确率标准差从1.53降至0.82。token级梯度归因显示潜在影响集中在推理连接token上，早期到中层Transformer是最有效的优化空间。
AI.conclusion: GradCuit通过直接从结果反馈优化内部推理，开辟了鲁棒且可解释的测试时扩展新方向，使LLM能够调整推理方式而非简单地重新生成、采样或重新排序输出。

title: Cross-Fitted Residual Utility for Primary-Preserving Cognitive Decision Correction in Automatic Modulation Classification
summary: Automatic modulation classification research has largely emphasized representation accuracy, but a cognitive receiver must also decide when heterogeneous evidence justifies overriding a trusted default prediction. We study this post-inference problem through cross-fitted residual utility and a primary-preserving cognitive decision policy. A structured KAN-Fourier classifier supplies the default probability, while neural and non-neural candidates provide observable evidence. Candidate-specific residual utility is learned from train-split out-of-fold predictions, and a disjoint validation split freezes action thresholds, approved transitions, conditional routes, and a unified risk mask before held-out evaluation. On RMLA, RMLB, and HISAR, the complete system improves overall accuracy from 63.632% to 66.332%, 65.161% to 66.168%, and 77.769% to 79.867%, respectively. Controlled comparisons show that the isolated utility target does not uniformly dominate alternative out-of-fold meta-learners; the consistent gain comes from the complete evidence-and-action policy. Paired bootstrap and Holm-corrected McNemar analyses support the controlled gains. A frozen-policy stress test under carrier-frequency offset, I/Q imbalance, and synthetic Rayleigh/Rician fading yields positive gains in all 11 conditions, with every paired 95\% confidence interval above zero.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种后推理认知决策策略，在自动调制分类（AMC）中，当异构证据支持覆盖默认预测时，系统能够决定是否采纳覆盖。通过交叉拟合残差效用和主保留认知决策策略，结合KAN-Fourier分类器，在RMLA、RMLB和HISAR数据集上分别将准确率提升至66.332%、66.168%和79.867%，并在11种信道失配条件下均获得正向增益。
AI.motivation: 现有自动调制分类研究过分强调表示精度，但认知接收器需要具备判断能力——即在异构证据充分时，是否应覆盖可信的默认预测。这是一个被忽视的后推理（post-inference）问题。
AI.method: 1) 使用结构化KAN-Fourier分类器提供默认概率；2) 神经网络和非神经网络候选提供可观测证据；3) 通过训练集折外预测学习候选特定的残差效用；4) 使用独立的验证集冻结动作阈值、批准的转换、条件路由和统一风险掩码；5) 在保持集上进行评估。
AI.result: 在RMLA、RMLB、HISAR上，整体准确率分别从63.632%提升至66.332%、65.161%提升至66.168%、77.769%提升至79.867%。隔离效用目标不一定在所有折外元学习器中占优，但完整的证据-行动策略带来一致增益。配对bootstrap和Holm校正的McNemar检验支持受控增益。冻结策略压力测试在CFO、I/Q不平衡和衰落条件下11种情形均获得正增益。
AI.conclusion: 完整的证据-行动认知策略是提升AMC系统的关键，而非仅依赖效用目标本身。该系统在多种信道失配条件下保持鲁棒性，验证了认知覆盖决策的实际价值。

title: StreamSplat: Streaming Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient novel-view synthesis without per-scene optimization, but most existing methods assume a fixed set of context views and process them jointly. This limits their applicability to online scenarios where calibrated views arrive sequentially and the scene must be updated causally. We present \emph{StreamSplat}, a streaming feed-forward 3DGS framework that incrementally maintains a persistent geometry-grounded scene state and decodes it into renderable 3D Gaussians after each input chunk. StreamSplat centers on a \textbf{Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)}, which stores historical 3D tokens in a memory-bounded voxel structure so that memory grows with explored scene geometry rather than stream length. To better reuse history during causal prediction, we introduce \textbf{History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA)} to project cached geometry as depth guidance for current cost-volume estimation, and \textbf{Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI)} to inject cached latent evidence into Gaussian-token regression. Experiments on DL3DV, RealEstate10K, and ScanNet show that StreamSplat remains competitive with state-of-the-art feed-forward 3DGS methods under sparse causal inputs, despite not using future views or full-scene context. More importantly, it scales to long input streams with 256, 512, and 1024 views where fixed-view baselines run out of memory, yielding sustained improvements in novel-view synthesis quality as more observations arrive. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: StreamSplat是一个流式前馈3D高斯溅射（3DGS）框架，通过增量维护基于几何的一致性场景状态，支持在线场景更新，无需未来视图或全场景上下文即可实现高效的新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D高斯溅射方法大多假设固定数量的上下文视角并联合处理，无法适应在线场景中校准视图按顺序到达、场景必须因果更新的需求，限制了其在实际应用中的适用性。
AI.method: 提出了两个核心组件：1) Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC) 将历史3D token存储在内存有界的体素结构中，使内存随探索的场景几何而非流长度增长；2) History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA) 将缓存几何投影为当前代价体积估计的深度引导；3) Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI) 将缓存潜在证据注入高斯token回归。整体框架增量维护几何基础场景状态，并在每个输入块后解码为可渲染的高斯。
AI.result: 在DL3DV、RealEstate10K和ScanNet数据集上，StreamSplat在稀疏因果输入下与最先进前馈3DGS方法保持竞争力；在256、512和1024视图的长输入流中，固定的视图基线会内存不足，而StreamSplat能持续稳定扩展并随着更多观测而提升新视角合成质量。
AI.conclusion: StreamSplat证明了流式前馈3DGS的可行性，通过体素缓存机制实现了内存高效的长序列在线场景重建，在处理超长输入流时具有显著优势。

title: onepot-Bench 0: towards lab-aware in silico chemistry benchmarks
summary:
Language models are playing an increasingly important role in laboratory science, performing tasks such as experiment planning, execution, and post-hoc analysis. However, precisely measuring their abilities is difficult, as scientific capabilities require a mixture of both problem-solving skills and domain-specific intuition. Existing evaluations rarely measure the capabilities required to make reliable decisions in a physical laboratory and often rely on public data that may have appeared in model training corpora.
  We introduce onepot-Bench 0, a proprietary benchmark suite for evaluating language models on synthetic chemistry capabilities relevant to wet-lab execution. onepot-Bench 0 comprises three complementary evaluations: ChemAbacus measures tool-free cheminformatics literacy and numerical reasoning; SynthRefusal characterizes safety and refusal behavior across a variety of benign, controlled, and designer-drug targets; and SynthBench evaluates reaction-outcome prediction and catalyst selection using private experimental data generated in our laboratory. Together, these evaluations probe basic competency, reliability, and deeper knowledge, all skills which are required for reliable performance in the lab.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了onepot-Bench 0，一个专有的基准测试套件，用于评估语言模型在湿实验室合成化学任务中的能力，包含三个互补的评估模块：ChemAbacus（化学信息学与数值推理）、SynthRefusal（安全与拒绝行为）和SynthBench（基于私有实验数据的反应预测与催化剂选择）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在实验室科学中应用日益广泛，但现有评估很少测量物理实验室中可靠决策所需的能力，且常依赖可能已进入训练语料的公开数据，因此需要新的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建专有的onepot-Bench 0基准套件，包含三个评估：1) ChemAbacus评估无需工具的科学信息学素养和数值推理；2) SynthRefusal评估模型对良性、受控和设计药物目标的拒绝行为；3) SynthBench使用实验室生成的私有实验数据评估反应结果预测和催化剂选择。
AI.result: onepot-Bench 0从三个维度（基础能力、可靠性、深层知识）全面评估语言模型在实验室中的表现，全部使用专有数据避免数据泄露问题。
AI.conclusion: onepot-Bench 0提供了一个更贴近实际湿实验室需求的评估框架，克服了现有评估依赖公开数据和缺乏实验相关性的局限。

title: Instruction-Conditioned Exploration with Asymmetric Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation
comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR) May 2026 cycle. OpenReview submission record at https://openreview.net/forum?id=PV945lekMa
summary: Post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important tool for improving model capabilities, but the LLM action-space structure introduces challenges distinct from classical RL, with implications for inducing exploration. New methods are required that leverage the broad knowledge and flexibility of pre-trained LLMs to deliberately generate diverse experience at training time. We propose Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE), which supplements task prompts during training with one of several distinct instructions, increasing the coverage of behaviours attempted. To facilitate ICE, we propose Asymmetric-RL/SD, a combined Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation training objective, to transfer explored behaviours to the unconditioned test-time policy. ICE with the Asymmetric-RL/SD objective improves Qwen3-1.7B held-out pass@1 performance at $4$K response length on mathematical reasoning tasks by $5.0\%$ relative to training with DAPO, with improvement persisting at a longer 8K context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出指令条件探索（ICE）方法，通过在训练时向任务提示补充不同指令来增加行为覆盖范围，并配合非对称RL/SD目标（强化学习+自蒸馏）将探索行为迁移到无条件测试策略。在Qwen3-1.7B上，数学推理任务4K响应长度的held-out pass@1相对DAPO提升5.0%，且8K更长上下文下改善持续存在。
AI.motivation: LLM后训练中使用RL已成为提升模型能力的重要工具，但LLM的动作空间结构与经典RL不同，给诱导探索带来挑战。需要新方法利用预训练LLM的广泛知识和灵活性，在训练时有意识地生成多样化经验。
AI.method: 提出ICE（指令条件探索）方法，在训练时用多种不同指令补充任务提示以增加行为覆盖；同时提出Asymmetric-RL/SD，一种结合强化学习和自蒸馏的训练目标，将探索到的行为迁移到无条件（不带额外指令）的测试时策略中。
AI.result: ICE配合Asymmetric-RL/SD目标使Qwen3-1.7B在数学推理任务上，4K响应长度held-out pass@1相对DAPO训练提升5.0%，且在8K更长上下文下改进仍然持续。
AI.conclusion: 指令条件探索与非对称RL/SD目标相结合是一种有效提升LLM RL训练探索效率和测试性能的方法，其收益在更长上下文中仍能保持。

title: Ground, Cover, and Refine: Evidence-Centric Frame Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering requires identifying sparse yet critical evidence from videos containing thousands of frames under a constrained visual-token budget. Existing methods either select query-aware frames in a single pass or rely on timestamped text solely as retrieval guidance, leading to two key limitations. First, selected frames tend to cluster around local relevance peaks, and once the budget is exhausted, omitted evidence cannot be recovered. Second, textual and visual evidence remain weakly aligned. We propose GCR, a training-free framework that casts fixed-budget frame selection as a joint evidence curation problem. Ground converts timestamped text into temporal events, selects query-relevant real frame anchors, and renders each event text onto its temporally aligned frame. Cover supplements grounded events with direct visual anchors for complementary visual evidence and applies global maximal marginal relevance to preserve diverse context. Refine revisits omitted temporal regions and replaces the weakest revisable context frame with a real-frame medoid---but only when the medoid offers greater evidence value. GCR maintains a fixed number of chronologically ordered frames and requires no VLM training or architectural modification. Experiments on LongVideoBench and Video-MME, across three 7B backbones and frame budgets of 8, 32, and 64, demonstrate consistent improvements in long-video QA. With the 7B LLaVA-OV backbone and 32 frames, GCR achieves 64.25% and 62.15% on the two benchmarks, outperforming the strongest reproduced baselines by 2.54 and 1.93 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GCR框架，一种无需训练的固定预算帧选择方法，用于长视频问答。GCR通过Ground（将时间戳文本转换为事件并渲染到对应帧）、Cover（补充直接视觉锚点并应用全局最大边际相关性）和Refine（重新审视被忽略的时间区域并替换最弱帧）三个步骤，在固定帧预算下实现联合证据策展，显著提升长视频QA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答方法存在两个关键局限：1）单次帧选择容易聚簇在局部相关峰值附近，预算耗尽后遗漏的证据无法恢复；2）文本与视觉证据对齐薄弱。因此需要一种更有效的联合证据策展方法来克服这些问题。
AI.method: GCR包含三个步骤：Ground将时间戳文本转换为时间事件，选择查询相关的真实帧锚点，并将事件文本渲染到时间对齐的帧上；Cover用直接视觉锚点补充接地事件，并应用全局最大边际相关性保持上下文多样性；Refine重新审视遗漏的时间区域，在当前最弱帧与真实帧中位数之间选择证据价值更高的替换。整个过程保持固定数量的时间顺序帧，无需VLM训练或架构修改。
AI.result: 在LongVideoBench和Video-MME上，跨三个7B骨干和8/32/64帧预算下均取得一致改进。使用7B LLaVA-OV骨干和32帧时，分别达到64.25%和62.15%，超越最强复现基线2.54和1.93个百分点。
AI.conclusion: GCR证明了通过联合证据策展（而非简单单次选择）能有效解决长视频固定预算帧选择的挑战，在多种骨干和预算设置下均表现稳健，且无需任何训练或架构改动。

title: Enriched text-guided variational multimodal knowledge distillation network (VMD) for automated diagnosis of plaque vulnerability in 3D carotid artery MRI
summary: Multimodal learning has attracted much attention in recent years due to its ability to effectively utilize data features from a variety of different modalities. Diagnosing the vulnerability of atherosclerotic plaques directly from carotid 3D MRI images is relatively challenging for both radiologists and conventional 3D vision networks. In clinical practice, radiologists assess patient conditions using a multimodal approach that incorporates various imaging modalities and domain-specific expertise, paving the way for the creation of multimodal diagnostic networks. In this paper, we have developed an effective strategy to leverage radiologists' domain knowledge to automate the diagnosis of carotid plaque vulnerability through Variation inference and Multimodal knowledge Distillation (VMD). This method excels in harnessing cross-modality prior knowledge from limited image annotations and radiology reports within training data, thereby enhancing the diagnostic network's accuracy for unannotated 3D MRI images. We conducted in-depth experiments on the dataset collected in-house and verified the effectiveness of the VMD strategy we proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为VMD（Variation inference and Multimodal knowledge Distillation）的策略，利用放射科医生的领域知识来自动诊断颈动脉斑块易损性，通过跨模态先验知识蒸馏和变分推断，在有限的图像标注和放射学报告训练数据下，提升未标注3D MRI图像的诊断准确性。
AI.motivation: 颈动脉斑块易损性诊断对放射科医生和传统3D视觉网络都具有挑战性；临床实践中医生采用多模态方法结合多种影像模态和领域专业知识进行诊断，这启发了多模态诊断网络的构建。然而，有限的标准标注数据限制了诊断网络的性能，因此需要利用跨模态先验知识来增强未标注3D MRI图像的诊断能力。
AI.method: 该方法通过变分推断（Variation inference）和多模态知识蒸馏（Multimodal knowledge Distillation）相结合的策略，在训练数据中充分利用有限的图像标注和放射学报告中的跨模态先验知识，从而增强诊断网络对未标注3D MRI图像的诊断准确性。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上进行了深入实验，验证了所提出的VMD策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VMD策略能够有效利用放射科医生的领域知识，通过跨模态先验知识提升颈动脉斑块易损性自动诊断的准确率，尤其对未标注的3D MRI图像具有显著的增强效果。

title: Illuminating Visual Identity in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Universal Multimodal Embeddings (UMEs) aim to unify various modalities and tasks into a shared representation space. In recent years, this field has witnessed substantial progress driven by the development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, a crucial capability, visual identity discrimination, remains underexplored in existing UME methods, despite its critical role in a wide range of tasks, including instance retrieval, re-identification, and identity preservation in AI-generated content. To bridge this gap, we propose a unified formulation for visual identity discrimination~(VisID) and introduce $\textbf{MVEB}$ ($\textbf{M}$ultimodal $\textbf{V}$isual Identity $\textbf{E}$mbedding $\textbf{B}$enchmark), a large-scale benchmark curated from both real-world and synthetic datasets to support evaluation and training. Furthermore, we present a simple yet effective learning framework that jointly optimizes general multimodal and visual identity representations through a carefully designed identity-aware sampling mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach successfully endows UMEs with strong identity discrimination capability and maintains competitive general multimodal performance. We believe this work not only illuminates a critical yet neglected capability, but also takes a step toward more holistic universal multimodal embeddings. Code and data are available at \href{https://chrisclear3.github.io/MVEB}{MVEB}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVEB基准和训练框架，赋予通用多模态嵌入（UMEs）视觉身份判别能力，同时保持通用多模态性能。
AI.motivation: 现有UMEs方法在统一多模态表示方面取得进展，但视觉身份判别能力（如实例检索、重识别、AI生成内容中的身份保持）被忽视，缺乏统一的公式化定义和大规模基准。
AI.method: 1) 提出统一的视觉身份判别（VisID）形式化定义；2) 构建MVEB大规模基准（涵盖真实世界和合成数据）；3) 提出简单有效的联合学习框架，通过精心设计的身份感知采样机制，同时优化通用多模态表示和视觉身份表示。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法使UMEs具备强大的身份判别能力，同时保持有竞争力的通用多模态性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了UMEs中被忽视的关键能力，推动更全面的通用多模态嵌入发展，并开源了代码和数据。

title: FairForensics: Seeing Expressions and Parsing Demographics via Vision-Language Modeling for Generalizable Fair Deepfake Detection
summary: The challenge of fair deepfake detection (FDD) has attracted increasing attention. Existing fairness-enhanced detectors often suffer from suboptimal generalization to unseen manipulations and fairness across demographic groups. They are typically developed and evaluated on demographically imbalanced distributions, resulting in biased predictions toward minority groups. In this paper, we construct a novel demographically balanced FDD benchmark to train and evaluate the fairness of detectors under both balanced and imbalanced population scenarios. Additionally, we introduce a novel expression and demographic perceptual vision-language model, termed FairForensics, for generalizable fair deepfake detection. FairForensics conducts face forgery generalization enhancement and demographic-aware fairness regularization. During face forgery generalization enhancement, built upon the novel observation of significant distribution differences between pristine and forged expression vectors, we design an expression encoder to capture high-level expression-guided forgery patterns, and an expression-perceptual visual encoder that integrates global appearance and expression forgery features while mitigating identity bias using an identity-aware patch perturbation module. Under demographic-aware fairness regularization, we propose a demographic-guided language encoder to extract population-aware global language embeddings, which boosts the decoupling of forgery features from demographic information via vision-language alignment. We devise a population-aware prototype fairness objective to enforce both inter-class separability and intra-class alignment across demographic subgroups. Extensive experiments on our balanced demographic benchmark show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art in terms of generalization and fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对公平深度伪造检测（FDD）问题，构建了人口统计平衡的基准数据集，并提出FairForensics视觉-语言模型，通过表情引导的伪造表征增强和人口统计感知的公平性正则化，在泛化性和公平性上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有公平增强的深度伪造检测器在未见篡改手段的泛化性和跨人口统计群体的公平性上表现不佳，原因在于它们通常在人口统计分布不平衡的数据上开发和评估，导致对少数群体的预测存在偏差。
AI.method: 1）构建人口统计平衡的FDD基准；2）提出FairForensics模型，包含两个核心模块：a) 面伪造泛化增强——设计表情编码器捕获高层表情引导的伪造模式，以及表情感知视觉编码器整合全局外观与表情伪造特征，并通过身份感知补丁扰动模块减轻身份偏差；b) 人口统计感知公平性正则化——提出人口统计引导语言编码器提取人口感知的全局语言嵌入，通过视觉-语言对齐解耦伪造特征与人口统计信息，并设计人口感知原型公平目标函数实现跨人口亚组的类间可分离性和类内对齐。
AI.result: 在平衡人口统计基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在泛化性和公平性方面均达到最先进水平（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: FairForensics通过结合表情感知的伪造泛化增强和人口统计感知的公平性正则化，有效解决了深度伪造检测中的泛化性与公平性难题，为公平深度伪造检测提供了新思路。

title: Amplitude-Only FFN Intervention for Tool-Structured LLM Inference Method: Gated Evaluation Protocol, and Cross-Model Empirical Results
summary: Large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, where small format, argument, or function-call errors can invalidate otherwise plausible responses. We study inference-time feed-forward network (FFN) intervention for improving structured outputs without retraining model weights. Our project began with Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), a direction-changing repair attempt that revealed sensitive SwiGLU FFN intervention sites but often caused more harm than fixes. We therefore propose Amplitude Gating (AG), a non-destructive alternative that preserves pretrained FFN weight directions and modulates only activation magnitudes during generation. We define a fine-grained intervention system spanning P1/P2/P3 and branch-specific P1s/P2a/P2b sites, and introduce an evaluation protocol that separates combination-oracle headroom from fixed configurations and learned gates, enforces sample-level accounting, and uses task-aware metrics for binary and partial-credit datasets. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, AG is weakly positive in aggregate but strongest on tool-structured tasks. On Qwen3.5-9B, a category-level learned gate improves tool/structured/agentic performance from 38.66% to 42.92% (+4.27 percentage points), with Hermes function-call tasks reaching about +7.6 points. On Qwen3-8B, Hermes JSON mode improves by +11.36 points. Qwen2.5-7B retains oracle headroom but current learned gates fail to capture it, showing that deployment requires model- and category-specific routing. Comparisons of entropy AG with Newton-Schulz-windowed AG show that neither family is uniformly dominant. These results identify tool-structured inference as the most credible first target for safe FFN-level inference optimization, while prospective online validation and broader cross-model evaluation remain necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型在工具调用场景下的推理时前馈网络（FFN）干预技术。作者先提出正交残差投影（ORP）方法但发现其在SwiGLU FFN位点上弊大于利，转而提出非破坏性的振幅门控（AG）方法，仅调节激活幅度而不改变预训练权重方向。实验表明AG在Qwen系列模型上整体弱正向，但在工具/结构化任务上效果最强，Qwen3.5-9B上类别级学习门控将工具/结构化/代理性能从38.66%提升至42.92%（+4.27个百分点），Hermes函数调用任务提升约+7.6点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为工具使用智能体时，微小的格式、参数或函数调用错误会导致原本合理的响应失效。现有方法需要重新训练模型权重，成本高昂。作者希望在不重训练权重的前提下，通过推理时的前馈网络干预来改善结构化输出质量。
AI.method: （1）提出正交残差投影（ORP）作为方向改变的修复尝试，但发现SwiGLU FFN干预位点敏感且常造成更多伤害；（2）提出非破坏性的振幅门控（AG），保留预训练FFN权重方向，仅调节生成过程中的激活幅度；（3）定义了细粒度干预系统，涵盖P1/P2/P3及分支特定的P1s/P2a/P2b位点；（4）引入评估协议，将组合oracle上限与固定配置和学习门控分开，实施样本级核算，并采用任务感知指标。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上，类别级学习门控将工具/结构化/智能体性能从38.66%提升至42.92%（+4.27个百分点），Hermes函数调用任务约+7.6点。Qwen3-8B上Hermes JSON模式提升+11.36点。Qwen2.5-7B保留oracle上限但当前学习门控无法捕获。熵AG与Newton-Schulz窗口AG比较表明两者均非普遍占优。
AI.conclusion: 工具结构化推理是安全FFN级推理优化的最可信首选目标，但部署需要模型和类别特定的路由策略，且仍需要在线验证和更广泛的跨模型评估。

title: SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on commonsense reasoning tasks but struggle with visual spatial reasoning. Most existing solutions introduce extra 3D prior inputs or external spatial encoders, which increase complexity and degrade the underlying VLMs' general-purpose capabilities after spatial fine-tuning. To this end, we propose a parameter-efficient \textit{\textbf{Spatio}-vision \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{M}odels (SpatioLM)}, that enhances spatial intelligence without extra 3D prior inputs or third-party spatial encoders. Concretely, we design a plug-and-play and non-invasive spatio-vision module that elicits the spatial knowledge inherent in VLMs. Furthermore, we innovatively leverage pseudo depth and camera information as supervision to guide the model in learning physically coherent representations. Extensive experiments show that SpatioLM achieves significant improvements in diverse tasks, including spatial perception and understanding while effectively limiting the degradation of general capabilities. Notably, the model achieves an impressive score of 71.6 on the VSI-Bench (the first model to surpass 70). In addition, it attains competitive performance when transferred to embodied manipulation tasks. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/xiaomi-research/spatio-lm}{\faGithub~spatio-lm}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatioLM，一种参数高效的视觉语言模型，通过即插即用的空间视觉模块和伪深度/相机信息监督，在不引入额外3D先验或外部空间编码器的情况下，显著提升VLM的空间推理能力，同时在VSI-Bench上达到71.6分（首个突破70的模型）。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在常识推理任务上表现良好，但在视觉空间推理上存在明显不足。已有解决方案要么引入额外的3D先验输入，要么使用外部空间编码器，这不仅增加了系统复杂度，还会在空间微调后损害VLM原有的通用能力。
AI.method: 1) 设计一个即插即用、非侵入式的空间视觉模块，用于激发VLM中已有的空间知识；2) 利用伪深度和相机信息作为监督信号，引导模型学习物理一致的表征；3) 采用参数高效的训练策略，最小化对通用能力的负面影响。
AI.result: 在多种空间感知和理解任务上取得显著提升，在VSI-Bench上达到71.6分（首个突破70的模型）。同时有效限制了通用能力的退化，并在迁移到具身操作任务时也取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: SpatioLM证明可以通过参数高效的模块设计和创新的监督策略来增强VLM的空间智能，无需依赖额外的3D先验或外部编码器，为视觉语言模型的空间推理能力提升提供了新的思路。

title: MemArbiter: Decision-Time Memory Arbitration for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain and use cross-step information to act coherently in long-horizon tasks. Existing methods improve memory accessibility, yet action-relevant information may still fail to guide the current decision because it is poorly formed, organized, prioritized, or presented. We call this post-access failure the Memory-Action Gap. We propose MemArbiter, a function-aware memory arbitration framework that addresses the memory-management-induced component of this gap. MemArbiter decomposes interaction histories into atomic items, organizes them into five functional Memory Banks, and combines bank-level demand, item-level relevance, focal-ambient representations, and a temporal presentation gate to dynamically control memory salience. We evaluate MemArbiter on ALFWorld against Flat Retrieval and Flat Recency under unified per-step memory budgets. With an open-weight action-generation model, MemArbiter achieves success rates of 82.8% and 92.5% under 500- and 750-token budgets, outperforming the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 25.4 percentage points, respectively. It also improves post-failure recovery and reduces failed-action repetition and state-action recurrence. These results show that function-aware memory arbitration enables accessible information to guide actions more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemArbiter，一个功能感知的内存仲裁框架，用于解决大语言模型智能体在长时程任务中"记忆-行动差距"（Memory-Action Gap）问题——即信息即使可访问，也可能因组织、优先级或呈现方式不佳而无法指导当前决策。该方法将交互历史分解为原子项，组织成五个功能内存库，并通过银行级需求、项目级相关性、焦点-环境表示和时间门控动态控制记忆显著性。在ALFWorld基准上，使用开源权重模型，在500和750 token预算下分别达到82.8%和92.5%的成功率，比最强基线高出20.9和25.4个百分点，同时改善了失败后恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆管理方法主要关注提升记忆的可访问性（accessibility），但即使信息可被访问，如果记忆的组织、优先级或呈现方式不佳，行动相关信息仍可能无法有效指导当前决策。这种"可访问但不可用"的差距被称为Memory-Action Gap，现有方法未充分解决由记忆管理不当引起的这一差距。
AI.method: MemArbiter框架包含四个核心组件：(1) 将交互历史分解为原子项；(2) 将记忆组织为五个功能化Memory Banks；(3) 结合bank层面的需求度、item层面的相关性、焦点-环境（focal-ambient）表示来评估记忆；(4) 通过时间呈现门控（temporal presentation gate）动态控制记忆的显著性和呈现方式，确保关键信息在正确时刻以正确形式呈现给决策模型。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld基准上，MemArbiter在500 token预算下达到82.8%成功率，在750 token预算下达到92.5%成功率，分别比最强基线（Flat Retrieval或Flat Recency）高出20.9和25.4个百分点。此外，MemArbiter还改善了失败后的恢复能力，减少了失败动作的重复和状态-动作的重复出现。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，功能感知的内存仲裁机制能够使可访问的信息更有效地指导智能体行动。MemArbiter验证了"内存管理方式"本身对决策质量的重要影响，即不仅要让信息可被检索到，还要确保信息以正确的组织结构、优先级和呈现方式为当前决策服务。

title: Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning for Segmentation Foundation Models via Visual Grounding
summary: Promptable segmentation foundation models (FMs) such as SAM3 and Medical SAM3 promise few-shot, interactively-specified segmentation for medical imaging through a natural language interface, yet their performance on clinical tasks falls well short of this promise. We posit that this shortfall is not an artefact of insufficient medical pretraining or imperfect prompt phrasing, but a structural limitation that will persist in any domain where paired image-text supervision is scarce, as it is across most clinical modalities. We further hypothesize that the limitation is specific to natural language as a control signal: a visually grounded prompt, learned directly from the target distribution, should recover the lost performance without additional image-text data or backbone retraining. We propose Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning (FS-CPL), which learns a continuous concept prompt embedding $\mathbf{p}^* \in \mathbb{R}^{T \times d}$ from a small support set of $K$ image--mask pairs via mask supervision, with the encoder-decoder backbone frozen. Across four public benchmarks spanning ultrasound and endoscopy (BUSI, HC18, TN3K, CVC-Clinic), FS-CPL delivers absolute Dice improvements of up to $+0.62$ over canonical text prompts and is \emph{backbone-agnostic}: it lifts both vanilla SAM3 and the domain-specifically pretrained Medical SAM3, showing that visual concept prompting is complementary to in-domain pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning (FS-CPL)，通过从少量图像-掩码对中学习连续概念提示嵌入，替代自然语言提示，以解决可提示分割基础模型在医学影像中因配对图文数据稀缺导致的性能不足问题。在超声和内窥镜四个基准数据集上，FS-CPL较典型文本提示取得最高+0.62的Dice提升，且对SAM3和Medical SAM3均有效。
AI.motivation: 可提示分割基础模型（如SAM3、Medical SAM3）承诺通过自然语言接口实现医学影像的少样本交互式分割，但实际临床任务性能远低于预期。作者认为这不是预训练不足或提示措辞不佳所致，而是结构性的局限——临床模态中配对图文监督数据稀缺，导致自然语言作为控制信号天然受限。
AI.method: FS-CPL从K个图像-掩码对的小支持集中学习一个连续概念提示嵌入p* ∈ R^(T×d)，仅通过掩码监督进行训练，编码器-解码器主干完全冻结。该方法用视觉接地（visual-grounded）的连续提示替代自然语言提示，直接从目标分布中学习提示表示。
AI.result: 在BUSI、HC18、TN3K、CVC-Clinic四个公开基准（覆盖超声和内窥镜）上，FS-CPL相较于典型文本提示取得最高+0.62的绝对Dice提升；且该方法是主干无关的（backbone-agnostic），对vanilla SAM3和领域预训练的Medical SAM3均有效，表明视觉概念提示与领域预训练互补。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言作为医学分割基础模型的控制信号存在结构性局限，尤其在图文配对数据稀缺的场景下。视觉概念提示是替代自然语言提示的有效方案，且与领域预训练互补，为医学影像少样本分割提供了新的思路。

title: Posterior Variance Is a Constraint Map, Not an Error Map: Closed-Form Uncertainty for Radiative Gaussian Splatting in Sparse-View CT
comment: v2: substantially revised and condensed; 31 pages total, 9 figures
summary: Radiative Gaussian splatting reconstructs sparse-view CT fast and accurately, and recent work attaches per-Gaussian posteriors to yield per-voxel uncertainty maps. We ask what such a map actually measures: posterior variance is a data-constraint map, not an error map -- its alarms are trustworthy, its all-clears are not. Exploiting the strict linearity of X-ray rendering in the per-Gaussian densities, we derive a clamp-aware closed form that the unchanged rasterizer evaluates exactly in one forward pass, in volume and projection space: the infinite-sample limit of the sampling estimator of concurrent work, at ~8x lower cost. On the official 15-scene benchmark this uncertainty ranks true error on 14 of 15 scenes. Restricted to the object interior -- the tissue a clinician reads -- the ranking collapses (median Spearman 0.11, 0/15 pass), identically for a deep ensemble and for a strictly positive log-normal posterior: three constructions, two estimator families, no survivors. The mechanism is structural: about 90% of in-object error is bias that reproduces across retrainings, invisible to model disagreement; 73-81% of the full-volume correlation is carried by object/surround contrast; and an exactly solvable control puts the observed in-object ranking 4-5x below what a perfectly calibrated posterior with the same sigma-spread would score. The error scale, by contrast, is an engineering problem, and we solve it: reparameterizing the posterior contracts the cross-scene temperature spread from 19.3x to 2.6x, one scene-agnostic temperature transfers to unseen scenes (10/15 leave-one-scene-out), and the repaired scale tracks photon count at the Poisson-predicted -1/2 power. We distill evaluation practice that would have caught the illusion -- masked calibration, seed-wise bias decomposition, an exact-posterior reference -- and release all protocols, seeds and per-run evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文发现辐射高斯泼溅（Radiative Gaussian Splatting）的不确定性图本质上是数据约束图而非误差图——其警报可信但"一切正常"的结论不可信。作者推导出钳位感知的闭式解，能以约8倍更低成本精确计算无限采样极限的不确定性，但发现在物体内部（临床医生读取的组织）不确定性排名完全失效（中位Spearman 0.11，0/15场景通过），其机制是结构性偏差（约90%的物体内部误差是跨重训练可复现的偏差）。作者通过重新参数化后验将跨场景温度散布从19.3倍压缩到2.6倍，并给出可操作的评估实践建议。
AI.motivation: 现有辐射高斯泼溅的不确定性图（来源于每高斯后验）被用于稀疏视图CT重建的不确定性估计，但作者质疑这类图实际测量的是什么。他们想弄清后验方差是否真正反映了误差，尤其关注临床医生实际读取的物体内部组织区域。
AI.method: 利用X射线渲染在每高斯密度上的严格线性性质，推导出钳位感知的闭式解，由未修改的光栅化器在一次前向传播中精确评估（体积和投影空间），对应并发工作采样估计器的无限采样极限，成本降低约8倍。同时采用深度集成和对数正态后验三种构造、两种估计器家族进行验证，并通过精确可解对照实验和偏差分解揭示失效机制。
AI.result: 在官方15场景基准上，该不确定性在14/15场景中正确排序真实误差，但在物体内部排名完全失效（中位Spearman 0.11，0/15通过），且三种构造两种估计器均无幸存者。约90%的物体内部误差是跨训练可复现的偏差；73-81%的全体积相关性由物体/周围对比度承载。重新参数化后验将跨场景温度散布从19.3倍压缩至2.6倍，一个场景无关温度可迁移到未见场景（10/15留一场景外验证）。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性图的"警报"可信但"清零"不可信——后验方差本质上是数据约束图而非误差图。这提醒研究者需要掩蔽校准评估、逐种子偏差分解和精确后验参照等评估实践来避免此类幻觉。误差尺度是可通过工程手段解决的问题，但误差排名的结构性失效需要更根本的解决方案。

title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering
summary: Long-horizon autonomous research tasks such as machine learning engineering require systems to make interdependent decisions under a limited budget. Existing LLM-based agents typically organize candidate-solution improvement through tree, graph, or chain structures, meaning that the search process determines how information is acquired and managed. We call this design solution-centric search and propose instead the information paradigm, in which an evolving information state represents the system's understanding of the task and guides solution improvement. We instantiate this paradigm in Iris, an inquiry-revision loop. For information acquisition, Iris generates local action plans from the current information state and uses epistemic actions to probe decision-critical unknowns without modifying the retained solution. For information management, Iris synthesizes observations across experiments into task knowledge composed of revisable claims with explicit scope and status. It updates this knowledge as new evidence arrives and constructs each decision context from raw evidence, structured summaries, or task knowledge at the required level of detail. On MLE-Bench, Iris attains a 64.9% any-medal rate under a 12-hour budget, the highest among compared systems. Across four tasks spanning harness engineering and model post-training, Iris also demonstrates cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息范式（information paradigm）替代传统解决方案中心搜索范式，并将其实例化为Iris系统——一个"探究-修订"循环框架，通过演化信息状态引导解决方案改进。Iris在MLE-Bench上以64.9%奖牌率超越所有对比系统。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在长时程自主研究任务（如机器学习工程）中，通常采用树、图或链结构组织候选方案的改进，这种"方案中心搜索"设计使得搜索过程决定了信息的获取与管理方式，缺乏对任务理解的系统性建模。
AI.method: Iris采用"探究-修订"循环：(1) 信息获取方面，从当前信息状态生成局部行动计划，通过认知动作（epistemic actions）探测决策关键未知项，而不修改保留的解决方案；(2) 信息管理方面，将跨实验的观测综合为任务知识，由带明确范围和状态的可修订声明组成，随新证据动态更新，并按需以原始证据、结构化摘要或任务知识构建决策上下文。
AI.result: 在MLE-Bench上，Iris在12小时预算下达到64.9%的任意奖牌率，为对比系统中最高；在四个涵盖工具工程和模型后训练的任务中展现了跨领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 信息范式（以演化信息状态为核心）优于方案中心搜索范式，Iris证明了通过显式建模任务理解状态并据此驱动解决方案改进，能够实现更高效的长时程自主研究。

title: FAU at ImageCLEF 2026 Task on Multimodal Reasoning Robust Candidate Scoring and Concise Multilingual Visual Answering
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. CLEF 2026 Working Notes, ImageCLEF 2026 Multimodal Reasoning Task
summary: We present our ImageCLEF 2026 Multimodal Reasoning system for the Visual Multiple Choice Question Answering (Visual MCQ) and Visual Open Question Answering (Visual OpenQA) subtasks. The challenge requires reliable reasoning over multilingual educational and scientific images with dense text, diagrams, charts, tables, formulas, and units, while enforcing strict answer formats. Our central finding is that robust output control is as important as model choice. For Visual MCQ, we replace fragile free-form generation with direct candidate label scoring from vision-language model logits, then combine complementary runs through score fusion and voting. For Visual OpenQA, we use image enhancement, concise final answer prompting, deterministic decoding, and targeted post-processing to remove reasoning traces and formatting artifacts. Without task-specific model training, our official submissions achieved third place in Visual MCQ with 0.7108 accuracy and first place in Visual OpenQA with 0.6488 COMET, 0.1391 BLEU, 0.2762 ROUGE L, and 0.2383 METEOR. The results highlight the practical value of inference engineering: careful scoring, ensembling, prompting, and cleanup can turn strong VLMs into reliable competition systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了ImageCLEF 2026多模态推理系统，用于视觉多项选择题（Visual MCQ）和视觉开放问答（Visual OpenQA）两项子任务。核心发现是输出控制与模型选择同等重要。对于MCQ任务，通过直接对候选标签进行logits评分替代自由文本生成，并结合分数融合与投票；对于OpenQA任务，采用图像增强、简洁答案提示、确定性解码和后处理清理。在不进行任务特定模型训练的情况下，在MCQ任务中获得第三名（准确率0.7108），在OpenQA任务中获得第一名（COMET 0.6488等指标），验证了推理工程的实际价值。
AI.motivation: 多语言教育和科学图像中的视觉问答具有高密度文本、图表、表格、公式等特点，且要求严格的答案格式，这使得可靠的推理系统设计面临挑战。作者希望通过探索无需任务特定训练的推理工程方法，将强大的视觉语言模型转化为可靠的竞赛系统。
AI.method: Visual MCQ任务采用候选标签logits直接评分替代脆弱的自由文本生成，并通过分数融合和投票组合互补的模型运行。Visual OpenQA任务采用图像增强、简洁最终答案提示、确定性解码以及目标后处理（去除推理痕迹和格式伪影）来确保输出质量。
AI.result: Visual MCQ任务获得第三名，准确率0.7108；Visual OpenQA任务获得第一名，COMET 0.6488，BLEU 0.1391，ROUGE L 0.2762，METEOR 0.2383。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果强调了推理工程的实际价值：精确的评分策略、模型集成、提示工程和输出清理可以将强大的VLM转化为可靠的竞赛系统，证明输出控制的重要性不亚于模型选择本身。

title: Beyond the Mean: Multi-Moment Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Existing methods generally aim to reduce the failure probabilities induced across problems. In this paper, we introduce a moment-based perspective on policy optimization for LLM reasoning by treating the failure probability of a randomly sampled problem as a random variable and characterizing optimization objectives through its moments. Under this perspective, many existing methods optimize only a single moment of the failure-probability distribution, leaving its broader distributional structure largely uncharacterized. We propose \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{M}oment \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (MMPO), a novel policy optimization framework that jointly minimizes multiple moments of the failure-probability distribution. MMPO admits a direct operational interpretation as minimizing the expected truncated time required to obtain the first successful response. Beyond MMPO, we further develop a general moment-transformation framework that systematically induces different moment profiles and provides a unified view of a broader family of policy optimization objectives. Experiments across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and models of different scales demonstrate that MMPO consistently outperforms strong baselines. We hope this moment-based perspective offers new insights into the design of policy optimization objectives for LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于矩（moment）视角的策略优化框架MMPO，将LLM推理中的失败概率视为随机变量，通过联合最小化其多个矩（而非单一矩）来优化策略，从而更全面地刻画失败概率的分布结构，在五个数学推理基准上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法通常只优化失败概率分布的单一矩（如期望），忽略了分布结构信息，限制了推理能力的进一步提升。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Moment Policy Optimization (MMPO)框架，联合最小化失败概率分布的多个矩；并进一步提出通用的矩变换框架，系统性地诱导不同矩配置，统一了更广泛的策略优化目标族。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准和不同规模模型上，MMPO一致性地优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 矩视角为LLM推理策略优化目标的设计提供了新的洞察，通过刻画失败概率的分布结构可以更好地提升模型推理能力。

title: Generative Brownian Bridge Diffusion In Motion Space For Enhanced Myocardial Strain Analysis
summary: Myocardial strain analysis of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images provides an important tool for evaluating cardiac function. However, current techniques require either human-adjusted post-processing with suboptimal regional accuracy, or specialized and costly imaging acquisitions. In this paper, we propose to leverage the power of generative models to synthesize high-quality motion-derived strain values from routinely acquired CMR sequences. Specifically, we develop a novel Brownian bridge diffusion model in motion space to learn the probabilistic mapping between standard CMR motion estimated from widely adopted registration methods and highly accurate motion provided by advanced strain imaging techniques. To promote the fidelity of anatomical structure in the generation process, our model is conditioned on the corresponding CMR images. We validate our method on large-scale multi-center CMR datasets including subjects of paired standard cine CMR and advanced strain imaging acquisitions. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves the accuracy of motion prediction and strain analysis from standard CMRs compared to existing learning-based approaches. Our research represents a new paradigm for potentially developing cost-effective, clinically deployable AI tools for cardiac function assessment with enhanced strain accuracy in busy clinical workflows. Our code is publicly available at anonymous.4open.science/r/Brownian-Bridge-strain-analysis-1140.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于布朗桥扩散模型的生成式方法，用于从常规CMR序列中合成高质量的应变值，以提高心肌应变分析的准确性和临床可用性。
AI.motivation: 现有心肌应变分析方法存在两大问题：一是需要人工调整的后处理且区域精度不足，二是需要特殊且昂贵的影像采集。这限制了其在繁忙临床工作流程中的应用。
AI.method: 开发了一种在运动空间中基于布朗桥扩散模型的新方法，学习标准CMR运动（通过广泛采用的配准方法估计）与高级应变成像技术提供的高精度运动之间的概率映射。模型以对应CMR图像为条件，以促进生成过程中解剖结构的保真度。
AI.result: 在大规模多中心CMR数据集（包括配对的标准cine CMR和高级应变成像采集）上验证，结果表明与现有基于学习的方法相比，该方法显著提高了标准CMR运动预测和应变分析的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究代表了开发经济高效、临床可部署的AI工具用于心脏功能评估的新范式，可在繁忙临床工作流程中以增强的应变精度进行应用，且代码已公开。

title: Auditing Data Provenance in LLM Fine-tuning via Intrinsic Distributional Fingerprints
comment: This is the extended version of CCS'26 paper https://doi.org/10.1145/3830454.3832639
summary:
The proliferation of customized Large Language Models (LLMs) poses critical risks of Data Intellectual Property (Data IP) infringement via unauthorized fine-tuning on proprietary data. Existing audit techniques are limited, as they require intervention during data preparation or training and remain fragile under malicious obfuscations such as data paraphrasing and knowledge distillation.
  We propose \textit{Distribution Provenance Audit (DPA)}, a post-hoc framework for auditing data IP infringement in LLM fine-tuning under black-box and malicious settings. DPA is grounded in a critical insight: regardless of fine-tuning tactics to evade provenance, the practical necessity of maintaining utility constrains the model to preserve the fundamental intersection of semantic substance and lexical form. Accordingly, DPA captures this persistent lexical-semantic intersection as intrinsic distributional fingerprints. The framework formulates the audit as a statistical hypothesis test, effectively quantifying these fingerprints via unbiased output sampling to reliably reject the null hypothesis of non-usage.
  Extensive experiments on medical and legal fine-tuning tasks show that DPA consistently outperforms existing baselines, remaining robust against adversarial trainers employing paraphrasing and knowledge distillation. We further highlight a fundamental dual-use tension: the same high-fidelity distributional fingerprints enabling reliable auditing may also facilitate privacy attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPA（Distribution Provenance Audit）框架，用于在黑盒和恶意场景下事后审计LLM微调中的数据IP侵权。DPA基于一个关键洞见：无论微调策略如何逃避溯源，保持实用性的需求迫使模型保留语义与词汇形式的交集。通过统计假设检验和无偏输出采样量化内在分布指纹，DPA在医疗和法律任务上优于现有基线，并对数据改写和知识蒸馏等对抗手段保持鲁棒性。同时揭示了指纹技术可能被用于隐私攻击的双重用途张力。
AI.motivation: 定制化LLM的激增通过未经授权的专有数据微调带来了严重的数据知识产权侵权风险。现有审计技术要么需要在数据准备或训练阶段进行干预，要么在恶意混淆（如数据改写和知识蒸馏）下表现脆弱，亟需一种后验的黑盒审计方法。
AI.method: DPA基于核心洞察：无论攻击者采用何种逃避策略，维持模型实用性必然迫使模型保留语义与词汇形式的稳定交集。DPA将此持久交集捕获为内在分布指纹，将审计形式化为统计假设检验，通过无偏输出采样有效量化这些指纹，以可靠地拒绝"未使用数据"的零假设。
AI.result: 在医疗和法律微调任务上的大量实验表明，DPA持续优于现有基线，对使用数据改写和知识蒸馏的对抗训练者保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DPA为黑盒和恶意场景下的LLM数据IP侵权审计提供了可靠的后验框架。同时论文揭示了基础性的双重用途张力：支持可靠审计的高保真分布指纹也可能被利用来进行隐私攻击，这一发现对审计技术的安全部署提出了重要警示。

title: Generative AI and Foundation Models in Medical Image
summary: In recent years, generative AI has attracted significant public attention, and its use has been rapidly expanding across a wide range of domains. From creative tasks such as text summarization, idea generation, and source code generation, to the streamlining of medical support tasks like diagnostic report generation and summarization, AI is now deeply involved in many areas. Today's breadth of AI applications is clearly distinct from what was seen before generative AI gained widespread recognition. Representative generative AI services include DALL-E 3 (OpenAI, California, USA) and Stable Diffusion (Stability AI, London, England, UK) for image generation, ChatGPT (OpenAI, California, USA), and Gemini (Google, California, USA) for text generation. The rise of generative AI has been influenced by advances in deep learning models and the scaling up of data, models, and computational resources based on the scaling laws. Moreover, the emergence of foundation models, which are trained on large-scale datasets and possess general-purpose knowledge applicable to various downstream tasks, is creating a new paradigm in AI development. These shifts brought about by generative AI and foundation models also profoundly impact medical image processing, fundamentally changing the framework for AI development in healthcare. This paper provides an overview of diffusion models used in image generation AI and large language models (LLMs) used in text generation AI, and introduces their applications in medical support. This paper also discusses foundation models, which are gaining attention alongside generative AI, including their construction methods and applications in the medical field. Finally, the paper explores how to develop foundation models and high-performance AI for medical support by fully utilizing national data and computational resources.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了生成式AI（扩散模型与大语言模型）在医疗支持领域的应用，并讨论了基础模型的构建方法及其在医学中的应用，最后探讨了如何利用国家数据和计算资源开发高性能的医疗AI。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI和基础模型的快速发展正深刻改变医疗影像处理和医疗AI开发的框架，有必要系统梳理这些技术在医疗领域的应用现状与未来发展方向。
AI.method: 本文采用综述性方法，分别介绍了图像生成AI中的扩散模型（如DALL-E 3、Stable Diffusion）和文本生成AI中的大语言模型（如ChatGPT、Gemini），并阐述它们在医疗支持任务中的应用；同时讨论了基础模型的构建方法与医学应用。
AI.result: 文章系统梳理了扩散模型与LLM在医疗诊断报告生成、总结等支持任务中的应用，并展望了利用国家数据和计算资源构建医疗专用基础模型的路径。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI和基础模型正在重塑医疗AI的开发范式，充分利用国家层面的数据和计算资源是构建高性能医疗AI的关键方向。

title: From Simple QA to Deep Research: A Verifiable Benchmark Constructed through Iterative Task Evolution
comment: 6 figures. Includes supplementary material. Code and data are publicly available
summary: Deep research benchmarks require expert-level tasks and reliable evaluation grounded in task-specific knowledge. Existing benchmarks rely heavily on expert authoring or pre-existing human-authored materials, while fully automatic construction struggles to ensure consistent and traceable verification. To address this gap, we introduce a verifiable benchmark of 500 deep research tasks spanning 31 topics and 10 major categories, with three query forms designed to probe complementary capabilities required for deep research. The benchmark is constructed automatically using an iterative Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger pipeline that progressively transforms simple questions into deep research tasks. Each task is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of atomic steps and associated checkpoints, enabling the query, DAG, and rubrics to evolve together in a controlled manner. Experiments demonstrate that the benchmark clearly discriminates among models and query types, while its fact-grounded pointwise rubrics enable fine-grained, human-aligned, and stable evaluation. Our data, implementation, and results are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含500个深度研究任务的可验证基准，覆盖31个主题和10大类，采用Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger流水线自动构建，每个任务以有向无环图（DAG）表示，实现可追踪的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究基准要么依赖专家手工撰写，要么依赖已有的人类材料，而全自动构建难以保证一致性和可追踪的验证。作者希望填补这一空白，提出一种既能自动构建又具备可靠验证能力的基准。
AI.method: 采用迭代的Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger流水线，将简单问题逐步转化为深度研究任务；每个任务表示为原子步骤的DAG及关联检查点，使查询、DAG和评分标准协同演进；提供三种查询形式以探测深度研究的不同互补能力。
AI.result: 实验表明该基准能清晰区分不同模型和查询类型；基于事实的逐点评分标准支持细粒度、与人类对齐且稳定的评估。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为深度研究任务提供了自动构建且可验证的评估方案，数据和实现已公开，可服务于后续研究。

title: Entity-Aware Sequence Transduction for Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting
summary: Player-centric ball action spotting requires temporally precise event detection together with actor attribution in crowded, partially observed multi-agent sports videos. Existing Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) baselines treat the player-role dimension as part of a flattened frame-level representation, which weakens the inductive bias for modeling player-specific temporal evolution and inter-player interactions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Entity Denoising Sequence Transduction (ME-DST). ME-DST keeps the role-slot dimension throughout encoding. It uses temporal attention to model the history of each role slot, and spatial attention to exchange information across role slots at each frame. This factorized design gives the model a direct structure for separating within-player evolution from inter-player context. We also add learnable role embeddings, tracking-derived tactical features, and fused visual predictions from X3D-L and Swin3D-S. Experiments on the FOOTPASS dataset show that ME-DST reaches a Micro F1 of 0.778. This improves the strongest official TAAD+DST baseline by 10.3 percentage points. Controlled ablations show that preserving the entity axis and encoding role identity are central to this gain. These results suggest that explicit entity modeling is an effective inductive bias for player-centric sports event understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ME-DST（多实体去噪序列转导）模型，用于足球视频中的球员中心球动作检测。该模型在整个编码过程中保留角色槽维度，采用时间注意力建模每个角色槽的历史、空间注意力在每帧跨角色槽交换信息，并通过解耦设计分离球员内部演化与球员间交互。在FOOTPASS数据集上达到Micro F1 0.778，比最强TAAD+DST基线提升10.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有DST基线将球员角色维度压平成帧级表示，削弱了对球员特定时间演化和球员间交互的归纳偏置，无法有效处理拥挤、部分遮挡的多智能体体育视频中的球员归属问题。
AI.method: 1) 在整个编码过程中保留角色槽维度；2) 时间注意力建模每个角色槽的历史演化；3) 空间注意力在每帧跨角色槽交换信息；4) 添加可学习的角色嵌入、轨迹追踪战术特征；5) 融合X3D-L和Swin3D-S的视觉预测。
AI.result: 在FOOTPASS数据集上达到Micro F1为0.778，比最强官方TAAD+DST基线提升10.3个百分点。消融实验表明保留实体轴和编码角色身份是性能提升的核心因素。
AI.conclusion: 显式实体建模是球员中心体育事件理解的有效归纳偏置，因子化的注意力设计能更好分离球员自身演化信息与球员间交互信息。

title: ET-Prune: Evidence-Aware Dynamic Budgeting for Visual Token Pruning in Text-Rich MLLMs
comment: Code and supplementary material is at https://github.com/Labyrinth0419/ET-Prune
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models, but a fixed token ratio is poorly matched to text-rich inputs. In OCR-centric tasks, decisive evidence can be a small number, label, or field whose relevance is specified by the question; indiscriminate pruning can erase that evidence while retaining visually salient but irrelevant regions. We present ET-Prune, a training-free framework that casts pruning as evidence allocation. It derives question-conditioned evidence from a decoder-side partial query-key block, safeguards text-like spatial regions, and converts evidence uncertainty and density into a sample-specific token floor. Three progressive middle-layer events then move the sequence toward this budget, retaining more tokens for diffuse or text-dense evidence and pruning concentrated evidence more aggressively. At the observed point estimates from one deterministic pass per configuration, ET-Prune leads or ties among pruned methods in all six backbone-benchmark comparisons at roughly half tokens. On OCRBench-v2, it leads the strongest pruned baselines by 1.80 and 0.68 percentage points on Qwen3-VL-8B and InternVL3.5-8B, respectively, while retaining about half of the visual tokens; on MMBench v1.1, it reaches 0.8467 circular exact-matching accuracy versus 0.8437 for Vanilla at 54.45% average visual-token retention. These results show a favorable observed quality-cost trade-off for evidence-aware dynamic budgeting in text-rich multimodal inference.

AI.tldr: ET-Prune是一种无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架，通过将剪枝视为"证据分配"来解决OCR密集型任务中固定token比例与文本丰富输入不匹配的问题。它在六个主干网络-基准组合中均领先或持平于其他剪枝方法，仅保留约一半token的情况下，在OCRBench-v2和MMBench v1.1上均取得了显著优势。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉token剪枝方法使用固定token比例，这与文本密集型输入不匹配。在OCR中心任务中，关键证据往往是少数标签或字段，其相关性由问题指定；不加区分的剪枝可能抹除关键证据，同时保留视觉显著但与问题无关的区域。
AI.method: ET-Prune包含三个核心组件：(1) 从解码器侧的partial query-key block中提取问题条件化的证据（question-conditioned evidence）；(2) 保护文本类空间区域（safeguards text-like spatial regions）；(3) 将证据的不确定性和密度转换为样本特定的token下限（sample-specific token floor）。随后通过三个渐进式的中间层事件（progressive middle-layer events）将序列推向该预算，对分散或文本密集的证据保留更多token，对集中证据则更激进地剪枝。
AI.result: 在六个主干网络-基准比较中，ET-Prune在约一半token条件下领先或持平于所有剪枝方法。OCRBench-v2上，在Qwen3-VL-8B上领先最强剪枝基线1.80个百分点，在InternVL3.5-8B上领先0.68个百分点；MMBench v1.1上达到0.8467的圆形精确匹配准确率，优于Vanilla的0.8437，同时仅保留54.45%的平均视觉token。
AI.conclusion: ET-Prune展示了证据感知的动态预算在文本丰富的多模态推理中具有良好的质量-成本权衡，验证了将剪枝视为证据分配而非简单token降采样的有效性。

title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as the knowledge-to-action gap. To address this challenge, we introduce IBA-Bench, a benchmark for implicit behavioral alignment constructed from longitudinal interaction histories that contain noise, implicit cues, and temporal inconsistencies. Unlike prior work, IBA-Bench evaluates whether an agent can execute tasks while satisfying implicit user constraints inferred from historical interactions. We further propose IBA-Agent, an agent framework that reconciles conflicting priorities through broad retrieval and trajectory-level alignment. Experiment results on IBA-Bench show that effective personalization remains a significant challenge for state-of-the-art LLM agents, and the proposed IBA-Agent substantially improves behavioral alignment in complex scenarios across nine application domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IBA-Bench基准，用于评估智能体从含噪的纵向交互历史中推断隐式用户约束并执行任务的能力，同时提出IBA-Agent框架，通过广泛检索和轨迹级对齐来调和冲突的用户偏好，在九个应用领域显著提升行为对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有个人化智能体基准多依赖静态偏好快照、固定交互日志或预定义用户档案的问答，无法捕捉用户偏好随时间的演化过程，也忽略了基于偏好条件执行任务的能力，即"知识到行动的鸿沟"（knowledge-to-action gap）。
AI.method: 构建IBA-Bench基准，基于包含噪声、隐式线索和时间不一致性的纵向交互历史来评估智能体任务执行中的隐式约束满足能力；并提出IBA-Agent框架，通过广泛检索和轨迹级对齐来调和冲突的用户优先级。
AI.result: 实验表明，最先进的LLM智能体在IBA-Bench上仍面临显著的个性化挑战，而IBA-Agent在九个应用领域的复杂场景中大幅提升了行为对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: 有效的个人化对现有LLM智能体仍是重大挑战，基于隐式行为对齐的基准和轨迹级对齐方法能够显著改善智能体对动态用户偏好的理解与执行能力。

title: UniSim-SLAM: Feed-Forward SLAM with Unified Sim(3) Optimization
summary: Recent geometric foundation models enable feed-forward inference for SLAM, but their predictions are strongly dependent on the input view set, which leads to geometric inconsistencies and trajectory drift when results are chained over long sequences. Online deployment further exposes a trade-off between the low latency of two-view tracking and the constraint richness of multi-view inference. We introduce UniSim-SLAM, an integrated system that runs lightweight two-view keyframe tracking in the frontend and performs periodic multi-view submap refinement in the backend. To combine predictions defined in heterogeneous local coordinates with inconsistent scales, we formulate a unified multi-level factor graph on $Sim(3)$ that jointly optimizes global keyframe poses and submap poses. The graph integrates temporal view-to-view odometry edges, view-to-submap bridge edges with depth-statistics scale anchoring, and submap-to-submap tie and scale constraints to enforce consistent similarity relations across submaps. Experiments on TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes show that UniSim-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in the uncalibrated setting, reducing trajectory error by $38.5\% $ on TUM RGB-D and $45.9\%$ on 7-Scenes compared to prior best results. Project page: https://vision3d-lab.github.io/unisim-slam/

AI.tldr: UniSim-SLAM是一个集成的SLAM系统,前端使用轻量级两视图关键帧跟踪,后端进行周期性多视图子图精化,通过统一的Sim(3)上的多层次因子图联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿,解决了几何基础模型在长序列上的几何不一致和轨迹漂移问题,在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes上分别降低了38.5%和45.9%的轨迹误差。
AI.motivation: 近期几何基础模型支持前馈式SLAM推理,但其预测强烈依赖于输入视图集,导致在长序列链式推理时出现几何不一致和轨迹漂移。此外,在线部署面临两视图跟踪低延迟与多视图推理约束丰富性之间的权衡。
AI.method: 提出UniSim-SLAM集成系统:前端运行轻量级两视图关键帧跟踪,后端进行周期性多视图子图精化。为组合处于异构局部坐标系且尺度不一致的预测,在Sim(3)上构建统一的多层次因子图,联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿。该图融合了时间视图到视图的里程计边、带深度统计尺度锚定的视图到子图桥接边,以及子图到子图的约束边和尺度约束,以强制各子图间一致的相似关系。
AI.result: 在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes数据集上的实验表明,UniSim-SLAM在无标定设置下达到了最先进的精度,相比先前最佳结果,在TUM RGB-D上轨迹误差降低38.5%,在7-Scenes上降低45.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过前后端分工和Sim(3)因子图统一优化,有效解决了几何基础模型在SLAM中的尺度不一致与轨迹漂移问题,实现了高精度且适合在线部署的SLAM系统。

title: PAC Approximation and DIRECT Optimization for Parametric Markov Models
summary: In this paper, we consider the parameter synthesis and optimization problem for parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs), the extension of classical MDPs where exact probability values are replaced by parametric expressions. Computing the rational function $f_{\lsf}$ that maps parameter valuations to the satisfaction value of a PRCTL property $\lsf$ is a computationally expensive task, particularly for pMDPs where the optimal policy may vary across the parameter space. We adopt the \emph{scenario approach} to efficiently synthesize a probably approximately correct (PAC) approximation $\ApproxFunOfProperty{f}$ of $f_{\lsf}$: by sampling parameter configurations and solving a linear program, we obtain a polynomial approximation whose error margin $\margin$ is guaranteed, with prescribed confidence, for all but an $\errorRate$-fraction of the parameter domain under the sampling distribution. We further show how this PAC framework can be combined with statistical model checking (SMC), enabling the analysis of black-box parametric models. Building on the PAC approximation, we integrate the DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles) algorithm for derivative-free global optimization over the parameter space. We establish conditional optimality-gap guarantees: under explicit Lipschitz and PAC-good-set assumptions, the difference between the true optimum $f_{\lsf}(\parameters^{*})$ and the value found by DIRECT is bounded by a partition-diameter term and, in the PAC case, an additional approximation-error term. An empirical evaluation on 2997 benchmarks focuses on the new DIRECT-based optimization component. The results show that DIRECT variants solve fewer instances than the scenario optimizer, but on their common successful instances they often return slightly better objective values and usually run faster, while remaining close to the scenario values within the PAC margin.

AI.tldr: 本文针对参数化马尔可夫决策过程（pMDPs）中的参数综合与优化问题，采用场景方法（scenario approach）通过采样和线性规划求解，获得PRCTL性质满足值函数$f_{\lsf}$的概率近似正确（PAC）多项式近似；进一步将该框架与统计模型检验（SMC）结合以支持黑盒模型分析，并集成DIRECT算法进行无导数全局优化，给出了条件性最优性间隙保证。在2997个基准上的实验表明，DIRECT变体虽解决的实例数少于场景优化器，但在共同成功实例上往往返回略优的目标值且运行更快。
AI.motivation: 参数化马尔可夫决策过程（pMDPs）中精确计算PRCTL性质满足值的理性函数$f_{\lsf}$计算代价极高，尤其当最优策略随参数空间变化时更为困难。因此需要高效的近似方法来综合参数并优化目标函数。
AI.method: 采用场景方法（scenario approach）：通过对参数配置进行采样并求解线性规划，获得具有误差裕度保证的多项式近似（PAC近似）；将此框架与统计模型检验（SMC）结合以支持黑盒参数模型；基于PAC近似集成DIRECT（DIviding RECTangles）算法进行无导数全局优化，并在Lipschitz和PAC好集合假设下建立条件最优性间隙保证。
AI.result: 在2997个基准上的实验评估表明：DIRECT变体解决的实例数量少于场景优化器，但在共同成功的实例上通常返回略优的目标值且运行更快，且结果保持在场景值的PAC裕度范围内。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的PAC场景方法结合DIRECT优化框架为pMDPs的参数综合与优化提供了高效且具有理论保证的近似方案，能够在精度与效率之间取得良好平衡。

title: SpatialQuery: Benchmarking Geometry-Grounded Multi-Instance Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong semantic understanding but remain unreliable in metric spatial reasoning, particularly when queries require comparing multiple instances of the same object category. We study this problem through the Closest-Instance Distance Query (CIDQ), where a model must identify the nearest visible candidate to a unique reference object and estimate their gravity-aligned floor-plane distance. We introduce SPATIALQUERY, a training- free framework for CIDQ reasoning from a single RGB image, together with SPATIALQUERY-1M, a benchmark containing over one million RGB-only question-answer pairs from 200 indoor scenes. SPATIALQUERY recovers instance-level metric geometry and transforms it into a canonical Bird's-Eye View through Scene Cubifying, which represents objects as uniformly sized, category-coded blocks to emphasize their relative floor- plane locations. We further propose Uncertainty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (UA-CoT) prompting, which incorporates geometry- derived per-instance uncertainty into the VLM reasoning process. Without task-specific fine-tuning or architectural modification, SPATIALQUERY with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves a Floor-MAE of 0.259 m, an Unc-Acc@0.3 m of 90.5%, and a proximity-decision accuracy of 84.18%, outperforming fine-tuned spatial specialists, general-purpose VLMs, and closed-source frontier models. Code, benchmark resources, and an interactive demo are available at https://namhai1810.github.io/SpatialQuery/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPATIALQUERY，一个无需训练的框架，用于解决视觉语言模型在度量空间推理中的不足，特别是针对最近实例距离查询（CIDQ）问题。通过场景立方化和不确定性感知链式思维提示，在单张RGB图像上实现实例级度量几何恢复，并在SPATIALQUERY-1M基准（100万个问答对，200个室内场景）上超越了微调的空间专家和封闭源前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽然具有强大的语义理解能力，但在度量空间推理上不可靠，尤其是当查询需要比较同一物体类别的多个实例时。现有方法缺乏针对此类细粒度空间关系推理的有效解决方案。
AI.method: SPATIALQUERY包含三个核心组件：(1) 从单张RGB图像恢复实例级度量几何；(2) 通过场景立方化（Scene Cubifying）将几何信息转换为规范鸟瞰图，将物体表示为统一大小、类别编码的块以强调相对地板平面位置；(3) 不确定性感知链式思维（UA-CoT）提示，将几何导出的每实例不确定性融入VLM推理过程。整个过程无需任务特定微调或架构修改。
