AI.result: 对主流CUAs的广泛评估表明，低危害注入攻击频繁绕过代理自身的防御机制和模拟用户审查，揭示了当前CUAs存在严重且此前未被充分探索的安全风险。
AI.conclusion: 当前以"人在回路"为核心的安全防御范式不足以应对低危害的隐形注入攻击，CUAs在这类攻击面前存在显著安全漏洞，需要更精细的风险评估和防御机制来应对行为上与合法任务难以区分的注入威胁。

title: RSVideo: Are Your Vision-Language Models Ready for Remote Sensing Videos?
summary: Remote-sensing videos enable real-time observation of changes in target attributes, short-term activities, and scene evolution. They record motion, actions, interactions, and scene changes that cannot be captured by isolated images. Existing models primarily target single images or discrete temporal observations spanning a long time range. However, a unified evaluation setting for assessing vision-language models on continuous remote-sensing video understanding remains lacking. We introduce RSVideo-10K, a remote-sensing video dataset comprising 10,773 instances, 1.47 million frames, and 17.02 hours of footage, containing both unmanned aerial vehicles and satellite platforms. Its fixed evaluation benchmark, RSVideo-Bench, contains 2,731 test instances and evaluates two complementary aspects of remote-sensing video understanding: L1 Perception and L2 Reasoning, spanning seven capability groups and 17 tasks. Evaluations show that current vision-language models still struggle to recover small local evidence, track short-lived states, and use scene-constrained spatial relations. Based on this analysis, we further propose RSVideo, a reinforcement learning framework for small-target spatiotemporal focusing that selects question-relevant regions across frames and suppresses redundant background tokens. RSVideo achieves a maximum absolute improvement of 9.01% with InternVL3.5-14B and attains the highest accuracy of 40.63% with Qwen3.6-27B across 26 open-source vision-language backbones.Codes will be available at https://github.com/HongjieZhou0329/RSVideo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSVideo-10K遥感视频数据集（10,773实例、147万帧、17.02小时，涵盖无人机和卫星平台）及其固定评测基准RSVideo-Bench（2,731测试实例，覆盖感知和推理两大方面、7个能力组、17个任务）。评测发现现有视觉语言模型在小目标证据恢复、短暂状态追踪和场景约束空间关系理解上存在困难。基于此，提出RSVideo强化学习框架，通过跨帧选择问题相关区域并抑制冗余背景token来实现小目标时空聚焦，在InternVL3.5-14B上取得最高9.01%的绝对提升，在Qwen3.6-27B上达到40.63%的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 遥感视频能够实时观测目标属性变化、短期活动和场景演变，记录孤立图像无法捕捉的运动、交互和场景变化。然而现有模型主要针对单张图像或长时间范围的离散时序观测，缺乏统一的连续遥感视频理解评估框架，这阻碍了视觉语言模型在该领域的系统评估与发展。
AI.method: 论文包含三部分工作：(1)构建RSVideo-10K数据集，包含10,773个实例、147万帧和17.02小时素材，涵盖无人机和卫星平台；(2)设计RSVideo-Bench固定评测基准，包含2,731个测试实例，从L1感知和L2推理两个互补角度评估，覆盖7个能力组和17个任务；(3)提出RSVideo强化学习框架，通过跨帧选择与问题相关区域并抑制冗余背景token，实现对遥感视频中小目标的时空聚焦。
AI.result: 评测显示当前视觉语言模型在小局部证据恢复、短暂状态追踪和场景约束空间关系利用方面仍表现不足。提出的RSVideo框架在InternVL3.5-14B上取得最大9.01%的绝对性能提升，在Qwen3.6-27B上达到40.63%的最高准确率，在26个开源视觉语言骨干模型上均验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了遥感视频连续理解统一评测的空缺，揭示了当前视觉语言模型在该场景下的核心短板，并通过小目标时空聚焦的强化学习框架显著提升了模型性能。数据集、基准和代码将公开，为遥感视频理解研究提供基础资源。

title: TBSG-Net: Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network for Fine-Grained Video Moment Retrieval
summary: Recent advances in proposal-free Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) have highlighted the effectiveness of Static Scene Graphs (SSGs). By modeling objects and their relations at the frame level, SSGs enrich retrieval-oriented video representations. However, integrating SSGs into VMR remains constrained by two inherent limitations: (1) Lack of Temporal Dynamics. SSGs fail to model how objects and their relationships evolve over time, leading to the loss of essential temporal dependencies in video representation; and (2) Lack of Explicit Temporal Span Encoding. SSGs do not explicitly encode the duration of relationships, making precise localization challenging. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network (TBSG-Net)---to the best of our knowledge, the first Dynamic Scene Graph (DSG) based proposal-free VMR model. Specifically, TBSG-Net leverages DSGs to extract event-centric graph representations of the input video, enabling the modeling of object interactions over time and thus addressing limitation (1). These DSGs are then processed by a novel Dynamic Scene Graph Embedding (DSG-E) module to capture both Temporal Span and spatio-temporal information. First, DSG-E utilizes a TBSG Constructor to transform DSGs into TBSGs, explicitly encoding objects, relationships, and time spans to tackle limitation (2). Second, the resultant TBSGs are passed into a hybrid TBSG Encoder that integrates a Transformer variant for global event modeling and a Graph Convolutional Network for detailed relational reasoning, ultimately producing a more comprehensive spatio-temporal representation. Our experiments demonstrate substantial improvements of TBSG-Net over all baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TBSG-Net，这是首个基于动态场景图（DSG）的免提案视频时刻检索（VMR）模型。针对静态场景图（SSG）在时间动态性和显式时间跨度编码上的不足，TBSG-Net通过DSG提取事件中心化图表示，并利用动态场景图嵌入模块（DSG-E）中的TBSG构造器编码对象、关系和时间跨度，再通过混合TBSG编码器（Transformer + GCN）融合全局事件建模与细粒度关系推理，实验表明在各基线上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有免提案视频时刻检索方法虽采用静态场景图（SSG）增强视频表示，但SSG存在两大固有缺陷：(1)无法建模对象及其关系随时间演化，丢失关键时间依赖；(2)无法显式编码关系持续时间，导致精确定位困难。
AI.method: 提出TBSG-Net，包含：(1) 利用动态场景图（DSG）提取事件中心化图表示，建模对象随时间的交互；(2) 提出DSG-E模块，其中TBSG构造器将DSG转换为显式编码对象、关系和时间跨度的TBSG；(3) 混合TBSG编码器融合Transformer变体（全局事件建模）与图卷积网络（细节关系推理），生成综合时空表示。
AI.result: 实验表明TBSG-Net在所有基线上均取得显著性能提升，验证了动态场景图及时间跨度显式编码对VMR任务的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TBSG-Net首次将动态场景图引入免提案VMR，通过显式编码时间跨度并融合全局与局部关系建模，有效解决了静态场景图的两大局限，为VMR中的时空关系建模提供了新方向。

title: GIFT: Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning for Non-Lambertian Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth foundation models, benefiting from large-scale synthetic training data, have demonstrated strong generalization. However, they often hallucinate depth on non-Lambertian surfaces, estimating reflected content in mirrors or transmitted content behind glass rather than the physical surface itself. Adapting these models with real-world data is challenging because conventional depth sensors are also unreliable in such regions. We observe that while the appearance of a non-Lambertian surface varies with its reflected or transmitted environment, its underlying geometry remains unchanged. Based on this observation, we propose GIFT (Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning), a parameter-efficient post-training framework that requires no measured depth labels. We collect groups of RGB images under controlled appearance changes while keeping the camera and target geometry fixed. GIFT exploits geometric invariance across these observations to suppress non-Lambertian depth hallucinations while retaining general depth estimation capability. We further construct a controlled benchmark that evaluates non-Lambertian depth recovery, robustness to appearance changes, and performance retention in other regions. Experiments on our benchmark and an independent real-world dataset demonstrate that GIFT improves depth prediction for mirrors and transparent objects while largely preserving the base model's performance, providing a practical and low-cost approach for adapting monocular depth foundation models to non-Lambertian scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出GIFT（几何不变微调）框架，通过利用非朗伯表面在外观变化下几何不变的特性，无需深度标签即可微调单目深度基础模型，抑制其在镜面/透明表面上的深度幻觉，同时保持整体深度估计性能。
AI.motivation: 单目深度基础模型在非朗伯表面（镜面、玻璃等）上会产生深度幻觉，而现实数据难以获取可靠的真实深度标签（传统深度传感器在这些区域同样不可靠），导致难以通过真值监督进行自适应。
AI.method: 1) 观察非朗伯表面的外观随反射/透射环境变化，但其底层几何保持不变；2) 收集在受控外观变化条件下（相机和目标几何固定）的RGB图像组；3) 利用跨观测的几何不变性进行参数高效的后训练微调，抑制非朗伯深度幻觉；4) 构建受控基准评估非朗伯深度恢复、外观变化鲁棒性和其他区域性能保留。
AI.result: 在自建基准和独立真实世界数据集上，GIFT显著改善了镜面和透明物体的深度预测，同时大幅保留了基础模型的性能，展示了低成本实用的非朗伯场景自适应能力。
AI.conclusion: GIFT提供了一种无需测量深度标签的参数高效后训练方案，是适应单目深度基础模型到非朗伯场景的实用且低成本方法。

title: STEAM:ASpatio-TEmporal Alignment Mixture-of-Experts Model with Hierarchical Pre-training for EEG Decoding
summary: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have been widely used in motor rehabilitation, disease diagnosis, and other neural engineering scenarios. However, conventional neural signal decoding algorithms often suffer from limited generalizability and high adaptation costs, motivating recent interest in BCI foundation models. Existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve general transferability, accurate decoding, and efficient downstream adaptation. We present STEAM, a hierarchical transfer framework that reconciles general-purpose representation learning with paradigm-specific specialization in EEG foundation models. The framework is instantiated as a dual-branch spatio-temporal encoder in which a shared soft mixture-of-experts (SSMoE) module aligns the spatial and temporal branches, allowing complementary representations to exchange information through a compact set of soft slots. Across seven downstream datasets and fourteen evaluation settings, STEAM attains the best average rank among the compared methods at a competitive inference cost measured in FLOPs. Building upon the Stage-I general initialization, the hierarchical pre-training strategy further specializes the model to a target paradigm without retraining from scratch, yielding consistent gains in paradigm-specific decoding accuracy.

AI.tldr: STEAM是一个层级式迁移框架，用于EEG基础模型，通过双分支时空编码器和共享软混合专家（SSMoE）模块实现通用表示学习与范式特定专业化之间的平衡。在七个下游数据集和十四个评估设置中取得最佳平均排名，并通过层级预训练策略在无需从头训练的情况下提升范式特定解码精度。
AI.motivation: 传统神经信号解码算法泛化能力有限且自适应成本高，促使研究者探索BCI基础模型。但现有方法难以同时实现通用迁移性、精确解码和高效下游适应，这三者之间存在矛盾。
AI.method: 提出STEAM层级式迁移框架，包含：(1) 双分支时空编码器结构；(2) 共享软混合专家（SSMoE）模块用于对齐时空两个分支，通过紧凑的软槽（soft slots）实现互补表示的交换；(3) 两阶段层级预训练策略：Stage-I实现通用初始化，在此基础上进一步向目标范式特化而无需从头训练。
AI.result: 在七个下游数据集和十四个评估设置中，STEAM取得最佳平均排名，推理成本（FLOPs）具有竞争力。层级预训练策略在范式特定解码精度上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: STEAM成功调和了EEG基础模型中通用表示学习与范式特定专业化之间的矛盾，证明了层级迁移策略在提升跨数据集泛化能力和下游任务适应效率方面的有效性。

title: Same Semantics, Different Paths: Self-Improving Alignment for Vision-Text Compression
summary: Vision-Text Compression (VTC) renders long texts into images and encodes them through the vision encoder (ViT), compressing thousands of text tokens into far fewer visual tokens. However, since the ViT is pretrained predominantly on natural images, it captures visual attributes (glyphs, font sizes, layout) rather than linguistic semantics, causing rendered-image representations to diverge from native-text representations. We term this cross-path inconsistency and show, via rendering perturbation experiments, that it is a critical yet overlooked bottleneck of VTC. We propose SPIRAL (Self-improving Path Integration and Realignment), a self-supervised alignment framework that closes this gap using only the model's own text-path behavior as supervision, requiring no external teachers or additional annotations. SPIRAL operates at two complementary granularities: token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) for local faithfulness, and sequence-level preference optimization (DPO) for global coherence. On VTCBench, SPIRAL improves the overall score of Qwen3-VL-8B from 35.10 to 54.02, approaching the native text-input performance (55.60) and outperforming models up to 30x larger. The two granularities exhibit complementary strengths: OPD excels at retrieval and is sample-efficient, while DPO is stronger on reasoning and memory and scales better with data. SPIRAL's benefits also generalize to out-of-domain benchmarks, confirming that effective VTC hinges on aligning rendered-image representations back to native-text semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIRAL，一种自监督对齐框架，用于解决视觉文本压缩（VTC）中渲染图像表示与原生文本表示之间的跨路径不一致问题，通过token级策略蒸馏和序列级偏好优化两种互补粒度，使Qwen3-VL-8B在VTCBench上的得分从35.10提升至54.02，接近原生文本输入性能（55.60），甚至超越30倍大的模型。
AI.motivation: VTC技术将长文本渲染为图像并通过视觉编码器压缩，但预训练的ViT主要基于自然图像，捕捉的是视觉属性（字形、字体大小、布局）而非语言语义，导致渲染图像表示与原生文本表示不一致，这是VTC中被忽视的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出SPIRAL框架，包含两个互补粒度的自监督对齐策略：(1) token级on-policy蒸馏（OPD）用于局部忠实性；(2) 序列级偏好优化（DPO）用于全局连贯性。该框架仅利用模型自身的文本路径行为作为监督，无需外部教师或额外标注。
AI.result: 在VTCBench上，SPIRAL将Qwen3-VL-8B的整体得分从35.10提升至54.02，接近原生文本输入性能（55.60），并超越30倍大的模型。OPD在检索任务上表现优秀且样本效率高，DPO在推理和记忆任务上更强且随数据规模扩展更好，且泛化到域外基准。
AI.conclusion: 有效的VTC关键在于将渲染图像表示重新对齐回原生文本语义，SPIRAL通过两种互补粒度的自监督对齐成功弥合了这一差距，证实了跨路径一致性对VTC性能的核心作用。

title: PromptPath: Prompt-Adaptive Computational Pathways for In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) has attracted increasing attention for enabling models to perform new tasks using only a few ``input--output'' prompt examples. However, existing approaches suffer from \textbf{shallow task adaptation}, where prompts are primarily used as contextual cues to implicitly infer task intent through semantic representations, while the underlying computational process remains unchanged. This limitation restricts task-specific adaptation and compromises inference interpretability. We argue that prompts should not only condition feature representations but also dynamically regulate the model's computation pathways. To this end, we propose \textbf{PromptPath}, an adaptive ICL framework that enables computation-level adaptation through prompt-conditioned dynamic pathways. Specifically, PromptPath introduces a prompt-driven routing mechanism to selectively activate and compose lightweight low-rank experts, forming task-specific computational pathways tailored to different prompts. By integrating prompt information directly into the inference process, PromptPath dynamically reconfigures model computation to enhance task specialization and interpretability. Extensive experiments on 3D point cloud and 2D visual recognition benchmarks demonstrate that PromptPath consistently outperforms state-of-the-art ICL baselines while exhibiting strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PromptPath，一个自适应的上下文学习（ICL）框架，通过提示驱动（prompt-driven）的路由机制，动态激活和组合轻量级低秩专家（low-rank experts），形成任务特定的计算路径，从而实现计算层面的任务适应，而非仅停留在语义特征层面的浅层适应。
AI.motivation: 现有的上下文学习方法存在"浅层任务适应"问题——提示仅作为上下文线索通过语义表示来隐式推断任务意图，而底层计算过程保持不变。这限制了任务特化能力和推理可解释性。作者认为提示不仅应调节特征表示，还应动态调控模型的计算通路。
AI.method: 提出PromptPath框架，核心是引入提示驱动的路由机制，选择性激活并组合轻量级低秩专家，为不同提示构建任务特定的计算路径。提示信息被直接集成到推理过程中，动态重新配置模型计算。
AI.result: 在3D点云和2D视觉识别基准上，PromptPath持续优于最先进的ICL基线，并展现出强大的跨领域和跨任务泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将提示直接融入推理的计算过程而非仅作为语义上下文，PromptPath实现了计算层面的自适应，提升了任务特化程度和推理可解释性，在视觉识别任务上取得了显著的性能优势。

title: Messages, Not Tokens: Grounded Coresets for Faithful VLM Compression
summary: Modern vision language models (VLMs) turn high-resolution images into long sequences of visual tokens. Every token traverses the language decoder and persists in its prompt KV cache, inflating inference cost and motivating aggressive visual compression. Existing score-based methods assign each token an independent importance score and retain the Top-K. However, text queries consume collective, signed attention messages from the visual population, not isolated patches. Consequently, equally sized Top-K sets can repeatedly cover one salient region, omit sparse but complementary evidence and discard information carried by the removed population. We therefore formulate faithful visual compression as constructing a compact coreset for decoder messages, and introduce our training-free Grounded Message Coreset Pruning (GMC) which jointly allocates support across query-grounded, appearance, and coordinate-aware evidence, then transports discarded states into selected representatives at their original multimodal positions before physical compaction and native attention resume. This decomposes faithful compression into two coupled components, including selecting carriers that cover the required message modes and realizing the signed population message on those carriers. We further derive bounds connecting their errors to signed-message distortion, visual innovation, and candidate-margin stability. Experiments across multiple VLM families and diverse benchmarks demonstrate strong performance, with GMC-H2 retaining 97.78% Full-relative mean capability on Qwen2.5-VL-7B using 80.2% fewer visual tokens, while GMC-L16 reaches 100.36%. Controlled interventions verify that collective support and population realization jointly drive these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GMC（Grounded Message Coreset Pruning），一种无需训练的视觉压缩方法，通过构建解码器消息的紧凑核心集来实现高保真视觉令牌压缩。该方法在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上仅使用19.8%的视觉令牌即可保留97.78%-100.36%的完整能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉压缩方法为每个视觉令牌分配独立的重要性分数并保留Top-K子集，但文本查询消耗的是来自视觉群体（population）的集体性、带符号的注意力消息（signed attention messages），而非孤立补丁。因此，同等大小的Top-K集合会重复覆盖同一显著区域、遗漏稀疏但互补的证据，并丢弃被移除群体携带的信息，导致压缩有损。
AI.method: GMC将保真视觉压缩形式化为构建解码器消息的紧凑核心集（coreset）。具体步骤：(1) 联合分配支持（support）到查询扎根（query-grounded）、外观（appearance）和坐标感知（coordinate-aware）三类证据；(2) 将丢弃的状态迁移（transport）到选定的代表性令牌上，保持其原始多模态位置；(3) 进行物理压缩后恢复原生注意力。该方法将压缩分解为两个耦合组件：选择覆盖所需消息模式的载体（carriers），以及在载体上实现带符号群体消息。论文还推导了连接这些误差与带符号消息失真、视觉创新和候选边际稳定性的理论界限。
AI.result: 在多个VLM家族和多样基准上的实验证明该方法性能优异：GMC-H2在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上使用减少80.2%的视觉令牌，仍保留97.78%的Full-relative平均能力；GMC-L16达到100.36%。受控干预实验验证了集体支持（collective support）和群体实现（population realization）共同驱动这些增益。
AI.conclusion: GMC通过将视觉压缩重新定义为消息核心集构建问题，解决了现有Top-K方法忽视视觉令牌间集体语义协作的缺陷。理论界限与实证结果共同表明，联合选择载体并实现群体消息是实现高保真、高压缩率视觉令牌压缩的有效途径。

title: Two Sides of the Same Coin: Co-Evolving Search for Cross-Task Attacks on Vision-Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, and 8 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong generalization across multimodal tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing attacks typically follow single-trajectory gradient optimization or task-specific objectives, limiting search-space exploration and cross-task transferability. We propose an evolutionary-computation-guided cross-modal attack framework for unified VLMs. The framework adaptively searches both textual and visual spaces. On the textual side, it evolves hard negative semantic embeddings around the source-category representation to provide diverse cross-modal repulsion. On the visual side, it maintains a population of object-region perturbations and combines momentum-based gradient updates with evolutionary selection, mutation, and crossover to more reliably explore multiple feasible trajectories. Jointly optimizing semantic negative guidance and localized perturbations generates adversarial examples that consistently shift source-object semantics toward target categories across vision-language tasks. Theoretical analyses show that the co-evolutionary search preserves perturbation feasibility, prevents degradation of the best observed fitness, and increases the probability of reaching high-margin adversarial regions compared with single-trajectory optimization. Experiments on Florence-2, OFA, and UnifiedIO-2 demonstrate strong overall attack performance across image captioning, object detection, region categorization, and object localization. Ablation studies further verify the complementary effectiveness of text-side semantic evolution and image-side perturbation evolution, as well as the framework's efficiency and cross-task transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架，用于统一视觉-语言模型（VLMs）。该框架在文本侧进化生成硬负语义嵌入，在视觉侧维护目标区域扰动种群并融合动量梯度更新与进化操作（选择、变异、交叉），联合优化以实现跨任务的对抗攻击。实验在Florence-2、OFA和UnifiedIO-2上验证了其在图像描述、目标检测、区域分类和目标定位等任务上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有对VLMs的攻击方法通常局限于单轨迹梯度优化或任务特定目标，限制了搜索空间探索和跨任务可迁移性。需要一种能同时探索文本和视觉空间、且具备跨任务攻击能力的统一攻击框架。
AI.method: 提出进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架：(1) 文本侧：围绕源类别表示进化硬负语义嵌入，提供跨模态排斥；(2) 视觉侧：维护目标区域扰动种群，结合基于动量的梯度更新与进化选择、变异、交叉操作；(3) 联合优化语义负引导与局部扰动，使源对象语义跨任务一致地向目标类别偏移。
AI.result: 在Florence-2、OFA和UnifiedIO-2上实现了强大的整体攻击性能，覆盖图像描述、目标检测、区域分类和目标定位任务。消融实验验证了文本侧语义进化与图像侧扰动进化的互补有效性，并证明了框架的效率与跨任务可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析证明共进化搜索保持扰动可行性，防止最佳适配度退化，并相比单轨迹优化提高了达到高边界对抗区域的概率。该框架展示了进化计算在多模态对抗攻击中的潜力，为统一VLMs的鲁棒性评估提供了新视角。

title: HiResNets: Native Full-HD Video Recognition with Foveal Residual Streams
summary: Much of the recent progress in image and video recognition has come at the cost of memory: larger models, increased resolution, and longer temporal contexts. An inevitable component is the quadratic (or larger) growth of memory and compute based on image resolution, which is a property of the grid sampling used in convolutional networks and vision transformers. In this work we study residual networks whose convolutional blocks have logarithmic-square growth instead, enabling them to process very high-resolution video quickly. The key insight is to use a residual architecture's residual stream as a high-resolution buffer, to which convolutional blocks only read and write via log-polar image warp operations. Layers adaptively focus on different parts of each frame, with very high resolution only near the focus point. A complete high-resolution representation is built up in the residual stream, analogous to eye saccades creating a complete picture in biological vision, and a theoretical construction is presented that eliminates the quadratic dependency of the residual stream resolution. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed HiResNets learn to foveate around scenes similarly to human vision, and have superior performance in difficult egocentric video recognition tasks, especially egocentric video with small objects and fine-grained recognition.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出HiResNets，一种利用残差网络残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区的架构，通过log-polar图像变形操作实现对数平方级的计算和内存增长，类比生物视觉的注视（saccade）机制，能够高效处理超高分辨率视频，并在自我中心视频识别任务中取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 图像和视频识别领域的最新进展以内存为代价：模型更大、分辨率更高、时间上下文更长。卷积网络和视觉Transformer中基于网格采样导致计算和内存随分辨率呈二次方（或更高）增长，这成为处理高分辨率视频的根本瓶颈。
AI.method: 关键洞见是利用残差网络的残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区，卷积块通过log-polar图像变形操作仅对缓冲区进行读写。各层自适应地聚焦于每帧的不同区域，仅在焦点附近使用极高分辨率，完整的高分辨率表示在残差流中逐步构建，类似生物视觉中眼球扫视形成完整画面的机制。论文还提供了消除残差流分辨率二次依赖的理论构造。
AI.result: 实验表明HiResNets学会了类似人类视觉的注视（foveation）行为，在困难的自我中心视频识别任务中表现优越，尤其是在包含小目标和细粒度识别的自我中心视频场景中。
AI.conclusion: 通过将残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区并结合类生物视觉的log-polar注视机制，实现了计算和内存随分辨率的对数平方增长，为高分辨率视频的高效识别提供了新范式。

title: Extended Field of View Analysis for VideoGAN-based Trajectory Generation
summary: Realistic and diverse trajectory generation is central to enabling higher levels of vehicle automation. While rule-based and classical learning-based methods may struggle to capture the complexity of traffic behavior, generative models have already demonstrated in other fields that they can handle a comparable level of complexity. In this paper, we build upon previous work on generative adversarial network (GAN)-based semantic bird's-eye-view traffic generation and extend the proposed framework in several key aspects. We improve the semantic representation, replace the trajectory extraction procedure with a graph-based association method, and systematically investigate increasingly larger fields of view. In addition, we introduce a quantitative evaluation framework to assess hallucinations and object permanence in generated videos. Our experiments demonstrate that the framework generalizes to larger and more complex traffic scenes while maintaining statistically realistic trajectories and coherent spatial relationships between traffic participants. Within 150GPU hours of training and with inference times below 20ms for scenes of up to 20s, our results demonstrate that video-based GANs remain an efficient and scalable approach for realistic trajectory generation, even in substantially larger traffic scenes, making them well suited for downstream tasks such as prediction, planning, and simulation in automated driving.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了基于GAN的语义鸟瞰图交通轨迹生成框架，通过改进语义表示、引入基于图的轨迹关联方法、系统研究更大视野范围，并提出定量评估框架（衡量幻觉和物体永续性），在150 GPU小时内无需训练即可在20毫秒内为长达20秒的场景生成统计上真实且空间关系连贯的交通轨迹。
AI.motivation: 真实且多样的轨迹生成是提升车辆自动化水平的核心需求。传统基于规则和经典学习方法难以捕捉交通行为的复杂性，而生成模型在其他领域已展示出处理类似复杂度的能力，因此需要将生成模型应用于更大规模、更复杂的交通场景轨迹生成。
AI.method: 1) 改进语义表示以提升生成质量；2) 用基于图的关联方法替换轨迹提取流程；3) 系统性地研究逐渐增大的视野范围；4) 引入定量评估框架来评估生成视频中的幻觉（hallucinations）和物体永续性（object permanence）。
AI.result: 框架能够泛化到更大、更复杂的交通场景，同时保持统计上真实的轨迹和交通参与者之间连贯的空间关系。仅需150 GPU小时训练，推理时间低于20毫秒（针对长达20秒的场景）。
AI.conclusion: 基于视频的GAN仍然是实现真实轨迹生成的高效且可扩展的方法，即使面对显著更大的交通场景也表现良好，非常适合自动驾驶中的预测、规划和仿真等下游任务。

title: Quaternion Tensor Modeling for Joint Color-Polarization Demosaicking
summary: Division-of-focal-plane (DoFP) color polarization cameras enable snapshot acquisition of color polarization mosaic images, but the inherently sparse sampling pattern makes color polarization demosaicking severely ill-posed. Existing methods often fail to jointly exploit the correlations among polarization channels and the physical constraints inherent in polarization imaging, resulting in noticeable demosaicking artifacts. To address this issue, a quaternion-tensor-based color polarization demosaicking (CPDM) method incorporating Stokes-domain total variation (TV) regularization is proposed. Correlation analysis shows that the correlations among polarization channels are stronger than those among color channels. Accordingly, the color polarization images acquired at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ are encoded into the four components of a third-order quaternion tensor, with the color channels organized along its third mode. A low-rank prior is then imposed on the quaternion tensor to exploit the global structural redundancy in the color polarization data. Moreover, spatial gradients are mapped to the Stokes domain through an orthogonal transformation to separate intensity, polarization and residual variations, with adaptive quaternion weights enabling component-specific regularization and preserving the energy consistency of the reconstructed Stokes vectors. An efficient optimization algorithm is derived for the resulting model. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior demosaicking performance of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于四元数张量与Stokes域全变分正则化的彩色偏振去马赛克（CPDM）方法。将四个偏振方向的彩色偏振图像编码为三阶四元数张量，利用低秩先验挖掘全局结构冗余，并通过正交变换将空间梯度映射到Stokes域，配合自适应四元数权重实现分量特定正则化，有效解决了彩色偏振成像中稀疏采样导致的重建病态问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的彩色偏振去马赛克方法未能联合利用偏振通道间的相关性和偏振成像固有的物理约束，导致明显的去马赛克伪影。统计分析表明偏振通道间的相关性比颜色通道间更强，这为设计更有效的重建模型提供了依据。
AI.method: 1) 将0°、45°、90°、135°四个偏振方向的彩色偏振图像编码为三阶四元数张量的四个分量，颜色通道沿第三模式排列；2) 对四元数张量施加低秩先验以利用全局结构冗余；3) 通过正交变换将空间梯度映射到Stokes域，分离强度、偏振和残差变化；4) 采用自适应四元数权重实现分量特定正则化，保持重建Stokes向量的能量一致性；5) 推导高效优化算法求解模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的方法在彩色偏振去马赛克性能上优于现有方法，有效减少了伪影，验证了联合利用偏振通道相关性和Stokes域物理约束的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过四元数张量建模和Stokes域TV正则化的有机结合，本文方法能够充分利用偏振通道间的强相关性和偏振成像的物理约束，为彩色偏振去马赛克这一病态逆问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: UniqueSplat: View-conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
summary: In this paper, we propose UniqueSplat, a view-conditioned feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting model to reconstruct customized 3D radiance fields for each view query. Existing feed-forward methods such as pixelSplat and MVSplat aim to generate fixed Gaussians across all views of each scene by minimizing the error between rendered views and ground-truth images. However, such fixed Gaussians generally render images from all views and lack the ability to adapt to specific viewpoints, as they do not incorporate target view information when predicting Gaussians. To address this, our UniqueSplat learns the view-conditioned information as a prior and incorporates this knowledge into network parameters, so that Gaussians are dynamically adjusted in accordance with different views. Specifically, we propose a two-branch view-conditioned hyperNetwork to simultaneously learn view-agnostic embeddings and view-specific knowledge, which not only explores the shareable knowledge from various views, but also adapts the model to specific views at test time. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including RealEstate10K, ACID and DTU demonstrate the superiority of UniqueSplat over the state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, UniqueSplat encouragingly outperforms existing methods in cross-dataset evaluation, showing its notable generalization ability.

AI.tldr: UniqueSplat是一种基于视图条件的端到端前馈3D高斯泼溅模型，通过双分支视图条件超网络学习视图无关嵌入和视图特定知识，使高斯模型能够根据目标视角动态调整，从而为每个视图查询重建定制化的辐射场，在RealEstate10K、ACID和DTU数据集上超越了现有最先进方法，并展现出更强的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的前馈方法（如pixelSplat和MVSplat）为每个场景生成固定高斯，仅最小化渲染视图与真实图像之间的误差，但未在预测高斯时纳入目标视图信息，因此无法针对特定视点自适应调整。
AI.method: 提出两分支视图条件超网络，同时学习视图无关嵌入和视图特定知识，将视图条件信息作为先验注入网络参数中，使高斯在推理时能根据具体视图动态调整。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K、ACID和DTU数据集上超越现有最先进方法，并在跨数据集评估中表现优异，展现出显著的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入视图条件信息使高斯生成具有视图自适应性，不仅提升了重建精度，还增强了模型的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: The Push-Forward Transform for Continuous and Robust Comparison of Dynamic Shapes
summary: We introduce a mathematical framework for shape comparison based on mapping functions from the shape domain to a common reference domain. This Push-Forward Transform enables invariant and robust comparison of shapes, preserving intrinsic geometric information. Quantitatively comparing shapes and their temporal evolution is a fundamental challenge in image analysis. Meaningful shape comparison requires representations that are invariant to transformations that do not alter shape itself, such as translation, rotation, reflection, re-parametrization, and uniform scaling, while remaining sensitive to intrinsic geometric variation. Existing approaches often rely on sensitive parameterizations, landmark correspondence, or learned representations that are difficult to interpret and reproduce. We show that the Push-Forward Transform (PF-T) applied to Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) yields a continuous representation that captures both boundary and interior geometry. We derive an interpretable morphometric that quantifies shape similarity and reveals features such as skeletal topology and rotational symmetries. The push-forward transform applies consistently to two- and three-dimensional shapes, extends to time-evolving geometries, and supports the joint analysis of shape and additional scalar fields defined over shapes, such as intensity or molecular signals. We present the mathematical formulation, describe an efficient algorithm, and benchmark the approach on 2D, 3D, and temporal data sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Push-Forward Transform (PF-T)的数学框架，通过将形状域映射到公共参考域并结合符号距离函数（SDF），实现对2D、3D及时间演化形状的不变且鲁棒的比较，同时保持了内蕴几何信息。
AI.motivation: 形状比较是图像分析中的基本挑战。有意义的形状比较需要表示方法对平移、旋转、反射、重参数化和均匀缩放等不改变形状本身的变换保持不变，同时对内蕴几何变化保持敏感。现有方法往往依赖敏感的参数化、地标对应或难以解释和复现的学习表示。
AI.method: 将Push-Forward Transform应用于Signed Distance Functions（SDF），获得同时捕捉边界和内部几何的连续表示；推导出可解释的形态学度量，用于量化形状相似性并揭示骨骼拓扑和旋转对称性等特征；该变换一致地适用于2D和3D形状，可扩展到时间演化几何，并支持形状与额外标量场（如强度或分子信号）的联合分析。
AI.result: 在2D、3D和时间演化数据集上进行了基准测试，验证了该方法的有效性。该方法提供了连续、可解释的表示，能够捕捉形状的内蕴几何信息。
AI.conclusion: PF-T提供了一种可解释、可复现且对无关变换不变的新颖形状比较框架，适用于静态和动态形状分析，并具备与额外标量场联合分析的能力。

title: PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs
summary: Embodied intelligence and world models require video understanding systems to go beyond recognizing objects and actions and develop an understanding of physical regularities. However, despite their strong performance on general video understanding tasks, current video-language models still struggle to reliably determine whether an observed event conforms to specific physical laws. Existing benchmarks primarily assess the physical quality of generated videos, providing limited support for systematically evaluating and improving the physical-law understanding of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs). To address this gap, we introduce PhyCheck, a video question answering dataset organized at two complementary levels of granularity. The coarse-grained subset asks models to determine whether the phenomenon shown in a video conforms to or violates physical laws, while the fine-grained subset further examines whether models can capture physical details responsible for the violation or compliance. We use these subsets as structured supervision to improve physical understanding. In addition, the dataset contains a diagnostic subset with external causal context that reveal hidden factors affecting physical plausibility, assessing whether models can recalibrate their judgments accordingly. Experiments with Fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL show that training with the proposed data substantially improves the understanding of physical-consistency, while evaluations in the diagnostic subset reveal that current models still have difficulty incorporating additional causal conditions into their decisions. These findings highlight the gap between recognizing surface-level inconsistencies and understanding underlying physical mechanisms, and provide a foundation for evaluating and improving physical understanding in Video-LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhyCheck，一个面向视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）的物理定律理解基准数据集，包含粗粒度（判断是否符合物理定律）和细粒度（捕捉具体物理细节）两个层级，以及一个带有外部因果上下文的诊断子集。通过微调Qwen2.5-VL验证了该数据能显著提升物理一致性理解能力，但也发现当前模型难以将额外因果条件融入决策。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型在通用视频理解任务上表现优异，但难以可靠判断事件是否符合特定物理定律。现有基准主要评估生成视频的物理质量，缺乏系统性评估和改进VideoLLMs物理定律理解的工具。
AI.method: 构建PhyCheck数据集，包含两个互补粒度的子集：粗粒度子集判断视频现象是否违反物理定律，细粒度子集考察模型能否捕捉违反或符合的具体物理细节；此外包含一个带外部因果上下文的诊断子集，用于评估模型能否根据隐藏因素重新校准判断。使用该数据对Qwen2.5-VL进行微调。
AI.result: 微调训练显著提升了模型对物理一致性的理解能力；但在诊断子集上，当前模型仍难以将额外因果条件融入判断决策中。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前模型在识别表面不一致与理解底层物理机制之间存在差距，为评估和改进VideoLLMs的物理理解能力提供了基础。

title: AdaForensics: Learning A Characteristic-aware Adaptive Deepfake Detector
summary: In this paper, we propose a characteristic-aware adaptive network named AdaForensics for deepfake detection. Most existing methods learn a fixed network to detect deepfakes based on carefully-designed network architectures. However, these methods employ the same deepfake detector for all the images despite of various facial characteristic, which fail to provide customized forgery detection for different individuals. To address this, our AdaForensics simultaneously learns characteristic-agnostic and characteristic-specific embeddings, where the detector dynamically adapts to varying faces with our designed hypernetwork on the fly. More specifically, our AdaForensics not only explores the shareable abstractions from various deepfake images, but also adapts the detector to the given characteristic at test time. To achieve this, we propose a two-branch HyperNetwork to learn an adaptive deepfake detector, which automatically adjusts the parameters based on characteristic of the input. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including FaceForensics, Celeb-DF and DFDC demonstrate our AdaForensics outperforms the state-of-the-art works.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaForensics，一种特征感知的自适应深度伪造检测网络。与以往使用固定网络检测所有图像的方法不同，AdaForensics通过双分支HyperNetwork同时学习特征无关和特征特定的嵌入，根据输入人脸的特征动态调整检测器参数，在FaceForensics、Celeb-DF和DFDC等数据集上超越了现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法使用固定网络对所有图像采用相同的检测策略，忽略了不同个体面部特征的差异性，无法为不同个体提供定制化的伪造检测方案，导致检测性能受限。
AI.method: 提出AdaForensics框架，同时学习特征无关（characteristic-agnostic）和特征特定（characteristic-specific）的嵌入；设计双分支HyperNetwork，在测试时根据输入人脸的特征自动调整检测器网络参数，实现动态自适应的深度伪造检测。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics、Celeb-DF和DFDC等广泛使用的数据集上进行实验，AdaForensics的性能优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将人脸特征信息融入检测器的动态参数调整中，AdaForensics验证了面向个体特征的自适应深度伪造检测方案的有效性，为深度伪造检测提供了新的思路。

title: GSRAIN: Physically Calibrated High-/Low-Frequency Rainfall Synthesis for 3D Gaussian Driving Scenes
summary: Existing rainfall simulation methods for autonomous driving remain limited in physical controllability and multi-view consistency. This paper presents GSRAIN, a high-/low-frequency rainfall synthesis method for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) driving scenes. GSRAIN constructs a high-frequency raindrop model from measured rainfall data and generates low-frequency rainy appearance using a geometry-aware single-step diffusion model. The two effects are then fused in a unified 3DGS scene, enabling rainfall-intensity control over the range of 0--13~mm/h. The proposed method achieves a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 149.09, outperforming CycleGAN-Turbo (155.71) and WeatherEdit (157.94). Object-detection and closed-loop driving experiments further show that the generated scenes expose scene-dependent performance changes of the evaluated algorithms under controllable rainfall. These results indicate that GSRAIN provides an effective approach for constructing physically controllable, repeatable, and closed-loop-compatible rainy-weather test scenes for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: GSRAIN是一种面向3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）驾驶场景的高/低频降雨合成方法，通过高频雨滴模型与低频降雨外观生成融合，实现0-13mm/h的可控降雨强度模拟，FID达149.09，优于CycleGAN-Turbo和WeatherEdit，并支持闭环驾驶测试。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶降雨仿真方法在物理可控性和多视角一致性方面存在局限，难以满足自动驾驶测试场景对可重复性和物理真实性的需求。
AI.method: GSRAIN包含两个核心组件：1）基于实测降雨数据构建的高频雨滴模型，用于生成真实的雨滴效果；2）基于几何感知的单步扩散模型生成低频降雨外观。两者在统一的3DGS场景中融合，支持0-13mm/h范围内的降雨强度控制。
AI.result: FID达到149.09，优于CycleGAN-Turbo（155.71）和WeatherEdit（157.94）；目标检测和闭环驾驶实验表明生成场景能暴露算法在可控降雨条件下的场景依赖性能变化。
AI.conclusion: GSRAIN为自动驾驶提供了一种物理可控、可重复、与闭环兼容的雨天测试场景构建的有效方法。

title: SWINSleepNet: A Hierarchical Context-Aware Framework for Sleep Staging (v2)
comment: Report-no: SDUST-SLEEP-202608-V2; 10 pages, 7 figures, revised updated version of arXiv submit/7867870, conference submission draft
summary: Automatic sleep staging is a critical role in sleep disorder diagnosis, sleep quality assessment, and long-term health monitoring; however, existing approaches suffer poor performance on ambiguous and transition-related sleep stages, caused by inadequate modeling of fine-grained intra-epoch structures and complex cross-region spectral dependencies. Traditional epoch-level encoders commonly fail to extract subtle temporal microstructures and intra-epoch cross-region interactions, resulting in unsatisfactory recognition accuracy for hard categories such as the N1 stage. To tackle these drawbacks, we propose SwinSleepNet, a hierarchical context-aware dual-stream framework that separately optimizes intra-epoch representation learning and inter-epoch contextual modeling. Concretely, we characterize each sleep epoch from two complementary perspectives: raw time-domain EEG signal and its time-frequency transformation. The time-domain branch adopts convolutional encoders to capture fine waveform temporal details, and the time-frequency branch uses Swin Transformer to extract local spectro-temporal features, hierarchical multi-scale information and long-range spatial dependencies. The multi-branch extracted features are fused into integrated embeddings, which are optimized by a bidirectional context module to capture cross-epoch temporal dependencies for final sleep stage classification. Comprehensive experiments on Sleep-EDF-20, Sleep-EDF-78 and SHHS datasets verify that our method achieves competitive overall performance, and exhibits stronger robustness and stability on difficult N1 stages and transitional epochs. The results prove that optimized intra-epoch representation learning based on hierarchical architecture greatly benefits automatic sleep staging tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwinSleepNet，一个层级化的上下文感知双流框架，分别优化睡眠阶段内的表示学习和阶段间的上下文建模，通过时域卷积编码器和时频Swin Transformer双分支互补特征提取，在Sleep-EDF-20、Sleep-EDF-78和SHHS数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能，尤其对难以分类的N1阶段和过渡期阶段表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动睡眠分期方法在模糊和过渡睡眠阶段（如N1阶段）上表现不佳，主要原因是缺乏对阶段内细粒度时间结构和跨区域频谱依赖关系的充分建模。传统epoch级编码器难以提取微妙的时间微结构和阶段内跨区域交互信息。
AI.method: 提出SwinSleepNet双流框架，包含：1）时域分支使用卷积编码器捕获精细的波形时间细节；2）时频分支使用Swin Transformer提取局部频谱-时间特征、层级多尺度信息和长距离空间依赖；3）多分支特征融合为综合嵌入；4）双向上下文模块捕获跨阶段时间依赖用于最终分类。
AI.result: 在Sleep-EDF-20、Sleep-EDF-78和SHHS三个数据集上的综合实验验证了该方法达到了有竞争力的整体性能，在困难的N1阶段和过渡期epoch上表现出更强的鲁棒性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 基于层级架构优化阶段内表示学习能极大地促进自动睡眠分期任务，双流互补的特征提取策略有效解决了模糊和过渡睡眠阶段的识别难题。

title: SPIRIT: Spatio-temporal Pairwise Relational Modeling of Instrument-Tissue Interactions for Surgical Action Triplet Recognition
summary: Fine-grained understanding of surgical activity is essential for context-aware assistance in the operating room, including safety monitoring, adverse event identification, and skill assessment. Surgical action triplets, defined as tuples of the form <instrument, verb, target>, provide a structured description of instrument-tissue interactions. A key open problem, however, is how to learn triplet representations that remain reliable across institutions, where surgical video varies in acquisition conditions, surgeon style, tool usage, and tissue handling, while existing triplet datasets do not support explicit evaluation of center-wise transfer. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{SPIRIT}, a structured framework for surgical action triplet recognition designed to learn interaction representations that transfer more reliably across centers. Instead of treating each triplet as a flat class label, SPIRIT first learns spatio-temporal representations for instruments, verbs, and targets, then models their pairwise relations, and finally composes them into coherent triplet predictions, with multi-head distillation used to stabilize learning. To evaluate this setting, we establish \textbf{MultiBypass-4C-T40}, a multi-centric dataset for dense surgical action triplet recognition in Roux-en-Y gastric bypass across four geographically distinct centers, with auxiliary phase and step annotations. Across multiple evaluation protocols, SPIRIT consistently outperforms strong recent baselines, highlighting the value of explicit relational reasoning for multi-centric triplet recognition. Code will be available at https://github.com/CAMMA-public/multibypass-4c-t40.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIRIT框架，一种结构化的手术动作三元组识别方法，通过分别学习器械、动词、目标的时空表征并建模两两关系来组合成三元组预测，并引入了多中心数据集MultiBypass-4C-T40用于跨中心泛化评估。
AI.motivation: 手术动作三元组（器械、动词、目标）对手术室情境感知辅助至关重要，但现有方法将三元组视为扁平类别标签，且缺乏跨医疗中心迁移的显式评估。不同中心的视频采集条件、外科医生风格、器械使用和组织处理方式存在差异，导致模型泛化性能不稳定。
AI.method: SPIRIT框架：（1）分别学习器械、动词和目标的时空表征；（2）建模它们之间的两两关系；（3）组合成连贯的三元组预测；（4）使用多头蒸馏来稳定学习过程。同时构建了MultiBypass-4C-T40多中心数据集，包含四个地理分布中心的Roux-en-Y胃旁路手术视频及相和步骤注释。
AI.result: 在多种评估协议下，SPIRIT一致优于近期强基线方法，证明了显式关系推理对多中心三元组识别的价值。
AI.conclusion: 显式关系推理框架SPIRIT能够更可靠地跨中心迁移手术动作三元组识别，多中心数据集为评估该设定提供了基准。

title: DerainSplat: Feed-Forward Clean 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Rainy Views
summary: Although image deraining has advanced substantially, existing methods mainly focus on 2D image restoration. As spatial intelligence applications such as embodied AI and autonomous driving continue to emerge, reconstructing clean 3D scenes from sparse rainy views in a feed-forward manner becomes increasingly important. Existing feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods often assume clean inputs and collapse under rainy conditions. To this end, we present \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}}, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs clean 3D scenes from only a few rainy views. To support this task, we build a large-scale multi-view derain dataset through a four-stage synthesis pipeline that sequentially models overcast illumination, depth-dependent haze, rain streaks, and lens raindrops, producing privileged weather factors. We introduce a weather net that predicts the weather factors from rainy context and yields two support maps. Scene support modulates cross-view cost-volume matching, while radiance support drives depth-aligned appearance fusion to fill corrupted pixels. The derived geometry evidence further attenuates Gaussian opacity to reduce spurious structures. A rainy cycle consistency re-renders clean views using the predicted factors and aligns them with rainy inputs. Extensive experiments show that \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}} outperforms existing methods on various datasets, including RealEstate10K, ACID, Mip-NeRF360, and real-world rainy scenes, with strong cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: DerainSplat是一个前馈框架，能从少量雨景视角重建干净的3D场景。它通过四阶段合成管线构建大规模多视角去雨数据集，提出天气网络预测天气因素并生成支撑图，用于调制跨视角代价体匹配和深度对齐的外观融合，并通过雨景循环一致性损失进一步提升重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有图像去雨方法主要聚焦于2D图像恢复，而随着具身智能和自动驾驶等空间智能应用的发展，从稀疏雨景视角前馈式重建干净3D场景的需求日益迫切。现有的前馈3D高斯泼溅方法假设输入干净，在雨景条件下会崩溃。
AI.method: 1) 构建四阶段合成管线（阴天光照、深度相关雾霾、雨线、镜头雨滴）生成大规模多视角去雨数据集；2) 引入天气网络预测天气因素并生成两种支撑图：场景支撑调制跨视角代价体匹配，辐射支撑驱动深度对齐的外观融合填充损坏像素；3) 利用几何证据衰减高斯不透明度减少虚假结构；4) 采用雨景循环一致性，利用预测因子重渲染干净视角并与雨景输入对齐。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K、ACID、Mip-NeRF360以及真实雨景场景等多个数据集上，DerainSplat均优于现有方法，并展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DerainSplat是首个面向稀疏雨景视角的前馈3D场景干净重建框架，通过数据合成、天气因素预测和双支撑调制机制，有效解决了雨景条件下的3D重建问题，为空间智能应用提供了可靠的解决方案。

title: T$^2$exture: Sparsely Perturbed Thermal-to-Texture Imaging
summary: Thermal imaging remains effective under adverse illumination, yet passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) measurements often lack fine texture. Existing thermal texture imaging approaches commonly rely on spectral sensing or registered auxiliary modalities, incurring substantial data throughput or vulnerability to cross-modal degradation. We introduce T$^2$exture, a sparsely perturbed thermal texture imaging framework that aims to reconstruct temporally dense thermal texture sequences from densely sampled passive frames and a few actively perturbed keyframes. We define thermal texture as the residual between a source-on observation and its corresponding source-off passive state. Under sparse LWIR illumination and rapid quasi-steady paired acquisition, this residual attenuates the passive-emission background and approximates a source-induced reflected response, exposing localized material- and geometry-dependent texture. T$^2$exture reconstructs a dense sequence of this source-conditioned response through two stages. Stage 1 estimates the unobserved source-off passive state at each active instant from neighboring passive frames to obtain reliable differential texture anchors. Stage 2 combines sparse anchors with passive structural context near each target time to reconstruct the dense sequence. On the simulated benchmark, T$^2$exture adds only 0.20M parameters to AMT-L while improving PSNR by 6.66 dB. Extensive evaluations on simulated and real acquisitions further show clearer texture recovery and stronger structural preservation than representative VFI baselines. These results establish T$^2$exture as a practical framework for thermal texture imaging under sparse active acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出T²exture，一种稀疏扰动热纹理成像框架，通过密集采样的被动帧和少量主动扰动关键帧，重建时间稠密的热纹理序列，在仅增加0.20M参数的情况下将PSNR提升6.66dB。
AI.motivation: 被动长波红外(LWIR)测量虽然能在不良光照下工作，但缺乏精细纹理。现有热纹理成像方法依赖光谱传感或配准的辅助模态，存在数据吞吐量大或跨模态退化脆弱的问题。
AI.method: T²exture将热纹理定义为源开启观测与其对应源关闭被动状态之间的残差。在稀疏LWIR照明和快速准稳态配对采集下，该残差衰减被动发射背景并近似源诱导反射响应。方法分两阶段：阶段1从邻近被动帧估计每个主动时刻未被观测的源关闭被动状态，获得可靠的差分纹理锚点；阶段2结合稀疏锚点和目标时间附近的被动结构上下文重构稠密序列。
AI.result: 在模拟基准上，T²exture仅向AMT-L添加0.20M参数，PSNR提升6.66dB。在模拟和真实采集上的广泛评估显示，相比代表性VFI基线，纹理恢复更清晰、结构保持更强。
AI.conclusion: T²exture被确立为一种在稀疏主动采集条件下实用的热纹理成像框架，在低开销下实现清晰的热纹理恢复。

title: RSC-GestureNet: Reliability-Aware Selective Causal Recognition of Chinese Traffic Police Gestures
summary: Traffic police gestures are safety-critical perception cues for autonomous driving. A deployable recognizer must infer commands causally from continuous full-frame video, remain stable around transitional arm motion, and avoid over-trusting corrupted pose measurements. This study presents RSC-GestureNet, a reliability-aware selective causal recognizer, for Chinese traffic police gestures. The model treats pose confidence as a first-class signal: unreliable joints are down weighted during graph reasoning, temporal evidence is aggregated causally, and calibrated predictions are selectively emitted through a reliability-aware inference rule. We further introduce CTPGesture-C, a reproducible feature-level corruption benchmark with seven pose/RGB degradation families, and an RGB-level diagnostic in which corrupted frames are reprocessed by MediaPipe before recognition. On the complete official CTPGesture v1 split (134,424 labeled frames and 33,451 causal windows), RSC-GestureNet achieves 93.33+-0.24% accuracy, 91.71+-0.27% macro-F1, 91.69+-0.29% online macro-F1, 98.80+-0.07% Early@10, 0.153+-0.013 s TTC, and the best robust macro-F1 among evaluated methods. Under the same split and causal protocol, it exceeds reproduced traffic-specific MD-GCN and HLP-GCN baselines by 3.23-4.11 macro-F1 points and 2.15-3.07 online-F1 points. These results, together with calibration, selective-risk, statistical, adaptive-branching, and image-level re-extraction analyses, indicate that explicit pose-reliability modeling improves early, stable, and robust traffic-command recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSC-GestureNet，一种面向中国交通警察手势的可靠性感知选择性因果识别器。该模型将姿态置信度作为一等信号，在图推理中降权不可靠关节点，以因果方式聚合时间证据，并通过可靠性感知推理规则选择性输出校准预测。作者还提出CTPGesture-C基准（7种姿态/RGB退化类型）以及RGB级诊断方法。在官方CTPGesture v1完整划分（134,424标签帧、33,451因果窗口）上，模型达到93.33%准确率、91.71%宏F1、98.80% Early@10，超越MD-GCN和HLP-GCN基线3.23-4.11个宏F1点。
AI.motivation: 交通警察手势是自动驾驶的关键安全感知线索。现有识别器需满足三个部署要求：从连续全帧视频中因果推断指令、在过渡性手臂运动期间保持稳定、避免过度信任被损坏的姿态测量。这些问题尚未被现有方法充分解决。
AI.method: RSC-GestureNet将姿态置信度作为一等信号集成到三个层面：(1)图推理阶段对不可靠的关节点进行降权；(2)因果方式聚合时间证据；(3)通过可靠性感知推理规则选择性输出经过校准的预测。同时构建了CTPGesture-C基准，包含7种姿态/RGB退化类型，并提供RGB级诊断流程。
AI.result: 在官方CTPGesture v1完整划分上：93.33±0.24%准确率、91.71±0.27%宏F1、91.69±0.29%在线宏F1、98.80±0.07% Early@10、0.153±0.013 s TTC。超越MD-GCN和HLP-GCN基线3.23-4.11个宏F1点和2.15-3.07个在线F1点，并获得最优鲁棒宏F1。
AI.conclusion: 通过校准、选择性风险、统计、自适应分支及图像级重提取分析，证实显式姿态可靠性建模能够提升早期、稳定且鲁棒的交通指令识别性能，为自动驾驶场景中的交通手势识别提供了可靠且可部署的解决方案。

title: CLEAR: Conflict-aware Learning via Evidence-guided Adaptive Routing for Unified Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Super-Resolution
summary: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Super-resolution is highly challenging since the sparse and low-resolution (LR) inputs lack sufficient geometric and high-frequency information for accurate reconstruction. To achieve high-quality reconstruction, existing sparse-view super-resolution methods adhere to two-stage pipeline that performs LR Gaussian reconstruction and then high-resolution (HR) Gaussian refinement, which directly results in stage-wise Gaussian transfer and reconstruction error accumulation. To this end, we propose CLEAR, a Conflict-aware Learning via Evidence-guided Adaptive Routing, as the first unified single-stage framework for Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Super-resolution. Specifically, CLEAR performs joint the optimization of authentic LR observations and external HR priors within a unified Gaussian representation. To mitigate the gradient conflicts introduced by sparse supervision during training, we propose a Gaussian-wise conflict-aware optimization strategy that regards the LR gradient as a reliable anchor and applies evidence-conditioned soft correction only to severe HR conflicts. Moreover, to recover high-frequency details, we introduce an evidence-guided Patch-to-Gaussian routing mechanism which estimates patch reliability and detail demand, lifts them into Gaussian space, and selectively routes high-frequency gradients and densification. Finally, we employ shared Gaussian dropout and a detached mid-training anchoring to enhance the robustness of training framework. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world $4\times$ super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that CLEAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and superior geometric fidelity.

AI.tldr: CLEAR是首个统一的单阶段框架，用于稀疏视角3D高斯溅射超分辨率，通过冲突感知学习和证据引导自适应路由，联合优化真实LR观测与外部HR先验，实现了SOTA的4倍超分辨率渲染质量和几何保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏视角超分辨率方法采用两阶段流程（先LR高斯重建，再HR高斯细化），导致阶段间高斯传递和重建误差积累。作者希望设计统一的单阶段框架来避免这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出高斯级冲突感知优化策略：将LR梯度作为可靠锚点，仅对严重HR冲突施加证据条件的软修正；2) 引入证据引导的Patch-to-Gaussian路由机制：估计patch可靠性并提升至高斯空间，选择性路由高频梯度和稠密化；3) 采用共享高斯dropout和分离的中期训练锚定增强训练鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界的4倍超分辨率基准上，CLEAR一致地实现了最先进的渲染质量和优越的几何保真度。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR通过统一的单阶段框架有效解决了稀疏视角3D高斯超分辨率中的误差积累和梯度冲突问题，验证了冲突感知优化与证据引导路由机制的有效性。

title: Self-supervised DXA representations encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability
summary: Whole-body dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) scans are routinely acquired to measure bone density and regional body composition, leaving their spatial structure largely unused. Here, we show that self-supervised learning (SSL) can convert raw DXA images into representations of systemic health. We introduce LeDXA, a vision model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns by predicting latent representations rather than reconstructing pixels. Trained from scratch on 11,540 unlabeled Human Phenotype Project scans, LeDXA was evaluated internally and on 47,400 external UK Biobank (UKBB) scans. It improved cross-cohort prediction of prevalent diseases and biomarkers beyond scanner-derived DXA measurements and DINOv3, a state-of-the-art general-purpose model, despite approximately 150,000-fold fewer training images and nearly 40-fold fewer parameters. Over a median 4.3-year UKBB follow-up, LeDXA improved incident disease prediction over tabular DXA measures, with the largest gains for hip and knee arthrosis and type 2 diabetes. For hip arthrosis, 66% of incident cases occurred in the highest-risk quartile versus 41% for tabular measures. Its representations predicted chronological age externally (r = 0.88; mean absolute error = 2.90 years), and the biological-age gap tracked broader disease burden and a 45% higher mortality hazard in the oldest-appearing quartile. The gap also decreased in women after starting hormone-replacement therapy, suggesting it may be modifiable. Genome-wide associations recovered mostly known body-composition and bone-density loci, and LeDXA embeddings were more heritable than DINOv3's. These findings reveal prognostic information in DXA images that conventional readouts discard, learnable with relatively little data and modest compute.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍LeDXA，一种基于JEPA架构的自监督视觉模型，能从全身DXA扫描图像中学习系统健康表征。仅用11,540张未标注图像训练，即可在内部和外部队列（47,400张UK Biobank扫描）中超越传统DXA表格指标和DINOv3，在疾病预测、生物年龄估计和遗传关联等方面表现优异，表明DXA图像中蕴含传统读数忽略的预后信息。
AI.motivation: 全身DXA扫描常用于测量骨密度和身体成分，但其空间结构信息基本未被利用。本文旨在探索能否通过自监督学习从DXA图像中提取系统健康表征，挖掘传统表格读数所丢弃的影像学信息，特别是在疾病预测和生物年龄评估方面的价值。
AI.method: 提出LeDXA，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的视觉模型，通过预测潜在表征而非重建像素进行自监督学习。在11,540张未标注的人类表型组计划（Human Phenotype Project）扫描上从零训练，并在内部及47,400张外部UK Biobank扫描上进行评估，与DXA表格测量和DINOv3基线进行比较。
AI.result: LeDXA在跨队列疾病和生物标志物预测上优于传统DXA测量和DINOv3（尽管训练图像少约15万倍、参数少近40倍）。在中位4.3年随访中改善了发病预测，髋/膝关节病和2型糖尿病增益最大；髋关节病高危四分位捕获66%病例（表格指标仅41%）。外部验证中生物年龄预测r=0.88（MAE=2.90年），生物年龄差距与疾病负担相关，最高表现四分位死亡风险高45%；激素替代治疗后差距下降提示可干预性。全基因组关联研究恢复了已知位点，且嵌入的遗传力高于DINOv3。
AI.conclusion: DXA图像中包含传统读数未利用的系统健康预后信息，可通过相对较少的数据和适度计算量学习。LeDXA证明了医学影像中未被开采的表征价值，并为临床影像的自我监督学习提供了高效范式。

title: VARPose: Flexible 2D Pose Densification via Visual Autoregressive Modeling for Enhanced 3D Lifting
summary: Visual AutoRegressive Modeling (VAR) has excelled in natural image generation via next-scale prediction, but its use on topology-structured data like human skeletons is still unexplored. VARPose is proposed to adaptively densify 2D sparse poses, thereby enriching the anatomical information available for 3D lifting models. Our core contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a Granularity-agnostic Pose Tokenizer (GPT), which employs a single hybrid codebook and a residual quantization strategy to encode poses of varying densities into a unified, multi-scale discrete representation. Our results demonstrate the strong generalizability of this representation. By decoupling the representation from the projection, we can successfully decode novel pose granularities using a frozen codebook with a retrained decoder. Second, we propose UniSkelar, a unified autoregressive model that treats "joint density" as "scale". UniSkelar learns to predict the token sequence for the next density level in a coarse-to-fine manner, conditioned on the sparsest pose. VARPose not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods and generalizes to unseen granularities, but also confers tangible performance gains on downstream tasks, such as 3D Pose Estimation and Human Mesh Recovery, through 2D pose densification. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/VARPose.git.

AI.tldr: VARPose将视觉自回归建模(VAR)应用于人体骨架这一拓扑结构数据，通过自适应的2D稀疏姿态加密来丰富3D姿态提升模型所需的解剖信息。核心贡献包括：1) 提出Granularity-agnostic Pose Tokenizer (GPT)，使用单一混合码本和残差量化策略将不同密度的姿态编码为统一的多尺度离散表示；2) 提出UniSkelar统一自回归模型，将"关节密度"视为"尺度"，以粗到细的方式预测下一密度级别的token序列。
AI.motivation: 视觉自回归建模(VAR)在自然图像生成中通过下一尺度预测取得了优异表现，但尚未被应用于人体骨架等拓扑结构数据。人体姿态数据具有不同的稀疏程度，如何有效地对这些不同密度的姿态进行建模并提升3D姿态提升模型性能是一个待解决的问题。
AI.method: 1) Granularity-agnostic Pose Tokenizer (GPT)：采用单一混合码本和残差量化策略，将不同密度的2D姿态编码为统一的多尺度离散表示，解耦表示与投影，使得可以仅通过重训练解码器就能解码新的姿态粒度；2) UniSkelar：统一自回归模型，将"关节密度"视为"尺度"，以最稀疏的姿态为条件，以粗到细的方式学习预测下一密度级别的token序列。
AI.result: VARPose在3D姿态估计和人体网格恢复等下游任务上超越了最先进的现有方法，并且能够泛化到未见过的姿态粒度。
AI.conclusion: VARPose成功将VAR范式扩展到人体骨架这类拓扑结构数据，通过2D姿态加密为下游任务带来了实实在在的性能提升，证明了多尺度离散姿态表示的良好泛化能力。

title: Local Margin Restoration for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities, yet their performance frequently degrades sharply under unexpected test-time distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising solution, continuously adapting VLMs over an unlabeled test stream presents fundamental challenges. Conventional top-1-centric updates often reinforce errors by corrupting the local semantic geometry among related classes, while iterative adaptation exacerbates progressive bias accumulation, ultimately driving the model toward mode collapse. To overcome these coupled vulnerabilities, we propose Local Margin Restoration (LMR), a lightweight, one-step TTA framework. At the sample level, our Protected Margin Restoration (PMR) objective recovers local semantic geometry by shielding plausible near-top candidates from external hard negatives. Concurrently, to combat stream-level degradation, we introduce a dual-stage stabilization mechanism, featuring an Adaptive Margin (AM) controller and Bias Correction (BC), to dynamically disrupt progressive bias accumulation and prevent mode collapse. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-C, ImageNet-C, and ImageNet variants demonstrate that LMR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA baselines, proving exceptionally robust and efficient even in challenging low-batch test-time regimes. Our code is available at https://github.com/DennisHuangYan/LMR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LMR（Local Margin Restoration），一种轻量级的一步式测试时适应（TTA）框架，通过样本级别的Protected Margin Restoration（PMR）目标恢复局部语义几何，并引入双阶段稳定机制（自适应边际控制器AM和偏差校正BC）来防止渐进偏差累积和模式崩溃，在CIFAR-C、ImageNet-C及ImageNet变体上一致优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）在多种分布偏移下性能显著下降。虽然TTA是一种有前景的解决方案，但传统基于top-1更新的策略会通过破坏相关类别间的局部语义几何来强化错误，而迭代适应会加剧渐进偏差累积，最终导致模式崩溃。现有方法未能同时解决这两个耦合问题。
AI.method: LMR框架包含两大核心组件：(1) 样本层面——Protected Margin Restoration (PMR)目标：通过保护接近top的候选类别免受外部硬负样本的干扰，恢复局部语义几何；(2) 流层面——双阶段稳定机制：Adaptive Margin (AM)控制器动态调节边际以打破坏渐偏差累积，Bias Correction (BC)防止模式崩溃。整体为轻量级、一步式（one-step）适应框架。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-C、ImageNet-C和ImageNet变体等多个基准上进行的大量实验表明，LMR一致地超越了现有的SOTA TTA基线方法，并且在具有挑战性的低批次测试时场景中展现出极强的鲁棒性和高效性。
AI.conclusion: LMR通过同时解决样本级局部几何退化和流级渐进偏差累积这两个耦合问题，为VLM在测试时分布偏移下的适应提供了一种高效稳健的解决方案，代码已开源。

title: VC-Tooler: Learning Compositional and Adaptive Visual Tool Use
summary: Agentic multimodal reasoning extends passive image understanding by allowing VLMs to actively acquire and refine visual evidence through visual tool interactions. Effective visual tool use requires three capabilities: grounding tool calls in visual context, composing tools across multiple steps, and adapting reasoning to tool-returned observations. However, existing approaches largely focus on grounding within fixed tool spaces and rigid invocation patterns, leaving composition and adaptation insufficiently addressed. We present VC-Tooler, which learns visual tool use as a compositional and adaptive capability. To this end, we first build a trajectory bank through a hierarchical synthesis pipeline covering three capability levels: single-tool grounding, multi-tool composition, and diverse tool contexts and interfaces. We then train the model in two stages: a supervised cold start that establishes these capabilities, followed by reinforcement learning that encourages accurate, efficient, and context-aware visual tool use. VC-Tooler achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on both general-purpose and agentic benchmarks, including $95.8\%$ on V* and $35.3\%$ on VTC-Bench, and shows promising transfer under richer tool settings at inference time. Project page: https://w1zheng.github.io/VC-Tooler

AI.tldr: VC-Tooler是一个将视觉工具使用学习为组合性与适应性能力的框架，通过分层合成数据管线构建轨迹库，并用两阶段训练（监督冷启动+强化学习）来提升视觉语言模型在代理式多模态推理中的工具调用能力，在V*和VTC-Bench等基准上达到开源模型最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉工具使用方法大多局限于固定的工具空间和僵硬的调用模式，未能充分解决工具的组合（跨多步骤调用多个工具）和适应性（根据工具返回的观察结果调整推理策略）问题。有效的视觉工具使用需要三种能力：在视觉上下文中对工具调用进行接地、跨步骤组合工具、以及适应工具返回的观察。这三点中的后两点在现有工作中没有得到充分解决。
AI.method: 1) 通过分层合成管线构建轨迹库，覆盖三个能力层级：单工具接地、多工具组合、多样化工具上下文与接口；2) 采用两阶段训练：先进行监督冷启动以建立上述能力，再通过强化学习鼓励准确、高效且上下文感知的视觉工具使用。
AI.result: VC-Tooler在通用基准和代理基准上均达到开源模型的最先进性能，其中V*上达到95.8%，VTC-Bench上达到35.3%，并且在推理时更丰富的工具设置下展现出良好的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: VC-Tooler验证了将视觉工具使用建模为组合性和适应性能力是可行且有效的，通过分层数据合成与两阶段训练策略，显著提升了视觉语言模型的代理式多模态推理能力。

title: GenPrior: Unleashing Text-to-Motion Generative Priors for Zero-Shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition
summary: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition (ZSAR) aims to recognize unseen action categories by aligning skeleton features with textual semantics. However, existing methods rely on text-derived prototypes that inherently lack geometric structure and physical constraints, resulting in a pronounced \textit{semantic-kinematic gap}. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{GenPrior}, the first framework to exploit generative priors from pre-trained Text-to-Motion (T2M) models for ZSAR. Specifically, we introduce Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion, which distills kinematic prototypes and intra-class dispersion from generative motion sequences and employs a learned gating network to adaptively inject reliable structural cues into textual embeddings while suppressing synthetic artifacts. Furthermore, we propose Generative Prototype Refinement, which leverages these generation-enhanced prototypes as anchors to mine high-confidence unseen samples, calibrating class prototypes toward the true distribution and thereby unleashing strong performance gains. Extensive experiments on NTU-60, NTU-120, and PKU-MMD demonstrate that GenPrior achieves state-of-the-art performance under both zero-shot and generalized zero-shot settings. Code is available at https://github.com/jidongkuang/GenPrior.

AI.tldr: GenPrior是首个利用预训练Text-to-Motion (T2M)模型中的生成先验来解决零样本骨架动作识别（ZSAR）中"语义-运动学差距"问题的框架。它通过Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion将运动学原型和类内分散度从生成的运动序列中蒸馏出来，并用学习到的门控网络自适应地将结构线索注入文本嵌入中；同时通过Generative Prototype Refinement利用生成增强的原型作为锚点挖掘高置信度未见样本，校准类原型。在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有ZSAR方法依赖文本派生的原型，这些原型本质上缺乏几何结构和物理约束，导致明显的语义-运动学差距，限制了模型对未见动作类别的识别能力。
AI.method: 1) Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion：从生成的运动序列中蒸馏运动学原型和类内分散度，利用学习到的门控网络自适应地注入可靠结构线索到文本嵌入中，同时抑制合成伪影。2) Generative Prototype Refinement：将生成增强的原型作为锚点，挖掘高置信度的未见样本，校准类原型使其更接近真实分布。
AI.result: 在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD三个基准数据集上，GenPrior在零样本和广义零样本两种设置下均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了利用T2M生成先验可以有效弥合语义-运动学差距，为ZSAR提供了一种利用生成模型知识的新范式，代码已开源。

title: HarMoE: Multi-Source Chest Radiograph Pretraining with Dataset-Disentangled Experts
summary: Recent vision-language models for chest X-ray understanding are largely built on image-report alignment and therefore rely heavily on MIMIC-CXR as the dominant pretraining source. While effective at scale, this paradigm underexplores an important alternative source of supervision: a range of existing multi-label classification datasets, which provide cleaner and more explicit disease signals than free-text reports, and can offer broader pathology coverage when combined across sources. However, learning from such heterogeneous datasets is nontrivial, as differences in label ontologies, annotation protocols, acquisition pipelines, and report styles can cause models to entangle clinical semantics with dataset identity, leading to poor transfer despite increased scale. In this work, we revisit radiology VLM construction from the perspective of harmonized multi-source learning. We propose HarMoE, a dataset-aware mixture-of-experts framework that learns shared cross-dataset medical semantics while confining source-specific variation to lightweight residual experts in deeper decoder layers. To further exploit clean supervision from labeled datasets, we train in a unified disease vocabulary with masked multi-dataset supervision, enabling the model to leverage complementary annotations without introducing false negatives. Experiments on large-scale chest X-ray benchmarks show that HarMoE consistently improves zero-shot classification, out-of-distribution transfer, and grounding over strong baselines. Our results suggest that building robust radiology VLMs requires moving beyond single-source image-report alignment toward structured knowledge construction from heterogeneous datasets with cleaner supervision and broader coverage. Code and the 873k harmonized dataset will be released at https://github.com/Roypic/harmoe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarMoE框架，通过数据集感知的混合专家（mixture-of-experts）方法，在异构多标签分类数据集上学习统一的放射学视觉-语言模型，克服了传统仅依赖MIMIC-CXR图像-报告对齐范式在病理覆盖和监督信号纯净度上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有胸部X射线视觉语言模型主要基于图像-报告对齐，过度依赖MIMIC-CXR作为预训练数据源。虽然规模化有效，但忽略了多标签分类数据集这一更干净、更明确、覆盖更广的监督来源。然而异构数据集在标签本体、标注协议、采集流程和报告风格上的差异会导致模型将临床语义与数据集身份混淆，影响迁移性能。
AI.method: 提出HarMoE（数据集感知混合专家框架）：1）在较深解码器层使用轻量级残差专家来隔离数据集特定变异，同时共享跨数据集的医学语义；2）在统一疾病词表下进行掩码多数据集监督训练，利用干净标签监督并避免引入假阴性。
AI.result: 在大规模胸部X射线基准测试上，HarMoE在零样本分类、分布外迁移和视觉定位任务上均一致优于强基线方法。同时发布了包含87.3万样本的协调数据集。
AI.conclusion: 构建稳健的放射学VLM需要超越单一数据源的图像-报告对齐范式，转向从异构数据集中进行结构化知识构建，以获取更干净的监督信号和更广泛的病理覆盖。

title: Open-Set Visual Text Forensics via Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow
summary: Rapidly evolving Generative AI enables sophisticated visual text manipulations that increasingly evade current forensic detectors. Existing discriminative models often overfit specific forgery patterns, limiting their generalization to unseen, open-set attacks. To address this challenge, we propose a generative detector that localizes tampering by estimating the local restoration cost required to align a query image with authentic visual-text statistics, rather than by learning forgery-specific decision boundaries. Specifically, we introduce Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow (SC-RF), a detector-oriented adaptation of Flow Matching for spatially sparse anomaly localization. We further mitigate data scarcity via self-supervised Artifact Injection and preserve high-frequency forensic traces using a pixel-space Forensic-DiT. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing the runner-up by 3.2 and 4.8 percentage points in F1 and IoU, respectively. In particular, the proposed detector demonstrates strong zero-shot performance on challenging unseen text editing patterns. We further provide an auxiliary stress-test analysis showing that local harmonization produced by our model can weaken the statistical cues relied upon by existing detectors, offering a complementary vulnerability-analysis perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SC-RF（Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow），一种基于生成式框架的视觉文本篡改检测器。它通过估计将查询图像与真实视觉文本统计对齐所需的局部恢复成本来定位篡改区域，而非学习特定伪造模式的判别边界。在三个基准上达到SOTA，F1和IoU分别超过第二名3.2和4.8个百分点，并对未见过的文本编辑模式展现出强零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有判别式篡改检测模型容易过拟合特定伪造模式，难以泛化到未见过的开放集攻击。随着生成式AI使视觉文本操纵日益复杂，需要一种不依赖学习伪造特定决策边界、而是从生成角度建模真实图像统计的新检测范式。
AI.method: 1) 提出Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow (SC-RF)：将Flow Matching适配为面向检测器的方案，用于空间稀疏异常定位。2) 通过自监督Artifact Injection缓解数据稀缺问题。3) 使用像素空间的Forensic-DiT保留高频取证痕迹。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上取得SOTA表现，F1和IoU分别比第二名高3.2和4.8个百分点；在具有挑战性的未见文本编辑模式上展现出强零样本性能；额外压力测试表明模型产生的局部协调可弱化现有检测器依赖的统计线索。
AI.conclusion: 生成式检测框架相比判别式方法在泛化性上更具优势，通过估计恢复成本而非学习伪造边界来定位篡改，能够更好地应对快速演变的生成式篡改攻击。同时该方法还提供了互补的漏洞分析视角。

title: EOVSAM: Efficient Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with SAM 3 in One Pass
summary: Open-vocabulary segmentation identifies and segments objects from arbitrary textual descriptions. SAM 3 supports noun-phrase-guided segmentation and achieves competitive open-vocabulary performance through exhaustive vocabulary traversal, yet suffers from prohibitive computational overhead as target categories scale. In this paper, we propose an Efficient Open-Vocabulary segmentation framework with SAM 3 (EOVSAM), which adapts SAM 3 for single-pass prediction. EOVSAM removes prompt conditioning to turn SAM 3 into an efficient mask generator and introduces a new Attentional Aggregation strategy to optimize open-vocabulary classification end-to-end. This formulation avoids the multi-stage pipelines and post-processing heuristics commonly used by existing methods, while mitigating the closed-set collapse that can arise when classification is optimized directly. EOVSAM consistently improves segmentation accuracy over vanilla SAM 3 on all evaluated datasets and accelerates inference by up to 338$\times$. Furthermore, EOVSAM maintains high accuracy at lower resolutions while achieving even more remarkable inference speeds. Experiments on standard semantic and panoptic segmentation benchmarks show that EOVSAM combines competitive or state-of-the-art accuracy with a substantial speed advantage over existing open-vocabulary segmentation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/EOVSAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EOVSAM框架，将SAM 3从穷举式词汇遍历的高计算开销模式，改造为单次前向预测的高效开放词汇分割框架。通过去除提示条件使SAM 3成为高效掩码生成器，并引入注意力聚合策略优化开放词汇分类端到端学习，在提升精度的同时实现高达338倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: SAM 3虽然支持名词短语引导的分割并取得了有竞争力的开放词汇性能，但通过穷举词汇遍历实现，当目标类别数量增加时计算开销呈爆炸式增长，推理速度成为严重瓶颈。现有方法依赖多阶段流程和后处理启发式规则，且直接优化分类容易导致闭集塌缩问题。
AI.method: EOVSAM包含两个关键设计：(1) 去除提示条件（prompt conditioning），将SAM 3转变为高效掩码生成器，实现单次前向预测；(2) 引入注意力聚合（Attentional Aggregation）策略，端到端优化开放词汇分类，避免多阶段流程和后处理启发式规则，同时缓解闭集塌缩问题。
AI.result: 在所有评估数据集上，EOVSAM相比原始SAM 3一致提升分割精度，推理速度最高提升338倍。在较低分辨率下仍能保持高精度并进一步加快推理。在标准语义分割和全景分割基准上，EOVSAM达到有竞争力或最先进的精度，同时在速度上显著优于现有开放词汇分割模型。
AI.conclusion: EOVSAM证明了通过重新设计SAM 3的网络结构和训练策略，可以在不牺牲精度的情况下大幅提升开放词汇分割的推理效率，为高效开放词汇分割提供了一种新的解决方案。

title: Sen-Cap: Sensor-Flexible and Noise-Resilient Human Motion Capture via LiDAR-Camera Integration
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ECCV 2026. Aoru Xue and Yujing Sun contributed equally. Yuexin Ma is the corresponding author
summary: We propose Sen-Cap, a Sensor-Flexible and Noise-Resilient 3D human motion Capture framework that integrates multi-modal data from LiDAR and camera. While multi-modal sensors provide richer information than single-modal sensors, existing approaches still suffer from two core challenges. First, multi-modal alignment/matching across arbitrarily deployed sensors is typically handled by explicit calibration, which propagates errors under changing viewpoints and in turn constrains deployment to fixed, highly overlapped layouts. Second, prior methods degrade under severe noise or partial sensor failures, which are common in real-world environments. To address these challenges, Sen-Cap introduces a Unified Across-Sensor Motion Estimator that reconstructs local pose and shape in a human-centric space without calibrations between sensors, supporting a flexible number of sensors, as well as a Noise-Resistant Trajectory Tracker that maintains robustness under severe point cloud noise through iterative refinement. These sensor-flexible and noise-resilient features make Sen-Cap more practical in real-world deployment. Notably, operating in real time, Sen-Cap achieves state-of-the-art performance on major metrics on Human-M3 and FreeMotion, as well as strong cross-domain performance on LiDARHuman26M and RELI11D. This combination of flexibility and robustness opens new opportunities for motion capture in real-world scenarios, e.g. sports analytics, field robotics, and large-scale immersive environments.

AI.tldr: Sen-Cap是一个传感器灵活且抗噪声的3D人体运动捕捉框架，融合LiDAR和相机多模态数据，无需传感器间显式标定，通过统一跨传感器运动估计器和抗噪声轨迹跟踪器实现鲁棒的实时运动捕捉，在Human-M3、FreeMotion等数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态3D人体运动捕捉方法面临两大核心挑战：一是多传感器对齐/匹配依赖显式标定，在视角变化下会传播误差并限制部署为固定、高度重叠的布局；二是现有方法在严重噪声或部分传感器故障下性能显著退化，这在真实环境中十分常见。
AI.method: Sen-Cap提出两个关键组件：1) 统一跨传感器运动估计器（Unified Across-Sensor Motion Estimator），在人体中心空间中重建局部姿态和形状，无需传感器间标定，支持灵活数量的传感器；2) 抗噪声轨迹跟踪器（Noise-Resistant Trajectory Tracker），通过迭代精化在严重点云噪声下保持鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Human-M3和FreeMotion数据集上的主要指标达到SOTA性能，在LiDARHuman26M和RELI11D上展现出强大的跨域性能，且支持实时运行。
AI.conclusion: Sen-Cap通过传感器灵活性和噪声鲁棒性的结合，为真实世界场景（如体育分析、野外机器人、大规模沉浸式环境）中的运动捕捉开辟了新机会，使其更具实际部署价值。

title: SpikeRestormer: Towards Energy-Efficient All-in-One Image Restoration via Unified Event Reasoning
summary: ANN-based All-in-One image restoration (AiOIR) unifies diverse degradation handling but incurs high computational costs, limiting its real-time deployment. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a low-power alternative, applying them to static images remains challenging. This difficulty arises because explicit event signals are absent, and degradation cues are heavily entangled with scene structures, hindering the learning of reliable restoration-oriented spike events. To address these issues, we propose SpikeRestormer, an energy-efficient SNN for AiOIR that performs event reasoning over internally generated spike cues. Specifically, we propose a degradation-event perception process to extract spike-based degradation events through Subtractive Degradation Event Attention (SDEA). Moreover, we introduce Hierarchical Bayesian Skip Masking (HBSM) and Additive Restoration Event Attention (AREA) processes for event-reliability inference and restoration-event construction, respectively. By integrating these complementary processes, SpikeRestormer formulates restoration as a unified process of degradation-event perception, degradation-event reliability inference, and restoration-event construction, liberating the potential of SNNs for energy-efficient AiOIR. Extensive experiments show that SpikeRestormer delivers competitive performance against ANN-based methods and establishes new state-of-the-art results among SNN-based methods with significantly lower energy consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpikeRestormer，一种基于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的能耗高效全合一图像恢复（AiOIR）方法。它通过在内部生成尖峰线索并进行事件推理，解决了SNN应用于静态图像时缺乏显式事件信号和退化线索与场景结构纠缠的难题，在多个恢复任务上达到与ANN方法竞争力相当的性能，并显著降低能耗。
AI.motivation: ANN-based全合一图像恢复虽然统一了多种退化处理，但计算成本高，难以实时部署。SNN虽然提供低功耗替代方案，但将其应用于静态图像时面临两大挑战：一是缺乏显式事件信号，二是退化线索与场景结构高度纠缠，导致难以学习可靠的恢复导向尖峰事件。
AI.method: 提出SpikeRestormer框架，包含三个互补过程：(1) 退化事件感知过程，通过Subtractive Degradation Event Attention (SDEA)提取基于尖峰的退化事件；(2) Hierarchical Bayesian Skip Masking (HBSM)用于事件可靠性推断；(3) Additive Restoration Event Attention (AREA)用于恢复事件构建。三者整合形成统一的恢复流程：退化事件感知→可靠性推断→恢复事件构建。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SpikeRestormer取得了与基于ANN的方法相竞争的恢复性能，同时建立了基于SNN方法的新SOTA结果，且能耗显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将恢复任务形式化为退化事件感知、可靠性推断和恢复事件构建的统一过程，SpikeRestormer释放了SNN在能耗高效全合一图像恢复方面的潜力，为低功耗视觉恢复任务提供了新方向。

title: A General-Purpose VLM Can Teach an Astronomy Foundation Model to Better Recognize Galaxy Morphology
summary: Existing astronomy foundation models provide strong galaxy representations, but adapting them to new survey conditions and survey-specific morphology recognition tasks still requires substantial human supervision. We show that VLM-based VQA systems contain meaningful visual-semantic priors that can serve as weak supervision for downstream morphology classifiers and improve morphology classification under limited human-label budgets. We first introduce a survey-oriented VQA benchmark spanning two representative imaging regimes and evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs on galaxy morphology questions. The results show that these models capture useful morphology signals and informative uncertainty, but are not sufficiently reliable to replace human annotators. Motivated by this finding, we use a general-purpose VLM as a morphology teacher for Zoobot, an astronomy foundation model pretrained on large-scale Galaxy Zoo annotations. Across two survey domains and multiple annotation budgets, the VLM teacher consistently improves Zoobot's downstream morphology classification. These results demonstrate that a general-purpose VLM provides knowledge complementary to an astronomy foundation model and can teach it to better recognize galaxy morphology under limited human supervision. The resulting pipeline is designed for label-efficient adaptation to forthcoming large-scale surveys, including the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) and the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. The benchmark and code are publicly available at https://github.com/fw-ic/VLM-morphology-teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用通用VLM（视觉语言模型）作为弱监督教师，辅助天文学基础模型Zoobot进行星系形态分类。在有限的标注预算下，VLM教师能显著提升Zoobot在多个巡天域中的下游形态分类性能，验证了通用VLM与天文基础模型的知识互补性。
AI.motivation: 现有的天文学基础模型虽然能提供强大的星系表征，但适配新的巡天条件和特定形态识别任务仍需大量人工标注。这成为大规模巡天（如LSST和Roman）实际应用的瓶颈，因此需要探索更高效的标签利用方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建覆盖两种成像体制的巡天导向VQA基准，评估主流VLM在星系形态问题上的表现；2) 将通用VLM作为形态学教师，为Zoobot（基于大规模Galaxy Zoo标注预训练的天文基础模型）提供弱监督信号，在两个巡天域和多档标注预算下进行训练与评估。
AI.result: VLM在星系形态问题上能捕获有用的形态信号并给出有信息量的不确定性，但尚不足以完全替代人工标注；然而作为教师，VLM能持续提升Zoobot的形态分类性能，在多个巡天域和标注预算设定下均表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 通用VLM提供的知识可与天文学基础模型形成互补，在有限人工监督下显著提升星系形态识别能力。该流程面向即将到来的大规模巡天任务（LSST和Roman），具备标签高效适配的潜力。

title: CalibBEV: LiDAR-Camera Calibration via BEV Alignment
summary: We present CalibBEV, a novel Bird's Eye View (BEV) alignment approach for LiDAR-camera calibration. Our method unifies LiDAR and camera data into a shared 3D spatial representation, enabling accurate and robust cross-modal calibration. CalibBEV extracts sensor-wise BEV features from each modality using domain-specific architectures and estimates the calibration matrix through a two-step alignment process. First, we perform an implicit alignment by regressing a coarse calibration matrix directly from the BEV features. To ease this alignment, we enforce semantic consistency between BEV representations across modalities using a contrastive loss inspired by CLIP, guiding both networks toward a unified feature space. In the second step, we leverage our BEV formulation to explicitly align the features of one modality with the other, refining the initial coarse estimate into a final, more accurate calibration matrix. CalibBEV significantly outperforms prior point-to-pixel matching methods, achieving state-of-the-art calibration accuracy. On the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks, our method reduces the Relative Rotation Error (RRE) by 51% and 68%, and the Relative Translation Error (RTE) by 80% and 91%, respectively, compared to previous methods.

AI.tldr: CalibBEV是一种新颖的鸟瞰图（BEV）对齐方法，用于LiDAR-相机标定。该方法将LiDAR和相机数据统一到共享的3D空间表示中，通过两步对齐过程估计标定矩阵：首先使用对比学习损失（受CLIP启发）进行隐式粗对齐，然后通过显式特征对齐进行精细化。在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，该方法相比现有方法大幅降低了旋转误差（RRE）和平移误差（RTE），取得了最先进的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的LiDAR-相机标定方法主要依赖点到像素（point-to-pixel）的匹配，这类方法在特征对应关系上不够鲁棒，且缺乏统一的跨模态空间表示。作者希望提出一种能够将两种模态统一到共享3D空间表示中的方法，以实现更准确和更鲁棒的跨模态标定。
AI.method: CalibBEV包含三个核心组件：1) 使用领域特定的架构从每种模态提取BEV特征；2) 第一步通过直接回归粗标定矩阵实现隐式对齐，并引入受CLIP启发的对比损失强制BEV表示间的语义一致性；3) 第二步利用BEV公式将一种模态的特征显式对齐到另一种模态，优化粗估计得到最终的精确标定矩阵。
AI.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，CalibBEV相比现有方法分别将RRE降低了51%和68%，将RTE降低了80%和91%，在标定精度上达到了最先进的水平，显著优于先前的点到像素匹配方法。
AI.conclusion: CalibBEV证明了将LiDAR和相机数据统一到共享BEV空间表示中，结合隐式粗对齐和显式精对齐的两步策略，能够大幅提升跨模态标定的准确性和鲁棒性，为LiDAR-相机标定领域提供了一种高效且先进的方法。

title: GEOID-Flood: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Benchmark Dataset for Flood Segmentation
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 - Terrabytes II Workshop, 23 pages
summary: Geospatial foundation models aim to learn representations that transfer across regions and sensors, yet evaluating them on specific tasks requires large, high-quality, multi-modal benchmarks that measure how well such models extract value from data. Concerning flood mapping, existing datasets rarely combine bi-temporal SAR and co-registered optical imagery at scale, leaving the value of foundation models for this downstream task largely untested. We introduce GEOID-Flood, a large-scale multi-modal flood segmentation benchmark, derived from Copernicus Emergency Management Service activations, spanning 219 events across 65 countries over ten years. The dataset provides more than 14,000 tiles with co-registered pre- and post-event Sentinel-1, in GRD and RTC format, pre-event Sentinel-2 composite, and DEM, including manually validated labels that separate background from permanent water and flooded water. Using this benchmark, we evaluate foundation models against conventional encoders across single-image, multi-temporal, and multi-modal protocols. We report three main findings: foundation models offer a consistent but modest advantage; optical-SAR fusion with finetuning best resolves transient flooding; and models trained on GEOID-Flood transfer to unseen events better than those trained on existing datasets. Dataset and code available at https://github.com/links-ads/geoid-flood.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GEOID-Flood，一个大规模多模态洪水分割基准数据集，包含219个事件、65个国家、超过14,000个瓦片，涵盖双时相SAR（GRD和RTC格式）、光学影像、DEM及人工验证标签。通过该基准评估了基础模型与传统编码器在多种协议下的表现，发现基础模型提供一致但适度的优势，光学-SAR融合微调最能解决瞬时洪水，且在该数据集上训练的模型迁移到未见事件的效果更好。
AI.motivation: 现有的洪水测绘数据集很少在规模上将双时相SAR与共配准的光学影像结合，导致地理空间基础模型在洪水分割这一下游任务中的价值未被充分测试。缺乏大规模、高质量的多模态基准来评估基础模型在不同地区与传感器间的迁移能力。
AI.method: 从哥白尼应急管理服务（Copernicus EMS）激活数据中构建了GEOID-Flood基准数据集，涵盖10年内65个国家的219个事件，提供超过14,000个瓦片，包含共配准的事件前后Sentinel-1（GRD和RTC格式）、事件前Sentinel-2合成影像、DEM，以及将背景、永久水和洪水分别标注的人工验证标签。在此基础上，设计了单图像、多时相和多模态三种协议，对比评估基础模型与传统编码器的性能。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：1）基础模型相比传统编码器提供一致但适度的性能优势；2）光学-SAR融合并配合微调最能有效解决瞬时洪水测绘；3）在GEOID-Flood上训练的模型相比在现有数据集上训练的模型，对未见事件的迁移泛化能力更强。
